items.dz: 像机场翻牌显示器
items.de: Airport split-flap board
items.pz: 每格上下两半，翻到一半交接内容并留中缝。
items.pe: Two halves per cell, content swapping at the seam.

definition.zh: 像机场翻牌显示器
definition.en: Airport split-flap board

distinction.zh: 每格上下两半，翻到一半交接内容并留中缝。
distinction.en: Two halves per cell, content swapping at the seam.

items.dz: 旧字上移、新字顶上来
items.de: The old glyph rolls out, the new rolls in
items.pz: 两行叠放整体 translateY(-50%)，容器 overflow:hidden。
items.pe: Two stacked lines translating −50% inside a clip.

definition.zh: 旧字上移、新字顶上来
definition.en: The old glyph rolls out, the new rolls in

distinction.zh: 两行叠放整体 translateY(-50%)，容器 overflow:hidden。
distinction.en: Two stacked lines translating −50% inside a clip.

items.dz: 一道光扫过文字
items.de: A light sweeps the words
items.pz: 渐变 background-clip:text + position 平移，别用 opacity 闪。
items.pe: A panning gradient in background-clip:text — never a flash.

definition.zh: 一道光扫过文字
definition.en: A light sweeps the words

distinction.zh: 渐变 background-clip:text + position 平移，别用 opacity 闪。
distinction.en: A panning gradient in background-clip:text — never a flash.

items.dz: 字里的颜色在跑
items.de: Colour runs through the letters
items.pz: background-size 300% + linear 平移，收尾色要回到起始色。
items.pe: 300% background panning; the last stop must equal the first.

definition.zh: 字里的颜色在跑
definition.en: Colour runs through the letters

distinction.zh: background-size 300% + linear 平移，收尾色要回到起始色。
distinction.en: 300% background panning; the last stop must equal the first.

items.dz: 字像水面一样起伏
items.de: The letters bob like water
items.pz: translateY 正弦错峰，幅度别超过 .1em。
items.pe: Sine-staggered translateY, under .1em of travel.

items.dz: 每字弹一下才停
items.de: Each letter bounces once
items.pz: scale 过冲 1.24 再回 1，用 back 曲线。
items.pe: Overshoot to 1.24 and settle with a back curve.

definition.zh: 每字弹一下才停
definition.en: Each letter bounces once

distinction.zh: scale 过冲 1.24 再回 1，用 back 曲线。
distinction.en: Overshoot to 1.24 and settle with a back curve.

items.dz: 从上方掉下来砸住
items.de: They fall from above and land
items.pz: 落地时轻微压扁（scaleY .9）再回弹，才有重量。
items.pe: Squash to scaleY .9 on landing, then recover.

definition.zh: 从上方掉下来砸住
definition.en: They fall from above and land

distinction.zh: 落地时轻微压扁（scaleY .9）再回弹，才有重量。
distinction.en: Squash to scaleY .9 on landing, then recover.

items.dz: 像挂着的牌子摇进来
items.de: It swings in like a hanging sign
items.pz: transform-origin 在顶部，rotate 阻尼衰减。
items.pe: Top origin with a damped rotation.

definition.zh: 像挂着的牌子摇进来
definition.en: It swings in like a hanging sign

distinction.zh: transform-origin 在顶部，rotate 阻尼衰减。
distinction.en: Top origin with a damped rotation.

items.dz: 带斜度冲进来
items.de: It rushes in on a slant
items.pz: skewX(-12deg) + translateX，落位时归零，像惯性。
items.pe: skewX(−12deg) plus translateX, both back to zero on land.

definition.zh: 带斜度冲进来
definition.en: It rushes in on a slant

distinction.zh: skewX(-12deg) + translateX，落位时归零，像惯性。
distinction.en: skewX(−12deg) plus translateX, both back to zero on land.

items.dz: 同一个字上下两种颜色
items.de: One word, two colours
items.pz: 两层同字，上层 clip-path 只留上半。
items.pe: Two copies; clip the top one to its upper half.

definition.zh: 同一个字上下两种颜色
definition.en: One word, two colours

distinction.zh: 两层同字，上层 clip-path 只留上半。
distinction.en: Two copies; clip the top one to its upper half.

items.dz: 描边字被逐渐填满
items.de: The outline fills with ink
items.pz: 两层：下层描边、上层实心用 clip-path 推进。
items.pe: Outline below, solid above, advanced by clip-path.

definition.zh: 描边字被逐渐填满
definition.en: The outline fills with ink

distinction.zh: 两层：下层描边、上层实心用 clip-path 推进。
distinction.en: Outline below, solid above, advanced by clip-path.

items.dz: 只有轮廓
items.de: Outline only
items.pz: -webkit-text-stroke 配足够大的字号，小字会糊。
items.pe: -webkit-text-stroke needs size — small type turns to mush.

definition.zh: 只有轮廓
definition.en: Outline only

distinction.zh: -webkit-text-stroke 配足够大的字号，小字会糊。
distinction.en: -webkit-text-stroke needs size — small type turns to mush.

items.dz: 像被笔一笔写出来
items.de: As if written stroke by stroke
items.pz: 真实书写要 SVG path + dashoffset，CSS 只能近似。
items.pe: Real handwriting needs SVG paths; CSS only approximates.

definition.zh: 像被笔一笔写出来
definition.en: As if written stroke by stroke

distinction.zh: 真实书写要 SVG path + dashoffset，CSS 只能近似。
distinction.en: Real handwriting needs SVG paths; CSS only approximates.

items.dz: 偶尔撕裂错位一下
items.de: It tears for a few frames
items.pz: 只在 5% 的时间里出现，常驻就成了噪音。
items.pe: Only for 5% of the loop — constant glitch is noise.

definition.zh: 偶尔撕裂错位一下
definition.en: It tears for a few frames

distinction.zh: 只在 5% 的时间里出现，常驻就成了噪音。
distinction.en: Only for 5% of the loop — constant glitch is noise.

items.dz: 边缘泛红青
items.de: Red and cyan fringing
items.pz: 两层偏移 1–3px，混合模式用 screen 或 multiply。
items.pe: Two copies offset 1–3px in screen or multiply.

definition.zh: 边缘泛红青
definition.en: Red and cyan fringing

distinction.zh: 两层偏移 1–3px，混合模式用 screen 或 multiply。
distinction.en: Two copies offset 1–3px in screen or multiply.

items.dz: 灯管通电的感觉
items.de: Glass tubing under current
items.pz: 内白外彩多层 shadow，加不规则闪烁才像真灯。
items.pe: White core, coloured halo, irregular flicker.

definition.zh: 灯管通电的感觉
definition.en: Glass tubing under current

distinction.zh: 内白外彩多层 shadow，加不规则闪烁才像真灯。
distinction.en: White core, coloured halo, irregular flicker.

items.dz: 字有厚度
items.de: The letters have thickness
items.pz: 多层 text-shadow 逐像素偏移，最外层最深。
items.pe: Stack shadows a pixel apart, darkest at the back.

definition.zh: 字有厚度
definition.en: The letters have thickness

distinction.zh: 多层 text-shadow 逐像素偏移，最外层最深。
distinction.en: Stack shadows a pixel apart, darkest at the back.

items.dz: 一道斜影拖很远
items.de: A long diagonal shadow
items.pz: 长影用一个 45° 的实色渐变阴影，别用模糊。
items.pe: One 45° solid shadow, no blur.

definition.zh: 一道斜影拖很远
definition.en: A long diagonal shadow

distinction.zh: 长影用一个 45° 的实色渐变阴影，别用模糊。
distinction.en: One 45° solid shadow, no blur.

items.dz: 像马克笔刷了一道
items.de: Swiped with a marker
items.pz: 背景层从 0 到 100% 宽，色块略高于基线更像笔迹。
items.pe: Grow the band from zero; sit it slightly above the baseline.

definition.zh: 像马克笔刷了一道
definition.en: Swiped with a marker

distinction.zh: 背景层从 0 到 100% 宽，色块略高于基线更像笔迹。
distinction.en: Grow the band from zero; sit it slightly above the baseline.

items.dz: 线从左伸到右
items.de: The rule sweeps right
items.pz: scaleX + transform-origin:left，别动 width。
items.pe: scaleX from the left origin — never width.

definition.zh: 线从左伸到右
definition.en: The rule sweeps right

distinction.zh: scaleX + transform-origin:left，别动 width。
distinction.en: scaleX from the left origin — never width.

items.dz: 鼠标经过的那个字跳起来
items.de: The letter under the pointer jumps
items.pz: 每字单独包一层，只动被悬停的那个。
items.pe: Wrap each letter; only the hovered one moves.

definition.zh: 鼠标经过的那个字跳起来
definition.en: The letter under the pointer jumps

distinction.zh: 每字单独包一层，只动被悬停的那个。
distinction.en: Wrap each letter; only the hovered one moves.

items.dz: 经过就翻一下
items.de: It flips as you pass
items.pz: 3D 翻转要给父层 perspective，否则像平面缩放。
items.pe: Without perspective on the parent it just looks squashed.

definition.zh: 经过就翻一下
definition.en: It flips as you pass

distinction.zh: 3D 翻转要给父层 perspective，否则像平面缩放。
distinction.en: Without perspective on the parent it just looks squashed.

items.dz: 靠近的字被推开一点
items.de: Nearby letters make room
items.pz: 按到指针的距离给 margin 或 translateX 插值。
items.pe: Interpolate margin or translateX by pointer distance.

definition.zh: 靠近的字被推开一点
definition.en: Nearby letters make room

distinction.zh: 按到指针的距离给 margin 或 translateX 插值。
distinction.en: Interpolate margin or translateX by pointer distance.

items.dz: 多行文字逐行掀开
items.de: Each wrapped line reveals in turn
items.pz: 用 box-decoration-break 或按行拆分，别用整块遮罩。
items.pe: Split by line rather than masking the whole block.

definition.zh: 多行文字逐行掀开
definition.en: Each wrapped line reveals in turn

distinction.zh: 用 box-decoration-break 或按行拆分，别用整块遮罩。
distinction.en: Split by line rather than masking the whole block.

items.dz: 像播放进度扫过文字
items.de: Colour advances like playback
items.pz: 用 clip-path 推进上层彩色副本，比逐字改色省节点。
items.pe: Advance a clipped colour copy instead of recolouring each glyph.

definition.zh: 像播放进度扫过文字
definition.en: Colour advances like playback

distinction.zh: 用 clip-path 推进上层彩色副本，比逐字改色省节点。
distinction.en: Advance a clipped colour copy instead of recolouring each glyph.

items.dz: 字被横向拉开
items.de: The letters stretch wide
items.pz: 可变字宽（wdth 轴）比 scaleX 好，笔画不会变形。
items.pe: Use the wdth axis — scaleX distorts the strokes.

definition.zh: 字被横向拉开
definition.en: The letters stretch wide

distinction.zh: 可变字宽（wdth 轴）比 scaleX 好，笔画不会变形。
distinction.en: Use the wdth axis — scaleX distorts the strokes.

items.dz: 一条不断滚动的字带
items.de: An endlessly scrolling band
items.pz: 内容复制两份、平移 -50%，宽度必须整齐。
items.pe: Duplicate the content and translate −50%.

items.dz: 几行字叠着依次露出
items.de: Stacked lines reveal in order
items.pz: 行高锁定，用 clip 而不是高度动画，避免回流。
items.pe: Lock the line box and clip — never animate height.

definition.zh: 几行字叠着依次露出
definition.en: Stacked lines reveal in order

distinction.zh: 行高锁定，用 clip 而不是高度动画，避免回流。
distinction.en: Lock the line box and clip — never animate height.

items.dz: 两行长度差不多
items.de: Both lines about equal
items.pz: text-wrap:balance 给标题、pretty 给正文，一行代码的排版升级。
items.pe: text-wrap:balance for headings, pretty for body — a one-line upgrade.

definition.zh: 两行长度差不多
definition.en: Both lines about equal

distinction.zh: text-wrap:balance 给标题、pretty 给正文，一行代码的排版升级。
distinction.en: text-wrap:balance for headings, pretty for body — a one-line upgrade.

items.dz: 大字要更紧、更细
items.de: Big type wants tighter, lighter
items.pz: 字号越大，字距越负、字重可略降，视觉才平衡。
items.pe: Larger size → tighter tracking and a slightly lower weight.

definition.zh: 大字要更紧、更细
definition.en: Big type wants tighter, lighter

distinction.zh: 字号越大，字距越负、字重可略降，视觉才平衡。
distinction.en: Larger size → tighter tracking and a slightly lower weight.

items.dz: 数字用等宽、文字用比例
items.de: Tabular figures, proportional text
items.pz: 会变的数字必须 tabular-nums，否则整行都在抖。
items.pe: Changing figures need tabular-nums or the line jitters.

definition.zh: 数字用等宽、文字用比例
definition.en: Tabular figures, proportional text

distinction.zh: 会变的数字必须 tabular-nums，否则整行都在抖。
distinction.en: Changing figures need tabular-nums or the line jitters.

items.dz: 小字大写压在标题上方
items.de: A small caps line above the headline
items.pz: 眉标是唯一允许全大写的地方，字距 .14em。
items.pe: The eyebrow is the one place caps are allowed — .14em tracking.

definition.zh: 小字大写压在标题上方
definition.en: A small caps line above the headline

distinction.zh: 眉标是唯一允许全大写的地方，字距 .14em。
distinction.en: The eyebrow is the one place caps are allowed — .14em tracking.

items.dz: 第一个字特别大
items.de: The first letter goes large
items.pz: ::first-letter 加 float 与负 margin，行数取 3 行。
items.pe: ::first-letter with float and negative margin, three lines deep.

items.dz: 字像墨在纸上洇开
items.de: Ink spreading into paper
items.pz: blur + contrast 制造粘连，再叠一层清晰字。
items.pe: Blur plus contrast to fuse, with a sharp copy on top.

definition.zh: 字像墨在纸上洇开
definition.en: Ink spreading into paper

distinction.zh: blur + contrast 制造粘连，再叠一层清晰字。
distinction.en: Blur plus contrast to fuse, with a sharp copy on top.

items.dz: 字被素材填满
items.de: Letters filled with imagery
items.pz: background-clip:text 要求字重足够，细体会看不出内容。
items.pe: background-clip:text needs weight or the image vanishes.

definition.zh: 字被素材填满
definition.en: Letters filled with imagery

distinction.zh: background-clip:text 要求字重足够，细体会看不出内容。
distinction.en: background-clip:text needs weight or the image vanishes.

items.dz: 文字向远处倒下去
items.de: The type lies away from you
items.pz: rotateX 配大 perspective，别超过 40° 否则不可读。
items.pe: rotateX under a wide perspective — past 40° it is unreadable.

definition.zh: 文字向远处倒下去
definition.en: The type lies away from you

distinction.zh: rotateX 配大 perspective，别超过 40° 否则不可读。
distinction.en: rotateX under a wide perspective — past 40° it is unreadable.

items.dz: 滚动时标题变小固定
items.de: It shrinks and pins as you scroll
items.pz: 用 scroll-driven animation，别在 scroll 事件里改字号。
items.pe: Use a scroll-driven animation, not a scroll listener.

definition.zh: 滚动时标题变小固定
definition.en: It shrinks and pins as you scroll

distinction.zh: 用 scroll-driven animation，别在 scroll 事件里改字号。
distinction.en: Use a scroll-driven animation, not a scroll listener.

items.dz: 一行标题里混四种字形角色，逐词收紧点亮
items.de: Four typographic roles in one headline, tightening into place word by word
items.pz: 封面主标题按 clamp(60px,7.5vw,92px)/0.96 排，一行里混四种角色：创作者名走 accent 斜体、& 用第二色 500 斜体、Guide 与 Format 走 500 斜体、The 与 Style 保持正体。逐词从 42% 透明度、+0.035em 字距收紧到实色，读者按顺序读下来。标题下面才是 What's inside 的三列数字和目录引导点。
items.pe: The cover headline sets at clamp(60px,7.5vw,92px) on line-height .96 and mixes four roles in one line: the creator name in accent italic, the ampersand in a second colour at italic 500, Guide and Format italic 500, The and Style upright. Words arrive in reading order from 42% opacity and +.035em tracking down to solid. Only below it sit the three-column What-is-inside stats and the dotted-leader contents.

items.dz: 标点伸出文本块边界对齐。
items.de: Punctuation hangs outside the text block.
items.pz: 引号/句号悬挂出边界，正文对齐更齐。说「标点悬挂」即此。
items.pe: hanging-punctuation: first last;

definition.zh: hanging-punctuation 允许标点符号悬挂到文本块边界外，使正文边缘对齐。
definition.en: Punctuation hangs outside the text block.

distinction.zh: 与 text-indent 的区别：text-indent 缩进首行，悬挂标点是标点越界。
distinction.en: Indent vs overhang.

items.dz: 先用后备字体，加载后交换。
items.de: Show fallback first, swap when loaded.
items.pz: FOIT/FOUT 控制。说「swap」即此。
items.pe: font-display: swap;

definition.zh: font-display: swap 在字体加载期间先显示后备字体，加载完成后交换。
definition.en: Show fallback first, swap when loaded.

distinction.zh: 与 optional/block 的区别：swap 总是交换，optional 可能不交换。
distinction.en: swap always swaps; optional may not.

dz: 一个方块如何改变形状、尺寸与状态
de: How one block changes shape, size & state

items.dz: 外圆角 − 内间距 = 内圆角
items.de: Inner radius = max(0, Outer radius − Gap)
items.pz: 工业级 UI 几何法则：当内间距 < 32px 时，内圆角必须严格满足 R_inner = max(0, R_outer - gap)。若内外使用相同半径，拐角会发生拥挤变形与非平行畸变，呈现出典型的不专业套娃感。
items.pe: Industrial UI geometry rule: inner radius must equal max(0, outer radius − padding). Identical radii cause warped, crammed corners.

definition.zh: 外圆角 − 内间距 = 内圆角
definition.en: Inner radius = max(0, Outer radius − Gap)

distinction.zh: 工业级 UI 几何法则：当内间距 < 32px 时，内圆角必须严格满足 R_inner = max(0, R_outer - gap)。若内外使用相同半径，拐角会发生拥挤变形与非平行畸变，呈现出典型的不专业套娃感。
distinction.en: Industrial UI geometry rule: inner radius must equal max(0, outer radius − padding). Identical radii cause warped, crammed corners.

items.dz: 圆点横向拉长成胶囊
items.de: A dot stretches into a pill
items.pz: 同时过渡 width 与 border-radius（保持 radius = 高度的一半）。
items.pe: Transition width and border-radius together, keeping radius at half the height.

definition.zh: 圆点横向拉长成胶囊
definition.en: A dot stretches into a pill

distinction.zh: 同时过渡 width 与 border-radius（保持 radius = 高度的一半）。
distinction.en: Transition width and border-radius together, keeping radius at half the height.

items.dz: 细长按钮展开成一张卡
items.de: A slim button unfolds into a card
items.pz: 同时过渡 height 与 border-radius，从 999px 收到 16px。
items.pe: Transition height and border-radius from 999px down to 16px.

definition.zh: 细长按钮展开成一张卡
definition.en: A slim button unfolds into a card

distinction.zh: 同时过渡 height 与 border-radius，从 999px 收到 16px。
distinction.en: Transition height and border-radius from 999px down to 16px.

items.dz: 整体等比放大缩小
items.de: The block scales up and back
items.pz: 优先用 transform:scale 而不是改 width/height，避免重排。
items.pe: Prefer transform:scale over animating width/height to avoid layout thrash.

definition.zh: 整体等比放大缩小
definition.en: The block scales up and back

distinction.zh: 优先用 transform:scale 而不是改 width/height，避免重排。
distinction.en: Prefer transform:scale over animating width/height to avoid layout thrash.

items.dz: 方角到圆角连续变化
items.de: Sharp corners round off continuously
items.pz: 单独过渡 border-radius，四角可给不同值做不对称形状。
items.pe: Transition border-radius alone; per-corner values give asymmetric shapes.

definition.zh: 方角到圆角连续变化
definition.en: Sharp corners round off continuously

distinction.zh: 单独过渡 border-radius，四角可给不同值做不对称形状。
distinction.en: Transition border-radius alone; per-corner values give asymmetric shapes.

items.dz: 方块化成柔和的超椭圆
items.de: The square softens into a squircle
items.pz: 用 border-radius 百分比 + 略微不同的横纵值模拟超椭圆。
items.pe: Percentage border-radius with slightly different h/v values fakes a squircle.

definition.zh: 方块化成柔和的超椭圆
definition.en: The square softens into a squircle

distinction.zh: 用 border-radius 百分比 + 略微不同的横纵值模拟超椭圆。
distinction.en: Percentage border-radius with slightly different h/v values fakes a squircle.

items.dz: 像水滴一样缓慢扭动
items.de: Slowly wobbles like a droplet
items.pz: 循环切换多组不对称 border-radius 百分比值。
items.pe: Loop between several asymmetric border-radius percentage sets.

definition.zh: 像水滴一样缓慢扭动
definition.en: Slowly wobbles like a droplet

distinction.zh: 循环切换多组不对称 border-radius 百分比值。
distinction.en: Loop between several asymmetric border-radius percentage sets.

items.dz: 1:1 变 16:9 再变回来
items.de: Goes 1:1 → 16:9 and back
items.pz: 过渡 aspect-ratio（或直接过渡 height），宽度固定。
items.pe: Transition aspect-ratio (or height) with a fixed width.

definition.zh: 1:1 变 16:9 再变回来
definition.en: Goes 1:1 → 16:9 and back

distinction.zh: 过渡 aspect-ratio（或直接过渡 height），宽度固定。
distinction.en: Transition aspect-ratio (or height) with a fixed width.

items.dz: 折叠内容向下展开
items.de: Folded content opens downward
items.pz: 用 grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr 实现无需固定高度的展开。
items.pe: Animate grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr so no fixed height is needed.

definition.zh: 折叠内容向下展开
definition.en: Folded content opens downward

distinction.zh: 用 grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr 实现无需固定高度的展开。
distinction.en: Animate grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr so no fixed height is needed.

items.dz: 展开态干净地收回原位
items.de: The open state folds cleanly back
items.pz: 出场用比入场略短的时长和 ease-in，收得干脆。
items.pe: Exit slightly faster than enter, with ease-in, so it snaps shut.

definition.zh: 展开态干净地收回原位
definition.en: The open state folds cleanly back

distinction.zh: 出场用比入场略短的时长和 ease-in，收得干脆。
distinction.en: Exit slightly faster than enter, with ease-in, so it snaps shut.

items.dz: 容器变宽时内部从竖排变横排
items.de: Contents flip from stacked to side-by-side
items.pz: 容器宽度变化 + 内部 flex-direction 切换，用 FLIP 保证子元素平滑。
items.pe: Width change plus a flex-direction switch; use FLIP to keep children smooth.

definition.zh: 容器变宽时内部从竖排变横排
definition.en: Contents flip from stacked to side-by-side

distinction.zh: 容器宽度变化 + 内部 flex-direction 切换，用 FLIP 保证子元素平滑。
distinction.en: Width change plus a flex-direction switch; use FLIP to keep children smooth.

items.dz: 小卡片飞到大位置，像同一个物体
items.de: A thumbnail flies into a hero — same object, new place
items.pz: 记录首末位置（First/Last），用 transform 反向补偿再播放，即 FLIP。
items.pe: Measure First and Last rects, invert with transform, then Play — the FLIP technique.

definition.zh: 小卡片飞到大位置，像同一个物体
definition.en: A thumbnail flies into a hero — same object, new place

distinction.zh: 记录首末位置（First/Last），用 transform 反向补偿再播放，即 FLIP。
distinction.en: Measure First and Last rects, invert with transform, then Play — the FLIP technique.

items.dz: 卡片翻转露出背面
items.de: The card turns to show its back
items.pz: 父级 perspective + 子级 rotateY(180deg)，两面 backface-visibility:hidden。
items.pe: Perspective on the parent, rotateY(180deg) on the child, backface-visibility hidden.

definition.zh: 卡片翻转露出背面
definition.en: The card turns to show its back

distinction.zh: 父级 perspective + 子级 rotateY(180deg)，两面 backface-visibility:hidden。
distinction.en: Perspective on the parent, rotateY(180deg) on the child, backface-visibility hidden.

items.dz: 像纸一样从中间折开
items.de: Unfolds from the middle like paper
items.pz: rotateX 配合 transform-origin:top，父级加 perspective。
items.pe: rotateX with transform-origin:top and perspective on the parent.

definition.zh: 像纸一样从中间折开
definition.en: Unfolds from the middle like paper

distinction.zh: rotateX 配合 transform-origin:top，父级加 perspective。
distinction.en: rotateX with transform-origin:top and perspective on the parent.

items.dz: 内容从一个点圆形展开
items.de: Content opens as a growing circle
items.pz: clip-path:circle(0) → circle(140%)，圆心可设为点击位置。
items.pe: clip-path circle(0) → circle(140%), centred on the click point.

definition.zh: 内容从一个点圆形展开
definition.en: Content opens as a growing circle

distinction.zh: clip-path:circle(0) → circle(140%)，圆心可设为点击位置。
distinction.en: clip-path circle(0) → circle(140%), centred on the click point.

items.dz: 从一侧擦出内容
items.de: Content wipes in from one edge
items.pz: clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0)，方向可换四边。
items.pe: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0); swap sides for direction.

definition.zh: 从一侧擦出内容
definition.en: Content wipes in from one edge

distinction.zh: clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0)，方向可换四边。
distinction.en: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0); swap sides for direction.

items.dz: 一块裂成两块分开
items.de: One block splits into two
items.pz: 两个子块共用同一背景，分别向两侧位移。
items.pe: Two halves share one background and translate apart.

definition.zh: 一块裂成两块分开
definition.en: One block splits into two

distinction.zh: 两个子块共用同一背景，分别向两侧位移。
distinction.en: Two halves share one background and translate apart.

items.dz: 两块靠拢粘成一块
items.de: Two blocks slide together and fuse
items.pz: 靠拢时把相邻圆角过渡到 0，视觉上就“粘”住了。
items.pe: As they meet, transition the touching corners to 0 so they read as fused.

definition.zh: 两块靠拢粘成一块
definition.en: Two blocks slide together and fuse

distinction.zh: 靠拢时把相邻圆角过渡到 0，视觉上就“粘”住了。
distinction.en: As they meet, transition the touching corners to 0 so they read as fused.

items.dz: 有弹性的胖瘦变化
items.de: Elastic fat/thin deformation
items.pz: scaleX 与 scaleY 反向变化，总体积守恒，动画才有生命。
items.pe: scaleX and scaleY move inversely — conserving volume is what sells it.

definition.zh: 有弹性的胖瘦变化
definition.en: Elastic fat/thin deformation

distinction.zh: scaleX 与 scaleY 反向变化，总体积守恒，动画才有生命。
distinction.en: scaleX and scaleY move inversely — conserving volume is what sells it.

items.dz: 容器倾斜出速度感
items.de: A lean that reads as speed
items.pz: transform:skewX，内部内容反向 skew 抵消文字变形。
items.pe: skewX the container and counter-skew the contents so text stays upright.

definition.zh: 容器倾斜出速度感
definition.en: A lean that reads as speed

distinction.zh: transform:skewX，内部内容反向 skew 抵消文字变形。
distinction.en: skewX the container and counter-skew the contents so text stays upright.

items.dz: 圆形按钮拉开成输入框
items.de: A round button pulls open into an input
items.pz: 宽度 + 圆角同时过渡，图标固定在左侧不动。
items.pe: Transition width and radius together while pinning the icon to the left.

definition.zh: 圆形按钮拉开成输入框
definition.en: A round button pulls open into an input

distinction.zh: 宽度 + 圆角同时过渡，图标固定在左侧不动。
distinction.en: Transition width and radius together while pinning the icon to the left.

items.dz: 点击后按钮收窄成转圈
items.de: The button shrinks into a spinner
items.pz: 宽度收到与高度相等，文字淡出、spinner 淡入。
items.pe: Shrink width to equal height, cross-fade label out and spinner in.

definition.zh: 点击后按钮收窄成转圈
definition.en: The button shrinks into a spinner

distinction.zh: 宽度收到与高度相等，文字淡出、spinner 淡入。
distinction.en: Shrink width to equal height, cross-fade label out and spinner in.

items.dz: 面板从底部推上来
items.de: A panel pushes up from the bottom
items.pz: translateY(100%) → 0，顶部圆角，配合遮罩渐显。
items.pe: translateY(100%) → 0 with rounded top corners and a fading scrim.

definition.zh: 面板从底部推上来
definition.en: A panel pushes up from the bottom

distinction.zh: translateY(100%) → 0，顶部圆角，配合遮罩渐显。
distinction.en: translateY(100%) → 0 with rounded top corners and a fading scrim.

items.dz: 面板从右边滑入
items.de: A panel slides in from the right
items.pz: translateX(100%) → 0，主体内容同时轻微缩放后退。
items.pe: translateX(100%) → 0 while the page behind scales back slightly.

definition.zh: 面板从右边滑入
definition.en: A panel slides in from the right

distinction.zh: translateX(100%) → 0，主体内容同时轻微缩放后退。
distinction.en: translateX(100%) → 0 while the page behind scales back slightly.

items.dz: 列表里的卡片放大成弹窗
items.de: A list card grows into a modal
items.pz: 共享元素 + 背景遮罩渐显，卡片位移到屏幕中心并放大。
items.pe: Shared element plus a fading scrim; the card translates to center and scales up.

definition.zh: 列表里的卡片放大成弹窗
definition.en: A list card grows into a modal

distinction.zh: 共享元素 + 背景遮罩渐显，卡片位移到屏幕中心并放大。
distinction.en: Shared element plus a fading scrim; the card translates to center and scales up.

items.dz: 小图扩张到通栏
items.de: A tile expands to full bleed
items.pz: 宽高与圆角同时到满屏值，注意用 will-change 稳定合成层。
items.pe: Animate width, height and radius to full-bleed values; will-change stabilises the layer.

definition.zh: 小图扩张到通栏
definition.en: A tile expands to full bleed

distinction.zh: 宽高与圆角同时到满屏值，注意用 will-change 稳定合成层。
distinction.en: Animate width, height and radius to full-bleed values; will-change stabilises the layer.

items.dz: 方块转 45 度成菱形
items.de: The square turns 45° into a diamond
items.pz: rotate(45deg) 配合 scale 补偿，避免超出容器。
items.pe: rotate(45deg) with a compensating scale so it stays inside the frame.

definition.zh: 方块转 45 度成菱形
definition.en: The square turns 45° into a diamond

distinction.zh: rotate(45deg) 配合 scale 补偿，避免超出容器。
distinction.en: rotate(45deg) with a compensating scale so it stays inside the frame.

items.dz: 一格变宽，其他格自动让位
items.de: One panel widens, the others give way
items.pz: 用 flex:1 与 flex:3 的过渡，兄弟元素自然被挤压。
items.pe: Transition flex-grow between 1 and 3; siblings compress automatically.

definition.zh: 一格变宽，其他格自动让位
definition.en: One panel widens, the others give way

distinction.zh: 用 flex:1 与 flex:3 的过渡，兄弟元素自然被挤压。
distinction.en: Transition flex-grow between 1 and 3; siblings compress automatically.

items.dz: 尺寸变化时轻微过冲再稳定
items.de: Size changes overshoot slightly, then settle
items.pz: 用 out-back 类缓动（cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)）做一次小过冲。
items.pe: Use an out-back curve (cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)) for a single small overshoot.

definition.zh: 尺寸变化时轻微过冲再稳定
definition.en: Size changes overshoot slightly, then settle

distinction.zh: 用 out-back 类缓动（cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)）做一次小过冲。
distinction.en: Use an out-back curve (cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)) for a single small overshoot.

items.dz: 两个圆靠近时像水银黏在一起
items.de: Two circles cling like mercury as they meet
items.pz: 父级 filter:blur + contrast 组成 gooey 滤镜，子元素为纯色圆。
items.pe: Parent filter blur+contrast makes the gooey filter; children are solid circles.

definition.zh: 两个圆靠近时像水银黏在一起
definition.en: Two circles cling like mercury as they meet

distinction.zh: 父级 filter:blur + contrast 组成 gooey 滤镜，子元素为纯色圆。
distinction.en: Parent filter blur+contrast makes the gooey filter; children are solid circles.

items.dz: 内容多少都能平滑展开
items.de: Opens smoothly whatever the content height
items.pz: grid-template-rows:0fr→1fr（或 CSS calc-size），避免写死 max-height。
items.pe: grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr (or calc-size) instead of a hardcoded max-height.

definition.zh: 内容多少都能平滑展开
definition.en: Opens smoothly whatever the content height

distinction.zh: grid-template-rows:0fr→1fr（或 CSS calc-size），避免写死 max-height。
distinction.en: grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr (or calc-size) instead of a hardcoded max-height.

dz: 元素怎么出现，又怎么退场
de: How things arrive, and how they leave

items.dz: 最基础的透明度渐显
items.de: The plainest opacity fade
items.pz: opacity 0→1，200–300ms，ease-out。
items.pe: opacity 0→1 over 200–300ms with ease-out.

definition.zh: 最基础的透明度渐显
definition.en: The plainest opacity fade

distinction.zh: opacity 0→1，200–300ms，ease-out。
distinction.en: opacity 0→1 over 200–300ms with ease-out.

items.dz: 轻轻往上抬一点点出现
items.de: Rises a little as it fades in
items.pz: opacity + translateY(16px)→0，位移别超过 24px。
items.pe: opacity plus translateY(16px)→0; keep the travel under 24px.

definition.zh: 轻轻往上抬一点点出现
definition.en: Rises a little as it fades in

distinction.zh: opacity + translateY(16px)→0，位移别超过 24px。
distinction.en: opacity plus translateY(16px)→0; keep the travel under 24px.

items.dz: 从上方落下出现
items.de: Drops in from above
items.pz: translateY(-20px)→0 配合 opacity，常用于顶部通知。
items.pe: translateY(-20px)→0 with opacity — good for top notifications.

definition.zh: 从上方落下出现
definition.en: Drops in from above

distinction.zh: translateY(-20px)→0 配合 opacity，常用于顶部通知。
distinction.en: translateY(-20px)→0 with opacity — good for top notifications.

items.dz: 从左侧滑入
items.de: Slides in from the left
items.pz: translateX(-32px)→0 + opacity。
items.pe: translateX(-32px)→0 with opacity.

definition.zh: 从左侧滑入
definition.en: Slides in from the left

distinction.zh: translateX(-32px)→0 + opacity。
distinction.en: translateX(-32px)→0 with opacity.

items.dz: 从右侧滑入
items.de: Slides in from the right
items.pz: translateX(32px)→0 + opacity。
items.pe: translateX(32px)→0 with opacity.

definition.zh: 从右侧滑入
definition.en: Slides in from the right

distinction.zh: translateX(32px)→0 + opacity。
distinction.en: translateX(32px)→0 with opacity.

items.dz: 由小到大出现
items.de: Grows into place
items.pz: scale(.92)→1 + opacity，起始别小于 .8 否则显廉价。
items.pe: scale(.92)→1 with opacity; starting below .8 looks cheap.

definition.zh: 由小到大出现
definition.en: Grows into place

distinction.zh: scale(.92)→1 + opacity，起始别小于 .8 否则显廉价。
distinction.en: scale(.92)→1 with opacity; starting below .8 looks cheap.

items.dz: 弹出时略微超过再回落
items.de: Overshoots a touch, then settles
items.pz: 用 out-back 缓动 cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)，只过冲一次。
items.pe: out-back easing cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) — one overshoot only.

definition.zh: 弹出时略微超过再回落
definition.en: Overshoots a touch, then settles

distinction.zh: 用 out-back 缓动 cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)，只过冲一次。
distinction.en: out-back easing cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) — one overshoot only.

items.dz: 来回抖两下才停
items.de: Wobbles twice before it stops
items.pz: 用多关键帧模拟阻尼振荡，或用 spring 物理动画库。
items.pe: Fake damped oscillation with keyframes, or use a spring physics library.

definition.zh: 来回抖两下才停
definition.en: Wobbles twice before it stops

distinction.zh: 用多关键帧模拟阻尼振荡，或用 spring 物理动画库。
distinction.en: Fake damped oscillation with keyframes, or use a spring physics library.

items.dz: 从模糊里对焦出来
items.de: Focuses out of a blur
items.pz: filter:blur(14px)→0 配合轻微 scale，注意性能开销。
items.pe: filter blur(14px)→0 plus a slight scale; watch the paint cost.

definition.zh: 从模糊里对焦出来
definition.en: Focuses out of a blur

distinction.zh: filter:blur(14px)→0 配合轻微 scale，注意性能开销。
distinction.en: filter blur(14px)→0 plus a slight scale; watch the paint cost.

items.dz: 像卷帘一样自下而上露出
items.de: Uncovers upward like a blind
items.pz: clip-path:inset(100% 0 0 0)→inset(0)。
items.pe: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) → inset(0).

definition.zh: 像卷帘一样自下而上露出
definition.en: Uncovers upward like a blind

distinction.zh: clip-path:inset(100% 0 0 0)→inset(0)。
distinction.en: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) → inset(0).

items.dz: 一块颜色扫过后留下内容
items.de: A color bar sweeps past and leaves the content
items.pz: 覆盖层从左进右出，内容在覆盖层经过时切换可见。
items.pe: An overlay enters left and exits right; the content appears as it passes.

definition.zh: 一块颜色扫过后留下内容
definition.en: A color bar sweeps past and leaves the content

distinction.zh: 覆盖层从左进右出，内容在覆盖层经过时切换可见。
distinction.en: An overlay enters left and exits right; the content appears as it passes.

items.dz: 从中心圆形张开
items.de: Opens as a circle from the centre
items.pz: clip-path:circle(0)→circle(75%)。
items.pe: clip-path circle(0) → circle(75%).

definition.zh: 从中心圆形张开
definition.en: Opens as a circle from the centre

distinction.zh: clip-path:circle(0)→circle(75%)。
distinction.en: clip-path circle(0) → circle(75%).

items.dz: 上下两条黑边向外拉开
items.de: Two bars pull apart, cinema style
items.pz: clip-path:inset(50% 0)→inset(0)，像电影开幕。
items.pe: clip-path inset(50% 0) → inset(0).

definition.zh: 上下两条黑边向外拉开
definition.en: Two bars pull apart, cinema style

distinction.zh: clip-path:inset(50% 0)→inset(0)，像电影开幕。
distinction.en: clip-path inset(50% 0) → inset(0).

items.dz: 沿水平轴翻转进入
items.de: Flips in around the horizontal axis
items.pz: perspective + rotateX(-90deg)→0，transform-origin 居中。
items.pe: perspective with rotateX(-90deg)→0, origin centred.

definition.zh: 沿水平轴翻转进入
definition.en: Flips in around the horizontal axis

distinction.zh: perspective + rotateX(-90deg)→0，transform-origin 居中。
distinction.en: perspective with rotateX(-90deg)→0, origin centred.

items.dz: 沿竖直轴翻转进入
items.de: Flips in around the vertical axis
items.pz: perspective + rotateY(90deg)→0。
items.pe: perspective with rotateY(90deg)→0.

definition.zh: 沿竖直轴翻转进入
definition.en: Flips in around the vertical axis

distinction.zh: perspective + rotateY(90deg)→0。
distinction.en: perspective with rotateY(90deg)→0.

items.dz: 一边转一边出现
items.de: Spins as it appears
items.pz: rotate(-12deg)→0 + scale + opacity，角度要小。
items.pe: rotate(-12deg)→0 with scale and opacity; keep the angle small.

definition.zh: 一边转一边出现
definition.en: Spins as it appears

distinction.zh: rotate(-12deg)→0 + scale + opacity，角度要小。
distinction.en: rotate(-12deg)→0 with scale and opacity; keep the angle small.

items.dz: 像挂牌一样晃两下
items.de: Swings like a hanging sign
items.pz: transform-origin:top center，rotate 阻尼递减。
items.pe: transform-origin top center with a decaying rotate.

definition.zh: 像挂牌一样晃两下
definition.en: Swings like a hanging sign

distinction.zh: transform-origin:top center，rotate 阻尼递减。
distinction.en: transform-origin top center with a decaying rotate.

items.dz: 从上方掉下来弹一下
items.de: Falls in and bounces once
items.pz: 下落用 ease-in，触底后 scaleY 压扁再恢复。
items.pe: ease-in on the fall, then a squash on landing.

definition.zh: 从上方掉下来弹一下
definition.en: Falls in and bounces once

distinction.zh: 下落用 ease-in，触底后 scaleY 压扁再恢复。
distinction.en: ease-in on the fall, then a squash on landing.

items.dz: 像折纸一样打开
items.de: Unfolds like paper
items.pz: rotateX(90deg)→0，transform-origin:top，父级 perspective。
items.pe: rotateX(90deg)→0 with origin top and parent perspective.

definition.zh: 像折纸一样打开
definition.en: Unfolds like paper

distinction.zh: rotateX(90deg)→0，transform-origin:top，父级 perspective。
distinction.en: rotateX(90deg)→0 with origin top and parent perspective.

items.dz: 像镜头猛推上来
items.de: Like a lens punching in
items.pz: scale(1.4)→1 配合 blur 递减，时长要短（<400ms）。
items.pe: scale(1.4)→1 with decreasing blur; keep it under 400ms.

definition.zh: 像镜头猛推上来
definition.en: Like a lens punching in

distinction.zh: scale(1.4)→1 配合 blur 递减，时长要短（<400ms）。
distinction.en: scale(1.4)→1 with decreasing blur; keep it under 400ms.

items.dz: 带一点倾斜地冲进来
items.de: Slides in with a lean
items.pz: translateX 与 skewX 同步回零，落定瞬间摆正。
items.pe: translateX and skewX return to zero together.

definition.zh: 带一点倾斜地冲进来
definition.en: Slides in with a lean

distinction.zh: translateX 与 skewX 同步回零，落定瞬间摆正。
distinction.en: translateX and skewX return to zero together.

items.dz: 一组元素依次出现
items.de: A group arrives one after another
items.pz: 每个元素 delay = index × 60~80ms，超过 8 个要压缩间隔。
items.pe: delay = index × 60–80ms; compress the step past eight items.

definition.zh: 一组元素依次出现
definition.en: A group arrives one after another

distinction.zh: 每个元素 delay = index × 60~80ms，超过 8 个要压缩间隔。
distinction.en: delay = index × 60–80ms; compress the step past eight items.

items.dz: 卡片像发牌一样甩出来
items.de: Cards are dealt onto the table
items.pz: 从同一堆叠位置出发，位移 + 旋转 + delay 展开。
items.pe: All start from one stack, then translate and rotate out with a delay.

definition.zh: 卡片像发牌一样甩出来
definition.en: Cards are dealt onto the table

distinction.zh: 从同一堆叠位置出发，位移 + 旋转 + delay 展开。
distinction.en: All start from one stack, then translate and rotate out with a delay.

items.dz: 边滚边进来
items.de: Rolls in from the side
items.pz: translateX 与 rotate 同步，模拟滚动的物体。
items.pe: translateX paired with rotate to fake rolling.

definition.zh: 边滚边进来
definition.en: Rolls in from the side

distinction.zh: translateX 与 rotate 同步，模拟滚动的物体。
distinction.en: translateX paired with rotate to fake rolling.

items.dz: 内容一行一行擦出来
items.de: The content reveals line by line
items.pz: 每行独立 mask 上移，delay 递增。
items.pe: Each row has its own mask sliding up, delayed by index.

definition.zh: 内容一行一行擦出来
definition.en: The content reveals line by line

distinction.zh: 每行独立 mask 上移，delay 递增。
distinction.en: Each row has its own mask sliding up, delayed by index.

items.dz: 安静地消失
items.de: Quietly disappears
items.pz: 出场比入场快 20–30%，用 ease-in。
items.pe: Exit 20–30% faster than the entrance, with ease-in.

definition.zh: 安静地消失
definition.en: Quietly disappears

distinction.zh: 出场比入场快 20–30%，用 ease-in。
distinction.en: Exit 20–30% faster than the entrance, with ease-in.

items.dz: 往下沉着消失
items.de: Sinks away downward
items.pz: translateY(0→24px) + opacity→0，ease-in。
items.pe: translateY 0→24px with opacity→0, ease-in.

definition.zh: 往下沉着消失
definition.en: Sinks away downward

distinction.zh: translateY(0→24px) + opacity→0，ease-in。
distinction.en: translateY 0→24px with opacity→0, ease-in.

items.dz: 缩小并模糊地散掉
items.de: Shrinks and blurs away
items.pz: scale(1→.88) + blur(0→8px) + opacity→0。
items.pe: scale 1→.88, blur 0→8px, opacity→0.

definition.zh: 缩小并模糊地散掉
definition.en: Shrinks and blurs away

distinction.zh: scale(1→.88) + blur(0→8px) + opacity→0。
distinction.en: scale 1→.88, blur 0→8px, opacity→0.

items.dz: 被吸回原来的按钮位置
items.de: Sucked back into the button it came from
items.pz: 逆向 FLIP：缩放并位移回触发元素的中心。
items.pe: Reverse FLIP: scale and translate back to the trigger centre.

definition.zh: 被吸回原来的按钮位置
definition.en: Sucked back into the button it came from

distinction.zh: 逆向 FLIP：缩放并位移回触发元素的中心。
distinction.en: Reverse FLIP: scale and translate back to the trigger centre.

items.dz: 像沙子一样碎掉消失
items.de: Crumbles away like sand
items.pz: 用噪声 mask 配合 mask-position/opacity 动画做溶解。
items.pe: A noise mask animated over mask-position/opacity gives the dissolve.

definition.zh: 像沙子一样碎掉消失
definition.en: Crumbles away like sand

distinction.zh: 用噪声 mask 配合 mask-position/opacity 动画做溶解。
distinction.en: A noise mask animated over mask-position/opacity gives the dissolve.

dz: 从一屏到另一屏之间发生了什么
de: What happens between one screen and the next

items.dz: A 淡出的同时 B 淡入
items.de: A fades out while B fades in
items.pz: 用 View Transitions API 的默认过渡即可，200–300ms。
items.pe: The default View Transitions cross-fade, 200–300ms.

definition.zh: A 淡出的同时 B 淡入
definition.en: A fades out while B fades in

distinction.zh: 用 View Transitions API 的默认过渡即可，200–300ms。
distinction.en: The default View Transitions cross-fade, 200–300ms.

items.dz: B 从右侧盖在 A 上面
items.de: B slides in on top of A
items.pz: 新页 translateX(100%)→0，旧页不动，加一层暗色遮罩。
items.pe: New view translateX(100%)→0 over a static old view plus a scrim.

definition.zh: B 从右侧盖在 A 上面
definition.en: B slides in on top of A

distinction.zh: 新页 translateX(100%)→0，旧页不动，加一层暗色遮罩。
distinction.en: New view translateX(100%)→0 over a static old view plus a scrim.

items.dz: B 把 A 推出屏幕
items.de: B pushes A off screen
items.pz: 两页同速同向位移 100%，像胶片一样连着走。
items.pe: Both views translate 100% at the same speed, like film frames.

definition.zh: B 把 A 推出屏幕
definition.en: B pushes A off screen

distinction.zh: 两页同速同向位移 100%，像胶片一样连着走。
distinction.en: Both views translate 100% at the same speed, like film frames.

items.dz: 旧页轻微后退，新页盖上
items.de: The old view recedes as the new one covers it
items.pz: 旧页 translateX(-30%) + 变暗，新页 translateX(100%)→0。
items.pe: Old view translateX(-30%) and dims; new view slides fully in.

definition.zh: 旧页轻微后退，新页盖上
definition.en: The old view recedes as the new one covers it

distinction.zh: 旧页 translateX(-30%) + 变暗，新页 translateX(100%)→0。
distinction.en: Old view translateX(-30%) and dims; new view slides fully in.

items.dz: A 滑走，露出下面的 B
items.de: A slides away to uncover B
items.pz: B 固定在底层，A 位移出画，注意 z-index。
items.pe: B sits underneath; A translates out. Mind the z-index.

definition.zh: A 滑走，露出下面的 B
definition.en: A slides away to uncover B

distinction.zh: B 固定在底层，A 位移出画，注意 z-index。
distinction.en: B sits underneath; A translates out. Mind the z-index.

items.dz: 同一个元素跨页连续移动
items.de: One element carries across both views
items.pz: View Transitions 里给两侧同名 view-transition-name。
items.pe: Give both sides the same view-transition-name.

items.dz: 点哪张卡就从哪张放大进去
items.de: The tapped card expands into the detail view
items.pz: 以点击点为 transform-origin 做 scale + 淡入。
items.pe: scale and fade with transform-origin at the click point.

definition.zh: 点哪张卡就从哪张放大进去
definition.en: The tapped card expands into the detail view

distinction.zh: 以点击点为 transform-origin 做 scale + 淡入。
distinction.en: scale and fade with transform-origin at the click point.

items.dz: 从点击处圆形扩开新页
items.de: The new view opens as a circle from the tap
items.pz: clip-path:circle(0 at 点击点)→circle(150%)。
items.pe: clip-path circle(0 at click) → circle(150%).

definition.zh: 从点击处圆形扩开新页
definition.en: The new view opens as a circle from the tap

distinction.zh: clip-path:circle(0 at 点击点)→circle(150%)。
distinction.en: clip-path circle(0 at click) → circle(150%).

items.dz: 画面从中间分开露出新页
items.de: The old view parts down the middle
items.pz: A 用两半 clip-path 向两侧移出。
items.pe: Clip A into two halves and move them apart.

definition.zh: 画面从中间分开露出新页
definition.en: The old view parts down the middle

distinction.zh: A 用两半 clip-path 向两侧移出。
distinction.en: Clip A into two halves and move them apart.

items.dz: 一道斜线扫过换页
items.de: A diagonal edge sweeps the page over
items.pz: 用带角度的 clip-path polygon 做扫除。
items.pe: An angled clip-path polygon does the wipe.

definition.zh: 一道斜线扫过换页
definition.en: A diagonal edge sweeps the page over

distinction.zh: 用带角度的 clip-path polygon 做扫除。
distinction.en: An angled clip-path polygon does the wipe.

items.dz: 像卡片一样翻到背面
items.de: The whole view flips like a card
items.pz: 容器 perspective，A/B 分别 rotateY 0/180 并隐藏背面。
items.pe: Perspective on the wrapper; A and B at rotateY 0/180 with hidden backfaces.

definition.zh: 像卡片一样翻到背面
definition.en: The whole view flips like a card

distinction.zh: 容器 perspective，A/B 分别 rotateY 0/180 并隐藏背面。
distinction.en: Perspective on the wrapper; A and B at rotateY 0/180 with hidden backfaces.

items.dz: 弹窗从 96% 放大浮现
items.de: The dialog scales up from 96%
items.pz: 遮罩淡入 + 弹窗 scale(.96)→1，退出更快。
items.pe: Scrim fades in; dialog scale(.96)→1. Exit faster than enter.

definition.zh: 弹窗从 96% 放大浮现
definition.en: The dialog scales up from 96%

distinction.zh: 遮罩淡入 + 弹窗 scale(.96)→1，退出更快。
distinction.en: Scrim fades in; dialog scale(.96)→1. Exit faster than enter.

items.dz: 从底部拉起的半屏面板
items.de: A half-height panel pulled up from the bottom
items.pz: translateY(100%)→0，支持拖拽回落与惯性。
items.pe: translateY(100%)→0, with drag-to-dismiss and momentum.

definition.zh: 从底部拉起的半屏面板
definition.en: A half-height panel pulled up from the bottom

distinction.zh: translateY(100%)→0，支持拖拽回落与惯性。
distinction.en: translateY(100%)→0, with drag-to-dismiss and momentum.

items.dz: 下划线滑到新标签
items.de: The indicator slides to the new tab
items.pz: 一个共享指示条，用 transform 移动到目标 tab 的位置和宽度。
items.pe: One shared bar, moved and resized with transform to the active tab.

definition.zh: 下划线滑到新标签
definition.en: The indicator slides to the new tab

distinction.zh: 一个共享指示条，用 transform 移动到目标 tab 的位置和宽度。
distinction.en: One shared bar, moved and resized with transform to the active tab.

items.dz: 内容换的同时轻微上移
items.de: Panels cross-fade with a small rise
items.pz: 旧内容 fade+下移出，新内容 fade+上移入，错开 60ms。
items.pe: Old panel fades down and out, new one rises in, offset by 60ms.

definition.zh: 内容换的同时轻微上移
definition.en: Panels cross-fade with a small rise

distinction.zh: 旧内容 fade+下移出，新内容 fade+上移入，错开 60ms。
distinction.en: Old panel fades down and out, new one rises in, offset by 60ms.

items.dz: 下一步从右进，上一步从左回
items.de: Next slides in from the right, back returns from the left
items.pz: 记录方向，正反向用同一套动画传入 direction 参数。
items.pe: Track direction and feed it into one shared animation.

definition.zh: 下一步从右进，上一步从左回
definition.en: Next slides in from the right, back returns from the left

distinction.zh: 记录方向，正反向用同一套动画传入 direction 参数。
distinction.en: Track direction and feed it into one shared animation.

items.dz: 换页时轻轻上抬淡入
items.de: Routes fade up gently
items.pz: 页面级过渡 300–360ms，位移别超过 16px。
items.pe: Page-level 300–360ms, travel under 16px.

definition.zh: 换页时轻轻上抬淡入
definition.en: Routes fade up gently

distinction.zh: 页面级过渡 300–360ms，位移别超过 16px。
distinction.en: Page-level 300–360ms, travel under 16px.

items.dz: 中间闪过一块品牌色再进新页
items.de: A brand-color panel bridges the two views
items.pz: 色块从下方覆盖再撤走，两段动画之间切换路由。
items.pe: A panel covers, the route swaps behind it, then it leaves.

definition.zh: 中间闪过一块品牌色再进新页
definition.en: A brand-color panel bridges the two views

distinction.zh: 色块从下方覆盖再撤走，两段动画之间切换路由。
distinction.en: A panel covers, the route swaps behind it, then it leaves.

items.dz: 点击的行原地长成整页
items.de: The tapped row grows into the full page
items.pz: 行的 rect 作为起点，FLIP 到详情页的 rect。
items.pe: Use the row rect as the FLIP origin for the detail page.

definition.zh: 点击的行原地长成整页
definition.en: The tapped row grows into the full page

distinction.zh: 行的 rect 作为起点，FLIP 到详情页的 rect。
distinction.en: Use the row rect as the FLIP origin for the detail page.

items.dz: 当前卡甩出，下一张顶上来
items.de: The top card flies out and the next steps up
items.pz: 甩出用 translateX + rotate，下层卡 scale 从 .94 到 1。
items.pe: Fling with translateX + rotate; the card below scales .94 → 1.

definition.zh: 当前卡甩出，下一张顶上来
definition.en: The top card flies out and the next steps up

distinction.zh: 甩出用 translateX + rotate，下层卡 scale 从 .94 到 1。
distinction.en: Fling with translateX + rotate; the card below scales .94 → 1.

items.dz: 一个收起、另一个同时展开
items.de: One collapses exactly as the other opens
items.pz: 两段动画共用时长，收起用 ease-in、展开用 ease-out。
items.pe: Shared duration; ease-in on the collapse, ease-out on the open.

definition.zh: 一个收起、另一个同时展开
definition.en: One collapses exactly as the other opens

distinction.zh: 两段动画共用时长，收起用 ease-in、展开用 ease-out。
distinction.en: Shared duration; ease-in on the collapse, ease-out on the open.

items.dz: 旧页虚掉，新页对焦
items.de: The old view blurs out, the new one focuses
items.pz: A blur+scale 放大淡出，B blur→0 缩回，营造纵深。
items.pe: A blurs and scales up out; B focuses and scales down in.

definition.zh: 旧页虚掉，新页对焦
definition.en: The old view blurs out, the new one focuses

distinction.zh: A blur+scale 放大淡出，B blur→0 缩回，营造纵深。
distinction.en: A blurs and scales up out; B focuses and scales down in.

items.dz: 上下两块向外拉开
items.de: Two halves pull apart top and bottom
items.pz: 两个覆盖层分别向上下移出，中间露出内容。
items.pe: Two covers move out vertically, exposing the content.

definition.zh: 上下两块向外拉开
definition.en: Two halves pull apart top and bottom

distinction.zh: 两个覆盖层分别向上下移出，中间露出内容。
distinction.en: Two covers move out vertically, exposing the content.

items.dz: 旧页缩小退到后面
items.de: The old view shrinks back into depth
items.pz: A scale(.9)+圆角+变暗，B 从底部升起。
items.pe: A scales to .9 with rounded corners and dims; B rises from below.

definition.zh: 旧页缩小退到后面
definition.en: The old view shrinks back into depth

distinction.zh: A scale(.9)+圆角+变暗，B 从底部升起。
distinction.en: A scales to .9 with rounded corners and dims; B rises from below.

items.dz: 换页时先出骨架再填内容
items.de: A skeleton bridges the wait before content lands
items.pz: 路由切换先渲染 skeleton，数据到位后交叉淡入。
items.pe: Render the skeleton on navigation, cross-fade when data lands.

definition.zh: 换页时先出骨架再填内容

distinction.zh: 路由切换先渲染 skeleton，数据到位后交叉淡入。
distinction.en: Render the skeleton on navigation, cross-fade when data lands.

items.dz: 状态切换用短淡入淡出表达连续性，不隐藏内容。
items.de: Use a short crossfade to express continuity without hiding content.
items.pz: 状态切换用短淡入淡出表达连续性，不隐藏内容。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Use a short crossfade to express continuity without hiding content. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.
