distinction.en: cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) — small elements, small amounts.

items.dz: 先后撤一点再出发
items.de: Pulls back before it goes
items.pz: 起手反向 8–10%，动画立刻有了重量。
items.pe: A reverse of 8–10% at the start gives the move weight.

definition.zh: 先后撤一点再出发
definition.en: Pulls back before it goes

distinction.zh: 起手反向 8–10%，动画立刻有了重量。
distinction.en: A reverse of 8–10% at the start gives the move weight.

items.dz: 来回振荡逐渐停住
items.de: Oscillates and damps out
items.pz: 用物理弹簧（stiffness/damping）而不是固定时长，交互跟手。
items.pe: Physical spring (stiffness/damping) instead of a fixed duration.

definition.zh: 来回振荡逐渐停住
definition.en: Oscillates and damps out

distinction.zh: 用物理弹簧（stiffness/damping）而不是固定时长，交互跟手。
distinction.en: Physical spring (stiffness/damping) instead of a fixed duration.

items.dz: 夸张的弹性，卡通感
items.de: Exaggerated elasticity — cartoon energy
items.pz: 振幅大、频率高，慎用，只适合玩具型产品。
items.pe: High amplitude and frequency — reserve it for playful products.

definition.zh: 夸张的弹性，卡通感
definition.en: Exaggerated elasticity — cartoon energy

distinction.zh: 振幅大、频率高，慎用，只适合玩具型产品。
distinction.en: High amplitude and frequency — reserve it for playful products.

items.dz: 掉下来弹几下
items.de: Drops and bounces a few times
items.pz: 每次弹跳高度衰减 40–50%，触底压扁一帧。
items.pe: Each bounce loses 40–50% height, with a squash at contact.

definition.zh: 掉下来弹几下
definition.en: Drops and bounces a few times

distinction.zh: 每次弹跳高度衰减 40–50%，触底压扁一帧。
distinction.en: Each bounce loses 40–50% height, with a squash at contact.

items.dz: 一格一格跳，像秒针
items.de: Jumps frame by frame, like a second hand
items.pz: steps(n) 用于精灵图、打字机、秒表。
items.pe: steps(n) is for sprite sheets, typewriters, tickers.

definition.zh: 一格一格跳，像秒针
definition.en: Jumps frame by frame, like a second hand

distinction.zh: steps(n) 用于精灵图、打字机、秒表。
distinction.en: steps(n) is for sprite sheets, typewriters, tickers.

items.dz: 同一曲线，快慢完全两种性格
items.de: Same curve, two totally different personalities
items.pz: 微交互 120ms、常规 200–300ms、页面级 360–500ms。
items.pe: Micro 120ms, standard 200–300ms, page-level 360–500ms.

definition.zh: 同一曲线，快慢完全两种性格
definition.en: Same curve, two totally different personalities

distinction.zh: 微交互 120ms、常规 200–300ms、页面级 360–500ms。
distinction.en: Micro 120ms, standard 200–300ms, page-level 360–500ms.

items.dz: 一个接一个地启动
items.de: Each one starts after the last
items.pz: delay = index × 步长，步长 50–90ms 最舒服。
items.pe: delay = index × step, 50–90ms feels best.

definition.zh: 一个接一个地启动
definition.en: Each one starts after the last

distinction.zh: delay = index × 步长，步长 50–90ms 最舒服。
distinction.en: delay = index × step, 50–90ms feels best.

items.dz: 后一个动作在前一个结束前就开始
items.de: The next move starts before the last one ends
items.pz: 相邻动画重叠 30–50%，整体更连贯不拖沓。
items.pe: Overlap neighbouring animations by 30–50% to keep it fluid.

definition.zh: 后一个动作在前一个结束前就开始
definition.en: The next move starts before the last one ends

distinction.zh: 相邻动画重叠 30–50%，整体更连贯不拖沓。
distinction.en: Overlap neighbouring animations by 30–50% to keep it fluid.

items.dz: 主体停了，附属还在动
items.de: The body stops, the trailing part keeps going
items.pz: 子元素比父元素晚 60–120ms 停，动画立刻有质感。
items.pe: Let children settle 60–120ms after the parent.

definition.zh: 主体停了，附属还在动
definition.en: The body stops, the trailing part keeps going

distinction.zh: 子元素比父元素晚 60–120ms 停，动画立刻有质感。
distinction.en: Let children settle 60–120ms after the parent.

items.dz: 主动作之外的一点点附加运动
items.de: A small extra motion riding on the main one
items.pz: 主体位移时给内部元素反向微移，制造惯性。
items.pe: Counter-move the contents slightly to fake inertia.

definition.zh: 主动作之外的一点点附加运动
definition.en: A small extra motion riding on the main one

distinction.zh: 主体位移时给内部元素反向微移，制造惯性。
distinction.en: Counter-move the contents slightly to fake inertia.

items.dz: 越快越斜，停下就正
items.de: Faster means more lean; it straightens on stop
items.pz: 把速度映射到 skewX，速度归零时角度归零。
items.pe: Map velocity onto skewX; zero velocity, zero angle.

definition.zh: 越快越斜，停下就正
definition.en: Faster means more lean; it straightens on stop

distinction.zh: 把速度映射到 skewX，速度归零时角度归零。
distinction.en: Map velocity onto skewX; zero velocity, zero angle.

items.dz: 来回摆动不间断
items.de: Swings back and forth forever
items.pz: animation-direction:alternate，别用两段动画拼。
items.pe: Use animation-direction:alternate rather than two chained animations.

definition.zh: 来回摆动不间断
definition.en: Swings back and forth forever

distinction.zh: animation-direction:alternate，别用两段动画拼。
distinction.en: Use animation-direction:alternate rather than two chained animations.

items.dz: 动一下、停一会儿、再动
items.de: Move, hold, move again
items.pz: 在关键帧里留 30–40% 的静止段，比加 delay 更可控。
items.pe: Hold for 30–40% of the keyframes instead of adding a delay.

definition.zh: 动一下、停一会儿、再动
definition.en: Move, hold, move again

distinction.zh: 在关键帧里留 30–40% 的静止段，比加 delay 更可控。
distinction.en: Hold for 30–40% of the keyframes instead of adding a delay.

items.dz: 沿一条曲线走，而不是直线
items.de: Follows a curve rather than a straight line
items.pz: CSS offset-path:path(...) + offset-distance 动画。
items.pe: CSS offset-path:path(...) animated via offset-distance.

definition.zh: 沿一条曲线走，而不是直线
definition.en: Follows a curve rather than a straight line

distinction.zh: CSS offset-path:path(...) + offset-distance 动画。
distinction.en: CSS offset-path:path(...) animated via offset-distance.

items.dz: 系统开了“减弱动效”就只留淡入
items.de: With reduced-motion on, keep only a fade
items.pz: @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){动画时长设为 .01ms 或只留 opacity}。
items.pe: Under prefers-reduced-motion, drop to opacity-only or 0.01ms.

definition.zh: 系统开了“减弱动效”就只留淡入
definition.en: With reduced-motion on, keep only a fade

distinction.zh: @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){动画时长设为 .01ms 或只留 opacity}。
distinction.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion, drop to opacity-only or 0.01ms.

items.dz: 从一角扩散到整个网格
items.de: Ripples across a grid from one corner
items.pz: delay 由行列距离决定（曼哈顿距离或欧氏距离）。
items.pe: Delay from grid distance — Manhattan or Euclidean.

definition.zh: 从一角扩散到整个网格
definition.en: Ripples across a grid from one corner

distinction.zh: delay 由行列距离决定（曼哈顿距离或欧氏距离）。
distinction.en: Delay from grid distance — Manhattan or Euclidean.

items.dz: 多个元素按剧本先后出场
items.de: Several elements enter on a script
items.pz: 用时间线工具（GSAP timeline / Web Animations）统一编排，别各写各的 delay。
items.pe: Use a timeline (GSAP / WAAPI) instead of scattering delays.

definition.zh: 多个元素按剧本先后出场
definition.en: Several elements enter on a script

distinction.zh: 用时间线工具（GSAP timeline / Web Animations）统一编排，别各写各的 delay。
distinction.en: Use a timeline (GSAP / WAAPI) instead of scattering delays.

dz: 有质量、有阻尼、有摩擦，动效才可信
de: Mass, damping and friction are what make motion believable

items.dz: 过冲一点再回来
items.de: It overshoots, then settles
items.pz: 刚度 / 阻尼 / 质量三参数，别用固定时长曲线硬凑。
items.pe: Stiffness, damping, mass — not a fixed-duration curve.

definition.zh: 过冲一点再回来
definition.en: It overshoots, then settles

distinction.zh: 刚度 / 阻尼 / 质量三参数，别用固定时长曲线硬凑。
distinction.en: Stiffness, damping, mass — not a fixed-duration curve.

items.dz: 摆动越来越小
items.de: The swing keeps shrinking
items.pz: 每次振幅乘 0.5–0.6，三次以内必须停。
items.pe: Multiply amplitude by 0.5–0.6; stop within three cycles.

definition.zh: 摆动越来越小
definition.en: The swing keeps shrinking

distinction.zh: 每次振幅乘 0.5–0.6，三次以内必须停。
distinction.en: Multiply amplitude by 0.5–0.6; stop within three cycles.

items.dz: 落地压扁、起跳拉长
items.de: Squash on impact, stretch on launch
items.pz: 体积守恒：scaleX 与 scaleY 互为倒数。
items.pe: Conserve volume — scaleX and scaleY are reciprocals.

definition.zh: 落地压扁、起跳拉长
definition.en: Squash on impact, stretch on launch

distinction.zh: 体积守恒：scaleX 与 scaleY 互为倒数。
distinction.en: Conserve volume — scaleX and scaleY are reciprocals.

items.dz: 弹几次高度递减
items.de: Each bounce is lower
items.pz: 每次弹起约为上次的 45%，间隔也随之变短。
items.pe: Each bounce ≈45% of the last, with shorter gaps.

definition.zh: 弹几次高度递减
definition.en: Each bounce is lower

distinction.zh: 每次弹起约为上次的 45%，间隔也随之变短。
distinction.en: Each bounce ≈45% of the last, with shorter gaps.

items.dz: 越掉越快
items.de: It falls faster and faster
items.pz: 位移 ∝ t²，用 ease-in（cubic-bezier(.5,0,1,1)）近似。
items.pe: Displacement ∝ t² — approximate with a strong ease-in.

definition.zh: 越掉越快
definition.en: It falls faster and faster

distinction.zh: 位移 ∝ t²，用 ease-in（cubic-bezier(.5,0,1,1)）近似。
distinction.en: Displacement ∝ t² — approximate with a strong ease-in.

items.dz: 两端慢、中间快
items.de: Slow at the ends, fast in the middle
items.pz: 钟摆用 sine 缓动（in-out），不能用匀速。
items.pe: A pendulum is sine-eased in and out, never linear.

definition.zh: 两端慢、中间快
definition.en: Slow at the ends, fast in the middle

distinction.zh: 钟摆用 sine 缓动（in-out），不能用匀速。
distinction.en: A pendulum is sine-eased in and out, never linear.

items.dz: 停下时还往前滑一点
items.de: It slides on after you let go
items.pz: 松手速度 × 摩擦系数逐帧衰减，低于阈值归零。
items.pe: Decay release velocity by friction each frame.

definition.zh: 停下时还往前滑一点
definition.en: It slides on after you let go

distinction.zh: 松手速度 × 摩擦系数逐帧衰减，低于阈值归零。
distinction.en: Decay release velocity by friction each frame.

items.dz: 后面的元素慢一拍
items.de: The trailing element lags
items.pz: lerp 系数 0.1–0.2，越小越黏。
items.pe: A lerp factor of 0.1–0.2 — smaller feels heavier.

definition.zh: 后面的元素慢一拍
definition.en: The trailing element lags

distinction.zh: lerp 系数 0.1–0.2，越小越黏。
distinction.en: A lerp factor of 0.1–0.2 — smaller feels heavier.

items.dz: 一串跟着头部摆
items.de: A chain follows its head
items.pz: 每节延迟 60ms、幅度递增，形成鞭状。
items.pe: Delay each link 60ms with growing amplitude.

definition.zh: 一串跟着头部摆
definition.en: A chain follows its head

distinction.zh: 每节延迟 60ms、幅度递增，形成鞭状。
distinction.en: Delay each link 60ms with growing amplitude.

items.dz: 像果冻一样晃
items.de: It wobbles like jelly
items.pz: skewX 与 skewY 交替衰减，别用 scale。
items.pe: Alternate decaying skewX and skewY — not scale.

definition.zh: 像果冻一样晃
definition.en: It wobbles like jelly

distinction.zh: skewX 与 skewY 交替衰减，别用 scale。
distinction.en: Alternate decaying skewX and skewY — not scale.

items.dz: 被拉长再弹回
items.de: Stretched, then snapped back
items.pz: 拉伸方向与运动方向一致，回弹要快。
items.pe: Stretch along the motion vector; snap back fast.

definition.zh: 被拉长再弹回
definition.en: Stretched, then snapped back

distinction.zh: 拉伸方向与运动方向一致，回弹要快。
distinction.en: Stretch along the motion vector; snap back fast.

items.dz: 靠近就被吸住
items.de: It gets caught
items.pz: 进入阈值后用 spring 快速吸附，别线性。
items.pe: Inside the threshold, spring in — never linear.

definition.zh: 靠近就被吸住
definition.en: It gets caught

distinction.zh: 进入阈值后用 spring 快速吸附，别线性。
distinction.en: Inside the threshold, spring in — never linear.

items.dz: 撞上去把力传下去
items.de: The impact travels through
items.pz: 前一个停住的瞬间下一个启动，节奏差 40ms。
items.pe: The next starts as the previous stops — 40ms apart.

definition.zh: 撞上去把力传下去
definition.en: The impact travels through

distinction.zh: 前一个停住的瞬间下一个启动，节奏差 40ms。
distinction.en: The next starts as the previous stops — 40ms apart.

items.dz: 两头交替摆动
items.de: The ends take turns
items.pz: 中间几颗完全不动，这才是牛顿摆的关键。
items.pe: The middle balls must not move at all.

definition.zh: 两头交替摆动
definition.en: The ends take turns

distinction.zh: 中间几颗完全不动，这才是牛顿摆的关键。
distinction.en: The middle balls must not move at all.

items.dz: 慢慢磨到停
items.de: It grinds to a halt
items.pz: 摩擦是线性衰减，与惯性的指数衰减不同。
items.pe: Friction decays linearly — inertia decays exponentially.

definition.zh: 慢慢磨到停
definition.en: It grinds to a halt

distinction.zh: 摩擦是线性衰减，与惯性的指数衰减不同。
distinction.en: Friction decays linearly — inertia decays exponentially.

items.dz: 走多远就转多少
items.de: Distance equals rotation
items.pz: 旋转角 = 位移 / 半径，不同步就像在滑。
items.pe: Angle = distance / radius, or it looks like sliding.

definition.zh: 走多远就转多少
definition.en: Distance equals rotation

distinction.zh: 旋转角 = 位移 / 半径，不同步就像在滑。
distinction.en: Angle = distance / radius, or it looks like sliding.

items.dz: 重的慢、轻的快
items.de: Heavy is slow, light is quick
items.pz: 质量差异用时长 + 过冲量表达，别只改速度。
items.pe: Express mass with duration and overshoot, not speed alone.

definition.zh: 重的慢、轻的快
definition.en: Heavy is slow, light is quick

distinction.zh: 质量差异用时长 + 过冲量表达，别只改速度。
distinction.en: Express mass with duration and overshoot, not speed alone.

items.dz: 先反向一点再出发
items.de: A tiny wind-up first
items.pz: 反向 8–12% 幅度，时长占总时长 15%。
items.pe: Wind back 8–12% for about 15% of the duration.

items.dz: 主体停了附件还在动
items.de: The body stops, the parts keep going
items.pz: 附属元素延后 60–120ms 停止，动画才不僵。
items.pe: Let secondary parts settle 60–120ms later.

definition.zh: 主体停了附件还在动
definition.en: The body stops, the parts keep going

distinction.zh: 附属元素延后 60–120ms 停止，动画才不僵。
distinction.en: Let secondary parts settle 60–120ms later.

items.dz: 不走直线走弧线
items.de: It curves instead of going straight
items.pz: 真实物体几乎不走直线，X 与 Y 用不同缓动。
items.pe: Real things arc — give X and Y different easings.

definition.zh: 不走直线走弧线
definition.en: It curves instead of going straight

distinction.zh: 真实物体几乎不走直线，X 与 Y 用不同缓动。
distinction.en: Real things arc — give X and Y different easings.

items.dz: 一个还没停下一个已开始
items.de: The next starts before the last ends
items.pz: 错峰 60–80ms 是重叠，超过 200ms 就成排队。
items.pe: 60–80ms overlaps; past 200ms it reads as a queue.

definition.zh: 一个还没停下一个已开始
definition.en: The next starts before the last ends

distinction.zh: 错峰 60–80ms 是重叠，超过 200ms 就成排队。
distinction.en: 60–80ms overlaps; past 200ms it reads as a queue.

items.dz: 最后 2px 的收敛
items.de: The last two pixels
items.pz: 收尾的小幅回弹是“质感”的来源，幅度 1–3px。
items.pe: That 1–3px settle is where quality lives.

definition.zh: 最后 2px 的收敛
definition.en: The last two pixels

distinction.zh: 收尾的小幅回弹是“质感”的来源，幅度 1–3px。
distinction.en: That 1–3px settle is where quality lives.

items.dz: 横向摇两下
items.de: Two quick shakes
items.pz: 幅度 ≤6px、频率两个来回、300ms 结束。
items.pe: Under 6px, two cycles, done in 300ms.

definition.zh: 横向摇两下
definition.en: Two quick shakes

distinction.zh: 幅度 ≤6px、频率两个来回、300ms 结束。
distinction.en: Under 6px, two cycles, done in 300ms.

items.dz: 两下一停的节奏
items.de: Two beats, then a rest
items.pz: 双峰节奏（快-快-停）比单次脉冲更像生命。
items.pe: A double beat reads alive; a single pulse reads mechanical.

definition.zh: 两下一停的节奏
definition.en: Two beats, then a rest

distinction.zh: 双峰节奏（快-快-停）比单次脉冲更像生命。
distinction.en: A double beat reads alive; a single pulse reads mechanical.

items.dz: 缓慢均匀地胀缩
items.de: Slow, even swelling
items.pz: 4s 一次、幅度 3–5%，超过就成了脉冲。
items.pe: One 4s cycle at 3–5% — more becomes a pulse.

definition.zh: 缓慢均匀地胀缩
definition.en: Slow, even swelling

distinction.zh: 4s 一次、幅度 3–5%，超过就成了脉冲。
distinction.en: One 4s cycle at 3–5% — more becomes a pulse.

items.dz: 像硬币快停时的晃
items.de: Like a coin about to settle
items.pz: 频率递增、幅度递减，是“将停”的关键。
items.pe: Frequency up, amplitude down — that is “about to stop”.

definition.zh: 像硬币快停时的晃
definition.en: Like a coin about to settle

distinction.zh: 频率递增、幅度递减，是“将停”的关键。
distinction.en: Frequency up, amplitude down — that is “about to stop”.

items.dz: 一串依次弹进来
items.de: They spring in one after another
items.pz: 每项相同曲线、不同延迟，才有“一队”的感觉。
items.pe: Same curve, different delay — that is what makes a queue.

definition.zh: 一串依次弹进来
definition.en: They spring in one after another

distinction.zh: 每项相同曲线、不同延迟，才有“一队”的感觉。
distinction.en: Same curve, different delay — that is what makes a queue.

items.dz: 有人不想看动画
items.de: Some people want it still
items.pz: prefers-reduced-motion 下只保留淡入，不做位移与缩放。
items.pe: Under prefers-reduced-motion keep the fade, drop the movement.

definition.zh: 有人不想看动画
definition.en: Some people want it still

distinction.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 下只保留淡入，不做位移与缩放。
distinction.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion keep the fade, drop the movement.

dz: 效果跟着滚动条走（请在画布里滚动）
de: Effects tied to the scrollbar — scroll inside the stage

items.dz: 滚到才淡入上浮，最常用的一种
items.de: Blocks fade up as they scroll into view
items.pz: 用 IntersectionObserver 加类，或 CSS animation-timeline:view() 做进入动画。
items.pe: IntersectionObserver toggling a class, or CSS animation-timeline:view().

definition.zh: 滚到才淡入上浮，最常用的一种
definition.en: Blocks fade up as they scroll into view

distinction.zh: 用 IntersectionObserver 加类，或 CSS animation-timeline:view() 做进入动画。
distinction.en: IntersectionObserver toggling a class, or CSS animation-timeline:view().

items.dz: 出现过就不再重播，避免晕眩
items.de: Plays once and stays — no re-triggering
items.pz: IntersectionObserver 触发后 unobserve，状态写进 dataset。
items.pe: Unobserve after the first intersection and record it on the dataset.

definition.zh: 出现过就不再重播，避免晕眩
definition.en: Plays once and stays — no re-triggering

distinction.zh: IntersectionObserver 触发后 unobserve，状态写进 dataset。
distinction.en: Unobserve after the first intersection and record it on the dataset.

items.dz: 背景比前景滚得慢
items.de: The background scrolls slower than the foreground
items.pz: 按滚动进度给不同层不同的 translateY 速率（0.2×~0.6×）。
items.pe: Give each layer a different translateY rate against scroll (0.2×–0.6×).

definition.zh: 背景比前景滚得慢
definition.en: The background scrolls slower than the foreground

distinction.zh: 按滚动进度给不同层不同的 translateY 速率（0.2×~0.6×）。
distinction.en: Give each layer a different translateY rate against scroll (0.2×–0.6×).

items.dz: 图片随滚动缓缓放大
items.de: The image slowly scales as you scroll
items.pz: 滚动进度映射到 scale(1→1.15)，容器 overflow:hidden。
items.pe: Map scroll progress to scale(1→1.15) inside an overflow-hidden frame.

definition.zh: 图片随滚动缓缓放大
definition.en: The image slowly scales as you scroll

distinction.zh: 滚动进度映射到 scale(1→1.15)，容器 overflow:hidden。
distinction.en: Map scroll progress to scale(1→1.15) inside an overflow-hidden frame.

items.dz: 顶部一条随滚动增长的线
items.de: A top bar that grows with the scroll
items.pz: scaleX 绑定 scroll() 时间线，transform-origin:left。
items.pe: scaleX bound to scroll() timeline with transform-origin left.

definition.zh: 顶部一条随滚动增长的线
definition.en: A top bar that grows with the scroll

distinction.zh: scaleX 绑定 scroll() 时间线，transform-origin:left。
distinction.en: scaleX bound to scroll() timeline with transform-origin left.

items.dz: 头部滚动时变矮变紧凑
items.de: The header compresses as you scroll
items.pz: position:sticky + 滚动进度驱动高度/字号，或滚过阈值加类。
items.pe: Sticky header plus scroll progress driving height/size, or a class past a threshold.

definition.zh: 头部滚动时变矮变紧凑
definition.en: The header compresses as you scroll

distinction.zh: position:sticky + 滚动进度驱动高度/字号，或滚过阈值加类。
distinction.en: Sticky header plus scroll progress driving height/size, or a class past a threshold.

items.dz: 卡片一张叠一张停住
items.de: Cards stack up and pin one over another
items.pz: 每张卡 position:sticky;top 递增，配合轻微 scale 做纵深。
items.pe: Each card sticky with an increasing top offset plus a small scale for depth.

definition.zh: 卡片一张叠一张停住
definition.en: Cards stack up and pin one over another

distinction.zh: 每张卡 position:sticky;top 递增，配合轻微 scale 做纵深。
distinction.en: Each card sticky with an increasing top offset plus a small scale for depth.

items.dz: 内容钉住不动，里面继续演变
items.de: The section pins while its contents keep changing
items.pz: GSAP ScrollTrigger 的 pin，或 sticky 容器 + 高度撑开。
items.pe: GSAP ScrollTrigger pin, or a sticky child inside a tall spacer.

definition.zh: 内容钉住不动，里面继续演变
definition.en: The section pins while its contents keep changing

distinction.zh: GSAP ScrollTrigger 的 pin，或 sticky 容器 + 高度撑开。
distinction.en: GSAP ScrollTrigger pin, or a sticky child inside a tall spacer.

items.dz: 纵向滚动带动横向移动
items.de: Vertical scrolling drives horizontal travel
items.pz: 钉住外层，把滚动进度映射为内层 translateX。
items.pe: Pin the wrapper and map scroll progress onto the inner translateX.

definition.zh: 纵向滚动带动横向移动
definition.en: Vertical scrolling drives horizontal travel

distinction.zh: 钉住外层，把滚动进度映射为内层 translateX。
distinction.en: Pin the wrapper and map scroll progress onto the inner translateX.

items.dz: 一屏一屏地停住
items.de: Each block snaps into place
items.pz: 容器 scroll-snap-type:y mandatory，子项 scroll-snap-align:center。
items.pe: scroll-snap-type:y mandatory on the scroller, scroll-snap-align on the items.

definition.zh: 一屏一屏地停住
definition.en: Each block snaps into place

distinction.zh: 容器 scroll-snap-type:y mandatory，子项 scroll-snap-align:center。
distinction.en: scroll-snap-type:y mandatory on the scroller, scroll-snap-align on the items.

items.dz: 文字随滚动由灰变黑
items.de: Copy brightens from grey to black as it passes
items.pz: 按滚动进度改变 color / opacity，可逐词做。
items.pe: Drive color/opacity from scroll progress, optionally per word.

definition.zh: 文字随滚动由灰变黑
definition.en: Copy brightens from grey to black as it passes

distinction.zh: 按滚动进度改变 color / opacity，可逐词做。
distinction.en: Drive color/opacity from scroll progress, optionally per word.

items.dz: 物体随滚动持续旋转
items.de: An object rotates as long as you scroll
items.pz: rotate 绑定 scroll() 进度，适合装饰元素。
items.pe: Bind rotate to scroll() progress — good for decorative objects.

definition.zh: 物体随滚动持续旋转
definition.en: An object rotates as long as you scroll

distinction.zh: rotate 绑定 scroll() 进度，适合装饰元素。
distinction.en: Bind rotate to scroll() progress — good for decorative objects.

items.dz: 数字滚到视口才开始跳动
items.de: The number starts counting when it enters view
items.pz: IntersectionObserver 触发 requestAnimationFrame 计数，缓出。
items.pe: IntersectionObserver kicks off a rAF counter with an ease-out curve.

definition.zh: 数字滚到视口才开始跳动
definition.en: The number starts counting when it enters view

distinction.zh: IntersectionObserver 触发 requestAnimationFrame 计数，缓出。
distinction.en: IntersectionObserver kicks off a rAF counter with an ease-out curve.

items.dz: 往下滚导航收起，往上滚回来
items.de: Nav hides scrolling down, returns scrolling up
items.pz: 比较上一次 scrollY 判断方向，切换 translateY(-100%)。
items.pe: Compare the previous scrollY for direction and toggle translateY(-100%).

definition.zh: 往下滚导航收起，往上滚回来
definition.en: Nav hides scrolling down, returns scrolling up

distinction.zh: 比较上一次 scrollY 判断方向，切换 translateY(-100%)。
distinction.en: Compare the previous scrollY for direction and toggle translateY(-100%).

items.dz: 滚到不同区块背景色渐变
items.de: The page tint changes section by section
items.pz: 每个 section 记录目标色，进入视口时过渡 body 背景。
items.pe: Each section carries a target color; transition the page background on enter.

definition.zh: 滚到不同区块背景色渐变
definition.en: The page tint changes section by section

distinction.zh: 每个 section 记录目标色，进入视口时过渡 body 背景。
distinction.en: Each section carries a target color; transition the page background on enter.

items.dz: 一条竖线随滚动画下来
items.de: A vertical line draws itself as you scroll
items.pz: scaleY 或 SVG stroke-dashoffset 绑定滚动进度。
items.pe: Bind scaleY or SVG stroke-dashoffset to scroll progress.

definition.zh: 一条竖线随滚动画下来
definition.en: A vertical line draws itself as you scroll

distinction.zh: scaleY 或 SVG stroke-dashoffset 绑定滚动进度。
distinction.en: Bind scaleY or SVG stroke-dashoffset to scroll progress.

items.dz: 离视口中心越远越模糊
items.de: The further from centre, the blurrier
items.pz: 把与视口中心的距离映射为 blur 值。
items.pe: Map distance from viewport centre onto the blur radius.

definition.zh: 离视口中心越远越模糊
definition.en: The further from centre, the blurrier

distinction.zh: 把与视口中心的距离映射为 blur 值。
distinction.en: Map distance from viewport centre onto the blur radius.

items.dz: 钉住时画面推近
items.de: The frame pushes in while pinned
items.pz: 钉住区间内把进度映射到 scale，退出时解钉。
items.pe: Within the pinned range map progress to scale, then unpin.

definition.zh: 钉住时画面推近
definition.en: The frame pushes in while pinned

distinction.zh: 钉住区间内把进度映射到 scale，退出时解钉。
distinction.en: Within the pinned range map progress to scale, then unpin.

items.dz: 滚得越快横条跑得越快
items.de: The ticker speeds up with your scrolling
items.pz: 记录滚动速度，映射到 marquee 的播放速率或 skew。
items.pe: Track scroll velocity and map it to the ticker rate or a skew.

definition.zh: 滚得越快横条跑得越快
definition.en: The ticker speeds up with your scrolling

distinction.zh: 记录滚动速度，映射到 marquee 的播放速率或 skew。
distinction.en: Track scroll velocity and map it to the ticker rate or a skew.

items.dz: 右侧圆点标出当前区块
items.de: Dots mark which section you are in
items.pz: IntersectionObserver 判断当前 section，高亮对应圆点。
items.pe: IntersectionObserver picks the active section and highlights its dot.

definition.zh: 右侧圆点标出当前区块
definition.en: Dots mark which section you are in

distinction.zh: IntersectionObserver 判断当前 section，高亮对应圆点。
distinction.en: IntersectionObserver picks the active section and highlights its dot.

items.dz: 侧栏跟随，主内容继续滚
items.de: The sidebar follows while content scrolls on
items.pz: position:sticky;top:24px，父级不要 overflow:hidden。
items.pe: position:sticky with a top offset; the parent must not clip overflow.

definition.zh: 侧栏跟随，主内容继续滚
definition.en: The sidebar follows while content scrolls on

distinction.zh: position:sticky;top:24px，父级不要 overflow:hidden。
distinction.en: position:sticky with a top offset; the parent must not clip overflow.

items.dz: 数据条随滚动长出来
items.de: Data bars grow as they enter view
items.pz: 进入视口后 scaleX/height 由 0 到目标值，带 stagger。
items.pe: On enter, animate scaleX/height from 0 with a stagger.

definition.zh: 数据条随滚动长出来
definition.en: Data bars grow as they enter view

distinction.zh: 进入视口后 scaleX/height 由 0 到目标值，带 stagger。
distinction.en: On enter, animate scaleX/height from 0 with a stagger.

items.dz: 色块划过后露出图片
items.de: A color panel slides off to expose the image
items.pz: 覆盖层随滚动 translateX 移出，露出下面内容。
items.pe: The overlay translates away as scroll progresses.

definition.zh: 色块划过后露出图片
definition.en: A color panel slides off to expose the image

distinction.zh: 覆盖层随滚动 translateX 移出，露出下面内容。
distinction.en: The overlay translates away as scroll progresses.

items.dz: 不同卡片以不同速度掠过
items.de: Cards drift past at different speeds
items.pz: 给每个元素不同的视差系数，形成层次。
items.pe: Give each element its own parallax factor.

definition.zh: 不同卡片以不同速度掠过
definition.en: Cards drift past at different speeds

distinction.zh: 给每个元素不同的视差系数，形成层次。
distinction.en: Give each element its own parallax factor.

items.dz: 滚到底部按钮升起来
items.de: The button rises once you reach the bottom
items.pz: 监听滚动到底（或最后一个哨兵元素进入视口）再显示。
items.pe: Watch for a sentinel at the bottom entering view, then reveal.

definition.zh: 滚到底部按钮升起来
definition.en: The button rises once you reach the bottom

distinction.zh: 监听滚动到底（或最后一个哨兵元素进入视口）再显示。
distinction.en: Watch for a sentinel at the bottom entering view, then reveal.

items.dz: 把吸附目标区整个向内推，落点停在容器内边距之后。
items.de: Insets the snap area so resting points land inside the padding.
items.pz: 有悬浮头时 scroll-padding-top:64px，吸附落点自动让出头下。说「吸附时让开顶栏」即此。
items.pe: scroll-padding-top:64px keeps snapped targets clear of a fixed header.

definition.zh: scroll-padding 在滚动容器的吸附口（snapport）向内收缩一段，使所有吸附落点整体偏移，等价于给吸附区加内边距。
definition.en: scroll-padding insets the snapport so every snap position shifts inward.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin 的区别：padding 是容器侧的整体收口，margin 是每个目标元素自带的外扩；与普通 padding 的区别：它只影响吸附与滚动定位，不影响绘制。
distinction.en: scroll-padding is container-side; scroll-margin is per-target; neither affects painting.

relations.reason: 容器侧收口 vs 目标侧外扩。

items.dz: 给吸附目标外扩一圈，锚点定位时留出呼吸空间。
items.de: Outsets each snap target so anchored landings get breathing room.
items.pz: 锚点跳转被顶栏遮住时，给目标加 scroll-margin-top:64px。说「目标让出 64px」即此。
items.pe: scroll-margin-top:64px on the target clears a fixed header after anchor jumps.

definition.zh: scroll-margin 在每个可滚动定位目标（吸附项、:target）外围扩展一段不可见区域，滚动定位按外扩后的盒子对齐。
definition.en: scroll-margin extends each scroll target with invisible outset the scroller aligns to.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-padding 的区别：margin 跟随目标元素（每个目标可不同），padding 是容器统一设置；与普通 margin 的区别：它不参与布局与绘制，只在滚动定位时生效。
distinction.en: per-target outset vs container padding; no layout or paint effect.

items.dz: 滚到边界后是否把滚动交还给外层或页面。
items.de: Controls whether scroll chaining leaks to ancestor scrollers.
items.pz: 弹层内滚动区加 overscroll-behavior:contain，滚到底不再拖动背后页面。说「别让滚动漏出去」即此。
items.pe: overscroll-behavior:contain stops a modal's scroller from chaining to the page.

definition.zh: overscroll-behavior 规定滚动到边界后的表现：auto 继续把滚动链交给祖先，contain 在本容器内消化，none 连边界回弹效果一并取消。
definition.en: overscroll-behavior decides boundary behavior: auto chains, contain stops chaining, none also kills native glow/bounce.

distinction.zh: 与 touch-action 的区别：touch-action 在手势开始前限制哪些手势归浏览器，overscroll-behavior 只管滚到边界后的连锁；两者常配合但作用层不同。
distinction.en: touch-action gates gestures up front; overscroll-behavior only governs edge chaining.

items.dz: 把滚动条调细或完全隐藏，但不取消滚动能力。
items.de: Thins or hides the scrollbar without disabling scrolling.
items.pz: scrollbar-width:thin 给侧栏细滚动条；none 隐藏但仍可滚。说「细滚动条」即此。
items.pe: scrollbar-width:thin for slim sidebars; none hides yet still scrolls.

definition.zh: scrollbar-width 以 auto/thin/none 三档控制滚动条占用的厚度，none 隐藏轨道但保留滚动能力。
definition.en: scrollbar-width sets auto/thin/none thickness; none hides the bar while scrolling still works.

distinction.zh: 与 ::-webkit-scrollbar 的区别：后者是非标准伪元素（可逐件雕花），scrollbar-width/scrollbar-color 是标准且两者互斥——一旦使用标准属性，webkit 伪元素失效。
distinction.en: ::-webkit-scrollbar is non-standard per-part styling; the standard pair replaces it when set.

relations.reason: 同族属性：width 管厚度、color 管配色，一起使用互斥于旧伪元素方案。

items.dz: 直接指定滑块与轨道两色。
items.de: Sets the thumb and track colors directly.
items.pz: scrollbar-color:#587A94 transparent：深色主题里滑块亮、轨道透明。说「滑块用这个色」即此。
items.pe: scrollbar-color:#587A94 transparent — bright thumb, clear track.

definition.zh: scroll-color 接受两个颜色：第一个为滑块（thumb），第二个为轨道（track），auto 交回系统配色。
definition.en: scrollbar-color takes two colors — thumb then track — with auto restoring the system scheme.

distinction.zh: 与 scrollbar-width 同族分工：一个管配色一个管厚度；与 ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb 的区别在于标准两色模型 vs 非标准多部件雕刻，互斥生效。
distinction.en: width pairs with it; ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb is the non-standard counterpart, mutually exclusive.

items.dz: 平时随流滚动，碰到阈值就钉在容器边上。
items.de: Scrolls with the flow until the threshold, then pins.
items.pz: 表头 sticky;top:0 钉在滚动区顶。它受最近滚动祖先与父盒边界双重约束。说「表头钉住」即此。
items.pe: position:sticky;top:0 pins a header inside its scroll ancestor.

definition.zh: sticky 元素先按相对定位随流排布，滚动跨过 inset 阈值后在包含块内表现为固定，直到触及父盒边界又被推走。
definition.en: sticky flows relatively until the inset threshold, then acts fixed within its containing block until pushed out by the parent edge.

distinction.zh: 与 fixed 的区别：fixed 以视口为参照且脱离文档流；sticky 以最近滚动祖先为参照、保留占位、受父盒范围约束。
distinction.en: fixed is viewport-based and out of flow; sticky is scroller-based, keeps its slot, and dies at the parent edge.

items.dz: 把动画进度绑到滚动位置，滚动多少播多少。
items.de: Binds animation progress to scroll position.
items.pz: animation-timeline:scroll() 让进度条随阅读滚动。说「跟着滚动播」即此。
items.pe: animation-timeline:scroll() drives progress from the scroller.

definition.zh: animation-timeline:scroll() 用滚动容器的滚动进度替换时间驱动：动画的进度随滚动位置走，与钟表时间无关。
definition.en: scroll() replaces clock time with scroll progress for the animation.

distinction.zh: 与 JS scroll 事件的区别：时间轴在合成器线程对齐滚动帧，无事件抖动；与 view() 的区别：scroll() 看容器整体进度，view() 看单个元素进出视口的进度。
distinction.en: scroll-driven timelines run on the compositor; view() tracks one element's viewport progress.

dz: 鼠标碰到时的反馈（请把鼠标移上去）
de: Feedback on hover — move your cursor over the demo

items.dz: 卡片微微升起、影子变深
items.de: The card lifts and its shadow deepens
items.pz: translateY(-4px) + 阴影加深，200–280ms。
items.pe: translateY(-4px) with a deeper shadow over 200–280ms.

definition.zh: 卡片微微升起、影子变深
definition.en: The card lifts and its shadow deepens

distinction.zh: translateY(-4px) + 阴影加深，200–280ms。
distinction.en: translateY(-4px) with a deeper shadow over 200–280ms.

items.dz: 卡片跟着鼠标方向倾斜
items.de: The card tips toward your cursor
items.pz: 按鼠标在卡内的相对位置计算 rotateX/rotateY，父级 perspective。
items.pe: Map cursor position inside the card to rotateX/rotateY under a perspective parent.

definition.zh: 卡片跟着鼠标方向倾斜
definition.en: The card tips toward your cursor

distinction.zh: 按鼠标在卡内的相对位置计算 rotateX/rotateY，父级 perspective。
distinction.en: Map cursor position inside the card to rotateX/rotateY under a perspective parent.

items.dz: 边缘泛起一圈柔光
items.de: A soft halo blooms at the edge
items.pz: box-shadow 用品牌色低透明度大扩散，别用 filter:blur。
items.pe: A wide, low-opacity brand-color box-shadow — not filter:blur.

definition.zh: 边缘泛起一圈柔光
definition.en: A soft halo blooms at the edge

distinction.zh: box-shadow 用品牌色低透明度大扩散，别用 filter:blur。
distinction.en: A wide, low-opacity brand-color box-shadow — not filter:blur.

items.dz: 边框沿四周画出来
items.de: The border draws itself around the box
items.pz: 两个伪元素各画两条边，用 scaleX/scaleY 顺序展开。
items.pe: Two pseudo-elements draw two edges each, scaling in sequence.

definition.zh: 边框沿四周画出来
definition.en: The border draws itself around the box

distinction.zh: 两个伪元素各画两条边，用 scaleX/scaleY 顺序展开。
distinction.en: Two pseudo-elements draw two edges each, scaling in sequence.

items.dz: 边框上的光一直在转
items.de: Light keeps travelling around the border
items.pz: conic-gradient 背景 + 内层遮罩留出 1–2px 边，旋转角度。
items.pe: A conic-gradient background masked by an inner panel, with the angle animating.

definition.zh: 边框上的光一直在转
definition.en: Light keeps travelling around the border

distinction.zh: conic-gradient 背景 + 内层遮罩留出 1–2px 边，旋转角度。
distinction.en: A conic-gradient background masked by an inner panel, with the angle animating.

items.dz: 颜色从左扫满按钮
items.de: Color sweeps across the button
items.pz: 伪元素 scaleX(0)→1，transform-origin 悬停时左、离开时右。
items.pe: Pseudo-element scaleX(0)→1; origin left on enter, right on leave.

definition.zh: 颜色从左扫满按钮
definition.en: Color sweeps across the button

distinction.zh: 伪元素 scaleX(0)→1，transform-origin 悬停时左、离开时右。
distinction.en: Pseudo-element scaleX(0)→1; origin left on enter, right on leave.

items.dz: 悬停时箭头往前挪一格
items.de: The arrow nudges forward on hover
items.pz: 只位移箭头（4–6px），文字不动，短促 180ms。
items.pe: Move only the arrow 4–6px in 180ms; the label stays put.

definition.zh: 悬停时箭头往前挪一格
definition.en: The arrow nudges forward on hover

distinction.zh: 只位移箭头（4–6px），文字不动，短促 180ms。
distinction.en: Move only the arrow 4–6px in 180ms; the label stays put.

items.dz: 框不动，里面的图放大
items.de: The frame holds still while the image grows
items.pz: 外框 overflow:hidden，内图 scale(1.06)，400ms。
items.pe: Overflow-hidden frame, inner image scale(1.06) over 400ms.

definition.zh: 框不动，里面的图放大
definition.en: The frame holds still while the image grows

distinction.zh: 外框 overflow:hidden，内图 scale(1.06)，400ms。
distinction.en: Overflow-hidden frame, inner image scale(1.06) over 400ms.

items.de: Even the caret can be brand
items.pz: caret-color 一行搞定，但别用低对比色。
items.pe: caret-color is one line — just keep it visible.

definition.zh: 输入光标也能是品牌色
definition.en: Even the caret can be brand

distinction.zh: caret-color 一行搞定，但别用低对比色。
distinction.en: caret-color is one line — just keep it visible.

items.dz: grab 变 grabbing
items.de: grab becomes grabbing
items.pz: 按下瞬间换成 grabbing，松手才回 grab。
items.pe: Swap to grabbing on pointerdown, back on release.

definition.zh: grab 变 grabbing
definition.en: grab becomes grabbing

distinction.zh: 按下瞬间换成 grabbing，松手才回 grab。
distinction.en: Swap to grabbing on pointerdown, back on release.

items.dz: 角上的小三角
items.de: The little corner grip
items.pz: 手柄点击区要 ≥16px，光标用 nwse-resize。
items.pe: A ≥16px hit area with the nwse-resize cursor.

definition.zh: 角上的小三角
definition.en: The little corner grip

distinction.zh: 手柄点击区要 ≥16px，光标用 nwse-resize。
distinction.en: A ≥16px hit area with the nwse-resize cursor.

items.dz: 光标消失只留位移
items.de: The cursor vanishes; only motion remains
items.pz: 游戏与 3D 视角用，必须提供退出提示（Esc）。
items.pe: For games and 3D — always show how to exit (Esc).

definition.zh: 光标消失只留位移
definition.en: The cursor vanishes; only motion remains

distinction.zh: 游戏与 3D 视角用，必须提供退出提示（Esc）。
distinction.en: For games and 3D — always show how to exit (Esc).

items.dz: 局部放大跟随指针
items.de: A magnifier follows the pointer
items.pz: 镜片内用更大的 background-size，位置反向偏移。
items.pe: Inside the lens use a bigger background-size, offset inversely.

definition.zh: 局部放大跟随指针
definition.en: A magnifier follows the pointer

distinction.zh: 镜片内用更大的 background-size，位置反向偏移。
distinction.en: Inside the lens use a bigger background-size, offset inversely.

items.dz: 还没碰到就有反应
items.de: It responds before you arrive
items.pz: 按距离插值，比 hover 更早给出反馈。
items.pe: Interpolate by distance — feedback before hover.

definition.zh: 还没碰到就有反应
definition.en: It responds before you arrive

distinction.zh: 按距离插值，比 hover 更早给出反馈。
distinction.en: Interpolate by distance — feedback before hover.

items.dz: 换成一个图形
items.de: Replace it with a graphic
items.pz: cursor:url() 必须给 fallback，尺寸不超过 32px。
items.pe: cursor:url() needs a fallback and should stay under 32px.

definition.zh: 换成一个图形
definition.en: Replace it with a graphic

distinction.zh: cursor:url() 必须给 fallback，尺寸不超过 32px。
distinction.en: cursor:url() needs a fallback and should stay under 32px.

items.dz: 看起来小、点起来大
items.de: Looks small, taps big
items.pz: 视觉 24px、热区 44px，用伪元素扩大。
items.pe: 24px visual, 44px hit area via a pseudo-element.

definition.zh: 看起来小、点起来大
definition.en: Looks small, taps big

distinction.zh: 视觉 24px、热区 44px，用伪元素扩大。
distinction.en: 24px visual, 44px hit area via a pseudo-element.

items.dz: 按住一会儿弹出操作
items.de: Hold to open actions
items.pz: 长按 500ms + 触觉反馈，期间显示进度环。
items.pe: 500ms hold with haptics and a progress ring.

definition.zh: 按住一会儿弹出操作
definition.en: Hold to open actions

distinction.zh: 长按 500ms + 触觉反馈，期间显示进度环。
distinction.en: 500ms hold with haptics and a progress ring.

dz: 跟手才叫直接操作
de: Direct manipulation means it tracks your finger

items.dz: 拿起来的一瞬间浮起
items.de: It lifts the moment you grab it
items.pz: 按下 80ms 内 scale 1.02 + 阴影升两级。
items.pe: Within 80ms: scale 1.02 and two shadow steps.

definition.zh: 拿起来的一瞬间浮起
definition.en: It lifts the moment you grab it

distinction.zh: 按下 80ms 内 scale 1.02 + 阴影升两级。
distinction.en: Within 80ms: scale 1.02 and two shadow steps.

items.dz: 原位留一个虚框
items.de: A ghost stays where it was
items.pz: 虚位用虚线框 + 浅底，高度与被拖项一致。
items.pe: A dashed well matching the dragged item’s height.

definition.zh: 原位留一个虚框
definition.en: A ghost stays where it was

distinction.zh: 虚位用虚线框 + 浅底，高度与被拖项一致。
distinction.en: A dashed well matching the dragged item’s height.

items.dz: 其他项让位
items.de: The others make room
items.pz: 让位用 FLIP（transform）而不是重排，200ms。
items.pe: Move neighbours with FLIP transforms, 200ms.

definition.zh: 其他项让位
definition.en: The others make room

distinction.zh: 让位用 FLIP（transform）而不是重排，200ms。
distinction.en: Move neighbours with FLIP transforms, 200ms.

items.dz: 只有手柄能拖
items.de: Only the grip drags
items.pz: 手柄用六点纹理，光标 grab，其余区域仍可点击。
items.pe: A six-dot grip with a grab cursor; the rest stays clickable.

definition.zh: 只有手柄能拖
definition.en: Only the grip drags

distinction.zh: 手柄用六点纹理，光标 grab，其余区域仍可点击。
distinction.en: A six-dot grip with a grab cursor; the rest stays clickable.

items.dz: 能放的地方亮起来
items.de: Valid targets light up
items.pz: 只高亮合法目标，非法目标给 not-allowed。
items.pe: Highlight valid targets only; mark invalid ones not-allowed.

definition.zh: 能放的地方亮起来
definition.en: Valid targets light up

distinction.zh: 只高亮合法目标，非法目标给 not-allowed。
distinction.en: Highlight valid targets only; mark invalid ones not-allowed.

items.dz: 松手对齐到格
items.de: It clicks onto the grid
items.pz: 吸附阈值 8–12px，松手时用短 spring 落位。
items.pe: An 8–12px threshold with a short spring on release.

definition.zh: 松手对齐到格
definition.en: It clicks onto the grid

distinction.zh: 吸附阈值 8–12px，松手时用短 spring 落位。
distinction.en: An 8–12px threshold with a short spring on release.

items.dz: 拖到尽头还能拉一点
items.de: Past the end it still gives a little
items.pz: 超界位移乘 0.3–0.5 衰减，松手弹回。
items.pe: Damp overscroll to 0.3–0.5 and spring back.

definition.zh: 拖到尽头还能拉一点
definition.en: Past the end it still gives a little

distinction.zh: 超界位移乘 0.3–0.5 衰减，松手弹回。
distinction.en: Damp overscroll to 0.3–0.5 and spring back.

items.dz: 推出屏幕就删掉
items.de: Push it off and it is gone
items.pz: 位移带旋转与透明度衰减，过阈值继续飞出。
items.pe: Add rotation and fade; past the threshold let it fly.

definition.zh: 推出屏幕就删掉
definition.en: Push it off and it is gone

distinction.zh: 位移带旋转与透明度衰减，过阈值继续飞出。
distinction.en: Add rotation and fade; past the threshold let it fly.

items.dz: 左右决定去留
items.de: Left or right decides
items.pz: 方向标签随位移淡入，超过 40% 宽度即判定。
items.pe: Fade in the verdict label; commit past 40% width.

definition.zh: 左右决定去留
definition.en: Left or right decides

distinction.zh: 方向标签随位移淡入，超过 40% 宽度即判定。
distinction.en: Fade in the verdict label; commit past 40% width.

items.dz: 两指撑开放大
items.de: Two fingers spread to zoom
items.pz: 缩放中心是两指中点，边界用橡皮筋。
items.pe: Scale about the midpoint; rubber-band at the limits.

definition.zh: 两指撑开放大
definition.en: Two fingers spread to zoom

distinction.zh: 缩放中心是两指中点，边界用橡皮筋。
distinction.en: Scale about the midpoint; rubber-band at the limits.

items.dz: 双击放大到该点
items.de: Double-tap zooms to that point
items.pz: 以点击点为原点缩放 2×，再次双击复原。
items.pe: Zoom 2× about the tap point; tap again to reset.

definition.zh: 双击放大到该点
definition.en: Double-tap zooms to that point

distinction.zh: 以点击点为原点缩放 2×，再次双击复原。
distinction.en: Zoom 2× about the tap point; tap again to reset.

items.dz: 按住拖动整个画布
items.de: Grab and move the whole canvas
items.pz: 平移要跟手 1:1，惯性滑行 300–600ms。
items.pe: 1:1 tracking with 300–600ms of inertia.

definition.zh: 按住拖动整个画布
definition.en: Grab and move the whole canvas

distinction.zh: 平移要跟手 1:1，惯性滑行 300–600ms。
distinction.en: 1:1 tracking with 300–600ms of inertia.

items.dz: 松手后继续滑一段
items.de: It keeps going after release
items.pz: 按松手速度衰减（0.95/帧），低于阈值停止。
items.pe: Decay the release velocity ~0.95 per frame.

definition.zh: 松手后继续滑一段
definition.en: It keeps going after release

distinction.zh: 按松手速度衰减（0.95/帧），低于阈值停止。
distinction.en: Decay the release velocity ~0.95 per frame.

items.dz: 一格一格停住
items.de: It stops one card at a time
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory + snap-align:center。
items.pe: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory with snap-align:center.

definition.zh: 一格一格停住
definition.en: It stops one card at a time

distinction.zh: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory + snap-align:center。
distinction.en: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory with snap-align:center.

items.dz: 拉到阈值松手刷新
items.de: Pull past the line and release
items.pz: 阈值前跟手、越界阻尼，触发后转成 spinner。
items.pe: Track, then damp past the threshold, then spin.

items.dz: 从屏幕边缘拉回上一页
items.de: Drag from the edge to go back
items.pz: 上一页跟随位移露出，过 50% 判定完成。
items.pe: Reveal the previous page as you drag; commit past 50%.

definition.zh: 从屏幕边缘拉回上一页
definition.en: Drag from the edge to go back

distinction.zh: 上一页跟随位移露出，过 50% 判定完成。
distinction.en: Reveal the previous page as you drag; commit past 50%.

items.dz: 卡片在列之间搬
items.de: Cards move between columns
items.pz: 跨列时目标列整体高亮，插入位留出空隙。
items.pe: Highlight the target column and open a gap.

definition.zh: 卡片在列之间搬
definition.en: Cards move between columns

distinction.zh: 跨列时目标列整体高亮，插入位留出空隙。
distinction.en: Highlight the target column and open a gap.

items.dz: 一把抓起好几个
items.de: Grab several at once
items.pz: 被拖的堆叠在指针下，角标显示数量。
items.pe: Stack them under the pointer with a count badge.

definition.zh: 一把抓起好几个
definition.en: Grab several at once

distinction.zh: 被拖的堆叠在指针下，角标显示数量。
distinction.en: Stack them under the pointer with a count badge.

items.dz: 手柄不能落后于手指
items.de: The thumb must not lag
items.pz: 滑块位置直接用指针坐标，不要加过渡。
items.pe: Bind position to the pointer directly — no transition.

definition.zh: 手柄不能落后于手指
definition.en: The thumb must not lag

distinction.zh: 滑块位置直接用指针坐标，不要加过渡。
distinction.en: Bind position to the pointer directly — no transition.

items.dz: 绕中心转动取值
items.de: Turn about the centre
items.pz: 用角度差而不是绝对角度，避免跳变。
items.pe: Use angle deltas, not absolute angle, to avoid jumps.

definition.zh: 绕中心转动取值
definition.en: Turn about the centre

distinction.zh: 用角度差而不是绝对角度，避免跳变。
distinction.en: Use angle deltas, not absolute angle, to avoid jumps.

items.dz: 第一次用给个示范
items.de: Show it once, the first time
items.pz: 用一次性动画演示手势，之后不再出现。
items.pe: Demonstrate once, then never again.

definition.zh: 第一次用给个示范
definition.en: Show it once, the first time

distinction.zh: 用一次性动画演示手势，之后不再出现。
distinction.en: Demonstrate once, then never again.

items.dz: 两指移动画布
items.de: Two fingers move the canvas
items.pz: 单指用于选择、双指用于平移，避免冲突。
items.pe: One finger selects, two pan — no conflict.

definition.zh: 两指移动画布
definition.en: Two fingers move the canvas

distinction.zh: 单指用于选择、双指用于平移，避免冲突。
distinction.en: One finger selects, two pan — no conflict.

items.dz: 先动哪个方向就锁哪个
items.de: The first direction wins
items.pz: 起始 10px 内判定主轴，之后忽略另一轴。
items.pe: Decide the axis in the first 10px, then ignore the other.

definition.zh: 先动哪个方向就锁哪个
definition.en: The first direction wins

distinction.zh: 起始 10px 内判定主轴，之后忽略另一轴。
distinction.en: Decide the axis in the first 10px, then ignore the other.

items.dz: 差一点就不算
items.de: Almost does not count
items.pz: 过阈值给视觉确认（变色/震动），未过就弹回。
items.pe: Confirm past the line; spring back before it.

definition.zh: 差一点就不算
definition.en: Almost does not count

distinction.zh: 过阈值给视觉确认（变色/震动），未过就弹回。
distinction.en: Confirm past the line; spring back before it.

items.dz: 关键节点震一下
items.de: A tap at the key moment
items.pz: 只在状态真正改变时震动，别连续震。
items.pe: Buzz only when state actually changes.

definition.zh: 关键节点震一下
definition.en: A tap at the key moment

distinction.zh: 只在状态真正改变时震动，别连续震。
distinction.en: Buzz only when state actually changes.

items.dz: 拖到边界容器自己滚
items.de: Near the edge, the list scrolls itself
items.pz: 越靠边滚得越快，速度上限要设。
items.pe: Speed rises with proximity — cap it.

definition.zh: 拖到边界容器自己滚
definition.en: Near the edge, the list scrolls itself

distinction.zh: 越靠边滚得越快，速度上限要设。
distinction.en: Speed rises with proximity — cap it.

items.dz: 中间那条线可以拖
items.de: The divider is draggable
items.pz: 拖动时给整页 cursor:col-resize，并禁用文本选中。
items.pe: Set col-resize on the body and disable selection while dragging.

definition.zh: 中间那条线可以拖
definition.en: The divider is draggable

distinction.zh: 拖动时给整页 cursor:col-resize，并禁用文本选中。
distinction.en: Set col-resize on the body and disable selection while dragging.

dz: 状态切换的手感全在这几毫秒里
de: The feel of a state change lives in a few milliseconds

items.dz: 旋钮滑到另一头
items.de: The knob slides across
items.pz: 轨道变色与旋钮位移同时，160–200ms。
items.pe: Track colour and knob travel together, 160–200ms.

definition.zh: 旋钮滑到另一头
definition.en: The knob slides across

distinction.zh: 轨道变色与旋钮位移同时，160–200ms。
distinction.en: Track colour and knob travel together, 160–200ms.

items.dz: 旋钮滑动时被压扁一点
items.de: The knob squashes as it travels
items.pz: 位移中间帧 scaleX(1.15) scaleY(.9)，落位复原。
items.pe: Mid-travel scaleX(1.15) scaleY(.9), then settle.

definition.zh: 旋钮滑动时被压扁一点
definition.en: The knob squashes as it travels

distinction.zh: 位移中间帧 scaleX(1.15) scaleY(.9)，落位复原。
distinction.en: Mid-travel scaleX(1.15) scaleY(.9), then settle.

items.dz: 开时对勾、关时叉
items.de: Tick when on, cross when off
items.pz: 图标随旋钮一起移动，切换时旋转 90°。
items.pe: The icon rides the knob and rotates 90° on change.

definition.zh: 开时对勾、关时叉
definition.en: Tick when on, cross when off

distinction.zh: 图标随旋钮一起移动，切换时旋转 90°。
distinction.en: The icon rides the knob and rotates 90° on change.

items.dz: 轨道上写着开/关
items.de: ON / OFF written on the track
items.pz: 文字随旋钮位置交换，宽度必须固定。
items.pe: Swap the labels with the knob; fix the width.

definition.zh: 轨道上写着开/关
definition.en: ON / OFF written on the track

distinction.zh: 文字随旋钮位置交换，宽度必须固定。
distinction.en: Swap the labels with the knob; fix the width.

items.dz: 方框里画一个勾
items.de: A tick drawn in the box
items.pz: 勾用 stroke-dashoffset 画出，180ms 完成。
items.pe: Draw the tick with dashoffset over 180ms.

definition.zh: 方框里画一个勾
definition.en: A tick drawn in the box

distinction.zh: 勾用 stroke-dashoffset 画出，180ms 完成。
distinction.en: Draw the tick with dashoffset over 180ms.

items.dz: 子项只选了一部分
items.de: Only some children are picked
items.pz: 半选用短横线，不是灰勾，语义完全不同。
items.pe: A dash, not a grey tick — different meaning.

definition.zh: 子项只选了一部分
definition.en: Only some children are picked

distinction.zh: 半选用短横线，不是灰勾，语义完全不同。
distinction.en: A dash, not a grey tick — different meaning.

items.dz: 整张卡都是点击区
items.de: The whole card is the target
items.pz: 选中给 2px 主色边 + 浅底，别只靠一个小勾。
items.pe: A 2px accent border and tint — a tiny tick is not enough.

definition.zh: 整张卡都是点击区
definition.en: The whole card is the target

distinction.zh: 选中给 2px 主色边 + 浅底，别只靠一个小勾。
distinction.en: A 2px accent border and tint — a tiny tick is not enough.

items.dz: 圆心亮起
items.de: The centre lights up
items.pz: 内点用 scale 从 0 到 1，别用 opacity。
items.pe: Scale the inner dot from 0 — not opacity.

definition.zh: 圆心亮起
definition.en: The centre lights up

distinction.zh: 内点用 scale 从 0 到 1，别用 opacity。
distinction.en: Scale the inner dot from 0 — not opacity.

items.dz: 滑块滑到选中项
items.de: The pill slides to the choice
items.pz: 背景滑块用 transform 平移，宽度差异要一起过渡。
items.pe: Translate one pill; transition width too when segments differ.

definition.zh: 滑块滑到选中项
definition.en: The pill slides to the choice

distinction.zh: 背景滑块用 transform 平移，宽度差异要一起过渡。
distinction.en: Translate one pill; transition width too when segments differ.

items.dz: 下划线跟着标签走
items.de: The rule follows the tab
items.pz: 一条线的 translateX + width 过渡，不要每个标签自带线。
items.pe: One rule transitioning translateX and width.

definition.zh: 下划线跟着标签走
definition.en: The rule follows the tab

distinction.zh: 一条线的 translateX + width 过渡，不要每个标签自带线。
distinction.en: One rule transitioning translateX and width.

items.dz: 点一下就选上
items.de: Tap to include
items.pz: 选中翻转为深底白字，未选保持描边。
items.pe: Selected inverts to dark; unselected stays outlined.

definition.zh: 点一下就选上
definition.en: Tap to include

distinction.zh: 选中翻转为深底白字，未选保持描边。
distinction.en: Selected inverts to dark; unselected stays outlined.

items.dz: 带叉号可删除
items.de: A small cross removes it
items.pz: 删除后其余项用 FLIP 平滑补位。
items.pe: Reflow the rest with a FLIP transition.

definition.zh: 带叉号可删除
definition.en: A small cross removes it

distinction.zh: 删除后其余项用 FLIP 平滑补位。
distinction.en: Reflow the rest with a FLIP transition.

items.dz: 一组里只能选一个
items.de: One of the set
items.pz: 相邻按钮共用 1px 边，选中项 z-index 提前。
items.pe: Share the 1px border; raise the active item.

definition.zh: 一组里只能选一个
definition.en: One of the set

distinction.zh: 相邻按钮共用 1px 边，选中项 z-index 提前。
distinction.en: Share the 1px border; raise the active item.

items.dz: 悬停到第几颗就亮到第几颗
items.de: Hover lights up to that star
items.pz: 用 ~ 兄弟选择器实现悬停填充，键盘也要能改。
items.pe: Sibling selectors for hover fill; keep it keyboard-operable.

definition.zh: 悬停到第几颗就亮到第几颗
definition.en: Hover lights up to that star

distinction.zh: 用 ~ 兄弟选择器实现悬停填充，键盘也要能改。
distinction.en: Sibling selectors for hover fill; keep it keyboard-operable.

items.dz: 按下时迸出小粒子
items.de: Particles burst on press
items.pz: 心形 scale 过冲 1.3 回到 1，粒子 400ms 后清除。
items.pe: Overshoot the heart to 1.3, and clean up particles after 400ms.

definition.zh: 按下时迸出小粒子
definition.en: Particles burst on press

items.de: Maintain a minimum distance between two thumbs so the selected range cannot collapse below a valid width.
items.pz: 原站展示两种约束处理：到达间隔后停止，或推动另一端使区间平移。最小间隔在变更逻辑中执行，disableSwap 只控制拖过另一端时是否交换活动滑块，不能单独替代间隔校验。 预览为原站静态截图；交互范围见原站示例。
items.pe: The source contrasts stopping at the minimum gap with shifting the range. Change handling enforces the gap. disableSwap controls active-thumb swapping when crossing another thumb and does not by itself enforce a minimum distance. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; follow the source link for interaction.

distinction.zh: 原站 limitTags 示例显示前两项和 +1，缩短未编辑时的字段长度。被折叠的项仍在已选集合中；这是显示限制，不是选择上限，也不是结果被删除。 预览为原站静态截图；交互范围见原站示例。
distinction.en: The limitTags example shows two items and +1 to reduce the field's unfocused footprint. Hidden tags remain selected. This is a presentation limit, not a selection cap or removal of values. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; follow the source link for interaction.

items.dz: 让拖动滑块和直接输入数字共享同一数值，兼顾粗调与精确输入。
items.de: Bind a slider and a number field to one value for coarse adjustment and exact entry.
items.pz: 原站 Volume 示例把滑块、音量图标和数字输入放在同一行。两个控件需要同步状态与有效范围，输入结束时还需处理超界值；并排摆放而没有共享值，不能称作联动。 预览为原站静态截图；交互范围见原站示例。
items.pe: The Volume example places a slider, icon and numeric field in one row. They must share state and valid bounds, including handling out-of-range input on completion. Mere side-by-side placement does not establish synchronization. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; follow the source link for interaction.
