distinction.en: Named grid-template-areas is the sturdiest version.

items.dz: 大小不一、白缝分割的拼贴
items.de: Mismatched tiles split by crisp white gutters
items.pz: 刻意打破对称，缝隙保持一致的纯白，是最有性格的一种拼图。
items.pe: Break symmetry on purpose and keep the white gutters even.

definition.zh: 大小不一、白缝分割的拼贴
definition.en: Mismatched tiles split by crisp white gutters

distinction.zh: 刻意打破对称，缝隙保持一致的纯白，是最有性格的一种拼图。
distinction.en: Break symmetry on purpose and keep the white gutters even.

items.dz: 整屏一句话
items.de: One sentence owning the screen
items.pz: 给主视觉留大量留白，一句话 + 一个 CTA 就够。
items.pe: Leave a lot of air: one sentence and one CTA is enough.

definition.zh: 整屏一句话
definition.en: One sentence owning the screen

distinction.zh: 给主视觉留大量留白，一句话 + 一个 CTA 就够。
distinction.en: Leave a lot of air: one sentence and one CTA is enough.

items.dz: 图文互相压住一角
items.de: Blocks deliberately overlap at a corner
items.pz: 让两个 grid item 落在同一格并用 z-index/margin 错开。
items.pe: Place two items in the same cell and offset with margin/z-index.

definition.zh: 图文互相压住一角
definition.en: Blocks deliberately overlap at a corner

distinction.zh: 让两个 grid item 落在同一格并用 z-index/margin 错开。
distinction.en: Place two items in the same cell and offset with margin/z-index.

items.dz: 长文两栏排版
items.de: Long-form set in two columns
items.pz: 正文列宽 60–75 字符，column-gap 至少 2rem。
items.pe: Measure of 60–75 characters, column-gap at least 2rem.

definition.zh: 长文两栏排版
definition.en: Long-form set in two columns

distinction.zh: 正文列宽 60–75 字符，column-gap 至少 2rem。
distinction.en: Measure of 60–75 characters, column-gap at least 2rem.

items.dz: 按容器宽度自动换行
items.de: Cards rewrap to the container width
items.pz: repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))，无需媒体查询。
items.pe: repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr)) — no media queries needed.

definition.zh: 按容器宽度自动换行
definition.en: Cards rewrap to the container width

distinction.zh: repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))，无需媒体查询。
distinction.en: repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr)) — no media queries needed.

items.dz: 所有格子保持同一比例
items.de: Every tile keeps the same ratio
items.pz: aspect-ratio 而不是写死高度，图片用 object-fit:cover。
items.pe: aspect-ratio instead of fixed heights; images object-fit:cover.

definition.zh: 所有格子保持同一比例
definition.en: Every tile keeps the same ratio

distinction.zh: aspect-ratio 而不是写死高度，图片用 object-fit:cover。
distinction.en: aspect-ratio instead of fixed heights; images object-fit:cover.

items.dz: 斜线把版面分成两块
items.de: A diagonal cuts the layout in two
items.pz: clip-path polygon 做斜切，注意内容避让斜边。
items.pe: clip-path polygon for the cut; keep content clear of the angle.

definition.zh: 斜线把版面分成两块
definition.en: A diagonal cuts the layout in two

distinction.zh: clip-path polygon 做斜切，注意内容避让斜边。
distinction.en: clip-path polygon for the cut; keep content clear of the angle.

items.dz: 统计卡按栅格排布
items.de: Stat cards on a 12-column grid
items.pz: 12 栅格 + span 组合，卡片高度用行数控制而非固定值。
items.pe: 12 columns with spans; control height by row count, not pixels.

definition.zh: 统计卡按栅格排布
definition.en: Stat cards on a 12-column grid

distinction.zh: 12 栅格 + span 组合，卡片高度用行数控制而非固定值。
distinction.en: 12 columns with spans; control height by row count, not pixels.

items.dz: 一条线串起事件
items.de: Events threaded on one line
items.pz: 左侧一条线 + 节点，内容右侧对齐，节点用伪元素。
items.pe: A rule with pseudo-element nodes on the left, content right.

definition.zh: 一条线串起事件
definition.en: Events threaded on one line

distinction.zh: 左侧一条线 + 节点，内容右侧对齐，节点用伪元素。
distinction.en: A rule with pseudo-element nodes on the left, content right.

items.dz: 流程分步指示
items.de: Step-by-step progress
items.pz: 等分 flex + 连接线用伪元素，当前步高亮。
items.pe: Equal flex items joined by pseudo-element rules; highlight the active step.

definition.zh: 流程分步指示
definition.en: Step-by-step progress

distinction.zh: 等分 flex + 连接线用伪元素，当前步高亮。
distinction.en: Equal flex items joined by pseudo-element rules; highlight the active step.

items.dz: 目录固定、正文滚动
items.de: Pinned table of contents, scrolling body
items.pz: sticky 元素的父级不能有 overflow:hidden。
items.pe: A sticky child needs a parent without overflow clipping.

definition.zh: 目录固定、正文滚动
definition.en: Pinned table of contents, scrolling body

distinction.zh: sticky 元素的父级不能有 overflow:hidden。
distinction.en: A sticky child needs a parent without overflow clipping.

items.dz: 并排比较几个方案
items.de: Options compared side by side
items.pz: 列宽等分、突出推荐列，行高统一避免锯齿。
items.pe: Equal columns, one highlighted; keep row heights uniform.

items.dz: 左字右图的经典首屏
items.de: Copy left, image right
items.pz: 文字列 45–55% 宽，图片列出血到边。
items.pe: Copy column 45–55%, image bleeding to the edge.

definition.zh: 左字右图的经典首屏
definition.en: Copy left, image right

distinction.zh: 文字列 45–55% 宽，图片列出血到边。
distinction.en: Copy column 45–55%, image bleeding to the edge.

items.dz: 一大多小的图片墙
items.de: One large image with small ones around it
items.pz: 第一张 span 2×2，其余自动填充。
items.pe: First tile spans 2×2, the rest auto-fill.

definition.zh: 一大多小的图片墙
definition.en: One large image with small ones around it

distinction.zh: 第一张 span 2×2，其余自动填充。
distinction.en: First tile spans 2×2, the rest auto-fill.

items.dz: 正文只占中间一条
items.de: Body copy in one centred column
items.pz: max-width:68ch + margin:auto，两侧留白比内容更重要。
items.pe: max-width:68ch with auto margins — the air matters more than the text.

definition.zh: 正文只占中间一条
definition.en: Body copy in one centred column

distinction.zh: max-width:68ch + margin:auto，两侧留白比内容更重要。
distinction.en: max-width:68ch with auto margins — the air matters more than the text.

items.dz: 一行可横滑的卡片
items.de: A horizontally scrollable row of cards
items.pz: overflow-x:auto + scroll-snap，首尾留 padding 做透出。
items.pe: overflow-x auto with scroll-snap and edge padding for peeking.

definition.zh: 一行可横滑的卡片
definition.en: A horizontally scrollable row of cards

distinction.zh: overflow-x:auto + scroll-snap，首尾留 padding 做透出。
distinction.en: overflow-x auto with scroll-snap and edge padding for peeking.

items.dz: 按钮一直贴在底部
items.de: The action bar stays at the bottom
items.pz: position:sticky;bottom:0 + 安全区 padding-bottom。
items.pe: position:sticky;bottom:0 plus safe-area padding.

definition.zh: 按钮一直贴在底部
definition.en: The action bar stays at the bottom

distinction.zh: position:sticky;bottom:0 + 安全区 padding-bottom。
distinction.en: position:sticky;bottom:0 plus safe-area padding.

items.dz: 图文左右交替往下走
items.de: Text and image alternate sides down the page
items.pz: 奇偶行用 direction 或 order 交换左右，节奏一致。
items.pe: Swap sides on odd/even rows with order; keep the rhythm even.

definition.zh: 图文左右交替往下走
definition.en: Text and image alternate sides down the page

distinction.zh: 奇偶行用 direction 或 order 交换左右，节奏一致。
distinction.en: Swap sides on odd/even rows with order; keep the rhythm even.

items.dz: 小屏一切都变一列
items.de: Everything becomes one column on mobile
items.pz: 先写单列，再在断点上升级为多列（mobile first）。
items.pe: Write the single column first, then upgrade at breakpoints.

definition.zh: 小屏一切都变一列
definition.en: Everything becomes one column on mobile

distinction.zh: 先写单列，再在断点上升级为多列（mobile first）。
distinction.en: Write the single column first, then upgrade at breakpoints.

items.dz: 不对称但舒服的比例
items.de: Asymmetric but comfortable proportions
items.pz: 用 1.618:1 或 2:3 这样的比例，比 50/50 更有张力。
items.pe: Use 1.618:1 or 2:3 — more tension than a flat 50/50.

definition.zh: 不对称但舒服的比例
definition.en: Asymmetric but comfortable proportions

distinction.zh: 用 1.618:1 或 2:3 这样的比例，比 50/50 更有张力。
distinction.en: Use 1.618:1 or 2:3 — more tension than a flat 50/50.

items.dz: 一列一个状态，卡片往右走
items.de: One column per state; cards move right
items.pz: 四列等宽 flex，列 = 状态，卡 = 任务；列头钉住，列内纵向滚动。
items.pe: Four equal flex columns: column = state, card = task. Pin the column head, scroll the body.

items.dz: 抬头 + 明细表 + 右侧总额
items.de: Header, line-item table, totals pushed right
items.pz: 明细行走 table，金额列右对齐；税与总额贴右下，付款指引单独一块。
items.pe: Line items in a table with a right-aligned amount column; tax and totals hug the bottom-right, payment terms get their own block.

items.dz: 一张纸看完一个人
items.de: One sheet, one whole career
items.pz: 容器锁 210:297 的纸比例，正文两栏 60/40，章节标题上方压一条短 accent 线。
items.pe: Lock the container to a 210:297 sheet, split the body 60/40, and set a short accent rule above every section title.

items.dz: 新人第一周干嘛，一屏看完
items.de: The whole first week in one scroll
items.pz: 长页分块：日程做成五段横条，经理和 buddy 并排两卡，学习路径与设备清单各自成块。
items.pe: Chunk the long page: a five-segment day strip, manager and buddy side by side, then the learning track and the kit list as their own blocks.

items.dz: 问题、指标、范围、故事，四块讲完
items.de: Problem, metrics, scope, stories — four blocks and done
items.pz: 顶部标题条挂状态 pill，下面 2×2：问题与指标一行，范围内外与 user stories 一行。
items.pe: A title bar carries the status pill; below it a 2x2 — problem and metrics on one row, scope in/out and user stories on the next.

items.dz: 季度横幅下面一排进度条
items.de: A quarter banner over a row of progress bars
items.pz: 季度 banner 占满顶部，每个 KR 一根条，按状态上色，条顶的小圆点就是 owner。
items.pe: The quarter banner spans the top; one bar per key result, coloured by status, with the owner as a dot sitting on top of it.

items.dz: 一页一主题，横着翻
items.de: One topic per page, swipe sideways
items.pz: 封面 / 已发布 / 进行中 / 阻塞 / 指标格 / 求助 / 致谢各占一块，页数固定才写得下去。
items.pe: Cover, shipped, in flight, blocked, a metric grid, asks and thanks each get one block — a fixed page count is what keeps it writable.

items.dz: 左议程右决议，action 必须有主
items.de: Agenda left, decisions right, every action owned
items.pz: 左右分栏：左边出席头像加议程勾选，右边决议卡片压着三行 action items。
items.pe: Split it: attendance and the agenda checklist on the left, a decisions card stacked over three action rows on the right.

items.dz: 600 宽单栏，到哪儿都一个样
items.de: A 600px single column that holds everywhere
items.pz: 锁 600px 单栏，规格用三列等分；布局靠 table 兜底，颜色全部写 inline。
items.pe: Lock a 600px single column, divide the specs into three equal cells, fall back to tables for layout and keep every colour inline.

items.dz: 一段内容被自动分成几栏，栏间有间距与分隔线。
items.de: One flow of content splits into balanced columns with gaps and rules.
items.pz: columns:3;column-rule:1px solid —— 内容自动平衡分栏。说「做成三栏」即此。
items.pe: columns:3 with column-rule balances one flow into three columns.

definition.zh: 多栏布局把一个内容流按指定栏数或栏宽自动分段，各栏共享同一内容流，由浏览器平衡栏高。
definition.en: Multi-column splits one content flow into balanced columns sharing a single flow.

distinction.zh: 与 grid 的区别：grid 的列是独立容器、项目显式放置；multicol 的栏是同一流的自 continuations，内容自动跨栏续排。
distinction.en: Grid columns are separate tracks with explicit items; multicol columns are continuations of one flow.

items.dz: 禁止一个块在分栏/分页边界被切成两半。
items.de: Forbids a box from being split across columns or pages.
items.pz: break-inside:avoid 用在卡片上，跨栏/打印分页时不被切半。说「这块不许断开」即此。
items.pe: break-inside:avoid keeps cards whole across columns and printed pages.

definition.zh: break-inside: avoid 告诉碎片化器（多栏、分页）不要在这个盒内部产生断点，宁可整块移到下一栏/页。
definition.en: break-inside: avoid tells the fragmentainer not to break inside this box; it moves whole instead.

distinction.zh: 与 break-after: avoid 的区别：inside 管盒内部断点，after 管盒与下一个兄弟之间；avoid 是请求而非强制，放不下时仍会断。
distinction.en: inside governs breaks within the box; break-after governs the gap to the next sibling; avoid is a request, not a guarantee.

items.dz: 容器有剩余空间时，按 grow 比例分给各弹性行。
items.de: Free space is distributed to items proportional to flex-grow.
items.pz: flex-grow 是份额不是倍数：1/1/3 是把余量按 1:1:3 分。说「这块吃三份余量」即此。
items.pe: flex-grow shares free space in ratios, not multipliers.

definition.zh: flex-grow 决定弹性行按什么份额瓜分容器的剩余空间：余量先按 grow 比例分配，再叠加到各自 basis 上。
definition.en: flex-grow sets the share of leftover space each item receives on top of its basis.

distinction.zh: 与 flex-shrink 方向相反（grow 分余量、shrink 分缺口）；与 flex-basis 的区别：basis 是分配前的理想尺寸，grow 只管分配增量。
distinction.en: grow distributes surplus, shrink distributes deficit; basis is the pre-distribution size.

relations.reason: 分配方向相反：余量 vs 缺口。

items.dz: 容器放不下时，按 shrink 比例从各弹性行扣宽。
items.de: Overflow is removed from items proportional to flex-shrink.
items.pz: flex-shrink:0 是「不许压我」；默认 1。防止卡片被挤变形时常用。说「这块不许收缩」即此。
items.pe: flex-shrink:0 forbids squeezing; the default is 1.

definition.zh: flex-shrink 决定总宽超出容器时从各弹性行扣除多少：按 shrink 加权分摊缺口。
definition.en: flex-shrink weights how deficit is removed from each item when the line overflows.

distinction.zh: 与 flex-grow 相反方向；与 min-width 的区别：min-width 是硬下限，shrink 是分摊权重，受 min-width 约束。
distinction.en: grow adds surplus; shrink removes deficit within min-width floors.

items.dz: 行与列的间距由一个属性统一声明，不靠 margin。
items.de: Row and column gaps are declared in one property instead of margins.
items.pz: gap:14px 同时管行列间距；只在主轴开缝用 row-gap 或 column-gap。说「用 gap 开缝」即此。
items.pe: gap:14px handles both axes; row-gap/column-gap split them.

aliases.scope: grid-gap 是 gap 在 grid 中的旧名

definition.zh: gap 在 flex/grid/multicol 的轨道或行之间创建固定间距，只在有缝的地方生效，首尾不产生额外空白。
definition.en: gap inserts fixed spacing between tracks/lines only — no leading or trailing space.

distinction.zh: 与 margin 的区别：margin 依附于单个元素（会带来首尾多余空隙与折叠问题），gap 依附于容器轨道且自动跳过单行/单列。
distinction.en: margin rides on items (edge overflow, collapsing); gap rides on tracks and vanishes when there is one line.

items.dz: align-* 管块轴、justify-* 管行轴，一套词汇通吃 grid 与 flex。
items.de: align-* runs the block axis, justify-* the inline axis — one vocabulary for grid and flex.
items.pz: 把 9 个格子统一压到底部居中：align-items:end + justify-items:center。说「按盒对齐调」即此。
items.pe: align-items:end + justify-items:center parks every cell bottom-center.

definition.zh: 盒对齐是跨布局模式的统一对齐系统：align-* 沿块轴排项目/轨道，justify-* 沿行轴，place-* 是两者简写。
definition.en: Box alignment is the shared alignment system: align-* on the block axis, justify-* on the inline axis, place-* as shorthand.

distinction.zh: 与 float/text-align 的区别：盒对齐作用于容器与轨道的关系（轴语义），不是文档流的漂浮或文本内对齐。
distinction.en: float/text-align act on flow and inline text; box alignment acts between container and tracks on axes.

items.dz: 一组元素共享的渲染顺序原子层，内外 z-index 互不串位。
items.de: An atomic render-order group; z-index battles never cross its border.
items.pz: 父级有了 opacity<1/transform/isolation 就形成上下文，子元素 z-index 再大也只在组内比。说「隔离层级」即此。
items.pe: opacity<1/transform/isolation on the parent walls off children's z-index.

definition.zh: 堆叠上下文是渲染顺序的最小闭包：由根、定位+z-index、opacity<1、transform、filter、isolation 等条件触发，其内部子元素的 z-index 只在本上下文内比较。
definition.en: A stacking context is the atomic unit of paint order; children's z-index compares only inside it.

distinction.zh: 与 z-index 数值大小的区别：跨上下文时数值不再直接可比，父上下文整体参与外层排序；理解它是排查「z-index 失灵」的关键。
distinction.en: Across contexts, raw z-index values are not comparable — the whole context ranks as one unit.

items.dz: 元素脱流靠边，行盒绕其行进——文字环绕的原生机制。
items.de: Floats shift the box aside; line boxes flow around it.
items.pz: 图文环绕 float:left + 行盒绕排；现代布局交给 flex/grid，float 回归本职（环绕与首字下沉）。说「文字绕开它」即此。
items.pe: float:left wraps text around the box; flex/grid own layout now.

definition.zh: float 使元素脱离常规流并向行首/行末靠拢，后续行盒缩短以绕开浮动体，直至 clear 打断。
definition.en: float removes the box from flow; line boxes shorten to wrap around it until clear.

distinction.zh: 与 flex/grid 的区别：浮动不是布局系统而是行内环绕机制——它不改变容器盒型，只影响行盒形状；shape-outside 是其形状扩展。
distinction.en: float wraps lines; flex/grid lay out containers.

dz: 把内容摆到圆上：环形画廊、弧形轮播、扇形展开
de: Content laid on a circle — ring galleries, arc carousels, fans

items.dz: 图片卡沿着圆周排一圈
items.de: Image cards laid around a circle
items.pz: 第 i 张：rotate(i×360/n) translateY(-半径)，再反向 rotate 让卡片竖直。
items.pe: Card i: rotate(i·360/n) translateY(−r), then counter-rotate so it stays upright.

definition.zh: 图片卡沿着圆周排一圈
definition.en: Image cards laid around a circle

distinction.zh: 第 i 张：rotate(i×360/n) translateY(-半径)，再反向 rotate 让卡片竖直。
distinction.en: Card i: rotate(i·360/n) translateY(−r), then counter-rotate so it stays upright.

items.dz: 整圈慢慢转，卡片始终朝上
items.de: The ring turns while cards stay upright
items.pz: 容器无限 rotate，子卡反向同速 rotate 抵消。
items.pe: Spin the container; counter-spin each card at the same rate.

definition.zh: 整圈慢慢转，卡片始终朝上
definition.en: The ring turns while cards stay upright

distinction.zh: 容器无限 rotate，子卡反向同速 rotate 抵消。
distinction.en: Spin the container; counter-spin each card at the same rate.

items.dz: 圆环躺下来，成了椭圆
items.de: The ring lies back into an ellipse
items.pz: 容器 rotateX(64deg)，卡片再 rotateX(-64deg) 立起来。
items.pe: rotateX(64deg) on the ring, −64deg on each card to stand it up.

definition.zh: 圆环躺下来，成了椭圆
definition.en: The ring lies back into an ellipse

distinction.zh: 容器 rotateX(64deg)，卡片再 rotateX(-64deg) 立起来。
distinction.en: rotateX(64deg) on the ring, −64deg on each card to stand it up.

items.dz: 像手里的一把牌
items.de: Like a hand of cards
items.pz: transform-origin 放在底部很远处，每张只差 6–10°。
items.pe: Put the origin far below and step 6–10° per card.

definition.zh: 像手里的一把牌
definition.en: Like a hand of cards

distinction.zh: transform-origin 放在底部很远处，每张只差 6–10°。
distinction.en: Put the origin far below and step 6–10° per card.

items.dz: 一排卡沿弧线起伏
items.de: A row curving along an arc
items.pz: 按索引给 translateY = 弧高×(1−cos)，并同步 rotate。
items.pe: translateY by arc height×(1−cos) with a matching rotate.

definition.zh: 一排卡沿弧线起伏
definition.en: A row curving along an arc

distinction.zh: 按索引给 translateY = 弧高×(1−cos)，并同步 rotate。
distinction.en: translateY by arc height×(1−cos) with a matching rotate.

items.dz: 中间那张正对你
items.de: The middle one faces you
items.pz: 按与中心的距离插值 scale / translateY / rotate 三者。
items.pe: Interpolate scale, translateY and rotate by distance from centre.

definition.zh: 中间那张正对你
definition.en: The middle one faces you

distinction.zh: 按与中心的距离插值 scale / translateY / rotate 三者。
distinction.en: Interpolate scale, translateY and rotate by distance from centre.

items.dz: 小图绕着主图转
items.de: Thumbs orbit the hero
items.pz: 主图静止，缩略图共享一个旋转容器。
items.pe: Hero stays; the thumbs share one spinning container.

definition.zh: 小图绕着主图转
definition.en: Thumbs orbit the hero

distinction.zh: 主图静止，缩略图共享一个旋转容器。
distinction.en: Hero stays; the thumbs share one spinning container.

items.dz: 一张张飞到圆上
items.de: They fly onto the circle one by one
items.pz: 从圆心 scale(0) 飞到目标角度，错峰 70ms。
items.pe: From scale(0) at the centre to the target angle, 70ms apart.

definition.zh: 一张张飞到圆上
definition.en: They fly onto the circle one by one

distinction.zh: 从圆心 scale(0) 飞到目标角度，错峰 70ms。
distinction.en: From scale(0) at the centre to the target angle, 70ms apart.

items.dz: 长按从中心弹出一圈
items.de: Hold and options bloom outward
items.pz: 按下时半径 0 → 目标，透明度同步，总时长 240ms。
items.pe: Radius 0 → target with opacity, 240ms total.

definition.zh: 长按从中心弹出一圈
definition.en: Hold and options bloom outward

distinction.zh: 按下时半径 0 → 目标，透明度同步，总时长 240ms。
distinction.en: Radius 0 → target with opacity, 240ms total.

items.dz: 像花一样张开
items.de: It opens like a flower
items.pz: 每片 transform-origin 在圆心，rotate + scaleY 同时。
items.pe: Origin at the centre, rotate and scaleY together.

definition.zh: 像花一样张开
definition.en: It opens like a flower

distinction.zh: 每片 transform-origin 在圆心，rotate + scaleY 同时。
distinction.en: Origin at the centre, rotate and scaleY together.

items.dz: 字沿着圆周排
items.de: Letters set around a circle
items.pz: 每个字 rotate(i×角) translateY(-半径)，字距靠角度调。
items.pe: Per glyph: rotate(i·step) translateY(−r); tracking is the angle.

definition.zh: 字沿着圆周排
definition.en: Letters set around a circle

distinction.zh: 每个字 rotate(i×角) translateY(-半径)，字距靠角度调。
distinction.en: Per glyph: rotate(i·step) translateY(−r); tracking is the angle.

items.dz: 徽章上的字在转
items.de: The badge type turns
items.pz: 整体 rotate 无限，速度 12–20s 才不晕。
items.pe: One endless rotate at 12–20s so it does not nauseate.

definition.zh: 徽章上的字在转
definition.en: The badge type turns

distinction.zh: 整体 rotate 无限，速度 12–20s 才不晕。
distinction.en: One endless rotate at 12–20s so it does not nauseate.

items.dz: 一圈被切成几段
items.de: The ring is cut into segments
items.pz: conic-gradient 硬色标 + 环形遮罩，段间留 2° 缝。
items.pe: Hard conic stops with a ring mask and a 2° gap.

definition.zh: 一圈被切成几段
definition.en: The ring is cut into segments

distinction.zh: conic-gradient 硬色标 + 环形遮罩，段间留 2° 缝。
distinction.en: Hard conic stops with a ring mask and a 2° gap.

items.dz: 一圈刻度线
items.de: A ring of tick marks
items.pz: 刻度用 repeating-conic-gradient，长刻度另叠一层。
items.pe: repeating-conic-gradient for ticks, a second layer for majors.

definition.zh: 一圈刻度线
definition.en: A ring of tick marks

distinction.zh: 刻度用 repeating-conic-gradient，长刻度另叠一层。
distinction.en: repeating-conic-gradient for ticks, a second layer for majors.

items.dz: 像 iOS 的滚轮
items.de: The iOS wheel
items.pz: 按距中心行数给 rotateX 与透明度，中间那行最清晰。
items.pe: rotateX and alpha by row distance; the centre row is crispest.

definition.zh: 像 iOS 的滚轮
definition.en: The iOS wheel

distinction.zh: 按距中心行数给 rotateX 与透明度，中间那行最清晰。
distinction.en: rotateX and alpha by row distance; the centre row is crispest.

items.dz: 一串封面绕成圆柱
items.de: Covers wrapped into a cylinder
items.pz: rotateY(i×角) translateZ(半径)，父层 perspective 1200。
items.pe: rotateY(i·step) translateZ(r) under a 1200px perspective.

definition.zh: 一串封面绕成圆柱
definition.en: Covers wrapped into a cylinder

distinction.zh: rotateY(i×角) translateZ(半径)，父层 perspective 1200。
distinction.en: rotateY(i·step) translateZ(r) under a 1200px perspective.

items.dz: 一圈头像围着中心
items.de: Avatars circling a centre
items.pz: 头像加白描边，圆周留一个缺口放“+N”。
items.pe: White rings on the avatars, one slot left for “+N”.

definition.zh: 一圈头像围着中心
definition.en: Avatars circling a centre

distinction.zh: 头像加白描边，圆周留一个缺口放“+N”。
distinction.en: White rings on the avatars, one slot left for “+N”.

items.dz: 一圈圈向外推
items.de: Rings pushing outward
items.pz: 多圈错峰 scale + 透明度衰减，delay 平均分布。
items.pe: Staggered scale with fading alpha, evenly delayed.

definition.zh: 一圈圈向外推
definition.en: Rings pushing outward

distinction.zh: 多圈错峰 scale + 透明度衰减，delay 平均分布。
distinction.en: Staggered scale with fading alpha, evenly delayed.

items.dz: 半径与角度同时增长
items.de: Radius and angle grow together
items.pz: 第 i 张：角度 i×35°、半径 40+i×12px。
items.pe: Card i: angle i·35°, radius 40+i·12px.

definition.zh: 半径与角度同时增长
definition.en: Radius and angle grow together

distinction.zh: 第 i 张：角度 i×35°、半径 40+i×12px。
distinction.en: Card i: angle i·35°, radius 40+i·12px.

items.dz: 十二个位置各就各位
items.de: Twelve positions, each in place
items.pz: 12 等分最常用：每格 30°，注意 12 点在 -90°。
items.pe: Twelve slots of 30°; remember 12 o’clock is −90°.

definition.zh: 十二个位置各就各位
definition.en: Twelve positions, each in place

distinction.zh: 12 等分最常用：每格 30°，注意 12 点在 -90°。
distinction.en: Twelve slots of 30°; remember 12 o’clock is −90°.

items.dz: 留一个口子放数值
items.de: A gap left for the value
items.pz: conic 起止角避开底部 60°，缺口处放标签。
items.pe: Skip the bottom 60° in the conic and put the label there.

definition.zh: 留一个口子放数值
definition.en: A gap left for the value

distinction.zh: conic 起止角避开底部 60°，缺口处放标签。
distinction.en: Skip the bottom 60° in the conic and put the label there.

items.dz: 一圈卡片还带厚度
items.de: The ring has thickness
items.pz: 同一角度放两张，后一张 translateZ 更远并变暗。
items.pe: Two cards per angle; the back one sits deeper and darker.

definition.zh: 一圈卡片还带厚度
definition.en: The ring has thickness

distinction.zh: 同一角度放两张，后一张 translateZ 更远并变暗。
distinction.en: Two cards per angle; the back one sits deeper and darker.

items.dz: 悬停那张向外弹出
items.de: The hovered card pops outward
items.pz: 沿半径方向再推 16px，其余降饱和。
items.pe: Push it 16px further out and desaturate the rest.

definition.zh: 悬停那张向外弹出
definition.en: The hovered card pops outward

distinction.zh: 沿半径方向再推 16px，其余降饱和。
distinction.en: Push it 16px further out and desaturate the rest.

items.dz: 半径不一样才不呆
items.de: Uneven radii keep it alive
items.pz: 给半径加 ±12px 的伪随机扰动，比完美圆更有机。
items.pe: Jitter the radius ±12px — more organic than a perfect circle.

definition.zh: 半径不一样才不呆
definition.en: Uneven radii keep it alive

distinction.zh: 给半径加 ±12px 的伪随机扰动，比完美圆更有机。
distinction.en: Jitter the radius ±12px — more organic than a perfect circle.

items.dz: 中间留孔放总数
items.de: The hole holds the total
items.pz: 甜甜圈比饼图好读：中心可以放最重要的数。
items.pe: A donut beats a pie — the hole carries the headline number.

definition.zh: 中间留孔放总数
definition.en: The hole holds the total

distinction.zh: 甜甜圈比饼图好读：中心可以放最重要的数。
distinction.en: A donut beats a pie — the hole carries the headline number.

items.dz: 两层环表示层级
items.de: Two rings, two levels
items.pz: 内环是父级、外环是子级，颜色继承父级色相。
items.pe: Inner ring parents, outer ring children inheriting the hue.

definition.zh: 两层环表示层级
definition.en: Two rings, two levels

distinction.zh: 内环是父级、外环是子级，颜色继承父级色相。
distinction.en: Inner ring parents, outer ring children inheriting the hue.

items.dz: 多个维度一起看
items.de: Several axes at once
items.pz: 轴数 5–7 最好读，超过 8 就成一团。
items.pe: Five to seven axes read best; past eight it is mush.

definition.zh: 多个维度一起看
definition.en: Several axes at once

distinction.zh: 轴数 5–7 最好读，超过 8 就成一团。
distinction.en: Five to seven axes read best; past eight it is mush.

items.dz: 留 90° 缺口的仪表
items.de: A gauge with a 90° gap
items.pz: 从 135° 起画 270°，缺口朝下最符合直觉。
items.pe: Start at 135° for 270°, gap facing down.

definition.zh: 留 90° 缺口的仪表
definition.en: A gauge with a 90° gap

distinction.zh: 从 135° 起画 270°，缺口朝下最符合直觉。
distinction.en: Start at 135° for 270°, gap facing down.

items.dz: 文字沿弧线滚动
items.de: Type scrolls along a curve
items.pz: 文字先摆到圆上，再整体旋转，就是弧形滚动。
items.pe: Place the type on the circle, then rotate the whole thing.

definition.zh: 文字沿弧线滚动
definition.en: Type scrolls along a curve

distinction.zh: 文字先摆到圆上，再整体旋转，就是弧形滚动。
distinction.en: Place the type on the circle, then rotate the whole thing.

items.dz: 两个半环相对
items.de: Two half rings facing each other
items.pz: 两层 conic 各占一半，中间留白做数值。
items.pe: Two conics, half each, with a value between.

definition.zh: 两个半环相对
definition.en: Two half rings facing each other

distinction.zh: 两层 conic 各占一半，中间留白做数值。
distinction.en: Two conics, half each, with a value between.

items.dz: 节点在圆上，连线在圆内
items.de: Nodes on the rim, links across the middle
items.pz: 节点在圆周、连线走弦，弦用二次贝塞尔更好看。
items.pe: Nodes on the rim, chords across — quadratic curves read better.

definition.zh: 节点在圆上，连线在圆内
definition.en: Nodes on the rim, links across the middle

distinction.zh: 节点在圆周、连线走弦，弦用二次贝塞尔更好看。
distinction.en: Nodes on the rim, chords across — quadratic curves read better.

items.dz: 铜银金三级徽章
items.de: Bronze, silver, gold
items.pz: 同一形状换材质渐变，倾斜 8° 更有雕塑感。
items.pe: One shape, three material gradients, tilted 8°.

definition.zh: 铜银金三级徽章
definition.en: Bronze, silver, gold

distinction.zh: 同一形状换材质渐变，倾斜 8° 更有雕塑感。
distinction.en: One shape, three material gradients, tilted 8°.

items.dz: 小球顺着轨迹走
items.de: A dot follows the track
items.pz: offset-path + offset-distance 是原生方案，比手算坐标准。
items.pe: offset-path with offset-distance beats hand-computed coordinates.

definition.zh: 小球顺着轨迹走
definition.en: A dot follows the track

distinction.zh: offset-path + offset-distance 是原生方案，比手算坐标准。
distinction.en: offset-path with offset-distance beats hand-computed coordinates.

items.dz: 一圈依次起伏
items.de: The ring breathes in sequence
items.pz: delay 按角度递增，一圈刚好一个周期。
items.pe: Delay by angle so one lap equals one cycle.

definition.zh: 一圈依次起伏
definition.en: The ring breathes in sequence

distinction.zh: delay 按角度递增，一圈刚好一个周期。
distinction.en: Delay by angle so one lap equals one cycle.

items.dz: 圆盘斜着放，像唱片
items.de: A disc set at an angle
items.pz: rotateX(66deg) + 厚度用第二层 translateZ 假造。
items.pe: rotateX(66deg) plus a second layer for thickness.

definition.zh: 圆盘斜着放，像唱片
definition.en: A disc set at an angle

distinction.zh: rotateX(66deg) + 厚度用第二层 translateZ 假造。
distinction.en: rotateX(66deg) plus a second layer for thickness.

items.dz: 大圆里塞小圆
items.de: Circles nested in circles
items.pz: 面积映射数值，不要用直径（会夸大 4 倍）。
items.pe: Map value to area — diameter exaggerates by four.

definition.zh: 大圆里塞小圆
definition.en: Circles nested in circles

distinction.zh: 面积映射数值，不要用直径（会夸大 4 倍）。
distinction.en: Map value to area — diameter exaggerates by four.

items.dz: 主体外一圈柔光
items.de: A soft ring of light
items.pz: 光环用同色高透明 + 大 blur，别用实心边。
items.pe: A blurred same-hue ring, never a solid border.

definition.zh: 主体外一圈柔光
definition.en: A soft ring of light

distinction.zh: 光环用同色高透明 + 大 blur，别用实心边。
distinction.en: A blurred same-hue ring, never a solid border.

dz: 一堆条目怎么进场、排序、操作
de: How many items arrive, sort and respond

items.dz: 行一条条淡入
items.de: Rows fade in one by one
items.pz: delay = index × 60ms，超过 10 行后 delay 封顶。
items.pe: delay = index × 60ms, capped after ten rows.

definition.zh: 行一条条淡入
definition.en: Rows fade in one by one

distinction.zh: delay = index × 60ms，超过 10 行后 delay 封顶。
distinction.en: delay = index × 60ms, capped after ten rows.

items.dz: 行从左侧依次推入
items.de: Rows push in from the left in sequence
items.pz: translateX(-24px)→0，配合极短的 blur 更顺。
items.pe: translateX(-24px)→0, optionally with a tiny blur.

definition.zh: 行从左侧依次推入
definition.en: Rows push in from the left in sequence

distinction.zh: translateX(-24px)→0，配合极短的 blur 更顺。
distinction.en: translateX(-24px)→0, optionally with a tiny blur.

items.dz: 整行轻微变色并右移
items.de: The row tints and nudges right
items.pz: 背景色 + 2px 右移，别加边框免得跳动。
items.pe: Background tint plus a 2px nudge — no border, it causes jitter.

definition.zh: 整行轻微变色并右移
definition.en: The row tints and nudges right

distinction.zh: 背景色 + 2px 右移，别加边框免得跳动。
distinction.en: Background tint plus a 2px nudge — no border, it causes jitter.

items.dz: 隔行浅色，方便横向读
items.de: Alternating tint helps you track across
items.pz: nth-child(even) 用最浅一档灰，别用边框分隔。
items.pe: nth-child(even) with the lightest grey; skip the borders.

definition.zh: 隔行浅色，方便横向读
definition.en: Alternating tint helps you track across

distinction.zh: nth-child(even) 用最浅一档灰，别用边框分隔。
distinction.en: nth-child(even) with the lightest grey; skip the borders.

items.dz: 点开行在原地展开详情
items.de: The row opens in place
items.pz: grid-template-rows:0fr→1fr，箭头同步旋转。
items.pe: grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr with the chevron rotating in sync.

definition.zh: 点开行在原地展开详情
definition.en: The row opens in place

distinction.zh: grid-template-rows:0fr→1fr，箭头同步旋转。
distinction.en: grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr with the chevron rotating in sync.

items.dz: 左滑露出删除按钮
items.de: Swipe left to expose delete
items.pz: 行 translateX，底层操作按钮固定；超过阈值直接执行。
items.pe: Translate the row over fixed action buttons; past a threshold, commit.

definition.zh: 左滑露出删除按钮
definition.en: Swipe left to expose delete

distinction.zh: 行 translateX，底层操作按钮固定；超过阈值直接执行。
distinction.en: Translate the row over fixed action buttons; past a threshold, commit.

items.dz: 拖起来的行浮起，其他行让位
items.de: The dragged row lifts, the rest make room
items.pz: 拖起项加阴影与 scale(1.02)，其他行用 transform 让位（FLIP）。
items.pe: Lift with shadow and scale(1.02); shift siblings with FLIP transforms.

definition.zh: 拖起来的行浮起，其他行让位
definition.en: The dragged row lifts, the rest make room

distinction.zh: 拖起项加阴影与 scale(1.02)，其他行用 transform 让位（FLIP）。
distinction.en: Lift with shadow and scale(1.02); shift siblings with FLIP transforms.

items.dz: 删掉的行收起，下面补位
items.de: The removed row collapses and the rest close up
items.pz: 先淡出 + 横移，再收 height，两段共 320ms。
items.pe: Fade and slide first, then collapse height — 320ms total.

definition.zh: 删掉的行收起，下面补位
definition.en: The removed row collapses and the rest close up

distinction.zh: 先淡出 + 横移，再收 height，两段共 320ms。
distinction.en: Fade and slide first, then collapse height — 320ms total.

items.dz: 新行从零高度长出并高亮一下
items.de: A new row grows in and flashes once
items.pz: 高度展开 + 一次淡黄底闪现（500ms）标示“这是新的”。
items.pe: Grow the height, then flash a soft highlight for 500ms.

definition.zh: 新行从零高度长出并高亮一下
definition.en: A new row grows in and flashes once

distinction.zh: 高度展开 + 一次淡黄底闪现（500ms）标示“这是新的”。
distinction.en: Grow the height, then flash a soft highlight for 500ms.

items.dz: 过滤后剩下的项平滑归位
items.de: Survivors glide into their new places
items.pz: 离场项 fade+scale，留下项用 FLIP 平移，别整体重绘。
items.pe: Fade out the removed, FLIP the survivors — never re-render blind.

definition.zh: 过滤后剩下的项平滑归位
definition.en: Survivors glide into their new places

distinction.zh: 离场项 fade+scale，留下项用 FLIP 平移，别整体重绘。
distinction.en: Fade out the removed, FLIP the survivors — never re-render blind.

items.dz: 排序时行互相交换位置
items.de: Rows swap places when sorted
items.pz: FLIP：记录旧位置，重排后反向补偿再播放。
items.pe: FLIP: record old rects, invert after the re-order, play.

definition.zh: 排序时行互相交换位置
definition.en: Rows swap places when sorted

distinction.zh: FLIP：记录旧位置，重排后反向补偿再播放。
distinction.en: FLIP: record old rects, invert after the re-order, play.

items.dz: 分组标题贴住顶部直到下一组
items.de: Group headers pin until the next group
items.pz: position:sticky;top:0 给分组标题，注意层级与背景不透明。
items.pe: Sticky headers with an opaque background and a z-index.

definition.zh: 分组标题贴住顶部直到下一组
definition.en: Group headers pin until the next group

distinction.zh: position:sticky;top:0 给分组标题，注意层级与背景不透明。
distinction.en: Sticky headers with an opaque background and a z-index.

items.dz: 勾选后整行变淡加删除线
items.de: Checked rows dim and strike through
items.pz: 勾 + 文字划线 + 透明度 60%，200ms 内完成。
items.pe: Tick, strike-through and 60% opacity, all inside 200ms.

definition.zh: 勾选后整行变淡加删除线
definition.en: Checked rows dim and strike through

distinction.zh: 勾 + 文字划线 + 透明度 60%，200ms 内完成。
distinction.en: Tick, strike-through and 60% opacity, all inside 200ms.

items.dz: 头像互相压边，悬停展开
items.de: Overlapping avatars fan out on hover
items.pz: 负 margin 叠放 + hover 时恢复间距，最多显示 4 个 + N。
items.pe: Negative margins, restored on hover; show four plus a count.

definition.zh: 头像互相压边，悬停展开
definition.en: Overlapping avatars fan out on hover

distinction.zh: 负 margin 叠放 + hover 时恢复间距，最多显示 4 个 + N。
distinction.en: Negative margins, restored on hover; show four plus a count.

de: Interrupt politely, leave cleanly

items.de: Grows from 96% to 100%
items.pz: 遮罩淡入 + 面板 scale(.96)→1，200ms ease-out。
items.pe: Scrim fades while the panel scales .96→1 in 200ms.

definition.en: Grows from 96% to 100%

distinction.en: Scrim fades while the panel scales .96→1 in 200ms.

items.dz: 从下方浮上来
items.de: It floats up from below
items.pz: 移动端优先用上移，桌面用缩放。
items.pe: Rise on mobile, scale on desktop.

definition.zh: 从下方浮上来
definition.en: It floats up from below

distinction.zh: 移动端优先用上移，桌面用缩放。
distinction.en: Rise on mobile, scale on desktop.

items.dz: 退出要比进入快
items.de: Leaving is faster than arriving
items.pz: 退出 150ms、无位移、只淡出，避免拖沓。
items.pe: Exit in 150ms with opacity only.

definition.zh: 退出要比进入快
definition.en: Leaving is faster than arriving

distinction.zh: 退出 150ms、无位移、只淡出，避免拖沓。
distinction.en: Exit in 150ms with opacity only.

items.dz: 背景被虚化
items.de: The background goes soft
items.pz: backdrop-filter 的遮罩比纯黑更贵气，但更耗性能。
items.pe: A blurred scrim looks richer but costs more.

definition.zh: 背景被虚化
definition.en: The background goes soft

distinction.zh: backdrop-filter 的遮罩比纯黑更贵气，但更耗性能。
distinction.en: A blurred scrim looks richer but costs more.

items.dz: 跟着手指走，松手吸附
items.de: Follows your finger, snaps on release
items.pz: 超过 40% 高度或速度阈值就关闭，否则弹回。
items.pe: Dismiss past 40% or a velocity threshold; otherwise spring back.

definition.zh: 跟着手指走，松手吸附
definition.en: Follows your finger, snaps on release

distinction.zh: 超过 40% 高度或速度阈值就关闭，否则弹回。
distinction.en: Dismiss past 40% or a velocity threshold; otherwise spring back.

items.dz: 贴着触发元素出现
items.de: It sticks to its trigger
items.pz: CSS anchor positioning 或 floating-ui，边缘要自动翻转。
items.pe: Anchor positioning or floating-ui, with edge flipping.

definition.zh: 贴着触发元素出现
definition.en: It sticks to its trigger

distinction.zh: CSS anchor positioning 或 floating-ui，边缘要自动翻转。
distinction.en: Anchor positioning or floating-ui, with edge flipping.

items.dz: 悬停 500ms 后出现
items.de: Appears after a 500ms hold
items.pz: 进入延迟 500ms、离开 100ms、同组之间无延迟。
items.pe: 500ms in, 100ms out, no delay between siblings.

definition.zh: 悬停 500ms 后出现
definition.en: Appears after a 500ms hold

distinction.zh: 进入延迟 500ms、离开 100ms、同组之间无延迟。
distinction.en: 500ms in, 100ms out, no delay between siblings.

items.dz: 提示里有标题和说明
items.de: A tooltip with a title and body
items.pz: 超过一行就该用 popover，并允许鼠标进入。
items.pe: Past one line it is a popover — and must be hoverable.

definition.zh: 提示里有标题和说明
definition.en: A tooltip with a title and body

distinction.zh: 超过一行就该用 popover，并允许鼠标进入。
distinction.en: Past one line it is a popover — and must be hoverable.

items.dz: 从边角滑入
items.de: Slides in from the corner
items.pz: 从最近的边缘进入，位移 16px，240ms。
items.pe: Enter from the nearest edge, 16px, 240ms.

definition.zh: 从边角滑入
definition.en: Slides in from the corner

distinction.zh: 从最近的边缘进入，位移 16px，240ms。
distinction.en: Enter from the nearest edge, 16px, 240ms.

items.dz: 多条叠成一叠
items.de: They pile into a stack
items.pz: 最多显示 3 条，其余折叠成“+2 条”。
items.pe: Show three; collapse the rest into “+2 more”.

definition.zh: 多条叠成一叠
definition.en: They pile into a stack

distinction.zh: 最多显示 3 条，其余折叠成“+2 条”。
distinction.en: Show three; collapse the rest into “+2 more”.

items.dz: 一条线走完就消失
items.de: A line runs out and it goes
items.pz: 悬停暂停计时，是最基本的礼貌。
items.pe: Pause the timer on hover — basic courtesy.

definition.zh: 一条线走完就消失
definition.en: A line runs out and it goes

distinction.zh: 悬停暂停计时，是最基本的礼貌。
distinction.en: Pause the timer on hover — basic courtesy.

items.dz: 往边上一推就走
items.de: Push it aside
items.pz: 带速度判定，快速轻扫也能触发。
items.pe: Honour velocity — a quick flick should count.

definition.zh: 往边上一推就走
definition.en: Push it aside

distinction.zh: 带速度判定，快速轻扫也能触发。
distinction.en: Honour velocity — a quick flick should count.

items.dz: 整条压在顶部
items.de: A full-width bar at the top
items.pz: 横幅要推开内容而不是覆盖，否则会遮住东西。

definition.zh: 整条压在顶部
definition.en: A full-width bar at the top

distinction.zh: 横幅要推开内容而不是覆盖，否则会遮住东西。
distinction.en: A banner should push content, not cover it.

items.dz: 就在相关内容旁边
items.de: Right next to what it is about
items.pz: 行内警示最有效：靠近问题、不打断流程。
items.pe: The most effective kind: close to the problem, no interruption.

definition.zh: 就在相关内容旁边
definition.en: Right next to what it is about

distinction.zh: 行内警示最有效：靠近问题、不打断流程。
distinction.en: The most effective kind: close to the problem, no interruption.

items.dz: 删除前的最后一问
items.de: The last question before deleting
items.pz: 主按钮是危险色，且不要默认聚焦；写清后果。
items.pe: Danger colour on the action, no autofocus, state the consequence.

definition.zh: 删除前的最后一问
definition.en: The last question before deleting

distinction.zh: 主按钮是危险色，且不要默认聚焦；写清后果。
distinction.en: Danger colour on the action, no autofocus, state the consequence.

items.dz: 要求打出名字才能删
items.de: Type the name to delete
items.pz: 高风险操作用输入确认，比二次点击更可靠。
items.pe: For high-risk actions, typed confirmation beats a second click.

definition.zh: 要求打出名字才能删
definition.en: Type the name to delete

distinction.zh: 高风险操作用输入确认，比二次点击更可靠。
distinction.en: For high-risk actions, typed confirmation beats a second click.

items.dz: 整块被锁住

items.pe: Only show it past 400ms so it does not flash.

definition.zh: 整块被锁住
definition.en: The area locks up

distinction.zh: 超过 400ms 才显示遮罩，避免闪一下。
distinction.en: Only show it past 400ms so it does not flash.

items.dz: 用骨架而不是转圈

items.pz: 知道布局就用骨架，未知才用 spinner。

definition.zh: 用骨架而不是转圈
definition.en: Skeletons, not spinners

distinction.zh: 知道布局就用骨架，未知才用 spinner。
distinction.en: Skeletons when you know the layout; spinners when you do not.

items.dz: 什么都没有的时候
items.de: When there is nothing yet
items.pz: 空状态必须给下一步动作，而不只是一句“暂无数据”。
items.pe: An empty state needs a next action, not just “no data”.

items.dz: 出错页也要有出路
items.de: An error page needs an exit
items.pz: 写清发生了什么、能做什么、去哪儿反馈。
items.pe: What happened, what to do, where to report.

definition.zh: 出错页也要有出路
definition.en: An error page needs an exit

distinction.zh: 写清发生了什么、能做什么、去哪儿反馈。
distinction.en: What happened, what to do, where to report.

items.dz: 断网时顶部变色

distinction.zh: 恢复时也要提示一次，并自动重试队列。
distinction.en: Announce recovery too, and flush the retry queue.

items.dz: 任务在角落继续跑

items.pz: 头/尾/侧栏统称 chrome，密度要一致。
items.pe: Header, footer and rails are the chrome — keep one density.

definition.zh: 内容之外的那一圈壳
definition.en: Everything around the content

distinction.zh: 头/尾/侧栏统称 chrome，密度要一致。
distinction.en: Header, footer and rails are the chrome — keep one density.

items.dz: 只有图标的窄侧栏
items.de: The narrow icon-only sidebar
items.pz: 宽 56–72px，悬停外扩成完整侧栏。
items.pe: 56–72px wide, expanding on hover.

definition.zh: 只有图标的窄侧栏
definition.en: The narrow icon-only sidebar

distinction.zh: 宽 56–72px，悬停外扩成完整侧栏。
distinction.en: 56–72px wide, expanding on hover.

items.dz: 两栏之间那道空
items.de: The space between columns
items.pz: gutter 是栏间距，margin 是版心外边距，别混。
items.pe: Gutter is between columns; margin is outside the grid.

definition.zh: 两栏之间那道空
definition.en: The space between columns

distinction.zh: gutter 是栏间距，margin 是版心外边距，别混。
distinction.en: Gutter is between columns; margin is outside the grid.

items.dz: 贴底的一条操作区
items.de: The action strip at the bottom
items.pz: 常驻不遮内容，安全区内边距别忘。
items.pe: Persistent, non-occluding, safe-area padded.

definition.zh: 贴底的一条操作区
definition.en: The action strip at the bottom

distinction.zh: 常驻不遮内容，安全区内边距别忘。
distinction.en: Persistent, non-occluding, safe-area padded.

items.dz: 从底部拉起来的半屏
items.de: The half-height panel from below
items.pz: 两档高度（peek / full），拖拽可切换。
items.pe: Two stops — peek and full — draggable between.

definition.zh: 从底部拉起来的半屏
definition.en: The half-height panel from below

distinction.zh: 两档高度（peek / full），拖拽可切换。
distinction.en: Two stops — peek and full — draggable between.

items.dz: 从边缘推进来的面板
items.de: The panel that slides in from an edge
items.pz: 宽度不超过 80%，带 scrim 和边缘阴影。
items.pe: Under 80% width, with a scrim and an edge shadow.

definition.zh: 从边缘推进来的面板
definition.en: The panel that slides in from an edge

distinction.zh: 宽度不超过 80%，带 scrim 和边缘阴影。
distinction.en: Under 80% width, with a scrim and an edge shadow.

items.dz: 锚定在触发器上的小面板
items.de: A small panel anchored to its trigger
items.pz: 带箭头指向锚点，贴边自动翻转。
items.pe: An arrow points at the anchor; it flips at edges.

definition.zh: 锚定在触发器上的小面板
definition.en: A small panel anchored to its trigger

distinction.zh: 带箭头指向锚点，贴边自动翻转。
distinction.en: An arrow points at the anchor; it flips at edges.

items.dz: 只解释、不承载操作
items.de: It explains; it never acts
items.pz: 延迟 400ms 出现、80ms 消失，绝不放按钮。
items.pe: In after 400ms, out after 80ms, never interactive.

definition.zh: 只解释、不承载操作
definition.en: It explains; it never acts

distinction.zh: 延迟 400ms 出现、80ms 消失，绝不放按钮。
distinction.en: In after 400ms, out after 80ms, never interactive.

items.dz: 一个三角控制一段内容
items.de: One caret controls one region
items.pz: 三角旋转 90° 表示展开，aria-expanded 必须写。
items.pe: Rotate the caret 90°, and set aria-expanded.

definition.zh: 一个三角控制一段内容
definition.en: One caret controls one region

distinction.zh: 三角旋转 90° 表示展开，aria-expanded 必须写。
distinction.en: Rotate the caret 90°, and set aria-expanded.

items.dz: 树形里那个小三角
items.de: The little triangle in a tree
items.pz: 点击区要覆盖整行，不只是三角本身。
items.pe: The hit target is the whole row, not the glyph.

definition.zh: 树形里那个小三角
definition.en: The little triangle in a tree

distinction.zh: 点击区要覆盖整行，不只是三角本身。
distinction.en: The hit target is the whole row, not the glyph.

items.dz: 一组互斥的展开器
items.de: A set of mutually exclusive disclosures
items.pz: 同时只开一个时要说明，否则用户会找丢内容。
items.pe: If only one opens, say so.

definition.zh: 一组互斥的展开器
definition.en: A set of mutually exclusive disclosures

distinction.zh: 同时只开一个时要说明，否则用户会找丢内容。
distinction.en: If only one opens, say so.

items.dz: 加减号夹着一个数
items.de: Plus and minus around a value
items.pz: 长按连续增减，到边界按钮要禁用。
items.pe: Press-and-hold repeats; disable at the bounds.

definition.zh: 加减号夹着一个数
definition.en: Plus and minus around a value

distinction.zh: 长按连续增减，到边界按钮要禁用。
distinction.en: Press-and-hold repeats; disable at the bounds.

items.dz: 输入框右侧的上下小箭头
items.de: The tiny up/down pair in a field
items.pz: 键盘上下键必须同效，滚轮默认别绑。
items.pe: Arrow keys must work; do not bind the wheel by default.

definition.zh: 输入框右侧的上下小箭头
definition.en: The tiny up/down pair in a field

distinction.zh: 键盘上下键必须同效，滚轮默认别绑。
distinction.en: Arrow keys must work; do not bind the wheel by default.

items.dz: 轨道叫 track，圆点叫 thumb
items.de: The bar is the track, the dot is the thumb
items.pz: thumb 命中区至少 44px，视觉可以只有 16px。
items.pe: A 44px hit target even if the dot is 16px.

definition.zh: 轨道叫 track，圆点叫 thumb
definition.en: The bar is the track, the dot is the thumb

distinction.zh: thumb 命中区至少 44px，视觉可以只有 16px。
distinction.en: A 44px hit target even if the dot is 16px.

items.dz: 滑轨上的档位点
items.de: Detents along the track
items.pz: 有刻度就必须吸附，否则刻度是骗人的。
items.pe: If there are ticks, it must snap.

definition.zh: 滑轨上的档位点
definition.en: Detents along the track

distinction.zh: 有刻度就必须吸附，否则刻度是骗人的。
distinction.en: If there are ticks, it must snap.

items.dz: 那几道小杠是可拖的暗示
items.de: Those little bars mean draggable
items.pz: 两三道 2px 短线，光标 grab / grabbing。
items.pe: Two or three 2px bars, with grab cursors.

definition.zh: 那几道小杠是可拖的暗示
definition.en: Those little bars mean draggable

distinction.zh: 两三道 2px 短线，光标 grab / grabbing。
distinction.en: Two or three 2px bars, with grab cursors.

items.dz: 两栏之间可拖的分隔条
items.de: The draggable divider between panes
items.pz: 命中区 8px、视觉 1px，悬停整条变色。
items.pe: An 8px hit zone over a 1px line.

definition.zh: 两栏之间可拖的分隔条
definition.en: The draggable divider between panes

distinction.zh: 命中区 8px、视觉 1px，悬停整条变色。
distinction.en: An 8px hit zone over a 1px line.

items.dz: 右下角那个小三角
items.de: The corner nub that resizes
items.pz: 八个方向都可拖时，要给对应的 cursor。
items.pe: Give each of the eight directions its cursor.

definition.zh: 右下角那个小三角
definition.en: The corner nub that resizes

distinction.zh: 八个方向都可拖时，要给对应的 cursor。
distinction.en: Give each of the eight directions its cursor.

items.dz: 你在层级里的哪一层
items.de: Where you are in the hierarchy
items.pz: 末项不可点，中间过长要折成省略。
items.pe: The last crumb is not a link; collapse the middle.

definition.zh: 你在层级里的哪一层
definition.en: Where you are in the hierarchy

distinction.zh: 末项不可点，中间过长要折成省略。
distinction.en: The last crumb is not a link; collapse the middle.

items.dz: 2–4 个互斥选项挤在一起
items.de: Two to four exclusive options in one row
items.pz: 超过四项就该用下拉，别硬挤。
items.pe: Past four options, use a select.

definition.zh: 2–4 个互斥选项挤在一起
definition.en: Two to four exclusive options in one row

distinction.zh: 超过四项就该用下拉，别硬挤。
distinction.en: Past four options, use a select.

items.dz: 能输入也能选的下拉
items.de: Type or pick
items.pz: 输入即过滤，键盘上下选，Enter 确认。
items.pe: Filter as you type; arrows navigate; Enter commits.

definition.zh: 能输入也能选的下拉
definition.en: Type or pick

distinction.zh: 输入即过滤，键盘上下选，Enter 确认。
distinction.en: Filter as you type; arrows navigate; Enter commits.

items.dz: 一组可选项，不带输入框
items.de: A pickable list with no input
items.pz: 当前项用 aria-selected，视觉不能只靠背景色。
items.pe: Mark aria-selected; do not rely on fill alone.

definition.zh: 一组可选项，不带输入框
definition.en: A pickable list with no input

distinction.zh: 当前项用 aria-selected，视觉不能只靠背景色。
distinction.en: Mark aria-selected; do not rely on fill alone.

items.dz: 打两个字就出候选
items.de: Suggestions after two characters
items.pz: 防抖 150ms，候选里高亮匹配片段。
items.pe: Debounce 150ms and highlight the matched span.

definition.zh: 打两个字就出候选
definition.en: Suggestions after two characters

distinction.zh: 防抖 150ms，候选里高亮匹配片段。
distinction.en: Debounce 150ms and highlight the matched span.

items.dz: 输入变成一颗颗可删的标签
items.de: Input turns into removable tokens
items.pz: 回车成 token，退格删最后一个。
items.pe: Enter tokenises; Backspace deletes the last.

definition.zh: 输入变成一颗颗可删的标签
definition.en: Input turns into removable tokens

distinction.zh: 回车成 token，退格删最后一个。
distinction.en: Enter tokenises; Backspace deletes the last.

items.dz: 可开关的一组条件
items.de: Toggleable conditions
items.pz: 选中要有形状变化（勾），不只是深色。
items.pe: Add a check, not just a darker fill.

definition.zh: 可开关的一组条件
definition.en: Toggleable conditions

distinction.zh: 选中要有形状变化（勾），不只是深色。
distinction.en: Add a check, not just a darker fill.

items.dz: 按维度分组的筛选区
items.de: Filters grouped by dimension
items.pz: 每组显示计数，已选项置顶。
items.pe: Show counts and pin the selected ones.

definition.zh: 按维度分组的筛选区
definition.en: Filters grouped by dimension

distinction.zh: 每组显示计数，已选项置顶。
distinction.en: Show counts and pin the selected ones.

items.dz: 三个点里藏次要操作
items.de: Secondary actions behind three dots
items.pz: 主操作永远别进 kebab，里面不超过 7 项。
items.pe: Never hide the primary action there; keep it under seven items.

definition.zh: 三个点里藏次要操作
definition.en: Secondary actions behind three dots

distinction.zh: 主操作永远别进 kebab，里面不超过 7 项。
distinction.en: Never hide the primary action there; keep it under seven items.

items.dz: 在指针处长出来的菜单
items.de: It grows at the pointer
items.pz: transform-origin 设在指针位置，贴边翻转。
items.pe: Origin at the pointer, flipped at the edges.

definition.zh: 在指针处长出来的菜单
definition.en: It grows at the pointer

distinction.zh: transform-origin 设在指针位置，贴边翻转。
distinction.en: Origin at the pointer, flipped at the edges.

items.dz: 搜索一切、执行一切
items.de: Search everything, run anything
items.pz: 模糊匹配 + 分组 + 快捷键提示，一屏内。
items.pe: Fuzzy match, grouped, with shortcut hints.

definition.zh: 搜索一切、执行一切
definition.en: Search everything, run anything

distinction.zh: 模糊匹配 + 分组 + 快捷键提示，一屏内。
distinction.en: Fuzzy match, grouped, with shortcut hints.

items.dz: 最底下那条持续信息
items.de: The persistent strip at the bottom
items.pz: 只放状态与轻量操作，不放主导航。
items.pe: State and light actions only — never primary nav.

definition.zh: 最底下那条持续信息
definition.en: The persistent strip at the bottom

distinction.zh: 只放状态与轻量操作，不放主导航。
distinction.en: State and light actions only — never primary nav.

items.dz: 右侧那一列参数
items.de: The property column on the right
items.pz: 按语义分组、每组可折叠、数值可拖动。
items.pe: Grouped, collapsible, scrubbable numbers.

definition.zh: 右侧那一列参数
definition.en: The property column on the right

distinction.zh: 按语义分组、每组可折叠、数值可拖动。
distinction.en: Grouped, collapsible, scrubbable numbers.

items.dz: 按住数值左右拖就能改
items.de: Drag the number to change it
items.pz: 光标变 ew-resize，按住 shift 精细调。
items.pe: ew-resize cursor, Shift for fine control.

definition.zh: 按住数值左右拖就能改
definition.en: Drag the number to change it

distinction.zh: 光标变 ew-resize，按住 shift 精细调。
distinction.en: ew-resize cursor, Shift for fine control.

items.dz: 一格颜色就是一个 swatch
items.de: One cell of colour
items.pz: 选中态用外框而不是勾，透明色要显示棋盘底。
items.pe: Ring for selection; checkerboard for transparency.

definition.zh: 一格颜色就是一个 swatch
definition.en: One cell of colour

distinction.zh: 选中态用外框而不是勾，透明色要显示棋盘底。
distinction.en: Ring for selection; checkerboard for transparency.

items.dz: 从画面上吸一个颜色
items.de: Pick a colour off the screen
items.pz: 放大镜跟随指针，显示 hex 与对比度。
items.pe: A loupe follows the pointer with hex and contrast.

definition.zh: 从画面上吸一个颜色
definition.en: Pick a colour off the screen

distinction.zh: 放大镜跟随指针，显示 hex 与对比度。
distinction.en: A loupe follows the pointer with hex and contrast.

items.dz: 可展开的层级列表
items.de: A hierarchy you can unfold
items.pz: 缩进 16px 一级，连接线可选但要一致。
items.pe: 16px per level; guide lines optional but consistent.

definition.zh: 可展开的层级列表
definition.en: A hierarchy you can unfold

distinction.zh: 缩进 16px 一级，连接线可选但要一致。
distinction.en: 16px per level; guide lines optional but consistent.

items.dz: 左边选，右边看
items.de: Pick left, read right
items.pz: 窄屏退化成两级页面，返回要保留选中。
items.pe: On narrow screens it becomes two pages; keep the selection.

definition.zh: 左边选，右边看
definition.en: Pick left, read right

distinction.zh: 窄屏退化成两级页面，返回要保留选中。
distinction.en: On narrow screens it becomes two pages; keep the selection.

items.dz: 横滚时第一列不动
items.de: The first column stays
items.pz: position:sticky left:0 + 一道右侧阴影表示可滚。
items.pe: sticky left with a right-edge shadow.

definition.zh: 横滚时第一列不动
definition.en: The first column stays

distinction.zh: position:sticky left:0 + 一道右侧阴影表示可滚。
distinction.en: sticky left with a right-edge shadow.

items.dz: 表头那个小箭头
items.de: The arrow in the header
items.pz: 三态：未排序 / 升 / 降，未排序也要占位。
items.pe: Three states, and reserve the space when unsorted.

definition.zh: 表头那个小箭头
definition.en: The arrow in the header

distinction.zh: 三态：未排序 / 升 / 降，未排序也要占位。
distinction.en: Three states, and reserve the space when unsorted.

items.dz: 页码 + 上下页
items.de: Page numbers with prev and next
items.pz: 当前页不可点，两端与当前页附近才列出。
items.pe: Current page is not a link; elide the middle.

definition.zh: 页码 + 上下页
definition.en: Page numbers with prev and next

distinction.zh: 当前页不可点，两端与当前页附近才列出。
distinction.en: Current page is not a link; elide the middle.

items.dz: 没有内容时不能空白一片
items.de: Nothing yet is still a design
items.pz: 一句说明 + 一个主动作，别只画插图。
items.pe: One sentence and one action.

definition.zh: 没有内容时不能空白一片
definition.en: Nothing yet is still a design

distinction.zh: 一句说明 + 一个主动作，别只画插图。
distinction.en: One sentence and one action.

items.dz: 内容形状的占位
items.de: A placeholder shaped like the content
items.pz: 形状要对得上真实内容，宽度别全部一样。
items.pe: Match the real shapes; vary the widths.

definition.zh: 内容形状的占位
definition.en: A placeholder shaped like the content

distinction.zh: 形状要对得上真实内容，宽度别全部一样。
distinction.en: Match the real shapes; vary the widths.

items.dz: 数字或圆点贴在图标角上
items.de: A count or dot on the corner
items.pz: 超过 99 显示 99+，纯提醒用点不用数。
items.pe: 99+ past two digits; a dot when the count adds nothing.

definition.zh: 数字或圆点贴在图标角上
definition.en: A count or dot on the corner

distinction.zh: 超过 99 显示 99+，纯提醒用点不用数。
distinction.en: 99+ past two digits; a dot when the count adds nothing.

items.dz: 底部一条短暂提示
items.de: A brief strip at the bottom
items.pz: 4 秒自动收，带一个撤销，不叠加超过一条。
items.pe: Four seconds, one undo, never stacked.

definition.zh: 底部一条短暂提示
definition.en: A brief strip at the bottom

distinction.zh: 4 秒自动收，带一个撤销，不叠加超过一条。
distinction.en: Four seconds, one undo, never stacked.

items.dz: 常驻在内容顶部的通告
items.de: A persistent notice above content
items.pz: 可关闭且状态要记住，别每次刷新都出现。
items.pe: Dismissible, and remember the dismissal.

definition.zh: 常驻在内容顶部的通告
definition.en: A persistent notice above content

distinction.zh: 可关闭且状态要记住，别每次刷新都出现。
distinction.en: Dismissible, and remember the dismissal.

items.dz: 正文里一段被框起来的提醒
items.de: A boxed aside inside prose
items.pz: 用背景与图标区分类型，别只靠左侧色条。
items.pe: Type by fill and icon — not a left colour bar.

definition.zh: 正文里一段被框起来的提醒
definition.en: A boxed aside inside prose

distinction.zh: 用背景与图标区分类型，别只靠左侧色条。
distinction.en: Type by fill and icon — not a left colour bar.

items.dz: 分步表单，一次只问一屏
items.de: A stepped form, one screen at a time
items.pz: 顶部步骤条要能看出总共几步、现在第几。
items.pe: The rail shows total and current step.

definition.zh: 分步表单，一次只问一屏
definition.en: A stepped form, one screen at a time

distinction.zh: 顶部步骤条要能看出总共几步、现在第几。
distinction.en: The rail shows total and current step.

items.dz: 第一次用的时候指一下
items.de: A first-run pointer
items.pz: 一次只讲一个，最多三步，可跳过。
items.pe: One point at a time, three max, skippable.

definition.zh: 第一次用的时候指一下
definition.en: A first-run pointer

distinction.zh: 一次只讲一个，最多三步，可跳过。
distinction.en: One point at a time, three max, skippable.

items.dz: 一个呼吸的点提示可交互
items.de: A breathing dot invites a tap
items.pz: 只在教学场景用，用户点过就永久消失。
items.pe: Onboarding only, and gone once tapped.

definition.zh: 一个呼吸的点提示可交互
definition.en: A breathing dot invites a tap

distinction.zh: 只在教学场景用，用户点过就永久消失。
distinction.en: Onboarding only, and gone once tapped.

items.dz: 键盘用户的定位框
items.de: The keyboard user's locator
items.pz: 2px 外框 + 2px 间隙，颜色对比 ≥3:1。
items.pe: A 2px ring with 2px offset, contrast ≥ 3:1.

definition.zh: 键盘用户的定位框
definition.en: The keyboard user's locator

distinction.zh: 2px 外框 + 2px 间隙，颜色对比 ≥3:1。
distinction.en: A 2px ring with 2px offset, contrast ≥ 3:1.

items.dz: 看得见的和点得到的不是一回事
items.de: What you see is not what you tap
items.pz: 移动端 ≥44px，靠 padding 或伪元素撑开。
items.pe: 44px minimum on touch, via padding or a pseudo-element.

definition.zh: 看得见的和点得到的不是一回事
definition.en: What you see is not what you tap

distinction.zh: 移动端 ≥44px，靠 padding 或伪元素撑开。
distinction.en: 44px minimum on touch, via padding or a pseudo-element.

items.dz: 能往里拖东西的区域
items.de: A region that accepts a drop
items.pz: 拖入时整块高亮并说明会发生什么。
items.pe: Highlight the whole region and say what will happen.

definition.zh: 能往里拖东西的区域
definition.en: A region that accepts a drop

distinction.zh: 拖入时整块高亮并说明会发生什么。
