items.pe: Keep filter and sort states visible in dark and high contrast. Validate scale, mobile, and locale switching.

definition.zh: 筛选和排序状态在暗色、高对比主题下仍可辨。
definition.en: Keep filter and sort states visible in dark and high contrast.

distinction.zh: 筛选和排序状态在暗色、高对比主题下仍可辨。 在大数据量、移动端和中英文切换下复核。
distinction.en: Keep filter and sort states visible in dark and high contrast. Validate scale, mobile, and locale switching.

items.dz: 发布前检查复杂条件、URL、权限、性能、语言和错误恢复。
items.de: Audit conditions, URL, permissions, performance, locale, and recovery.
items.pz: 发布前检查复杂条件、URL、权限、性能、语言和错误恢复。 在大数据量、移动端和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Audit conditions, URL, permissions, performance, locale, and recovery. Validate scale, mobile, and locale switching.

definition.zh: 发布前检查复杂条件、URL、权限、性能、语言和错误恢复。
definition.en: Audit conditions, URL, permissions, performance, locale, and recovery.

distinction.zh: 发布前检查复杂条件、URL、权限、性能、语言和错误恢复。 在大数据量、移动端和中英文切换下复核。
distinction.en: Audit conditions, URL, permissions, performance, locale, and recovery. Validate scale, mobile, and locale switching.

items.dz: 逐通道取较暗者。
items.de: Per-channel minimum.
items.pz: mix-blend-mode:darken——压暗亮背景上的亮字。说「变暗混合」即此。
items.pe: Keep the darker of each channel.

definition.zh: 变暗（darken）逐通道比较源与目标，取较小者输出，整体呈现压暗效果。
definition.en: Per-channel minimum.

distinction.zh: 与 color-burn 的区别：darken 是逐通道取小（无乘法加深），burn 按比例放大暗部。
distinction.en: Channel-wise minimum, no multiplication.

items.dz: 逐通道取较亮者。
items.de: Per-channel maximum.
items.pz: mix-blend-mode:lighten——提亮暗底。说「变亮混合」即此。
items.pe: Keep the lighter of each channel.

definition.zh: 变亮（lighten）逐通道取源与目标的较大者。
definition.en: Per-channel maximum.

distinction.zh: 与 screen 的区别：screen 是乘法公式（柔），lighten 是取大（硬）。
distinction.en: Channel-wise maximum; screen multiplies instead.

items.dz: 按比例压暗目标暗部。
items.de: Scales down destination darkness.
items.pz: mix-blend-mode:color-burn——加深底图暗部细节。说「加深混合」即此。
items.pe: Boosts darkness proportionally.

definition.zh: 颜色加深（color-burn）将目标色按源比例放大其暗部：暗处更暗且保细节。
definition.en: Scales down destination darkness.

distinction.zh: 与 multiply 的区别：burn 增强对比（暗者愈暗），multiply 是均匀乘法变暗。
distinction.en: Contrast-boosting darkness; multiply darkens uniformly.

items.dz: 用源饱和度+目标色相/明度组色。
items.de: Source saturation, destination hue and tone.
items.pz: mix-blend-mode:saturation——把上层饱和度灌给底层色相。说「饱和度混合」即此。
items.pe: Non-separable: saturation from top.

definition.zh: 饱和度混合是非分离混合：输出的饱和度取自源，色相与明度取自目标。
definition.en: Source saturation, destination hue and tone.

distinction.zh: 与 hue 混合的区别：交换的通道不同（饱和 vs 色相）；非分离模式必须在对色空间计算。
distinction.en: Swaps saturation; hue keeps its own.

items.dz: 用源明度+目标色相/饱和度组色。
items.de: Source luminosity with destination hue/sat.
items.pz: mix-blend-mode:luminosity——给底图换「明度」。说「明度混合」即此。
items.pe: Luminosity from top, color from below.

definition.zh: 明度混合输出的明度取自源，色相与饱和度取自目标——上色（tint）的经典手法。
definition.en: Source luminosity with destination hue/sat.

distinction.zh: 与 color 混合的区别：交换的通道相反（明度 vs 色相饱和度）。
distinction.en: Mirror of color blending.

items.dz: plus-lighter 线性加法合成（叠加高光专用）。
items.de: Additive compositing for highlights.
items.pz: mix-blend-mode:plus-lighter——真实的加法（光叠加）而非 screen 近似。说「加法混合」即此。
items.pe: True addition, not screen.

definition.zh: plus-lighter 将源与目标在线性空间相加（capped），是发光体叠加的正确合成（HRD 高光、光束）。
definition.en: Additive compositing for highlights.

distinction.zh: 与 screen 的区别：screen 是公式近似（永远不会到纯白叠加过曝），plus-lighter 是真加法。
distinction.en: True addition; screen is a formula approximation.

items.dz: 逐通道独立运算的混合家族：变暗/变亮/乘/滤等。
items.de: Channel-wise blend family.
items.pz: multiply/screen/darken/lighten/dodge/burn/hard-light/soft-light/difference/exclusion 都属可分离族。说「可分离混合」即此。
items.pe: Per-channel math family.

definition.zh: 可分离混合模式对 R/G/B 三通道独立应用同一公式，与色相无关，可逐通道数学描述。
definition.en: Channel-wise blend family.

distinction.zh: 与非分离族的区别：非分离（hue/sat/color/luminosity）必须先转换到 HSL 类色彩空间整体运算。
distinction.en: Per-channel vs whole-color computation.

items.dz: 必须整体换色空间计算的混合家族：hue/sat/color/luminosity。
items.de: Whole-color blend family.
items.pz: hue/saturation/color/luminosity 四模式基于 Lab/HSL 类空间重组通道。说「非分离混合」即此。
items.pe: HSL-space channel recombination.

definition.zh: 非分离混合族把源与目标转换到对色空间后按通道重组，无法逐通道独立描述。
definition.en: Whole-color blend family.

distinction.zh: 与可分离族的区别见 separable-blend；族内四者互换的通道各不相同。
distinction.en: Recombines channels in a color space.

items.dz: 两组周期纹叠加产生干涉条纹。
items.de: Interference between two periodic patterns.
items.pz: 两层细条纹叠加旋转 2-3° 即出摩尔纹；屏幕拍照伪影的同源现象。说「摩尔纹」即此。
items.pe: Rotate stripes to interference.

definition.zh: 摩尔纹是两组相近周期图案叠加产生的干涉条纹，屏幕摄影与细网格缩放中常见。
definition.en: Interference between two periodic patterns.

distinction.zh: 与普通锯齿（aliasing）的区别：摩尔纹是两组周期信号的拍频，锯齿是单信号采样不足。
distinction.en: Interference between two periodic patterns; aliasing is single-signal undersampling.

dz: 把照片放进形状、文字和镂空窗口；比较硬裁切、半透明遮罩与真实擦除，调节范围和构图。
de: Put photographs inside shapes, type, and cut-out windows. Compare clipping, alpha masks, and actual erasing while adjusting coverage and composition.

items.dz: 比较旅游封面从四个方向显现的读图顺序。照片尺寸不动，边界移动，山峰不会随着揭示被压扁。
items.de: Compare four reveal directions on a travel cover. The photograph keeps its size while the clipping edge moves.
items.pz: 用 inset() 裁切照片层；从左显现应先裁掉右侧。保持标题在裁切层外。布局尺寸不变不代表一定由 GPU 合成，仍需测量大图的绘制开销。
items.pe: Clip only the photo with inset(); a left-to-right reveal starts with the right side hidden. Keep the caption outside. Stable layout does not guarantee compositor-only rendering.

definition.zh: 比较旅游封面从四个方向显现的读图顺序。照片尺寸不动，边界移动，山峰不会随着揭示被压扁。
definition.en: Compare four reveal directions on a travel cover. The photograph keeps its size while the clipping edge moves.

distinction.zh: 用 inset() 裁切照片层；从左显现应先裁掉右侧。保持标题在裁切层外。布局尺寸不变不代表一定由 GPU 合成，仍需测量大图的绘制开销。
distinction.en: Clip only the photo with inset(); a left-to-right reveal starts with the right side hidden. Keep the caption outside. Stable layout does not guarantee compositor-only rendering.

items.dz: 从画面中央的山脊开始，向两边展现完整山谷，适合横幅开场和作品展示。
items.de: Reveal the ridge first, then the surrounding valley, useful for a wide opening image or a portfolio cover.
items.pz: 一层 inset(0 50%) 即可同时隐藏左右两半，过渡到 inset(0)。缩窄窗口不会缩放照片；重要主体应先出现在中线附近。
items.pe: Animate one layer from inset(0 50%) to inset(0). This changes the window without scaling the photo; place the subject near its center.

definition.zh: 从画面中央的山脊开始，向两边展现完整山谷，适合横幅开场和作品展示。
definition.en: Reveal the ridge first, then the surrounding valley, useful for a wide opening image or a portfolio cover.

distinction.zh: 一层 inset(0 50%) 即可同时隐藏左右两半，过渡到 inset(0)。缩窄窗口不会缩放照片；重要主体应先出现在中线附近。
distinction.en: Animate one layer from inset(0 50%) to inset(0). This changes the window without scaling the photo; place the subject near its center.

items.dz: 让显现从指定山峰或按钮附近开始。移动圆心，观察相同半径在画面边角会留下多少未覆盖区域。
items.de: Start a reveal near a chosen peak or trigger. Move its origin to see how much of the far corner remains uncovered.
items.pz: circle() 的百分比半径相对参考框的归一化对角线。结束半径必须覆盖最远角；示例取 150%，不能把 50% 当作完整展开。
items.pe: A percentage circle radius uses the normalized diagonal. The final radius must reach the farthest corner; this example uses 150%, not 50%.

definition.zh: 让显现从指定山峰或按钮附近开始。移动圆心，观察相同半径在画面边角会留下多少未覆盖区域。
definition.en: Start a reveal near a chosen peak or trigger. Move its origin to see how much of the far corner remains uncovered.

distinction.zh: circle() 的百分比半径相对参考框的归一化对角线。结束半径必须覆盖最远角；示例取 150%，不能把 50% 当作完整展开。
distinction.en: A percentage circle radius uses the normalized diagonal. The final radius must reach the farthest corner; this example uses 150%, not 50%.

items.dz: 以草坡为最后保留的焦点，模拟章节结束时画面收拢；其余画面先消失。
items.de: Keep the green slopes visible last as a chapter closes, giving the ending a deliberate focal point.
items.pz: 反向缩小 circle()；光圈中心和照片焦点是两套坐标。正文或关闭按钮不要放进消失的区域，低动态偏好应直接显示结束态。
items.pe: Shrink circle() in reverse. Its center is independent of the photo focal point. Keep text and dismissal controls outside the disappearing region.

definition.zh: 以草坡为最后保留的焦点，模拟章节结束时画面收拢；其余画面先消失。
definition.en: Keep the green slopes visible last as a chapter closes, giving the ending a deliberate focal point.

distinction.zh: 反向缩小 circle()；光圈中心和照片焦点是两套坐标。正文或关闭按钮不要放进消失的区域，低动态偏好应直接显示结束态。
distinction.en: Shrink circle() in reverse. Its center is independent of the photo focal point. Keep text and dismissal controls outside the disappearing region.

items.dz: 运动或旅行海报可让斜边带出整幅照片，同时保留照片的水平地平线。
items.de: A diagonal edge can introduce an outdoor poster while the photograph itself keeps a level horizon.
items.pz: 两端都使用四个 polygon 顶点，按同一顺序插值。终点超出画框，避免右上角残留三角空白；不要用 skew 把照片本身拉斜。
items.pe: Keep four polygon vertices in the same order at both ends. Extend beyond the frame to cover the final corner; do not skew the image itself.

definition.zh: 运动或旅行海报可让斜边带出整幅照片，同时保留照片的水平地平线。
definition.en: A diagonal edge can introduce an outdoor poster while the photograph itself keeps a level horizon.

distinction.zh: 两端都使用四个 polygon 顶点，按同一顺序插值。终点超出画框，避免右上角残留三角空白；不要用 skew 把照片本身拉斜。
distinction.en: Keep four polygon vertices in the same order at both ends. Extend beyond the frame to cover the final corner; do not skew the image itself.

items.dz: 同一张山谷照片通过平行窗口逐条露出。拖动开合比例，可以检查细条是否把主体切碎。
items.de: Parallel windows reveal one continuous valley image. Adjust their opening to judge whether narrow bands fragment the subject.
items.pz: 重复线性渐变决定每条窗口的透明段；条数决定周期，开合比例决定不透明段长度。照片始终只有一层，不会被重复平铺。
items.pe: A repeating linear gradient defines each opaque band and transparent gap. Band count sets the period; opening sets the opaque fraction. The photo is not tiled.

definition.zh: 同一张山谷照片通过平行窗口逐条露出。拖动开合比例，可以检查细条是否把主体切碎。
definition.en: Parallel windows reveal one continuous valley image. Adjust their opening to judge whether narrow bands fragment the subject.

distinction.zh: 重复线性渐变决定每条窗口的透明段；条数决定周期，开合比例决定不透明段长度。照片始终只有一层，不会被重复平铺。
distinction.en: A repeating linear gradient defines each opaque band and transparent gap. Band count sets the period; opening sets the opaque fraction. The photo is not tiled.

items.dz: 章节标题先被色条覆盖，再露出完整文字。先后顺序可以避免文字与色条同时抢占注意力。
items.de: A slab covers a chapter title before revealing it, separating the two visual events.
items.pz: 色条用独立伪元素，文字在覆盖最满时由透明变为可见。不要把 opacity 加在整个父层上，否则遮盖用的色条也会消失。
items.pe: Animate an independent pseudo-element and reveal the glyphs only when the slab fully covers them. Parent opacity would also hide the slab.

definition.zh: 章节标题先被色条覆盖，再露出完整文字。先后顺序可以避免文字与色条同时抢占注意力。
definition.en: A slab covers a chapter title before revealing it, separating the two visual events.

distinction.zh: 色条用独立伪元素，文字在覆盖最满时由透明变为可见。不要把 opacity 加在整个父层上，否则遮盖用的色条也会消失。
distinction.en: Animate an independent pseudo-element and reveal the glyphs only when the slab fully covers them. Parent opacity would also hide the slab.

items.dz: 照片的一侧慢慢融入纸色背景，为封面标题留出柔和空间，而照片主体仍保持完整对比度。
items.de: Fade one side of a photograph into the paper background, leaving a calm area for a cover title without fading the entire subject.
items.pz: alpha 遮罩里不透明黑色保留图像，transparent 隐藏图像；黑色并不代表挖空。调节渐隐起点，不要把文字一并放入遮罩层。
items.pe: In an alpha mask, opaque black preserves the image and transparent hides it. Adjust the fade start and keep the text outside the mask.

definition.zh: 照片的一侧慢慢融入纸色背景，为封面标题留出柔和空间，而照片主体仍保持完整对比度。
definition.en: Fade one side of a photograph into the paper background, leaving a calm area for a cover title without fading the entire subject.

distinction.zh: alpha 遮罩里不透明黑色保留图像，transparent 隐藏图像；黑色并不代表挖空。调节渐隐起点，不要把文字一并放入遮罩层。
distinction.en: In an alpha mask, opaque black preserves the image and transparent hides it. Adjust the fade start and keep the text outside the mask.

items.dz: 把景观照片融入米色画布。四边都逐渐透明，换成有纹理的底色也不会出现白色假边。
items.de: Blend a landscape into the surrounding canvas. Transparent edges work over a textured or colored background without a white fringe.
items.pz: 横向和纵向 alpha 渐变用 intersect 相交。这里使用两层完整 mask-image；只写一层 WebKit 前缀会丢失另一个方向的渐隐。
items.pe: Intersect horizontal and vertical alpha gradients. Both prefixed and standard declarations contain both layers so neither axis is lost.

definition.zh: 把景观照片融入米色画布。四边都逐渐透明，换成有纹理的底色也不会出现白色假边。
definition.en: Blend a landscape into the surrounding canvas. Transparent edges work over a textured or colored background without a white fringe.

distinction.zh: 横向和纵向 alpha 渐变用 intersect 相交。这里使用两层完整 mask-image；只写一层 WebKit 前缀会丢失另一个方向的渐隐。
distinction.en: Intersect horizontal and vertical alpha gradients. Both prefixed and standard declarations contain both layers so neither axis is lost.

items.dz: 景点清单用渐隐暗示下方还有内容。到达列表顶端或底端时，相应的渐隐消失，第一项和最后一项仍能读全。
items.de: A destination list fades only where more content remains. At either end, the fade clears so the first and last entries stay readable.
items.pz: 根据 scrollTop 与最大滚动距离分别开关上下渐隐。容器可用键盘滚动；此演示由用户控制，不自动争抢滚动位置。
items.pe: Set the top and bottom fades independently from scrollTop and the maximum scroll position. The focusable list scrolls by keyboard and does not auto-scroll.

definition.zh: 景点清单用渐隐暗示下方还有内容。到达列表顶端或底端时，相应的渐隐消失，第一项和最后一项仍能读全。
definition.en: A destination list fades only where more content remains. At either end, the fade clears so the first and last entries stay readable.

distinction.zh: 根据 scrollTop 与最大滚动距离分别开关上下渐隐。容器可用键盘滚动；此演示由用户控制，不自动争抢滚动位置。
distinction.en: Set the top and bottom fades independently from scrollTop and the maximum scroll position. The focusable list scrolls by keyboard and does not auto-scroll.

items.dz: 把真实山谷装进 ALPS 四个粗体字，适合短标题和目的地封面。移动照片焦点，比较山脊与山体在笔画中的占比。
items.de: Fill the short title ALPS with a real valley photograph. Shift the photo to balance sky and mountain detail inside the strokes.
items.pz: background-clip:text 只裁背景；用足够粗、足够大的字，确保照片仍可辨认。文字颜色透明前用 @supports 检测，正文和链接保留普通可读颜色。
items.pe: background-clip:text clips the background. Use large, heavy type so the image is recognizable. Gate transparent text with @supports and keep body copy readable.

definition.zh: 把真实山谷装进 ALPS 四个粗体字，适合短标题和目的地封面。移动照片焦点，比较山脊与山体在笔画中的占比。
definition.en: Fill the short title ALPS with a real valley photograph. Shift the photo to balance sky and mountain detail inside the strokes.

distinction.zh: background-clip:text 只裁背景；用足够粗、足够大的字，确保照片仍可辨认。文字颜色透明前用 @supports 检测，正文和链接保留普通可读颜色。
distinction.en: background-clip:text clips the background. Use large, heavy type so the image is recognizable. Gate transparent text with @supports and keep body copy readable.

items.dz: 让全景照片在 ALPS 字形后面缓慢移动，适合片头或目的地标题；字形保持静止，动态只发生在文字内部。
items.de: Pan a panorama behind the stationary word ALPS for a destination title or opening sequence.
items.pz: 本例移动的是照片背景，不冒充视频。背景尺寸大于字形后才有平移空间；真正的视频填字需独立 video 与 SVG/CSS 遮罩，并提供静态海报回退。
items.pe: This example pans a photograph, not a video. An oversized background creates room to pan. Actual video type needs a video layer, a mask, and a static poster fallback.

definition.zh: 让全景照片在 ALPS 字形后面缓慢移动，适合片头或目的地标题；字形保持静止，动态只发生在文字内部。
definition.en: Pan a panorama behind the stationary word ALPS for a destination title or opening sequence.

distinction.zh: 本例移动的是照片背景，不冒充视频。背景尺寸大于字形后才有平移空间；真正的视频填字需独立 video 与 SVG/CSS 遮罩，并提供静态海报回退。
distinction.en: This example pans a photograph, not a video. An oversized background creates room to pan. Actual video type needs a video layer, a mask, and a static poster fallback.

items.dz: 把矩形照片装进圆、六边形、三角形或星形。形状不需要变成图片：它是窗口，后面的照片仍可独立更换、缩放和移动。
items.de: Place a photograph inside a circle, hexagon, triangle, or star. The shape is a window; the photo remains a separate, replaceable layer.
items.pz: 先给照片层设置 cover，再用 clip-path 裁外轮廓，最后移动照片焦点保护主体。clip-path 会裁掉元素自己的阴影；需要沿轮廓的阴影时给外层加 drop-shadow。不同点数的 polygon 不保证平滑过渡。
items.pe: Size the photo with cover, clip its outline, then adjust the focal point. clip-path also clips the element’s shadow; apply drop-shadow to an outer wrapper. Polygons with different point counts do not interpolate smoothly.

definition.zh: 把矩形照片装进圆、六边形、三角形或星形。形状不需要变成图片：它是窗口，后面的照片仍可独立更换、缩放和移动。
definition.en: Place a photograph inside a circle, hexagon, triangle, or star. The shape is a window; the photo remains a separate, replaceable layer.

distinction.zh: 先给照片层设置 cover，再用 clip-path 裁外轮廓，最后移动照片焦点保护主体。clip-path 会裁掉元素自己的阴影；需要沿轮廓的阴影时给外层加 drop-shadow。不同点数的 polygon 不保证平滑过渡。
distinction.en: Size the photo with cover, clip its outline, then adjust the focal point. clip-path also clips the element’s shadow; apply drop-shadow to an outer wrapper. Polygons with different point counts do not interpolate smoothly.

items.dz: 非对称轮廓让同一张自然风景从矩形版面中跳出来，可用于人物介绍或生态主题封面。
items.de: An asymmetric silhouette gives a landscape an organic outline for a profile or nature-themed cover.
items.pz: border-radius 的斜杠前后分别控制水平、垂直半径。只改变外框，不拉伸照片；轮廓过度波动会裁掉主体，也会影响文字旁的稳定留白。
items.pe: Values before and after the border-radius slash control horizontal and vertical radii. Change the frame without stretching the image; excessive movement can crop the subject.

definition.zh: 非对称轮廓让同一张自然风景从矩形版面中跳出来，可用于人物介绍或生态主题封面。
definition.en: An asymmetric silhouette gives a landscape an organic outline for a profile or nature-themed cover.

distinction.zh: border-radius 的斜杠前后分别控制水平、垂直半径。只改变外框，不拉伸照片；轮廓过度波动会裁掉主体，也会影响文字旁的稳定留白。
distinction.en: Values before and after the border-radius slash control horizontal and vertical radii. Change the frame without stretching the image; excessive movement can crop the subject.

items.dz: 照片保持原位，六边形轮廓在两种构图之间过渡；可用来强调内容切换而不移动整张图片。
items.de: The photo stays still while a six-vertex outline changes shape, signaling a transition without moving the image itself.
items.pz: 两端使用相同数量、相同顺序的 polygon 顶点。此限制针对 polygon 插值，不能推广成所有 clip-path 都必须有点数；边缘平滑度也不同于 SVG 曲线路径。
items.pe: Use the same number and order of polygon vertices. This is a polygon interpolation rule, not a rule for every clip-path shape; straight edges also differ from SVG curves.

definition.zh: 照片保持原位，六边形轮廓在两种构图之间过渡；可用来强调内容切换而不移动整张图片。
definition.en: The photo stays still while a six-vertex outline changes shape, signaling a transition without moving the image itself.

distinction.zh: 两端使用相同数量、相同顺序的 polygon 顶点。此限制针对 polygon 插值，不能推广成所有 clip-path 都必须有点数；边缘平滑度也不同于 SVG 曲线路径。
distinction.en: Use the same number and order of polygon vertices. This is a polygon interpolation rule, not a rule for every clip-path shape; straight edges also differ from SVG curves.

items.dz: 用平滑的 SVG 曲线把照片做成相册封面或图标，避免用多边形近似时出现明显折角。
items.de: A smooth SVG silhouette turns a photo into an album cover or icon without polygon corners.
items.pz: 示例是连续贝塞尔曲线近似，不宣称是 iOS 图标的精确超椭圆。SVG viewBox 统一坐标，mask-size:100% 100% 随容器缩放。
items.pe: This is a continuous Bézier approximation, not an exact iOS superellipse. A normalized SVG viewBox and mask-size:100% 100% let the frame scale.

definition.zh: 用平滑的 SVG 曲线把照片做成相册封面或图标，避免用多边形近似时出现明显折角。
definition.en: A smooth SVG silhouette turns a photo into an album cover or icon without polygon corners.

distinction.zh: 示例是连续贝塞尔曲线近似，不宣称是 iOS 图标的精确超椭圆。SVG viewBox 统一坐标，mask-size:100% 100% 随容器缩放。
distinction.en: This is a continuous Bézier approximation, not an exact iOS superellipse. A normalized SVG viewBox and mask-size:100% 100% let the frame scale.

items.dz: 把地点档案做成带切角的照片卡。切角只占装饰区，标题和坐标仍在完整矩形安全区内。
items.de: A cut corner gives a location card a document-like edge while its title and coordinates remain inside the safe area.
items.pz: 用 polygon 切掉右上角，给内容留出大于切角深度的内边距。边框会一起被裁掉，不能把原本的矩形 border 当作沿轮廓描边。
items.pe: Cut the top-right corner with polygon and keep content farther in than the cut depth. A rectangular border is clipped too; it does not trace the new outline.

definition.zh: 把地点档案做成带切角的照片卡。切角只占装饰区，标题和坐标仍在完整矩形安全区内。
definition.en: A cut corner gives a location card a document-like edge while its title and coordinates remain inside the safe area.

distinction.zh: 用 polygon 切掉右上角，给内容留出大于切角深度的内边距。边框会一起被裁掉，不能把原本的矩形 border 当作沿轮廓描边。
distinction.en: Cut the top-right corner with polygon and keep content farther in than the cut depth. A rectangular border is clipped too; it does not trace the new outline.

items.dz: 让展示票券两侧的半圆缺口真正透出背景，可直接放在彩色海报或照片上。
items.de: Real transparent notches let a sample ticket sit over a colored poster or photograph without painted-on circles.
items.pz: 两层径向 alpha 渐变用 intersect 相交；每层只挖一侧。二维码、票号和正文要离缺口至少一个半径，不能依赖背景色补两个圆。
items.pe: Intersect two radial alpha masks, one notch per side. Keep ticket numbers and content at least a notch radius away; no background-colored circles are used.

definition.zh: 让展示票券两侧的半圆缺口真正透出背景，可直接放在彩色海报或照片上。
definition.en: Real transparent notches let a sample ticket sit over a colored poster or photograph without painted-on circles.

distinction.zh: 两层径向 alpha 渐变用 intersect 相交；每层只挖一侧。二维码、票号和正文要离缺口至少一个半径，不能依赖背景色补两个圆。
distinction.en: Intersect two radial alpha masks, one notch per side. Keep ticket numbers and content at least a notch radius away; no background-colored circles are used.

items.dz: 把风景裁成一张四边穿孔的纪念邮票。透明齿孔能透出下面的画布，中央照片和邮资字样仍完整。
items.de: Frame a landscape as a sample stamp with transparent perforations on all four sides.
items.pz: 四层径向渐变分别在上、下、左、右边重复并相交。齿孔只切边缘，不能把圆心放在卡片中线，否则得到的是穿孔横条。
items.pe: Four repeated radial masks cut the top, bottom, left, and right edges. Their centers lie on the edges, not on the middle of the card.

definition.zh: 把风景裁成一张四边穿孔的纪念邮票。透明齿孔能透出下面的画布，中央照片和邮资字样仍完整。
definition.en: Frame a landscape as a sample stamp with transparent perforations on all four sides.

distinction.zh: 四层径向渐变分别在上、下、左、右边重复并相交。齿孔只切边缘，不能把圆心放在卡片中线，否则得到的是穿孔横条。
distinction.en: Four repeated radial masks cut the top, bottom, left, and right edges. Their centers lie on the edges, not on the middle of the card.

items.dz: 把同一张照片透过圆孔阵列展示，适合展示窗、印刷网点或装饰性封面。调节孔距即可改变图像的可识别度。
items.de: View one photograph through a repeated aperture pattern, useful for a display screen or decorative cover. Pitch controls recognizability.
items.pz: mask-size 定义重复单元，mask-repeat 平铺遮罩而不是照片。alpha 模式看透明度，黑色和白色只要不透明都会保留画面，并非必须黑白图。
items.pe: mask-size sets the tile; mask-repeat repeats the mask, not the photograph. Alpha mode uses opacity, so both opaque black and opaque white reveal the image.

definition.zh: 把同一张照片透过圆孔阵列展示，适合展示窗、印刷网点或装饰性封面。调节孔距即可改变图像的可识别度。
definition.en: View one photograph through a repeated aperture pattern, useful for a display screen or decorative cover. Pitch controls recognizability.

distinction.zh: mask-size 定义重复单元，mask-repeat 平铺遮罩而不是照片。alpha 模式看透明度，黑色和白色只要不透明都会保留画面，并非必须黑白图。
distinction.en: mask-size sets the tile; mask-repeat repeats the mask, not the photograph. Alpha mode uses opacity, so both opaque black and opaque white reveal the image.

items.en: Type cut through a paper layer
items.dz: 在纸色封面上挖出 ALPS 字样，只有字内显示真实山谷；这与给文字涂渐变不同，背景照片贯穿整个版面。
items.de: Cut ALPS out of a paper-colored cover so the panorama shows through the letters as one continuous image.
items.pz: 纸层使用 SVG 黑字白底蒙版并明确设置 luminance：白底保留纸，黑字挖洞。换成 alpha 模式时，不透明黑字也会保留纸，洞就消失；可切换比较。正常文字标题保留在演示之外。
items.pe: A black-type-on-white SVG masks the paper in luminance mode: white keeps paper, black cuts a hole. In alpha mode, opaque black also keeps paper, closing the hole. Switch modes to compare.

definition.zh: 在纸色封面上挖出 ALPS 字样，只有字内显示真实山谷；这与给文字涂渐变不同，背景照片贯穿整个版面。
definition.en: Cut ALPS out of a paper-colored cover so the panorama shows through the letters as one continuous image.

distinction.zh: 纸层使用 SVG 黑字白底蒙版并明确设置 luminance：白底保留纸，黑字挖洞。换成 alpha 模式时，不透明黑字也会保留纸，洞就消失；可切换比较。正常文字标题保留在演示之外。
distinction.en: A black-type-on-white SVG masks the paper in luminance mode: white keeps paper, black cuts a hole. In alpha mode, opaque black also keeps paper, closing the hole. Switch modes to compare.

items.dz: 用柔边窗口聚焦照片中的草坡，周边保留暗色轮廓帮助定位。适合比较局部细节，而不是隐藏全部上下文。
items.de: A soft window emphasizes the foreground slopes while a dark surrounding image preserves context.
items.pz: 底层照片保持可见但变暗，上层同图使用径向 alpha 渐变。两层必须使用相同尺寸和焦点；只移动遮罩中心，不移动照片。
items.pe: Keep a dim full image underneath and mask a matching image above. Both layers share size and position; move only the mask center.

definition.zh: 用柔边窗口聚焦照片中的草坡，周边保留暗色轮廓帮助定位。适合比较局部细节，而不是隐藏全部上下文。
definition.en: A soft window emphasizes the foreground slopes while a dark surrounding image preserves context.

distinction.zh: 底层照片保持可见但变暗，上层同图使用径向 alpha 渐变。两层必须使用相同尺寸和焦点；只移动遮罩中心，不移动照片。
distinction.en: Keep a dim full image underneath and mask a matching image above. Both layers share size and position; move only the mask center.

items.dz: 移动指针或手指，在暗化风景上查看原图细节；键盘方向键也可移动窗口。
items.de: Move a pointer or finger to inspect the original photo through a spotlight; arrow keys move it too.
items.pz: 把指针坐标换算成容器内百分比，再更新 mask 中心。触屏拖动要设置 pointer capture；键盘聚焦后提供相同功能，离开画面时保留最后位置。
items.pe: Convert pointer coordinates into container percentages and update the mask center. Capture touch drags and provide equivalent arrow-key movement while focused.

definition.zh: 移动指针或手指，在暗化风景上查看原图细节；键盘方向键也可移动窗口。
definition.en: Move a pointer or finger to inspect the original photo through a spotlight; arrow keys move it too.

distinction.zh: 把指针坐标换算成容器内百分比，再更新 mask 中心。触屏拖动要设置 pointer capture；键盘聚焦后提供相同功能，离开画面时保留最后位置。
distinction.en: Convert pointer coordinates into container percentages and update the mask center. Capture touch drags and provide equivalent arrow-key movement while focused.

items.dz: 两片不透明幕布从中间退开，先看到山脊，再看到全景；完整照片一直在下方，没有左右两幅不对齐的问题。
items.de: Two opaque curtains open over one continuous image, revealing the central ridge before the full panorama.
items.pz: 用两个伪元素覆盖左右半幅，以 translateX 移出。保留底图尺寸，避免把每半张图单独 cover；幕布只用于过场，不遮挡必须立即操作的内容。
items.pe: Cover each half with a pseudo-element and translate them out. Keep one background photo rather than separately cropping two halves.

definition.zh: 两片不透明幕布从中间退开，先看到山脊，再看到全景；完整照片一直在下方，没有左右两幅不对齐的问题。
definition.en: Two opaque curtains open over one continuous image, revealing the central ridge before the full panorama.

distinction.zh: 用两个伪元素覆盖左右半幅，以 translateX 移出。保留底图尺寸，避免把每半张图单独 cover；幕布只用于过场，不遮挡必须立即操作的内容。
distinction.en: Cover each half with a pseudo-element and translate them out. Keep one background photo rather than separately cropping two halves.

items.dz: 一张带真实风景的折页从封面侧展开。透视与固定折痕让用户看清它是在翻页，不是在压缩照片。
items.de: A landscape page unfolds around a fixed hinge. Perspective makes it read as a fold rather than a squashed image.
items.pz: 外层设置 perspective，照片层以左边为 transform-origin 做 rotateY。backface-visibility 避免背面倒字；本例是单页折叠，不模拟纸张弯曲。
items.pe: Set perspective on the wrapper and rotate the photo around its left edge. Hide the backface. This is a single-plane fold, not a paper-bending simulation.

definition.zh: 一张带真实风景的折页从封面侧展开。透视与固定折痕让用户看清它是在翻页，不是在压缩照片。
definition.en: A landscape page unfolds around a fixed hinge. Perspective makes it read as a fold rather than a squashed image.

distinction.zh: 外层设置 perspective，照片层以左边为 transform-origin 做 rotateY。backface-visibility 避免背面倒字；本例是单页折叠，不模拟纸张弯曲。
distinction.en: Set perspective on the wrapper and rotate the photo around its left edge. Hide the backface. This is a single-plane fold, not a paper-bending simulation.

items.dz: 同一张照片分成五个连续竖片，按次序展开。山脊线必须能在相邻片之间接上，才能保持全景的整体感。
items.de: Five aligned slices open in sequence. The ridge should connect across neighboring slices so the panorama remains one image.
items.pz: 每片的背景尺寸是整幅宽度的五倍，背景位置依次为 0/25/50/75/100%。只缩放片的遮罩窗口，不能把五份完整照片拼在一起。
items.pe: Each slice uses a background five times its width, positioned at 0/25/50/75/100%. Reveal slices of one image rather than repeating five full images.

definition.zh: 同一张照片分成五个连续竖片，按次序展开。山脊线必须能在相邻片之间接上，才能保持全景的整体感。
definition.en: Five aligned slices open in sequence. The ridge should connect across neighboring slices so the panorama remains one image.

distinction.zh: 每片的背景尺寸是整幅宽度的五倍，背景位置依次为 0/25/50/75/100%。只缩放片的遮罩窗口，不能把五份完整照片拼在一起。
distinction.en: Each slice uses a background five times its width, positioned at 0/25/50/75/100%. Reveal slices of one image rather than repeating five full images.

items.dz: 从低分辨率山谷逐步恢复到清晰照片，可用于揭晓答案或模拟图像逐步解析。细节真的被采样成像素块。
items.de: Resolve a low-resolution valley into a clear photograph. The detail is actually sampled into blocks, not covered by a dotted mask.
items.pz: 先把照片画到较小的离屏 canvas，再关闭 imageSmoothingEnabled 放大。右侧参数控制采样宽度；这只是显示处理，不代表真实下载进度。
items.pe: Draw into a smaller offscreen canvas, then enlarge with imageSmoothingEnabled=false. The sample-width control changes resolution; it does not represent download progress.

definition.zh: 从低分辨率山谷逐步恢复到清晰照片，可用于揭晓答案或模拟图像逐步解析。细节真的被采样成像素块。
definition.en: Resolve a low-resolution valley into a clear photograph. The detail is actually sampled into blocks, not covered by a dotted mask.

distinction.zh: 先把照片画到较小的离屏 canvas，再关闭 imageSmoothingEnabled 放大。右侧参数控制采样宽度；这只是显示处理，不代表真实下载进度。
distinction.en: Draw into a smaller offscreen canvas, then enlarge with imageSmoothingEnabled=false. The sample-width control changes resolution; it does not represent download progress.

items.dz: 将圆形风景放入一段真实的旅行手记中，正文沿圆弧绕排；改变圆形大小可以检查窄栏是否还剩足够字数。
items.de: Place a round landscape inside an actual paragraph and let the copy wrap along its curve. Resize it to test the remaining line length.
items.pz: shape-outside 只影响 float 周围的行内内容，不负责裁切照片。用同样的 circle() 做 clip-path，另设 shape-margin 留出阅读距离；flex 子项不会自动绕形。
items.pe: shape-outside changes inline flow around a float; it does not clip the photo. Use matching clip-path and shape-margin. Flex children do not wrap this way.

definition.zh: 将圆形风景放入一段真实的旅行手记中，正文沿圆弧绕排；改变圆形大小可以检查窄栏是否还剩足够字数。
definition.en: Place a round landscape inside an actual paragraph and let the copy wrap along its curve. Resize it to test the remaining line length.

distinction.zh: shape-outside 只影响 float 周围的行内内容，不负责裁切照片。用同样的 circle() 做 clip-path，另设 shape-margin 留出阅读距离；flex 子项不会自动绕形。
distinction.en: shape-outside changes inline flow around a float; it does not clip the photo. Use matching clip-path and shape-margin. Flex children do not wrap this way.

items.dz: 卡片默认只露出中央取景，悬停或键盘聚焦后展开全景；触屏点按也可以切换。
items.de: A card opens from a central crop to the full panorama on hover or focus; tapping toggles it on touch screens.
items.pz: 始终使用 inset()，同时过渡裁切量与圆角。给触屏和键盘提供等价状态，不把关键信息只藏在 hover 中。
items.pe: Use inset() in both states and transition its crop and radius. Provide equivalent touch and keyboard states rather than making essential information hover-only.

definition.zh: 卡片默认只露出中央取景，悬停或键盘聚焦后展开全景；触屏点按也可以切换。
definition.en: A card opens from a central crop to the full panorama on hover or focus; tapping toggles it on touch screens.

distinction.zh: 始终使用 inset()，同时过渡裁切量与圆角。给触屏和键盘提供等价状态，不把关键信息只藏在 hover 中。
distinction.en: Use inset() in both states and transition its crop and radius. Provide equivalent touch and keyboard states rather than making essential information hover-only.

items.dz: 把两个错开的圆当作取景窗口：相加显示并集，相交只保留重叠，排除则挖掉重叠；减去还能观察图层顺序。
items.de: Combine two offset circular windows: add reveals their union, intersect keeps overlap, exclude removes overlap, and subtract exposes layer order.
items.pz: 列表第一层是当前源层，其下方是目标层；subtract 不是两边对称相减。先用两层图检查运算，再扩展到复杂遮罩。
items.pe: The first listed mask is the source over the layers below. Subtract is directional, unlike exclude. Verify a two-layer case before stacking more masks.

definition.zh: 把两个错开的圆当作取景窗口：相加显示并集，相交只保留重叠，排除则挖掉重叠；减去还能观察图层顺序。
definition.en: Combine two offset circular windows: add reveals their union, intersect keeps overlap, exclude removes overlap, and subtract exposes layer order.

distinction.zh: 列表第一层是当前源层，其下方是目标层；subtract 不是两边对称相减。先用两层图检查运算，再扩展到复杂遮罩。
distinction.en: The first listed mask is the source over the layers below. Subtract is directional, unlike exclude. Verify a two-layer case before stacking more masks.

items.dz: 一条环形读数表示资料准备进度，中间保留数值。拖动到 0% 和 100%，确认起点与闭合状态都正确。
items.de: A ring indicates preparation progress while keeping the numeric value in its center. Test both empty and complete states.
items.pz: conic-gradient 画进度，径向遮罩只挖掉中间，数字放在未遮罩的兄弟层。CSS 环和 SVG stroke 各有适用场景，不能直接断言某个性能更好。
items.pe: A conic gradient draws the progress and a radial mask removes its center. Keep the number on an unmasked sibling. Neither CSS nor SVG is inherently faster in every case.

definition.zh: 一条环形读数表示资料准备进度，中间保留数值。拖动到 0% 和 100%，确认起点与闭合状态都正确。
definition.en: A ring indicates preparation progress while keeping the numeric value in its center. Test both empty and complete states.

distinction.zh: conic-gradient 画进度，径向遮罩只挖掉中间，数字放在未遮罩的兄弟层。CSS 环和 SVG stroke 各有适用场景，不能直接断言某个性能更好。
distinction.en: A conic gradient draws the progress and a radial mask removes its center. Keep the number on an unmasked sibling. Neither CSS nor SVG is inherently faster in every case.

items.dz: 用水箱液面表达高度比例，数字与实际填充高度同步。这里的百分比是高度，不是圆形截面的面积或液体体积。
items.de: A tank level communicates height with a synchronized number. The percentage measures height, not circular area or liquid volume.
items.pz: 圆形容器裁切液体层，液面位置由参数决定，顶部弧面轻微旋转。百分比文本不进入裁切层；若要表示真实体积，需要先将体积换算成对应液位，低动态偏好仅停止表面运动。
items.pe: Clip a level-controlled fill inside a circle and gently rotate its rounded surface. Keep the number outside the clipped fill. For actual volume, first convert volume to level; reduced motion stops the surface movement.

definition.zh: 用水箱液面表达高度比例，数字与实际填充高度同步。这里的百分比是高度，不是圆形截面的面积或液体体积。
definition.en: A tank level communicates height with a synchronized number. The percentage measures height, not circular area or liquid volume.

distinction.zh: 圆形容器裁切液体层，液面位置由参数决定，顶部弧面轻微旋转。百分比文本不进入裁切层；若要表示真实体积，需要先将体积换算成对应液位，低动态偏好仅停止表面运动。
distinction.en: Clip a level-controlled fill inside a circle and gently rotate its rounded surface. Keep the number outside the clipped fill. For actual volume, first convert volume to level; reduced motion stops the surface movement.

items.dz: 拖动鼠标或手指，银色表层会沿笔迹真正被擦掉，露出下方山谷照片。键盘可用“全部揭开”，也能重新覆盖再试。
items.de: Drag a mouse or finger to erase the silver coating along your actual path and reveal the valley. Keyboard users can reveal all or reset.
items.pz: 在透明 canvas 上绘制覆盖层，再用 destination-out 擦除笔迹；照片留在 canvas 下方。按设备像素比绘制、捕获指针并处理取消事件，避免触屏拖动中断。遮住的内容已在客户端，不能作为秘密信息保护。
items.pe: Paint a coating on a transparent canvas and erase strokes with destination-out; keep the photo underneath. Handle device pixel ratio, pointer capture, and cancellation. The hidden content is already on the client, so this is not a security boundary.

definition.zh: 拖动鼠标或手指，银色表层会沿笔迹真正被擦掉，露出下方山谷照片。键盘可用“全部揭开”，也能重新覆盖再试。
definition.en: Drag a mouse or finger to erase the silver coating along your actual path and reveal the valley. Keyboard users can reveal all or reset.

distinction.zh: 在透明 canvas 上绘制覆盖层，再用 destination-out 擦除笔迹；照片留在 canvas 下方。按设备像素比绘制、捕获指针并处理取消事件，避免触屏拖动中断。遮住的内容已在客户端，不能作为秘密信息保护。
distinction.en: Paint a coating on a transparent canvas and erase strokes with destination-out; keep the photo underneath. Handle device pixel ratio, pointer capture, and cancellation. The hidden content is already on the client, so this is not a security boundary.

items.dz: 照片在固定取景框内横向移动，外侧边缘被截住；框下的标题始终保持原位。
items.de: A photo pans inside a fixed viewport while its caption remains still outside the crop.
items.pz: overflow:clip 不创建滚动容器，也不能像 hidden 那样通过 scrollLeft 滚动。这里移动内部图片层；若需要独立格式化上下文可加 display:flow-root。
items.pe: overflow:clip creates no scroll container and cannot be programmatically scrolled like hidden. Move the inner photo layer; add flow-root when an independent formatting context is needed.

definition.zh: 照片在固定取景框内横向移动，外侧边缘被截住；框下的标题始终保持原位。
definition.en: A photo pans inside a fixed viewport while its caption remains still outside the crop.

distinction.zh: overflow:clip 不创建滚动容器，也不能像 hidden 那样通过 scrollLeft 滚动。这里移动内部图片层；若需要独立格式化上下文可加 display:flow-root。
distinction.en: overflow:clip creates no scroll container and cannot be programmatically scrolled like hidden. Move the inner photo layer; add flow-root when an independent formatting context is needed.

items.dz: 把圆形照片像钟面一样沿顺时针方向揭开，适合短过场或圆形媒体浏览。拖动角度可看清扇形范围。
items.de: Reveal a round photograph clockwise like a clock face. Adjust the angle to inspect the actual sector.
items.pz: 圆形裁切决定外轮廓，conic-gradient alpha 遮罩决定扇形。普通 background 渐变本身不会可靠地平滑插值；本例直接控制角度，不伪装为自动动画。
items.pe: A circle defines the silhouette and a conic alpha mask defines the sector. Ordinary background gradients do not smoothly interpolate by default, so this study controls the angle directly.

definition.zh: 把圆形照片像钟面一样沿顺时针方向揭开，适合短过场或圆形媒体浏览。拖动角度可看清扇形范围。
definition.en: Reveal a round photograph clockwise like a clock face. Adjust the angle to inspect the actual sector.

distinction.zh: 圆形裁切决定外轮廓，conic-gradient alpha 遮罩决定扇形。普通 background 渐变本身不会可靠地平滑插值；本例直接控制角度，不伪装为自动动画。
distinction.en: A circle defines the silhouette and a conic alpha mask defines the sector. Ordinary background gradients do not smoothly interpolate by default, so this study controls the angle directly.

items.dz: 照片下沿变成连续波浪，适合从景观横幅过渡到下一段正文；背景仍从波谷自然透出。
items.de: A scalloped lower edge transitions a landscape banner into the next section while preserving transparency in the valleys.
items.pz: 主矩形与底部一排圆相加形成波浪。遮罩与照片使用独立的尺寸，确保只影响下沿，不把整张照片裁成多个竖条。
items.pe: Add a solid upper rectangle to a row of circles at the bottom. Size the mask independently from the photo so only the lower edge is shaped.

definition.zh: 照片下沿变成连续波浪，适合从景观横幅过渡到下一段正文；背景仍从波谷自然透出。
definition.en: A scalloped lower edge transitions a landscape banner into the next section while preserving transparency in the valleys.

distinction.zh: 主矩形与底部一排圆相加形成波浪。遮罩与照片使用独立的尺寸，确保只影响下沿，不把整张照片裁成多个竖条。
distinction.en: Add a solid upper rectangle to a row of circles at the bottom. Size the mask independently from the photo so only the lower edge is shaped.

items.dz: 用不规则下沿给旅行档案增加剪贴感，照片上方仍留出完整矩形区域以保留主体。
items.de: An irregular lower edge gives a travel archive a clipped-paper feel without interrupting the main subject.
items.pz: 用不等距 polygon 顶点切出纸边；这是平面轮廓，不包含纸纤维或厚度。不要重复同一组等距锯齿，否则更像票据撕线。
items.pe: Use uneven polygon vertices for a torn silhouette. It is a flat edge without paper fibers or thickness. Equal repeated teeth read more like a receipt perforation.

definition.zh: 用不规则下沿给旅行档案增加剪贴感，照片上方仍留出完整矩形区域以保留主体。
definition.en: An irregular lower edge gives a travel archive a clipped-paper feel without interrupting the main subject.

distinction.zh: 用不等距 polygon 顶点切出纸边；这是平面轮廓，不包含纸纤维或厚度。不要重复同一组等距锯齿，否则更像票据撕线。
distinction.en: Use uneven polygon vertices for a torn silhouette. It is a flat edge without paper fibers or thickness. Equal repeated teeth read more like a receipt perforation.

items.dz: 把横向风景重新构图为拱形竖幅，可用于目的地封面或展览海报。移动照片焦点，避免山峰被拱顶切掉。
items.de: Reframe a landscape as an arched portrait for a destination cover or exhibition poster. Adjust the focal point to protect the peak.
items.pz: 上角使用椭圆半径、下角保持小圆角；overflow:hidden 裁切实际照片。框是竖幅，cover 必然裁去横图两侧，不能把裁切误认作图片变形。
items.pe: Use elliptical top radii and small bottom radii with overflow:hidden. Cover crops a landscape to a portrait frame; it should not stretch the image.

definition.zh: 把横向风景重新构图为拱形竖幅，可用于目的地封面或展览海报。移动照片焦点，避免山峰被拱顶切掉。
definition.en: Reframe a landscape as an arched portrait for a destination cover or exhibition poster. Adjust the focal point to protect the peak.

distinction.zh: 上角使用椭圆半径、下角保持小圆角；overflow:hidden 裁切实际照片。框是竖幅，cover 必然裁去横图两侧，不能把裁切误认作图片变形。
distinction.en: Use elliptical top radii and small bottom radii with overflow:hidden. Cover crops a landscape to a portrait frame; it should not stretch the image.

items.dz: 在原尺寸照片上缩小取景窗口，同时改变圆角。比较硬边矩形与胶片式圆角窗口的构图差异。
items.de: Inset a window within the original photograph and change its radius to compare hard and rounded crops.
items.pz: inset() 的 round 在裁切边界上生效；它不同于给整张图片设 border-radius。照片和窗口各自独立，内缩量过大时要重新调整主体位置。
items.pe: The round keyword rounds the inset clipping boundary, unlike border-radius on the entire image. The photo and window remain independent.

definition.zh: 在原尺寸照片上缩小取景窗口，同时改变圆角。比较硬边矩形与胶片式圆角窗口的构图差异。
definition.en: Inset a window within the original photograph and change its radius to compare hard and rounded crops.

distinction.zh: inset() 的 round 在裁切边界上生效；它不同于给整张图片设 border-radius。照片和窗口各自独立，内缩量过大时要重新调整主体位置。
distinction.en: The round keyword rounds the inset clipping boundary, unlike border-radius on the entire image. The photo and window remain independent.

items.dz: 把照片放进叶片或地图标记轮廓。SVG 定义轮廓，真实照片独立保留，可替换素材而不重画形状。
items.de: Place a photograph inside a leaf or map-pin silhouette. The SVG defines the outline independently from the replaceable photo.
items.pz: 本例实际使用含 path 的 SVG 图像作为 mask-image，设置 viewBox 与 mask-size。它不是 polygon，也不是 clipPath 引用；需要软边时可在 SVG 里增加透明渐变。
items.pe: This uses an SVG image containing a path as mask-image, with viewBox and mask-size. It is not a polygon or a clipPath reference; SVG alpha gradients can add soft edges.

definition.zh: 把照片放进叶片或地图标记轮廓。SVG 定义轮廓，真实照片独立保留，可替换素材而不重画形状。
definition.en: Place a photograph inside a leaf or map-pin silhouette. The SVG defines the outline independently from the replaceable photo.

distinction.zh: 本例实际使用含 path 的 SVG 图像作为 mask-image，设置 viewBox 与 mask-size。它不是 polygon，也不是 clipPath 引用；需要软边时可在 SVG 里增加透明渐变。
distinction.en: This uses an SVG image containing a path as mask-image, with viewBox and mask-size. It is not a polygon or a clipPath reference; SVG alpha gradients can add soft edges.

items.dz: 深色封面挖出一个圆形窗口，窗口里露出清晰照片。调整窗口位置，可以用同一张大图制作不同局部封面。
items.de: Cut a clear circular window through a dark cover. Reposition the window to create different close-up covers from one photo.
items.pz: 透明圆形加超大扩散 box-shadow 形成覆盖层，外容器限制阴影范围。覆盖层应 pointer-events:none；这只做视觉遮挡，不改变底层交互或可访问树。
items.pe: A transparent circle with a large spread shadow forms the cover, clipped by its wrapper. Keep the overlay pointer-events:none; visual coverage does not remove underlying interaction or accessibility.

definition.zh: 深色封面挖出一个圆形窗口，窗口里露出清晰照片。调整窗口位置，可以用同一张大图制作不同局部封面。
definition.en: Cut a clear circular window through a dark cover. Reposition the window to create different close-up covers from one photo.

distinction.zh: 透明圆形加超大扩散 box-shadow 形成覆盖层，外容器限制阴影范围。覆盖层应 pointer-events:none；这只做视觉遮挡，不改变底层交互或可访问树。
distinction.en: A transparent circle with a large spread shadow forms the cover, clipped by its wrapper. Keep the overlay pointer-events:none; visual coverage does not remove underlying interaction or accessibility.

items.dz: 在地点资料清单中突出当前整理步骤，其他步骤变暗但仍保留位置关系。切换目标，观察高亮是否完整包住这一行。
items.de: Highlight the current step in a location-data checklist while keeping the surrounding workflow visible.
items.pz: 示例用目标行的扩散阴影覆盖其他行。真实引导还需管理焦点、Esc 退出、定位更新和跳过入口；视觉挖洞不能替代这些行为。
items.pe: The selected row casts a spread shadow over its siblings. Production onboarding also needs focus handling, Escape, skip, and position updates; a visual hole does not implement them.

definition.zh: 在地点资料清单中突出当前整理步骤，其他步骤变暗但仍保留位置关系。切换目标，观察高亮是否完整包住这一行。
definition.en: Highlight the current step in a location-data checklist while keeping the surrounding workflow visible.

distinction.zh: 示例用目标行的扩散阴影覆盖其他行。真实引导还需管理焦点、Esc 退出、定位更新和跳过入口；视觉挖洞不能替代这些行为。
distinction.en: The selected row casts a spread shadow over its siblings. Production onboarding also needs focus handling, Escape, skip, and position updates; a visual hole does not implement them.

items.dz: 让“PREPARING”随完成比例被填色，文字本身始终可读。填色只承担辅助反馈，不能代替可访问的数值进度。
items.de: Fill PREPARING with color as completion increases while keeping the whole word readable. The color is secondary to an accessible numeric value.
items.pz: 两层同字同字体重合，上层用 inset() 按进度裁切；不用渐变过渡造成模糊中线。真实任务应把同一数值写入 progress 或 aria-valuenow。
items.pe: Align two identical text layers and clip the colored layer by progress. Use the same value in progress or aria-valuenow for actual task status.

definition.zh: 让“PREPARING”随完成比例被填色，文字本身始终可读。填色只承担辅助反馈，不能代替可访问的数值进度。
definition.en: Fill PREPARING with color as completion increases while keeping the whole word readable. The color is secondary to an accessible numeric value.

distinction.zh: 两层同字同字体重合，上层用 inset() 按进度裁切；不用渐变过渡造成模糊中线。真实任务应把同一数值写入 progress 或 aria-valuenow。
distinction.en: Align two identical text layers and clip the colored layer by progress. Use the same value in progress or aria-valuenow for actual task status.

items.dz: 斜向条纹把照片处理成可识别的图形纹理；条纹越密，整体越接近原图，越疏则更适合做背景装饰。
items.de: Diagonal slits turn a photograph into a recognizable graphic texture. Dense stripes preserve more detail; wider gaps make a stronger decorative pattern.
items.pz: 重复线性 alpha 渐变交替保留和隐藏照片。条宽与间隔分别控制，文字放在独立实色区域；不要把高频条纹持续快速移动。
items.pe: A repeating alpha gradient alternates visible and hidden bands. Control stripe and gap widths separately and keep text on a solid region. Avoid fast continuous motion.

definition.zh: 斜向条纹把照片处理成可识别的图形纹理；条纹越密，整体越接近原图，越疏则更适合做背景装饰。
definition.en: Diagonal slits turn a photograph into a recognizable graphic texture. Dense stripes preserve more detail; wider gaps make a stronger decorative pattern.

distinction.zh: 重复线性 alpha 渐变交替保留和隐藏照片。条宽与间隔分别控制，文字放在独立实色区域；不要把高频条纹持续快速移动。
distinction.en: A repeating alpha gradient alternates visible and hidden bands. Control stripe and gap widths separately and keep text on a solid region. Avoid fast continuous motion.

items.dz: 九片照片从错位状态回到原位，最后拼成一张连续的全景；可检查山脊和草坡是否在接缝处对齐。
items.de: Nine displaced tiles settle into one continuous photograph. Check that the ridge and hillside align across the seams.
items.pz: 每片使用同一图片、三倍背景尺寸和对应的横纵定位；整体取景比例保持不变。位移动画结束时必须回到准确坐标，不随机改变终点。
items.pe: Use the same image on every tile with 300% background size and matching row/column positions. Preserve the full-frame ratio and return every tile to exact coordinates.

definition.zh: 九片照片从错位状态回到原位，最后拼成一张连续的全景；可检查山脊和草坡是否在接缝处对齐。
definition.en: Nine displaced tiles settle into one continuous photograph. Check that the ridge and hillside align across the seams.

distinction.zh: 每片使用同一图片、三倍背景尺寸和对应的横纵定位；整体取景比例保持不变。位移动画结束时必须回到准确坐标，不随机改变终点。
distinction.en: Use the same image on every tile with 300% background size and matching row/column positions. Preserve the full-frame ratio and return every tile to exact coordinates.

items.dz: 用同一张照片比较原始彩色与黑白处理。拖动分界线，内容的位置完全重合，避免读者把构图变化误认为处理效果。
items.de: Compare the same photograph in color and grayscale. The divider changes coverage while both images remain perfectly aligned.
items.pz: 两层同图同尺寸，顶层用 inset() 裁切；滤镜只是示例处理。保留原图在后面，不能让中间阶段露出空白，也不把裁切称为透明度交叉淡化。
items.pe: Align two same-sized images and clip the processed top layer with inset(). Keep the original behind it; this is a wipe comparison, not an opacity cross-fade.

definition.zh: 用同一张照片比较原始彩色与黑白处理。拖动分界线，内容的位置完全重合，避免读者把构图变化误认为处理效果。
definition.en: Compare the same photograph in color and grayscale. The divider changes coverage while both images remain perfectly aligned.

distinction.zh: 两层同图同尺寸，顶层用 inset() 裁切；滤镜只是示例处理。保留原图在后面，不能让中间阶段露出空白，也不把裁切称为透明度交叉淡化。
distinction.en: Align two same-sized images and clip the processed top layer with inset(). Keep the original behind it; this is a wipe comparison, not an opacity cross-fade.

items.dz: 短标题的每个字从自己的基线窗口依次上升，适合章节开场；完整标题结束后停留，便于阅读。
items.de: Each letter rises through its own baseline window, followed by a pause that keeps the complete title readable.
items.pz: 每个字必须有独立裁切窗口；这里只让 span 的 clip-path 和 translateY 同时变化，父层裁掉底部溢出。长正文不要逐字播放，低动态时直接显示全部。
items.pe: Each glyph needs its own clipping behavior. Here each span combines clip-path and translateY within an overflow-clipped parent. Do not animate long paragraphs letter by letter.

definition.zh: 短标题的每个字从自己的基线窗口依次上升，适合章节开场；完整标题结束后停留，便于阅读。
definition.en: Each letter rises through its own baseline window, followed by a pause that keeps the complete title readable.

distinction.zh: 每个字必须有独立裁切窗口；这里只让 span 的 clip-path 和 translateY 同时变化，父层裁掉底部溢出。长正文不要逐字播放，低动态时直接显示全部。
distinction.en: Each glyph needs its own clipping behavior. Here each span combines clip-path and translateY within an overflow-clipped parent. Do not animate long paragraphs letter by letter.

items.dz: 从一个小窗口扩大到整张照片，边缘始终柔和；可用于图片聚焦转全景的过场。
items.de: Grow from a small window to the full photograph while retaining a soft boundary.
items.pz: 保持照片尺寸固定，放大居中的径向遮罩；mask-repeat:no-repeat 避免重复窗口。最终遮罩要覆盖四角，不能只放大到照片宽度的一倍。
items.pe: Keep the image fixed and enlarge a centered radial mask with no-repeat. The final mask must cover all four corners, not just reach the frame width.

definition.zh: 从一个小窗口扩大到整张照片，边缘始终柔和；可用于图片聚焦转全景的过场。
definition.en: Grow from a small window to the full photograph while retaining a soft boundary.

distinction.zh: 保持照片尺寸固定，放大居中的径向遮罩；mask-repeat:no-repeat 避免重复窗口。最终遮罩要覆盖四角，不能只放大到照片宽度的一倍。
distinction.en: Keep the image fixed and enlarge a centered radial mask with no-repeat. The final mask must cover all four corners, not just reach the frame width.

items.dz: 同一条底色被裁到当前栏目下面。切换栏目时，观察指示范围是否跟随完整按钮，而不是只追着文字中点。
items.de: One colored layer is clipped to the current navigation item. Change the selected section and inspect how the highlight covers the full target.
items.pz: 示例五项等宽，inset 左右值可由索引计算。真实的不同宽度导航需读取按钮位置；文字层放在遮罩上方，并以 aria-current 或选中状态表达当前项。
items.pe: These five items have equal widths, so insets follow the index. Unequal items need measured bounds. Keep labels above the layer and expose selection semantically.

definition.zh: 同一条底色被裁到当前栏目下面。切换栏目时，观察指示范围是否跟随完整按钮，而不是只追着文字中点。
definition.en: One colored layer is clipped to the current navigation item. Change the selected section and inspect how the highlight covers the full target.

distinction.zh: 示例五项等宽，inset 左右值可由索引计算。真实的不同宽度导航需读取按钮位置；文字层放在遮罩上方，并以 aria-current 或选中状态表达当前项。
distinction.en: These five items have equal widths, so insets follow the index. Unequal items need measured bounds. Keep labels above the layer and expose selection semantically.

items.dz: 给一张内容完整的地点卡添加细渐变边框。边框强调卡片边界，内部照片和文字仍保持平静。
items.de: Give a complete location card a thin gradient border while keeping its photo and text calm.
items.pz: 双层背景分别裁到 padding-box 与 border-box，并保留透明 border 宽度。此方法中间是实色填充；若中间必须真正透明，改用排除合成的遮罩边框。
items.pe: Clip two backgrounds to padding-box and border-box with a transparent border. The center is an opaque fill; use an exclude mask when it must be truly transparent.

definition.zh: 给一张内容完整的地点卡添加细渐变边框。边框强调卡片边界，内部照片和文字仍保持平静。
definition.en: Give a complete location card a thin gradient border while keeping its photo and text calm.

distinction.zh: 双层背景分别裁到 padding-box 与 border-box，并保留透明 border 宽度。此方法中间是实色填充；若中间必须真正透明，改用排除合成的遮罩边框。
distinction.en: Clip two backgrounds to padding-box and border-box with a transparent border. The center is an opaque fill; use an exclude mask when it must be truly transparent.

items.dz: 让一段高亮沿地点卡边框缓慢经过，提示“当前选中”或处理中。照片与标题保持静止，避免整卡闪烁。
items.de: Move a restrained highlight around a location card to suggest selection or activity while its content remains still.
items.pz: 旋转的锥形渐变放在最底层，内层纸面遮住中心；内容单独抬到上层。不要给整张卡持续变色，低动态模式保留静态边框即可。
items.pe: Rotate a conic gradient behind an opaque inset surface and lift the content above both. Reduced motion keeps a static border.

definition.zh: 让一段高亮沿地点卡边框缓慢经过，提示“当前选中”或处理中。照片与标题保持静止，避免整卡闪烁。
definition.en: Move a restrained highlight around a location card to suggest selection or activity while its content remains still.

distinction.zh: 旋转的锥形渐变放在最底层，内层纸面遮住中心；内容单独抬到上层。不要给整张卡持续变色，低动态模式保留静态边框即可。
distinction.en: Rotate a conic gradient behind an opaque inset surface and lift the content above both. Reduced motion keeps a static border.

items.dz: 照片清单底部的阴影表示仍有下一张，到底后阴影消失；向下滚动后，上方阴影才出现。
items.de: A bottom shadow indicates more photos below, disappears at the end, and gains a top counterpart after scrolling down.
items.pz: 四层背景中两层白色遮片用 background-attachment:local 随内容滚动，两层阴影用 scroll 留在视口边缘。它不依赖滚动驱动动画，也不需要固定假遮罩盖住正文。
items.pe: Two local-attached white covers move with the content while two scroll-attached shadows stay at the viewport edges. This uses background attachment, not scroll-driven animation.

definition.zh: 照片清单底部的阴影表示仍有下一张，到底后阴影消失；向下滚动后，上方阴影才出现。
definition.en: A bottom shadow indicates more photos below, disappears at the end, and gains a top counterpart after scrolling down.

distinction.zh: 四层背景中两层白色遮片用 background-attachment:local 随内容滚动，两层阴影用 scroll 留在视口边缘。它不依赖滚动驱动动画，也不需要固定假遮罩盖住正文。
distinction.en: Two local-attached white covers move with the content while two scroll-attached shadows stay at the viewport edges. This uses background attachment, not scroll-driven animation.

dz: 阴影不是装饰，是在说“谁在上面”
de: Shadow is not decoration — it says what sits on top

items.dz: 一套可复用的高度
items.de: A reusable set of heights
items.pz: 定 4–5 级阴影，越高越大越淡，不要每处现调。
items.pe: Define 4–5 steps: higher means larger and fainter. Never improvise.

definition.zh: 一套可复用的高度
definition.en: A reusable set of heights

distinction.zh: 定 4–5 级阴影，越高越大越淡，不要每处现调。
distinction.en: Define 4–5 steps: higher means larger and fainter. Never improvise.

items.dz: 把同一张照片卡放在多层阴影上，观察近边缘的接触影与远处的柔影如何分工。
items.de: Compare the tight contact shadow and the wider soft shadow beneath the same photo card.
items.pz: 每层分别控制偏移、模糊与透明度；靠近物体的层更紧。照片、边框和卡片尺寸保持一致，比较才有意义。
items.pe: Tune offset, blur, and opacity per layer. Keep the photo, border, and dimensions fixed so the shadow comparison remains meaningful.

definition.zh: 把同一张照片卡放在多层阴影上，观察近边缘的接触影与远处的柔影如何分工。
definition.en: Compare the tight contact shadow and the wider soft shadow beneath the same photo card.

distinction.zh: 每层分别控制偏移、模糊与透明度；靠近物体的层更紧。照片、边框和卡片尺寸保持一致，比较才有意义。
distinction.en: Tune offset, blur, and opacity per layer. Keep the photo, border, and dimensions fixed so the shadow comparison remains meaningful.

items.dz: 用一层短柔影把照片卡与白色背景分开，适合低层级内容卡，不会把它抬成浮窗。
items.de: A single short shadow separates the photo card from its background without suggesting a floating dialog.
items.pz: 示例偏移 1px、模糊 2px；这些数值只对应当前尺寸，不是所有界面的通用处方。浅底色下还要检查边界能否被看见。
items.pe: This specimen uses a 1px offset and 2px blur. Those values fit this size, not every interface; check whether the boundary remains visible.

definition.zh: 用一层短柔影把照片卡与白色背景分开，适合低层级内容卡，不会把它抬成浮窗。
definition.en: A single short shadow separates the photo card from its background without suggesting a floating dialog.

distinction.zh: 示例偏移 1px、模糊 2px；这些数值只对应当前尺寸，不是所有界面的通用处方。浅底色下还要检查边界能否被看见。
distinction.en: This specimen uses a 1px offset and 2px blur. Those values fit this size, not every interface; check whether the boundary remains visible.

items.dz: 让照片卡的投影带一点强调色，适合暖色背景或品牌色面；照片本身保持原色，便于比较。
items.de: Tint the card shadow with the accent color while keeping the photograph unchanged for comparison.
items.pz: 颜色参与阴影透明度混合；先控制饱和度和不透明度，再调整模糊半径。带色并不天然更高级，过饱和会像发光。
items.pe: Control saturation and opacity before blur radius. A tinted shadow is not inherently better; excessive saturation reads as a glow.

definition.zh: 让照片卡的投影带一点强调色，适合暖色背景或品牌色面；照片本身保持原色，便于比较。
definition.en: Tint the card shadow with the accent color while keeping the photograph unchanged for comparison.

distinction.zh: 颜色参与阴影透明度混合；先控制饱和度和不透明度，再调整模糊半径。带色并不天然更高级，过饱和会像发光。
distinction.en: Control saturation and opacity before blur radius. A tinted shadow is not inherently better; excessive saturation reads as a glow.

items.dz: 低角度光的长影
items.de: A low sun, a long shadow
items.pz: 偏移远大于模糊，方向要全站统一。
items.pe: Offset far exceeds blur; keep one direction site-wide.

items.dz: 给完整照片卡加零模糊的偏移投影，边缘像印刷错版一样清楚。它适合强图形边界和海报式卡片。
items.de: A zero-blur offset shadow gives the complete photo card a crisp, print-like edge for graphic layouts.
items.pz: box-shadow 的第三个长度是模糊半径，这里为 0。8px 偏移不会占据布局空间；相邻卡片仍需预留可见投影的位置。
items.pe: The third box-shadow length is blur radius, set to zero here. The 8px offset occupies no layout space, so neighboring cards need clearance.

definition.zh: 给完整照片卡加零模糊的偏移投影，边缘像印刷错版一样清楚。它适合强图形边界和海报式卡片。
definition.en: A zero-blur offset shadow gives the complete photo card a crisp, print-like edge for graphic layouts.

distinction.zh: box-shadow 的第三个长度是模糊半径，这里为 0。8px 偏移不会占据布局空间；相邻卡片仍需预留可见投影的位置。
distinction.en: The third box-shadow length is blur radius, set to zero here. The 8px offset occupies no layout space, so neighboring cards need clearance.

items.dz: 按下去像沉进面板
items.de: Sinks into the panel
items.pz: 按下用 inset 阴影加 1px 位移，弹起用外阴影。
items.pe: Press: inset shadow plus 1px shift. Release: back to outer.

definition.zh: 按下去像沉进面板
definition.en: Sinks into the panel

distinction.zh: 按下用 inset 阴影加 1px 位移，弹起用外阴影。
distinction.en: Press: inset shadow plus 1px shift. Release: back to outer.

items.dz: 同色浮雕，一亮一暗
items.de: Same-colour relief: one light, one dark
items.pz: 两个反向阴影 + 与底色完全同色，对比度是硬伤。
items.pe: Two opposite shadows on an identical background — contrast is its flaw.

definition.zh: 同色浮雕，一亮一暗
definition.en: Same-colour relief: one light, one dark

distinction.zh: 两个反向阴影 + 与底色完全同色，对比度是硬伤。
distinction.en: Two opposite shadows on an identical background — contrast is its flaw.

items.dz: 阴影变成光源
items.de: The shadow becomes a light
items.pz: 同色高饱和 + 无偏移大模糊。
items.pe: Same hue, saturated, no offset, wide blur.

definition.zh: 阴影变成光源
definition.en: The shadow becomes a light

distinction.zh: 同色高饱和 + 无偏移大模糊。
distinction.en: Same hue, saturated, no offset, wide blur.

items.dz: 键盘焦点必须看得见
items.de: Keyboard focus has to be visible
items.pz: 用 outline + outline-offset，别用 box-shadow（会被裁）。
items.pe: Use outline with outline-offset — box-shadow gets clipped.

definition.zh: 键盘焦点必须看得见
definition.en: Keyboard focus has to be visible

distinction.zh: 用 outline + outline-offset，别用 box-shadow（会被裁）。
distinction.en: Use outline with outline-offset — box-shadow gets clipped.

items.dz: 深浅两圈，任何底色都看得见
items.de: Two rings so it shows on any ground
items.pz: 内圈浅色、外圈深色，是无障碍推荐做法。
items.pe: Light inner ring, dark outer ring — the accessible pattern.

definition.zh: 深浅两圈，任何底色都看得见
definition.en: Two rings so it shows on any ground

distinction.zh: 内圈浅色、外圈深色，是无障碍推荐做法。
distinction.en: Light inner ring, dark outer ring — the accessible pattern.

items.dz: 悬停后照片卡抬高并出现更宽的阴影，表示这张卡可以进一步查看。标题随卡片一起移动。
items.de: Hover lifts the photo card and broadens its shadow, suggesting that the card can be explored further.
items.pz: 位移与阴影同时过渡，照片不单独缩放。当前演示是 CSS 悬停反馈；实际产品还需真实链接和键盘焦点反馈。
items.pe: Transition the offset and shadow together without zooming the photograph separately. Production use also needs a real link and keyboard focus feedback.

definition.zh: 悬停后照片卡抬高并出现更宽的阴影，表示这张卡可以进一步查看。标题随卡片一起移动。
definition.en: Hover lifts the photo card and broadens its shadow, suggesting that the card can be explored further.

distinction.zh: 位移与阴影同时过渡，照片不单独缩放。当前演示是 CSS 悬停反馈；实际产品还需真实链接和键盘焦点反馈。
distinction.en: Transition the offset and shadow together without zooming the photograph separately. Production use also needs a real link and keyboard focus feedback.

items.dz: 一圈实心环随状态变化
items.de: A solid ring that reacts to state
items.pz: box-shadow 的 spread 参数做环，比 border 不占布局。
items.pe: Use the spread value as a ring — it costs no layout.

definition.zh: 一圈实心环随状态变化
definition.en: A solid ring that reacts to state

distinction.zh: box-shadow 的 spread 参数做环，比 border 不占布局。
distinction.en: Use the spread value as a ring — it costs no layout.

items.dz: 底部一条很紧的暗影
items.de: A tight dark line where it touches
items.pz: 接触面处必须有一层几乎不模糊的暗影，否则物体在飘。
items.pe: Without a near-sharp contact shadow the object floats.

definition.zh: 底部一条很紧的暗影
definition.en: A tight dark line where it touches

distinction.zh: 接触面处必须有一层几乎不模糊的暗影，否则物体在飘。
distinction.en: Without a near-sharp contact shadow the object floats.

items.dz: 物体轻轻上下浮，影子跟着变
items.de: It bobs, and the shadow answers
items.pz: 物体上移时阴影变大变淡，两者必须同步。
items.pe: As it rises the shadow grows and fades — in sync.

definition.zh: 物体轻轻上下浮，影子跟着变
definition.en: It bobs, and the shadow answers

distinction.zh: 物体上移时阴影变大变淡，两者必须同步。
distinction.en: As it rises the shadow grows and fades — in sync.

items.dz: 影子贴合真实形状
items.de: The shadow hugs the real shape
items.pz: filter:drop-shadow 会识别透明像素与 clip-path。
items.pe: filter:drop-shadow respects alpha and clip-path.

definition.zh: 影子贴合真实形状
definition.en: The shadow hugs the real shape

distinction.zh: filter:drop-shadow 会识别透明像素与 clip-path。
distinction.en: filter:drop-shadow respects alpha and clip-path.

items.dz: 文字轻轻浮起
items.de: Type lifted slightly
items.pz: 低透明度大模糊，别给正文加阴影。
items.pe: Low opacity, wide blur — and never on body copy.

definition.zh: 文字轻轻浮起
definition.en: Type lifted slightly

distinction.zh: 低透明度大模糊，别给正文加阴影。
distinction.en: Low opacity, wide blur — and never on body copy.

items.dz: 照片上的字必须压得住
items.de: Type over a photo needs help
items.pz: 底部渐变遮片比 text-shadow 更可靠。
items.pe: A bottom gradient scrim beats a text-shadow.

definition.zh: 照片上的字必须压得住
definition.en: Type over a photo needs help

distinction.zh: 底部渐变遮片比 text-shadow 更可靠。
distinction.en: A bottom gradient scrim beats a text-shadow.

items.dz: 夹角处自然变暗
items.de: Corners naturally darken
items.pz: 内阴影只给上边缘，模拟顶光下的接缝。
items.pe: An inset shadow on the top edge only.

definition.zh: 夹角处自然变暗
definition.en: Corners naturally darken

distinction.zh: 内阴影只给上边缘，模拟顶光下的接缝。
distinction.en: An inset shadow on the top edge only.

items.dz: 滚动后头部才出现阴影
items.de: The header only gets a shadow once you scroll
items.pz: 用 IntersectionObserver 或 scroll-driven，别常驻阴影。
items.pe: Toggle it with IntersectionObserver — do not ship it always-on.

definition.zh: 滚动后头部才出现阴影
definition.en: The header only gets a shadow once you scroll

distinction.zh: 用 IntersectionObserver 或 scroll-driven，别常驻阴影。
distinction.en: Toggle it with IntersectionObserver — do not ship it always-on.

items.dz: 背景压暗把注意力交出去
items.de: The background dims and hands over attention
items.pz: 遮罩 40–60% 黑，进入 200ms、退出 150ms。
items.pe: 40–60% black; 200ms in, 150ms out.

definition.zh: 背景压暗把注意力交出去
definition.en: The background dims and hands over attention

distinction.zh: 遮罩 40–60% 黑，进入 200ms、退出 150ms。
distinction.en: 40–60% black; 200ms in, 150ms out.

items.dz: 较深的双层阴影把内容卡从背景中提起，可用于比较菜单或浮层的视觉层级。
items.de: A deeper two-layer shadow lifts content above the background for a popover or menu elevation study.
items.pz: 近层收紧接触边缘，远层表现悬浮距离。本例是一张视觉样本卡，不包含菜单的焦点、定位和关闭逻辑。
items.pe: A tight layer anchors the edge; a wide layer suggests distance. This is a visual specimen, not a menu with focus, positioning, or dismissal behavior.

definition.zh: 较深的双层阴影把内容卡从背景中提起，可用于比较菜单或浮层的视觉层级。
definition.en: A deeper two-layer shadow lifts content above the background for a popover or menu elevation study.

distinction.zh: 近层收紧接触边缘，远层表现悬浮距离。本例是一张视觉样本卡，不包含菜单的焦点、定位和关闭逻辑。
distinction.en: A tight layer anchors the edge; a wide layer suggests distance. This is a visual specimen, not a menu with focus, positioning, or dismissal behavior.

items.dz: 暗底下阴影几乎没用
items.de: Shadows barely work on dark
items.pz: 暗色里用更亮的背景色分层，而不是加深阴影。
items.pe: Separate dark layers by lightening the surface, not darkening the shadow.

definition.zh: 暗底下阴影几乎没用
definition.en: Shadows barely work on dark

distinction.zh: 暗色里用更亮的背景色分层，而不是加深阴影。
distinction.en: Separate dark layers by lightening the surface, not darkening the shadow.

items.dz: 照片卡在取起、悬浮、放回三个状态间循环，阴影随距离变化，而照片内容持续保持可辨认。
items.de: The photo card cycles through rest, lift, and settle while its changing shadow communicates distance.
items.pz: 缩放、轻微旋转和阴影必须在同一关键帧序列对齐。减少动态时停在静态内容，不能留下透明空卡。
items.pe: Align scale, rotation, and shadow in one keyframe sequence. Reduced motion should keep a visible resting card.

definition.zh: 照片卡在取起、悬浮、放回三个状态间循环，阴影随距离变化，而照片内容持续保持可辨认。
definition.en: The photo card cycles through rest, lift, and settle while its changing shadow communicates distance.

distinction.zh: 缩放、轻微旋转和阴影必须在同一关键帧序列对齐。减少动态时停在静态内容，不能留下透明空卡。
distinction.en: Align scale, rotation, and shadow in one keyframe sequence. Reduced motion should keep a visible resting card.

items.dz: 全站阴影同一个方向
items.de: One direction, everywhere
items.pz: 光从上方偏左，所有阴影就该往右下。
items.pe: Light from upper-left means every shadow falls lower-right.

definition.zh: 全站阴影同一个方向
definition.en: One direction, everywhere

distinction.zh: 光从上方偏左，所有阴影就该往右下。
distinction.en: Light from upper-left means every shadow falls lower-right.

items.dz: 大元素要更大的影
items.de: Bigger things cast bigger shadows
items.pz: 阴影半径大致等于元素高度的 15–25%。
items.pe: Blur ≈ 15–25% of the element height.

definition.zh: 大元素要更大的影
definition.en: Bigger things cast bigger shadows

distinction.zh: 阴影半径大致等于元素高度的 15–25%。
distinction.en: Blur ≈ 15–25% of the element height.

items.dz: 有时候一条线就够了
items.de: Sometimes a hairline is enough
items.pz: 信息密集界面用 1px 线分层，比阴影干净得多。
items.pe: In dense UI, hairlines separate better than shadows.

definition.zh: 有时候一条线就够了
definition.en: Sometimes a hairline is enough

distinction.zh: 信息密集界面用 1px 线分层，比阴影干净得多。
distinction.en: In dense UI, hairlines separate better than shadows.

items.dz: 几圈环表达强调
items.de: Rings to emphasise
items.pz: 多个 spread 递增的 box-shadow，透明度递减。
items.pe: Several shadows with growing spread and falling alpha.

definition.zh: 几圈环表达强调
definition.en: Rings to emphasise

distinction.zh: 多个 spread 递增的 box-shadow，透明度递减。
distinction.en: Several shadows with growing spread and falling alpha.

items.dz: 一圈圈扩散出去
items.de: Rings pushing outward
items.pz: spread 从 0 到大、opacity 到 0，循环 1.6s。
items.pe: Spread grows while alpha falls, on a 1.6s loop.

definition.zh: 一圈圈扩散出去
definition.en: Rings pushing outward

distinction.zh: spread 从 0 到大、opacity 到 0，循环 1.6s。
distinction.en: Spread grows while alpha falls, on a 1.6s loop.

items.dz: 像挖进页面的一块
items.de: A well carved into the page
items.pz: 浅灰底 + 上边缘内阴影，表示“输入区”。
items.pe: Grey fill plus a top inset shadow reads as an input well.

definition.zh: 像挖进页面的一块
definition.en: A well carved into the page

distinction.zh: 浅灰底 + 上边缘内阴影，表示“输入区”。
distinction.en: Grey fill plus a top inset shadow reads as an input well.

items.dz: 两道实心阴影模拟照片卡后面的纸张堆叠，不额外复制正文，也不会造成多份可读内容。
items.de: Two solid shadows suggest stacked paper behind a photo card without duplicating readable content.
items.pz: 用正 Y 偏移和负扩散半径产生逐层缩小的薄片。它只暗示数量，不能用于表示真实可翻阅的卡片堆。
items.pe: Positive Y offsets and negative spread make the thin layers progressively smaller. They imply a stack, not an actual set of browsable cards.

definition.zh: 两道实心阴影模拟照片卡后面的纸张堆叠，不额外复制正文，也不会造成多份可读内容。
definition.en: Two solid shadows suggest stacked paper behind a photo card without duplicating readable content.

distinction.zh: 用正 Y 偏移和负扩散半径产生逐层缩小的薄片。它只暗示数量，不能用于表示真实可翻阅的卡片堆。
distinction.en: Positive Y offsets and negative spread make the thin layers progressively smaller. They imply a stack, not an actual set of browsable cards.

items.dz: 两侧影子不同颜色
items.de: Two shadows, two colours
items.pz: 两个反向偏移的彩色阴影，是海报语言。
items.pe: Opposed coloured shadows — poster language, not product UI.

definition.zh: 两侧影子不同颜色
definition.en: Two shadows, two colours

distinction.zh: 两个反向偏移的彩色阴影，是海报语言。
distinction.en: Opposed coloured shadows — poster language, not product UI.

items.dz: 光源在鼠标那边
items.de: The light sits where the pointer is
items.pz: 把指针方向取反，写进阴影偏移变量。
items.pe: Invert the pointer vector into the shadow offset.

definition.zh: 光源在鼠标那边
definition.en: The light sits where the pointer is

distinction.zh: 把指针方向取反，写进阴影偏移变量。
distinction.en: Invert the pointer vector into the shadow offset.

items.dz: 一条 1px 的白线
items.de: A single 1px white line
items.pz: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6) 是拟物的灵魂。
items.pe: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6) is the whole trick.

definition.zh: 一条 1px 的白线
definition.en: A single 1px white line

distinction.zh: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6) 是拟物的灵魂。
distinction.en: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6) is the whole trick.

items.dz: 悬停时只让预先画好的柔影逐渐出现，照片与标题保持静止，便于观察阴影透明度的作用。
items.de: Fade in a prepainted shadow on hover while keeping the photograph and title still.
items.pz: 阴影放在独立伪元素上，动画改变 opacity。伪元素要 pointer-events:none，否则可能挡住卡片内的真实控件。
items.pe: Put the shadow on a pseudo-element and animate opacity. Use pointer-events:none so it cannot cover actual card controls.

definition.zh: 悬停时只让预先画好的柔影逐渐出现，照片与标题保持静止，便于观察阴影透明度的作用。
definition.en: Fade in a prepainted shadow on hover while keeping the photograph and title still.

distinction.zh: 阴影放在独立伪元素上，动画改变 opacity。伪元素要 pointer-events:none，否则可能挡住卡片内的真实控件。
distinction.en: Put the shadow on a pseudo-element and animate opacity. Use pointer-events:none so it cannot cover actual card controls.

items.dz: 每一层有固定用途
items.de: Every layer has one job
items.pz: 把 z-index 定成命名常量：内容 0、浮层 100、模态 1000。
items.pe: Name your z-index tiers: content 0, popover 100, modal 1000.

definition.zh: 每一层有固定用途
definition.en: Every layer has one job

distinction.zh: 把 z-index 定成命名常量：内容 0、浮层 100、模态 1000。
distinction.en: Name your z-index tiers: content 0, popover 100, modal 1000.

items.dz: 深色照片卡周围透出一圈扩散色光，强调选中或活动状态；卡内文字需要保持足够对比。
items.de: A colored halo around a dark photo card can mark an active state while its caption stays legible.
items.pz: 模糊伪元素位于卡片后方，外容器不能把光晕裁掉。光晕属于强调光，不应当作自然投影或唯一选中提示。
items.pe: Keep the blurred layer behind the card and allow its halo outside the container. It is an accent glow, not a natural shadow or a sole selection cue.

definition.zh: 深色照片卡周围透出一圈扩散色光，强调选中或活动状态；卡内文字需要保持足够对比。
definition.en: A colored halo around a dark photo card can mark an active state while its caption stays legible.

distinction.zh: 模糊伪元素位于卡片后方，外容器不能把光晕裁掉。光晕属于强调光，不应当作自然投影或唯一选中提示。
distinction.en: Keep the blurred layer behind the card and allow its halo outside the container. It is an accent glow, not a natural shadow or a sole selection cue.

items.dz: 阴影主要落在卡片右下角，帮助比较有方向的光照与居中的柔影。
items.de: A shadow concentrated below the right corner makes directional lighting easier to compare with centered elevation.
items.pz: X/Y 偏移确定光源反方向，负扩散半径收窄投影。整组卡片应共享方向，避免每张卡有不同的“太阳”。
items.pe: Offsets define the direction and negative spread narrows the shadow. Use one direction across a group of cards.

definition.zh: 阴影主要落在卡片右下角，帮助比较有方向的光照与居中的柔影。
definition.en: A shadow concentrated below the right corner makes directional lighting easier to compare with centered elevation.

distinction.zh: X/Y 偏移确定光源反方向，负扩散半径收窄投影。整组卡片应共享方向，避免每张卡有不同的“太阳”。
distinction.en: Offsets define the direction and negative spread narrows the shadow. Use one direction across a group of cards.

items.dz: 父层裁切会吃掉阴影
items.de: A clipping parent eats the shadow
items.pz: overflow:hidden 的父层里，阴影只能画在内部。
items.pe: Inside overflow:hidden, shadows can only live within bounds.

definition.zh: 父层裁切会吃掉阴影
definition.en: A clipping parent eats the shadow

distinction.zh: overflow:hidden 的父层里，阴影只能画在内部。
distinction.en: Inside overflow:hidden, shadows can only live within bounds.

items.dz: 一条极淡的影代替线
items.de: A faint shadow instead of a rule
items.pz: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06) 比 border 更柔和，不占 1px 布局。
items.pe: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06) is softer than a border and costs no layout.

definition.zh: 一条极淡的影代替线
definition.en: A faint shadow instead of a rule

distinction.zh: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06) 比 border 更柔和，不占 1px 布局。
distinction.en: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06) is softer than a border and costs no layout.

items.dz: 鼠标周围一圈微光
items.de: A faint halo around the pointer
items.pz: 径向渐变跟随指针，透明度 8–14%，尺寸 200px 左右。
items.pe: A radial gradient at 8–14% alpha, roughly 200px.

definition.zh: 鼠标周围一圈微光
definition.en: A faint halo around the pointer

distinction.zh: 径向渐变跟随指针，透明度 8–14%，尺寸 200px 左右。
distinction.en: A radial gradient at 8–14% alpha, roughly 200px.

items.dz: 当前项浮起来一点
items.de: The active row floats a touch
items.pz: 选中项给一级阴影 + 白底，其余保持平。
items.pe: One shadow step and a white fill on the active row only.

definition.zh: 当前项浮起来一点
definition.en: The active row floats a touch

distinction.zh: 选中项给一级阴影 + 白底，其余保持平。
distinction.en: One shadow step and a white fill on the active row only.

items.dz: 带照片的通知卡从下方进入，较宽阴影让它与背景内容分层；通知内容在停留时仍要读得清。
items.de: A photo notification enters from below with a broad shadow separating it from the background.
items.pz: 这里只展示通知的视觉入场，生产实现还需停留时长、关闭入口和读屏播报策略。动画不要替代状态文案。
items.pe: This shows visual entry only. Production notifications still need timing, dismissal, and an announcement strategy.

definition.zh: 带照片的通知卡从下方进入，较宽阴影让它与背景内容分层；通知内容在停留时仍要读得清。
definition.en: A photo notification enters from below with a broad shadow separating it from the background.

distinction.zh: 这里只展示通知的视觉入场，生产实现还需停留时长、关闭入口和读屏播报策略。动画不要替代状态文案。
distinction.en: This shows visual entry only. Production notifications still need timing, dismissal, and an announcement strategy.

items.dz: 快速移动时影子被拉长
items.de: The shadow smears when it moves fast
items.pz: 按速度把阴影沿运动方向拉长，停下即恢复。
items.pe: Stretch the shadow along the velocity vector; reset at rest.

definition.zh: 快速移动时影子被拉长
definition.en: The shadow smears when it moves fast

distinction.zh: 按速度把阴影沿运动方向拉长，停下即恢复。
distinction.en: Stretch the shadow along the velocity vector; reset at rest.

dz: 把平面推进空间：翻转、深度、视差
de: Pushing flat things into space — flips, depth, parallax

items.dz: 沿竖轴翻过去
items.de: Flips around the vertical axis
items.pz: 父层 perspective + 元素 rotateY，记得 backface-visibility。
items.pe: perspective on the parent, rotateY on the child, plus backface-visibility.

definition.zh: 沿竖轴翻过去
definition.en: Flips around the vertical axis

distinction.zh: 父层 perspective + 元素 rotateY，记得 backface-visibility。
distinction.en: perspective on the parent, rotateY on the child, plus backface-visibility.

items.dz: 沿横轴翻过去
items.de: Flips around the horizontal axis
items.pz: rotateX，配合略短的时长避免晕。
items.pe: rotateX with a slightly shorter duration so it does not feel queasy.

definition.zh: 沿横轴翻过去
definition.en: Flips around the horizontal axis

distinction.zh: rotateX，配合略短的时长避免晕。
distinction.en: rotateX with a slightly shorter duration so it does not feel queasy.

items.dz: 正反两面来回翻
items.de: Front and back trade places
items.pz: 两层绝对定位，一层 rotateY(180deg)，父层翻转。
items.pe: Two stacked faces, the back pre-rotated 180°, the parent flips.

definition.zh: 正反两面来回翻
definition.en: Front and back trade places

distinction.zh: 两层绝对定位，一层 rotateY(180deg)，父层翻转。
distinction.en: Two stacked faces, the back pre-rotated 180°, the parent flips.

items.dz: 真正的六面体在转
items.de: A real six-sided box turning
items.pz: 六个面用 translateZ + rotate 摆位，父层 preserve-3d。
items.pe: Six faces placed with rotate + translateZ inside a preserve-3d parent.

definition.zh: 真正的六面体在转
definition.en: A real six-sided box turning

distinction.zh: 六个面用 translateZ + rotate 摆位，父层 preserve-3d。
distinction.en: Six faces placed with rotate + translateZ inside a preserve-3d parent.

items.dz: 卡片跟着鼠标歪一点
items.de: The card leans toward the pointer
items.pz: 把鼠标相对中心的偏移映射到 rotateX/rotateY，幅度别超过 12°。
items.pe: Map pointer offset from centre onto rotateX/rotateY, capped around 12°.

definition.zh: 卡片跟着鼠标歪一点
definition.en: The card leans toward the pointer

distinction.zh: 把鼠标相对中心的偏移映射到 rotateX/rotateY，幅度别超过 12°。
distinction.en: Map pointer offset from centre onto rotateX/rotateY, capped around 12°.

items.dz: 几层卡片在 Z 轴上排开
items.de: Cards spread out along the Z axis
items.pz: 每层 translateZ 递增，加轻微缩放模拟距离。
items.pe: Increase translateZ per layer and scale slightly for distance.

definition.zh: 几层卡片在 Z 轴上排开
definition.en: Cards spread out along the Z axis

distinction.zh: 每层 translateZ 递增，加轻微缩放模拟距离。
distinction.en: Increase translateZ per layer and scale slightly for distance.

items.dz: 从远处推到眼前
items.de: Pushed from far away up to the glass
items.pz: 动画 translateZ 而不是 scale，透视会自然产生形变。
items.pe: Animate translateZ rather than scale — perspective does the rest.

definition.zh: 从远处推到眼前
definition.en: Pushed from far away up to the glass

distinction.zh: 动画 translateZ 而不是 scale，透视会自然产生形变。
distinction.en: Animate translateZ rather than scale — perspective does the rest.

items.dz: 以一条边为轴推开
items.de: Swings open on one edge
items.pz: transform-origin 设到左边，rotateY 负角度。
items.pe: Put transform-origin on the left edge and rotateY negatively.

definition.zh: 以一条边为轴推开
definition.en: Swings open on one edge

distinction.zh: transform-origin 设到左边，rotateY 负角度。
distinction.en: Put transform-origin on the left edge and rotateY negatively.

items.dz: 像书页一样掀过去
items.de: A page turning in a book
items.pz: 页面右缘为轴，翻转过半时切换正反面内容。
items.pe: Hinge on the right edge; swap face content past the halfway point.

definition.zh: 像书页一样掀过去
definition.en: A page turning in a book

distinction.zh: 页面右缘为轴，翻转过半时切换正反面内容。
distinction.en: Hinge on the right edge; swap face content past the halfway point.

items.dz: 中间正对，两侧向内斜
items.de: Centre faces you, the sides angle inward
items.pz: 按与中心的距离给 rotateY 和 translateZ 插值。
items.pe: Interpolate rotateY and translateZ by distance from centre.

definition.zh: 中间正对，两侧向内斜
definition.en: Centre faces you, the sides angle inward

distinction.zh: 按与中心的距离给 rotateY 和 translateZ 插值。
distinction.en: Interpolate rotateY and translateZ by distance from centre.

items.dz: 薄片高速自转
items.de: A thin disc spinning fast
items.pz: rotateY 无限旋转 + 用 scaleX 模拟厚度错觉。
items.pe: Endless rotateY, with scaleX cheating the thickness.

definition.zh: 薄片高速自转
definition.en: A thin disc spinning fast

distinction.zh: rotateY 无限旋转 + 用 scaleX 模拟厚度错觉。
distinction.en: Endless rotateY, with scaleX cheating the thickness.

items.dz: 翻几次停在一面
items.de: Tumbles, then settles on one face
items.pz: 把 rotate 值取 90° 的整数倍，落点才是正面。
items.pe: Keep rotations to multiples of 90° so it lands square.

definition.zh: 翻几次停在一面
definition.en: Tumbles, then settles on one face

distinction.zh: 把 rotate 值取 90° 的整数倍，落点才是正面。
distinction.en: Keep rotations to multiples of 90° so it lands square.

items.dz: 小球绕着主体转一圈
items.de: A satellite circles the body
items.pz: 父层 rotateY，子元素 translateZ 撑出半径。
items.pe: Rotate the parent on Y; push the child out with translateZ.
aliases: 父层 rotateY / 子层 translateZ(半径)

definition.zh: 小球绕着主体转一圈
definition.en: A satellite circles the body

distinction.zh: 父层 rotateY，子元素 translateZ 撑出半径。
distinction.en: Rotate the parent on Y; push the child out with translateZ.

items.dz: 元素沿螺旋线排开
items.de: Items strung along a helix
items.pz: 第 i 个元素 rotateY(i×角) translateZ(半径) translateY(i×步长)。
items.pe: Item i gets rotateY(i·angle) translateZ(r) translateY(i·step).

definition.zh: 元素沿螺旋线排开
definition.en: Items strung along a helix

distinction.zh: 第 i 个元素 rotateY(i×角) translateZ(半径) translateY(i×步长)。
distinction.en: Item i gets rotateY(i·angle) translateZ(r) translateY(i·step).

items.dz: 一层层从深处冲过来
items.de: Rings rush at you from the depth
items.pz: 多层同心矩形，translateZ 从远到近循环。
items.pe: Concentric frames looping translateZ from far to near.

definition.zh: 一层层从深处冲过来
definition.en: Rings rush at you from the depth

distinction.zh: 多层同心矩形，translateZ 从远到近循环。
distinction.en: Concentric frames looping translateZ from far to near.

items.dz: 缓慢无规律地浮动
items.de: Drifts slowly, never quite repeating
items.pz: 两三个不同周期的 rotate/translate 叠加，周期互质。
items.pe: Layer two or three rotations with co-prime durations.

definition.zh: 缓慢无规律地浮动
definition.en: Drifts slowly, never quite repeating

distinction.zh: 两三个不同周期的 rotate/translate 叠加，周期互质。
distinction.en: Layer two or three rotations with co-prime durations.

items.dz: 像折纸一样一片片打开
items.de: Panels unfold like paper
items.pz: 相邻面 transform-origin 交替、角度取反。
items.pe: Alternate transform-origin and flip the sign per panel.

definition.zh: 像折纸一样一片片打开
definition.en: Panels unfold like paper

distinction.zh: 相邻面 transform-origin 交替、角度取反。
distinction.en: Alternate transform-origin and flip the sign per panel.

items.dz: 中缝一折，收起来
items.de: Creases down the middle and closes
items.pz: 上下两半分别 rotateX，共用中线做轴。
items.pe: Two halves rotateX around the shared centre line.

definition.zh: 中缝一折，收起来
definition.en: Creases down the middle and closes

distinction.zh: 上下两半分别 rotateX，共用中线做轴。
distinction.en: Two halves rotateX around the shared centre line.

items.dz: 吊在一角轻轻晃
items.de: Hangs from a corner and sways
items.pz: transform-origin 放角上，rotate 小角度阻尼摆。
items.pe: Origin at a corner, small damped rotation.

definition.zh: 吊在一角轻轻晃
definition.en: Hangs from a corner and sways

distinction.zh: transform-origin 放角上，rotate 小角度阻尼摆。
distinction.en: Origin at a corner, small damped rotation.

items.dz: 布面一波一波起伏
items.de: Cloth rippling in waves
items.pz: 把面切成竖条，每条 rotateY 错峰摆动。
items.pe: Slice into vertical strips and phase-shift each rotateY.

definition.zh: 布面一波一波起伏
definition.en: Cloth rippling in waves

distinction.zh: 把面切成竖条，每条 rotateY 错峰摆动。
distinction.en: Slice into vertical strips and phase-shift each rotateY.

items.dz: 网格像水面起伏
items.de: The grid undulates like water
items.pz: translateZ 按 sin(行+列) 错峰，父层大 perspective。
items.pe: translateZ phased by sin(row+col) under a wide perspective.
aliases: animation-delay 按 sin(行列) 错峰

definition.zh: 网格像水面起伏
definition.en: The grid undulates like water

distinction.zh: translateZ 按 sin(行+列) 错峰，父层大 perspective。

distinction.zh: 两层同形状分别染红青、反向偏移几像素。

items.dz: 换个透视原点，空间就歪了

items.dz: 转过去就看不见了

distinction.zh: backface-visibility:hidden 是翻牌不漏内容的关键。

items.dz: 一次写完所有变换

definition.zh: 一次写完所有变换

distinction.zh: matrix3d 适合从设计工具导出的精确变换，可读性差。

items.dz: 远处的层是虚的
