definition.en: Stops so you can read it

distinction.zh: animation-play-state:paused，比重设动画平滑。
distinction.en: animation-play-state:paused — smoother than restarting.

items.dz: 进出都柔和
items.de: Soft at both ends
items.pz: mask 渐变而不是覆盖白块，任何底色都适用。
items.pe: A gradient mask adapts to any ground; white overlays do not.

definition.zh: 进出都柔和
definition.en: Soft at both ends

distinction.zh: mask 渐变而不是覆盖白块，任何底色都适用。
distinction.en: A gradient mask adapts to any ground; white overlays do not.

items.dz: 一排客户标识滚过
items.de: A row of client marks
items.pz: logo 统一高度而不是宽度，去色后再统一透明度。
items.pe: Normalise height, then desaturate to one alpha.

definition.zh: 一排客户标识滚过
definition.en: A row of client marks

distinction.zh: logo 统一高度而不是宽度，去色后再统一透明度。
distinction.en: Normalise height, then desaturate to one alpha.

items.dz: 像股票行情条
items.de: A stock-ticker bar
items.pz: 涨跌用符号 + 颜色双编码，数字等宽。
items.pe: Sign plus colour, tabular figures.

definition.zh: 像股票行情条
definition.en: A stock-ticker bar

distinction.zh: 涨跌用符号 + 颜色双编码，数字等宽。
distinction.en: Sign plus colour, tabular figures.

items.dz: 一列内容往上走
items.de: A column travelling up
items.pz: 纵向循环同理：复制两份、translateY(-50%)。
items.pe: Same trick vertically: duplicate and translateY −50%.

definition.zh: 一列内容往上走
definition.en: A column travelling up

distinction.zh: 纵向循环同理：复制两份、translateY(-50%)。
distinction.en: Same trick vertically: duplicate and translateY −50%.

items.dz: 三排不同速度
items.de: Three rows, three speeds
items.pz: 速度比 1 : 1.3 : 0.8，视觉最丰富。
items.pe: A 1 : 1.3 : 0.8 speed ratio reads richest.

definition.zh: 三排不同速度
definition.en: Three rows, three speeds

distinction.zh: 速度比 1 : 1.3 : 0.8，视觉最丰富。
distinction.en: A 1 : 1.3 : 0.8 speed ratio reads richest.

items.dz: 整条带子斜着穿过
items.de: The band crosses on a slant
items.pz: 容器 rotate(-4deg) 并超出边界，避免露出端头。
items.pe: Rotate the band −4° and overflow the bounds.

definition.zh: 整条带子斜着穿过
definition.en: The band crosses on a slant

distinction.zh: 容器 rotate(-4deg) 并超出边界，避免露出端头。
distinction.en: Rotate the band −4° and overflow the bounds.

items.dz: 两条斜带交叉
items.de: Two slanted bands cross
items.pz: 两条角度相反，交点处用混合模式更有层次。
items.pe: Opposite angles; blend where they cross.

definition.zh: 两条斜带交叉
definition.en: Two slanted bands cross

distinction.zh: 两条角度相反，交点处用混合模式更有层次。
distinction.en: Opposite angles; blend where they cross.

items.dz: 一排图片无缝滚过
items.de: A seamless row of images
items.pz: 每张统一比例，间距 8–12px，别加圆角阴影。
items.pe: One ratio, 8–12px gutters, no per-tile shadow.

definition.zh: 一排图片无缝滚过
definition.en: A seamless row of images

distinction.zh: 每张统一比例，间距 8–12px，别加圆角阴影。
distinction.en: One ratio, 8–12px gutters, no per-tile shadow.

items.dz: 一排评价卡缓慢走过
items.de: A slow row of quote cards
items.pz: 速度要慢到能读完一句（40s 以上）。
items.pe: Slow enough to read a sentence — 40s or more.

definition.zh: 一排评价卡缓慢走过
definition.en: A slow row of quote cards

distinction.zh: 速度要慢到能读完一句（40s 以上）。
distinction.en: Slow enough to read a sentence — 40s or more.

items.dz: 滑动后停在整格
items.de: It settles on whole cards
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory，滚动条隐藏但保留键盘。
items.pe: x mandatory snapping; hide the bar, keep keyboard access.

definition.zh: 滑动后停在整格
definition.en: It settles on whole cards

distinction.zh: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory，滚动条隐藏但保留键盘。
distinction.en: x mandatory snapping; hide the bar, keep keyboard access.

items.dz: 边缘故意露一点
items.de: A sliver of the next card shows
items.pz: 露出 16–28px 提示可滑，比小圆点更有效。
items.pe: A 16–28px peek beats dot indicators.

definition.zh: 边缘故意露一点
definition.en: A sliver of the next card shows

distinction.zh: 露出 16–28px 提示可滑，比小圆点更有效。
distinction.en: A 16–28px peek beats dot indicators.

items.dz: 当前那颗变长
items.de: The active dot stretches
items.pz: 当前项用宽度变化而不是换色，识别更快。
items.pe: Widen the active dot rather than recolouring it.

definition.zh: 当前那颗变长
definition.en: The active dot stretches

distinction.zh: 当前项用宽度变化而不是换色，识别更快。
distinction.en: Widen the active dot rather than recolouring it.

items.dz: 每 5 秒换一张
items.de: A new card every five seconds
items.pz: 必须可暂停，且悬停/聚焦时自动停。
items.pe: Must be pausable, and pause on hover or focus.

definition.zh: 每 5 秒换一张
definition.en: A new card every five seconds

distinction.zh: 必须可暂停，且悬停/聚焦时自动停。
distinction.en: Must be pausable, and pause on hover or focus.

items.dz: 一条线走完就换
items.de: The line runs out and it advances
items.pz: 计时条要和真实切换同步，悬停一起暂停。
items.pe: Keep the bar and the advance in sync — pause together.

definition.zh: 一条线走完就换
definition.en: The line runs out and it advances

distinction.zh: 计时条要和真实切换同步，悬停一起暂停。
distinction.en: Keep the bar and the advance in sync — pause together.

items.dz: 一条大字循环带
items.de: A big-type loop
items.pz: 字号越大速度要越慢，感知速度与字号成正比。
items.pe: Bigger type needs slower speed — perception scales with size.

definition.zh: 一条大字循环带
definition.en: A big-type loop

distinction.zh: 字号越大速度要越慢，感知速度与字号成正比。
distinction.en: Bigger type needs slower speed — perception scales with size.

items.dz: 句子里一个词在换
items.de: One word keeps changing
items.pz: 换词时容器宽度过渡，否则整句会跳。
items.pe: Transition the container width or the sentence jumps.

definition.zh: 句子里一个词在换
definition.en: One word keeps changing

distinction.zh: 换词时容器宽度过渡，否则整句会跳。
distinction.en: Transition the container width or the sentence jumps.

items.dz: 整片网格缓慢平移
items.de: The whole grid drifts
items.pz: 平移一个完整格距后瞬移回零，视觉无缝。
items.pe: Translate exactly one cell, then snap back.

definition.zh: 整片网格缓慢平移
definition.en: The whole grid drifts

distinction.zh: 平移一个完整格距后瞬移回零，视觉无缝。
distinction.en: Translate exactly one cell, then snap back.

items.dz: 物件被送过去
items.de: Objects ride along
items.pz: 带纹与物件同速，否则会有“滑动”错觉。
items.pe: Match the belt texture speed to the objects.

definition.zh: 物件被送过去
definition.en: Objects ride along

distinction.zh: 带纹与物件同速，否则会有“滑动”错觉。
distinction.en: Match the belt texture speed to the objects.

items.dz: 两端的翻页按钮
items.de: Page buttons at both ends
items.pz: 到头就禁用箭头，别让它无反应地存在。
items.pe: Disable the arrow at the end — do not leave it dead.

definition.zh: 两端的翻页按钮
definition.en: Page buttons at both ends

distinction.zh: 到头就禁用箭头，别让它无反应地存在。
distinction.en: Disable the arrow at the end — do not leave it dead.

items.dz: 按住直接拖
items.de: Grab and drag it
items.pz: 鼠标拖动 + 惯性，光标要用 grab / grabbing。
items.pe: Pointer drag with inertia and grab cursors.

definition.zh: 按住直接拖
definition.en: Grab and drag it

distinction.zh: 鼠标拖动 + 惯性，光标要用 grab / grabbing。
distinction.en: Pointer drag with inertia and grab cursors.

items.dz: 滚一段后停住
items.de: It rolls, then stops
items.pz: 停下时保留一点减速，别硬切。
items.pe: Ease into the stop — never cut it.

definition.zh: 滚一段后停住
definition.en: It rolls, then stops

distinction.zh: 停下时保留一点减速，别硬切。
distinction.en: Ease into the stop — never cut it.

items.dz: 顶部一条持续滚动
items.de: A running line at the top
items.pz: 公告条必须可关闭，且关闭状态要记住。
items.pe: Dismissible — and remember the dismissal.

definition.zh: 顶部一条持续滚动
definition.en: A running line at the top

distinction.zh: 公告条必须可关闭，且关闭状态要记住。
distinction.en: Dismissible — and remember the dismissal.

items.dz: 页面滚得快，带子也快
items.de: Scroll faster, the band runs faster
items.pz: 把滚动速度映射到 playbackRate，上限要 clamp。
items.pe: Map scroll velocity onto playbackRate — clamp the top end.

definition.zh: 页面滚得快，带子也快
definition.en: Scroll faster, the band runs faster

distinction.zh: 把滚动速度映射到 playbackRate，上限要 clamp。
distinction.en: Map scroll velocity onto playbackRate — clamp the top end.

items.dz: 远近三层各自速度
items.de: Three depths, three speeds
items.pz: 越远越慢越淡，才有空间感。
items.pe: Farther means slower and paler.

definition.zh: 远近三层各自速度
definition.en: Three depths, three speeds

distinction.zh: 越远越慢越淡，才有空间感。
distinction.en: Farther means slower and paler.

dz: 数字要看得清、跳得稳、涨得有说服力
de: Numbers should read clean, tick steady, and land convincingly

items.dz: 数字跳动时位置不抖
items.de: Digits stop jittering as they change
items.pz: font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums，所有会变的数字都该开。
items.pe: font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums on anything that changes.

items.dz: 从 0 涨到目标值
items.de: Climbs from zero to the target
items.pz: 用 ease-out 收尾，最后 20% 放慢，别线性。
items.pe: Ease out the last 20% — never linear.

definition.zh: 从 0 涨到目标值
definition.en: Climbs from zero to the target

distinction.zh: 用 ease-out 收尾，最后 20% 放慢，别线性。
distinction.en: Ease out the last 20% — never linear.

items.dz: 每一位像滚筒一样翻
items.de: Each digit rolls like a drum
items.pz: 每位一个竖列 0–9，translateY 到目标位。
items.pe: One 0–9 column per digit, translateY to the target.

definition.zh: 每一位像滚筒一样翻
definition.en: Each digit rolls like a drum

distinction.zh: 每位一个竖列 0–9，translateY 到目标位。
distinction.en: One 0–9 column per digit, translateY to the target.

items.dz: 像机械翻牌钟
items.de: A split-flap clock
items.pz: 上下两半分别翻转，中缝要有一条暗线。
items.pe: Two halves flipping with a dark seam between.

definition.zh: 像机械翻牌钟
definition.en: A split-flap clock

distinction.zh: 上下两半分别翻转，中缝要有一条暗线。
distinction.en: Two halves flipping with a dark seam between.

items.dz: 旧数字上移、新数字进来
items.de: The old digit leaves upward
items.pz: 容器 overflow:hidden，两个数字上下排，整体 translateY。
items.pe: Clip the cell and translate a two-digit column.

definition.zh: 旧数字上移、新数字进来
definition.en: The old digit leaves upward

distinction.zh: 容器 overflow:hidden，两个数字上下排，整体 translateY。
distinction.en: Clip the cell and translate a two-digit column.

items.dz: 旁边一个小箭头和百分比
items.de: A small arrow and a percentage
items.pz: 涨跌用形状 + 颜色双编码，别只靠红绿。
items.pe: Encode direction with shape and colour, never colour alone.

definition.zh: 旁边一个小箭头和百分比
definition.en: A small arrow and a percentage

distinction.zh: 涨跌用形状 + 颜色双编码，别只靠红绿。
distinction.en: Encode direction with shape and colour, never colour alone.

items.dz: 变了就闪一下
items.de: It flashes when it changes
items.pz: 背景色闪 300ms 后淡出，不要移动数字。
items.pe: Flash the background for 300ms — never move the number.

definition.zh: 变了就闪一下
definition.en: It flashes when it changes

distinction.zh: 背景色闪 300ms 后淡出，不要移动数字。
distinction.en: Flash the background for 300ms — never move the number.

items.dz: 数字大、说明小
items.de: A huge figure, a small label
items.pz: 数字用 tabular + 负字距，说明用小号大写。
items.pe: Tabular figures with tight tracking; the label small and uppercase.

definition.zh: 数字大、说明小
definition.en: A huge figure, a small label

distinction.zh: 数字用 tabular + 负字距，说明用小号大写。
distinction.en: Tabular figures with tight tracking; the label small and uppercase.

items.dz: 单位小一号并对齐基线
items.de: The unit sits smaller, on the baseline
items.pz: 单位用 0.4em 并 baseline 对齐，不要上标。
items.pe: Set the unit at 0.4em on the baseline — not superscript.

definition.zh: 单位小一号并对齐基线
definition.en: The unit sits smaller, on the baseline

distinction.zh: 单位用 0.4em 并 baseline 对齐，不要上标。
distinction.en: Set the unit at 0.4em on the baseline — not superscript.

items.de: 3,425 becomes 3.4k
items.pz: 仪表盘用缩写，明细页用完整数字。
items.pe: Abbreviate in dashboards, spell out in detail views.

definition.en: 3,425 becomes 3.4k

distinction.zh: 仪表盘用缩写，明细页用完整数字。
distinction.en: Abbreviate in dashboards, spell out in detail views.

items.dz: 符号、千分位、小数位
items.de: Symbol, separators, decimals
items.pz: 用 Intl.NumberFormat，别手写正则。
items.pe: Use Intl.NumberFormat — never hand-rolled regex.

definition.zh: 符号、千分位、小数位
definition.en: Symbol, separators, decimals

distinction.zh: 用 Intl.NumberFormat，别手写正则。
distinction.en: Use Intl.NumberFormat — never hand-rolled regex.

items.dz: 一条填充的轨道
items.de: A track filling up
items.pz: 进度只用 transform:scaleX，别动 width。
items.pe: Fill with transform:scaleX, not width.

definition.zh: 一条填充的轨道
definition.en: A track filling up

distinction.zh: 进度只用 transform:scaleX，别动 width。
distinction.en: Fill with transform:scaleX, not width.

items.dz: 不知道多久，先动着
items.de: No idea how long — keep moving
items.pz: 一小段在轨道上往复，不要伪造百分比。
items.pe: A short segment sweeping the track — never fake a percentage.

definition.zh: 不知道多久，先动着
definition.en: No idea how long — keep moving

distinction.zh: 一小段在轨道上往复，不要伪造百分比。
distinction.en: A short segment sweeping the track — never fake a percentage.

items.dz: 几段格子逐个亮起
items.de: Segments lighting one by one
items.pz: 分段进度更适合“共 5 步”这类有限流程。
items.pe: Segments suit finite flows: step 3 of 5.

definition.zh: 几段格子逐个亮起
definition.en: Segments lighting one by one

items.dz: 连续数值按相邻区间分箱；每个柱高表示该区间的频数。
items.de: Continuous values are grouped into adjacent intervals; each bar height encodes that interval’s frequency.
items.pz: 数据：56 个示例测量值；箱宽 10；柱间不留空隙。核对区间边界与各箱频数后再调整箱宽。
items.pe: Example: 56 measurements, bin width 10, with no gaps between bins. Check interval boundaries and counts before changing bin width.

definition.zh: 直方图把连续变量的取值范围划分为相邻区间，并用每个区间的柱表示其中的观测频数或频率。
definition.en: A histogram partitions a continuous variable’s range into adjacent intervals and uses each bin’s bar to encode the observations’ frequency or relative frequency.

distinction.zh: 直方图的横轴是数值区间，柱间通常不留空隙；柱状图横轴是离散类别，类别可独立排列。改变箱宽会改变直方图的形状。
distinction.en: A histogram’s x-axis contains numeric intervals and its bars normally touch; a bar chart uses discrete categories that can be reordered independently. Changing bin width changes a histogram’s shape.

items.dz: 用核平滑估计连续变量的分布形状；曲线峰值表示观测值较集中的区段。
items.de: Kernel smoothing estimates the shape of a continuous distribution; peaks mark regions where observations concentrate.
items.pz: 用图中列出的 12 个样本和 Gaussian kernel 计算 KDE；带宽 h=0.5。带宽越大，曲线越平滑；这张图与柱形分箱计数不同。
items.pe: Compute a KDE from the 12 listed samples with a Gaussian kernel and bandwidth h=0.5. Larger bandwidth smooths more; unlike a histogram, the curve is not a count of bins.

aliases.scope: Source-listed name for a kernel-smoothed density plot
Source-listed alternate name; not a trace-timeline visualization

definition.zh: 密度图用核平滑估计连续变量在各取值附近的概率密度，以曲线展示分布形状；曲线下面积归一化为 1。
definition.en: A density plot uses kernel smoothing to estimate probability density across a continuous variable and displays the distribution’s shape as a curve; the area under the curve is normalized to 1.

distinction.zh: 与直方图按箱计频不同，密度图通过核函数和带宽平滑估计；带宽会改变曲线的平滑程度。曲线高度表示密度，不是该点的样本数量。
distinction.en: Unlike a histogram’s binned counts, a density plot smooths an estimate using a kernel and bandwidth. Bandwidth changes smoothness; curve height is density, not a raw observation count.

relations.reason: Both summarize continuous distributions, but one counts observations in intervals and the other plots a kernel-smoothed density estimate.

items.dz: 把离散单位排列成矩阵，每个点等权，并用颜色编码类别以便比较数量或比例。
items.de: Discrete units are arranged in a matrix; each dot has equal weight, and color encodes categories for count or proportion comparison.
items.pz: 示例共 100 个单位，A/B/C 分别为 46/34/20；每点代表一个单位。按行从左到右读取，先看数量再比较比例。
items.pe: The example contains 100 units: A/B/C = 46/34/20; one dot equals one unit. Read left to right by row, then compare counts and proportions.

definition.zh: 点矩阵图把离散数据表示为按矩阵排列的点，并用颜色区分类别，以便比较类别数量或比例。
definition.en: A dot matrix chart represents discrete data as dots arranged in a matrix and uses color to distinguish categories for count or proportion comparison.

distinction.zh: 本示例每个点代表一个等权单位，点数可直接计数；它不是带连续数值轴的散点图，也不是以地理位置为点位的点阵地图。
distinction.en: Here each dot represents one equal-weight unit and can be counted directly; this is neither an axis-based scatter/dot plot nor a geographic dot map.

items.sourceLabel: Data Visualization Catalogue · Dot Matrix Chart

items.dz: 在估计值两侧绘制与定量轴平行的区间线和端帽；必须说明区间代表什么。
items.de: Draw a capped interval parallel to a quantitative axis around an estimate; label what the interval represents.
items.pz: 示例绘制三组估计值及 95% 置信区间：圆点是均值，横线与端帽是区间。标准差、标准误、置信区间和极值范围含义不同，不能互换标签。
items.pe: The example shows three estimates with 95% confidence intervals: dots are means; capped lines are intervals. Standard deviation, standard error, confidence intervals and min–max ranges mean different things and must not share labels.

definition.zh: 误差线是在定量坐标轴方向上从估计值或柱端点延伸的区间标记，通常带有端帽，用来表达所选统计区间的变化或不确定性。
definition.en: Error bars are capped interval marks extending from an estimate or bar endpoint along a quantitative axis to show variability or uncertainty for a specified statistic.

distinction.zh: 误差线是叠加在散点、柱状图或折线图上的标记，不是独立的图表类型。标准差、标准误、置信区间和极值范围含义不同，必须明确标注；时间或类别序列的连续区间带是另一种表示。
distinction.en: Error bars are marks overlaid on scatter, bar or line charts, not a standalone chart type. Standard deviation, standard error, confidence interval and min–max range differ and must be labeled; a continuous band over a series is another representation.

items.dz: 把节点放在一条线上，用弧线连接相关节点；可用弧线粗细表示节点对的共现频次。
items.de: Place nodes on one line and connect related pairs with arcs; arc thickness can encode pair frequency.
items.pz: 示例有五个节点与 12 次共现权重；节点不代表顺序流向，弧线无箭头。弧太多时容易交叠，不能呈现二维网络的空间结构。
items.pe: Five nodes are linked with 12 co-occurrence counts. Nodes are not a process sequence and arcs are undirected. Dense links can clutter and do not retain a 2D network layout.

definition.zh: 弧线图把网络节点排列在一条线上，并用弧线连接相关节点；线宽可表示节点对的频次。
definition.en: An arc diagram is a network layout that places nodes along one line and connects related pairs with arcs; line width may encode pair frequency.

distinction.zh: 它是网络图的一维排列变体，不表示流程方向，也不保留二维空间结构；连接过多时容易杂乱。
distinction.en: It is a one-dimensional layout variant of a network diagram, not a process flow, and it does not retain a 2D spatial layout; dense links can clutter.

relations.reason: The Arc Diagram source explicitly calls it an alternate way of representing a two-dimensional Network Diagram; the one-dimensional ordered layout specializes the node-link relation view.

items.dz: 用连接的标准图形表示过程步骤；矩形表示操作，菱形表示判断，连线或箭头说明流程方向。
items.de: Represent process steps with connected conventional symbols: rectangles for actions, diamonds for decisions, and lines or arrows for flow direction.
items.pz: 示例从开始进入“检查输入”，在“有效？”处分支；“是”进入通过，“否”补充材料后回到检查。流程图描述步骤与控制流，不表示分类数据的数量流。
items.pe: The example starts at “Check input,” branches at “Valid?,” accepts on Yes, and loops from “Add evidence” back to checking on No. This models process and control flow, not quantities moving between categories.

definition.zh: 流程图用相连的标准图形表示过程步骤；矩形表示操作，菱形表示判断，箭头或连线说明流程方向。
definition.en: A flow chart represents process steps with connected conventional symbols; rectangles indicate actions, diamonds decisions, and arrows or lines show direction.

distinction.zh: 它说明过程或控制流，不表示分类值之间按数量缩放的数据流；本例“否”分支返回补充材料后的复核步骤。
distinction.en: It explains a process or control flow, not a quantitatively sized flow between categories; the example loops its No branch back to review after evidence is added.

items.dz: 通过逐次添加的划记记录各类别频数，并在行或列旁显示总数。
items.de: Record category frequency with one tally mark per observation and show the total beside each group.
items.pz: 四类示例计数为 6、8、4、7，共 25；每满五个用一条斜线划过前四个。它保留离散计数记录；直方图则把连续量分箱并用相邻柱表示。
items.pe: Four example categories count 6, 8, 4 and 7, totaling 25; every fifth mark crosses the previous four. It records discrete tallies, while a histogram bins a continuous variable into adjacent bars.

definition.zh: 划记表用逐次添加的划记记录类别频数，并在相邻位置显示每组总数。
definition.en: A tally chart records categorical frequency with incrementally added tally marks and displays a total beside each group.

distinction.zh: 本例每五划一组，第五划斜穿前四划；它保留离散逐次计数。直方图将连续变量分入相邻区间并以柱高编码频数。
distinction.en: Marks are grouped by fives, with the fifth crossing the first four; the chart records discrete tallies. A histogram bins a continuous variable and encodes frequencies with adjacent bars.

items.dz: 以词语大小呈现其在文本或标签集合中的相对频次；排布形状可变化，颜色也可用于额外变量。
items.de: Use word size to show relative frequency in text or tag collections; placement can vary, and color may encode another variable.
items.pz: 示例列出七个设计关键词与提及次数；字体大小按频次增加，颜色只作装饰。词云适合快速浏览关键词，不适合精确比较；长词和字形高度会影响视觉注意。
items.pe: Seven design terms are shown with mention counts; type size rises with frequency while color is decorative. A cloud supports quick keyword scanning, not precise comparison; long words and glyph height can attract extra attention.

definition.zh: 词云用相对词语大小呈现文本或标签集合中的频次；词语可排列成簇或其他形状，颜色也可映射另一变量。
definition.en: A word cloud uses relative word size to show frequency in a text or tag collection; words may form a cluster or other shape, and color can map another variable.

distinction.zh: 它适合快速扫读关键词，不适合精确比较频次；长词与字形高度会吸引额外注意。本例颜色仅作装饰，没有映射第二变量。
distinction.en: It supports quick keyword scanning rather than precise frequency comparison; long words and glyph height can draw extra attention. Color in this example is decorative and maps no second variable.

items.dz: 用平行的分类维度与按类别比例分配宽度的流带，展示分类数据的流向与分布。
items.de: Show categorical flow and distribution with parallel dimensions and ribbons sized by category proportion.
items.pz: 示例以 100 个订单串联地区、设备与方案三维；每条流带宽度按订单数缩放，不使用箭头。
items.pe: The example links 100 orders across region, device and plan; each ribbon width scales with order count and uses no arrows.

definition.zh: 平行集图用一组平行的分类维度展示数据在各类别间的分布；每个类别分区和连接它的流带宽度按对应比例分配。
definition.en: Parallel sets show categorical dimensions in parallel; each category band and the ribbon connecting categories is sized according to its proportional share of the data.

distinction.zh: 它以分类维度与比例流带编码，而不是在平行数值轴上绘制单条记录。与桑基图相似，但本条采用维度分区，无箭头，流带宽度表示类别占比。
distinction.en: It encodes categorical dimensions and proportional ribbons rather than individual records across quantitative parallel axes. It resembles a Sankey diagram, but uses dimension sets without arrows and scales ribbons by category share.

items.dz: 把两组人口直方图背靠背排列，比较不同年龄组的人口数量。
items.de: Place two population histograms back to back to compare counts across age groups.
items.pz: 年龄组纵向排列，男性与女性分别向中线两侧绘制，左右共用人数刻度；较年长年龄组置顶。此示例值为示意，不代表实际人口统计。
items.pe: Stack age groups vertically with older groups at the top; draw male and female counts outward from a shared center using matching scales. Values are illustrative, not population statistics.

aliases.scope: Source-listed alternate name; the grouping can be another population split when labeled.

definition.zh: 人口金字塔把两个群体的人口直方图背靠背排列，按年龄组显示人数，左右共用同一水平数值尺度。
definition.en: A population pyramid places two population histograms back to back, showing counts by age group on a shared horizontal scale.

distinction.zh: 它是面向人口年龄结构的直方图具名变体：年龄组沿纵轴，人口数量沿横轴，两组从中线向外镜像展开。它不同于普通分组柱状图的并列柱。
distinction.en: It is a named histogram variant for population age structure: age groups run vertically and population counts extend outward from a shared center. This differs from side-by-side grouped bars.

relations.reason: The catalogue explicitly defines a population pyramid as paired back-to-back histograms; the demographic split and mirrored layout specialize that base chart.

items.dz: 按数值位值分组，把茎放在左列、排序后的叶向右展开，从而保留原始数据。
items.de: Group values by place value, placing stems at left and sorted leaves to the right to retain the original data.
items.pz: 示例数据 2、4、11、17、20、23：茎代表十位，叶代表个位；键 `1 | 7 = 17` 说明读法。避免与轴上点图或棒棒糖图混淆。
items.pe: Example values 2, 4, 11, 17, 20, 23: stems are tens and leaves are ones; key `1 | 7 = 17` explains the encoding. This is distinct from an axis-based dot plot or lollipop chart.

aliases.scope: Source-listed alternate name; not the shorter ambiguous “stem plot”.

definition.zh: 茎叶图按位值把数值分组：茎显示高位，叶按升序列出剩余低位，从图中仍可还原原始观测值。
definition.en: A stem-and-leaf plot groups values by place value: stems show the higher digits and sorted leaves list the remaining lower digits, preserving the original observations.

distinction.zh: 它不是轴上点图，也不是端点圆点连到基线的棒棒糖图。读取时必须提供键，例如 `1 | 7 = 17`。本条只采用来源列出的完整替代名，避免与现有 Dot plot 的短别名 `stem plot` 冲突。
distinction.en: It is neither an axis-based dot plot nor a lollipop chart with endpoint dots connected to a baseline. Include a key such as `1 | 7 = 17`. This entry uses only the source-listed full alternate names to avoid the existing Dot plot item’s ambiguous short alias `stem plot`.

items.sourceLabel: Data Visualization Catalogue · Stem & Leaf Plot

items.dz: 用相交的闭合区域表示集合，并呈现全部可能的交集关系。
items.de: Represent sets with overlapping closed regions and show all possible intersection relationships.
items.pz: U 矩形包含全集；三个相交圆表示 A、B、C 的七个内部成员区，h 位于 U 内但在三集合之外。字母是元素而非计数；图形面积不编码数量。
items.pe: The rectangle marks universe U; three overlapping circles show the seven interior regions of A, B and C, while h is inside U but outside all three sets. Letters are elements, not counts; areas do not encode quantities.

aliases.scope: Source-listed alternate name for a Venn-style all-intersections diagram; not every set-overlap graphic.

definition.zh: 维恩图用闭合区域表示集合，展示集合之间全部可能的交集关系；成员可标在相应区域中。
definition.en: A Venn diagram uses closed regions for sets and displays all possible intersections among them; members can be placed in their corresponding regions.

distinction.zh: 图中的区域表示成员资格组合，而不是默认按数量缩放的面积。即便某种成员组合为空，维恩图仍保留对应区域；本例字母是元素，不是计数。
distinction.en: Regions represent membership combinations, not automatically count-scaled areas. A Venn diagram retains the possible region even when its membership is empty; letters in this example are elements, not counts.

items.dz: 在地理位置上连接迁移或移动路线；线宽表示数量，箭头可标出方向。
items.de: Connect migration or movement routes across geographic positions; line width encodes volume and arrows can show direction.
items.pz: 四条示意路线 A→B、A→C、B→D、C→D 的数量分别为 8、6、4、2，总量 20。线宽按路线数量增加；地点布局是示意图，不代表真实经纬度。
items.pe: Four schematic routes A→B, A→C, B→D and C→D carry 8, 6, 4 and 2 trips (20 route totals). Line width rises with route volume; node positions are illustrative, not geographic coordinates.

definition.zh: 流向地图在地理位置之间绘制迁移或移动路线；路线线宽可表示数量，箭头可标出方向。
definition.en: A flow map draws migration or movement routes between geographic locations; route width can encode volume and arrows can show direction.

distinction.zh: 它以地理位置作为路线端点，呈现地点间的移动数量；shader flow map 是用于纹理或流场效果的方向贴图，不是地理图表。
distinction.en: It anchors routes to geographic locations and shows movement volume between places. A shader flow map is a direction texture for rendering flow fields, not a geographic chart.

items.dz: 用节点与连接线呈现实体之间的关系；布局可以显示群组、连接密度及跨群连接。
items.de: Use nodes and links to show relationships between entities; layout can reveal clusters, link density and bridges.
items.pz: 示例将 A/B/C 与 D/E/F 排成两个群组，七条无向连接中 C–D 是唯一跨组连接。位置只服务于结构阅读，不代表地图坐标或时间顺序。
items.pe: The example arranges A/B/C and D/E/F as two clusters; C–D is their only bridge among seven undirected links. Positions support topology reading and do not encode geography or sequence.

definition.zh: 网络图用节点表示实体、用连线表示实体之间的联系；节点大小或连线权重可继续编码变量。
definition.en: A network diagram uses nodes for entities and links for their relationships; node size or link weight can encode additional variables.

distinction.zh: 一般网络图可采用二维布局，表达群组、连接密度及方向；弧线图是节点沿一条线排列的具名变体，和弦图则把节点排在圆周上。
distinction.en: A general network diagram can use a 2D layout to show clusters, connectivity and direction. Arc diagrams place nodes on one line; chord diagrams arrange them around a circle.

items.dz: 以流带宽度表示阶段间流量的数量；流量可以在各阶段合并或拆分。
items.de: Encode quantities between stages with band width; flows may combine or split at each stage.
items.pz: 100 个示例访问中，65 个继续、35 个退出；继续的 65 个又分成完成 40 个与离开 25 个。阶段值守恒，流带宽度按数量缩放并从左向右流动。
items.pe: Of 100 example visits, 65 continue and 35 exit; the continuing 65 split into 40 completions and 25 departures. Stage totals conserve flow; bands scale with quantity and move left to right.

definition.zh: 桑基图用带宽表示阶段之间流动的数量；流量可以在各节点合并或拆分，方向由阶段顺序和箭头表示。
definition.en: A Sankey diagram encodes quantities flowing between stages with band width; flows can merge or split at nodes, and direction follows the stages or arrows.

distinction.zh: 它表达可守恒的数量流，线宽随数值变化；流程图表达操作与判断而不缩放流量，平行集强调分类维度比例且不使用箭头。
distinction.en: It shows quantitative flow with width proportional to value. Flow charts show actions and decisions without scaled quantities; parallel sets emphasize categorical proportions and omit arrows.

items.dz: 把实体排在圆周上，用内部弦线表示实体对的联系；弦线粗细可按关系数值缩放。
items.de: Arrange entities around a circle and connect pairs with interior chords; chord width can scale to relationship values.
items.pz: 四个实体 A/B/C/D 的五组关系值分别为 8、4、6、3、2，共 23。四个节点都位于同一圆环上，线宽按关系值缩放；颜色只作装饰。
items.pe: Five pair values among A/B/C/D are 8, 4, 6, 3 and 2 (23 total). All four nodes lie on one circle, stroke width tracks pair value, and color is decorative.

definition.zh: 和弦图把实体排在圆周上，以弧线或贝塞尔曲线连接有关系的实体对，并可用弦线大小表示数值。
definition.en: A chord diagram arranges entities around a circle and connects related pairs with arcs or Bézier curves; chord size can encode values.

distinction.zh: 它是网络图的环形具名变体，突出实体对之间的比较；弧线图把节点排成直线，桑基图表达阶段间有方向的流量。本例颜色只作装饰，不编码第二变量。
distinction.en: It is a named circular variant of a network diagram for comparing entity pairs. Arc diagrams arrange nodes on a line; Sankey diagrams encode directed stage flows. Color in this example is decorative and encodes no second variable.

relations.reason: Both diagrams represent relationships among entities with node-link marks; the chord diagram specializes the network layout by placing nodes around a circle and scaling pair arcs.

items.dz: 按价格反转结构显示供需变化，横向推进代表反转事件而非等距时间。
items.de: Show supply-and-demand shifts through price reversals; horizontal steps mark reversal events, not evenly spaced time.
items.pz: 示意摆点价格为 100→110→105→120→111→125→99。达到预设反转幅度后折返；越过前肩 110 后转为较粗 Yang 线，跌破前腰 105 后转为较细 Yin 线。
items.pe: Illustrative pivot prices: 100→110→105→120→111→125→99. The line reverses at its preset threshold, thickens after rising above the prior shoulder at 110, and thins after falling below the prior waist at 105.

definition.zh: Kagi 图以连续竖线表现价格方向；达到预设反转幅度后折返，横线标出肩与腰，线宽或颜色随价格突破前次反转界限而变化。
definition.en: A Kagi chart shows price direction with connected vertical strokes. A preset reversal amount turns the line; horizontal shoulders and waists mark turns, while line weight or color changes when price breaks a prior reversal level.

distinction.zh: 横向位置按反转事件推进，不是等距时间轴；它不绘制每个时间区间的开、高、低、收四价。
distinction.en: Horizontal position advances by reversal events, not equal time intervals; the chart does not plot open, high, low and close for every time period.

items.dz: 把时间序列沿阿基米德螺线从中心向外排列，以比较长周期中的重复模式。
items.de: Place time-series observations along an outward Archimedean spiral to compare repeating patterns over long periods.
items.pz: 24 个示意月值分成两圈，每圈 12 个月；同一月份在相邻年份角度对应，颜色区分年份，偏离螺旋基线的距离表示月值。
items.pe: Twenty-four illustrative monthly values form two turns of 12 months each. Matching months align by angle across years; color separates years and radial offset from the spiral baseline shows the monthly value.

definition.zh: 螺旋图把时间序列沿阿基米德螺线从中心向外排列；每一圈可对应一个周期，便于比较跨周期的重复模式。
definition.en: A spiral plot places time-series observations along an outward Archimedean spiral. Each turn can represent a period, making repeated patterns across periods easier to compare.

distinction.zh: 时间沿螺线从内向外推进，数值由点、线、柱或相对螺旋基线的偏移表示；螺旋卡片或装饰性螺纹没有时间序列编码。
distinction.en: Time progresses outward along the spiral; values use points, lines, bars or displacement from the spiral baseline. Decorative spiral layouts do not encode a time series.

items.dz: 在地理位置上放置圆形标记，并用圆面积表示各地点的数值。
items.de: Place circular marks at geographic locations and use each circle’s area to encode a location value.
items.pz: 五个示意地点的值为 25、16、12、9、4；半径按 3√value 缩放，因此圆面积与值成比例。底图和位置均为示意，地点标注数值单位为 visits。
items.pe: Five schematic locations have values 25, 16, 12, 9 and 4 visits. Radius uses 3√value, so circle area is proportional to the value. The basemap and coordinates are illustrative.

definition.zh: 气泡地图把圆形标记放在地理位置上，并按圆面积比例表示每个地点的数值。
definition.en: A bubble map places circular marks at geographic locations and encodes each location’s value by circle area.

distinction.zh: 气泡地图用点的位置与圆面积表达地点和数值；分级设色图给区域填色，流向地图则绘制地点间的路线。
distinction.en: A bubble map uses point location and circle area for place and value; choropleths fill regions with color, while flow maps draw routes between locations.

items.dz: 保留圆周节点和连接线，去掉弦带，以突出关系结构。
items.de: Keep the circular nodes and connection lines but remove ribbons to emphasize the relationship structure.
items.pz: A、B、C、D 四个节点分布在圆周上，五条等宽直线表示已有关联；本例不编码流量、权重或类别。与普通和弦图相比，边只画连接线，不绘制填充弦带。
items.pe: Four nodes A, B, C and D sit around a circle; five fixed-width straight lines indicate relationships. This example does not encode flow, weight or category. Unlike a ribbon chord diagram, edges are lines without filled bands.

definition.zh: 非带状和弦图是和弦图的简化变体，只画圆周节点与连接线，用来突出实体间的关系。
definition.en: A non-ribbon chord diagram is a stripped-down Chord Diagram variant that shows circularly arranged nodes and connection lines to emphasize relationships.

distinction.zh: 它保留圆周布局但去掉填充弦带；本示例的线宽固定，不编码流量或权重。普通和弦图可用弦带大小表示关系值。
distinction.en: It keeps the circular layout but removes filled ribbons; line width is fixed and encodes no flow or weight. A ribbon Chord Diagram can size bands by relationship value.

relations.reason: The source explicitly describes the non-ribbon chart as a stripped-down Chord Diagram and links directly to that chart; it removes filled bands while retaining the circular node-and-connection structure.

items.sourceLabel: Data Visualization Catalogue · Non-ribbon Chord Diagram

items.dz: 把不同系列的值按同一类别上下堆叠，整柱高度表示总量，各段表示分项。
items.de: Stack values from different series within each category; full bar height shows the total and each segment shows one part.
items.pz: North = 18+12+10=40，Central = 12+18+8=38，South = 22+10+6=38。段色区分 Core/Plus/Pro；总量由整柱高度表示。跨类别比较中间段较困难，段数增加会更难读。
items.pe: North = 18+12+10=40, Central = 12+18+8=38, South = 22+10+6=38. Segment color identifies Core/Plus/Pro; total is the full bar height. Middle segments are harder to compare across categories, and readability falls as segment count grows.

definition.zh: 堆叠柱状图在每个类别中把多个系列的数值段沿共同基线累加；整柱高度表示总量，各段表示构成部分。
definition.en: A stacked bar graph adds series segments from a common baseline within each category; full bar height represents the total and each segment represents a component.

distinction.zh: 总量由完整柱高表示，段序和共同刻度影响比较；中间段跨类别不共基线，直接比较较困难。归一为 100% 的形式是独立命名变体。
distinction.en: Total is encoded by the full bar height, with segment order and a shared scale shaping comparison; middle segments lack a common baseline across categories. The normalized 100% form is a separately named variant.

items.sourceLabel: Data Visualization Catalogue · Stacked Bar Graph

items.dz: 把每组总量归一为 100%，比较不同组内部的组成比例。
items.de: Normalize every group to 100% to compare its internal composition across groups.
items.pz: North = 45/30/25%，Central = 32/48/20%，South = 58/27/15%；每组相加均为 100%。柱高固定，只比较 Core/Plus/Pro 的组内比例，不比较原始总量。
items.pe: North = 45/30/25%, Central = 32/48/20%, South = 58/27/15%; every group sums to 100%. Bar height is fixed, so compare within-group shares, not original totals.

definition.zh: 100% 堆叠柱状图先把每组各系列换算为占比，再让每根柱的总高固定为 100%，用于比较组内构成。
definition.en: A 100% stacked bar graph converts each group’s series to shares and fixes every bar’s total height at 100% to compare composition.

distinction.zh: 柱高不再显示组间绝对总量；仅段高表示组内占比。它是普通堆叠柱状图的比例归一化变体。
distinction.en: Bar height no longer shows absolute totals across groups; segment height shows within-group share only. It is the proportion-normalized variant of a simple stacked bar graph.

relations.reason: The source groups the form with stacked bars, but its within-group values are normalized to a common 100% total, removing absolute size comparison.

items.sourceLabel: Data Visualization Catalogue · Stacked Bar Graph

items.dz: 用一条折线依次连接同一条记录在多条平行数值轴上的位置，以比较多变量关系。
items.de: Connect one record’s values across parallel numeric axes to compare multivariate relationships.
items.pz: 五个产品记录 A–E 使用 Cost/Reach/Quality/Load 四轴，值归一到 0–100。Quality 轴刷选 55–80 时突出 A/C/E 三条线，其余淡出；重新排序变量轴会改变相邻关系的可读性。
items.pe: Five product records A–E use Cost/Reach/Quality/Load axes normalized to 0–100. Brushing Quality from 55–80 highlights A/C/E and fades the others; reordering axes changes which adjacent relationships are easiest to read.

definition.zh: 平行坐标图为每个数值变量绘制一条平行轴，并用折线依次连接单条记录在各轴上的取值。
definition.en: A parallel coordinates plot uses one parallel quantitative axis per variable and a polyline connecting each record’s values across axes.

distinction.zh: 折线表示单条观测记录，轴顺序与各轴尺度会影响相邻变量关系的阅读；刷选可突出满足某轴范围的记录。平行集处理分类维度与比例流带，不是这类数值记录折线。
distinction.en: Each polyline represents an individual observation; axis order and scale affect reading of adjacent variable relationships, and brushing can highlight records within an axis range. Parallel sets use categorical dimensions and proportional ribbons instead.

relations.reason: Parallel Coordinates uses quantitative axes and one polyline per record; Parallel Sets uses categorical dimensions and proportional ribbons.

items.sourceLabel: Data Visualization Catalogue · Parallel Coordinates Plot

items.dz: 把类别放在等角的极坐标扇区里，以半径表示每类数值。
items.de: Place categories in equal-angle polar sectors and encode each value by radial length.
items.pz: 八个月份的示意值为 7、9、12、16、15、13、10、8；每段角度相等，半径按值线性增加。面积随半径平方增长，外侧扇区会比数值增幅更醒目。
items.pe: Illustrative values for eight months are 7, 9, 12, 16, 15, 13, 10 and 8. Each sector has equal angle and radius grows linearly with value. Sector area grows with radius squared, so outer values look disproportionately larger.

definition.zh: 南丁格尔玫瑰图把类别放在等角的极坐标扇区中，以扇区半径表示数值。
definition.en: A Nightingale rose chart places categories in equal-angle polar sectors and encodes values by sector radius.

distinction.zh: 半径与数值成正比但面积按半径平方增长，外圈视觉增幅会超过线性数值增幅；不要把面积误认为线性数值编码。来源也称 Coxcomb Chart / Polar Area Diagram。
distinction.en: Radius is proportional to value but sector area grows with radius squared, making outer changes look larger than linear value changes; area is not a linear encoding. The source also lists Coxcomb Chart and Polar Area Diagram.

items.sourceLabel: Data Visualization Catalogue · Nightingale Rose Chart

items.dz: 用 X 和 O 分列记录上涨与下跌价格动作；箱大小与反转箱数过滤小幅波动。
items.de: Record rising and falling price moves in X and O columns; box size and reversal amount filter minor fluctuations.
items.pe: Box size = $5 and reversal amount = 3 boxes. Columns: X 100/105/110/115; O 110/105/100; X 105/110/115/120/125; O 120/115/110. Column order marks reversals, not time; traded volume is not shown.

definition.zh: 点数图用 X 列表示达到箱大小的上涨，用 O 列表示达到箱大小的下跌；达到设定反转箱数后才换列。
definition.en: A Point & Figure chart uses X columns for rises reaching a box size and O columns for falls reaching that size; a new column starts only after the specified reversal amount.

distinction.zh: 点数图与 Kagi 图都按价格反转事件推进，不按等距时间绘制；点数图用 X/O 箱列、箱大小和反转箱数过滤价格动作，Kagi 用连续线及肩、腰标记反转。
distinction.en: Both Point & Figure and Kagi charts advance by price-action reversals rather than equal time intervals. Point & Figure filters price moves with X/O box columns, box size and a reversal count; Kagi uses a connected line with shoulders and waists.

relations.reason: Both omit equal time intervals, but Point & Figure uses alternating X/O price-box columns and reversal amounts while Kagi uses connected line segments with shoulders and waists.

items.sourceLabel: Data Visualization Catalogue · Point & Figure Chart

items.dz: 整圆按占比切扇形，强调部分与整体。
items.de: A full circle sliced by share.
items.pz: 扇形 3-5 块以内、从 12 点顺时针降序；占比是唯一编码。说「切饼图」即此。
items.pe: Three to five slices, sorted from 12 o'clock.

definition.zh: 饼图把一个完整圆按各类占比切成扇形：角度是唯一的数量编码。
definition.en: Slices angle-encode shares of a whole.

distinction.zh: 与环形图（donut）的区别：donut 中空以容纳总量标注；与夜莺玫瑰图的区别：玫瑰用半径而非角度编码数值。
distinction.en: Donut hollows the center; rose charts radius-encode.

relations.reason: 中空与实心的整体表达差异。

items.dz: 离散类别的量用等宽柱的高度编码。
items.de: Category amounts as equal-width bars.
items.pz: 零基线不可截断；类目间留缝以区别于直方图。说「柱状图」即此。
items.pe: Zero baseline mandatory; gaps separate it from histograms.

definition.zh: 柱状图用等宽柱的高度线性编码离散类别的数量，柱间留缝。
definition.en: Height-encodes category amounts on a zero baseline.

distinction.zh: 与直方图的区别：直方图柱表示连续区间频数、无缝且宽度有意义；与堆叠柱（stacked-bar-graph）的区别：单系列 vs 分量叠加。
distinction.en: Histograms bin continuous data seamlessly.

items.dz: 连续有序数据用线段连接，强调趋势走向。
items.de: Connected segments over ordered data.
items.pz: x 轴必须是有序维度（时间最典型）；多于 4 条线考虑拆分。说「折线看趋势」即此。
items.pe: Ordered x only; four series max.

definition.zh: 折线图把有序（通常为时间）数据点用线段连接，坡度即变化率。
definition.en: Connects ordered values; slope encodes rate of change.

distinction.zh: 与散点图（scatter）的区别：散点不连线、无序假设；与面积图（area-chart）的区别：面积图在折线下方填充，强调总量。
distinction.en: Scatter omits connection; area fills underneath.

items.dz: 折线下方填充到基线，强调总量积累。
items.de: The area under the line filled to the baseline.
items.pz: 单系列面积图强调体积感；多系列默认堆叠。说「面积填充」即此。
items.pe: Fill emphasizes volume; multi-series stacks by default.

definition.zh: 面积图把折线与基线之间填充，用面积强调连续量的累积规模。
definition.en: Fills between the line and baseline.

distinction.zh: 与折线图（line-chart）的区别：折线只看走势，面积强调量级；与堆叠面积（d3/areastack）的区别：单系列 vs 多系列构成。
distinction.en: Volume emphasis vs pure trend.

items.dz: 散点的第三维编码进圆面积。
items.de: A third variable encoded in bubble area.
items.pz: 半径 ∝ 数值开方（面积 ∝ 数值）；图例必须给尺寸参照。说「气泡大小」即此。
items.pe: Radius scales with sqrt(value); size legends required.

definition.zh: 气泡图是散点图的扩展：以圆面积编码第三个数值维度。
definition.en: Scatter with a third variable in area.

distinction.zh: 与气泡地图（bubble-map）的区别：气泡图锚在 x/y 数值坐标系，气泡地图锚在地理坐标；与散点的区别：多了面积通道。
distinction.en: Bubble maps anchor geographically.

items.dz: 沿时间轴标出关键节点，点即事件。
items.de: Key events as points along time.
items.pz: 项目汇报用：里程碑点+短标签交错防重叠。说「时间节点图」即此。
items.pe: Stagger labels to avoid overlap.

definition.zh: 里程碑图把无时长的关键事件作为时间轴上的标记点呈现。
definition.en: Zero-duration events as axis markers.

distinction.zh: 与甘特图（d3/gantt）的区别：甘特条有时长跨度，里程碑只有时点；与运行图的区别：强调离散事件而非连续值。
distinction.en: Points, not spans like Gantt bars.

items.dz: 直方图累计化的 S 曲线：任意点读出「小于 x 的样本数」。
items.de: The histogram's cumulative S-curve.
items.pz: 单调不减、右端=样本总数；读分位数直接查曲线。说「累计曲线」即此。
items.pe: Monotone up, ending at N; quantiles read off directly.

definition.zh: 累计频数曲线（ogive）把分组频数自左向右累加，得到单调上升的 S 形曲线。
definition.en: Cumulative frequencies plotted as a monotone S.

distinction.zh: 与直方图（histogram）的区别：直方图看每段频数，ogive 看累计值；与 ECDF（ecdf-plot）的区别：ogive 基于分组区间，ECDF 基于逐样本。
distinction.en: Grouped cumulative vs per-sample ECDF.

items.dz: 降序柱 + 累计百分比折线的双编码组合。
items.de: Descending bars plus a cumulative line.
items.pz: 找「关键少数」：累计线过 80% 处之前的类目即优先项。说「帕累托分析」即此。
items.pe: The vital few sit left of the 80% crossing.

definition.zh: 帕累托图把类目按频数降序排列成柱，并叠加累计百分比折线（右轴）。
definition.en: Sorted bars plus a cumulative-percentage line.

distinction.zh: 与普通柱状图的区别：附加累计维线（右轴），专用于 80/20 分析；与双轴组合图（dual-axis-chart）的区别：帕累托的折线语义固定为累计占比。
distinction.en: The line is always cumulative share.

items.dz: 时序折线加中心线与上下控制限，判断过程是否受控。
items.de: A run chart with center line and control limits.
items.pz: 点越限或连续 7 点同侧即触发调查；控制限来自过程数据不是目标值。说「SPC 受控」即此。
items.pe: Limits come from process data, not targets.

definition.zh: 控制图在时序折线上叠加中心线（均值）与 ±3σ 控制限，用统计规则判定过程波动是否异常。
definition.en: Run line with center line and 3-sigma limits.

distinction.zh: 与运行图（run-chart）的区别：控制图多出统计控制限与判异规则；与阈值线（threshold）的区别：阈值是业务目标，控制限是过程统计量。
distinction.en: Statistical limits, not business targets.

items.dz: 最朴素的时序折线：先看过程再谈控制。
items.de: The plain process line over time.
items.pz: 改进项目第一步：先画运行图中位数，再决定要不要控制限。说「先画运行图」即此。
items.pe: Median first; limits later.

definition.zh: 运行图是按时间顺序绘制的观测折线，通常附中位数线用于游程判读。
definition.en: A time-ordered line with a median reference.

distinction.zh: 与折线图（line-chart）的区别：运行图是过程监测语义（附中位数与游程规则）；与控制图（control-chart）的区别：无控制限。
distinction.en: Median only, no control limits.

items.dz: 三组分占比（和恒为 100%）在等边三角形内的唯一落点。
items.de: Three-part compositions inside an equilateral triangle.
items.pz: 土壤学/化学配比专用：三个轴都从各自底边读。说「三角形配方图」即此。
items.pe: Read each axis from its own base.

definition.zh: 三元相图把三个非负且和恒定的组分映射为等边三角形内的唯一点。
definition.en: Three-part compositions map to one point in a triangle.

distinction.zh: 与雷达图家族的区别：三元图的三个轴受和恒定约束（二维承载三维）；与散点的区别：自由度只有 2。
distinction.en: Constant-sum constraint frees one dimension.

items.dz: 层次聚类的合并记录：枝高即合并距离。
items.de: Merge heights encode cluster distance.
items.pz: 在最大垂直间隙处横切得到聚类数。说「切 dendrogram」即此。
items.pe: Cut where gaps are tallest.

definition.zh: 树状图记录层次聚类逐次合并：叶为样本，枝的垂直高度为合并时的相异度。
definition.en: Merge heights encode dissimilarity.

distinction.zh: 与树形布局（d3/treelayout）的区别：dendrogram 的枝高有距离语义（不齐顶）；与冰柱图（d3/icicle）的区别：icicle 编码层级占比。
distinction.en: Heights carry distance semantics.

items.dz: 把相近走向的边捆成束，稠密网络一眼读出主干。
items.de: Bend similar edges together to reveal trunks.
items.pz: 航班/依赖关系图降噪利器：捆绑度是可调参数，过强会误读连接。说「把边捆起来」即此。
items.pe: Tune the bundling strength; over-bundling misleads.

definition.zh: 边捆绑把空间走向相近的边弯曲汇聚成束，降低网络图视觉混乱并暴露主干。
definition.en: Curves similar edges into shared trunks.

distinction.zh: 与普通直连网络图（network-diagram）的区别：边被共同弯曲、经过共享控制点；与 hierarchical bundling 的区别在锚点来源。
distinction.en: Shared control points bend edges together.

items.dz: 多变量两两散点铺成方阵，对角线放分布。
items.de: Pairwise scatters in a grid.
items.pz: n 个变量 → n×n 格；看相关找强格，再看单格细节。说「SPLOM」即此。
items.pe: Scan the grid for strong cells.

definition.zh: 散点矩阵把每个变量对画成一个散点格，构成 n×n 方阵以通览两两关系。
definition.en: Every variable pair gets its own cell.

distinction.zh: 与平行坐标（parallel-coordinates-plot）的区别：SPLOM 用二维格承载两两关系（n² 格），平行坐标用一条折线穿越 n 轴。
distinction.en: Grid of pairs vs one polyline across axes.

items.dz: 分阶段类目流：粗带表现构成在阶段间的迁移。
items.de: Stage-to-stage flows as thick sediment bands.
items.pz: 市场结构变迁、职业流动：每个阶段一组类目轴。说「看结构怎么流」即此。
items.pe: One category axis per stage.

definition.zh: 冲积图沿多个阶段轴排布类目块，以等宽流带表现构成在阶段间的迁移与重组。
definition.en: Category blocks per stage joined by share-width flows.

distinction.zh: 与桑基图（sankey-diagram）的区别：桑基的节点是来源-目标二元流，冲积强调多阶段类目轴的构成演变；与平行集合（parallel-sets）的区别：平行集合轴为离散属性维度。
distinction.en: Multi-stage composition, not source-target only.

items.dz: 柱从最小值伸到最大值，没有共同基线。
items.de: Bars span min to max, no zero baseline.
items.pz: 温度区间、工期区间专用：只看范围不看绝对量。说「区间跨度」即此。
items.pe: Ranges only, never magnitudes.

definition.zh: 跨度图的柱两端分别是数据的最小值与最大值，表达区间而非数量。
definition.en: Bars stretch between min and max.

distinction.zh: 与柱状图（bar-chart）的区别：柱起点不是零而是各自最小值，不可比大小只能比范围；与误差条的区别：误差条是中心值±不确定度。
distinction.en: Ranges, not magnitudes.

items.dz: 圆圈关系只画真实存在的交集。
items.de: Only existing intersections are drawn.
items.pz: 集合关系图：某个交集为空就不画——这是与韦恩图的分界。说「欧拉图」即此。
items.pe: Empty intersections vanish.

definition.zh: 欧拉图用圆圈表达集合及其真实存在的关系：空交集不出现。
definition.en: Circles for sets, drawn only for existing relations.

distinction.zh: 与韦恩图（venn-diagram）的区别：韦恩图必须画出全部 2ⁿ 个区域（含空的），欧拉图按实际关系裁剪；表达力更强但形状不唯一。
distinction.en: Venn forces all zones; Euler prunes.

relations.reason: 全部区域 vs 真实交集。

items.dz: 集合交集以矩阵点+横柱呈现，破解多集合韦恩图灾难。
items.de: Intersection matrix plus bars: Venn's escape hatch.
items.pz: 4 个以上集合的可视化选 UpSet：按交集大小降序读列。说「UpSet 分析」即此。
items.pe: Columns sort by intersection size.

definition.zh: UpSet 图以「集合成员点阵 + 交集大小柱」的组合表达多集合交集，替代高阶韦恩图。
definition.en: Membership matrix plus intersection bars.

distinction.zh: 与韦恩图/欧拉图的区域面积编码不同：UpSet 用位置矩阵精确表达集合归属，可扩展到十几个集合。
distinction.en: Positional membership beats area encoding at scale.

items.dz: 调用栈聚合成倒置层叠条：宽=耗时，深=调用深度。
items.de: Aggregated stacks: width is time, depth is nesting.
items.pz: 性能分析标配：从顶往下找最宽平台即热点；点击可缩放。说「看火焰图找热点」即此。
items.pe: Widest plateau under the top is your hotspot.

definition.zh: 火焰图把采样到的调用栈按字母序聚合为倒置层叠条形：宽度正比于在栈内的时间占比。
definition.en: Aggregated stacks; width proportional to time.

distinction.zh: 与冰柱图（d3/icicle）的区别：层次语义同为嵌套矩形，但火焰图专用于调用栈性能分析且通常按字母排序聚合；与桑基图的区别：无流语义。
distinction.en: Profile semantics, not flow.

items.dz: 堆叠面积归一化到 0–100%，只看构成不看总量。
items.de: Stacked area normalized to 100%.
items.pz: 份额结构随时间的演化；总量信息被刻意抹掉。说「归一化堆叠」即此。
items.pe: Composition only, never totals.

definition.zh: 把堆叠面积图的各层归一化为百分比，整体上下边界恒为 0–100%，只呈现构成比例的演化。
definition.en: Stacked shares normalized to a 0-100% band.

distinction.zh: 与普通堆叠面积（d3/areastack）的区别：普通版保留总量信息（边界随总量起伏），归一化版刻意抹掉总量；与百分比堆叠柱（percent-stacked-bar-graph）的区别：连续 x vs 离散类目。
distinction.en: Shares only; totals deliberately erased.

items.dz: 把长时序分层折叠叠加，用色深代替高度，省空间不失分辨率。
items.de: Layered folding: color depth instead of height.
items.pz: 窄面板放多条指标：分层切成 N 带叠在原位，色越深值越高。说「地平线折叠」即此。
items.pe: Fold into bands; darker is higher.

definition.zh: 地平线图把值域切成若干带后折叠叠加在一条窄带内，以颜色深浅恢复被裁掉的高度信息。
definition.en: Banded folding with color recovering height.

distinction.zh: 与普通面积图（area-chart）的区别：面积图需要高度空间，地平线图以色深换取 1/N 的垂直空间且分辨率不降。
distinction.en: Color depth replaces height.

items.dz: 数值在事件点之间保持不变：水平段+垂直跳变。
items.de: Values persist between events: horizontal then jump.
items.pz: 价格阶梯、版本状态、税率段——变化是瞬时的才用。说「阶梯连线」即此。
items.pe: Use only when values hold between events.

definition.zh: 阶梯图以水平线段表示值在事件间的保持，垂直线段表示瞬时跳变。
definition.en: Horizontal holds with vertical jumps.

distinction.zh: 与折线图（line-chart）的区别：折线假设变化是渐变的（斜率有意义），阶梯图假设值恒定到下一事件。
distinction.en: Instant jumps, not gradual slopes.

items.dz: 左右两个独立刻度承载两个系列。
items.de: Two series on two independent scales.
items.pz: 慎用：两轴刻度可被操纵出假相关；必须标注轴归属与单位。说「左右双轴」即此。
items.pe: Label both axes; beware fake correlations.

definition.zh: 双轴组合图在同一绘图区用左右两个独立 y 轴承载量纲不同的两个系列。
definition.en: Two y-scales in one plot area.

distinction.zh: 与帕累托图（pareto-chart）的区别：帕累托的右轴语义固定为累计占比；双轴组合是通用机制。
distinction.en: Generic two-scale mechanism.

items.dz: 竖线表高低，左刻开右刻闭的金融柱。
items.de: Vertical range with open/close ticks.
items.pz: 与 K 线（candlestick）同信息但更紧凑；左 tick=开盘、右 tick=收盘。说「OHLC 柱」即此。
items.pe: Left tick opens, right tick closes.

definition.zh: OHLC 图以带双刻的竖线同时编码一期的最高/最低价与开盘/收盘价。
definition.en: Range bars with open/close ticks.

distinction.zh: 与 K 线图（d3/candlestick）的区别：信息相同，K 线用实体填充开收差，OHLC 用刻线表达，更紧凑但涨跌需靠颜色。
distinction.en: Ticks instead of a filled body.

items.dz: 网络转矩阵：行列表节点，格子即边。
items.de: The network as an n×n grid.
items.pz: 稠密网络比点线图清晰；重排行-列可让块结构浮现。说「矩阵看网络」即此。
items.pe: Reorder rows/columns to reveal blocks.

definition.zh: 邻接矩阵图把网络的边集渲染为 n×n 格阵，格色编码有无边或权重。
definition.en: Edges as colored cells in an n×n grid.

distinction.zh: 与点线网络图（network-diagram）的区别：矩阵无空间布局语义但抗稠密（O(n²) 格子不会叠边）；适合找块/团结构。
distinction.en: No layout semantics; handles density.

items.dz: 网格点上画箭头：方向+大小同时编码。
items.de: Arrows encode direction and magnitude.
items.pz: 风场/流场标配；箭头长度即模长，网格采样密度决定可读性。说「矢量场」即此。
items.pe: Arrow length is the magnitude.

definition.zh: 矢量场箭头图在网格点绘制箭头，方向与长度分别编码向量方向与模长。
definition.en: Grid arrows encode vector direction and magnitude.

distinction.zh: 与流线图的区别：quiver 是离散采样箭头，流线是积分连续轨迹；与风斗（wind barbs）的区别：风斗用羽毛编码风速。
distinction.en: Sampled arrows vs integrated streamlines.

items.dz: 每点代表固定数量，用点的疏密表现地理分布。
items.de: One dot = N units; density shows geography.
items.pz: 点值要标注（1 点 = 1000 人）；随机散布在统计区内避免伪聚集。说「点地图」即此。
items.pe: Annotate the dot value.

definition.zh: 点密度地图以等值点（1 点 = N 单位）撒布在地理区域内，用疏密表现分布强度。
definition.en: Equal-value dots scattered by density.

distinction.zh: 与分级填色地图（d3/choropleth）的区别：choropleth 按行政单元整体着色（有边界假象），点地图表现区内真实分布；与比例符号地图的区别：点大小恒定。
distinction.en: In-region scatter, not unit fills.

items.dz: 在地理位置上放大小随数值变化的符号。
items.de: Sized symbols pinned to places.
items.pz: 面积 ∝ 数值；重叠时用透明度或改用饼符号分层。说「气泡地图」即此。
items.pe: Area proportional; overlap needs care.

definition.zh: 比例符号地图在地理位置放置面积随数值变化的符号（通常为圆）。
definition.en: Area-scaled symbols at locations.

distinction.zh: 与点密度地图（dot-density-map）的区别：点地图点大小恒定靠数量，比例符号靠大小；与气泡图（bubble-chart）的区别：锚定地理坐标而非数值坐标系。
distinction.en: Size encoding at geographic anchors.

items.dz: 地理点对之间画弧线，表现两地关系强度。
items.de: Arcs between places encode pairwise links.
items.pz: 航线/迁移/通信：弧粗细或颜色编码流量。说「连线关系图」即此。
items.pe: Weight arcs by flow volume.

definition.zh: 连线地图在地理点位之间绘制弧线，以弧宽/颜色编码点对间的关系强度。
definition.en: Geographic arcs weighted by pair flows.

distinction.zh: 与流地图（d3/flow-map）的区别：流地图强调有向移动轨迹，连线图强调成对关系（可为无向）；与 edge-bundling 的区别：捆绑是网络图技术、基底非地理。
distinction.en: Pairwise relations on a map.

items.dz: 把区域等面积化成方格阵列，位置近似地理邻接。
items.de: Equal-area tiles approximating geography.
items.pz: 小倍数地图网格、美国各州选举图的经典方案。说「格子地图」即此。
items.pe: One tile per region, roughly adjacent.

definition.zh: 瓦片网格地图把每个地理区域表示为一个等面积方格，按近似地理邻接排布。
definition.en: One equal-area tile per region.

distinction.zh: 与真实地理地图的区别：放弃形状保真换取面积公平（小区域不再不可见）；与 waffle 图的区别：waffle 表示数量构成，tile 表示地理单元。
distinction.en: Area fairness over shape fidelity.

items.dz: 用图标个数编码数量，一个图标=N 单位。
items.de: Icon counts encode quantities.
items.pz: 汇报与科普：一图标=固定数量必须标注；图标部分填充有歧义要慎用。说「象形统计」即此。
items.pe: Annotate icons-per-unit; avoid partial fills.

definition.zh: 象形图以重复图标个数编码数量：每个图标代表固定单位数。
definition.en: Repeated icons, one per fixed unit.

distinction.zh: 与 waffle 图（waffle）的区别：waffle 用抽象方格，象形图用语义图标（人物/车辆）；两者同为单位计数编码。
distinction.en: Semantic icons vs abstract squares.

items.dz: 一维数值散点铺在轴上，看原始分布密度。
items.de: One-dimensional scatter along an axis.
items.pz: 样本量小（<150）直接铺点；点重叠时抖动或换 beeswarm。说「铺原始点」即此。
items.pe: Raw points before any binning.

definition.zh: 带状图把每个样本作为单点画在一根数值轴上，呈现未经聚合的原始分布。
definition.en: Every sample as a dot on one axis.

distinction.zh: 与箱线图（box-plot）的区别：箱线聚合了五数，strip 保留全部原始点；与 beeswarm（d3/beeswarm）的区别：beeswarm 防重叠排布。
distinction.en: Raw dots vs summarized boxes.

items.dz: Letter-value 多层箱：比箱线图多几层分位，大样本更细。
items.de: Letter-value boxes beyond quartiles.
items.pz: 大样本（>5000）替代箱线图：每一层箱都是等概分位。说「boxen 看尾部」即此。
items.pe: More quantile boxes for big n.

definition.zh: 信封值图按 letter-value（四分位之外的八分位、十六分位…）绘制多层嵌套箱，展示尾部分位细节。
definition.en: Nested letter-value boxes.

distinction.zh: 与箱线图（box-plot）的区别：箱线只到四分位+离群点，boxen 逐层外推分位箱（信息更多）；适合大样本。
distinction.en: Deeper quantile boxes for large n.

items.dz: 逐样本阶梯上升的累计概率曲线。
items.de: Per-sample stair-step cumulative probability.
items.pz: 无需分箱参数；多条 ECDF 叠加即分布对比。说「ECDF」即此。
items.pe: No binning knobs at all.

definition.zh: ECDF 把每个样本按序阶梯上升 1/n，给出经验累积分布函数的完整形状。
definition.en: Each sample steps up by 1/n.

distinction.zh: 与 ogive（ogive-curve）的区别：ogive 基于分组区间，ECDF 逐样本精确（无分箱损失）；与直方图的区别：无参数。
distinction.en: Per-sample exact, parameter-free.

items.dz: 两组分位数互为坐标：贴对角线即同分布。
items.de: Quantiles against quantiles: on the line means alike.
items.pz: 正态检验的经典用法：样本分位数 vs 理论分位数。说「Q-Q 检验」即此。
items.pe: Sample vs theoretical quantiles.

definition.zh: Q-Q 图把两组数据（或样本与理论分布）的分位数互为 x/y 坐标，对角线为同分布参照。
definition.en: Quantile pairs plotted; the diagonal is the null.

distinction.zh: 与直方图（histogram）的区别：Q-Q 对尾部偏差极其敏感（直方图最不敏感的区域）；无需选 bin。
distinction.en: Tail-sensitive and parameter-free.

items.dz: 随时间尚未发生事件的概率阶梯下降。
items.de: Stepwise survival probability over time.
items.pz: 医学试验标配：阶梯下降在事件发生点，+号标注删失。说「KM 曲线」即此。
items.pe: Steps at events; plus marks are censored.

definition.zh: Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线以阶梯折线估计随时间推移的存活概率，事件点下降、删失点标注。
definition.en: Stepwise survival probability with censor marks.

distinction.zh: 与折线图（line-chart）的区别：阶梯语义=事件驱动，且纵轴是概率（0–1）；删失机制是它独有的统计内容。
distinction.en: Event-driven steps with censoring.

items.dz: 多项研究的效应量方块+置信区间横线一图并列。
items.de: Effect sizes with CI whiskers, study by study.
items.pz: Meta 分析标配：方块=点估计、横线=95%CI、菱形=合并效应。说「森林图」即此。
items.pe: Diamond = pooled estimate.

definition.zh: 森林图纵向并列多项研究的效应量：方块为点估计、横线为置信区间、菱形为合并估计。
definition.en: Study-level effects with CI whiskers and a pooled diamond.

distinction.zh: 与误差条散点（error-bars）的区别：forest 有研究列表语义与合并菱形；横线是置信区间而非数据范围。
distinction.en: Pooled diamond is the signature.

items.dz: x=效应量、y=显著性：喷发两翼即差异基因/蛋白。
items.de: Effect size vs significance: wings erupt.
items.pz: 组学数据筛选标配：右上/左上翼为显著差异点，横线为显著性阈值。说「火山筛选」即此。
items.pe: Wings above the threshold line.

definition.zh: 火山图以效应量（log 倍数变化）为 x、显著性（-log10 p）为 y 的散点图，阈值线以上两翼即显著差异项。
definition.en: Effect vs significance scatter with wings.

distinction.zh: 与普通散点（scatter）的区别：坐标轴语义固定（效应/显著性）且带阈值判定线；形状似火山得名。
distinction.en: Fixed semantics plus a significance gate.

items.dz: 全基因组位点按染色体分段铺开，高耸天际线即显著信号。
items.de: GWAS skyline across chromosomes.
items.pz: GWAS 标配：x 按染色体分色块交替，-log10(p) 竖直，阈值线横切。说「曼哈顿天际线」即此。
items.pe: Alternating chromosome blocks; a threshold line.

definition.zh: 曼哈顿图把海量位点按染色体顺序沿 x 铺开、显著性（-log10 p）为 y，形似曼哈顿天际线。
definition.en: Chromosome-blocked significance skyline.

distinction.zh: 与散点（scatter）的区别：x 是分类拼接的基因组坐标、染色体交替配色是识别特征；尖峰即候选位点。
distinction.en: Blocky x, spiky skyline.

items.dz: 各状态工作项数量随时间累积叠放：带宽=在制、坡度=吞吐。
items.de: Stacked state counts over time.
items.pz: 看板分析核心图：带宽变大即堆积，斜率差即吞吐。说「CFD 看流动」即此。
items.pe: Band width is WIP; slope is throughput.

definition.zh: 累积流图把各状态工作项的累计数量叠放为随时间的多层面积带。
definition.en: Stacked cumulative state counts.

distinction.zh: 与堆叠面积图（d3/areastack）的区别：语义为流程状态量（WIP/吞吐诊断），不只是构成展示；层间垂直距离有明确管理含义。
distinction.en: Process diagnostics, not just composition.

items.dz: Web 默认色彩空间： transfers 曲线 + RGB 基色。
items.de: The web default color space.
items.pz: 无色域声明的颜色都在 sRGB；覆盖约 70% Display-P3。说「sRGB 基准」即此。
items.pe: The baseline every screen speaks.

definition.zh: sRGB 是 Web 的默认色彩空间：定义了 RGB 原色、白点与转移曲线，未声明色域的颜色均按 sRGB 解释。
definition.en: The web default color space.

distinction.zh: 与 display-p3 的区别：P3 色域更广（约多 30% 面积），在 sRGB 屏上会裁剪回落。
distinction.en: sRGB is the baseline every screen speaks; display-p3 exceeds it by ~50% volume.

items.dz: 更广的广色域：iPhone/Mac 屏幕原生空间。
items.de: The wide-gamut default of Apple screens.
items.pz: color(display-p3 1 0 0) 是比 sRGB 红更艳的红。说「广色域红」即此。
items.pe: A wider, juicier red.

definition.zh: Display-P3 覆盖比 sRGB 大约 50% 的色域体积（DCI-P3 变体、D65 白点），现代设备屏原生支持。
definition.en: The wide-gamut default of Apple screens.

distinction.zh: 与 sRGB 的区别：饱和度上限更高；在 sRGB 显示器上须做色域映射（见 gamut-mapping）。
distinction.en: display-p3 holds wider saturated colors; sRGB screens clip them via gamut mapping.

items.dz: 感知均匀的 L 明度 + a/b 色度轴。
items.de: Perceptually uniform L,a,b.
items.pz: lab(53% 40 59) 是 CSS 里的 CIELAB：明度均匀，适合计算对比与色差。说「Lab 空间」即此。
items.pe: Lightness that behaves.

definition.zh: CIELAB 以 L（明度）与 a/b（色度对立轴）描述颜色，感知均匀：相同 ΔL 观感亮度差一致。
definition.en: Perceptually uniform L,a,b.

distinction.zh: 与 sRGB 的区别：sRGB 是设备导向，Lab 是感知导向；色差计算（ΔE）与无障碍对比度都应在其上做。
distinction.en: Lab is perceptually uniform; sRGB is device-oriented.

items.dz: Lab 的极坐标版：L 明度 C 色度 H 色相。
items.de: Lab in polar form.
items.pz: lch(52% 58 45)——调色板生成最爱：转 H 保明度。说「LCH 调色」即此。
items.pe: Rotate hue, hold lightness.

definition.zh: LCH 是 Lab 的极坐标表示：L 明度、C 色度（饱和度）、H 色相，是程序化调色板的首选空间。
definition.en: Lab in polar form.

distinction.zh: 与 HSL 的区别：HSL 的「亮度」不感知均匀（黄色比蓝“亮”），LCH 的 L 是真实的感知明度。
distinction.en: LCH keeps L constant across hues; HSL lightness is perceptually uneven.

items.dz: 修正 Lab 缺陷的改良感知空间（Björn Ottosson）。
items.de: The improved perceptual space.
items.pz: oklab(0.6 0.1 0.1)：渐变插值与图像处理的更优底座。说「Oklab」即此。
items.pe: Better gradients by design.

definition.zh: Oklab 修正了 CIELAB 在蓝区的色相弯曲与数值噪声，是 CSS 渐变插值（in oklab）的推荐空间。
definition.en: The improved perceptual space.

distinction.zh: 与 Lab 的区别：同为感知空间但数值行为更稳定；CSS 中 gradient 默认 sRGB 插值产生灰带，指定 in oklab 消除。
distinction.en: Oklab fixes Lab hue bending in blues; gradients interpolate without gray bands.

items.dz: 显式声明色彩空间的通用取色函数。
items.de: Explicit color-space taking.
items.pz: color(display-p3 …)/color(rec2020 …)/color(xyz …)——色域跟着参数走。说「color() 指定空间」即此。
items.pe: The space is in the call.

definition.zh: color() 函数以显式色彩空间参数（display-p3、rec2020、xyz、srgb…）解析颜色，是跨色域工作的统一入口。
definition.en: Explicit color-space taking.

distinction.zh: 与 hex/rgb 的区别：hex 隐含 sRGB；color() 把色彩空间声明为语法的一部分。
distinction.en: color() declares the space in the call; hex/rgb imply sRGB.

items.dz: 从既有颜色派生新颜色。
items.de: Derive new colors from existing ones.
items.pz: oklch(from var(--brand) calc(l*0.8) c h)——主题色阶一行生成。说「相对取色」即此。
items.pe: One brand color, a whole ramp.

definition.zh: 相对颜色语法 color: oklch(from var(--brand) l c h) 允许以数学调整既有颜色的分量派生新色。
definition.en: Derive new colors from existing ones.

distinction.zh: 与 color-mix 的区别：mix 是两色混合，相对语法是单色分量运算（缩放明度、旋转色相）。
distinction.en: Relative syntax operates on one color components; color-mix blends two colors.

items.dz: 广色域色落到窄屏时的裁剪策略。
items.de: How wide-gamut colors clip to smaller screens.
items.pz: color(display-p3 …) 在 sRGB 屏会被映射——映射算法决定观感。说「色域裁剪」即此。
items.pe: Not all colors survive the trip.

definition.zh: 色域映射把超出目标设备色域的颜色调整到可表示范围，CSS 色域映射以 CSS Chromaticity/OKLCH 空间裁剪为准。
definition.en: How wide-gamut colors clip to smaller screens.

distinction.zh: 与简单 clamp 的区别：好的映射保明度与色相、牺牲饱和度；粗暴 RGB clamp 会同时改变明度与色相。
distinction.en: Mapping preserves lightness and hue while sacrificing saturation; naive clamping corrupts both.

items.dz: sRGB 的转移曲线：人眼感知的非线性补偿。
items.de: The transfer curve of sRGB.
items.pz: sRGB 数值非线性（≈2.2 次幂），线性计算（混合/光照）必须先解码。说「先线性再算」即此。
items.pe: Decode before you math.

definition.zh: 伽马校正指 sRGB 编码/解码的转移函数（约 2.2 次幂）：存储用编码值，物理计算须用线性值。
definition.en: The transfer curve of sRGB.

distinction.zh: 与 light-dark() 的区别：那是主题切换；与本条相关的经典错误是「在 sRGB 数值上做线性渐变/光照」产生灰带。
distinction.en: gamma is an encoding curve; light-dark() is theme switching.

items.dz: 把高动态亮度压缩到显示范围。
items.de: Compressing HDR into display range.
items.pz: ACES/Reinhard 等映射曲线保高光层次不硬裁。说「色调映射」即此。
items.pe: HDR into LDR with grace.

definition.zh: 色调映射用非线性压缩曲线（Reinhard/ACES 等）把高动态范围亮度映射到显示器可表达的范围。
definition.en: Compressing HDR into display range.

distinction.zh: 与 gamma 的区别：gamma 是编码曲线，tone mapping 是亮度域压缩策略；两者在渲染管线中串联。
distinction.en: tone mapping compresses luminance range; gamma encodes it.

items.dz: CSS 允许为渐变/混合指定插值空间。
items.de: Declare the space gradients blend in.
items.pz: linear-gradient(in oklab, …)/in oklch/in srgb——消除灰带。说「in oklab」即此。
items.pe: One keyword kills the gray band.

definition.zh: color-interpolation 方法（CSS 以 in <space> 语法）决定渐变/动画中颜色的混合空间，直接影响中间色观感。
definition.en: Declare the space gradients blend in.

distinction.zh: 与 oklab 条目的区别：那是空间定义，本条是 CSS 中的指定语法与应用位置。
distinction.en: This is the CSS syntax site; oklab-space defines the space itself.

items.dz: 蓝→黄渐变在 sRGB 中途经灰、在 Oklab 中饱和。
items.de: The blue-to-yellow test case.
items.pz: 同一条蓝黄渐变：sRGB 中段发灰，oklab/oklch 中段保持饱和。说「灰带测试」即此。
items.pe: The canonical gray-band demo.

definition.zh: 蓝→黄渐变是插值空间的试金石：sRGB 逐通道插值途经去饱和灰带，感知空间插值保持中段饱和（经过绿色）。
definition.en: The blue-to-yellow test case.

distinction.zh: 与 color-interpolation-prop 的区别：那条讲语法机制，这条讲经典案例与判断方法。
distinction.en: The blue-yellow case study; color-interpolation-prop is the syntax mechanism.

items.de: Names grid regions in ASCII-art strings; items sit by name.
items.pz: grid-template-areas:'h h' 's m'；子项 grid-area:m。改版图只需改字符串。说「按区域排」即此。
items.pe: grid-template-areas:'h h' 's m'; grid-area:m — the layout is the string.

definition.zh: grid-template-areas 用带名字的字符串矩阵声明网格区域，子项以 grid-area:<名字> 占据对应区域，同名字符串自动跨行跨列合并。
definition.en: grid-template-areas declares named regions via string rows; grid-area:<name> places items, and repeated names merge cells.

distinction.zh: 与 grid-template-columns/rows 的区别：后者只定轨道几何，areas 额外把几何变成可命名的语义版图；命名区域之间形成隐式命名线。
distinction.en: Track templates define geometry; areas add named semantic regions and implicit named lines.

items.dz: 自动放置器回头填补网格里的空洞。
items.de: The auto-placement backfills holes left in the grid.
items.pz: grid-auto-flow:dense 适合卡片高低不一的瀑布式网格；代价是视觉顺序与 DOM 顺序可能不一致。说「开稠密回填」即此。
items.pe: grid-auto-flow:dense backfills holes in uneven card grids.

definition.zh: dense 关键字启用稠密回填算法：后续较小的项目会被回头放入前面跨行/跨列项目留下的空洞。
definition.en: dense enables backfilling: later smaller items slot into holes left by earlier spanning items.

distinction.zh: 与默认 row 流的区别：默认只向前推进、留下空洞；dense 会回填但打乱视觉与 DOM 顺序的一致性，键盘/tab 顺序需另行保证。
distinction.en: Default flow leaves holes; dense fills them at the cost of visual/DOM order divergence.

items.dz: 用网格线编号把项目钉到具体区间。
items.de: Pins items to explicit grid lines by number.
items.pz: grid-column:2/4 表示从 2 号线跨到 4 号线；-1 是末线。说「从几号线到几号线」即此。
items.pe: grid-column:2/4 spans from line 2 to line 4; -1 is the last line.

definition.zh: grid-row/column 以线号（含负数倒数与 span 记法）声明项目的起止线：1 是首线，-1 是末线，同名区域还会隐式生成命名线。
definition.en: grid-row/column pin items between numbered grid lines, with negative indexes and span notation.

distinction.zh: 与 grid-template-areas 的区别：areas 是语义化版图（字符串命名），线基定位是几何坐标（数字精确）；两者可混用。
distinction.en: areas name regions semantically; line placement is numeric geometry.

dz: 图标系统统一几何、语义、方向、可访问性和状态表达。
