items.dz: 元素沿一条 SVG 路径滑行，朝向可随路径切线。
items.de: The element slides along an SVG path, optionally rotating with the tangent.
items.pz: offset-path:path('M...') 配 offset-distance 动画。说「沿这条曲线走」即此。
items.pe: offset-path with an animated offset-distance moves the element along the curve.

definition.zh: offset-path 为元素定义一条定位路径，offset-distance 决定元素在路径上的位置，offset-rotate 决定是否随切线转向。
definition.en: offset-path defines the track; offset-distance places the element along it and offset-rotate aligns to the tangent.

distinction.zh: 与 transform:translate 动画的区别：transform 是坐标插值（直线/贝塞尔手写关键帧），offset-path 以真实路径弧长参数化，转弯处速度均匀且可随切线旋转。
distinction.en: transform interpolates coordinates; offset-path parameterizes by path arclength with tangent rotation.

items.dz: 先记位、改布局、反转、播放，用 transform 演出布局变化。
items.de: First, Last, Invert, Play: perform layout changes with transforms.
items.pz: 列表重排/卡片换位用 FLIP：First 记录起点矩形，Last 改 DOM，Invert 反向 transform，Play 过渡到 0。
items.pe: Record First, mutate DOM, Invert, Play.

definition.zh: FLIP 是布局动画技法：以 First(记录起始位置)→Last(应用最终布局)→Invert(施加反向 transform)→Play(过渡清零)四步，把昂贵的布局变化伪装成廉价的合成动画。
definition.en: First, Last, Invert, Play: perform layout changes with transforms.

distinction.zh: 与直接 transition 布局属性的区别：FLIP 只动画 transform（合成器友好），布局跳变在一帧内完成；与 view-transition 的区别：View Transitions 由浏览器接管快照。
distinction.en: FLIP performs layout changes as transforms; direct layout transitions thrash the main thread.

items.dz: 用位置、光线与对比把注意力引向该看的地方。
items.de: Direct attention through placement and contrast.
items.pz: 动效一次只有一个主角：主角动、配角静。说「舞台调度」即此。
items.pe: One protagonist per beat.

definition.zh: 舞台调度（staging）是动画十二原则之一：通过排布、动作时机与对比把观众注意力引向叙事要点。
definition.en: Direct attention through placement and contrast.

distinction.zh: 与 follow-through 的区别：staging 管注意力分配（谁动），follow-through 管动作的物理延续（怎么停）。
distinction.en: Staging allocates attention; follow-through continues physical motion.

items.sourceLabel: Wikipedia: Twelve basic principles of animation

items.dz: 放大动作到比真实更真的程度，让反馈可感知。
items.de: Push motion past realism so it reads.
items.pz: 按钮按压下沉 2px 可感知；真实物理 0.2px 无人看见——动画要夸张。说「夸张一点」即此。
items.pe: 2px press beats 0.2px realism.

definition.zh: 夸张原则（exaggeration）要求把动作幅度、速度或形变放大到比物理真实更明显的程度，使交互反馈在感知阈值之上。
definition.en: Push motion past realism so it reads.

distinction.zh: 与 squash & stretch 的区别：挤压是体积守恒的形变手法，夸张是幅度策略；夸张可以不涉及形变。
distinction.en: Exaggeration scales amplitude; squash and stretch conserves volume while deforming.

items.sourceLabel: Wikipedia: Twelve basic principles of animation

items.dz: 两种创作流程：逐帧顺画流畅生动，关键姿态法可控精准。
items.de: Frame-by-frame improvisation vs keyed poses.
items.pz: CSS 世界对应：keyframes 全手写（顺画）vs 只写首末帧交给插值（姿态法）。说「关键帧策略」即此。
items.pe: Hand-authored frames vs interpolated poses.

definition.zh: straight-ahead（逐张顺画）从第一帧一路画到最后，动作流动但难控制；pose-to-pose（姿态法）先定关键姿态再补中间帧，可控且高效。
definition.en: Frame-by-frame improvisation vs keyed poses.

distinction.zh: 与 keyframes 规则的区别：那是 CSS 语法机制，本条是创作方法论；两者在 UI 动效里对应「手写全帧 vs 首末帧+缓动」。
distinction.en: Straight-ahead improvises every frame; pose-to-pose keys anchors and interpolates.

items.sourceLabel: Wikipedia: Twelve basic principles of animation

items.dz: 帧数与速度决定物体的重量、情绪与意图。
items.de: Frame counts encode weight and intent.
items.pz: 同一动作 4 帧轻快、12 帧沉重——节奏即角色。说「快慢即性格」即此。
items.pe: Four frames feel light; twelve feel heavy.

definition.zh: 节奏原则（timing）：同一动作所用的帧数/时长直接传达物体的重量、尺度与情绪。
definition.en: Frame counts encode weight and intent.

distinction.zh: 与 duration-scale 的区别：duration-scale 是产品级时长令牌体系，timing 是动画基本原理层面的表达手段。
distinction.en: Timing is a principle about meaning per frame; duration-scale is a product token system.

items.sourceLabel: Wikipedia: Twelve basic principles of animation

items.dz: 决定动画前后是否应用首末帧样式。
items.de: Applies keyframe styles outside the active phase.
items.pz: delay 期间要不要保持 from 样式、结束后停在 to——fill-mode 三档说了算。说「forwards 停在结尾」即此。
items.pe: forwards freezes the final frame.

definition.zh: animation-fill-mode 取 none/forwards/backwards/both：控制动画非活动期间（延迟前/结束后）元素是否呈现关键帧样式。
definition.en: Applies keyframe styles outside the active phase.

distinction.zh: 与 animation-play-state 的区别：fill-mode 管时间边界外的样式残留，play-state 管播放中的暂停/恢复。
distinction.en: fill-mode governs styles outside the active phase; play-state pauses mid-flight.

items.dz: normal/reverse/alternate/alternate-reverse 四种往返播放。
items.de: normal, reverse, alternate, alternate-reverse.
items.pz: 呼吸效果用 alternate 省一半关键帧。说「来回播放」即此。
items.pe: alternate halves the keyframes.

definition.zh: animation-direction 控制循环的方向语义：normal 每轮从头、reverse 反向、alternate 奇偶轮往返、alternate-reverse 反向起。
definition.en: normal, reverse, alternate, alternate-reverse.

distinction.zh: 与 ping-pong 手写负延迟的区别：alternate 是原生机制，无需第二组关键帧。
distinction.en: direction governs loop orientation; ping-pong hand-plays duplicate keyframes.

items.dz: running/paused 实时暂停恢复动画。
items.de: Pause and resume without resetting.
items.pz: hover 暂停跑马灯、 tab 切后台停播——一个属性零 JS。说「暂停动画」即此。
items.pe: Paused marquee on hover, zero JS.

definition.zh: animation-play-state 以 running/paused 暂停或恢复动画且保持当前进度。
definition.en: Pause and resume without resetting.

distinction.zh: 与移除 animation 的区别：移除会重置进度，paused 冻结现场；与 transition 无关。
distinction.en: play-state freezes progress; removing the animation resets it.

items.dz: 缩放旋转的参考锚点：动效性格的隐藏开关。
items.de: The anchor of scale and rotation.
items.pz: 卡片入场 origin 从左上→中心，动画性格完全不同。说「锚点放哪儿」即此。
items.pe: Origin moves the character of motion.

definition.zh: transform-origin 指定 transform 函数的参考原点，改变缩放/旋转的空间语义而不改变函数本身。
definition.en: The anchor of scale and rotation.

distinction.zh: 与 translate 前置的区别：origin 是几何锚点语义，translate 是位移量；旋转方向感完全由 origin 决定。
distinction.en: origin is the geometric anchor; translate is a displacement.

items.dz: 用采样点拼出任意缓动曲线的 CSS 新函数。
items.de: Piecewise-linear custom easings in CSS.
items.pz: 把弹簧/弹跳曲线采样成 linear(0, 0.3 10%, 1) 直接在 CSS 复现 JS 缓动。说「自定义缓动」即此。
items.pe: Sample curves straight into CSS.

definition.zh: linear() 以等距或不等距采样点线性连接，把任意缓动（含弹跳、回弹）表达为纯 CSS。
definition.en: Piecewise-linear custom easings in CSS.

distinction.zh: 与 cubic-bezier 的区别：贝塞尔只有 4 个控制点且曲线必有单调时间轴；linear() 可表达多峰震荡。
distinction.en: linear() samples any curve including oscillations; cubic-bezier is capped at four points.

items.dz: 以单个元素进出视口的进度驱动其动画。
items.de: Progress driven by an element's viewport crossing.
items.pz: 滚动到哪播到哪：卡片进场逐个揭示（scroll-driven reveal 的官方形态）。说「进视口播动画」即此。
items.pe: Cards reveal as they enter.

definition.zh: view() 以目标元素在视口内的可见进度替代时钟：配合 animation-range 定义进出场区间。
definition.en: Progress driven by an element's viewport crossing.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll() 的区别：scroll() 看滚动容器整体进度，view() 看单个元素相对视口的进度；与 scroll-reveal JS 方案的区别：纯 CSS 无监听。
distinction.en: view() tracks one element's viewport progress; scroll() tracks the container.

items.dz: 用 JS 直接创建与控制浏览器动画引擎的动画。
items.de: Script the browser's animation engine directly.
items.pz: element.animate(keyframes, options) 返回可暂停/反转/ seek 的 Animation 对象。说「WAAPI」即此。
items.pe: Animation objects you can pause and seek.

definition.zh: Element.animate(keyframes, options) 在浏览器动画引擎创建 Animation 实例：play/pause/reverse/finish/回放速率与 promise 完成信号，优于 requestAnimationFrame 手写循环。
definition.en: Script the browser's animation engine directly.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS animation 的区别：WAAPI 以程序对象存在（可逐个控制/组合/取消），CSS 版附着于规则；与 rAF 手写的区别：引擎在合成器线程插值。
distinction.en: Element.animate returns controllable Animation objects; CSS animations bind to rules; rAF loops interpolate manually.

items.dz: 把关键帧与目标解耦的效果对象，可复用可替换。
items.de: Detached effect objects for reuse.
items.pz: new KeyframeEffect(el, frames, opts)：一个效果挂到多个目标或动态换目标。说「效果对象」即此。
items.pe: One effect, many targets.

definition.zh: KeyframeEffect 把目标元素与关键帧打包为独立效果对象，可被多个 Animation 共享、动态改目标或序列化复用。
definition.en: Detached effect objects for reuse.

distinction.zh: 与 Element.animate 的区别：animate 一步创建并播放；KeyframeEffect 是可持久复用的底层构件。
distinction.en: KeyframeEffect detaches effects from playback; animate() creates and plays in one step.

items.dz: 用 promise 等动画真正结束再继续业务。
items.de: Await the animation, then continue.
items.pz: await anim.finished 再弹 toast——回调地狱退散。说「等动画播完」即此。
items.pe: await, then toast.

definition.zh: Animation.finished 是 promise：动画正常完成 resolve，被取消 reject——把续接逻辑写成顺序异步代码。
definition.en: Await the animation, then continue.

distinction.zh: 与 animationend 事件的区别：promise 天然适配 async/await 与 try/catch（取消即 reject），事件回调无此组合语义。
distinction.en: finished resolves on completion and rejects on cancel; animationend is callback-shaped.

items.dz: 多动画写同一属性时按 replace/add/accumulate 合并。
items.de: How stacked animations merge per property.
items.pz: 同一元素两段动画都改 translate：add 让位移叠加而非覆盖。说「动画叠加」即此。
items.pe: add stacks instead of overwriting.

definition.zh: WAAPI/CSS 的 animation-composite（KeyframeEffect.composite）决定动画对同一属性的效果如何合并：replace 覆盖、add 数值累加、accumulate 按单位累计。
definition.en: How stacked animations merge per property.

distinction.zh: 与 animation-composition 属性的区别：CSS 属性版是全局简写，WAAPI 的 composite 逐效果精细控制。
distinction.en: per-effect composite merges precisely; the CSS animation-composition property is global.

items.dz: 提前告知浏览器某属性将要变化，让它预建合成层。
items.de: Pre-warn the engine to promote a layer.
items.pz: 动画启动前 1 帧设 will-change:transform，结束后移除——常驻反而浪费内存。说「提个醒」即此。
items.pe: Hint before, remove after.

definition.zh: will-change 向浏览器预告即将变化的属性，促使其提前提升合成层/分配缓冲，消除动画启动卡顿。
definition.en: Pre-warn the engine to promote a layer.

distinction.zh: 与 compositor-safe 的区别：那是「只用 transform/opacity」的写法原则，will-change 是显式提示 API；过度使用适得其反。
distinction.en: will-change explicitly promotes a layer; compositor-safe is a coding style rule.

items.dz: 显式指定每帧在时间轴上的百分比位置。
items.de: Explicit per-frame timeline positions.
items.pz: keyframes 里 offset:0/.2/.9/.1…节奏由你，浏览器只补空白。说「帧放在哪」即此。
items.pe: You place the frames in time.

definition.zh: 关键帧的 offset 显式声明其在 0–1 时间轴上的位置；未声明者由浏览器均匀分配。
definition.en: Explicit per-frame timeline positions.

distinction.zh: 与百分比 keyframes 的区别：offset 是同一机制的 WAAPI/对象形式；价值在于程序化生成时序。
distinction.en: offsets place frames explicitly in time; undeclared frames distribute evenly.

items.dz: 动画生命周期的三个监听点。
items.de: The three lifecycle listeners.
items.pz: animationstart 埋点、iteration 换文案、end 清理 DOM。说「动画事件」即此。
items.pe: Start, iterate, end hooks.

definition.zh: CSS 动画在生命周期触发 animationstart/animationiteration/animationend（及取消时的 animationcancel）事件。
definition.en: The three lifecycle listeners.

distinction.zh: 与 WAAPI finished promise 的区别：事件适合多轮监听与 UI 解耦，promise 适合一次性顺序逻辑。
distinction.en: lifecycle events suit multi-round listeners; finished promise suits one-shot awaits.

items.dz: 动画步进按真实流逝时间计算，帧率无关。
items.de: Step by elapsed time, not by frame count.
items.pz: 120Hz 屏与 60Hz 屏同速：dt = now - last，速度×dt。说「帧率无关」即此。
items.pe: Same speed on 120Hz and 60Hz.

definition.zh: delta-time 计时以两帧之间的真实流逝时间（ms）驱动步进，使模拟速度与显示刷新率无关。
definition.en: Step by elapsed time, not by frame count.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS animation 的区别：CSS 时间轴由浏览器保证帧率无关，delta-time 是 JS/rAF 与物理模拟的手写等价物。
distinction.en: delta-time is the hand-written equivalent of the engine-guaranteed CSS timeline.

items.dz: M3 的标准/强调缓动曲线组：有名字的整套曲线体系。
items.de: Named curve set: standard and emphasized.
items.pz: emphasized-decelerate 进场、emphasized-accelerate 退场——直接引用令牌而非手调贝塞尔。说「用 M3 曲线」即此。
items.pe: Named curves, not hand-tuned beziers.

definition.zh: Material 3 把缓动曲线固化为命名令牌：standard（默认）、emphasized（强调进出场）及其 decelerate/accelerate 变体。
definition.en: Named curve set: standard and emphasized.

distinction.zh: 与手写 cubic-bezier 的区别：令牌是设计系统级一致性约定（带语义名），曲线值随版本统一演进。
distinction.en: tokens are named system curves; hand-tuned beziers are local one-offs.

items.dz: 过渡进行中允许被打断并从当前值继续，而非回退重播。
items.de: Transitions that reverse mid-flight from current values.
items.pz: 快速来回 hover：进度反向续走而非闪回起点——interruptible 是高级手感的核心。说「打断续走」即此。
items.pe: Reversal continues from current value.

definition.zh: 可中断动效指动画/过渡在任意时刻可被新交互打断，且从当前插值状态反向继续（浏览器 transition 天然如此）。
definition.en: Transitions that reverse mid-flight from current values.

distinction.zh: 与 transition-cancel 的区别：cancel 是事件通知机制，interruptible 是动效设计原则（要求短时长+可逆曲线）。
distinction.en: interruptible is a design principle demanding reversible curves; transition-cancel is the event mechanism.

items.dz: 容器从卡片原位扩展为详情页的连续变形。
items.de: A card morphs in place into a detail view.
items.pz: 点卡片→卡片自己长成详情页（不是跳转）：Material 四大转场模式之一。说「容器变身」即此。
items.pe: The card grows into the page.

definition.zh: 容器变换（container transform）让用户点击的容器原地扩展为目标界面，保持空间连续性——Material 运动系统的核心转场模式。
definition.en: A card morphs in place into a detail view.

distinction.zh: 与 shared-axis 的区别：shared-axis 表达前后关系（左右/上下滑入），container transform 表达从属展开；与 shared-element 的区别：shared 是元素跨屏迁移，container 是原地变形。
distinction.en: container transform expands in place; shared-axis expresses order; shared-element migrates across screens.

items.dz: 界面元素沿同一根轴进出：层级关系由方向表达。
items.de: Screens enter and exit along one axis.
items.pz: 前进=左出右进、返回反向：方向即层级语义。说「共享轴转场」即此。
items.pe: Direction encodes hierarchy.

definition.zh: 共享轴（shared axis）是 Material 转场模式：前后界面沿同一根轴滑入滑出，用方向表达界面层级的前后关系。
definition.en: Screens enter and exit along one axis.

distinction.zh: 与 container-transform 的区别：shared-axis 无从属展开关系、只表达顺序；与 tabslide 的区别：那是组件交互，这是页面转场模式。
distinction.en: shared-axis expresses order along an axis; container-transform expresses expansion.

items.dz: 旧界面先淡出、新界面再淡入的串行转场。
items.de: Old fades out, then the new fades in.
items.pz: 串行两段（out 30% → in）避免交叉闪烁：Material 第三种转场模式。说「先出后进」即此。
items.pe: Serial, not cross.

definition.zh: fade-through 是 Material 转场模式：旧界面先完全淡出（通常 90ms），新界面再淡入（210ms），串行避免交叉混叠。
definition.en: Old fades out, then the new fades in.

distinction.zh: 与 crossfade 的区别：crossfade 是并行交叉（两界面同时半透明），fade-through 是串行（永不叠加）；串行消除文字混叠。
distinction.en: fade-through is serial (never overlapping); crossfade blends both layers simultaneously.

items.dz: 拖过头界限时阻力递增、松手弹回。
items.de: Over-drag resists, then snaps back.
items.pz: iOS 边缘拖拽的手感：越拖越紧，松手回弹。说「橡皮筋」即此。
items.pe: The iOS overscroll feel.

definition.zh: 橡皮筋（rubber-band）效果在拖动超出边界时施加递增阻力（位移饱和），松手后以回弹动画归位。
definition.en: Over-drag resists, then snaps back.

distinction.zh: 与 magnet snap 的区别：磁吸是吸附到目标点，rubber-band 是边界过拖保护；与 overscroll-behavior 的区别：那是 CSS 的滚动链控制，rubber-band 是手感模拟。
distinction.en: rubber-band protects boundaries; magnet snap attracts to targets.

items.dz: 让子元素的命名滚动时间轴提升给祖先共享。
items.de: Hoist a child's named timeline to ancestors.
items.pz: 孙元素要驱动祖先的动画？named view-timeline + timeline-scope 向上广播。说「跨层共享时间轴」即此。
items.pe: Cross-element timelines.

definition.zh: timeline-scope 把后代元素命名的滚动/视图时间轴提升到指定祖先作用域，使不在同一子树内的动画也能引用该时间轴。
definition.en: Hoist a child's named timeline to ancestors.

distinction.zh: 与匿名 scroll()/view() 的区别：匿名轴只能就近引用；命名轴 + scope 才能跨子树接线。
distinction.en: named timelines with scope wire across subtrees; anonymous scroll()/view() bind locally.

items.dz: 把动效建模为状态与转换的有限自动机。
items.de: Motion as a finite state machine.
items.pz: 按钮 idle→hover→press→loading→success：每个态有自己的动画与允许转换——可预测可测试。说「状态机动效」即此。
items.pe: Predictable, testable motion graphs.

definition.zh: 状态机动画把 UI 动效组织为有限状态与显式转换（如 XState）：每次只处于一个状态，转换即动画。
definition.en: Motion as a finite state machine.

distinction.zh: 与散落 CSS class 切换的区别：状态机保证无非法转换与并发冲突，可单元测试；与时间轴编排的区别：由事件驱动而非时间驱动。
distinction.en: state machines forbid illegal transitions and are testable; timeline choreography is time-driven.

items.dz: 弹簧动画的三参数物理：质量、刚度、阻尼。
items.de: The spring triple behind natural motion.
items.pz: stiffness 高→回弹快、damping 低→震荡多、mass 大→反应迟钝。说「调弹簧」即此。
items.pe: Three dials for natural feel.

definition.zh: 弹簧动画以质量（mass）、刚度（stiffness）、阻尼（damping）三参数完全确定运动曲线：参数有物理直觉、可映射到任意弹簧库。
definition.en: The spring triple behind natural motion.

distinction.zh: 与贝塞尔缓动的区别：弹簧曲线由初速度与物理参数决定（时长自适应、可中断续走），贝塞尔是固定时长插值。
distinction.en: springs adapt duration to parameters and velocity; beziers run a fixed clock.

items.dz: 静图缓慢缩放平移制造运动错觉的纪录片手法。
items.de: Slow zoom and pan over a still image.
items.pz: 静态 hero 图 + 20s 缓慢 scale(1→1.08) 平移：页面立刻有了呼吸感。说「肯·伯恩斯」即此。
items.pe: Stills learn to breathe.

definition.zh: 肯·伯恩斯效应对静止图像施加极缓慢的缩放与平移，以最低成本赋予静态素材镜头运动感。
definition.en: Slow zoom and pan over a still image.

distinction.zh: 与普通缩放动画的区别：速度极慢（10-20s）、缩放幅度小（5-15%）且缩放平移同时进行，目标是「几乎察觉不到的运动」。
distinction.en: ken-burns is imperceptibly slow over stills; normal zooms are perceptible transforms.

dz: 焦点、播报、对比、命中区、减弱动效——每条都能被验收，不是"加个 aria" 就完事
de: Focus, announcements, contrast, target size, reduced motion — each one testable, not just "add an aria attribute"

items.dz: 键盘走到哪，哪里有一圈
items.de: Wherever the keyboard lands, a ring appears
items.pz: 2px 实心外环 + 2px 偏移，颜色要在深浅底上都够；绝不 outline:none 而不给替代。
items.pe: A 2px solid ring with a 2px offset, legible on light and dark. Never outline:none without a replacement.

definition.zh: 键盘走到哪，哪里有一圈
definition.en: Wherever the keyboard lands, a ring appears

distinction.zh: 2px 实心外环 + 2px 偏移，颜色要在深浅底上都够；绝不 outline:none 而不给替代。
distinction.en: A 2px solid ring with a 2px offset, legible on light and dark. Never outline:none without a replacement.

items.dz: 鼠标点不显环，键盘走才显
items.de: Mouse clicks show no ring; keyboard does
items.pz: 交互样式挂 :focus-visible，:focus 只留作兜底；不要为了"好看"全局关掉。
items.pe: Style :focus-visible and keep :focus as a fallback. Never disable it globally for looks.

definition.zh: 鼠标点不显环，键盘走才显
definition.en: Mouse clicks show no ring; keyboard does

distinction.zh: 交互样式挂 :focus-visible，:focus 只留作兜底；不要为了"好看"全局关掉。
distinction.en: Style :focus-visible and keep :focus as a fallback. Never disable it globally for looks.

items.dz: 模态打开后 Tab 走不出去
items.de: Tab cannot escape an open modal
items.pz: 循环首尾可聚焦元素，Esc 关闭；背景内容加 inert，不只是 aria-hidden。
items.pe: Cycle the first and last focusable nodes, Esc closes, and mark the background inert — not just aria-hidden.

items.dz: 关掉浮层后焦点回到原来那个按钮
items.de: Closing an overlay returns focus to its trigger
items.pz: 打开前存住 document.activeElement，关闭后 focus() 回去；否则键盘用户直接被扔回页首。
items.pe: Store document.activeElement before opening and focus() it back on close, or keyboard users are dumped at the top.

definition.zh: 关掉浮层后焦点回到原来那个按钮
definition.en: Closing an overlay returns focus to its trigger

distinction.zh: 打开前存住 document.activeElement，关闭后 focus() 回去；否则键盘用户直接被扔回页首。
distinction.en: Store document.activeElement before opening and focus() it back on close, or keyboard users are dumped at the top.

items.dz: 第一个 Tab 出现"跳到正文"
items.de: The first Tab reveals "skip to content"
items.pz: 视觉隐藏但可聚焦，聚焦时滑出；目标容器要有 tabindex="-1"。
items.pe: Visually hidden but focusable; it slides in on focus. Give the target container tabindex="-1".

definition.zh: 第一个 Tab 出现"跳到正文"
definition.en: The first Tab reveals "skip to content"

distinction.zh: 视觉隐藏但可聚焦，聚焦时滑出；目标容器要有 tabindex="-1"。
distinction.en: Visually hidden but focusable; it slides in on focus. Give the target container tabindex="-1".

items.dz: 一组控件只占一个 Tab 位
items.de: A whole group takes one Tab stop
items.pz: 组内只有一个 tabindex="0"，其余 -1，方向键在组内移动；工具栏、单选组、日历必用。
items.pe: One tabindex="0" inside the group, the rest -1, arrows move within. Mandatory for toolbars, radio groups, calendars.

definition.zh: 一组控件只占一个 Tab 位
definition.en: A whole group takes one Tab stop

distinction.zh: 组内只有一个 tabindex="0"，其余 -1，方向键在组内移动；工具栏、单选组、日历必用。
distinction.en: One tabindex="0" inside the group, the rest -1, arrows move within. Mandatory for toolbars, radio groups, calendars.

items.zh: 阅读顺序 = DOM 顺序
items.dz: 看起来在左边，Tab 却最后到
items.de: It looks first but Tab reaches it last
items.pz: flex order / grid 定位 / 绝对定位都会把视觉顺序和 DOM 顺序拆开；用 DOM 顺序对齐视觉，别用正 tabindex 打补丁。
items.pe: order, grid placement and absolute positioning split visual from DOM order. Fix the DOM — never patch with positive tabindex.

definition.zh: 看起来在左边，Tab 却最后到
definition.en: It looks first but Tab reaches it last

distinction.zh: flex order / grid 定位 / 绝对定位都会把视觉顺序和 DOM 顺序拆开；用 DOM 顺序对齐视觉，别用正 tabindex 打补丁。
distinction.en: order, grid placement and absolute positioning split visual from DOM order. Fix the DOM — never patch with positive tabindex.

items.dz: 屏幕上看不见，读屏能读到
items.de: Invisible on screen, present to a reader
items.pz: 1px 裁切 + clip-path，不用 display:none 也不用 visibility:hidden（那两个读屏也读不到）。
items.pe: A 1px clipped box — never display:none or visibility:hidden, which hide it from readers too.

definition.zh: 屏幕上看不见，读屏能读到
definition.en: Invisible on screen, present to a reader

distinction.zh: 1px 裁切 + clip-path，不用 display:none 也不用 visibility:hidden（那两个读屏也读不到）。
distinction.en: A 1px clipped box — never display:none or visibility:hidden, which hide it from readers too.

items.dz: 内容变了要说一声
items.de: Say it out loud when content changes
items.pz: aria-live 容器必须在变更前就存在于 DOM；文本要完整成句，不要只播报数字。
items.pe: The aria-live container must exist in the DOM before the change. Announce a whole sentence, not a bare number.

definition.zh: 内容变了要说一声
definition.en: Say it out loud when content changes

distinction.zh: aria-live 容器必须在变更前就存在于 DOM；文本要完整成句，不要只播报数字。
distinction.en: The aria-live container must exist in the DOM before the change. Announce a whole sentence, not a bare number.

items.dz: 插话还是排队
items.de: Interrupt, or wait your turn
items.pz: 状态更新用 polite（排队），只有错误与危险用 assertive（打断）；滥用 assertive 等于一直喊。
items.pe: Status updates are polite (queued); only errors and danger are assertive (interrupting). Overusing assertive means shouting.

definition.zh: 插话还是排队
definition.en: Interrupt, or wait your turn

distinction.zh: 状态更新用 polite（排队），只有错误与危险用 assertive（打断）；滥用 assertive 等于一直喊。
distinction.en: Status updates are polite (queued); only errors and danger are assertive (interrupting). Overusing assertive means shouting.

items.dz: 点标签能聚焦到输入框
items.de: Clicking the label focuses the field
items.pz: label[for] 对应 input[id]，或把 input 包进 label；placeholder 永远不能当标签用。
items.pe: label[for] matched to input[id], or wrap the input in the label. A placeholder is never a label.

definition.zh: 点标签能聚焦到输入框
definition.en: Clicking the label focuses the field

distinction.zh: label[for] 对应 input[id]，或把 input 包进 label；placeholder 永远不能当标签用。
distinction.en: label[for] matched to input[id], or wrap the input in the label. A placeholder is never a label.

items.dz: 每个控件都要能被这三样描述
items.de: Every control needs all three
items.pz: 可访问名称来自 label / aria-label / 内容；角色来自语义标签优先；值用 aria-valuenow 之类。缺一个就等于不可用。
items.pe: The name comes from a label or content, the role from a semantic element first, the value from aria-value*. Missing one makes it unusable.

definition.zh: 每个控件都要能被这三样描述
definition.en: Every control needs all three

distinction.zh: 可访问名称来自 label / aria-label / 内容；角色来自语义标签优先；值用 aria-valuenow 之类。缺一个就等于不可用。
distinction.en: The name comes from a label or content, the role from a semantic element first, the value from aria-value*. Missing one makes it unusable.

items.dz: 读屏用户靠它跳章节
items.de: Readers jump between them
items.pz: header / nav / main / aside / footer 各一个，main 只能有一个；多个同类要加 aria-label 区分。
items.pe: One each of header, nav, main, aside, footer — exactly one main. Label duplicates to tell them apart.

definition.zh: 读屏用户靠它跳章节
definition.en: Readers jump between them

distinction.zh: header / nav / main / aside / footer 各一个，main 只能有一个；多个同类要加 aria-label 区分。
distinction.en: One each of header, nav, main, aside, footer — exactly one main. Label duplicates to tell them apart.

items.dz: h1 到 h6 不能跳级
items.de: No skipped heading levels
items.pz: 一页一个 h1，往下不跳级；标题大小是视觉决定，层级是结构决定，两件事分开。
items.pe: One h1 per page and no level skipping. Size is a visual decision, level is a structural one — keep them separate.

definition.zh: h1 到 h6 不能跳级
definition.en: No skipped heading levels

distinction.zh: 一页一个 h1，往下不跳级；标题大小是视觉决定，层级是结构决定，两件事分开。
distinction.en: One h1 per page and no level skipping. Size is a visual decision, level is a structural one — keep them separate.

items.dz: 有信息就写，纯装饰就留空
items.de: Informative gets text, decorative gets empty
items.pz: 装饰图 alt=""，信息图写清"说了什么"而不是"画了什么"，图表要在正文给出数据。
items.pe: Decorative images get alt="", informative ones say what it means (not what it depicts), and charts need the data in prose.

definition.zh: 有信息就写，纯装饰就留空
definition.en: Informative gets text, decorative gets empty

distinction.zh: 装饰图 alt=""，信息图写清"说了什么"而不是"画了什么"，图表要在正文给出数据。
distinction.en: Decorative images get alt="", informative ones say what it means (not what it depicts), and charts need the data in prose.

items.dz: 有声音就要有字
items.de: If it makes sound, it needs text
items.pz: 字幕含说话人与关键音效，位置避开画面下方 UI；长视频再另配可搜索文字稿。
items.pe: Captions carry speaker labels and key sound effects, placed clear of bottom UI. Long video also needs a searchable transcript.

definition.zh: 有声音就要有字
definition.en: If it makes sound, it needs text

distinction.zh: 字幕含说话人与关键音效，位置避开画面下方 UI；长视频再另配可搜索文字稿。
distinction.en: Captions carry speaker labels and key sound effects, placed clear of bottom UI. Long video also needs a searchable transcript.

items.dz: 把画面里的信息念出来
items.de: Narrate what only the picture says
items.pz: 给纯视觉信息（表情、图表、文字卡）配一条描述音轨或扩展描述版本。
items.pe: Add a description track — or an extended-description cut — for information carried only by the image.

definition.zh: 把画面里的信息念出来
definition.en: Narrate what only the picture says

distinction.zh: 给纯视觉信息（表情、图表、文字卡）配一条描述音轨或扩展描述版本。
distinction.en: Add a description track — or an extended-description cut — for information carried only by the image.

items.de: 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large
items.pz: 算的是文字与其"真实背景"的比；半透明文字、图上文字、渐变上文字都要按最差点算。
items.pe: Measure against the real backdrop. Alpha text, text on photos and text on gradients are all judged at the worst point.

definition.en: 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large

distinction.zh: 算的是文字与其"真实背景"的比；半透明文字、图上文字、渐变上文字都要按最差点算。
distinction.en: Measure against the real backdrop. Alpha text, text on photos and text on gradients are all judged at the worst point.

items.dz: 边框和图标也要够
items.de: Borders and icons need it too
items.pz: 输入框边框、开关轨道、图标、焦点环对相邻色至少 3:1；"极淡的灰线"是最常见的失败点。
items.pe: Field borders, switch tracks, icons and focus rings need 3:1 against neighbours. Hairline greys are the usual failure.

definition.zh: 边框和图标也要够
definition.en: Borders and icons need it too

distinction.zh: 输入框边框、开关轨道、图标、焦点环对相邻色至少 3:1；"极淡的灰线"是最常见的失败点。
distinction.en: Field borders, switch tracks, icons and focus rings need 3:1 against neighbours. Hairline greys are the usual failure.

items.dz: 红绿色盲看不出你的"红涨绿跌"
items.de: Red-green cannot read your up-down colours
items.pz: 成对色改用蓝橙轴，或在色相之外再加明度差、形状、标签；用模拟器验收三种类型。
items.pe: Swap red-green pairs for a blue-orange axis, and add a lightness, shape or label difference. Verify with a simulator.

definition.zh: 红绿色盲看不出你的"红涨绿跌"
definition.en: Red-green cannot read your up-down colours

distinction.zh: 成对色改用蓝橙轴，或在色相之外再加明度差、形状、标签；用模拟器验收三种类型。
distinction.en: Swap red-green pairs for a blue-orange axis, and add a lightness, shape or label difference. Verify with a simulator.

items.dz: 把颜色遮掉还看得懂吗
items.de: Would it still read in greyscale?
items.pz: 状态、必填、错误、图例都要有第二编码：图标、下划线、文案、纹理。
items.pe: States, required marks, errors and legends need a second encoding: an icon, an underline, a word, a texture.

definition.zh: 把颜色遮掉还看得懂吗
definition.en: Would it still read in greyscale?

distinction.zh: 状态、必填、错误、图例都要有第二编码：图标、下划线、文案、纹理。
distinction.en: States, required marks, errors and legends need a second encoding: an icon, an underline, a word, a texture.

items.dz: 视觉可以小，命中区不能小
items.de: It can look small; it cannot be small
items.pz: 移动端 44×44px、桌面 24×24px 起；用 padding 或伪元素撑开命中区，不要放大图标本身。
items.pe: From 44×44px on touch, 24×24px on desktop. Grow the hit area with padding or a pseudo-element, not the icon.

definition.zh: 视觉可以小，命中区不能小
definition.en: It can look small; it cannot be small

distinction.zh: 移动端 44×44px、桌面 24×24px 起；用 padding 或伪元素撑开命中区，不要放大图标本身。
distinction.en: From 44×44px on touch, 24×24px on desktop. Grow the hit area with padding or a pseudo-element, not the icon.

items.dz: 两个小按钮之间要留手指的余量
items.de: Leave room for a fingertip between them
items.pz: 命中区不足时，相邻目标中心距至少 44px；密集图标行是最容易误触的地方。
items.pe: When targets are undersized, keep 44px between centres. Dense icon rows are where mis-taps happen.

definition.zh: 两个小按钮之间要留手指的余量
definition.en: Leave room for a fingertip between them

distinction.zh: 命中区不足时，相邻目标中心距至少 44px；密集图标行是最容易误触的地方。
distinction.en: When targets are undersized, keep 44px between centres. Dense icon rows are where mis-taps happen.

items.dz: 有人一看视差就晕
items.de: Parallax makes some people ill
items.pz: prefers-reduced-motion:reduce 时去掉视差、缩放、旋转、自动轮播，保留淡入与瞬时状态变化。
items.pe: Under prefers-reduced-motion, drop parallax, scale, rotation and autoplay — keep fades and instant state changes.

definition.zh: 有人一看视差就晕
definition.en: Parallax makes some people ill

distinction.zh: prefers-reduced-motion:reduce 时去掉视差、缩放、旋转、自动轮播，保留淡入与瞬时状态变化。
distinction.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion, drop parallax, scale, rotation and autoplay — keep fades and instant state changes.

items.dz: 毛玻璃对某些人就是一团糊
items.de: Frosted glass reads as mud to some
items.pz: prefers-reduced-transparency 时把半透明面板换成实色，去掉 backdrop-filter。
items.pe: Under prefers-reduced-transparency, swap translucent panels for solid fills and drop backdrop-filter.

definition.zh: 毛玻璃对某些人就是一团糊
definition.en: Frosted glass reads as mud to some

distinction.zh: prefers-reduced-transparency 时把半透明面板换成实色，去掉 backdrop-filter。
distinction.en: Under prefers-reduced-transparency, swap translucent panels for solid fills and drop backdrop-filter.

items.dz: Windows 高对比下你的界面还在吗
items.de: Does your UI survive Windows high contrast?
items.pz: forced-colors:active 时系统接管颜色；用 CanvasText / ButtonFace 等系统色，给纯色块加 border 才不会消失。
items.pe: When forced-colors is active the system owns colour. Use system keywords and give solid blocks a border or they vanish.

definition.zh: Windows 高对比下你的界面还在吗
definition.en: Does your UI survive Windows high contrast?

distinction.zh: forced-colors:active 时系统接管颜色；用 CanvasText / ButtonFace 等系统色，给纯色块加 border 才不会消失。
distinction.en: When forced-colors is active the system owns colour. Use system keywords and give solid blocks a border or they vanish.

items.dz: 放大四倍不能出现横向滚动
items.de: No horizontal scroll at 400%
items.pz: 等价于 320px 宽视口：用相对单位、允许换行、避免固定宽容器与两轴滚动。
items.pe: It equals a 320px viewport — relative units, allowed wrapping, no fixed-width containers or two-axis scrolling.

definition.zh: 放大四倍不能出现横向滚动
definition.en: No horizontal scroll at 400%

distinction.zh: 等价于 320px 宽视口：用相对单位、允许换行、避免固定宽容器与两轴滚动。
distinction.en: It equals a 320px viewport — relative units, allowed wrapping, no fixed-width containers or two-axis scrolling.

items.dz: 用户拉大行距不能把字压掉
items.de: User line-height must not clip text
items.pz: 行高 1.5×、段距 2×、字距 0.12em、词距 0.16em 时仍不能截断；给文本容器留可增长的高度。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Survive line-height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2×, letter-spacing .12em, word-spacing .16em without clipping. Let text boxes grow. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 用户拉大行距不能把字压掉
definition.en: User line-height must not clip text

distinction.zh: 行高 1.5×、段距 2×、字距 0.12em、词距 0.16em 时仍不能截断；给文本容器留可增长的高度。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Survive line-height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2×, letter-spacing .12em, word-spacing .16em without clipping. Let text boxes grow. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 轮椅上装的平板转不过来
items.de: A mounted tablet cannot be rotated
items.pz: 除游戏等本质需求外不要锁 orientation；横竖两种布局都要能用。
items.pe: Do not lock orientation unless it is essential. Both portrait and landscape must work.

definition.zh: 轮椅上装的平板转不过来
definition.en: A mounted tablet cannot be rotated

distinction.zh: 除游戏等本质需求外不要锁 orientation；横竖两种布局都要能用。
distinction.en: Do not lock orientation unless it is essential. Both portrait and landscape must work.

items.dz: 会话要过期得先问一句
items.de: Warn before the session dies
items.pz: 至少提前 20 秒提示，并提供"延长"；表单内容要能恢复，不能一刷新全没。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Warn at least 20 seconds ahead with an extend action, and preserve form content across the refresh. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 会话要过期得先问一句
definition.en: Warn before the session dies

distinction.zh: 至少提前 20 秒提示，并提供"延长"；表单内容要能恢复，不能一刷新全没。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Warn at least 20 seconds ahead with an extend action, and preserve form content across the refresh. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 超过 5 秒的自动动作必须能停
items.de: Anything auto over 5s needs a stop
items.pz: 轮播、跑马灯、动图都要有暂停控件，且默认不自动播放声音。
items.pe: Carousels, marquees and animated media need a pause control, and never autoplay audio.

definition.zh: 超过 5 秒的自动动作必须能停
definition.en: Anything auto over 5s needs a stop

distinction.zh: 轮播、跑马灯、动图都要有暂停控件，且默认不自动播放声音。
distinction.en: Carousels, marquees and animated media need a pause control, and never autoplay audio.

items.dz: 闪太快会诱发癫痫
items.de: Fast flashing can trigger seizures
items.pz: 任何区域每秒闪烁不超过 3 次，且不要大面积红色闪动；故障风、霓虹风尤其要收着。
items.pe: No more than three flashes per second in any region, and never large-area red flashing. Glitch and neon styles need restraint.

definition.zh: 闪太快会诱发癫痫
definition.en: Fast flashing can trigger seizures

distinction.zh: 任何区域每秒闪烁不超过 3 次，且不要大面积红色闪动；故障风、霓虹风尤其要收着。
distinction.en: No more than three flashes per second in any region, and never large-area red flashing. Glitch and neon styles need restraint.

items.dz: 错在哪、是哪条
items.de: Which field, and which rule
items.pz: 错误要文字化并与字段关联（aria-describedby），聚焦到第一个错误；不要只把边框变红。
items.pe: Errors are text, linked to the field with aria-describedby, and focus moves to the first one. A red border alone is not an error message.

definition.zh: 错在哪、是哪条
definition.en: Which field, and which rule

distinction.zh: 错误要文字化并与字段关联（aria-describedby），聚焦到第一个错误；不要只把边框变红。
distinction.en: Errors are text, linked to the field with aria-describedby, and focus moves to the first one. A red border alone is not an error message.

items.dz: 别只说错了，说怎么改
items.de: Say how to fix it, not just that it broke
items.pz: 给出示例、允许值域或一键修正；金融与法律场景还要给撤销窗口。
items.pe: Offer an example, the allowed range, or a one-tap fix. Financial and legal flows also need an undo window.

definition.zh: 别只说错了，说怎么改
definition.en: Say how to fix it, not just that it broke

distinction.zh: 给出示例、允许值域或一键修正；金融与法律场景还要给撤销窗口。
distinction.en: Offer an example, the allowed range, or a one-tap fix. Financial and legal flows also need an undo window.

items.dz: 把说明放在需要它的地方
items.de: Put the hint where the doubt is
items.pz: 帮助文本放在标签下、输入前，常驻而不是悬停才出；tooltip 里的关键信息等于没有。
items.pe: Help sits under the label, before the field, and stays visible. Critical information inside a tooltip is invisible.

definition.zh: 把说明放在需要它的地方
definition.en: Put the hint where the doubt is

distinction.zh: 帮助文本放在标签下、输入前，常驻而不是悬停才出；tooltip 里的关键信息等于没有。
distinction.en: Help sits under the label, before the field, and stays visible. Critical information inside a tooltip is invisible.

items.dz: 让浏览器和密码管理器帮上忙
items.de: Let the browser and password manager help
items.pz: 按规范写 autocomplete（name / email / one-time-code / new-password），对认知障碍与运动障碍用户帮助最大。
items.pe: Use the standard tokens (name, email, one-time-code, new-password). It helps cognitive and motor users the most.

definition.zh: 让浏览器和密码管理器帮上忙
definition.en: Let the browser and password manager help

distinction.zh: 按规范写 autocomplete（name / email / one-time-code / new-password），对认知障碍与运动障碍用户帮助最大。
distinction.en: Use the standard tokens (name, email, one-time-code, new-password). It helps cognitive and motor users the most.

items.dz: 星号之外还要有话
items.de: An asterisk is not a sentence
items.pz: 用 required 属性 + 文字"必填"，并在表单顶部说明标记含义；反过来标"选填"往往更清楚。
items.pe: Use the required attribute plus the word, and explain the mark at the top. Marking the optional fields is often clearer.

definition.zh: 星号之外还要有话
definition.en: An asterisk is not a sentence

distinction.zh: 用 required 属性 + 文字"必填"，并在表单顶部说明标记含义；反过来标"选填"往往更清楚。
distinction.en: Use the required attribute plus the word, and explain the mark at the top. Marking the optional fields is often clearer.

items.dz: 一组单选要有一个组名
items.de: A radio group needs a group name
items.pz: 用 fieldset + legend 或 role="group" + aria-labelledby，否则读屏只念得到"选项一"。
items.pe: Use fieldset with legend, or role="group" with aria-labelledby, or a reader only hears "option one".

definition.zh: 一组单选要有一个组名
definition.en: A radio group needs a group name

distinction.zh: 用 fieldset + legend 或 role="group" + aria-labelledby，否则读屏只念得到"选项一"。
distinction.en: Use fieldset with legend, or role="group" with aria-labelledby, or a reader only hears "option one".

items.dz: 用原生 dialog，别自己搭
items.de: Use the native dialog, do not rebuild it

items.dz: aria-expanded 必须跟着变

items.pz: 触发器是 button，带 aria-expanded 与 aria-controls；箭头旋转只是视觉，状态在属性里。
items.pe: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. The rotating caret is decoration; the state lives in the attribute.

definition.zh: aria-expanded 必须跟着变
definition.en: aria-expanded has to actually change

distinction.zh: 触发器是 button，带 aria-expanded 与 aria-controls；箭头旋转只是视觉，状态在属性里。
distinction.en: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. The rotating caret is decoration; the state lives in the attribute.

items.dz: tablist / tab / tabpanel 三件套
items.de: The tablist, tab and tabpanel triad
items.pz: aria-selected 标当前项，方向键切换（roving tabindex），面板用 aria-labelledby 指回标签。
items.pe: aria-selected marks the current tab, arrows switch with roving tabindex, and the panel points back with aria-labelledby.

definition.zh: tablist / tab / tabpanel 三件套
definition.en: The tablist, tab and tabpanel triad

distinction.zh: aria-selected 标当前项，方向键切换（roving tabindex），面板用 aria-labelledby 指回标签。
distinction.en: aria-selected marks the current tab, arrows switch with roving tabindex, and the panel points back with aria-labelledby.

items.dz: 能打字也能选，语义最容易写错

definition.zh: 能打字也能选，语义最容易写错
