definition.zh: 没有粗体字重就会被"描一圈"
definition.en: Without a bold cut the browser strokes it

distinction.zh: 中文字体家族常只有 Regular/Medium；缺字重时浏览器合成加粗会糊。要么装真字重，要么只用 400/500。
distinction.en: CJK families often ship only Regular and Medium. Synthetic bold blurs — install the real weight or stay at 400/500.

items.dz: 日文书籍与中文题词会竖着走
items.de: Japanese books and Chinese inscriptions run vertically
items.pz: writing-mode:vertical-rl + text-orientation:upright；数字与拉丁要用 text-combine-upright 做"纵中横"。
items.pe: writing-mode:vertical-rl with text-orientation:upright, and text-combine-upright for numerals and Latin runs.

definition.zh: 日文书籍与中文题词会竖着走
definition.en: Japanese books and Chinese inscriptions run vertically

distinction.zh: writing-mode:vertical-rl + text-orientation:upright；数字与拉丁要用 text-combine-upright 做"纵中横"。
distinction.en: writing-mode:vertical-rl with text-orientation:upright, and text-combine-upright for numerals and Latin runs.

items.dz: 汉字上面那一行小字
items.de: The small line above the characters
items.pz: <ruby> + <rt>，ruby-position 控制上下；行高要预留注音空间，否则会压到上一行。
items.pe: ruby with rt, positioned by ruby-position. Reserve line height or the annotation collides with the line above.

definition.zh: 汉字上面那一行小字
definition.en: The small line above the characters

distinction.zh: <ruby> + <rt>，ruby-position 控制上下；行高要预留注音空间，否则会压到上一行。
distinction.en: ruby with rt, positioned by ruby-position. Reserve line height or the annotation collides with the line above.

items.dz: 德语能把按钮撑破
items.de: German bursts your button
items.pz: 德/俄/芬兰比英文长 30–40%，日韩更短；按钮与标签要能换行或截断，绝不写死宽度。
items.pe: German, Russian and Finnish run 30–40% longer than English; CJK runs shorter. Let buttons wrap or truncate — never fix their width.

definition.zh: 德语能把按钮撑破
definition.en: German bursts your button

distinction.zh: 德/俄/芬兰比英文长 30–40%，日韩更短；按钮与标签要能换行或截断，绝不写死宽度。
distinction.en: German, Russian and Finnish run 30–40% longer than English; CJK runs shorter. Let buttons wrap or truncate — never fix their width.

items.dz: "你有" + n + "条消息"在别的语言里语序不同
items.de: Word order differs elsewhere
items.pz: 整句作为一个可翻译单元，变量用占位符；语序、量词、介词位置都由译文自己决定。
items.pe: Make the whole sentence one translatable unit with placeholders. Word order, measure words and prepositions belong to the translation.

definition.zh: "你有" + n + "条消息"在别的语言里语序不同
definition.en: Word order differs elsewhere

distinction.zh: 整句作为一个可翻译单元，变量用占位符；语序、量词、介词位置都由译文自己决定。
distinction.en: Make the whole sentence one translatable unit with placeholders. Word order, measure words and prepositions belong to the translation.

items.dz: 不是"1 个"和"n 个"两种
items.de: It is not just one and many
items.pz: 阿拉伯语 6 类、俄语 4 类、中文 1 类；用 Intl.PluralRules 与 ICU MessageFormat，别写 n>1 的三目。
items.pe: Arabic has six categories, Russian four, Chinese one. Use Intl.PluralRules and ICU MessageFormat, never n>1 ternaries.

definition.zh: 不是"1 个"和"n 个"两种
definition.en: It is not just one and many

distinction.zh: 阿拉伯语 6 类、俄语 4 类、中文 1 类；用 Intl.PluralRules 与 ICU MessageFormat，别写 n>1 的三目。
distinction.en: Arabic has six categories, Russian four, Chinese one. Use Intl.PluralRules and ICU MessageFormat, never n>1 ternaries.

items.dz: 同一个词在句中要变形
items.de: The same word inflects in place
items.pz: 斯拉夫语系有格变化，罗曼语系有性；UI 里避免把人名塞进有格变化的句式，或让译者提供多个变体。
items.pe: Slavic languages inflect for case, Romance for gender. Avoid slotting names into inflected sentences, or let translators supply variants.

definition.zh: 同一个词在句中要变形
definition.en: The same word inflects in place

distinction.zh: 斯拉夫语系有格变化，罗曼语系有性；UI 里避免把人名塞进有格变化的句式，或让译者提供多个变体。
distinction.en: Slavic languages inflect for case, Romance for gender. Avoid slotting names into inflected sentences, or let translators supply variants.

items.dz: 03/04 到底是三月四日还是四月三日
items.de: Is 03/04 March or April?
items.pz: 一律用 Intl.DateTimeFormat 与 locale；日志与 API 用 ISO 8601，界面上写月份名避免歧义。
items.pe: Always Intl.DateTimeFormat with a locale. Use ISO 8601 in logs and APIs, and spell the month in UI.

definition.zh: 03/04 到底是三月四日还是四月三日
definition.en: Is 03/04 March or April?

distinction.zh: 一律用 Intl.DateTimeFormat 与 locale；日志与 API 用 ISO 8601，界面上写月份名避免歧义。
distinction.en: Always Intl.DateTimeFormat with a locale. Use ISO 8601 in logs and APIs, and spell the month in UI.

items.de: Germany writes 1.234,56
items.pz: 千分位与小数点因地而异，印度用 lakh/crore 分组；Intl.NumberFormat 处理，永远不要手写正则。
items.pe: Separators differ, and India groups by lakh and crore. Use Intl.NumberFormat and never hand-roll a regex.

definition.en: Germany writes 1.234,56

distinction.zh: 千分位与小数点因地而异，印度用 lakh/crore 分组；Intl.NumberFormat 处理，永远不要手写正则。
distinction.en: Separators differ, and India groups by lakh and crore. Use Intl.NumberFormat and never hand-roll a regex.

items.dz: 符号在前在后、有没有空格都不同
items.de: Symbol before, after, spaced or not
items.pz: Intl.NumberFormat 的 currency 样式；金额存整数最小单位（分），显示时才格式化，避免浮点误差。
items.pe: Use the currency style, store amounts as integer minor units, and format only at display time to dodge float errors.

definition.zh: 符号在前在后、有没有空格都不同
definition.en: Symbol before, after, spaced or not

distinction.zh: Intl.NumberFormat 的 currency 样式；金额存整数最小单位（分），显示时才格式化，避免浮点误差。
distinction.en: Use the currency style, store amounts as integer minor units, and format only at display time to dodge float errors.

items.dz: 公顷、英亩、平方公里
items.de: Hectares, acres, square kilometres
items.pz: Intl.NumberFormat 的 unit 样式；同时给主单位与括号换算，别只给一个体系的人看得懂的数。
items.pe: Use the unit style, and show a converted value in parentheses. Do not publish a number only one measurement system understands.

definition.zh: 公顷、英亩、平方公里
definition.en: Hectares, acres, square kilometres

distinction.zh: Intl.NumberFormat 的 unit 样式；同时给主单位与括号换算，别只给一个体系的人看得懂的数。
distinction.en: Use the unit style, and show a converted value in parentheses. Do not publish a number only one measurement system understands.

items.dz: 按 Unicode 码点排序等于乱排
items.de: Code-point order is not alphabetical order
items.pz: Intl.Collator 按 locale 排；瑞典语 Å 在 Z 后，德语 ä 视作 a，中文可按拼音或笔画。
items.pe: Intl.Collator sorts per locale — Swedish Å follows Z, German ä sorts as a, Chinese by pinyin or stroke count.

definition.zh: 按 Unicode 码点排序等于乱排
definition.en: Code-point order is not alphabetical order

distinction.zh: Intl.Collator 按 locale 排；瑞典语 Å 在 Z 后，德语 ä 视作 a，中文可按拼音或笔画。
distinction.en: Intl.Collator sorts per locale — Swedish Å follows Z, German ä sorts as a, Chinese by pinyin or stroke count.

items.dz: 不是所有人都有"名"和"姓"
items.de: Not everyone has a first and last name
items.pz: 优先一个"全名"字段 + 可选"显示名"；需要拆分时标清顺序，并支持单名、多姓、非拉丁字符。
items.pe: Prefer one full-name field plus an optional display name. If you must split, label the order and allow mononyms and non-Latin scripts.

definition.zh: 不是所有人都有"名"和"姓"
definition.en: Not everyone has a first and last name

distinction.zh: 优先一个"全名"字段 + 可选"显示名"；需要拆分时标清顺序，并支持单名、多姓、非拉丁字符。
distinction.en: Prefer one full-name field plus an optional display name. If you must split, label the order and allow mononyms and non-Latin scripts.

items.dz: 省市区不是全球通用结构
items.de: State and ZIP are not universal
items.pz: 先选国家，再按国家渲染字段集与顺序；邮编不一定存在、不一定是数字、不一定必填。
items.pe: Pick the country first, then render that country's field set and order. Postcodes may not exist, may not be numeric, may be optional.

definition.zh: 省市区不是全球通用结构
definition.en: State and ZIP are not universal

distinction.zh: 先选国家，再按国家渲染字段集与顺序；邮编不一定存在、不一定是数字、不一定必填。
distinction.en: Pick the country first, then render that country's field set and order. Postcodes may not exist, may not be numeric, may be optional.

items.dz: 别做长度和格式校验
items.de: Do not validate length or shape
items.pz: 存 E.164（+ 国家码），显示时按 locale 分组；输入框给国家选择器而不是正则拦人。
items.pe: Store E.164 with the country code and group for display. Offer a country picker instead of a regex that rejects real numbers.

definition.zh: 别做长度和格式校验
definition.en: Do not validate length or shape

distinction.zh: 存 E.164（+ 国家码），显示时按 locale 分组；输入框给国家选择器而不是正则拦人。
distinction.en: Store E.164 with the country code and group for display. Offer a country picker instead of a regex that rejects real numbers.

items.dz: 不是所有人都用公历
items.de: Not everyone uses the Gregorian calendar
items.pz: 伊斯兰历、佛历、和历、希伯来历都在用；Intl 支持 calendar 选项，日期选择器要能切换。
items.pe: Islamic, Buddhist, Japanese-era and Hebrew calendars are all in daily use. Intl supports a calendar option; your date picker should too.

definition.zh: 不是所有人都用公历
definition.en: Not everyone uses the Gregorian calendar

distinction.zh: 伊斯兰历、佛历、和历、希伯来历都在用；Intl 支持 calendar 选项，日期选择器要能切换。
distinction.en: Islamic, Buddhist, Japanese-era and Hebrew calendars are all in daily use. Intl supports a calendar option; your date picker should too.

items.dz: UTC 存储，本地显示，还要说清是哪个时区
items.de: Store UTC, show local, name the zone
items.pz: 存 UTC 时间戳 + 事件的 IANA 时区名；跨时区会议要显示两个时区，并标 DST 变更。
items.pe: Store a UTC instant plus the event's IANA zone. Cross-zone meetings show both, and flag DST transitions.

definition.zh: UTC 存储，本地显示，还要说清是哪个时区
definition.en: Store UTC, show local, name the zone

distinction.zh: 存 UTC 时间戳 + 事件的 IANA 时区名；跨时区会议要显示两个时区，并标 DST 变更。
distinction.en: Store a UTC instant plus the event's IANA zone. Cross-zone meetings show both, and flag DST transitions.

items.dz: 周一开始还是周日开始
items.de: Monday or Sunday
items.pz: 中国与欧洲多为周一、美国与日本多为周日、部分中东为周六；用 locale 的 weekInfo，不要写死。
items.pe: Monday in Europe and China, Sunday in the US and Japan, Saturday in parts of the Middle East. Read locale weekInfo.

definition.zh: 周一开始还是周日开始
definition.en: Monday or Sunday

distinction.zh: 中国与欧洲多为周一、美国与日本多为周日、部分中东为周六；用 locale 的 weekInfo，不要写死。
distinction.en: Monday in Europe and China, Sunday in the US and Japan, Saturday in parts of the Middle East. Read locale weekInfo.

items.dz: 缺字会跳到一个完全不同的字体
items.de: A missing glyph jumps to another face
items.pz: 按语言给不同栈（CJK 要显式列思源/苹方/微软雅黑），用 unicode-range 分片，避免一句话里三种字形。
items.pe: Give each script its own stack, split with unicode-range, and avoid three different faces inside one sentence.

definition.zh: 缺字会跳到一个完全不同的字体
definition.en: A missing glyph jumps to another face

distinction.zh: 按语言给不同栈（CJK 要显式列思源/苹方/微软雅黑），用 unicode-range 分片，避免一句话里三种字形。
distinction.en: Give each script its own stack, split with unicode-range, and avoid three different faces inside one sentence.

items.dz: 不写 lang，读屏会用错发音
items.de: Without lang, the reader mispronounces
items.pz: <html lang> 必写，段落内换语言要在元素上标 lang；它还影响断行规则、连字与引号形状。
items.pe: Set html lang, and mark inline language switches on the element. It also drives line breaking, ligatures and quote shapes.

definition.zh: 不写 lang，读屏会用错发音
definition.en: Without lang, the reader mispronounces

distinction.zh: <html lang> 必写，段落内换语言要在元素上标 lang；它还影响断行规则、连字与引号形状。
distinction.en: Set html lang, and mark inline language switches on the element. It also drives line breaking, ligatures and quote shapes.

items.dz: 同一个字号，中文看起来更小
items.de: The same size reads smaller in Han
items.pz: CJK 通常要比拉丁大 1–2px、行高再高 0.1–0.2；用 :lang() 选择器分别微调，而不是一套值全局用。
items.pe: CJK usually needs 1–2px more size and 0.1–0.2 more line height. Tune per :lang() rather than one global value.

definition.zh: 同一个字号，中文看起来更小
definition.en: The same size reads smaller in Han

distinction.zh: CJK 通常要比拉丁大 1–2px、行高再高 0.1–0.2；用 :lang() 选择器分别微调，而不是一套值全局用。
distinction.en: CJK usually needs 1–2px more size and 0.1–0.2 more line height. Tune per :lang() rather than one global value.

items.dz: 汉字方块密，行高要更松
items.de: Dense square glyphs need looser leading
items.pz: 中文正文 1.7–1.9，拉丁 1.5–1.6；标题可以收到 1.3，但绝不能像拉丁标题那样压到 1.0。
items.pe: Chinese body text wants 1.7–1.9 against 1.5–1.6 for Latin. Headings can tighten to 1.3, never to 1.0.

definition.zh: 汉字方块密，行高要更松
definition.en: Dense square glyphs need looser leading

distinction.zh: 中文正文 1.7–1.9，拉丁 1.5–1.6；标题可以收到 1.3，但绝不能像拉丁标题那样压到 1.0。
distinction.en: Chinese body text wants 1.7–1.9 against 1.5–1.6 for Latin. Headings can tighten to 1.3, never to 1.0.

items.dz: 汉字和拉丁之间要有一点气
items.de: A hair of space between Han and Latin
items.pz: text-autospace 或在构建期插入 1/4 空；数字与单位之间也要，"5GB" 不如 "5 GB"。
items.pe: Use text-autospace, or insert a quarter space at build time. Numerals and units want it too — 5 GB, not 5GB.

definition.zh: 汉字和拉丁之间要有一点气
definition.en: A hair of space between Han and Latin

distinction.zh: text-autospace 或在构建期插入 1/4 空；数字与单位之间也要，"5GB" 不如 "5 GB"。
distinction.en: Use text-autospace, or insert a quarter space at build time. Numerals and units want it too — 5 GB, not 5GB.

items.dz: 省略号在不同语言里不一样宽
items.de: The ellipsis is not the same width everywhere
items.pz: 优先多行截断（line-clamp）而不是单行；CJK 按字截断没问题，拉丁要按词，且要给 title 或展开。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Prefer line-clamp to single-line truncation. CJK may break mid-run; Latin must break on words — and always offer the full text. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 省略号在不同语言里不一样宽
definition.en: The ellipsis is not the same width everywhere

distinction.zh: 优先多行截断（line-clamp）而不是单行；CJK 按字截断没问题，拉丁要按词，且要给 title 或展开。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Prefer line-clamp to single-line truncation. CJK may break mid-run; Latin must break on words — and always offer the full text. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 阿拉伯语区用的是另一套数字
items.de: Arabic locales use different digits
items.pz: 阿拉伯-印度数字（٠١٢）、天城体数字都在用；Intl 的 numberingSystem 控制，表格对齐要用等宽数字。
items.pe: Eastern Arabic and Devanagari digits are in real use. Control it with numberingSystem, and align tables with tabular figures.

definition.zh: 阿拉伯语区用的是另一套数字
definition.en: Arabic locales use different digits

distinction.zh: 阿拉伯-印度数字（٠١٢）、天城体数字都在用；Intl 的 numberingSystem 控制，表格对齐要用等宽数字。
distinction.en: Eastern Arabic and Devanagari digits are in real use. Control it with numberingSystem, and align tables with tabular figures.

items.dz: 打拼音也要能搜到汉字
items.de: Pinyin should find Han characters
items.pz: 索引时同时存原文、拼音全拼与首字母；日文要存假名读音，阿拉伯语要去变音符号。
items.pe: Index the original plus full and initial pinyin. Japanese needs kana readings, Arabic needs diacritics stripped.

definition.zh: 打拼音也要能搜到汉字
definition.en: Pinyin should find Han characters

distinction.zh: 索引时同时存原文、拼音全拼与首字母；日文要存假名读音，阿拉伯语要去变音符号。
distinction.en: Index the original plus full and initial pinyin. Japanese needs kana readings, Arabic needs diacritics stripped.

items.dz: 拼音还没上屏就别去搜索
items.de: Do not search while the IME is composing
items.pz: 监听 compositionstart / compositionend，组合期间不触发查询与校验；否则每敲一个字母都发请求。
items.pe: Listen for compositionstart and compositionend and suppress queries in between, or every keystroke fires a request.

definition.zh: 拼音还没上屏就别去搜索
definition.en: Do not search while the IME is composing

distinction.zh: 监听 compositionstart / compositionend，组合期间不触发查询与校验；否则每敲一个字母都发请求。
distinction.en: Listen for compositionstart and compositionend and suppress queries in between, or every keystroke fires a request.

items.dz: % 前面有没有空格也是本地习惯
items.de: Even the space before % is local
items.pz: 法语 12 % 有空格、英语 12% 没有；负号位置、括号表负也因地区与会计习惯而异。
items.pe: French writes 12 %, English 12%. Minus placement and parenthesised negatives vary by locale and accounting convention.

definition.zh: % 前面有没有空格也是本地习惯
definition.en: Even the space before % is local

distinction.zh: 法语 12 % 有空格、英语 12% 没有；负号位置、括号表负也因地区与会计习惯而异。
distinction.en: French writes 12 %, English 12%. Minus placement and parenthesised negatives vary by locale and accounting convention.

items.dz: 键名要说明"在哪、干什么"
items.de: A key says where and what
items.pz: 用 area.component.action 这类层级键，不要用英文原文当键；带上下文注释与最大长度约束给译者。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Use hierarchical keys like area.component.action, never the English string. Ship translator notes and a max length. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 键名要说明"在哪、干什么"
definition.en: A key says where and what

distinction.zh: 用 area.component.action 这类层级键，不要用英文原文当键；带上下文注释与最大长度约束给译者。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Use hierarchical keys like area.component.action, never the English string. Ship translator notes and a max length. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 上线前先用假语言把界面撑一遍
items.de: Stress the UI with a fake language first
items.pz: 把文案自动加长 40%、加变音符号、两端加方括号：一眼看出硬编码字符串与撑破的容器。
items.pe: Auto-expand strings 40%, add accents and wrap in brackets. Hard-coded strings and burst containers reveal themselves instantly.

definition.zh: 上线前先用假语言把界面撑一遍
definition.en: Stress the UI with a fake language first

distinction.zh: 把文案自动加长 40%、加变音符号、两端加方括号：一眼看出硬编码字符串与撑破的容器。
distinction.en: Auto-expand strings 40%, add accents and wrap in brackets. Hard-coded strings and burst containers reveal themselves instantly.

items.dz: 每次改文案都可能撑破别的语言
items.de: Every copy change can burst another locale
items.pz: 把最长语言（德/俄/芬）与 RTL 各截一版进视觉回归；CI 里跑一次比上线后修十次便宜。
items.pe: Snapshot the longest locales and one RTL build in visual regression. One CI pass beats ten post-launch patches.

definition.zh: 每次改文案都可能撑破别的语言
definition.en: Every copy change can burst another locale

distinction.zh: 把最长语言（德/俄/芬）与 RTL 各截一版进视觉回归；CI 里跑一次比上线后修十次便宜。
distinction.en: Snapshot the longest locales and one RTL build in visual regression. One CI pass beats ten post-launch patches.

dz: 暗色不是把颜色反过来，是另一套光照模型；再加上 token 分层、品牌切换与首屏防闪
de: Dark mode is a different lighting model, not an inversion — plus token tiers, brand switching and no first-paint flash

items.dz: 别叫 grey-400，叫 border-subtle
items.de: Not grey-400 — border-subtle
items.pz: 三层：原始色阶 → 语义角色（surface / border / text-muted）→ 组件专用；组件只许用语义层。
items.pe: Three tiers: raw ramp → semantic role (surface, border, text-muted) → component alias. Components may only touch the semantic tier.

definition.zh: 别叫 grey-400，叫 border-subtle
definition.en: Not grey-400 — border-subtle

distinction.zh: 三层：原始色阶 → 语义角色（surface / border / text-muted）→ 组件专用；组件只许用语义层。
distinction.en: Three tiers: raw ramp → semantic role (surface, border, text-muted) → component alias. Components may only touch the semantic tier.

items.dz: 改一个原始色不该改遍全站
items.de: Changing one raw colour should not ripple everywhere
items.pz: raw 只被 semantic 引用，semantic 只被 component 引用；跨层直引是维护地狱的起点。
items.pe: Raw feeds semantic, semantic feeds component. A cross-tier reference is where the maintenance debt begins.

definition.zh: 改一个原始色不该改遍全站
definition.en: Changing one raw colour should not ripple everywhere

distinction.zh: raw 只被 semantic 引用，semantic 只被 component 引用；跨层直引是维护地狱的起点。
distinction.en: Raw feeds semantic, semantic feeds component. A cross-tier reference is where the maintenance debt begins.

items.dz: 让改版只改一层
items.de: A redesign should touch one layer
items.pz: 组件写 button-bg 而不是 accent-600；换品牌或换主题时只重新指向别名，组件代码一行不动。
items.pe: Components read button-bg, not accent-600. Rebranding repoints the aliases and leaves component code untouched.

definition.zh: 让改版只改一层
definition.en: A redesign should touch one layer

distinction.zh: 组件写 button-bg 而不是 accent-600；换品牌或换主题时只重新指向别名，组件代码一行不动。
distinction.en: Components read button-bg, not accent-600. Rebranding repoints the aliases and leaves component code untouched.

items.dz: 一行就修好滚动条和表单控件
items.de: One line fixes scrollbars and form controls
items.pz: :root{color-scheme:light dark} 让原生控件、滚动条、系统对话框跟着主题；漏了它暗色下会露出白条。
items.pe: color-scheme:light dark makes native controls, scrollbars and system dialogs follow. Skip it and white bars show through.

definition.zh: 一行就修好滚动条和表单控件
definition.en: One line fixes scrollbars and form controls

distinction.zh: :root{color-scheme:light dark} 让原生控件、滚动条、系统对话框跟着主题；漏了它暗色下会露出白条。
distinction.en: color-scheme:light dark makes native controls, scrollbars and system dialogs follow. Skip it and white bars show through.

items.dz: 纯白变纯黑会刺眼到发光
items.de: Pure white to pure black glares
items.pz: 暗色底用 #12151a 一类而非 #000，文字用 #e8ecf1 而非 #fff；对比拉满会产生光晕（halation）。
items.pe: Use about #12151a rather than pure black, and #e8ecf1 rather than pure white. Maxed contrast causes halation.

definition.zh: 纯白变纯黑会刺眼到发光
definition.en: Pure white to pure black glares

distinction.zh: 暗色底用 #12151a 一类而非 #000，文字用 #e8ecf1 而非 #fff；对比拉满会产生光晕（halation）。
distinction.en: Use about #12151a rather than pure black, and #e8ecf1 rather than pure white. Maxed contrast causes halation.

items.dz: 暗色里越高越亮，不是越暗
items.de: Higher means lighter, not darker
items.pz: 亮色靠阴影表示层级，暗色靠"表面变亮"；每升一级底色提亮 3–5%，阴影只做辅助。
items.pe: Light mode encodes depth with shadow; dark mode encodes it with a lighter surface — about 3–5% per step.

definition.zh: 暗色里越高越亮，不是越暗
definition.en: Higher means lighter, not darker

distinction.zh: 亮色靠阴影表示层级，暗色靠"表面变亮"；每升一级底色提亮 3–5%，阴影只做辅助。
distinction.en: Light mode encodes depth with shadow; dark mode encodes it with a lighter surface — about 3–5% per step.

items.dz: 亮色的饱和色在暗底上会震动
items.de: Saturated hues vibrate on dark
items.pz: 暗色主题的强调色要降饱和、提明度；同一个品牌色在两个主题下应该是两个数值。
items.pe: Dark themes need less saturation and more lightness. One brand hue means two different values across themes.

definition.zh: 亮色的饱和色在暗底上会震动
definition.en: Saturated hues vibrate on dark

distinction.zh: 暗色主题的强调色要降饱和、提明度；同一个品牌色在两个主题下应该是两个数值。
distinction.en: Dark themes need less saturation and more lightness. One brand hue means two different values across themes.

items.dz: 暗色里一张亮照片像手电筒
items.de: A bright photo is a torch in dark mode
items.pz: 给图片加 filter:brightness(.86) 或半透明遮罩；纯白背景的产品图要换成透明或深底版本。
items.pe: Apply brightness(.86) or a scrim. Product shots on white need a transparent or dark-ground variant.

definition.zh: 暗色里一张亮照片像手电筒
definition.en: A bright photo is a torch in dark mode

distinction.zh: 给图片加 filter:brightness(.86) 或半透明遮罩；纯白背景的产品图要换成透明或深底版本。
distinction.en: Apply brightness(.86) or a scrim. Product shots on white need a transparent or dark-ground variant.

items.zh: 暗色用高光而不是阴影
items.dz: 黑底上的黑影看不见
items.de: A black shadow is invisible on black
items.pz: 用 inset 顶部 1px 高光 + 边框透明白（rgba(255,255,255,.08)）代替投影；投影只在极亮元素下保留。
items.pe: Use a 1px inset top highlight and a translucent white border instead. Keep drop shadows only under very light elements.

definition.zh: 黑底上的黑影看不见
definition.en: A black shadow is invisible on black

distinction.zh: 用 inset 顶部 1px 高光 + 边框透明白（rgba(255,255,255,.08)）代替投影；投影只在极亮元素下保留。
distinction.en: Use a 1px inset top highlight and a translucent white border instead. Keep drop shadows only under very light elements.

items.dz: 品牌色可能在暗底上根本不合格
items.de: Your brand hue may simply fail on dark
items.pz: 先测对比度，不合格就在暗色里换成品牌色的亮阶，或者只把它用在大字与图形上。
items.pe: Measure first. If it fails, use a lighter step of the brand ramp in dark, or restrict it to large type and graphics.

definition.zh: 品牌色可能在暗底上根本不合格
definition.en: Your brand hue may simply fail on dark

distinction.zh: 先测对比度，不合格就在暗色里换成品牌色的亮阶，或者只把它用在大字与图形上。
distinction.en: Measure first. If it fails, use a lighter step of the brand ramp in dark, or restrict it to large type and graphics.

items.dz: 亮 / 暗 / 跟随系统
items.de: Light, dark, system
items.pz: 默认"跟随系统"，用户显式选择后才写入存储；二态切换会让用户失去跟随能力。
items.pe: Default to system and only persist an explicit choice. A two-state toggle takes away the ability to follow.

definition.zh: 亮 / 暗 / 跟随系统
definition.en: Light, dark, system

distinction.zh: 默认"跟随系统"，用户显式选择后才写入存储；二态切换会让用户失去跟随能力。
distinction.en: Default to system and only persist an explicit choice. A two-state toggle takes away the ability to follow.

items.dz: 用户在系统里切了，你要跟着变
items.de: They switch at the OS; you follow
items.pz: 监听 prefers-color-scheme 查询的 change 事件，而不是只在加载时读一次。
items.pe: Listen to the change event on the prefers-color-scheme query — do not read it once at load.

definition.zh: 用户在系统里切了，你要跟着变
definition.en: They switch at the OS; you follow

distinction.zh: 监听 prefers-color-scheme 查询的 change 事件，而不是只在加载时读一次。
distinction.en: Listen to the change event on the prefers-color-scheme query — do not read it once at load.

items.dz: 刷新一下白光闪一下眼
items.de: A white flash on every refresh
items.pz: 在 <head> 里用一段阻塞小脚本读存储并给 html 打 class；等 React 挂载再改就一定会闪。
items.pe: Read storage in a tiny blocking script in head and set a class on html. Waiting for React guarantees a flash.

definition.zh: 刷新一下白光闪一下眼
definition.en: A white flash on every refresh

distinction.zh: 在 <head> 里用一段阻塞小脚本读存储并给 html 打 class；等 React 挂载再改就一定会闪。
distinction.en: Read storage in a tiny blocking script in head and set a class on html. Waiting for React guarantees a flash.

items.dz: 一个属性写两个值
items.de: One property, both values
items.pz: color:light-dark(#23232f,#e8ecf1) 省掉整套媒体查询；需要 color-scheme 已声明才生效。
items.pe: color:light-dark(#23232f,#e8ecf1) removes a whole media-query layer — it needs color-scheme declared.

definition.zh: 一个属性写两个值
definition.en: One property, both values

distinction.zh: color:light-dark(#23232f,#e8ecf1) 省掉整套媒体查询；需要 color-scheme 已声明才生效。
distinction.en: color:light-dark(#23232f,#e8ecf1) removes a whole media-query layer — it needs color-scheme declared.

items.dz: 除了亮暗，还有"看得清"这一档
items.de: Beyond light and dark: legible
items.pz: prefers-contrast:more 时加粗边框、去掉浅灰、提高文字对比；不是把所有东西变黑白。
items.pe: Under prefers-contrast:more, thicken borders, drop pale greys and raise text contrast — not a black-and-white dump.

definition.zh: 除了亮暗，还有"看得清"这一档
definition.en: Beyond light and dark: legible

distinction.zh: prefers-contrast:more 时加粗边框、去掉浅灰、提高文字对比；不是把所有东西变黑白。
distinction.en: Under prefers-contrast:more, thicken borders, drop pale greys and raise text contrast — not a black-and-white dump.

items.dz: 选了就要记住，跨标签也一致
items.de: Remember it, and across tabs
items.pz: localStorage 存显式选择 + storage 事件同步其他标签；服务端渲染时用 cookie 才能首屏就对。
items.pe: Store the explicit choice and sync tabs with the storage event. Server rendering needs a cookie to get frame one right.

definition.zh: 选了就要记住，跨标签也一致
definition.en: Remember it, and across tabs

distinction.zh: localStorage 存显式选择 + storage 事件同步其他标签；服务端渲染时用 cookie 才能首屏就对。
distinction.en: Store the explicit choice and sync tabs with the storage event. Server rendering needs a cookie to get frame one right.

items.dz: 一个暗色区块嵌在亮色页里
items.de: One dark block inside a light page
items.pz: 把 token 定义挂在容器上而不是 :root，容器内自成主题；页脚、代码块、演示区最常用。
items.pe: Declare tokens on a container rather than :root so it themes itself. Footers, code blocks and demo areas want this.

definition.zh: 一个暗色区块嵌在亮色页里
definition.en: One dark block inside a light page

distinction.zh: 把 token 定义挂在容器上而不是 :root，容器内自成主题；页脚、代码块、演示区最常用。
distinction.en: Declare tokens on a container rather than :root so it themes itself. Footers, code blocks and demo areas want this.

items.dz: 同一套组件跑五个品牌
items.de: One component set, five brands
items.pz: 品牌差异只允许存在于 token 值（色、圆角、字体、密度）；一旦落到组件结构上就无法扩展。
items.pe: Brand differences live only in token values — colour, radius, type, density. Once they reach component structure it stops scaling.

definition.zh: 同一套组件跑五个品牌
definition.en: One component set, five brands

distinction.zh: 品牌差异只允许存在于 token 值（色、圆角、字体、密度）；一旦落到组件结构上就无法扩展。
distinction.en: Brand differences live only in token values — colour, radius, type, density. Once they reach component structure it stops scaling.

items.dz: 突变刺眼，全局过渡会卡
items.de: A hard cut jars; a global transition janks
items.pz: 用 View Transitions 做一次圆形揭开，或只给 background/color 加 120ms 过渡；不要给所有属性加 transition:all。
items.pe: Do one circular reveal with View Transitions, or transition only background and color for 120ms. Never transition:all.

definition.zh: 突变刺眼，全局过渡会卡
definition.en: A hard cut jars; a global transition janks

distinction.zh: 用 View Transitions 做一次圆形揭开，或只给 background/color 加 120ms 过渡；不要给所有属性加 transition:all。
distinction.en: Do one circular reveal with View Transitions, or transition only background and color for 120ms. Never transition:all.

items.dz: 线性图标在暗底要更细一点
items.de: Line icons need to be thinner on dark
items.pz: 暗底上同样线宽看起来更粗（光渗）；把 stroke 从 1.75 调到 1.5，或用 currentColor 让它自然跟随。
items.pe: The same stroke looks heavier on dark because of bloom. Drop 1.75 to 1.5, and use currentColor so it follows the text.

definition.zh: 线性图标在暗底要更细一点
definition.en: Line icons need to be thinner on dark

distinction.zh: 暗底上同样线宽看起来更粗（光渗）；把 stroke 从 1.75 调到 1.5，或用 currentColor 让它自然跟随。
distinction.en: The same stroke looks heavier on dark because of bloom. Drop 1.75 to 1.5, and use currentColor so it follows the text.

items.dz: 插画不能靠 filter 反色
items.de: You cannot invert illustration with a filter
items.pz: 插画与图表要出亮暗两版资产，或用 currentColor + CSS 变量画；PNG 插画在暗色里一定露白边。
items.pe: Ship two asset sets, or draw with currentColor and variables. PNG illustration always leaks a white fringe on dark.

definition.zh: 插画不能靠 filter 反色
definition.en: You cannot invert illustration with a filter

distinction.zh: 插画与图表要出亮暗两版资产，或用 currentColor + CSS 变量画；PNG 插画在暗色里一定露白边。
distinction.en: Ship two asset sets, or draw with currentColor and variables. PNG illustration always leaks a white fringe on dark.

items.dz: 代码块要跟着换配色
items.de: Code blocks switch schemes too
items.pz: 亮暗各选一个成熟主题（如 GitHub Light/Dark、One Light/Dark），别自己配；注释色最容易不合格。
items.pe: Pick a mature pair — GitHub or One, light and dark — rather than inventing one. Comment colour is the usual contrast failure.

definition.zh: 代码块要跟着换配色
definition.en: Code blocks switch schemes too

distinction.zh: 亮暗各选一个成熟主题（如 GitHub Light/Dark、One Light/Dark），别自己配；注释色最容易不合格。
distinction.en: Pick a mature pair — GitHub or One, light and dark — rather than inventing one. Comment colour is the usual contrast failure.

items.dz: 数据色不能两套主题共用一份
items.de: One data palette cannot serve both
items.pz: 暗色下数据色要提亮降饱和，网格线用透明白，标注要重新测对比度；序列顺序保持一致以免读错。
items.pe: Lighten and desaturate data hues for dark, switch gridlines to translucent white, and re-measure labels. Keep the series order stable.

definition.zh: 数据色不能两套主题共用一份
definition.en: One data palette cannot serve both

distinction.zh: 暗色下数据色要提亮降饱和，网格线用透明白，标注要重新测对比度；序列顺序保持一致以免读错。
distinction.en: Lighten and desaturate data hues for dark, switch gridlines to translucent white, and re-measure labels. Keep the series order stable.

items.dz: 地图不换底图就毁掉整页暗色
items.de: A light basemap ruins the whole dark page
items.pz: 底图、道路、水体、标注要整套换；标注描边在暗底上要改成深色 halo 而不是白色。
items.pe: Swap the whole basemap — roads, water, labels — and change label halos from white to dark.

definition.zh: 地图不换底图就毁掉整页暗色
definition.en: A light basemap ruins the whole dark page

distinction.zh: 底图、道路、水体、标注要整套换；标注描边在暗底上要改成深色 halo 而不是白色。
distinction.en: Swap the whole basemap — roads, water, labels — and change label halos from white to dark.

items.dz: 暗底毛玻璃要靠边框才看得出边界
items.de: On dark, glass needs a border to have an edge
items.pz: 暗色玻璃用 rgba(255,255,255,.06) 填充 + .12 顶部高光 + .1 边框；亮色那套 alpha 直接搬过来会消失。
items.pe: Dark glass wants a .06 white fill, a .12 top highlight and a .1 border. Reusing the light-mode alphas makes it vanish.

definition.zh: 暗底毛玻璃要靠边框才看得出边界
definition.en: On dark, glass needs a border to have an edge

distinction.zh: 暗色玻璃用 rgba(255,255,255,.06) 填充 + .12 顶部高光 + .1 边框；亮色那套 alpha 直接搬过来会消失。
distinction.en: Dark glass wants a .06 white fill, a .12 top highlight and a .1 border. Reusing the light-mode alphas makes it vanish.

items.dz: 边框用透明白，不用固定灰
items.de: Translucent white, not a fixed grey
items.pz: rgba(255,255,255,.08–.14) 会随底色自动适配层级；写死的 #2a2a2a 在不同海拔上会时隐时现。
items.pe: rgba(255,255,255,.08–.14) adapts to whatever surface it sits on. A hard-coded #2a2a2a appears and disappears by elevation.

definition.zh: 边框用透明白，不用固定灰
definition.en: Translucent white, not a fixed grey

distinction.zh: rgba(255,255,255,.08–.14) 会随底色自动适配层级；写死的 #2a2a2a 在不同海拔上会时隐时现。
distinction.en: rgba(255,255,255,.08–.14) adapts to whatever surface it sits on. A hard-coded #2a2a2a appears and disappears by elevation.

items.dz: 深色焦点环在深底上等于没有
items.de: A dark ring on dark is no ring
items.pz: 用双层环：内圈底色、外圈亮色，两种主题都成立；或直接用 outline-color:currentColor。
items.pe: Use a two-layer ring — an inner ring in the surface colour, an outer bright one — so it works in both themes.

definition.zh: 深色焦点环在深底上等于没有
definition.en: A dark ring on dark is no ring

distinction.zh: 用双层环：内圈底色、外圈亮色，两种主题都成立；或直接用 outline-color:currentColor。
distinction.en: Use a two-layer ring — an inner ring in the surface colour, an outer bright one — so it works in both themes.

items.dz: ::selection 不换就会看不清被选的字
items.de: Unchanged ::selection hides the selected text
items.pz: 两个主题各给一组 ::selection 背景与前景；浅色高亮块（mark）在暗色里也要重配。
items.pe: Give each theme its own ::selection pair, and re-tune mark highlights for dark too.

definition.zh: ::selection 不换就会看不清被选的字
definition.en: Unchanged ::selection hides the selected text

distinction.zh: 两个主题各给一组 ::selection 背景与前景；浅色高亮块（mark）在暗色里也要重配。
distinction.en: Give each theme its own ::selection pair, and re-tune mark highlights for dark too.

items.dz: 亮色滚动条在暗色页面上像一道伤口
items.de: A light scrollbar scars a dark page
items.pz: color-scheme 解决大部分；要精细控制用 scrollbar-color: thumb track，别整个 ::-webkit-scrollbar 重画。
items.pe: color-scheme covers most of it. For fine control use scrollbar-color rather than repainting the whole webkit scrollbar.

definition.zh: 亮色滚动条在暗色页面上像一道伤口
definition.en: A light scrollbar scars a dark page

distinction.zh: color-scheme 解决大部分；要精细控制用 scrollbar-color: thumb track，别整个 ::-webkit-scrollbar 重画。
distinction.en: color-scheme covers most of it. For fine control use scrollbar-color rather than repainting the whole webkit scrollbar.

items.dz: 客户端会替你反色
items.de: The client will invert it for you
items.pz: meta name=color-scheme + supported-color-schemes，关键色写死并用表格背景色兜底；Gmail 只会部分尊重。
items.pe: Declare color-scheme and supported-color-schemes, hard-code critical colours and back them with table bgcolor. Gmail only partly complies.

definition.zh: 客户端会替你反色
definition.en: The client will invert it for you

distinction.zh: meta name=color-scheme + supported-color-schemes，关键色写死并用表格背景色兜底；Gmail 只会部分尊重。
distinction.en: Declare color-scheme and supported-color-schemes, hard-code critical colours and back them with table bgcolor. Gmail only partly complies.

items.dz: OG 图不会跟随用户主题
items.de: Share cards never follow the user theme
items.pz: 分享图固定一套（通常深底），不要指望它响应主题；文字要足够大，1200×630 会被压缩到很小。
items.pe: Fix one treatment — usually dark — and do not expect it to adapt. Set type large; 1200×630 gets shown tiny.

definition.zh: OG 图不会跟随用户主题
definition.en: Share cards never follow the user theme

distinction.zh: 分享图固定一套（通常深底），不要指望它响应主题；文字要足够大，1200×630 会被压缩到很小。
distinction.en: Fix one treatment — usually dark — and do not expect it to adapt. Set type large; 1200×630 gets shown tiny.

items.dz: 让主题跟着封面走
items.de: Let the theme follow the artwork
items.pz: 提取封面主色生成一组和谐色（Material You 那一套）；必须钳制饱和与明度，否则某些图会毁掉可读性。
items.pe: Extract a seed colour and generate a harmonised set. Clamp saturation and lightness or some artwork destroys legibility.

definition.zh: 让主题跟着封面走
definition.en: Let the theme follow the artwork

distinction.zh: 提取封面主色生成一组和谐色（Material You 那一套）；必须钳制饱和与明度，否则某些图会毁掉可读性。
distinction.en: Extract a seed colour and generate a harmonised set. Clamp saturation and lightness or some artwork destroys legibility.

items.dz: 让用户挑一个颜色，但要兜住对比度
items.de: Let them pick — then guarantee contrast
items.pz: 只暴露强调色一个变量，前景色用 oklch 亮度判断自动取黑或白；不要让用户能配出不可读的组合。
items.pe: Expose one accent variable and derive the foreground from its oklch lightness. Never let a user configure an unreadable pair.

definition.zh: 让用户挑一个颜色，但要兜住对比度
definition.en: Let them pick — then guarantee contrast

distinction.zh: 只暴露强调色一个变量，前景色用 oklch 亮度判断自动取黑或白；不要让用户能配出不可读的组合。
distinction.en: Expose one accent variable and derive the foreground from its oklch lightness. Never let a user configure an unreadable pair.

items.dz: 每个 token 在每个主题下都要过一遍
items.de: Every token, every theme, checked
items.pz: 生成对比度矩阵：每个 text token × 每个 surface token；CI 里跑，新增颜色不合格就拦下来。
items.pe: Generate a contrast matrix of every text token against every surface token, and gate it in CI.

definition.zh: 每个 token 在每个主题下都要过一遍
definition.en: Every token, every theme, checked

distinction.zh: 生成对比度矩阵：每个 text token × 每个 surface token；CI 里跑，新增颜色不合格就拦下来。
distinction.en: Generate a contrast matrix of every text token against every surface token, and gate it in CI.

items.dz: 系统会把你的主题整个接管
items.de: The OS takes your theme away entirely
items.pz: forced-colors:active 时放弃自定义色，改用系统关键字并保证结构可辨；这时"主题"变成"结构"。
items.pe: Under forced-colors, drop custom colour for system keywords and let structure carry meaning. Theme becomes layout.

definition.zh: 系统会把你的主题整个接管
definition.en: The OS takes your theme away entirely

distinction.zh: forced-colors:active 时放弃自定义色，改用系统关键字并保证结构可辨；这时"主题"变成"结构"。
distinction.en: Under forced-colors, drop custom colour for system keywords and let structure carry meaning. Theme becomes layout.

items.dz: 跟随系统深色/浅色偏好的媒体查询开关。
items.de: Media query that mirrors the OS dark or light preference.
items.pz: @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark) 提供深色分支，别再用 JS 探测。说「跟随系统深浅」即此。
items.pe: @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark) branches without JS.

definition.zh: prefers-color-scheme 反映操作系统级亮/暗偏好，取值 light/dark，配合 @media 提供对应主题分支。
definition.en: prefers-color-scheme mirrors the OS light/dark preference for @media branching.

distinction.zh: 与 color-scheme 属性的区别：媒体查询读用户偏好决定「怎么画」，color-scheme 属性声明组件应适配哪种方案并影响默认配色与表单控件渲染。
distinction.en: the media feature reads the preference; the color-scheme property declares which scheme a component supports.

relations.reason: 深浅适配的两个入口：媒体查询分支 vs 同一样式内取值。

dz: 零一多、错误、离线、过期、配额、通知——只画"有数据"那一种，是交付里最常见的缺口
de: Zero-one-many, errors, offline, stale, quota, notifications — shipping only the happy path is the most common gap of all

items.dz: 还没有任何东西的时候
items.de: Before anything exists
items.pz: 一句说明它是什么 + 一个主动作 + 可选的示例数据；别只画一张插画。
items.pe: One sentence saying what this is, one primary action, and optionally sample data. Not just an illustration.

definition.zh: 还没有任何东西的时候
definition.en: Before anything exists

distinction.zh: 一句说明它是什么 + 一个主动作 + 可选的示例数据；别只画一张插画。
distinction.en: One sentence saying what this is, one primary action, and optionally sample data. Not just an illustration.

items.dz: 搜不到要给下一步
items.de: A dead end needs an exit
items.pz: 回显搜索词、给拼写建议与放宽条件的按钮、列出热门项；不要只写"无结果"。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Echo the query, offer spelling suggestions and a broaden-search action, and list popular items. Never a bare "no results". This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 搜不到要给下一步
definition.en: A dead end needs an exit

distinction.zh: 回显搜索词、给拼写建议与放宽条件的按钮、列出热门项；不要只写"无结果"。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Echo the query, offer spelling suggestions and a broaden-search action, and list popular items. Never a bare "no results". This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 是筛没了，不是真没有
items.de: Filtered out, not absent
items.pz: 明确说"当前筛选下无结果"，并给"清除筛选"一键回到全集；两种空状态文案必须不同。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Say it is the filter, and offer a one-tap clear. These two empty states must never share copy. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 是筛没了，不是真没有
definition.en: Filtered out, not absent

distinction.zh: 明确说"当前筛选下无结果"，并给"清除筛选"一键回到全集；两种空状态文案必须不同。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Say it is the filter, and offer a one-tap clear. These two empty states must never share copy. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 收件箱清空是好事
items.de: An empty inbox is a win
items.pz: 任务型列表清空要庆祝而不是道歉；语气与首次为空完全相反。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Celebrate a cleared task list instead of apologising. The tone is the opposite of first-run empty. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 收件箱清空是好事
definition.en: An empty inbox is a win

distinction.zh: 任务型列表清空要庆祝而不是道歉；语气与首次为空完全相反。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Celebrate a cleared task list instead of apologising. The tone is the opposite of first-run empty. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 一条数据也要看起来是设计过的
items.de: One row must still look designed
items.pz: 网格里只有一张卡时不要拉满整行；列表只有一条时隐藏排序与分页。
items.pe: Do not stretch a single card across the whole row, and hide sorting and pagination for a single row.

definition.zh: 一条数据也要看起来是设计过的
definition.en: One row must still look designed

distinction.zh: 网格里只有一张卡时不要拉满整行；列表只有一条时隐藏排序与分页。
distinction.en: Do not stretch a single card across the whole row, and hide sorting and pagination for a single row.

items.dz: 一千条和十条不是同一个界面
items.de: A thousand rows is a different screen
items.pz: 出现搜索、筛选、批量操作、虚拟滚动与"跳到"；密度也要跟着变紧。
items.pe: Search, filters, bulk actions, virtual scrolling and a jump-to appear — and the density tightens.

definition.zh: 一千条和十条不是同一个界面
definition.en: A thousand rows is a different screen

distinction.zh: 出现搜索、筛选、批量操作、虚拟滚动与"跳到"；密度也要跟着变紧。
distinction.en: Search, filters, bulk actions, virtual scrolling and a jump-to appear — and the density tightens.

items.dz: 超过 10000 条就别再说"共 N 条"
items.de: Past ten thousand, stop counting
items.pz: 显示"10,000+"而不是精确总数（精确 count 很贵），并强制引导到筛选与搜索。
items.pe: Show "10,000+" rather than an exact count — counting is expensive — and push people into search.

definition.zh: 超过 10000 条就别再说"共 N 条"
definition.en: Past ten thousand, stop counting

distinction.zh: 显示"10,000+"而不是精确总数（精确 count 很贵），并强制引导到筛选与搜索。
distinction.en: Show "10,000+" rather than an exact count — counting is expensive — and push people into search.

items.dz: 结构已知就用骨架
items.de: Known structure means skeleton
items.pz: 骨架块与真实内容同尺寸；同时预留操作栏位置，否则加载完会整页下移。
items.pe: Match the real geometry, and reserve the toolbar row too or the page shifts down on arrival.

definition.zh: 结构已知就用骨架
definition.en: Known structure means skeleton

distinction.zh: 骨架块与真实内容同尺寸；同时预留操作栏位置，否则加载完会整页下移。
distinction.en: Match the real geometry, and reserve the toolbar row too or the page shifts down on arrival.

items.dz: 追加时不要动已有内容
items.de: Appending must not move what is there
items.pz: 新内容加在下方，滚动位置保持不动；底部占位高度要在请求前就撑住。
items.pe: Append below and keep the scroll anchored. Reserve the footer height before the request.

definition.zh: 追加时不要动已有内容
definition.en: Appending must not move what is there

distinction.zh: 新内容加在下方，滚动位置保持不动；底部占位高度要在请求前就撑住。
distinction.en: Append below and keep the scroll anchored. Reserve the footer height before the request.

items.dz: 旧数据还在，只是在更新
items.de: The old data stays while it updates
items.pz: 保留现有内容 + 顶部细进度条或轻微降透明度；千万不要清空再重载。
items.pe: Keep the content and add a hairline progress bar or a slight dim. Never blank and reload.

definition.zh: 旧数据还在，只是在更新
definition.en: The old data stays while it updates

distinction.zh: 保留现有内容 + 顶部细进度条或轻微降透明度；千万不要清空再重载。
distinction.en: Keep the content and add a hairline progress bar or a slight dim. Never blank and reload.

items.dz: 这是 3 分钟前的数字
items.de: These numbers are three minutes old
items.pz: 标注数据时间戳与"刷新"入口；金融、库存、监控类界面缺了它就是误导。
items.pe: Stamp the data time and offer a refresh. In finance, inventory and monitoring, omitting it is misinformation.

definition.zh: 这是 3 分钟前的数字
definition.en: These numbers are three minutes old

distinction.zh: 标注数据时间戳与"刷新"入口；金融、库存、监控类界面缺了它就是误导。
distinction.en: Stamp the data time and offer a refresh. In finance, inventory and monitoring, omitting it is misinformation.

items.dz: 批量操作里有几条挂了
items.de: A few of the batch failed
items.pz: 说清成功几条、失败几条、失败原因分组，并只对失败项提供重试；别整批回滚。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Report the counts, group the reasons and retry only the failures. Do not roll back the batch. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 批量操作里有几条挂了
definition.en: A few of the batch failed

distinction.zh: 说清成功几条、失败几条、失败原因分组，并只对失败项提供重试；别整批回滚。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Report the counts, group the reasons and retry only the failures. Do not roll back the batch. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 整个页面拿不到数据
items.de: Nothing on the page loaded
items.pz: 给出发生了什么、能做什么、以及一个可上报的错误码；不要显示堆栈。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: What happened, what to do, and a reportable code. Never a stack trace. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 整个页面拿不到数据
definition.en: Nothing on the page loaded

distinction.zh: 给出发生了什么、能做什么、以及一个可上报的错误码；不要显示堆栈。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: What happened, what to do, and a reportable code. Never a stack trace. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 一个卡片挂了不该拖垮整页
items.de: One broken card must not take the page
items.pz: 每个数据区块自己承担错误边界，就地显示重试；容器高度保持不变。
items.pe: Give each block its own error boundary with a local retry, and keep the container height.

definition.zh: 一个卡片挂了不该拖垮整页
definition.en: One broken card must not take the page

distinction.zh: 每个数据区块自己承担错误边界，就地显示重试；容器高度保持不变。
distinction.en: Give each block its own error boundary with a local retry, and keep the container height.

items.dz: 断网要说，恢复也要说
items.de: Announce the drop and the recovery
items.pz: 常驻一条低干扰横幅说明当前离线与哪些功能不可用；恢复时短暂提示后自动消失。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: A persistent low-noise bar naming what is unavailable, and a brief self-dismissing note on recovery. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 断网要说，恢复也要说
definition.en: Announce the drop and the recovery

distinction.zh: 常驻一条低干扰横幅说明当前离线与哪些功能不可用；恢复时短暂提示后自动消失。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: A persistent low-noise bar naming what is unavailable, and a brief self-dismissing note on recovery. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 别让指数退避看起来像卡死
items.de: Backoff must not look frozen
items.pz: 显示尝试次数与下次重试倒计时，并给"立即重试"；静默重连会让用户以为坏了。
items.pe: Show the attempt count, the next retry countdown, and a retry-now button. Silent backoff reads as broken.

definition.zh: 别让指数退避看起来像卡死
definition.en: Backoff must not look frozen

distinction.zh: 显示尝试次数与下次重试倒计时，并给"立即重试"；静默重连会让用户以为坏了。
distinction.en: Show the attempt count, the next retry countdown, and a retry-now button. Silent backoff reads as broken.

items.dz: 说清缺什么权限、找谁要
items.de: Name the permission and who grants it
items.pz: "没有权限"要具体到角色与资源，并给出申请入口；不要伪装成 404。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Name the role and the resource, and provide the request path. Do not disguise it as a 404. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 说清缺什么权限、找谁要
definition.en: Name the permission and who grants it

distinction.zh: "没有权限"要具体到角色与资源，并给出申请入口；不要伪装成 404。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Name the role and the resource, and provide the request path. Do not disguise it as a 404. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 404 也要能继续走
items.de: A 404 still needs a next step
items.pz: 给搜索框、上一级链接与最近访问；纯插画 404 是在给用户添堵。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Offer search, a parent link and recent items. A purely decorative 404 wastes their time. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 404 也要能继续走
definition.en: A 404 still needs a next step

distinction.zh: 给搜索框、上一级链接与最近访问；纯插画 404 是在给用户添堵。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Offer search, a parent link and recent items. A purely decorative 404 wastes their time. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 东西曾经在这里
items.de: It used to be here
items.pz: 410 与 404 语气不同：说明它被谁在何时删除，是否能恢复；链接分享场景尤其重要。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: A 410 is not a 404: say who removed it, when, and whether it can be restored. Shared links depend on this. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 东西曾经在这里
definition.en: It used to be here

distinction.zh: 410 与 404 语气不同：说明它被谁在何时删除，是否能恢复；链接分享场景尤其重要。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: A 410 is not a 404: say who removed it, when, and whether it can be restored. Shared links depend on this. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 告诉他等多久
items.de: Tell them how long
items.pz: 给出剩余等待秒数（Retry-After）与配额窗口，倒计时可视；不要只说"请稍后再试"。
items.pe: Surface Retry-After as a visible countdown with the quota window. "Try again later" is not information.

definition.zh: 告诉他等多久
definition.en: Tell them how long

distinction.zh: 给出剩余等待秒数（Retry-After）与配额窗口，倒计时可视；不要只说"请稍后再试"。
distinction.en: Surface Retry-After as a visible countdown with the quota window. "Try again later" is not information.

items.dz: 计划内停机要提前通知
items.de: Planned downtime is announced in advance
items.pz: 提前 3 天站内横幅 + 停机页给出预计恢复时间与状态页链接；时间要带时区。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: A banner three days ahead, and a downtime page with an ETA in a named time zone plus a status-page link. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 计划内停机要提前通知
definition.en: Planned downtime is announced in advance

distinction.zh: 提前 3 天站内横幅 + 停机页给出预计恢复时间与状态页链接；时间要带时区。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: A banner three days ahead, and a downtime page with an ETA in a named time zone plus a status-page link. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 一部分功能暂时不可用
items.de: Part of it is temporarily off
items.pz: 把不可用功能就地置灰并说明原因，其余照常；整站下线是最后手段。
items.pe: Grey out the affected features in place with a reason and keep the rest working. A full outage is the last resort.

definition.zh: 一部分功能暂时不可用
definition.en: Part of it is temporarily off

distinction.zh: 把不可用功能就地置灰并说明原因，其余照常；整站下线是最后手段。
distinction.en: Grey out the affected features in place with a reason and keep the rest working. A full outage is the last resort.

items.dz: 成功要说，但不该挡路
items.de: Say it, but do not block
items.pz: 底部或角落 3–4 秒自动消失，带撤销；不要用需要点确定的弹窗宣布成功。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Bottom or corner, three to four seconds, with undo. Never a modal to announce success. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 成功要说，但不该挡路
definition.en: Say it, but do not block

distinction.zh: 底部或角落 3–4 秒自动消失，带撤销；不要用需要点确定的弹窗宣布成功。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Bottom or corner, three to four seconds, with undo. Never a modal to announce success. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 按钮自己变成"已保存"
items.de: The button becomes "saved"
items.pz: 在触发点就地反馈比飘出提示更好定位；保持 1.5s 后恢复，宽度不能跳。
items.pe: Feedback at the point of action beats a floating toast. Revert after 1.5s and keep the width stable.

definition.zh: 按钮自己变成"已保存"
definition.en: The button becomes "saved"

distinction.zh: 在触发点就地反馈比飘出提示更好定位；保持 1.5s 后恢复，宽度不能跳。
distinction.en: Feedback at the point of action beats a floating toast. Revert after 1.5s and keep the width stable.

items.dz: 比"确定要删除吗"好得多
items.de: Far better than "are you sure?"
items.pz: 执行后停留 5–8 秒的撤销条，堆叠时合并成"已删除 3 项"；撤销必须真的能还原顺序与位置。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: A five-to-eight second strip, merged when stacked, and the undo must restore order and position exactly. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 比"确定要删除吗"好得多

definition.en: pointer-events:none removes the element from hit-testing; auto restores it.
