distinction.zh: 主操作放底部 1/3，破坏性操作放顶部（防误触）；6.7 寸屏上顶部按钮需要换手。
distinction.en: Primary actions in the bottom third, destructive ones up top where mis-taps are unlikely. A 6.7-inch screen needs a hand change to reach the top.

items.dz: 从左边缘划回去
items.de: Swipe from the left edge to go back
items.pz: 系统手势会和你的横滑组件冲突：给横滑轨留出边缘 24px，或用 touch-action 明确让路。
items.pe: The system gesture fights your horizontal carousel. Leave a 24px edge gutter or yield with touch-action.

definition.zh: 从左边缘划回去
definition.en: Swipe from the left edge to go back

distinction.zh: 系统手势会和你的横滑组件冲突：给横滑轨留出边缘 24px，或用 touch-action 明确让路。
distinction.en: The system gesture fights your horizontal carousel. Leave a 24px edge gutter or yield with touch-action.

items.dz: 列表里那张图长成详情页的头图
items.de: The thumbnail grows into the hero
items.pz: View Transitions API 的 view-transition-name 对上同一个元素；比例要一致，否则会看到形变。
items.pe: Match one view-transition-name across both views. Keep the aspect ratio or you will see it warp.

definition.zh: 列表里那张图长成详情页的头图
definition.en: The thumbnail grows into the hero

distinction.zh: View Transitions API 的 view-transition-name 对上同一个元素；比例要一致，否则会看到形变。
distinction.en: Match one view-transition-name across both views. Keep the aspect ratio or you will see it warp.

items.dz: 新页从右边推进来，旧页往左走一点
items.de: The new page pushes in, the old one eases left
items.pz: 前进右进左出、返回反向；旧页要有轻微视差（-30%）与压暗，才有层次。
items.pe: Forward comes from the right; back reverses it. The outgoing page parallaxes about 30% and dims slightly.

definition.zh: 新页从右边推进来，旧页往左走一点
definition.en: The new page pushes in, the old one eases left

distinction.zh: 前进右进左出、返回反向；旧页要有轻微视差（-30%）与压暗，才有层次。
distinction.en: Forward comes from the right; back reverses it. The outgoing page parallaxes about 30% and dims slightly.

items.dz: 从底部整页升起来
items.de: A full page rising from the bottom
items.pz: 模态是"另一个任务"，转场从下往上、圆角变大、背后页缩小；退出必须能下滑。
items.pe: A modal is a separate task: it rises, gains corner radius, and shrinks the page behind. Swipe-down must dismiss it.

definition.zh: 从底部整页升起来
definition.en: A full page rising from the bottom

distinction.zh: 模态是"另一个任务"，转场从下往上、圆角变大、背后页缩小；退出必须能下滑。
distinction.en: A modal is a separate task: it rises, gains corner radius, and shrinks the page behind. Swipe-down must dismiss it.

items.dz: 轻震一下比动画更快被感知
items.de: A tap of vibration lands faster than animation
items.pz: 选择用轻（selection）、成功用中、错误用双击式；不要给滚动与悬停加震动。
items.pe: Light for selection, medium for success, a double pattern for errors. Never on scroll or hover.

definition.zh: 轻震一下比动画更快被感知
definition.en: A tap of vibration lands faster than animation

distinction.zh: 选择用轻（selection）、成功用中、错误用双击式；不要给滚动与悬停加震动。
distinction.en: Light for selection, medium for success, a double pattern for errors. Never on scroll or hover.

items.dz: 按住 500ms 弹出上下文
items.de: Hold 500ms for context
items.pz: 长按要有渐进反馈（缩放 + 触感），菜单从按压点长出；必须另有可见入口（"…"按钮）。
items.pe: Give progressive feedback while holding — scale plus haptics — and grow the menu from the press point. Also ship a visible "…".

definition.zh: 按住 500ms 弹出上下文
definition.en: Hold 500ms for context

distinction.zh: 长按要有渐进反馈（缩放 + 触感），菜单从按压点长出；必须另有可见入口（"…"按钮）。
distinction.en: Give progressive feedback while holding — scale plus haptics — and grow the menu from the press point. Also ship a visible "…".

items.dz: 一屏一条，划过去就定住
items.de: One item per screen, snapped
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:y mandatory + 每项 100dvh；要保证内部可滚元素不被吞掉手势。
items.pe: y-mandatory snapping with 100dvh items — and make sure inner scrollables still get the gesture.

definition.zh: 一屏一条，划过去就定住
definition.en: One item per screen, snapped

distinction.zh: scroll-snap-type:y mandatory + 每项 100dvh；要保证内部可滚元素不被吞掉手势。
distinction.en: y-mandatory snapping with 100dvh items — and make sure inner scrollables still get the gesture.

items.dz: 大标题滚上去变成小标题
items.de: The large title shrinks into the bar
items.pz: 大标题在内容里，滚动时淡出并把文字交给顶栏；两者要在同一水平位置对齐才不突兀。
items.pe: The large title lives in the content and hands its text to the bar on scroll. Align them horizontally or it jars.

definition.zh: 大标题滚上去变成小标题
definition.en: The large title shrinks into the bar

distinction.zh: 大标题在内容里，滚动时淡出并把文字交给顶栏；两者要在同一水平位置对齐才不突兀。
distinction.en: The large title lives in the content and hands its text to the bar on scroll. Align them horizontally or it jars.

items.dz: 两到四个互斥视图
items.de: Two to four exclusive views
items.pz: 滑块跟随选中项移动，宽度按最长文案统一；超过四项改用下拉或标签滚动。
items.pe: The thumb slides to the selection and every segment shares the widest label. Past four, use a select.

definition.zh: 两到四个互斥视图
definition.en: Two to four exclusive views

distinction.zh: 滑块跟随选中项移动，宽度按最长文案统一；超过四项改用下拉或标签滚动。
distinction.en: The thumb slides to the selection and every segment shares the widest label. Past four, use a select.

items.dz: 从底部弹出的一列动作
items.de: A column of actions from below
items.pz: 破坏性动作单独一组并用红色，取消永远单独一块在最下方；不要超过 6 项。
items.pe: Destructive actions get their own group in red, and Cancel always sits alone at the bottom. Six items maximum.

definition.zh: 从底部弹出的一列动作
definition.en: A column of actions from below

distinction.zh: 破坏性动作单独一组并用红色，取消永远单独一块在最下方；不要超过 6 项。
distinction.en: Destructive actions get their own group in red, and Cancel always sits alone at the bottom. Six items maximum.

items.dz: 别挡住底部标签栏
items.de: Keep clear of the tab bar
items.pz: 出现在标签栏之上、安全区之内，宽度留边距；带撤销的提示要延长到 8 秒。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Sit above the tab bar and inside the safe area with side margins. Extend to eight seconds when it carries an undo. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 别挡住底部标签栏
definition.en: Keep clear of the tab bar

distinction.zh: 出现在标签栏之上、安全区之内，宽度留边距；带撤销的提示要延长到 8 秒。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Sit above the tab bar and inside the safe area with side margins. Extend to eight seconds when it carries an undo. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 一个屏幕只配一个
items.de: One per screen, at most
items.pz: 固定在右下（RTL 翻到左下），滚动时可缩成图标；不要用它承载多个动作除非能展开。
items.pe: Bottom-trailing corner, shrinking to the icon on scroll. Do not overload it unless it expands.

definition.zh: 一个屏幕只配一个
definition.en: One per screen, at most

distinction.zh: 固定在右下（RTL 翻到左下），滚动时可缩成图标；不要用它承载多个动作除非能展开。
distinction.en: Bottom-trailing corner, shrinking to the icon on scroll. Do not overload it unless it expands.

items.dz: 窄屏骨架要按卡片来
items.de: Skeletons follow the card, not the table
items.pz: 一屏放 3–4 个骨架卡就够，再多也看不见；高度要和真实卡一致。
items.pe: Three or four skeleton cards fill the screen; more is invisible. Match the real card height exactly.

definition.zh: 窄屏骨架要按卡片来
definition.en: Skeletons follow the card, not the table

distinction.zh: 一屏放 3–4 个骨架卡就够，再多也看不见；高度要和真实卡一致。
distinction.en: Three or four skeleton cards fill the screen; more is invisible. Match the real card height exactly.

items.dz: 输数字就别弹字母键盘
items.de: Numbers should not summon letters
items.pz: inputmode=numeric/decimal/tel/email/search，配 enterkeyhint 改回车键文案；type=number 会带上没用的步进器。
items.pe: inputmode plus enterkeyhint. type=number drags along a stepper nobody wants.

definition.zh: 输数字就别弹字母键盘
definition.en: Numbers should not summon letters

distinction.zh: inputmode=numeric/decimal/tel/email/search，配 enterkeyhint 改回车键文案；type=number 会带上没用的步进器。
distinction.en: inputmode plus enterkeyhint. type=number drags along a stepper nobody wants.

items.dz: 六个格子，能粘贴也能自动填
items.de: Six boxes that accept a paste and an autofill
items.pz: 用一个真实 input 加视觉分格（别用六个 input），autocomplete="one-time-code"，满位自动提交。
items.pe: One real input with visual boxes — never six inputs — plus autocomplete="one-time-code" and auto-submit when full.

definition.zh: 六个格子，能粘贴也能自动填
definition.en: Six boxes that accept a paste and an autofill

distinction.zh: 用一个真实 input 加视觉分格（别用六个 input），autocomplete="one-time-code"，满位自动提交。
distinction.en: One real input with visual boxes — never six inputs — plus autocomplete="one-time-code" and auto-submit when full.

items.dz: 日期与时间用系统的那一套
items.de: Dates and times belong to the OS
items.pz: 移动端优先 input[type=date/time]：自带无障碍、本地格式与惯性滚轮；自造滚轮几乎总是更差。
items.pe: Prefer input type date and time on mobile — accessibility, locale format and momentum come free. Hand-rolled wheels lose.

definition.zh: 日期与时间用系统的那一套
definition.en: Dates and times belong to the OS

distinction.zh: 移动端优先 input[type=date/time]：自带无障碍、本地格式与惯性滚轮；自造滚轮几乎总是更差。
distinction.en: Prefer input type date and time on mobile — accessibility, locale format and momentum come free. Hand-rolled wheels lose.

items.dz: 底部条要加 env() 才不被压
items.de: Bottom bars need env() or they get covered
items.pz: padding-bottom:max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))；横屏时左右也要加。
items.pe: padding-bottom:max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) — and the inline insets too in landscape.

definition.zh: 底部条要加 env() 才不被压
definition.en: Bottom bars need env() or they get covered

distinction.zh: padding-bottom:max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))；横屏时左右也要加。
distinction.en: padding-bottom:max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) — and the inline insets too in landscape.

items.dz: 在图上双击，心跳一下
items.de: Double-tap the photo; a heart beats
items.pz: 要和单击（打开）与缩放（双击放大）区分：内容型双击点赞，图片查看器双击缩放，二者别混在同一屏。
items.pe: Separate it from single-tap open and double-tap zoom. Content feeds like; viewers zoom. Never both on one screen.

definition.zh: 在图上双击，心跳一下
definition.en: Double-tap the photo; a heart beats

distinction.zh: 要和单击（打开）与缩放（双击放大）区分：内容型双击点赞，图片查看器双击缩放，二者别混在同一屏。
distinction.en: Separate it from single-tap open and double-tap zoom. Content feeds like; viewers zoom. Never both on one screen.

items.dz: 头像外面那圈渐变
items.de: The gradient ring around the avatar
items.pz: 未读用渐变环、已读用灰环、正在上传用旋转虚线；环宽 2–3px，与头像留 2px 白隙。
items.pe: Unread gets the gradient, read gets grey, uploading gets a spinning dash. A 2–3px ring with a 2px white gap.

definition.zh: 头像外面那圈渐变
definition.en: The gradient ring around the avatar

distinction.zh: 未读用渐变环、已读用灰环、正在上传用旋转虚线；环宽 2–3px，与头像留 2px 白隙。
distinction.en: Unread gets the gradient, read gets grey, uploading gets a spinning dash. A 2–3px ring with a 2px white gap.

items.dz: 露出下一张的一角
items.de: Show a sliver of the next
items.pz: 首项左侧留 padding、末项右侧留 padding（scroll-padding），让"还有更多"变成视觉事实。
items.pe: Pad the first and last items with scroll-padding so "there is more" becomes visible fact.

definition.zh: 露出下一张的一角
definition.en: Show a sliver of the next

distinction.zh: 首项左侧留 padding、末项右侧留 padding（scroll-padding），让"还有更多"变成视觉事实。
distinction.en: Pad the first and last items with scroll-padding so "there is more" becomes visible fact.

items.dz: 几页、第几页
items.de: How many, and which
items.pz: 超过 8 页改用"3/12"数字或缩略进度条；当前点放大而不只是变色。
items.pe: Past eight pages switch to "3/12" or a bar. Enlarge the active dot rather than only recolouring it.

definition.zh: 几页、第几页
definition.en: How many, and which

distinction.zh: 超过 8 页改用"3/12"数字或缩略进度条；当前点放大而不只是变色。
distinction.en: Past eight pages switch to "3/12" or a bar. Enlarge the active dot rather than only recolouring it.

items.dz: 键盘一弹，工具条贴在它上面
items.de: A bar riding on top of the keyboard
items.pz: 放"完成/上一个/下一个"或格式按钮，用 visualViewport 跟随键盘高度；表单跨字段跳转靠它。
items.pe: Done, previous and next, or formatting buttons, tracking the keyboard with visualViewport. It is how people move between fields.

definition.zh: 键盘一弹，工具条贴在它上面
definition.en: A bar riding on top of the keyboard

distinction.zh: 放"完成/上一个/下一个"或格式按钮，用 visualViewport 跟随键盘高度；表单跨字段跳转靠它。
distinction.en: Done, previous and next, or formatting buttons, tracking the keyboard with visualViewport. It is how people move between fields.

items.dz: 点顶部就回到最上面
items.de: Tap the top to return to the start
items.pz: 滚过一屏后出现"回到顶部"按钮，或让顶栏可点；长列表没有这个就是残废。
items.pe: Show a back-to-top affordance after one screen, or make the header tappable. Long lists without it are broken.

definition.zh: 点顶部就回到最上面
definition.en: Tap the top to return to the start

distinction.zh: 滚过一屏后出现"回到顶部"按钮，或让顶栏可点；长列表没有这个就是残废。
distinction.en: Show a back-to-top affordance after one screen, or make the header tappable. Long lists without it are broken.

items.dz: 不是断网，是很慢
items.de: Not offline — just slow
items.pz: 超过 3 秒给"网络较慢"提示与"仅加载文字"选项；把图片降级成占位。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Past three seconds, offer a slow-network notice and a text-only option, downgrading images to placeholders. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 不是断网，是很慢
definition.en: Not offline — just slow

distinction.zh: 超过 3 秒给"网络较慢"提示与"仅加载文字"选项；把图片降级成占位。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Past three seconds, offer a slow-network notice and a text-only option, downgrading images to placeholders. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 不装 App 也能用一小段
items.de: A slice that runs without installing
items.pz: 把单个任务（扫码点单、看票）做成免安装片段，只在必要时引导安装；不要一进来就拦装。
items.pe: Ship a single task as an install-free slice and only prompt when necessary. An immediate install wall loses everyone.

definition.zh: 不装 App 也能用一小段
definition.en: A slice that runs without installing

distinction.zh: 把单个任务（扫码点单、看票）做成免安装片段，只在必要时引导安装；不要一进来就拦装。
distinction.en: Ship a single task as an install-free slice and only prompt when necessary. An immediate install wall loses everyone.

items.dz: 先说为什么，再弹系统框
items.de: Explain before the system asks
items.pz: 自建一屏说明用途与收益，用户同意后才触发系统弹窗；系统弹窗被拒一次就很难再要回来。
items.pe: Show your own screen explaining the benefit first — a system prompt refused once is nearly unrecoverable.

definition.zh: 先说为什么，再弹系统框
definition.en: Explain before the system asks

distinction.zh: 自建一屏说明用途与收益，用户同意后才触发系统弹窗；系统弹窗被拒一次就很难再要回来。
distinction.en: Show your own screen explaining the benefit first — a system prompt refused once is nearly unrecoverable.

items.dz: 指纹或面容代替密码
items.de: A fingerprint instead of a password
items.pz: 失败要有密码兜底路径，且不能暴露"账号存在"；不要在每次前台切换都要求验证。
items.pe: Always keep a password fallback, never leak account existence, and do not re-prompt on every foreground.

definition.zh: 指纹或面容代替密码
definition.en: A fingerprint instead of a password

distinction.zh: 失败要有密码兜底路径，且不能暴露"账号存在"；不要在每次前台切换都要求验证。
distinction.en: Always keep a password fallback, never leak account existence, and do not re-prompt on every foreground.

items.dz: 从链接进来要落到对的那一屏
items.de: A link must land on the right screen
items.pz: 未登录时先记住目标再走登录，登录后直达；App 未装时回落到网页版同一内容。
items.pe: Remember the destination through login, and fall back to the same web content when the app is absent.

definition.zh: 从链接进来要落到对的那一屏
definition.en: A link must land on the right screen

distinction.zh: 未登录时先记住目标再走登录，登录后直达；App 未装时回落到网页版同一内容。
distinction.en: Remember the destination through login, and fall back to the same web content when the app is absent.

items.dz: 你的滑动和系统的滑动打起来了
items.de: Your swipe fights the system swipe
items.pz: 用 touch-action 明确让出方向；地图与画布这类需要全权手势的区域要显式声明 none 并给退出手势。
items.pe: Declare touch-action to yield an axis. Maps and canvases that need full control declare none — and provide an exit.

definition.zh: 你的滑动和系统的滑动打起来了
definition.en: Your swipe fights the system swipe

distinction.zh: 用 touch-action 明确让出方向；地图与画布这类需要全权手势的区域要显式声明 none 并给退出手势。
distinction.en: Declare touch-action to yield an axis. Maps and canvases that need full control declare none — and provide an exit.

items.dz: 到底了还能拽一点，然后弹回来
items.de: It gives a little at the end, then springs back
items.pz: iOS 原生行为要保留（它是"到底了"的反馈）；只在需要防止连带滚动时用 overscroll-behavior。
items.pe: Keep the native bounce — it is the end-of-list signal. Use overscroll-behavior only to stop chaining.

definition.zh: 到底了还能拽一点，然后弹回来
definition.en: It gives a little at the end, then springs back

distinction.zh: iOS 原生行为要保留（它是"到底了"的反馈）；只在需要防止连带滚动时用 overscroll-behavior。
distinction.en: Keep the native bounce — it is the end-of-list signal. Use overscroll-behavior only to stop chaining.

items.dz: 往下滚把顶栏收走
items.de: Scrolling down takes the bar away
items.pz: 下滚隐藏、上滚立刻回来（不必滚到顶）；隐藏要有阈值防抖，且吸顶筛选条不能一起藏。
items.pe: Hide on down, return immediately on up. Add a threshold against jitter, and never hide the sticky filter bar with it.

definition.zh: 往下滚把顶栏收走
definition.en: Scrolling down takes the bar away

distinction.zh: 下滚隐藏、上滚立刻回来（不必滚到顶）；隐藏要有阈值防抖，且吸顶筛选条不能一起藏。
distinction.en: Hide on down, return immediately on up. Add a threshold against jitter, and never hide the sticky filter bar with it.

items.dz: 离开字段才报错，不是每敲一下
items.de: Validate on blur, not on every keystroke
items.pz: blur 时校验、输入时清除错误；提交前统一再校验一次并聚焦第一个错误。
items.pe: Validate on blur and clear on input. Re-validate on submit and focus the first failure.

definition.zh: 离开字段才报错，不是每敲一下
definition.en: Validate on blur, not on every keystroke

distinction.zh: blur 时校验、输入时清除错误；提交前统一再校验一次并聚焦第一个错误。
distinction.en: Validate on blur and clear on input. Re-validate on submit and focus the first failure.

items.dz: 加减号要够大，中间数字可直接输
items.de: Big plus and minus, editable middle
items.pz: 按钮 44px 起，中间数字可点开键盘；长按连续加减要有加速度。
items.pe: Buttons from 44px with a tappable numeric middle, and acceleration on hold.

definition.zh: 加减号要够大，中间数字可直接输
definition.en: Big plus and minus, editable middle

distinction.zh: 按钮 44px 起，中间数字可点开键盘；长按连续加减要有加速度。
distinction.en: Buttons from 44px with a tappable numeric middle, and acceleration on hold.

items.dz: 价格与按钮一起钉在底部
items.de: Price and button pinned together
items.pz: 滚动到内容底部时解除吸附并入内容流，避免遮挡最后一段；安全区内边距必须加。
items.pe: Release it into the flow at the end of the content so it stops covering the last paragraph. Safe-area padding required.

definition.zh: 价格与按钮一起钉在底部
definition.en: Price and button pinned together

distinction.zh: 滚动到内容底部时解除吸附并入内容流，避免遮挡最后一段；安全区内边距必须加。
distinction.en: Release it into the flow at the end of the content so it stops covering the last paragraph. Safe-area padding required.

items.dz: 同一块区域既要横滑又要纵滚
items.de: One area, both a horizontal swipe and a vertical scroll
items.pz: 先按首次位移角度锁定主轴（超过 30° 判纵向），锁定后不再切换；否则会出现"滑不动"。
items.pe: Lock the axis from the first movement angle — past about 30° it is vertical — and never switch mid-gesture.

definition.zh: 同一块区域既要横滑又要纵滚
definition.en: One area, both a horizontal swipe and a vertical scroll

distinction.zh: 先按首次位移角度锁定主轴（超过 30° 判纵向），锁定后不再切换；否则会出现"滑不动"。
distinction.en: Lock the axis from the first movement angle — past about 30° it is vertical — and never switch mid-gesture.

items.dz: 双指缩放、单指拖动、下滑关闭
items.de: Pinch, pan, swipe down to close
items.pz: 缩放上限 3–4×、双击在 1× 与 2× 间切换、下滑时背景渐透并跟手缩小。
items.pe: Cap zoom at three or four, double-tap toggles 1× and 2×, and a downward drag shrinks the image as the backdrop fades.

definition.zh: 双指缩放、单指拖动、下滑关闭
definition.en: Pinch, pan, swipe down to close

distinction.zh: 缩放上限 3–4×、双击在 1× 与 2× 间切换、下滑时背景渐透并跟手缩小。
distinction.en: Cap zoom at three or four, double-tap toggles 1× and 2×, and a downward drag shrinks the image as the backdrop fades.

items.dz: 桌面上那个红点
items.de: The red dot on the home screen
items.pz: 只对需要用户行动的事计数；进入应用后要按实际已读收敛，不能只在打开时清零。
items.pe: Count only what needs action, and reconcile it with real read state rather than zeroing on launch.

definition.zh: 桌面上那个红点
definition.en: The red dot on the home screen

distinction.zh: 只对需要用户行动的事计数；进入应用后要按实际已读收敛，不能只在打开时清零。
distinction.en: Count only what needs action, and reconcile it with real read state rather than zeroing on launch.

items.dz: 抽屉上面又开一个抽屉
items.de: A sheet on top of a sheet
items.pz: 最多两层，下层要缩小并压暗表示"在后面"；第三层就该换成整页导航。
items.pe: Two layers maximum, with the lower one scaled and dimmed. A third layer should become full-page navigation.

definition.zh: 抽屉上面又开一个抽屉
definition.en: A sheet on top of a sheet

distinction.zh: 最多两层，下层要缩小并压暗表示"在后面"；第三层就该换成整页导航。
distinction.en: Two layers maximum, with the lower one scaled and dimmed. A third layer should become full-page navigation.

items.dz: 返回列表要回到原来那一行
items.de: Going back returns you to the same row
items.pz: 记录滚动位置与列表项 id，返回时按 id 定位（分页数据可能已变）；不要只存像素值。
items.pe: Store the position and the anchor item id, and restore by id — paged data may have shifted under you.

definition.zh: 返回列表要回到原来那一行
definition.en: Going back returns you to the same row

distinction.zh: 记录滚动位置与列表项 id，返回时按 id 定位（分页数据可能已变）；不要只存像素值。
distinction.en: Store the position and the anchor item id, and restore by id — paged data may have shifted under you.

items.dz: 先写本地，再慢慢同步
items.de: Write locally, sync eventually
items.pz: 所有写操作先落本地库并立刻反映在 UI，后台队列上传；网络只是同步通道而不是前置条件。
items.pe: Every write hits local storage and the UI immediately, with a background upload queue. The network is a sync channel, not a gate.

definition.zh: 先写本地，再慢慢同步
definition.en: Write locally, sync eventually

distinction.zh: 所有写操作先落本地库并立刻反映在 UI，后台队列上传；网络只是同步通道而不是前置条件。
distinction.en: Every write hits local storage and the UI immediately, with a background upload queue. The network is a sync channel, not a gate.

dz: 商品图、规格选择、加购动效、购物车、结算步骤、定价套餐——从看见到付完钱的全套词汇
de: Galleries, variant pickers, add-to-cart motion, carts, checkout steps and pricing tiers — from browsing to paid

items.dz: 主图加一排缩略图
items.de: A hero image with a thumbnail rail
items.pz: 缩略图当前项要有边框而不只是变亮；切换时主图淡入而不是滑动，避免误以为可横滑。
items.pe: Mark the active thumbnail with a border, and cross-fade the hero rather than sliding it.

definition.zh: 主图加一排缩略图
definition.en: A hero image with a thumbnail rail

distinction.zh: 缩略图当前项要有边框而不只是变亮；切换时主图淡入而不是滑动，避免误以为可横滑。
distinction.en: Mark the active thumbnail with a border, and cross-fade the hero rather than sliding it.

items.dz: 鼠标停在图上局部放大
items.de: A loupe follows the pointer
items.pz: 2–3× 局部放大在旁边显示，移动端改为点击进全屏缩放；不要在原位放大遮住选项。
items.pe: Show a 2–3× loupe beside the image, and switch to a full-screen zoom on touch.

definition.zh: 鼠标停在图上局部放大
definition.en: A loupe follows the pointer

distinction.zh: 2–3× 局部放大在旁边显示，移动端改为点击进全屏缩放；不要在原位放大遮住选项。
distinction.en: Show a 2–3× loupe beside the image, and switch to a full-screen zoom on touch.

items.dz: 颜色、尺码、容量
items.de: Colour, size, capacity
items.pz: 缺货组合要置灰而不是隐藏（让人知道存在），色板用真实色块加名称；只剩一种规格时不显示选择器。
items.pe: Grey out unavailable combinations rather than hiding them, label every swatch, and hide the picker when only one option exists.

definition.zh: 颜色、尺码、容量
definition.en: Colour, size, capacity

distinction.zh: 缺货组合要置灰而不是隐藏（让人知道存在），色板用真实色块加名称；只剩一种规格时不显示选择器。
distinction.en: Grey out unavailable combinations rather than hiding them, label every swatch, and hide the picker when only one option exists.

items.dz: 色块要能对上实物
items.de: The swatch must match the object
items.pz: 用产品实拍取色而不是品牌色；深色色块要加浅描边，白色要加深描边，选中用外环。
items.pe: Sample the colour from the product photo. Outline dark swatches light, white swatches dark, and select with a ring.

definition.zh: 色块要能对上实物
definition.en: The swatch must match the object

distinction.zh: 用产品实拍取色而不是品牌色；深色色块要加浅描边，白色要加深描边，选中用外环。
distinction.en: Sample the colour from the product photo. Outline dark swatches light, white swatches dark, and select with a ring.

items.dz: 在选之前就能查
items.de: Available before they choose
items.pz: 尺码表就地展开而不是跳走，支持按身高体重推荐；退货率主要由这一步决定。
items.pe: Expand the chart in place rather than navigating away, and recommend from height and weight. This step drives your return rate.

definition.zh: 在选之前就能查
definition.en: Available before they choose

distinction.zh: 尺码表就地展开而不是跳走，支持按身高体重推荐；退货率主要由这一步决定。
distinction.en: Expand the chart in place rather than navigating away, and recommend from height and weight. This step drives your return rate.

items.dz: "仅剩 3 件"要是真的
items.de: "Only 3 left" must be true
items.pz: 真实库存低于阈值才显示，且不要跳动；假造紧迫感一旦被发现就会毁掉信任。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Show it only below a real threshold and keep it stable. Fabricated urgency destroys trust once noticed. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: "仅剩 3 件"要是真的
definition.en: "Only 3 left" must be true

distinction.zh: 真实库存低于阈值才显示，且不要跳动；假造紧迫感一旦被发现就会毁掉信任。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Show it only below a real threshold and keep it stable. Fabricated urgency destroys trust once noticed. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 让商品飞进购物车
items.de: The item flies into the cart
items.pz: 克隆商品图沿曲线飞向购物车图标 + 图标弹一下 + 数字变化；总时长不超过 500ms。
items.pe: Clone the thumbnail along an arc into the cart icon, bump the icon and change the count — under 500ms total.

definition.zh: 让商品飞进购物车
definition.en: The item flies into the cart

distinction.zh: 克隆商品图沿曲线飞向购物车图标 + 图标弹一下 + 数字变化；总时长不超过 500ms。
distinction.en: Clone the thumbnail along an arc into the cart icon, bump the icon and change the count — under 500ms total.

items.dz: 从右边滑出，不用离开页面
items.de: Slides in from the right without leaving
items.pz: 加购后自动打开 3 秒再收起，或只弹提示；抽屉里要能改数量与删除，并显示运费门槛。
items.pe: Auto-open briefly or just toast. The drawer must allow quantity edits and show the free-shipping threshold.

definition.zh: 从右边滑出，不用离开页面
definition.en: Slides in from the right without leaving

distinction.zh: 加购后自动打开 3 秒再收起，或只弹提示；抽屉里要能改数量与删除，并显示运费门槛。
distinction.en: Auto-open briefly or just toast. The drawer must allow quantity edits and show the free-shipping threshold.

items.dz: 再买 28 元就免运费
items.de: ¥28 more for free shipping
items.pz: 进度条 + 差额 + 推荐凑单商品；达成后要有明确的达成反馈而不是静默消失。
items.pe: A bar, the gap, and suggested add-ons — with a clear celebration when it is met, not a silent disappearance.

definition.zh: 再买 28 元就免运费
definition.en: ¥28 more for free shipping

distinction.zh: 进度条 + 差额 + 推荐凑单商品；达成后要有明确的达成反馈而不是静默消失。
distinction.en: A bar, the gap, and suggested add-ons — with a clear celebration when it is met, not a silent disappearance.

items.dz: 价格和按钮永远在手边
items.de: Price and button always at hand
items.pz: 滚过主图后出现，含缩略图、价格、规格摘要与主按钮；不要重复整个规格选择器。
items.pe: Appears past the hero with a thumbnail, price, variant summary and the button — not a duplicate picker.

definition.zh: 价格和按钮永远在手边
definition.en: Price and button always at hand

distinction.zh: 滚过主图后出现，含缩略图、价格、规格摘要与主按钮；不要重复整个规格选择器。
distinction.en: Appears past the hero with a thumbnail, price, variant summary and the button — not a duplicate picker.

items.dz: 现价、原价、单价、税
items.de: Now, was, per-unit, tax
items.pz: 现价最大，原价删除线且较小，折扣率单独标；单价（每 100g）对比购是刚需，含税与否要写明。
items.pe: Now price largest, was price struck and smaller, discount as its own tag. Unit price aids comparison; tax inclusion must be stated.

definition.zh: 现价、原价、单价、税
definition.en: Now, was, per-unit, tax

distinction.zh: 现价最大，原价删除线且较小，折扣率单独标；单价（每 100g）对比购是刚需，含税与否要写明。
distinction.en: Now price largest, was price struck and smaller, discount as its own tag. Unit price aids comparison; tax inclusion must be stated.

items.dz: 别拿虚构原价划线
items.de: Do not strike a price that never existed
items.pz: 原价要是真实成交过的价格，并标注参考期；多地法规已强制要求"30 天内最低价"。
items.pe: The was-price must be a real prior price with a stated window. Many jurisdictions now require the 30-day low.

definition.zh: 别拿虚构原价划线
definition.en: Do not strike a price that never existed

distinction.zh: 原价要是真实成交过的价格，并标注参考期；多地法规已强制要求"30 天内最低价"。
distinction.en: The was-price must be a real prior price with a stated window. Many jurisdictions now require the 30-day low.

items.dz: 星级分布比平均分有用
items.de: The distribution beats the average
items.pz: 给 1–5 星各自的条形分布、带图评价优先、按关键词聚合（"偏小 32 人提到"）。
items.pe: Show the per-star distribution, surface reviews with photos, and cluster by keyword.

definition.zh: 星级分布比平均分有用
definition.en: The distribution beats the average

distinction.zh: 给 1–5 星各自的条形分布、带图评价优先、按关键词聚合（"偏小 32 人提到"）。
distinction.en: Show the per-star distribution, surface reviews with photos, and cluster by keyword.

items.dz: 半星要真的表示半星
items.de: A half star means a half
items.pz: 用渐变裁切显示小数星级并同时给数字（4.3）；只有一条评价时显示数量而不是星级。
items.pe: Clip the fill for fractional stars and always show the number too. With one review, show the count rather than the stars.

definition.zh: 半星要真的表示半星
definition.en: A half star means a half

distinction.zh: 用渐变裁切显示小数星级并同时给数字（4.3）；只有一条评价时显示数量而不是星级。
distinction.en: Clip the fill for fractional stars and always show the number too. With one review, show the count rather than the stars.

items.dz: 每个条件后面带数量
items.de: Every option carries its count
items.pz: 显示每个选项的结果数，选中项置顶并可一键清除；筛选后为空要给"清除"而不是空白。
items.pe: Show counts, pin the selected options, and offer a clear-all. An empty result needs an exit, not a blank.

definition.zh: 每个条件后面带数量
definition.en: Every option carries its count

distinction.zh: 显示每个选项的结果数，选中项置顶并可一键清除；筛选后为空要给"清除"而不是空白。
distinction.en: Show counts, pin the selected options, and offer a clear-all. An empty result needs an exit, not a blank.

items.dz: 默认排序要说清是什么
items.de: Name the default order
items.pz: "推荐排序"要能解释依据；价格排序要标明含不含运费。默认永远不该是"随机"。
items.pe: Explain what "recommended" means, and say whether price sorting includes shipping. Never default to random.

definition.zh: 默认排序要说清是什么
definition.en: Name the default order

distinction.zh: "推荐排序"要能解释依据；价格排序要标明含不含运费。默认永远不该是"随机"。
distinction.en: Explain what "recommended" means, and say whether price sorting includes shipping. Never default to random.

items.dz: 不离开列表就能看细节
items.de: Details without leaving the list
items.pz: 弹层里放图、规格、价格与加购，但不放完整详情；一定要给"查看完整详情"出口。
items.pe: The overlay carries images, variants, price and add-to-cart — never the full page. Always link out to it.

definition.zh: 不离开列表就能看细节
definition.en: Details without leaving the list

distinction.zh: 弹层里放图、规格、价格与加购，但不放完整详情；一定要给"查看完整详情"出口。
distinction.en: The overlay carries images, variants, price and add-to-cart — never the full page. Always link out to it.

items.dz: 心跳一下，然后记住
items.de: It beats once, then remembers
items.pz: 未登录也要能收藏（本地存），登录后合并；图标要有明确的已收藏态而不是仅变色。
items.pe: Allow it before login with local storage and merge later. The saved state needs a shape change, not only colour.

definition.zh: 心跳一下，然后记住
definition.en: It beats once, then remembers

distinction.zh: 未登录也要能收藏（本地存），登录后合并；图标要有明确的已收藏态而不是仅变色。
distinction.en: Allow it before login with local storage and merge later. The saved state needs a shape change, not only colour.

items.dz: 并排看差异，相同的收起来
items.de: Side by side, with the identical rows folded
items.pz: 默认只显示有差异的行，提供"显示全部"；列头吸顶，最多同时比 4 项。
items.pe: Show only differing rows by default with a reveal-all. Sticky column headers, four items maximum.

definition.zh: 并排看差异，相同的收起来
definition.en: Side by side, with the identical rows folded

distinction.zh: 默认只显示有差异的行，提供"显示全部"；列头吸顶，最多同时比 4 项。
distinction.en: Show only differing rows by default with a reveal-all. Sticky column headers, four items maximum.

items.dz: 地址、配送、支付、确认
items.de: Address, shipping, payment, review
items.pz: 步骤条显示进度且可回退；每步只问必要信息，总价与运费在每一步都可见。
items.pe: A reversible progress indicator, only essential fields per step, and the total visible throughout.

definition.zh: 地址、配送、支付、确认
definition.en: Address, shipping, payment, review

distinction.zh: 步骤条显示进度且可回退；每步只问必要信息，总价与运费在每一步都可见。
distinction.en: A reversible progress indicator, only essential fields per step, and the total visible throughout.

items.dz: 别在付款前逼人注册
items.de: Do not force an account before payment
items.pz: 先结算、付完再提供"一键创建账号"；强制注册是转化率最大的单点损失。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Let them pay, then offer one-tap account creation. A forced signup is the single largest conversion loss. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 别在付款前逼人注册
definition.en: Do not force an account before payment

distinction.zh: 先结算、付完再提供"一键创建账号"；强制注册是转化率最大的单点损失。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Let them pay, then offer one-tap account creation. A forced signup is the single largest conversion loss. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 打两个字就能选到
items.de: Two characters and it is found
items.pz: 接地址联想 API + 完整的 autocomplete 语义；手填要能纠正，不要因格式校验挡住真实地址。
items.pe: Wire an address lookup and the full autocomplete tokens. Keep manual entry editable and never block a real address on format.

definition.zh: 打两个字就能选到
definition.en: Two characters and it is found

distinction.zh: 接地址联想 API + 完整的 autocomplete 语义；手填要能纠正，不要因格式校验挡住真实地址。
distinction.en: Wire an address lookup and the full autocomplete tokens. Keep manual entry editable and never block a real address on format.

items.dz: 四位一组，自动识别卡种
items.de: Grouped in fours, brand detected
items.pz: 自动分组、自动跳到有效期、卡种图标就地出现；不要禁止粘贴，也不要在失焦前报错。
items.pe: Auto-group, auto-advance, and show the brand inline. Never block paste, never validate before blur.

definition.zh: 四位一组，自动识别卡种
definition.en: Grouped in fours, brand detected

distinction.zh: 自动分组、自动跳到有效期、卡种图标就地出现；不要禁止粘贴，也不要在失焦前报错。
distinction.en: Auto-group, auto-advance, and show the brand inline. Never block paste, never validate before blur.

items.dz: 一键付掉，跳过所有表单
items.de: One tap, no forms at all
items.pz: Apple/Google Pay 按钮放在表单最上方而不是最下方；样式必须用官方按钮规范。
items.pe: Put the wallet button above the form, not below it, and use the official button styling.

definition.zh: 一键付掉，跳过所有表单
definition.en: One tap, no forms at all

distinction.zh: Apple/Google Pay 按钮放在表单最上方而不是最下方；样式必须用官方按钮规范。
distinction.en: Put the wallet button above the form, not below it, and use the official button styling.

items.dz: 把总价拆成月付
items.de: Split the total into monthly
items.pz: 同时显示总额与分期额，标明利率与总利息；只显示月付额是误导性定价。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Show both the total and the instalment with the rate and total interest. Monthly-only is deceptive pricing. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 把总价拆成月付
definition.en: Split the total into monthly

distinction.zh: 同时显示总额与分期额，标明利率与总利息；只显示月付额是误导性定价。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Show both the total and the instalment with the rate and total interest. Monthly-only is deceptive pricing. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 折叠起来，别提醒所有人去找券
items.de: Fold it away — do not send everyone hunting
items.pz: 优惠码入口默认折叠；失败要说清原因（过期/不适用/最低门槛），成功要显示抵扣行。
items.pe: Collapse it by default. Failures name the reason; successes add a visible discount line.

definition.zh: 折叠起来，别提醒所有人去找券
definition.en: Fold it away — do not send everyone hunting

distinction.zh: 优惠码入口默认折叠；失败要说清原因（过期/不适用/最低门槛），成功要显示抵扣行。
distinction.en: Collapse it by default. Failures name the reason; successes add a visible discount line.

items.dz: 每一笔钱都要能对上
items.de: Every line must reconcile
items.pz: 商品小计、运费、税、优惠、总计逐行列出；总计要加粗且与上方有分隔线。
items.pe: Itemise subtotal, shipping, tax, discounts and total, with the total ruled off and bold.

definition.zh: 每一笔钱都要能对上
definition.en: Every line must reconcile

distinction.zh: 商品小计、运费、税、优惠、总计逐行列出；总计要加粗且与上方有分隔线。
distinction.en: Itemise subtotal, shipping, tax, discounts and total, with the total ruled off and bold.

items.dz: 按下之后绝不能能再按一次
items.de: It must never be pressable twice
items.pz: 点击立刻禁用并转为加载态，按钮文案带金额（"支付 ¥128"）；失败后才恢复可点。
items.pe: Disable and switch to loading on the first press, label it with the amount, and only re-enable on failure.

definition.zh: 按下之后绝不能能再按一次
definition.en: It must never be pressable twice

distinction.zh: 点击立刻禁用并转为加载态，按钮文案带金额（"支付 ¥128"）；失败后才恢复可点。
distinction.en: Disable and switch to loading on the first press, label it with the amount, and only re-enable on failure.

items.dz: 几秒钟不能让人以为失败了
items.de: A few seconds must not read as failure
items.pz: 全屏遮罩 + 明确"正在处理，请不要关闭页面" + 超时后给查询入口；绝不允许重复提交。
items.pe: A blocking overlay saying do not close the page, plus a lookup path on timeout. Never allow a resubmit.

definition.zh: 几秒钟不能让人以为失败了
definition.en: A few seconds must not read as failure

distinction.zh: 全屏遮罩 + 明确"正在处理，请不要关闭页面" + 超时后给查询入口；绝不允许重复提交。
distinction.en: A blocking overlay saying do not close the page, plus a lookup path on timeout. Never allow a resubmit.

items.dz: 订单号、时间、下一步
items.de: Number, time, what happens next
items.pz: 订单号可复制、预计到货区间、跟踪入口与联系方式；这一页是客服工单量的主要变量。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: A copyable order number, a delivery window, a tracking link and support contact. This page decides your ticket volume. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 订单号、时间、下一步
definition.en: Number, time, what happens next

distinction.zh: 订单号可复制、预计到货区间、跟踪入口与联系方式；这一页是客服工单量的主要变量。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: A copyable order number, a delivery window, a tracking link and support contact. This page decides your ticket volume. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 一条时间线，当前节点高亮
items.de: A timeline with the current node lit
items.pz: 节点写清"发生了什么"而不是内部状态码；预计时间变化要主动通知。
items.pe: Nodes describe what happened, not internal codes — and proactively notify when the estimate changes.

definition.zh: 一条时间线，当前节点高亮
definition.en: A timeline with the current node lit

distinction.zh: 节点写清"发生了什么"而不是内部状态码；预计时间变化要主动通知。
distinction.en: Nodes describe what happened, not internal codes — and proactively notify when the estimate changes.

items.dz: 选商品、选原因、拿标签
items.de: Pick items, pick a reason, get a label
items.pz: 原因选项要能反哺商品页（"偏小"多就调尺码指引）；自助退货比客服退货便宜十倍。
items.pe: Feed the reasons back into the product page. Self-service returns cost a tenth of a support ticket.

definition.zh: 选商品、选原因、拿标签
definition.en: Pick items, pick a reason, get a label

distinction.zh: 原因选项要能反哺商品页（"偏小"多就调尺码指引）；自助退货比客服退货便宜十倍。
distinction.en: Feed the reasons back into the product page. Self-service returns cost a tenth of a support ticket.

items.dz: 三档，中间那档被推荐
items.de: Three tiers, the middle one recommended
items.pz: 推荐档要在视觉上升起（描边 + 徽标 + 略高），功能列表用"包含上一档全部"减少重复。
items.pe: Lift the recommended tier with a border, a badge and extra height, and say "everything in the previous tier".

definition.zh: 三档，中间那档被推荐
definition.en: Three tiers, the middle one recommended

distinction.zh: 推荐档要在视觉上升起（描边 + 徽标 + 略高），功能列表用"包含上一档全部"减少重复。
distinction.en: Lift the recommended tier with a border, a badge and extra height, and say "everything in the previous tier".

items.dz: 切到年付要立刻看到省多少
items.de: Switching shows the saving at once
items.pz: 价格数字要滚动过渡而不是瞬变，并显示"省两个月"徽标；默认选年付要诚实标注。
items.pe: Roll the numbers rather than swapping them, and show the saving. If annual is preselected, label it plainly.

definition.zh: 切到年付要立刻看到省多少
definition.en: Switching shows the saving at once

distinction.zh: 价格数字要滚动过渡而不是瞬变，并显示"省两个月"徽标；默认选年付要诚实标注。
distinction.en: Roll the numbers rather than swapping them, and show the saving. If annual is preselected, label it plainly.

items.dz: 让人算得出这个月要花多少
items.de: They must be able to predict the bill
items.pz: 实时用量 + 已产生费用 + 预计月末费用 + 上限设置；超额规则必须在超额前就展示过。
items.pe: Live usage, cost so far, projected month-end and a cap. The overage rule must be shown before any overage.

definition.zh: 让人算得出这个月要花多少
definition.en: They must be able to predict the bill

distinction.zh: 实时用量 + 已产生费用 + 预计月末费用 + 上限设置；超额规则必须在超额前就展示过。
distinction.en: Live usage, cost so far, projected month-end and a cap. The overage rule must be shown before any overage.

items.dz: 推荐要真的相关
items.de: The recommendation must be relevant
items.pz: "经常一起买"用真实共购数据；加价购要在加购后而不是详情页打断决策。
items.pe: Base "bought together" on real co-purchase data, and place add-ons after the add-to-cart, not before the decision.

definition.zh: 推荐要真的相关
definition.en: The recommendation must be relevant

distinction.zh: "经常一起买"用真实共购数据；加价购要在加购后而不是详情页打断决策。
distinction.en: Base "bought together" on real co-purchase data, and place add-ons after the add-to-cart, not before the decision.

items.dz: 帮人找回刚看过的那个
items.de: Help them find the one they just saw
items.pz: 横滑轨放最近 8 件，可删除单项；这是转化率性价比最高的模块之一。
items.pe: A rail of the last eight with per-item removal. One of the highest-yield modules there is.

definition.zh: 帮人找回刚看过的那个
definition.en: Help them find the one they just saw

distinction.zh: 横滑轨放最近 8 件，可删除单项；这是转化率性价比最高的模块之一。
distinction.en: A rail of the last eight with per-item removal. One of the highest-yield modules there is.

items.dz: 给你 10 分钟，别用假倒计时
items.de: Ten real minutes — no fake clocks
items.pz: 只在真的锁库存时显示倒计时；到期要真的释放并明确告知，而不是刷新后重新开始。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Only show it when stock is truly held, and really release it — do not restart on refresh. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 给你 10 分钟，别用假倒计时
definition.en: Ten real minutes — no fake clocks

distinction.zh: 只在真的锁库存时显示倒计时；到期要真的释放并明确告知，而不是刷新后重新开始。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: Only show it when stock is truly held, and really release it — do not restart on refresh. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 结算时才冒出来的税最伤转化
items.de: A tax that appears at checkout kills conversion
items.pz: 在商品页就写明含税或另计与大致税率；跨境要标关税责任方。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: State tax inclusion and the approximate rate on the product page, and name who pays duty on cross-border orders. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

definition.zh: 结算时才冒出来的税最伤转化
definition.en: A tax that appears at checkout kills conversion

distinction.zh: 在商品页就写明含税或另计与大致税率；跨境要标关税责任方。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
distinction.en: State tax inclusion and the approximate rate on the product page, and name who pays duty on cross-border orders. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 退货政策比安全徽标有用
items.de: A return policy beats a security badge
items.pz: 把退货天数、发货地、客服响应时间写成文字放在按钮附近；泛泛的"安全支付"图标没人信。
items.pe: Put the return window, origin and support response near the button as words. Generic padlock badges convince nobody.

definition.zh: 退货政策比安全徽标有用
definition.en: A return policy beats a security badge

distinction.zh: 把退货天数、发货地、客服响应时间写成文字放在按钮附近；泛泛的"安全支付"图标没人信。
distinction.en: Put the return window, origin and support response near the button as words. Generic padlock badges convince nobody.

items.dz: 回来的时候东西还在
items.de: The cart is still there when they return
items.pz: 购物车跨设备持久化，回访时提示"你有 2 件未结算"；邮件挽回要带商品图与直达链接。
items.pe: Persist the cart across devices and greet returners with it. Recovery email carries the images and a direct link.

definition.zh: 回来的时候东西还在
definition.en: The cart is still there when they return

distinction.zh: 购物车跨设备持久化，回访时提示"你有 2 件未结算"；邮件挽回要带商品图与直达链接。
distinction.en: Persist the cart across devices and greet returners with it. Recovery email carries the images and a direct link.

items.dz: 取消要和订阅一样容易
items.de: Cancelling is as easy as subscribing
items.pz: 一个页面看到下次扣费日、金额、暂停与取消；把取消藏进客服流程在多地已属违法。
items.pe: One page with the next charge date, amount, pause and cancel. Hiding cancellation behind support is illegal in several jurisdictions.

definition.zh: 取消要和订阅一样容易
definition.en: Cancelling is as easy as subscribing

distinction.zh: 一个页面看到下次扣费日、金额、暂停与取消；把取消藏进客服流程在多地已属违法。
distinction.en: One page with the next charge date, amount, pause and cancel. Hiding cancellation behind support is illegal in several jurisdictions.

items.dz: 不显示价格、带贺卡、分开发货
items.de: Hide the price, add a note, ship separately
items.pz: 礼品模式要贯穿到发票与包裹（收件人看不到金额）；贺卡字数限制要在输入时提示。
items.pe: Gift mode must reach the invoice and the parcel, and the note needs a live character limit.

definition.zh: 不显示价格、带贺卡、分开发货
definition.en: Hide the price, add a note, ship separately

distinction.zh: 礼品模式要贯穿到发票与包裹（收件人看不到金额）；贺卡字数限制要在输入时提示。
distinction.en: Gift mode must reach the invoice and the parcel, and the note needs a live character limit.

items.dz: 不是所有交易都能一键下单
items.de: Not every deal ends in a tap
items.pz: B2B 要有阶梯价、询价单、采购单号字段与账期支付；把它硬塞进 C 端结算流程一定会漏。
items.pe: B2B needs tiered pricing, a quote request, a PO number field and terms. Forcing it through a consumer checkout always breaks.

definition.zh: 不是所有交易都能一键下单
definition.en: Not every deal ends in a tap

distinction.zh: B2B 要有阶梯价、询价单、采购单号字段与账期支付；把它硬塞进 C 端结算流程一定会漏。
distinction.en: B2B needs tiered pricing, a quote request, a PO number field and terms. Forcing it through a consumer checkout always breaks.
