items.dz: 背后的东西被掰弯
items.de: Whatever is behind bends
items.pz: MeshPhysicalMaterial: transmission=1, ior=1.5, thickness>0。
items.pe: MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission 1, ior 1.5, thickness > 0.

definition.zh: 背后的东西被掰弯
definition.en: Whatever is behind bends

distinction.zh: MeshPhysicalMaterial: transmission=1, ior=1.5, thickness>0。
distinction.en: MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission 1, ior 1.5, thickness > 0.

items.dz: 光从内部透出来
items.de: Light seeps from inside
items.pz: thickness + attenuationColor 模拟蜡/皮肤的透光。
items.pe: thickness plus attenuationColor for wax- or skin-like translucency.

definition.zh: 光从内部透出来
definition.en: Light seeps from inside

distinction.zh: thickness + attenuationColor 模拟蜡/皮肤的透光。
distinction.en: thickness plus attenuationColor for wax- or skin-like translucency.

items.dz: 角度一变颜色就变
items.de: Colour shifts with angle
items.pz: MeshPhysicalMaterial 的 iridescence + iridescenceThicknessRange。
items.pe: iridescence with iridescenceThicknessRange on MeshPhysicalMaterial.

definition.zh: 角度一变颜色就变
definition.en: Colour shifts with angle

distinction.zh: MeshPhysicalMaterial 的 iridescence + iridescenceThicknessRange。
distinction.en: iridescence with iridescenceThicknessRange on MeshPhysicalMaterial.

items.dz: 拉丝金属那种长高光
items.de: The long highlight of brushed metal
items.pz: anisotropy + anisotropyRotation，高光沿切线方向拉长。
items.pe: anisotropy with anisotropyRotation stretches the highlight along the tangent.

definition.zh: 拉丝金属那种长高光
definition.en: The long highlight of brushed metal

distinction.zh: anisotropy + anisotropyRotation，高光沿切线方向拉长。
distinction.en: anisotropy with anisotropyRotation stretches the highlight along the tangent.

items.dz: 车漆上那层亮膜
items.de: The lacquer layer on car paint
items.pz: clearcoat=1 + clearcoatRoughness 0.1，是独立于底层的第二层高光。
items.pe: clearcoat 1 with clearcoatRoughness 0.1 — a second specular layer.

definition.zh: 车漆上那层亮膜
definition.en: The lacquer layer on car paint

distinction.zh: clearcoat=1 + clearcoatRoughness 0.1，是独立于底层的第二层高光。
distinction.en: clearcoat 1 with clearcoatRoughness 0.1 — a second specular layer.

items.dz: 像磨砂玻璃后的世界
items.de: Frosted-glass world behind
items.pz: transmission 配 roughness>0，需要 renderer 的 transmissionResolutionScale。
items.pe: transmission with roughness > 0; tune transmissionResolutionScale.

definition.zh: 像磨砂玻璃后的世界
definition.en: Frosted-glass world behind

distinction.zh: transmission 配 roughness>0，需要 renderer 的 transmissionResolutionScale。
distinction.en: transmission with roughness > 0; tune transmissionResolutionScale.

items.dz: 一群点绕着核心转
items.de: Points swarm a core
items.pz: Points + 每点自己的角速度，位置在 shader 里算，不要回 CPU。
items.pe: Points with per-point angular velocity computed in the shader.

definition.zh: 一群点绕着核心转
definition.en: Points swarm a core

distinction.zh: Points + 每点自己的角速度，位置在 shader 里算，不要回 CPU。
distinction.en: Points with per-point angular velocity computed in the shader.

items.dz: 运动留下一条带子
items.de: Motion leaves a ribbon
items.pz: 把历史位置写进 BufferGeometry 环形缓冲，做 MeshLine。
items.pe: Push history positions into a ring buffer and draw a MeshLine.

definition.zh: 运动留下一条带子
definition.en: Motion leaves a ribbon

distinction.zh: 把历史位置写进 BufferGeometry 环形缓冲，做 MeshLine。
distinction.en: Push history positions into a ring buffer and draw a MeshLine.

items.dz: 几十万点跟着看不见的风走
items.de: Hundreds of thousands of points ride invisible wind
items.pz: 位置存进 FloatTexture，用 ping-pong FBO 每帧积分速度。
items.pe: Store positions in a float texture; integrate velocity with ping-pong FBOs.

definition.zh: 几十万点跟着看不见的风走
definition.en: Hundreds of thousands of points ride invisible wind

distinction.zh: 位置存进 FloatTexture，用 ping-pong FBO 每帧积分速度。
distinction.en: Store positions in a float texture; integrate velocity with ping-pong FBOs.

items.dz: 烟一样打卷上升
items.de: Smoke curls upward
items.pz: curl(noise) 保证无散度，粒子才不会挤成一团。
items.pe: Curl of a noise field is divergence-free — particles stop clumping.

definition.zh: 烟一样打卷上升
definition.en: Smoke curls upward

distinction.zh: curl(noise) 保证无散度，粒子才不会挤成一团。
distinction.en: Curl of a noise field is divergence-free — particles stop clumping.

items.dz: 分离、对齐、聚集
items.de: Separate, align, cohere
items.pz: 三条规则加权求和，邻域用空间哈希，不然 O(n²)。
items.pe: Weighted sum of three rules; use a spatial hash for neighbours.

definition.zh: 分离、对齐、聚集
definition.en: Separate, align, cohere

distinction.zh: 三条规则加权求和，邻域用空间哈希，不然 O(n²)。
distinction.en: Weighted sum of three rules; use a spatial hash for neighbours.

items.dz: 网格被拉扯后回弹
items.de: A pulled mesh springs back
items.pz: 相邻顶点连弹簧（Verlet 积分），刚度别超 0.3 会炸。
items.pe: Verlet springs between neighbours; keep stiffness under 0.3.

definition.zh: 网格被拉扯后回弹
definition.en: A pulled mesh springs back

distinction.zh: 相邻顶点连弹簧（Verlet 积分），刚度别超 0.3 会炸。
distinction.en: Verlet springs between neighbours; keep stiffness under 0.3.

items.dz: 落地后整块肉都在颤
items.de: The whole body quivers on landing
items.pz: 质点-弹簧网格 + 体积约束，或直接用 Rapier 的 softbody。
items.pe: Mass-spring mesh with a volume constraint, or Rapier softbodies.

definition.zh: 落地后整块肉都在颤
definition.en: The whole body quivers on landing

distinction.zh: 质点-弹簧网格 + 体积约束，或直接用 Rapier 的 softbody。
distinction.en: Mass-spring mesh with a volume constraint, or Rapier softbodies.

items.dz: 一层层推过来的浪
items.de: Wave trains rolling in
items.pz: 叠 3–5 个 Gerstner 波（不同频率与方向），别用单一 sin。
items.pe: Sum 3–5 Gerstner waves at different frequencies and headings.

definition.zh: 一层层推过来的浪
definition.en: Wave trains rolling in

distinction.zh: 叠 3–5 个 Gerstner 波（不同频率与方向），别用单一 sin。
distinction.en: Sum 3–5 Gerstner waves at different frequencies and headings.

items.dz: 山脊从平面里长出来
items.de: Ridges rise out of the plane
items.pz: PlaneGeometry 顶点按 fBm 噪声抬高，颜色按高度分层。
items.pe: Raise PlaneGeometry vertices by fBm noise; colour by altitude.

definition.zh: 山脊从平面里长出来
definition.en: Ridges rise out of the plane

distinction.zh: PlaneGeometry 顶点按 fBm 噪声抬高，颜色按高度分层。
distinction.en: Raise PlaneGeometry vertices by fBm noise; colour by altitude.

items.dz: 厚厚一团有内部的云
items.de: Cloud with an inside
items.pz: 光线步进 3D 噪声，步数 48 起、抖动采样点去带状。
items.pe: Ray-march 3D noise, 48+ steps, jitter samples to hide banding.

definition.zh: 厚厚一团有内部的云
definition.en: Cloud with an inside

distinction.zh: 光线步进 3D 噪声，步数 48 起、抖动采样点去带状。
distinction.en: Ray-march 3D noise, 48+ steps, jitter samples to hide banding.

items.dz: 光从缝隙里射出来
items.de: Shafts push through the gap
items.pz: 径向模糊亮度掩膜（GodraysPass），或直接画锥形半透几何。
items.pe: Radial-blur a luminance mask, or draw translucent cones.

definition.zh: 光从缝隙里射出来
definition.en: Shafts push through the gap

distinction.zh: 径向模糊亮度掩膜（GodraysPass），或直接画锥形半透几何。
distinction.en: Radial-blur a luminance mask, or draw translucent cones.

items.dz: 缝隙处自然变暗
items.de: Crevices darken on their own
items.pz: SSAOPass 半径 0.1–0.3 场景尺度，强度别拉满。
items.pe: SSAOPass with a radius of 0.1–0.3 scene units, modest intensity.

definition.zh: 缝隙处自然变暗
definition.en: Crevices darken on their own

distinction.zh: SSAOPass 半径 0.1–0.3 场景尺度，强度别拉满。
distinction.en: SSAOPass with a radius of 0.1–0.3 scene units, modest intensity.

items.dz: 选中物体镶一道边
items.de: The selection gets an edge
items.pz: OutlinePass 或 inverted-hull：放大一份背面材质当轮廓。
items.pe: OutlinePass, or an inverted-hull backface shell.

definition.zh: 选中物体镶一道边
definition.en: The selection gets an edge

distinction.zh: OutlinePass 或 inverted-hull：放大一份背面材质当轮廓。
distinction.en: OutlinePass, or an inverted-hull backface shell.

items.dz: 整幅画降成大像素
items.de: The frame drops to fat pixels
items.pz: RenderPixelatedPass，pixelSize 4–8，配合 normalEdge 更像素风。
items.pe: RenderPixelatedPass, pixelSize 4–8, with normalEdge strength.

definition.zh: 整幅画降成大像素
definition.en: The frame drops to fat pixels

distinction.zh: RenderPixelatedPass，pixelSize 4–8，配合 normalEdge 更像素风。
distinction.en: RenderPixelatedPass, pixelSize 4–8, with normalEdge strength.

items.dz: 印刷网点质感
items.de: Print-screen dots
items.pz: HalftonePass，或 shader 里按亮度决定圆点半径。
items.pe: HalftonePass, or size dots by luminance in a shader.

definition.zh: 印刷网点质感
definition.en: Print-screen dots

distinction.zh: HalftonePass，或 shader 里按亮度决定圆点半径。
distinction.en: HalftonePass, or size dots by luminance in a shader.

items.dz: 一层活的噪点
items.de: A living layer of grain
items.pz: FilmPass 或每帧偏移一张噪声图，强度 3–6%。
items.pe: FilmPass, or offset a noise texture each frame at 3–6% strength.

definition.zh: 一层活的噪点
definition.en: A living layer of grain

distinction.zh: FilmPass 或每帧偏移一张噪声图，强度 3–6%。
distinction.en: FilmPass, or offset a noise texture each frame at 3–6% strength.

items.dz: 动作留下一串残影
items.de: Motion smears behind
items.pz: AfterimagePass damp 0.9，或每帧对上一帧 render target 做衰减混合。
items.pe: AfterimagePass with damp 0.9, blending the previous frame.

definition.zh: 动作留下一串残影
definition.en: Motion smears behind

distinction.zh: AfterimagePass damp 0.9，或每帧对上一帧 render target 做衰减混合。
distinction.en: AfterimagePass with damp 0.9, blending the previous frame.

items.dz: 偶发的数字撕裂
items.de: Occasional digital tearing
items.pz: GlitchPass goWild=false，让它 2–4 秒才发作一次。
items.pe: GlitchPass with goWild off — fire every 2–4 seconds.

definition.zh: 偶发的数字撕裂
definition.en: Occasional digital tearing

distinction.zh: GlitchPass goWild=false，让它 2–4 秒才发作一次。
distinction.en: GlitchPass with goWild off — fire every 2–4 seconds.

items.dz: 边缘泛红蓝
items.de: Red and blue creep at the edges
items.pz: 按到中心距离偏移 RGB 采样点，强度随半径平方增长。
items.pe: Offset RGB samples by radial distance squared.

definition.zh: 边缘泛红蓝
definition.en: Red and blue creep at the edges

distinction.zh: 按到中心距离偏移 RGB 采样点，强度随半径平方增长。
distinction.en: Offset RGB samples by radial distance squared.

items.dz: 四角自然压暗
items.de: The corners fall away
items.pz: 径向 mask 乘到最终颜色，别用一张 PNG 盖上去。
items.pe: Multiply a radial mask into the final colour, not an overlay PNG.

definition.zh: 四角自然压暗
definition.en: The corners fall away

distinction.zh: 径向 mask 乘到最终颜色，别用一张 PNG 盖上去。
distinction.en: Multiply a radial mask into the final colour, not an overlay PNG.

items.dz: 快的东西被拉长
items.de: Fast things stretch
items.pz: 按速度矢量做方向性模糊（速度缓冲），别全屏乱糊。
items.pe: Directional blur driven by a velocity buffer.

definition.zh: 快的东西被拉长
definition.en: Fast things stretch

distinction.zh: 按速度矢量做方向性模糊（速度缓冲），别全屏乱糊。
distinction.en: Directional blur driven by a velocity buffer.

items.dz: 静止两帧后画面变干净
items.de: Hold still and it sharpens
items.pz: 相机不动时累积抖动采样，动起来立刻丢弃历史。
items.pe: Accumulate jittered samples while static; discard history on motion.

definition.zh: 静止两帧后画面变干净
definition.en: Hold still and it sharpens

distinction.zh: 相机不动时累积抖动采样，动起来立刻丢弃历史。
distinction.en: Accumulate jittered samples while static; discard history on motion.

items.dz: 门里是另一个空间
items.de: Another space inside the frame
items.pz: stencil buffer 限制第二个场景只在门的区域渲染。
items.pe: Use the stencil buffer so scene B only draws inside the portal.

definition.zh: 门里是另一个空间
definition.en: Another space inside the frame

distinction.zh: stencil buffer 限制第二个场景只在门的区域渲染。
distinction.en: Use the stencil buffer so scene B only draws inside the portal.

items.dz: 一屏两个相机
items.de: Two cameras, one canvas
items.pz: renderer.setScissorTest(true) + setViewport 分两次渲染。
items.pe: setScissorTest(true) and render twice with different viewports.

definition.zh: 一屏两个相机
definition.en: Two cameras, one canvas

distinction.zh: renderer.setScissorTest(true) + setViewport 分两次渲染。
distinction.en: setScissorTest(true) and render twice with different viewports.

items.dz: 画面吃自己，越套越深
items.de: The frame eats itself
items.pz: 把上一帧的 render target 当贴图再画进场景，缩放 0.98。
items.pe: Feed the previous render target back in at 0.98 scale.

definition.zh: 画面吃自己，越套越深
definition.en: The frame eats itself

distinction.zh: 把上一帧的 render target 当贴图再画进场景，缩放 0.98。
distinction.en: Feed the previous render target back in at 0.98 scale.

items.dz: 一张大图里换格子
items.de: Cells cycle inside one sheet
items.pz: texture.offset / repeat 定位到 atlas 的某一格。
items.pe: Point texture.offset and repeat at one atlas cell.

definition.zh: 一张大图里换格子
definition.en: Cells cycle inside one sheet

distinction.zh: texture.offset / repeat 定位到 atlas 的某一格。
distinction.en: Point texture.offset and repeat at one atlas cell.

items.dz: 模型表面在播片
items.de: The mesh is playing footage
items.pz: VideoTexture 需要 muted+playsinline，别忘 needsUpdate。
items.pe: VideoTexture needs muted and playsinline; keep needsUpdate on.

definition.zh: 模型表面在播片
definition.en: The mesh is playing footage

distinction.zh: VideoTexture 需要 muted+playsinline，别忘 needsUpdate。
distinction.en: VideoTexture needs muted and playsinline; keep needsUpdate on.

items.dz: 三维表面上有字在打
items.de: Type appears on a 3D surface
items.pz: 用 2D canvas 画字再当 CanvasTexture，改字后置 needsUpdate。
items.pe: Draw text into a 2D canvas as a CanvasTexture; flag needsUpdate.

definition.zh: 三维表面上有字在打
definition.en: Type appears on a 3D surface

distinction.zh: 用 2D canvas 画字再当 CanvasTexture，改字后置 needsUpdate。
distinction.en: Draw text into a 2D canvas as a CanvasTexture; flag needsUpdate.

items.dz: 不用贴图也有花纹
items.de: Pattern without a texture
items.pz: shader 里 mod(floor(uv*n),2) 生成，永不失真。
items.pe: mod(floor(uv * n), 2.0) in the shader — resolution-independent.

definition.zh: 不用贴图也有花纹
definition.en: Pattern without a texture

distinction.zh: shader 里 mod(floor(uv*n),2) 生成，永不失真。
distinction.en: mod(floor(uv * n), 2.0) in the shader — resolution-independent.

items.dz: 任意形体都不拉伸贴图
items.de: No stretching on any shape
items.pz: 按法线权重混合 XY / YZ / XZ 三次采样。
items.pe: Blend XY / YZ / XZ samples weighted by the normal.

definition.zh: 任意形体都不拉伸贴图
definition.en: No stretching on any shape

distinction.zh: 按法线权重混合 XY / YZ / XZ 三次采样。
distinction.en: Blend XY / YZ / XZ samples weighted by the normal.

items.dz: 纹理自己往前走
items.de: The texture keeps walking
items.pz: texture.wrapS=RepeatWrapping，每帧加 offset.x。
items.pe: RepeatWrapping plus a per-frame offset.x increment.

definition.zh: 纹理自己往前走
definition.en: The texture keeps walking

distinction.zh: texture.wrapS=RepeatWrapping，每帧加 offset.x。
distinction.en: RepeatWrapping plus a per-frame offset.x increment.

items.dz: 半透明用噪点点开
items.de: Transparency by dither
items.pz: material.alphaHash=true，避免排序问题的伪透明。
items.pe: material.alphaHash avoids transparency sorting entirely.

definition.zh: 半透明用噪点点开
definition.en: Transparency by dither

distinction.zh: material.alphaHash=true，避免排序问题的伪透明。
distinction.en: material.alphaHash avoids transparency sorting entirely.

items.dz: 一格一格播出动画
items.de: Frame-by-frame from one sheet
items.pz: steps() 或每帧改 texture.offset，帧率控制在 12fps 才有手感。
items.pe: Use steps() timing or offset per frame; 12fps reads best.

definition.zh: 一格一格播出动画
definition.en: Frame-by-frame from one sheet

distinction.zh: steps() 或每帧改 texture.offset，帧率控制在 12fps 才有手感。
distinction.en: Use steps() timing or offset per frame; 12fps reads best.

items.dz: 只留影子不留地板
items.de: Shadow without the floor
items.pz: ShadowMaterial + transparent 地面，合成到真实背景上。
items.pe: A ShadowMaterial plane composites shadow onto any background.

definition.zh: 只留影子不留地板
definition.en: Shadow without the floor

distinction.zh: ShadowMaterial + transparent 地面，合成到真实背景上。
distinction.en: A ShadowMaterial plane composites shadow onto any background.

items.dz: 近处影子清楚，远处也不糊
items.de: Crisp near, still correct far
items.pz: 按相机距离分 3–4 级 shadow map（CSM），各级分辨率不同。
items.pe: Split the frustum into 3–4 cascades with separate shadow maps.

definition.zh: 近处影子清楚，远处也不糊
definition.en: Crisp near, still correct far

distinction.zh: 按相机距离分 3–4 级 shadow map（CSM），各级分辨率不同。
distinction.en: Split the frustum into 3–4 cascades with separate shadow maps.

items.dz: 物体被环境的颜色染上
items.de: The room tints the object
items.pz: LightProbe / 球谐系数存环境光，成本远低于实时反射。
items.pe: Spherical-harmonic light probes cost far less than real-time reflection.

definition.zh: 物体被环境的颜色染上
definition.en: The room tints the object

distinction.zh: LightProbe / 球谐系数存环境光，成本远低于实时反射。
distinction.en: Spherical-harmonic light probes cost far less than real-time reflection.

items.dz: 模型到齐前先给个交代
items.de: Tell them before the model lands
items.pz: LoadingManager.onProgress 驱动进度条，DRACO/KTX2 先压缩。
items.pe: Drive a bar from LoadingManager.onProgress; compress with DRACO/KTX2.

definition.zh: 模型到齐前先给个交代
definition.en: Tell them before the model lands

distinction.zh: LoadingManager.onProgress 驱动进度条，DRACO/KTX2 先压缩。
distinction.en: Drive a bar from LoadingManager.onProgress; compress with DRACO/KTX2.

items.dz: 看不见的就不画
items.de: Offscreen means unrendered
items.pz: frustumCulled 默认开；大场景再加 BVH 或 octree 粗剔。
items.pe: frustumCulled is on by default; add a BVH for big scenes.

definition.zh: 看不见的就不画
definition.en: Offscreen means unrendered

distinction.zh: frustumCulled 默认开；大场景再加 BVH 或 octree 粗剔。
distinction.en: frustumCulled is on by default; add a BVH for big scenes.

items.dz: 手靠近时目标发亮
items.de: Targets glow as the hand nears
items.pz: WebXR hand input 的关节位置算距离，距离映射到 emissive。
items.pe: Map WebXR joint distance to emissive intensity.

definition.zh: 手靠近时目标发亮
definition.en: Targets glow as the hand nears

distinction.zh: WebXR hand input 的关节位置算距离，距离映射到 emissive。
distinction.en: Map WebXR joint distance to emissive intensity.

items.dz: canvas 拿到 WebGL 上下文即进入 GL 状态机。
items.de: Fetching the GL state machine from a canvas.
items.pz: canvas.getContext("webgl2") 返回 GL 上下文；之后所有调用都是状态机操作。说「拿 GL 句柄」即此。
items.pe: One context, one giant state machine.

definition.zh: canvas.getContext('webgl2') 返回 WebGL 渲染上下文：此后的一切绘制经由 GL 状态机（绑定缓冲/纹理/程序后调用 draw）。
definition.en: Fetching the GL state machine from a canvas.

distinction.zh: 与 2d 上下文的区别：同一 canvas 只能激活一种上下文类型；GL 没有 2D 那样的路径状态，只有显式缓冲与程序。
distinction.en: GL is an explicit state machine with buffers and programs; 2d is an immediate path API.

items.dz: 编译→链接→使用的着色器程序生命周期。
items.de: Compile, link, use: the program lifecycle.
items.pz: createShader→shaderSource→compileShader→attach→linkProgram→useProgram。说「着色器生命周期」即此。
items.pe: Six calls before the first pixel.

definition.zh: WebGL 程序由顶点与片段着色器编译后链接而成；useProgram 激活后绘制调用才有着色逻辑。
definition.en: Compile, link, use: the program lifecycle.

distinction.zh: 与 2D 绘制的区别：没有任何内置绘制能力——先构建程序再喂几何；编译/链接错误需显式查询日志。
distinction.en: GL has no built-in drawing: programs must be compiled, linked and used first.

items.dz: 每顶点属性 vs 每绘制uniform 两种输入。
items.de: Per-vertex attributes vs per-draw uniforms.
items.pz: attribute 随顶点变（position），uniform 全绘制共享（时间/矩阵）。说「顶点量 vs 全局量」即此。
items.pe: Vertex-varying vs draw-constant.

definition.zh: attribute（in）是从顶点缓冲逐顶点读取的输入；uniform 是每次绘制前设置的常量，整个 draw call 期间不变。
definition.en: Per-vertex attributes vs per-draw uniforms.

distinction.zh: 两者的区别是数据频率：per-vertex vs per-draw；选错频率是 WebGL 性能问题的头号来源。
distinction.en: The attribute/uniform split is per-vertex vs per-draw frequency; mixing them is the top perf bug.

items.dz: 把顶点从模型空间变换到裁剪空间。
items.de: Transforms vertices into clip space.
items.pz: gl_Position = projMatrix * viewMatrix * modelMatrix * position——顶点着色器的核心职责。说「顶点变换」即此。
items.pe: One line does the heavy lifting.

definition.zh: 顶点着色器对每个顶点执行一次：计算 gl_Position（裁剪空间坐标）并输出可 varying 插值的属性。
definition.en: Transforms vertices into clip space.

distinction.zh: 与片段着色器的区别：调用频率与职责不同——顶点管“在哪”，片段管“什么颜色”。
distinction.en: Vertex shaders run per vertex and output clip-space positions; fragments run per pixel.

items.dz: 对每个可能显示的像素算出最终颜色。
items.de: Computes the final color of every fragment.
items.pz: gl_FragColor = f(vColor, vUV, uniforms)——逐像素执行，性能预算的最大头。说「逐像素上色」即此。
items.pe: Per-pixel: where the budget goes.

definition.zh: 片段着色器对光栅化产生的每个片段执行：输出颜色并处理纹理采样、光照与效果。
definition.en: Computes the final color of every fragment.

distinction.zh: 与顶点着色器的区别：执行次数大一到几个数量级；能省则省（分支/采样次数）是 WebGL 优化核心。
distinction.en: Fragment shaders run per fragment — the dominant cost; vertex work is comparatively cheap.

items.dz: drawElements 复用顶点：四点画两三角。
items.de: Reuse vertices: 4 points, 2 triangles.
items.pz: 顶点缓冲存 4 角 + 索引 [0,1,2,2,1,3] → drawElements 画 quad。说「索引复用」即此。
items.pe: Indices save memory and cache.

definition.zh: index buffer 存顶点索引，drawElements 按索引取顶点组装图元：同一顶点被多个三角形复用。
definition.en: Reuse vertices: 4 points, 2 triangles.

distinction.zh: 与 drawArrays 的区别：arrays 按顺序消费顶点（重复数据），elements 索引复用（省内存且利于顶点缓存）。
distinction.en: drawElements reuses vertices via indices; drawArrays consumes them linearly.

items.dz: 纹理绑定在单元上：采样器引单元号。
items.de: Textures bind to units; samplers point at units.
items.pz: activeTexture(TEXTURE0)→bindTexture→uniform1i(sampler,0)：多纹理同帧采样。说「纹理槽位」即此。
items.pe: Slots, not pointers.

definition.zh: 纹理单元（texture units）是同时可绑定的纹理槽位：采样器 uniform 以整数指向单元号，实现一次 draw 多纹理混合。
definition.en: Textures bind to units; samplers point at units.

distinction.zh: 与 2D 画布的多图层区别：GL 无图层概念，多“图层”= 多纹理槽 + 着色器混合逻辑。
distinction.en: Textures bind to unit slots addressed by sampler integers; there is no layer concept.

items.dz: VAO 打包整套顶点属性配置，一次绑定切换。
items.de: Bundle attribute state; switch in one bind.
items.pz: createVertexArray→绑定后配置 attribPointer→之后 bindVertexArray 一步换装。说「顶点配置包」即此。
items.pe: Attribute state in one object.

definition.zh: VAO（WebGL2 原生）记录全部顶点属性指针与缓冲绑定：绘制不同几何时 bindVertexArray 一次切换。
definition.en: Bundle attribute state; switch in one bind.

distinction.zh: 与逐次 vertexAttribPointer 的区别：VAO 免去每帧重复配置，多网格场景的标准做法。
distinction.en: VAOs encapsulate attribute configuration; without them every mesh rebinds pointers each frame.

items.dz: 按深度缓冲决定像素前后遮挡。
items.de: The depth buffer decides occlusion.
items.pz: enable(DEPTH_TEST) 后 z 近者胜；画不透明场景先开深度。说「深度遮挡」即此。
items.pe: Closer z wins the pixel.

definition.zh: 深度测试把片段的深度值与深度缓冲比较，仅更近者写入：无需排序即可正确遮挡。
definition.en: The depth buffer decides occlusion.

distinction.zh: 与画家算法的区别：画家算法按远到近排序绘制（易错且慢），深度测试逐像素硬件判定；透明物需关闭或特殊处理。
distinction.en: Depth testing decides occlusion per pixel; painter's algorithm sorts whole objects and breaks easily.

items.dz: blendFunc 定源头与目标色的加权公式。
items.de: blendFunc weights source against destination.
items.pz: gl.enable(BLEND);gl.blendFunc(SRC_ALPHA,ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA)——透明合成的底层公式。说「GL 混合」即此。
items.pe: One equation behind all transparency.

definition.zh: gl.blendFunc/blendEquation 定义片段色与帧缓冲色的加权合成公式：透明、加法发光、乘法阴影皆由此出。
definition.en: blendFunc weights source against destination.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS mix-blend-mode 的区别：GL 混合是固定硬件公式（两个因子+方程），混合模式由因子组合模拟； premultiplied alpha 直接影响因子选择。
distinction.en: GL blending is one fixed equation with two factors; CSS blend modes are named presets.

items.dz: 以模板掩码门控像素写入。
items.de: Gate pixel writes with a stencil mask.
items.pz: stencilFunc/stencilOp 先描形再画内容——镜中世界、 portals 的实现。说「模板门控」即此。
items.pe: Draw a mask, then draw through it.

definition.zh: stencil buffer 以逐像素掩码门控写入：先渲染掩码形状（写模板值），再以 stencilFunc 只允许掩码内绘制。
definition.en: Gate pixel writes with a stencil mask.

distinction.zh: 与 gl-blending 的区别：混合决定“怎么混”，模板决定“哪里允许画”；与 depth-test 的区别：比较依据是标记值不是深度。
distinction.en: Stencil gates WHERE writes happen; blending decides HOW colors combine.

items.dz: 一份几何 × N 份实例数据一次画完。
items.de: One geometry, N instances, one call.
items.pz: drawArraysInstanced + per-instance attribute（divisor=1）：十万草叶一次调用。说「实例化」即此。
items.pe: One draw call for a hundred thousand copies.

definition.zh: 实例化渲染（WebGL2 drawArraysInstanced / ANGLE 扩展）以每实例属性（vertexAttribDivisor）批量绘制同一几何的众多变体。
definition.en: One geometry, N instances, one call.

distinction.zh: 与逐个 draw 的区别：把 N 次 draw 压成 1 次（CPU 提交成本骤降）；与粒子池（partorbit）的区别：那是 CPU 管理对象，这是 GPU 复制几何。
distinction.en: Instancing collapses N draws into one with per-instance attributes; CPU particle pools manage objects.

items.dz: gl_PointSize 画出可编程大小的点。
items.de: Programmable point primitives.
items.pz: drawArrays(POINTS) + gl_PointSize + gl_PointCoord：粒子系统最省几何。说「点精灵」即此。
items.pe: Points are tiny quads for free.

definition.zh: GL 的 POINTS 图元以 gl_PointSize 指定大小、片段着色器以 gl_PointCoord 定位点内纹理——零几何成本的粒子。
definition.en: Programmable point primitives.

distinction.zh: 与 instanced quad 粒子的区别：点精灵无旋转自由（始终屏幕对齐方形），但几何成本最低。
distinction.en: Point sprites are screen-aligned squares with zero geometry; instanced quads rotate freely.

items.dz: TRIANGLES/STRIP/FAN/LINES 等组装方式。
items.de: How vertices assemble into primitives.
items.pz: 同一组顶点按 TRIANGLES 与 TRIANGLE_FAN 解释结果完全不同。说「图元模式」即此。
items.pe: Same vertices, different assemblies.

definition.zh: drawArrays 的 mode 决定顶点如何组装：TRIANGLES（独立三角）/STRIP/FAN、LINES/LINE_STRIP、POINTS。
definition.en: How vertices assemble into primitives.

distinction.zh: 与索引无关：mode 管组装规则，index buffer 管顶点选取；STRIP 省 index 但破坏顶点缓存局部性。
distinction.en: Modes define assembly rules; index buffers define vertex selection — orthogonal concerns.

items.dz: gl_FragCoord 给出像素级窗口坐标。
items.de: Window-space coordinates of the fragment.
items.pz: gl_FragCoord.xy = 当前像素中心（+1/z=深度）：屏幕空间效果的免费坐标系。说「像素坐标」即此。
items.pe: Your pixels, addressed.

definition.zh: gl_FragCoord 提供片段在窗口空间的像素中心坐标与深度：屏幕空间效果（渐晕、像素化、扫描线）的坐标来源。
definition.en: Window-space coordinates of the fragment.

distinction.zh: 与 uv 的区别：uv 随几何贴图，FragCoord 恒为屏幕像素——后处理效果必须用它。
distinction.en: gl_FragCoord is window-space per pixel; uv is mapped by geometry — post-processing needs FragCoord.

items.dz: highp/mediump/lowp 声明浮点精度档位。
items.de: Declaring float precision per shader.
items.pz: 移动端 mediump 默认足够；深度/位置用 highp——省带宽与功耗。说「精度档位」即此。
items.pe: Pick the cheapest correct precision.

definition.zh: GLSL 的 precision qualifier 声明变量浮点精度：highp 全精度、mediump/lowp 在移动 GPU 上显著省电省带宽。
definition.en: Declaring float precision per shader.

distinction.zh: 与类型选择的区别：float 只定类型，precision 定位数档；不足的精度表现为条纹/抖动而非报错。
distinction.en: Precision sets mantissa depth; under-precision shows as banding, not errors.

items.dz: 越界 UV 的四种接缝策略。
items.de: What happens when UV leaves 0-1.
items.pz: REPEAT 平铺 / CLAMP_TO_EDGE 钳边 / MIRRORED_REPEAT 镜像——UV 出界策略。说「环绕方式」即此。
items.pe: Repeat, clamp, mirror.

definition.zh: 纹理环绕参数（REPEAT/CLAMP_TO_EDGE/MIRRORED_REPEAT）决定 UV 超出 0–1 时的采样方式。
definition.en: What happens when UV leaves 0-1.

distinction.zh: 与 mipmap 的区别：wrap 管越界，mipmap 管缩小采样；两者常一起调（NPOT 纹理的 wrap 受限）。
distinction.en: Wrap handles out-of-range UV; mipmaps handle minification sampling.

items.dz: gl.viewport 把 NDC 映射到画布区域。
items.de: Maps NDC onto canvas pixels.
items.pz: 改 canvas 尺寸必须同步 gl.viewport(0,0,w,h)——忘改则拉伸或半屏。说「视口矩形」即此。
items.pe: NDC needs a pixel window.

definition.zh: gl.viewport(x,y,w,h) 定义 NDC [-1,1]² 到窗口像素的映射矩形；与画布尺寸不同步是经典失真来源。
definition.en: Maps NDC onto canvas pixels.

distinction.zh: 与 scissor 的区别：viewport 管坐标映射，scissor 管写入裁剪；前者必设，后者可选。
distinction.en: viewport maps NDC to pixels; scissor clips writes — resize without it distorts.

items.dz: 顶点着色器输出后的裁剪与透视除法。
items.de: Clip, then divide, then map.
items.pz: gl_Position(w) 先裁剪（|x|≤w）再除以 w 得 NDC——透视的来源。说「裁剪空间」即此。
items.pe: The w division is the perspective.

definition.zh: 裁剪空间以 gl_Position 的 w 分量定义可见锥体：先裁剪（|x|,|y|,|z|≤w）再透视除法得到 NDC。
definition.en: Clip, then divide, then map.

distinction.zh: 与 NDC 的区别：NDC 是除法后的归一化立方；透视感完全来自除以 w 而非矩阵本身。
distinction.en: NDC is after the w-divide; the perspective lives entirely in that division.

items.dz: 模型×视图×投影三矩阵串联。
items.de: Model, view, projection chained.
items.pz: M（摆放）×V（相机）×P（投影）：改相机=改 V。说「三矩阵」即此。
items.pe: Move the world, or move the camera?

definition.zh: MVP 链把顶点从模型空间经世界空间（Model）、相机空间（View）变换到裁剪空间（Projection）。
definition.en: Model, view, projection chained.

distinction.zh: 与直接写死顶点坐标的区别：三段分离让物体动画（M）、相机运镜（V）、镜头特性（P）独立复用。
distinction.en: M/V/P separate object motion, camera and lens; hardcoded vertices freeze all three.

items.dz: 按绕向丢弃背对相机的三角形。
items.de: Cull triangles facing away by winding.
items.pz: enable(CULL_FACE)+cullFace(BACK)：顶点顺序（顺/逆时针）即正反面。说「剔除背面」即此。
items.pe: Winding order is the facing.

definition.zh: 背面剔除按三角形顶点绕向（屏幕投影后的方向）丢弃背对相机的面：不透明物体可省约一半片段着色。
definition.en: Cull triangles facing away by winding.

distinction.zh: 与 depth-test 的区别：剔除在光栅化前整面丢弃（更省），深度测试逐像素比较；双面材质需关闭剔除。
distinction.en: Culling drops whole triangles pre-rasterization; depth testing compares per pixel.

dz: GLSL 里那几十个反复用的小函数，就是全部的画面语言
de: A few dozen GLSL primitives account for most of what you see

items.dz: 边缘可以任意软硬
items.de: Edges as soft or hard as you like
items.pz: length(uv-.5)-r 得到距离，再 smoothstep 控制边缘宽度。
items.pe: length(uv - .5) - r, then smoothstep for edge width.

definition.zh: 边缘可以任意软硬
definition.en: Edges as soft or hard as you like

distinction.zh: length(uv-.5)-r 得到距离，再 smoothstep 控制边缘宽度。
distinction.en: length(uv - .5) - r, then smoothstep for edge width.

items.dz: 任意圆角都无锯齿
items.de: Any radius, no jaggies
items.pz: max(abs(p)-b,0) 的长度减 r，是 UI 圆角的通解。
items.pe: length(max(abs(p) - b, 0.0)) - r — the general rounded-rect.

definition.zh: 任意圆角都无锯齿
definition.en: Any radius, no jaggies

distinction.zh: max(abs(p)-b,0) 的长度减 r，是 UI 圆角的通解。
distinction.en: length(max(abs(p) - b, 0.0)) - r — the general rounded-rect.

items.dz: 两个形状黏成一个
items.de: Two shapes melt into one
items.pz: smin(a,b,k) 平滑并集，k 越大越黏。
items.pe: smin(a, b, k) — larger k, gooier blend.

definition.zh: 两个形状黏成一个
definition.en: Two shapes melt into one

distinction.zh: smin(a,b,k) 平滑并集，k 越大越黏。
distinction.en: smin(a, b, k) — larger k, gooier blend.

items.dz: 没有几何也能有体积
items.de: Volume without geometry
items.pz: 沿视线累加 SDF 距离，命中即着色；步数 64 上限。
items.pe: March the SDF along the view ray, shade on hit, cap at 64 steps.

definition.zh: 没有几何也能有体积
definition.en: Volume without geometry

distinction.zh: 沿视线累加 SDF 距离，命中即着色；步数 64 上限。
distinction.en: March the SDF along the view ray, shade on hit, cap at 64 steps.

items.dz: 自然界的粗糙感
items.de: Nature-grade roughness
items.pz: 5–6 个 octave 的 noise 叠加，振幅每层 ×0.5、频率 ×2。
items.pe: Sum 5–6 octaves, amplitude ×0.5 and frequency ×2 each.

definition.zh: 自然界的粗糙感
definition.en: Nature-grade roughness

distinction.zh: 5–6 个 octave 的 noise 叠加，振幅每层 ×0.5、频率 ×2。
distinction.en: Sum 5–6 octaves, amplitude ×0.5 and frequency ×2 each.

items.dz: 细胞状的分区
items.de: Cellular partitioning
items.pz: 按到最近特征点的距离着色，第二近距离给边界。
items.pe: Shade by nearest feature-point distance; use the second for borders.

definition.zh: 细胞状的分区
definition.en: Cellular partitioning

distinction.zh: 按到最近特征点的距离着色，第二近距离给边界。
distinction.en: Shade by nearest feature-point distance; use the second for borders.

items.dz: 噪声再喂给噪声
items.de: Noise fed back into noise
items.pz: noise(p + noise(p)*k)，一层就够，两层开始糊。
items.pe: noise(p + noise(p) * k) — one level is usually enough.

definition.zh: 噪声再喂给噪声
definition.en: Noise fed back into noise

distinction.zh: noise(p + noise(p)*k)，一层就够，两层开始糊。
distinction.en: noise(p + noise(p) * k) — one level is usually enough.

items.dz: 纹理沿指定方向淌
items.de: Texture flows where you point it
items.pz: 用一张 RG 贴图当方向，两次相位错开采样再混合。
items.pe: RG texture as direction; sample twice at offset phases and blend.

definition.zh: 纹理沿指定方向淌
definition.en: Texture flows where you point it

distinction.zh: 用一张 RG 贴图当方向，两次相位错开采样再混合。
distinction.en: RG texture as direction; sample twice at offset phases and blend.

items.dz: 按噪声阈值一点点消失
items.de: It vanishes by noise threshold
items.pz: discard 或 alpha 用 step(noise, t)，t 从 0 走到 1。
items.pe: step(noise, t) into alpha or discard, t sweeping 0→1.

definition.zh: 按噪声阈值一点点消失
definition.en: It vanishes by noise threshold

distinction.zh: discard 或 alpha 用 step(noise, t)，t 从 0 走到 1。
distinction.en: step(noise, t) into alpha or discard, t sweeping 0→1.

items.dz: 轮廓自己带一层光
items.de: The silhouette carries light
items.pz: 用 SDF 的绝对值窄带做发光带：exp(-abs(d)*k)。
items.pe: exp(-abs(d) * k) over the SDF gives a glow band.

definition.zh: 轮廓自己带一层光
definition.en: The silhouette carries light

distinction.zh: 用 SDF 的绝对值窄带做发光带：exp(-abs(d)*k)。
distinction.en: exp(-abs(d) * k) over the SDF gives a glow band.

items.dz: 一道线扫过整块屏
items.de: A line sweeps the panel
items.pz: fract(uv.y*n - t) 做重复线，再叠一条快速扫描。
items.pe: fract(uv.y * n - t) for the lines, plus one fast sweeper.

definition.zh: 一道线扫过整块屏
definition.en: A line sweeps the panel

distinction.zh: fract(uv.y*n - t) 做重复线，再叠一条快速扫描。
distinction.en: fract(uv.y * n - t) for the lines, plus one fast sweeper.

items.dz: 老显示器的桶形失真
items.de: Old-monitor barrel distortion
items.pz: uv = uv + uv*(len²)*k 做桶形，再叠暗角与扫描线。
items.pe: Barrel-distort the uv by length², then add vignette and scanlines.

definition.zh: 老显示器的桶形失真
definition.en: Old-monitor barrel distortion

distinction.zh: uv = uv + uv*(len²)*k 做桶形，再叠暗角与扫描线。
distinction.en: Barrel-distort the uv by length², then add vignette and scanlines.

items.dz: 重复对称的图案
items.de: Mirrored, repeating symmetry
items.pz: 极坐标下 mod(angle, TAU/n) 再取绝对值就得到镜像扇区。
items.pe: In polar space, mod the angle by TAU/n and mirror it.

definition.zh: 重复对称的图案
definition.en: Mirrored, repeating symmetry

distinction.zh: 极坐标下 mod(angle, TAU/n) 再取绝对值就得到镜像扇区。
distinction.en: In polar space, mod the angle by TAU/n and mirror it.

items.dz: 直的变成绕的
items.de: Straight becomes circular
items.pz: vec2(length(p), atan(p.y,p.x)) 换到极坐标再采样。
items.pe: Sample in vec2(length(p), atan(p.y, p.x)) space.

definition.zh: 直的变成绕的
definition.en: Straight becomes circular

distinction.zh: vec2(length(p), atan(p.y,p.x)) 换到极坐标再采样。
distinction.en: Sample in vec2(length(p), atan(p.y, p.x)) space.

items.dz: 中心被拧了一圈
items.de: The centre gets a twist
items.pz: 旋转角度随半径衰减：angle += (1-r)*strength。
items.pe: angle += (1 - r) * strength, so the twist fades outward.

definition.zh: 中心被拧了一圈
definition.en: The centre gets a twist

distinction.zh: 旋转角度随半径衰减：angle += (1-r)*strength。
distinction.en: angle += (1 - r) * strength, so the twist fades outward.

items.dz: 一圈圈扩出去
items.de: Rings push outward
items.pz: sin(length(p)*f - t) 当高度扰动 uv，振幅随半径衰减。
items.pe: sin(length(p) * f - t) offsets the uv, amplitude falling with radius.

definition.zh: 一圈圈扩出去
definition.en: Rings push outward

distinction.zh: sin(length(p)*f - t) 当高度扰动 uv，振幅随半径衰减。
distinction.en: sin(length(p) * f - t) offsets the uv, amplitude falling with radius.

items.dz: 池底那些游动的光网
items.de: The dancing net on the pool floor
items.pz: 两层 domain-warp 噪声取 pow(x,6) 得到亮线。
items.pe: Two warped noise layers, pow(x, 6.0) to isolate the bright lines.

definition.zh: 池底那些游动的光网
definition.en: The dancing net on the pool floor

distinction.zh: 两层 domain-warp 噪声取 pow(x,6) 得到亮线。
distinction.en: Two warped noise layers, pow(x, 6.0) to isolate the bright lines.

items.dz: 一个 dot 就有立体感
items.de: One dot product buys depth
items.pz: dot(normal, lightDir) 直接当亮度，环境项给 0.2 保底。
items.pe: dot(N, L) as brightness with a 0.2 ambient floor.

definition.zh: 一个 dot 就有立体感
definition.en: One dot product buys depth

distinction.zh: dot(normal, lightDir) 直接当亮度，环境项给 0.2 保底。
distinction.en: dot(N, L) as brightness with a 0.2 ambient floor.

items.dz: 高光越小越贵气
items.de: Smaller highlight, richer surface
items.pz: pow(dot(N,H), shininess)，shininess 从 8 提到 128。
items.pe: pow(dot(N, H), shininess) — push shininess 8 → 128.

definition.zh: 高光越小越贵气
definition.en: Smaller highlight, richer surface

distinction.zh: pow(dot(N,H), shininess)，shininess 从 8 提到 128。
distinction.en: pow(dot(N, H), shininess) — push shininess 8 → 128.

items.dz: 亮度只有三档
items.de: Light quantised to three steps
items.pz: floor(NdotL*steps)/steps，边缘再加一道描边。
items.pe: floor(NdotL * steps) / steps, plus an outline pass.

definition.zh: 亮度只有三档
definition.en: Light quantised to three steps

distinction.zh: floor(NdotL*steps)/steps，边缘再加一道描边。
distinction.en: floor(NdotL * steps) / steps, plus an outline pass.

items.dz: 按明暗换线密度
items.de: Line density follows value
items.pz: 按亮度选不同密度的斜线图层（TAM），别用单张贴图。
items.pe: Pick from tonal art maps by luminance rather than one texture.

definition.zh: 按明暗换线密度
definition.en: Line density follows value

distinction.zh: 按亮度选不同密度的斜线图层（TAM），别用单张贴图。
distinction.en: Pick from tonal art maps by luminance rather than one texture.

items.dz: 两色也能表现渐变
items.de: Two colours, still a gradient
items.pz: 4×4 Bayer 矩阵做阈值，比随机噪点更干净。
items.pe: A 4×4 Bayer threshold beats random noise.

definition.zh: 两色也能表现渐变
definition.en: Two colours, still a gradient

distinction.zh: 4×4 Bayer 矩阵做阈值，比随机噪点更干净。
distinction.en: A 4×4 Bayer threshold beats random noise.

items.dz: 颜色被砍成几档
items.de: Colour chopped into bands
items.pz: floor(c*n)/n，n=4 是海报感的甜点。
items.pe: floor(c * n) / n — n = 4 is the poster sweet spot.

definition.zh: 颜色被砍成几档
definition.en: Colour chopped into bands

distinction.zh: floor(c*n)/n，n=4 是海报感的甜点。
distinction.en: floor(c * n) / n — n = 4 is the poster sweet spot.

items.dz: 灰度换成一条色带
items.de: Greyscale remapped to a ramp
items.pz: 亮度当 u 去查一张 1D 渐变贴图，一键换配色。
items.pe: Use luminance as u into a 1D ramp texture.

definition.zh: 灰度换成一条色带
definition.en: Greyscale remapped to a ramp

distinction.zh: 亮度当 u 去查一张 1D 渐变贴图，一键换配色。
distinction.en: Use luminance as u into a 1D ramp texture.

items.dz: RGB 三通道错开
items.de: RGB channels drift apart
items.pz: 三次采样各偏移几像素，偏移量随半径增长。
items.pe: Three samples at radius-scaled offsets.

definition.zh: RGB 三通道错开
definition.en: RGB channels drift apart

distinction.zh: 三次采样各偏移几像素，偏移量随半径增长。
distinction.en: Three samples at radius-scaled offsets.

items.dz: 大半径也不掉帧
items.de: Big radius, still cheap
items.pz: 横竖分两遍，半径 r 的代价从 r² 降到 2r。
items.pe: Separate horizontal and vertical passes: 2r instead of r².

definition.zh: 大半径也不掉帧
definition.en: Big radius, still cheap

distinction.zh: 横竖分两遍，半径 r 的代价从 r² 降到 2r。
distinction.en: Separate horizontal and vertical passes: 2r instead of r².

items.dz: 虚化成六边形光斑
items.de: Out-of-focus points bloom hexagonal
items.pz: 按光圈形状采样（六边形核），高光要先做 pre-multiply。
items.pe: Sample with a hexagonal aperture kernel; pre-multiply highlights.

definition.zh: 虚化成六边形光斑
definition.en: Out-of-focus points bloom hexagonal

distinction.zh: 按光圈形状采样（六边形核），高光要先做 pre-multiply。
distinction.en: Sample with a hexagonal aperture kernel; pre-multiply highlights.

items.dz: 从中心炸开的速度感
items.de: Speed exploding from centre
items.pz: 沿 uv-center 方向多次采样并递减权重。
items.pe: Sample along (uv - centre) with falling weights.

definition.zh: 从中心炸开的速度感
definition.en: Speed exploding from centre

distinction.zh: 沿 uv-center 方向多次采样并递减权重。
distinction.en: Sample along (uv - centre) with falling weights.

items.dz: 只留下轮廓线
items.de: Only the contours survive
items.pz: 3×3 卷积求梯度幅值，阈值前先转灰度。
items.pe: 3×3 gradient magnitude on the luminance channel.

definition.zh: 只留下轮廓线
definition.en: Only the contours survive

distinction.zh: 3×3 卷积求梯度幅值，阈值前先转灰度。
distinction.en: 3×3 gradient magnitude on the luminance channel.

items.dz: 细节被提出来
items.de: Detail gets pulled forward
items.pz: 原图 + (原图-模糊)*k，k 别超过 0.6。
items.pe: original + (original − blur) * k, k under 0.6.

definition.zh: 细节被提出来
definition.en: Detail gets pulled forward

distinction.zh: 原图 + (原图-模糊)*k，k 别超过 0.6。
distinction.en: original + (original − blur) * k, k under 0.6.

items.dz: 只让亮的部分参与
items.de: Only the bright part plays
items.pz: smoothstep(t-δ, t+δ, luma) 当 mask，比 step 少锯齿。
items.pe: smoothstep(t−δ, t+δ, luma) as the mask.

definition.zh: 只让亮的部分参与
definition.en: Only the bright part plays

distinction.zh: smoothstep(t-δ, t+δ, luma) 当 mask，比 step 少锯齿。
distinction.en: smoothstep(t−δ, t+δ, luma) as the mask.

items.dz: 整块面料在飘
items.de: The cloth is breathing
items.pz: 顶点着色器里 position.z += sin(x*f + t)，法线要一起改。
items.pe: position.z += sin(x * f + t) in the vertex shader; fix the normals too.

definition.zh: 整块面料在飘
definition.en: The cloth is breathing

distinction.zh: 顶点着色器里 position.z += sin(x*f + t)，法线要一起改。
distinction.en: position.z += sin(x * f + t) in the vertex shader; fix the normals too.

items.dz: 模型沿法线炸散
items.de: The mesh bursts along its normals
items.pz: position += normal * t，t 用 easeOutQuint 收尾。
items.pe: position += normal * t with an ease-out-quint tail.

definition.zh: 模型沿法线炸散
definition.en: The mesh bursts along its normals

distinction.zh: position += normal * t，t 用 easeOutQuint 收尾。
distinction.en: position += normal * t with an ease-out-quint tail.

items.dz: 面片像纸一样折起来
items.de: Faces fold like paper
items.pz: 按 uv.y 分段旋转顶点，铰链要对齐面片边界。
items.pe: Rotate vertices per uv.y band with hinges on face edges.

definition.zh: 面片像纸一样折起来
definition.en: Faces fold like paper

distinction.zh: 按 uv.y 分段旋转顶点，铰链要对齐面片边界。
distinction.en: Rotate vertices per uv.y band with hinges on face edges.

items.dz: 纹理钉在屏幕上不跟物体走
items.de: Texture pinned to the screen
items.pz: 用 gl_FragCoord/resolution 当 uv，物体动纹理不动。
items.pe: uv = gl_FragCoord / resolution — the object moves, the texture stays.

definition.zh: 纹理钉在屏幕上不跟物体走
definition.en: Texture pinned to the screen

distinction.zh: 用 gl_FragCoord/resolution 当 uv，物体动纹理不动。
distinction.en: uv = gl_FragCoord / resolution — the object moves, the texture stays.

items.dz: 交界处不再有硬边
items.de: No hard seam where things meet
items.pz: 读深度缓冲算差值，差越小 alpha 越低（soft particles）。
items.pe: Sample the depth buffer; fade alpha as the difference shrinks.

definition.zh: 交界处不再有硬边
definition.en: No hard seam where things meet

distinction.zh: 读深度缓冲算差值，差越小 alpha 越低（soft particles）。
distinction.en: Sample the depth buffer; fade alpha as the difference shrinks.

items.dz: 平面看起来真的有深度
items.de: A flat plane gains real depth
items.pz: 沿视线在高度图里步进找交点，比 normal map 更立体。
items.pe: March the view ray through the height map for a real intersection.

definition.zh: 平面看起来真的有深度
definition.en: A flat plane gains real depth

distinction.zh: 沿视线在高度图里步进找交点，比 normal map 更立体。
distinction.en: March the view ray through the height map for a real intersection.

items.dz: 一张球图搞定所有光照
items.de: One sphere image is the whole lighting rig
items.pz: 把 view-space 法线的 xy 当 uv 去查那张球形贴图。
items.pe: Use the view-space normal xy as uv into the sphere image.

definition.zh: 一张球图搞定所有光照
definition.en: One sphere image is the whole lighting rig

distinction.zh: 把 view-space 法线的 xy 当 uv 去查那张球形贴图。
distinction.en: Use the view-space normal xy as uv into the sphere image.

items.dz: 不规则形体贴图不接缝
items.de: No seams on irregular shapes
items.pz: 三次采样按 pow(abs(normal), 4) 归一化混合。
items.pe: Blend three samples weighted by pow(abs(N), 4.0), normalised.

definition.zh: 不规则形体贴图不接缝
definition.en: No seams on irregular shapes

distinction.zh: 三次采样按 pow(abs(normal), 4) 归一化混合。
distinction.en: Blend three samples weighted by pow(abs(N), 4.0), normalised.

items.dz: 来回但不突变
items.de: Back and forth, never a jump
items.pz: abs(fract(t)*2-1) 得到无缝往复，比 sin 更省。
items.pe: abs(fract(t) * 2 - 1) gives a seamless ping-pong.

definition.zh: 来回但不突变
definition.en: Back and forth, never a jump

distinction.zh: abs(fract(t)*2-1) 得到无缝往复，比 sin 更省。
distinction.en: abs(fract(t) * 2 - 1) gives a seamless ping-pong.

items.dz: 硬边变成可控软边
items.de: A controllable soft edge
items.pz: smoothstep(a,b,x) 是抗锯齿的最小成本方案。
items.pe: smoothstep(a, b, x) is the cheapest antialiasing you get.

definition.zh: 硬边变成可控软边
definition.en: A controllable soft edge

distinction.zh: smoothstep(a,b,x) 是抗锯齿的最小成本方案。
distinction.en: smoothstep(a, b, x) is the cheapest antialiasing you get.

items.dz: 整体换色但不脏
items.de: Recolour without mud
items.pz: 转 HSV 只改 H，S/V 留着；别在 RGB 里乱乘。
items.pe: Convert to HSV and only touch H — never scale RGB directly.

definition.zh: 整体换色但不脏
definition.en: Recolour without mud

distinction.zh: 转 HSV 只改 H，S/V 留着；别在 RGB 里乱乘。
distinction.en: Convert to HSV and only touch H — never scale RGB directly.

items.dz: 中间色不再发灰
items.de: No grey dead zone in the middle
items.pz: 在 OKLab / oklch 里插值，感知均匀。
items.pe: Interpolate in OKLab / oklch for perceptual evenness.

definition.zh: 中间色不再发灰
definition.en: No grey dead zone in the middle

distinction.zh: 在 OKLab / oklch 里插值，感知均匀。
distinction.en: Interpolate in OKLab / oklch for perceptual evenness.

items.dz: 大面积渐变不再有环
items.de: No rings in a big gradient
items.pz: 输出前加 ±0.5/255 的三角噪声，肉眼看不见但环消失。
items.pe: Add ±0.5/255 triangular noise before output.

definition.zh: 大面积渐变不再有环
definition.en: No rings in a big gradient

distinction.zh: 输出前加 ±0.5/255 的三角噪声，肉眼看不见但环消失。
distinction.en: Add ±0.5/255 triangular noise before output.

items.dz: 半透明边缘不发黑
items.de: No black fringe on soft edges
items.pz: 混合前先乘 alpha，OneMinusSrcAlpha 才对。
items.pe: Multiply by alpha before blending with OneMinusSrcAlpha.

definition.zh: 半透明边缘不发黑
definition.en: No black fringe on soft edges

distinction.zh: 混合前先乘 alpha，OneMinusSrcAlpha 才对。
distinction.en: Multiply by alpha before blending with OneMinusSrcAlpha.

items.dz: 光叠光只会更亮
items.de: Light on light only brightens
items.pz: blending=AdditiveBlending 且 depthWrite=false。
items.pe: AdditiveBlending with depthWrite off.

definition.zh: 光叠光只会更亮
definition.en: Light on light only brightens

distinction.zh: blending=AdditiveBlending 且 depthWrite=false。
distinction.en: AdditiveBlending with depthWrite off.

items.dz: 影子不再有条纹
items.de: No more shadow acne
items.pz: normalBias 优于 constant bias；再不行调 shadow camera 近远面。
items.pe: Prefer normalBias; then tighten the shadow camera near/far.

definition.zh: 影子不再有条纹
definition.en: No more shadow acne

distinction.zh: normalBias 优于 constant bias；再不行调 shadow camera 近远面。
distinction.en: Prefer normalBias; then tighten the shadow camera near/far.

items.dz: 远处纹理不再闪
items.de: Distant texture stops shimmering
items.pz: 开 anisotropy + 适度 mip bias，比降分辨率好。
items.pe: Anisotropic filtering plus a mild mip bias.

definition.zh: 远处纹理不再闪
definition.en: Distant texture stops shimmering

distinction.zh: 开 anisotropy + 适度 mip bias，比降分辨率好。
distinction.en: Anisotropic filtering plus a mild mip bias.

items.dz: 字放大也不糊
items.de: Type stays crisp at any size
items.pz: MSDF 字体贴图 + median 三通道，缩放不失真。
items.pe: MSDF atlas with a three-channel median — scale-free crispness.

definition.zh: 字放大也不糊
definition.en: Type stays crisp at any size

distinction.zh: MSDF 字体贴图 + median 三通道，缩放不失真。
distinction.en: MSDF atlas with a three-channel median — scale-free crispness.

items.dz: 不用贴图也能上色
items.de: Colour without a texture
items.pz: geometry 的 color attribute + material.vertexColors=true。
items.pe: A color attribute plus material.vertexColors.

definition.zh: 不用贴图也能上色
definition.en: Colour without a texture

distinction.zh: geometry 的 color attribute + material.vertexColors=true。
distinction.en: A color attribute plus material.vertexColors.

items.dz: 像水银一样黏在一起
items.de: Mercury-like coalescing
items.pz: blur + 高 contrast 的滤镜组合，或 shader 里 smin。
items.pe: Blur then crank contrast — or smin in a shader.

definition.zh: 像水银一样黏在一起
definition.en: Mercury-like coalescing

distinction.zh: blur + 高 contrast 的滤镜组合，或 shader 里 smin。
distinction.en: Blur then crank contrast — or smin in a shader.

items.dz: 一瞬间的分叉亮线
items.de: A branching flash
items.pz: 递归中点位移画折线，配 3 帧内的亮度爆闪。
items.pe: Midpoint-displacement polyline with a 3-frame flash.

definition.zh: 一瞬间的分叉亮线
definition.en: A branching flash

distinction.zh: 递归中点位移画折线，配 3 帧内的亮度爆闪。
distinction.en: Midpoint-displacement polyline with a 3-frame flash.

items.dz: 底部亮、顶部撕碎
items.de: Bright base, torn tip
items.pz: 向上滚动的噪声乘一条纵向衰减，颜色走黑体色带。
items.pe: Upward-scrolling noise times a vertical falloff, blackbody ramp.

definition.zh: 底部亮、顶部撕碎
definition.en: Bright base, torn tip

distinction.zh: 向上滚动的噪声乘一条纵向衰减，颜色走黑体色带。
distinction.en: Upward-scrolling noise times a vertical falloff, blackbody ramp.

items.dz: 越升越散
items.de: It spreads as it rises
items.pz: 噪声 + 上升偏移，透明度随高度平方衰减。
items.pe: Noise plus rising offset; alpha falls with height squared.

definition.zh: 越升越散
definition.en: It spreads as it rises

distinction.zh: 噪声 + 上升偏移，透明度随高度平方衰减。
distinction.en: Noise plus rising offset; alpha falls with height squared.

items.dz: 穿过星星往前飞
items.de: Flying through stars
items.pz: 星点 z 递减，屏幕位置 = xy/z，越近越快越大。
items.pe: Decrement z; project xy / z so near stars move fastest.

definition.zh: 穿过星星往前飞
definition.en: Flying through stars

distinction.zh: 星点 z 递减，屏幕位置 = xy/z，越近越快越大。
distinction.en: Decrement z; project xy / z so near stars move fastest.

items.dz: 半透明加横条抖动
items.de: Translucent with a scan jitter
items.pz: 菲涅尔 + 横条 mask + 轻微 y 抖动，别加彩虹色。
items.pe: Fresnel plus a stripe mask and a light y jitter — skip the rainbow.

definition.zh: 半透明加横条抖动
definition.en: Translucent with a scan jitter

distinction.zh: 菲涅尔 + 横条 mask + 轻微 y 抖动，别加彩虹色。
distinction.en: Fresnel plus a stripe mask and a light y jitter — skip the rainbow.

items.dz: 溶解边缘带着火线
items.de: The dissolve edge burns
items.pz: 同一噪声阈值取两个 step 之差，中间那条带上暖色。
items.pe: Two thresholds on one noise field; tint the band between them.

definition.zh: 溶解边缘带着火线
definition.en: The dissolve edge burns

distinction.zh: 同一噪声阈值取两个 step 之差，中间那条带上暖色。
distinction.en: Two thresholds on one noise field; tint the band between them.

items.dz: 用背面撑出一圈黑边
items.de: Backfaces make the ink line
items.pz: 复制一份放大、只画背面、颜色纯黑，成本极低。
items.pe: A scaled backface-only copy in black — nearly free.

definition.zh: 用背面撑出一圈黑边
definition.en: Backfaces make the ink line

distinction.zh: 复制一份放大、只画背面、颜色纯黑，成本极低。
distinction.en: A scaled backface-only copy in black — nearly free.

items.dz: 手绘线像在呼吸
items.de: Hand-drawn lines breathe
items.pz: 每 3 帧换一张排线图（shake-shake 手法），别逐帧。
items.pe: Swap hatch textures every third frame, not every frame.

definition.zh: 手绘线像在呼吸
definition.en: Hand-drawn lines breathe

distinction.zh: 每 3 帧换一张排线图（shake-shake 手法），别逐帧。
distinction.en: Swap hatch textures every third frame, not every frame.

items.dz: 一眼看出拉伸
items.de: Stretching becomes obvious
items.pz: 开发期贴 UV 棋盘图，格子变形就是 UV 有问题。
items.pe: Ship a UV checker during dev — deformed squares mean bad UVs.

definition.zh: 一眼看出拉伸
definition.en: Stretching becomes obvious

distinction.zh: 开发期贴 UV 棋盘图，格子变形就是 UV 有问题。
distinction.en: Ship a UV checker during dev — deformed squares mean bad UVs.

items.dz: 多层正弦场叠加的经典 demo 纹。
items.de: Layered sine fields, the classic demo.
items.pz: sin(x+t)+sin(y+t)+sin(x+y+t)…叠加归一化输出色带。说「plasma」即此。
items.pe: Sines upon sines upon sines.

definition.zh: plasma 是 demoscene 经典：多个随时间相位的正弦场求和后映射色带，生成流动的连续彩纹。
definition.en: Layered sine fields, the classic demo.

distinction.zh: 与 feTurbulence 的区别：plasma 是解析正弦（完全确定、平滑），turbulence 是梯度噪声（随机基底）。
distinction.en: plasma is analytic sines; turbulence is stochastic gradient noise.

items.dz: 程序化六边形镶嵌与描边。
items.de: Procedural hexagonal tiling.
items.pz: axial 坐标 + 距离场描边：蜂窝、晶格、科技 UI 底纹。说「六边形网格」即此。
items.pe: Honeycomb by math.

definition.zh: 六边形网格纹以轴向坐标与 SDF 六边形距离场程序化生成，天然无缝、密度可控。
definition.en: Procedural hexagonal tiling.

distinction.zh: 与方格网格的区别：六边形是边数最少的等边镶嵌（每格 6 等邻），蜂巢/晶格语义更强。
distinction.en: Hexagons tile with six equal neighbors; square grids have four.

items.dz: 程序化砖块排布与错缝。
items.de: Procedural bricks with running bond.
items.pz: 行号奇偶决定半砖错缝 + mortar 缝宽参数。说「砖墙纹」即此。
items.pe: Half-offset rows.

definition.zh: 程序化砖墙纹按行交错半砖（running bond）排布，mortar 缝与砖尺寸皆为参数。
definition.en: Procedural bricks with running bond.

distinction.zh: 与贴图的区别：程序纹无限分辨率无接缝；与 hatching 的区别：那是排线风格，这是结构砌式。
distinction.en: Brickwork offsets rows; hatching is stroke styling.

items.dz: step/floor 生成条纹与条纹渐变。
items.de: Stripe fields via step functions.
items.pz: step(.5, fract(x*freq)) 出条纹；配 smoothstep 出抗锯齿软条纹。说「条纹场」即此。
items.pe: fract + step = stripes.

definition.zh: 程序化条纹以 fract 坐标折叠 + step 阈值生成，条纹频率与方向都是 Uniform 参数。
definition.en: Stripe fields via step functions.

distinction.zh: 与 repeating-linear-gradient 的区别：同一数学（fract 折叠），着色器版可随位置扭曲出波浪/环状条纹。
distinction.en: fract+step stripes warp freely; repeating-linear-gradient is fixed-axis.

items.sourceLabel: The Book of Shaders: Shaping functions

items.dz: 单元内随机取向的四分之一弧拼出迷宫。
items.de: Quarter-arc tiles in random orientation.
items.pz: 每格随机选 0/1 画相对两角的四分之一弧——连通迷宫自动出现。说「特吕谢」即此。
items.pe: Random flips, guaranteed maze.

definition.zh: 特吕谢纹（Truchet tiling）在每单元内以随机取向放置装饰（四分之一弧），拼合后形成连续迷宫纹样。
definition.en: Quarter-arc tiles in random orientation.

distinction.zh: 与普通纹理的区别：连续性由单元设计保证（任何随机序列都无缝）——程序化美学的教科书案例。
distinction.en: Tile design guarantees continuity for any random sequence; generic textures seam.

items.dz: 格点随机值之间插值的平滑噪声。
items.de: Random lattice values, interpolated.
items.pz: 格点 hash 随机值 + smoothstep 插值 = 大朵软噪声；叠 octaves 出 fbm。说「值噪声」即此。
items.pe: Softer and cheaper than gradient noise.

definition.zh: 值噪声在整数格点上放置伪随机值，格内以插值（常用 smoothstep）过渡，产生柔和连续噪声。
definition.en: Random lattice values, interpolated.

distinction.zh: 与 Perlin 梯度噪声的区别：值噪声插值的是“值”（易现格状伪影），Perlin 插值的是“梯度”（更各向同性）。
distinction.en: Value noise interpolates lattice values (grid artifacts); Perlin interpolates gradients.

items.dz: 完全随机、无空间相关的像素噪声。
items.de: Pure uncorrelated randomness.
items.pz: hash(uv) 逐像素独立随机：胶片颗粒、抖动基底。说「白噪声」即此。
items.pe: Every pixel its own coin flip.

definition.zh: 白噪声是空间完全不相关的随机信号：每像素独立随机值，频谱平坦。
definition.en: Pure uncorrelated randomness.

distinction.zh: 与值/分形噪声的区别：无任何空间相关性——看起来是“沙”，不是“云”；溶解转场（dissolve-noise）用它。
distinction.en: White noise has zero spatial correlation; value noise interpolates smoothly.

items.dz: 能量集中在高频的“悦耳”随机。
items.de: High-frequency-only randomness.
items.pz: 抖动/采样首选：颗粒细密不聚块，比白噪声观感高级。说「蓝噪声」即此。
items.pe: Grain without clumping.

definition.zh: 蓝噪声的频谱能量集中在高频段：样本分布均匀不聚块，是抖动、采样与 CI 颗粒的高级选择。
definition.en: High-frequency-only randomness.

distinction.zh: 与白噪声的区别：白噪声会随机聚块（低频能量也存在），蓝噪声压制低频——量化到“最小间距”约束。
distinction.en: Blue noise suppresses low-frequency clumping; white noise clumps randomly.

items.dz: 以重心坐标画三角形网格线。
items.de: Wireframes from barycentric coordinates.
items.pz: 片段级重心坐标 n House：edge factor = 1-min(bary)——几何着色器时代的替代方案。说「重心线框」即此。
items.pe: Wireframe without geometry shaders.

definition.zh: 以重心坐标到边的距离生成线框（无需几何着色器/ line 模式），现代线框渲染的标准技巧。
definition.en: Wireframes from barycentric coordinates.

distinction.zh: 与 gl.LINES 线框的区别：LINES 需要额外索引且线宽受限为 1，重心线框在片段级抗锯齿可调宽。
distinction.en: Barycentric wireframes run in the fragment stage; gl.LINES is geometry-bound and 1px.

items.dz: 屏幕空间对比度检测的快速抗锯齿后处理。
items.de: Screen-space cheap anti-aliasing.
items.pz: FXAA 找边缘方向沿垂直方向模糊一次——一 pass 搞定。说「FXAA」即此。
items.pe: One pass, all edges.

definition.zh: FXAA 以屏幕空间局部对比度检测边缘，沿边缘垂直方向模糊混合，实现单 pass 低成本抗锯齿。
definition.en: Screen-space cheap anti-aliasing.

distinction.zh: 与 MSAA 的区别：MSAA 是硬件多重采样（几何边精准但贵），FXAA 是后处理近似（快但会糊细节文字）。
distinction.en: FXAA is a cheap screen-space approximation; MSAA is precise hardware sampling.

items.dz: 电影级标准映射曲线：肩部+趾部。
items.de: The filmic tonemapping standard.
items.pz: ACES 近似式一行入片段着色器；高光滚降、暗部保细节。说「ACES」即此。
items.pe: The filmic shoulder.

definition.zh: ACES 色调映射是影视行业标准的压缩曲线（含肩部与趾部），把线性 HDR 值映射为胶片感的显示范围。
definition.en: The filmic tonemapping standard.

distinction.zh: 与 Reinhard 的区别：Reinhard 简单倒数压缩（整体偏灰），ACES 有对比度保留与色相偏移校正。
distinction.en: ACES preserves contrast with shoulder/toe; Reinhard compresses uniformly.

items.dz: 光源尺寸决定阴影边缘的软硬。
items.de: Light size decides shadow edge softness.
items.pz: 点光源→硬边；面光源→半影。着色器里 shadow map 配 PCF 模糊半径。说「软硬阴影」即此。
items.pe: Umbra and penumbra.

definition.zh: 阴影软硬由光源相对尺寸决定：小光源投影硬边（本影），面光源产生半影（umbra/penumbra 过渡带）。
definition.en: Light size decides shadow edge softness.

distinction.zh: 与 shadow map bias 的区别：bias 解决痤疮伪影，PCF/软阴影解决边缘质感——两个独立的问题。
distinction.en: Light size decides edge softness; shadow map bias fixes acne artifacts.

items.zh: PBR 金属粗糙度工作流
items.dz: 以 albedo/metallic/roughness 三贴图驱动物理光照。
items.de: The standard PBR parameterization.
items.pz: metallic 决定 F0、roughness 决定 GGX 高光宽度——材质表现力全部来自这三张图。说「metal-rough」即此。
items.pe: Three maps run the show.

definition.zh: 金属-粗糙度工作流（glTF 标准）以 albedo/metallic/roughness 参数化 PBR 材质：metallic 控制 F0 反射率，roughness 控制高光分布。
definition.en: The standard PBR parameterization.

distinction.zh: 与 specular-glossiness 旧工作流的区别：metal-rough 中 metallic 是标量参数，无需独立 specular 贴图；能量守恒内建。
distinction.en: metal-roughness parameterizes PBR with built-in energy conservation; specular-glossiness needs extra maps.

items.dz: 把法线贴图叠加到基础法线上制造细节。
items.de: Detail normals over base normals.
items.pz: 白犰狳式 detail normal 与 base normal 混合（白化-out 重归一化）。说「细节法线」即此。
items.pe: Detail without geometry.

definition.zh: 法线贴图混合把细节法线（如织物纹路）叠加到基础法线上（白化-out / RNM 混合后重归一化），无额外几何获得微观起伏。
definition.en: Detail normals over base normals.

distinction.zh: 与多层材质贴图的区别：混合发生在法线向量空间而非颜色空间；重归一化是正确性的关键步骤。
distinction.en: Normal blending operates in vector space and must renormalize; color blending is per channel.

items.dz: MSDF 用三通道距离场保留锐利转角。
items.de: MSDF keeps corners crisp at any size.
items.pz: MSDF Atlas：一张小纹理任意字号锐利渲染，转角不像单通道 SDF 那样圆化。说「MSDF 字体」即此。
items.pe: Crisp corners, one texture.

definition.zh: 多通道有符号距离场（MSDF）以 RGB 三通道分别编码到最近边的距离与方向，弥补单通道 SDF 的圆角化缺陷，实现任意缩放的锐利文字/图标。
definition.en: MSDF keeps corners crisp at any size.

distinction.zh: 与单通道 SDF 文字（uvsdftext）的区别：单通道版转角会圆化，MSDF 在转角处保持锐利；代价是生成更复杂。
distinction.en: MSDF keeps corners crisp; single-channel SDF rounds them at any size.

items.dz: 以 N 倍分辨率渲染再降采样。
items.de: Render at N×, then downsample.
items.pz: 离屏 4× 分辨率渲染 → 盒滤波回目标尺寸——最朴素最正确的抗锯齿。说「超采样」即此。
items.pe: The brute force that always works.

definition.zh: 超采样（SSAA）以倍增分辨率渲染再盒滤波降采样：对全部信号（几何、纹理、着色）均匀抗锯齿。
definition.en: Render at N×, then downsample.

distinction.zh: 与 FXAA 的区别：SSAA 是真采样（无细节损失、无糊文字）但成本随倍数线性增长；FXAA 是近似。
distinction.en: SSAA truly samples everything at N× cost; FXAA approximates in one pass.

items.dz: 让 GPU 在写入/读取时自动做伽马编解码。
items.de: Hardware gamma encode on write.
items.pz: GL_FRAMEBUFFER_SRGB / canvas 配置：光照在线性空间算、存储自动编码。说「sRGB 帧缓冲」即此。
items.pe: Encode on write, decode on read.

definition.zh: sRGB 帧缓冲扩展让 GPU 在写入帧缓冲时自动做线性→sRGB 编码、采样时解码，使管线全程线性计算。
definition.en: Hardware gamma encode on write.

distinction.zh: 与手动 pow(1/2.2) 的区别：硬件编码免费且无精度损失；忘记开启是渲染偏暗/偏亮的常见根因。
distinction.en: The framebuffer encodes on write; manual pow(1/2.2) is the hand-rolled equivalent.

items.dz: 高光反射与漫散射是光照的两个本质分量。
items.de: The two essential lighting responses.
items.pz: 漫反射随朝向（N·L），镜面随视角（半程向量）： Roughness 越低镜面越锐。说「双分量光照」即此。
items.pe: N·L vs the half-vector.

definition.zh: 漫反射是进入表面的散射（Lambert N·L），镜面反射是表层直接反射（随视角移动的高光）——实时光照的两块基石。
definition.en: The two essential lighting responses.

distinction.zh: 与 fresnel 的区别：fresnel 描述两者随视角的比例变化；本条是分量本身的定义。
distinction.en: These are the two lighting components; fresnel governs their ratio per view angle.

items.dz: 全程线性计算、只在首尾编解码的工作管线。
items.de: Linear in, linear out, encode at the ends.
items.pz: 纹理解码→线性光照→tone mapping→伽马编码：顺序错了全错。说「线性工作流」即此。
items.pe: The pipeline order that matters.

definition.zh: 线性工作流要求：输入纹理解码到线性、全部光照与混合在线性空间进行、最后经 tone mapping 与伽马编码输出。
definition.en: Linear in, linear out, encode at the ends.

distinction.zh: 与 srgb-framebuffer 的区别：那是实现手段之一，本条是整条管线的组织原则。
distinction.en: linear-workflow is the pipeline organization principle; srgb-framebuffer is one implementation.

dz: 时间线、缓动库、ScrollTrigger——工业级动效的默认工具
de: Timelines, eases and ScrollTrigger — the industry default

items.dz: 一串元素依次进场
items.de: Elements arrive one after another
items.pz: tl.from(items,{y:24,opacity:0,stagger:.06,ease:"power3.out"})
items.pe: tl.from(items, { y: 24, opacity: 0, stagger: 0.06, ease: "power3.out" })

definition.zh: 一串元素依次进场
definition.en: Elements arrive one after another

distinction.zh: tl.from(items,{y:24,opacity:0,stagger:.06,ease:"power3.out"})
distinction.en: tl.from(items, { y: 24, opacity: 0, stagger: 0.06, ease: "power3.out" })

items.dz: 从中间往两边扩散
items.de: It spreads from the middle out
items.pz: stagger:{from:"center",each:.05}
items.pe: stagger: { from: "center", each: 0.05 }

definition.zh: 从中间往两边扩散
definition.en: It spreads from the middle out

distinction.zh: stagger:{from:"center",each:.05}
distinction.en: stagger: { from: "center", each: 0.05 }

items.dz: 像一道斜波扫过网格
items.de: A diagonal wave crosses the grid
items.pz: stagger:{grid:[3,3],from:"start",axis:null,each:.05}
items.pe: stagger: { grid: [3,3], from: "start", each: 0.05 }

definition.zh: 像一道斜波扫过网格
definition.en: A diagonal wave crosses the grid

distinction.zh: stagger:{grid:[3,3],from:"start",axis:null,each:.05}
distinction.en: stagger: { grid: [3,3], from: "start", each: 0.05 }

items.dz: 起手极快、尾巴极长
items.de: Fast attack, long tail
items.pz: ease:"power4.out"，UI 进场的默认选择。
items.pe: ease: "power4.out" — the default for UI entrances.

definition.zh: 起手极快、尾巴极长
definition.en: Fast attack, long tail

distinction.zh: ease:"power4.out"，UI 进场的默认选择。
distinction.en: ease: "power4.out" — the default for UI entrances.

items.dz: 比 power4 还要更急一点
items.de: Even snappier than power4
items.pz: ease:"expo.out"，适合"弹出即到位"的面板。
items.pe: ease: "expo.out" — for panels that must feel instant.

definition.zh: 比 power4 还要更急一点
definition.en: Even snappier than power4

distinction.zh: ease:"expo.out"，适合"弹出即到位"的面板。
distinction.en: ease: "expo.out" — for panels that must feel instant.

items.dz: 过一点头再回来
items.de: A small overshoot, then home
items.pz: ease:"back.out(1.7)"，1.7 是甜点值。
items.pe: ease: "back.out(1.7)" — 1.7 is the sweet spot.

definition.zh: 过一点头再回来
definition.en: A small overshoot, then home

distinction.zh: ease:"back.out(1.7)"，1.7 是甜点值。
distinction.en: ease: "back.out(1.7)" — 1.7 is the sweet spot.

items.dz: 弹两下才停
items.de: It rings before settling
items.pz: ease:"elastic.out(1,.35)"，第二参数越小弹得越久。
items.pe: ease: "elastic.out(1, 0.35)" — smaller means longer ring.

definition.zh: 弹两下才停
definition.en: It rings before settling

distinction.zh: ease:"elastic.out(1,.35)"，第二参数越小弹得越久。
distinction.en: ease: "elastic.out(1, 0.35)" — smaller means longer ring.

items.dz: 落地弹几下
items.de: It bounces on landing
items.pz: ease:"bounce.out"，只用在有重量的物体上。
items.pe: ease: "bounce.out" — only for things with weight.

definition.zh: 落地弹几下
definition.en: It bounces on landing

distinction.zh: ease:"bounce.out"，只用在有重量的物体上。
distinction.en: ease: "bounce.out" — only for things with weight.

items.dz: 两头都很稳
items.de: Calm at both ends
items.pz: ease:"circ.inOut"，适合大位移的镜头式移动。
items.pe: ease: "circ.inOut" for long, camera-like moves.

definition.zh: 两头都很稳
definition.en: Calm at both ends

distinction.zh: ease:"circ.inOut"，适合大位移的镜头式移动。
distinction.en: ease: "circ.inOut" for long, camera-like moves.

items.dz: 一格一格跳
items.de: It jumps cell by cell
items.pz: ease:"steps(8)"，做序列帧或计数器。
items.pe: ease: "steps(8)" for sprite frames and counters.

definition.zh: 一格一格跳
definition.en: It jumps cell by cell

distinction.zh: ease:"steps(8)"，做序列帧或计数器。
distinction.en: ease: "steps(8)" for sprite frames and counters.

items.dz: 左右摇几下，幅度递减
items.de: A few decaying shakes
items.pz: CustomWiggle.create("w",{wiggles:6,type:"easeOut"})
items.pe: CustomWiggle.create("w", { wiggles: 6, type: "easeOut" })

definition.zh: 左右摇几下，幅度递减
definition.en: A few decaying shakes

distinction.zh: CustomWiggle.create("w",{wiggles:6,type:"easeOut"})
distinction.en: CustomWiggle.create("w", { wiggles: 6, type: "easeOut" })

items.dz: 弹跳还带压扁
items.de: Bounce with squash baked in
items.pz: CustomBounce.create("b",{strength:.6,squash:2})
items.pe: CustomBounce.create("b", { strength: 0.6, squash: 2 })

definition.zh: 弹跳还带压扁
definition.en: Bounce with squash baked in

distinction.zh: CustomBounce.create("b",{strength:.6,squash:2})
distinction.en: CustomBounce.create("b", { strength: 0.6, squash: 2 })

items.dz: 一条 tween 走多个路点
items.de: One tween, many waypoints
items.pz: gsap.to(el,{keyframes:[{x:100},{y:60},{x:0,y:0}]})
items.pe: gsap.to(el, { keyframes: [{x:100},{y:60},{x:0,y:0}] })

definition.zh: 一条 tween 走多个路点
definition.en: One tween, many waypoints

distinction.zh: gsap.to(el,{keyframes:[{x:100},{y:60},{x:0,y:0}]})
distinction.en: gsap.to(el, { keyframes: [{x:100},{y:60},{x:0,y:0}] })

items.dz: 来回播放同一段
items.de: The same beat, back and forth
items.pz: repeat:-1, yoyo:true, repeatDelay:.2
items.pe: repeat: -1, yoyo: true, repeatDelay: 0.2

definition.zh: 来回播放同一段
definition.en: The same beat, back and forth

distinction.zh: repeat:-1, yoyo:true, repeatDelay:.2
distinction.en: repeat: -1, yoyo: true, repeatDelay: 0.2

items.dz: 整段动效突然加速
items.de: The whole sequence speeds up
items.pz: gsap.to(tl,{timeScale:2.5,duration:.6})，改的是时间线本身。
items.pe: gsap.to(tl, { timeScale: 2.5 }) — you tween the timeline itself.

definition.zh: 整段动效突然加速
definition.en: The whole sequence speeds up

distinction.zh: gsap.to(tl,{timeScale:2.5,duration:.6})，改的是时间线本身。
distinction.en: gsap.to(tl, { timeScale: 2.5 }) — you tween the timeline itself.

items.dz: 跟手但有阻尼
items.de: It follows your hand, with damping
items.pz: const x=gsap.quickTo(el,"x",{duration:.4,ease:"power3"})
items.pe: gsap.quickTo(el, "x", { duration: 0.4, ease: "power3" })

definition.zh: 跟手但有阻尼
definition.en: It follows your hand, with damping

distinction.zh: const x=gsap.quickTo(el,"x",{duration:.4,ease:"power3"})

items.dz: 真想看才展开，划过不展开
items.de: Only real intent opens it
items.pz: 进入 120ms 后才展开，离开 240ms 才收，防误触。

items.dz: 贴边时自动换方向

items.pe: Use Floating UI flip and shift middleware.

definition.zh: 贴边时自动换方向

distinction.zh: Floating UI 的 flip + shift middleware，别自己算。
distinction.en: Use Floating UI flip and shift middleware.

items.dz: 一万行也能有进场动效

definition.zh: 一万行也能有进场动效

distinction.zh: react-virtual 只渲染可视行，进场动效挂在行内不在容器。
distinction.en: Virtualise rows and animate inside the row, not the container.

items.dz: 一串元素像尾巴跟上来
items.de: A trail follows the first

items.pe: useTrail(n, { from, to, config: config.gentle })

definition.zh: 一串元素像尾巴跟上来
definition.en: A trail follows the first

distinction.en: useTrail(n, { from, to, config: config.gentle })

items.dz: 四套配方覆盖九成场景

items.pe: config.stiff / gentle / wobbly / molasses — pick, then tune.

definition.zh: 四套配方覆盖九成场景
definition.en: Four presets cover most needs

distinction.zh: config.stiff / gentle / wobbly / molasses，先选再调。
distinction.en: config.stiff / gentle / wobbly / molasses — pick, then tune.

items.dz: 两段动效严格接力

items.pe: useChain([refA, refB], [0, 0.3]) beats manual delays.

definition.zh: 两段动效严格接力
definition.en: Two springs, strict handoff

distinction.zh: useChain([refA,refB],[0,.3])，比 delay 更可靠。
distinction.en: useChain([refA, refB], [0, 0.3]) beats manual delays.

items.dz: 事件里直接开动效

items.pz: const [scope,animate]=useAnimate(); animate(scope.current,{x:20})
items.pe: useAnimate() gives you animate() inside handlers.

definition.zh: 事件里直接开动效
definition.en: Fire motion straight from an event

distinction.zh: const [scope,animate]=useAnimate(); animate(scope.current,{x:20})

items.dz: 一串关键动作写成数组

definition.zh: 一串关键动作写成数组
definition.en: The whole beat as an array

items.dz: 不用 JS 也能滚动驱动
items.de: Scroll-driven without JS
items.pz: animation-timeline:view() / scroll()，降级用 IntersectionObserver。
items.pe: animation-timeline: view() or scroll(), with an IO fallback.

definition.zh: 不用 JS 也能滚动驱动
definition.en: Scroll-driven without JS

distinction.zh: animation-timeline:view() / scroll()，降级用 IntersectionObserver。
distinction.en: animation-timeline: view() or scroll(), with an IO fallback.

items.dz: 尊重系统偏好
items.de: Respect the system preference
items.pz: const reduce=useReducedMotion()，reduce 时只留 opacity。
items.pe: useReducedMotion() — keep only opacity when true.

definition.zh: 尊重系统偏好
definition.en: Respect the system preference

distinction.en: useReducedMotion() — keep only opacity when true.

items.dz: 兄弟组件一起重算布局
items.de: Siblings re-measure together
items.pz: <LayoutGroup> 包住互相影响的可折叠项。
items.pe: Wrap mutually affecting collapsibles in LayoutGroup.

definition.zh: 兄弟组件一起重算布局
definition.en: Siblings re-measure together

distinction.zh: <LayoutGroup> 包住互相影响的可折叠项。
distinction.en: Wrap mutually affecting collapsibles in LayoutGroup.

items.dz: 指一张，其他张退让
items.de: Hover one, the rest recede
items.pz: 父层 group hover 下给兄弟降 opacity/scale。
items.pe: On group hover, dim and shrink the siblings.

definition.zh: 指一张，其他张退让

items.dz: 自定义光标带阻尼跟随
items.de: A damped custom cursor

items.pe: Spring the pointer coords with damping ≈ 30.

definition.zh: 自定义光标带阻尼跟随

distinction.zh: useSpring 包 pointer 坐标，damping 30 左右。

items.dz: 按钮被指针吸过去
items.de: The button is drawn to the cursor
items.pz: 指针相对中心的偏移 ×0.3 喂给 useSpring。
items.pe: Feed pointer offset × 0.3 into useSpring.

definition.zh: 按钮被指针吸过去
definition.en: The button is drawn to the cursor

distinction.zh: 指针相对中心的偏移 ×0.3 喂给 useSpring。
distinction.en: Feed pointer offset × 0.3 into useSpring.

items.dz: 整行从遮罩后升起
items.de: Lines rise from behind a mask
items.pz: 每行一个 overflow:hidden 包裹，内层 y:100%→0。
items.pe: Wrap each line, animate the inner y from 100% to 0.

definition.zh: 整行从遮罩后升起
definition.en: Lines rise from behind a mask

distinction.zh: 每行一个 overflow:hidden 包裹，内层 y:100%→0。
distinction.en: Wrap each line, animate the inner y from 100% to 0.

items.dz: 进视口才开始数

items.pz: useInView 触发 animate(count,target,{duration:1.2})。
items.pe: Trigger animate(count, target) from useInView.

definition.zh: 进视口才开始数
definition.en: It starts counting on entry

distinction.zh: useInView 触发 animate(count,target,{duration:1.2})。
distinction.en: Trigger animate(count, target) from useInView.

items.dz: 错了抖一下并聚焦
items.de: Wrong input shakes and focuses
items.pz: ±6px 三次衰减 + aria-live 提示，别只靠红框。
items.pe: Three decaying ±6px shakes plus an aria-live message.

definition.zh: 错了抖一下并聚焦

distinction.zh: ±6px 三次衰减 + aria-live 提示，别只靠红框。

items.dz: 提交完成打一个勾
items.de: A check lands on success
items.pz: 勾用 stroke-dashoffset 画出来，配 spring scale。
items.pe: Draw the check with stroke-dashoffset plus a spring scale.

definition.zh: 提交完成打一个勾
definition.en: A check lands on success

distinction.zh: 勾用 stroke-dashoffset 画出来，配 spring scale。
distinction.en: Draw the check with stroke-dashoffset plus a spring scale.

items.dz: 滑块过一点头
items.de: The knob overshoots slightly
items.pz: spring(500,30) + 滑块宽度短暂拉长。
items.pe: spring(500, 30) with a brief knob stretch.

definition.zh: 滑块过一点头
definition.en: The knob overshoots slightly

distinction.zh: spring(500,30) + 滑块宽度短暂拉长。
distinction.en: spring(500, 30) with a brief knob stretch.

items.dz: 勾出现时盒子鼓一下
items.de: The box pops as it checks
items.pz: scale 1→1.15→1 配勾的 clip-path 揭示。
items.pe: scale 1 → 1.15 → 1 with a clip-path reveal on the tick.

definition.zh: 勾出现时盒子鼓一下

distinction.zh: scale 1→1.15→1 配勾的 clip-path 揭示。
distinction.en: scale 1 → 1.15 → 1 with a clip-path reveal on the tick.

items.dz: 选中态在选项间滑动
items.de: The selection slides between options
items.pz: 共享 layoutId 的圆点，不是各自 fade。
items.pe: One layoutId dot, not per-option fades.

definition.zh: 选中态在选项间滑动
definition.en: The selection slides between options

distinction.zh: 共享 layoutId 的圆点，不是各自 fade。
distinction.en: One layoutId dot, not per-option fades.

items.dz: 底片滑到选中项
items.de: The pill slides to the choice

definition.zh: 底片滑到选中项

distinction.zh: 底片 layout 动画 + 文字颜色同帧切换。

items.dz: 从触发点长出来

definition.zh: 从触发点长出来

distinction.zh: transform-origin 设在触发点，scale .95→1 + y -4→0。
distinction.en: Set transform-origin at the trigger; scale 0.95 → 1.

items.dz: 呼出即聚焦，键盘全通
items.de: Opens focused, fully keyboard-driven
items.pz: 打开时 scale .96→1 + backdrop 淡入，输入框自动 focus。
items.pe: Scale 0.96 → 1 with a scrim; autofocus the input.

definition.zh: 呼出即聚焦，键盘全通
definition.en: Opens focused, fully keyboard-driven

distinction.zh: 打开时 scale .96→1 + backdrop 淡入，输入框自动 focus。
distinction.en: Scale 0.96 → 1 with a scrim; autofocus the input.

items.dz: 横滑丢掉提示
items.de: Swipe it away

definition.zh: 横滑丢掉提示
definition.en: Swipe it away

distinction.zh: drag="x" + onDragEnd 超 100px 或速度超 500 就移除。

items.dz: 上下键移动高亮块

items.dz: 点缩略图放大成全屏

items.dz: 每个状态一套姿势

items.pe: animate={state} with idle / loading / done variants.

distinction.en: animate={state} with idle / loading / done variants.

items.dz: 加载完才淡入，不闪

items.dz: 下滚收起、上滚露出

items.dz: 拖分隔条改布局

items.dz: 成功时一下小爆发

dz: 数据驱动形状：enter / update / exit 是全部动效的骨架
de: Data-driven shapes — enter, update, exit is the whole grammar

items.dz: 新数据长出来，旧数据缩回去

definition.zh: 同一条数据始终是同一根柱子
definition.en: One datum keeps its bar

distinction.en: Pass a key function to join — never the index.

items.dz: 重新排序时柱子横向滑

definition.zh: 重新排序时柱子横向滑

items.dz: 排名一直在换

definition.zh: 排名一直在换

distinction.zh: 每帧插值一次 rank 与 value，keyframes 数越多越顺。

items.dz: 刻度换的时候旧的淡出

items.pe: Fade exiting ticks; fade in new ones at their new positions.

items.dz: 扇形沿着角度长出来

items.dz: 一个环讲一个百分比

distinction.zh: arc().innerRadius 留 70%，中间放数字。

items.dz: 柱子绕成一圈

distinction.zh: scaleRadial 才不会让面积说谎，别直接用线性半径。

items.dz: 换一种曲线换一种气质

distinction.zh: curveMonotoneX 保单调，curveCatmullRom 更圆但会过冲。

items.dz: 一层层叠上去

distinction.zh: stack() 的 order 与 offset 决定叙事：wiggle 做 streamgraph。

items.dz: 一叠密度曲线

distinction.zh: 各行留 -50% 的重叠，从后往前画。

items.dz: 散点变成等高线

items.dz: 点挤开但不重叠

items.dz: 拖一个，整网跟着松动

distinction.zh: 只在无意义的轴上加抖动，幅度不超过半个间距。
distinction.en: Only jitter the meaningless axis, under half a step.

items.dz: 时间跨度横着画
items.de: Spans laid out in time
items.pz: 按开始时间排序，依赖关系用细连线。
items.pe: Sort by start; draw dependencies as hairlines.

definition.zh: 时间跨度横着画
definition.en: Spans laid out in time

distinction.zh: 按开始时间排序，依赖关系用细连线。
distinction.en: Sort by start; draw dependencies as hairlines.

items.dz: 两点之间的差
items.de: The gap between two points
items.pz: 连线细、端点圆，颜色区分前后。
items.pe: Thin connector, round ends, two colours.

definition.zh: 两点之间的差
definition.en: The gap between two points

distinction.zh: 连线细、端点圆，颜色区分前后。
distinction.en: Thin connector, round ends, two colours.

items.dz: 每个类别以细线连到端点圆点
items.de: A thin stem connects each category to its endpoint dot
items.pz: 每条细线从共同基线延伸到数值位置，端点圆点与线共同构成数据标记。
items.pe: Each thin stem rises from a shared baseline to its value; the endpoint dot and stem form one data mark.

definition.zh: 棒棒糖图以共同基线为起点，为每个类别绘制一条延伸到其数值位置的细线，并在端点放置圆点。
definition.en: A lollipop chart uses a shared baseline and, for each category, a thin stem ending in a dot at its value.

distinction.zh: 此示例中的线连接端点与共同基线；线宽只是绘制参数，不是图表类型名称。
distinction.en: In this example, the stem connects each endpoint to a shared baseline; its stroke width is a rendering parameter, not the chart identity.

items.dz: 半圆表盘
items.de: A half-circle dial
items.pz: arc 从 -90° 到 90°，配 cornerRadius 更精致。
items.pe: Sweep -90° to 90° and add a cornerRadius.

definition.zh: 半圆表盘
definition.en: A half-circle dial

distinction.zh: arc 从 -90° 到 90°，配 cornerRadius 更精致。
distinction.en: Sweep -90° to 90° and add a cornerRadius.

items.dz: 一条线说明合格与否
items.de: One line separates pass and fail
items.pz: 阈值上下分色，别只画一条虚线了事。
items.pe: Colour above and below, not just a dashed line.

definition.zh: 一条线说明合格与否
definition.en: One line separates pass and fail

distinction.zh: 阈值上下分色，别只画一条虚线了事。
distinction.en: Colour above and below, not just a dashed line.

items.dz: 线周围有一条带
items.de: A band around the line
items.pz: area 上下界半透明填充，线在带上面。
items.pe: Fill the bounds with a translucent area; the line rides on top.

definition.zh: 线周围有一条带
definition.en: A band around the line

distinction.zh: area 上下界半透明填充，线在带上面。
distinction.en: Fill the bounds with a translucent area; the line rides on top.

items.dz: 缺的地方要断开
items.de: Gaps must actually break
items.pz: defined(d=>d.v!=null) 让线断开，别插值假装有数据。
items.pe: line.defined() breaks the path — never interpolate over gaps.

definition.zh: 缺的地方要断开
definition.en: Gaps must actually break

distinction.zh: defined(d=>d.v!=null) 让线断开，别插值假装有数据。
distinction.en: line.defined() breaks the path — never interpolate over gaps.

items.dz: 域到值域的均匀线性映射。
items.de: Uniform linear mapping from domain to range.
items.pz: scale([0,100],[0,400])：值差相等则像素差相等，刻度均匀。说「线性映射」即此。
items.pe: Equal input gaps become equal pixel gaps.

definition.zh: d3.scaleLinear 在域与值域间建立线性关系：v→range[0]+(v-d0)/(d1-d0)*(r1-r0)。
definition.en: Uniform linear mapping from domain to range.

distinction.zh: 线性比例尺是所有连续映射的基准：间距守恒。
distinction.en: Equal domain gaps become equal pixel gaps; pow/log distort them on purpose.

items.dz: 先对域值取幂再线性映射。
items.de: Linear mapping over exponent-transformed domain.
items.pz: scalePow().exponent(3)：小值被压向起点，强调大值差异。说「三次幂压小值」即此。
items.pe: exponent(3) squeezes small values toward the start.

definition.zh: d3.scalePow 以 exponent 对域值求幂后线性映射：v→((v-d0)/(d1-d0))^e。
definition.en: Linear mapping over exponent-transformed domain.

distinction.zh: 与 scaleSqrt 的区别：sqrt 是 exponent=0.5 的特例（常用于面积编码）；与 linear 的区别在于值域间距的非均匀性。
distinction.en: pow pre-exponentiates the domain; linear maps it untouched.

items.dz: 开方映射：面积可感知量到半径的正确桥梁。
items.de: Square-root mapping: the area-encoding bridge.
items.pz: 气泡图半径用 sqrt 映射数值，面积才与数值成正比。说「半径开方」即此。
items.pe: sqrt(v) so bubble area tracks the value.

definition.zh: d3.scaleSqrt 是 exponent=0.5 的 pow 比例尺，使圆面积 ∝ 数值。
definition.en: Square-root mapping: the area-encoding bridge.

distinction.zh: 与 linear 的区别：开方补偿了面积随半径的平方增长；与 pow 的关系是特例。
distinction.en: sqrt is the exponent-0.5 special case that keeps bubble areas truthful.

items.dz: 跨数量级数据的均匀化映射。
items.de: Uniformizing data that spans orders of magnitude.
items.pz: scaleLog：1/10/100/1000 等距分布；数量级差一等距即一等距。说「按数量级」即此。
items.pe: 1/10/100/1000 land evenly.

definition.zh: d3.scaleLog 以对数变换映射域：v→log(v/log(基))，刻度自然落在 10 的幂上。
definition.en: Uniformizing data that spans orders of magnitude.

distinction.zh: 与 linear 的区别：乘法距离变像素距离；域必须为正。与 symlog 的区别：symlog 在零附近保线性段。
distinction.en: log turns multiplicative gaps into pixel gaps; symlog keeps a linear band near zero.

items.dz: 原样返回输入的透明映射。
items.de: A transparent pass-through mapping.
items.pz: scaleIdentity 用于「需要比例尺接口但不想要变换」的场合（如 quadtree 范围查询）。说「原样透传」即此。
items.pe: Scale API without transformation.

definition.zh: d3.scaleIdentity 的映射函数是恒等函数，保留比例尺接口（invert/copy/ticks）。
definition.en: A transparent pass-through mapping.

distinction.zh: 与 linear([0,1],[0,1]) 的区别：语义上声明「不做变换」，避免读者误以为存在缩放。
distinction.en: Identity keeps the scale API but returns input unchanged.

items.dz: 以日期为域的线性比例尺，刻度按日历智能取整。
items.de: Linear scale over dates with calendar-aware ticks.
items.pz: scaleTime().domain([new Date(2020,0),new Date(2021,0)])：tick 自动落在月/周界。说「时间轴」即此。
items.pe: Ticks land on calendar boundaries automatically.

definition.zh: d3.scaleTime 以数值化时间戳做线性映射，但 ticks/nice 按日历间隔（日/月/年）取整，并正确处理本地时区与夏令时。
definition.en: Linear scale over dates with calendar-aware ticks.

distinction.zh: 与 scaleUtc 的区别：time 按本地时区解释日历边界，utc 按协调世界时；两者数学映射相同。
distinction.en: time interprets calendar boundaries in local time; utc uses UTC.

items.dz: 以 UTC 为基准的时间比例尺。
items.de: Time scale keyed to UTC.
items.pz: 跨时区一致的数据（日志、全球服务）用 scaleUtc，避免本地时区偏移刻度。说「按世界时」即此。
items.pe: Calendar boundaries in UTC.

definition.zh: d3.scaleUtc 与 scaleTime 同为线性时间映射，但刻度与取整按 UTC 日历（无夏令时扰动）。
definition.en: Time scale keyed to UTC.

distinction.zh: 与 scaleTime 的区别只在日历解释；对全球一致数据更可复现。
distinction.en: utc keys the calendar to UTC; time uses the local zone.

items.dz: 连续域切成等宽段，各自映射到离散值。
items.de: Slices a continuous domain into equal-width buckets.
items.pz: scaleQuantize().domain([0,100]).range(['低','中','高'])：33 分到「低」。说「等宽分段」即此。
items.pe: Equal-width buckets map to discrete outputs.

definition.zh: d3.scaleQuantize 将连续域均分为 range.length 段，输入按落段取离散输出。
definition.en: Slices a continuous domain into equal-width buckets.

distinction.zh: 与 scaleQuantile 的区别：quantize 按值域等宽切（样本数不均），quantile 按样本分位切（每段样本数近似相等）。
distinction.en: quantize slices the range into equal widths; quantile slices by sample rank.

items.dz: 按样本分位数切段，每段样本数相等。
items.de: Slices by sample quantiles.
items.pz: scaleQuantile().domain(data).range(colors)：每色样本数近似相等，抗极值。说「按分位切」即此。
items.pe: Each color gets a similar sample count.

definition.zh: d3.scaleQuantile 以样本分位数确定分段阈值：段宽随数据分布变化。
definition.en: Slices by sample quantiles.

distinction.zh: 与 scaleQuantize 的区别：切分依据是经验分布而非等宽；适合偏态数据着色。
distinction.en: quantile slices by sample distribution; quantize slices by value width.

items.dz: 显式阈值数组决定分段边界的离散映射。
items.de: Explicit thresholds define bucket boundaries.
items.pz: scaleThreshold().domain([18,60]).range(['未成年','成人','老年'])：边界由业务直接指定。说「按阈值定级」即此。
items.pe: Boundaries come straight from the spec.

definition.zh: d3.scaleThreshold 以 domain 中的阈值数组划分输入，输出 range 的对应离散值。
definition.en: Explicit thresholds define bucket boundaries.

distinction.zh: 与 quantize/quantile 的区别：阈值不由算法给出而由领域规则给出（法定年龄、风险分级）。
distinction.en: threshold boundaries come from domain rules, not algorithms.

items.dz: 离散类别到离散值的命名映射。
items.de: Named mapping between discrete categories and values.
items.pz: scaleOrdinal(['A','B','C'],['#BFDDF4','#F2CBDD','#C5E2D7'])。说「类别配色」即此。
items.pe: Categories map to named values.

definition.zh: d3.scaleOrdinal 以字符串映射表连接类别与离散输出，未知类别走 unknown 策略。
definition.en: Named mapping between discrete categories and values.

distinction.zh: 与 scaleBand 的区别：ordinal 只给映射不给几何宽度；band 在其上补充连续区间布局。
distinction.en: ordinal maps names only; band adds interval geometry on top.

items.dz: 类别轴布局器：每类一段连续带，含内外边距。
items.de: Category-axis layout: one band per category.
items.pz: scaleBand().domain(cats).range([0,400]).padding(0.2)：柱宽/间距一步到位。说「类别带布局」即此。
items.pe: Bandwidth and paddings computed for you.

definition.zh: d3.scaleBand 把连续范围切成类别带：bandwidth/step/paddingInner/paddingOuter 决定布局几何。
