definition.en: Category-axis layout: one band per category.

distinction.zh: 与 scalePoint 的区别：band 给出区间（有宽度，柱有粗细），point 给出点（散点/折线的类目定位）。
distinction.en: band yields intervals with width; point yields centers only.

items.dz: 类别轴的点定位：每类一个中心点。
items.de: Category-axis point positioning.
items.pz: scalePoint().domain(cats).range([0,400])：折线图类目均匀点定位。说「类目定位成点」即此。
items.pe: One center point per category.

definition.zh: d3.scalePoint 是 band 的退化形式：带宽为 0，仅输出每类中心点（含 padding）。
definition.en: Category-axis point positioning.

distinction.zh: 与 scaleBand 的区别：无带宽；与 scaleOrdinal 的区别：有连续范围内的几何位置语义。
distinction.en: point is band with zero bandwidth; ordinal carries no geometry.

items.dz: 把线性映射包上 sqrt 变换的径向版。
items.de: A radial variant with sqrt shaping.
items.pz: scaleRadial：玫瑰图/径向柱的半径映射（面积正确）。说「径向映射」即此。
items.pe: Radius mapping with area correctness.

definition.zh: d3.scaleRadial 是内嵌 sqrt 的连续比例尺，用于把数值映射到半径而不失面积比例。
definition.en: A radial variant with sqrt shaping.

distinction.zh: 与 scaleSqrt 的区别：语义命名的径向版（同公式）；与 scaleLinear 的区别：半径编码必须开方。
distinction.en: radial embeds sqrt so radius encodes area correctly.

items.dz: 超出域的输入被钉在值域端点。
items.de: Out-of-domain inputs pin to range ends.
items.pz: scale.clamp(true)：异常数据不把柱子顶出画布。说「开夹持」即此。
items.pe: clamp(true) keeps marks inside the canvas.

definition.zh: d3 连续比例尺的 clamp(true) 将域外输入钳制到值域端点；默认不夹持（外推）。
definition.en: Out-of-domain inputs pin to range ends.

distinction.zh: 与 clamp(false) 的区别：默认线性外推会画出画布；夹持是防御异常数据的机制。
distinction.en: clamp(true) pins overflow to the ends; the default extrapolates.

items.dz: 从像素坐标反查数据值：交互的基础。
items.de: Pixel coordinates back to data values.
items.pz: scale.invert(mouseX)：十字准线、刷选的范围还原全靠它。说「反查数值」即此。
items.pe: Crosshairs and brushes call invert.

definition.zh: d3 连续比例尺的 invert 把值域坐标映射回域值，是刷选/准线/缩放换算的基础。
definition.en: Pixel coordinates back to data values.

distinction.zh: 与 forward 映射的区别：方向相反；与 band 的 invertExtent 的区别：band 反演给出区间。
distinction.en: invert runs the mapping backwards for pointer-to-data reads.

items.dz: 让比例尺给出约 N 个「好看的」刻度。
items.de: About-N nice ticks from the scale.
items.pz: scale.ticks(5) 不保证恰好 5 个——它在 1/2/5×10^k 序列里挑最接近的。说「给个大概数」即此。
items.pe: ticks(5) picks from the 1/2/5×10^k ladder.

definition.zh: d3 连续比例尺的 ticks(count) 返回「可读」刻度集合：从 1/2/5×10^k 阶梯中选取，数量近似请求值。
definition.en: About-N nice ticks from the scale.

distinction.zh: 与手动给定数组刻度的区别：ticks 与域自适应；与 time 的区别：时间比例尺走日历阶梯。
distinction.en: ticks(count) picks from the 1/2/5x10^k ladder; manual arrays are static.

items.dz: 刻度文字的本地化与规格化。
items.de: Readable, localized tick labels.
items.pz: tickFormat(locale,',.0f') 或自定义函数：千分位、百分比、单位一次到位。说「刻度怎么写」即此。
items.pe: Locale-aware and unit-aware labels.

definition.zh: d3 的 tickFormat 或 scale.tickFormat(count, specifier) 决定刻度文字：数字精度、千分位、百分比、单位换算。
definition.en: Readable, localized tick labels.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS 样式的区别：这是数据文本语义（有效位/单位），不是外观。
distinction.en: tickFormat decides text semantics (precision, units), not styling.

items.dz: 在两个值之间生成连续过渡的函数族。
items.de: The family of continuous tweens between values.
items.pz: d3.interpolate(a,b) 自动识别颜色/数字/日期/数组；t∈[0,1] 返回中间态。说「做个插值」即此。
items.pe: Auto-detects color, number, date, array.

definition.zh: d3-interpolate 提供 interpolateNumber/rgb/date/array/string 等：给定 t∈[0,1] 返回中间值，是过渡与连续色标的引擎。
definition.en: The family of continuous tweens between values.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS transition 的区别：插值器是纯函数（可脱离元素复用），过渡是时间驱动系统。
distinction.en: interpolators are pure t-functions; transitions are time systems.

items.dz: 多站点插值：N 个色标点连成一条采样线。
items.de: N stops stitched into one sampler.
items.pz: d3.piecewise(d3.interpolateRgb, ['#BFDDF4','#C5E2D7','#F2CBDD'])。说「多段色带」即此。
items.pe: Stops stitched into one function.

definition.zh: d3.piecewise 把插值器与站点数组组成分段函数：t 落在哪段就用该段插值器。
definition.en: N stops stitched into one sampler.

distinction.zh: 与连续比例尺的区别：piecewise 是插值组合器（无域概念），常作为 scaleSequential 的插值器。
distinction.en: piecewise stitches stops into one sampler; scales add a domain.

items.dz: 缩放时让轴与数据同步重算。
items.de: Axes and marks recompute under zoom.
items.pz: zoomed 事件里 xScale.rescaleX(xTransform)：轴刻度随缩放刷新。说「缩放联动轴」即此。
items.pe: rescaleX/Y rebinds the scale to the transform.

definition.zh: d3.zoom 的变换经 rescaleX/rescaleY 反推比例尺新域，使轴、网格与图形保持一致。
definition.en: Axes and marks recompute under zoom.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS transform 缩放的区别：CSS 只放大像素（刻度字也变大），rescale 重算域（刻度语义正确）。
distinction.en: rescale rebinds the domain so ticks stay semantic; CSS zoom only scales pixels.

items.dz: 控制类目带之间的呼吸空间。
items.de: Breathing room between category bands.
items.pz: paddingInner 控带间、paddingOuter 控两端；step=带宽+内距。说「柱间距」即此。
items.pe: paddingInner between, paddingOuter at the ends.

definition.zh: d3.scaleBand 的 paddingInner 决定类目带之间的空隙比例，paddingOuter 决定两端留白。
definition.en: Breathing room between category bands.

distinction.zh: 与手动 margin 的区别：padding 是相对 step 的比例，随容器尺寸自适应。
distinction.en: padding is a fraction of step, adapting with container size; margins are fixed.

items.dz: 同一轴组件的四个朝向：刻度朝哪边。
items.de: Four orientations of one axis component.
items.pz: axisTop/axisBottom/axisLeft/axisRight 复用同一渲染逻辑。说「轴放上下还是左右」即此。
items.pe: axisTop/Bottom/Left/Right share rendering.

definition.zh: d3-axis 以 axisTop/Bottom/Left/Right 生成四个朝向的轴渲染器，仅刻度与标签位置不同。
definition.en: Four orientations of one axis component.

distinction.zh: 与手画线的区别：axis 是数据驱动组件（绑定比例尺自动生成刻度/标签/基线）。
distinction.en: orientation mounts ticks/labels on a side; the scale math is shared.

items.dz: 日历感知的时间阶梯：日/周/月/年。
items.de: The calendar-aware time ladder.
items.pz: d3.timeDay/timeWeek/timeMonth/timeYear 提供 offset/count/range，是时间刻度阶梯的来源。说「按日历跳」即此。
items.pe: Calendar steps, not fixed milliseconds.

definition.zh: d3-time 的 interval 族（timeMillisecond…timeYear）实现日历感知的偏移与计数（月≠固定毫秒数），支撑时间刻度。
definition.en: The calendar-aware time ladder.

distinction.zh: 与固定毫秒间隔的区别：日历间隔跨越夏令时与月长差异仍正确。
distinction.en: calendar intervals respect month lengths and DST; fixed milliseconds do not.

items.dz: 经纬直接当直角坐标：最简单的投影。
items.de: Longitude and latitude as plain coordinates.
items.pz: plate carrée：教学与快速原型首选；高纬拉伸明显。说「经纬直投」即此。
items.pe: Plate carrée: simple but stretchy.

definition.zh: d3.geoEquirectangular 将经纬度直接映射为平面直角坐标（等距圆柱）。
definition.en: Longitude and latitude as plain coordinates.

distinction.zh: 与 Mercator 的区别：无纬度拉伸（y=φ 而非对数），高纬不爆炸但形状失真；两者都是圆柱族。
distinction.en: equirectangular maps lat/lon straight; mercator exponentiates latitude.

items.dz: 等角航行投影：纬度向两极指数拉伸。
items.de: Conformal rhumb-line projection with polar blow-up.
items.pz: 航向恒角线是直线；格陵兰被放大数倍——尺寸比较要避开。说「墨卡托」即此。
items.pe: Greenland swells; angles survive.

definition.zh: d3.geoMercator 是等角圆柱投影：y=ln(tan(π/4+φ/2))，保持任意点局部角度（等角）。
definition.en: Conformal rhumb-line projection with polar blow-up.

distinction.zh: 与 equirectangular 的区别：纬线间距指数放大以保角；高纬面积严重失真。
distinction.en: mercator keeps angles and blows up the poles; equirectangular keeps spacing.

items.dz: 墨卡托转 90°：沿中央经线保形，制窄长疆域。
items.de: Mercator rotated: conformal along a meridian.
items.pz: UTM 的基础；南北向走廊（国家、管线）变形最小。说「横轴墨卡托」即此。
items.pe: The UTM workhorse.

definition.zh: d3.geoTransverseMercator 把墨卡托的圆柱轴横置：沿中央经线等形保真，东西两侧快速放大。
definition.en: Mercator rotated: conformal along a meridian.

distinction.zh: 与 Mercator 的区别：保形带从赤道变为中央经线；适合南北延展区域。
distinction.en: transverse Mercator rotates the cylinder onto a meridian.

items.dz: 从无穷远看地球：半球透视图。
items.de: The earth seen from infinity.
items.pz: 卫星视角半球；边缘压缩到切线。说「地球仪半面」即此。
items.pe: Half-globe satellite view.

definition.zh: d3.geoOrthographic 是方位投影之一：视点无穷远的平行投影，只显示半球。
definition.en: The earth seen from infinity.

distinction.zh: 与 stereographic 的区别：orthographic 无透视放大（边缘压扁），stereographic 越靠边越放大。
distinction.en: orthographic has no perspective growth; stereographic magnifies the rim.

items.dz: 从极点透视：保角且有限（除对跖点）。
items.de: Conformal and finite except the antipode.
items.pz: 极区地图与半球全景常用；越靠边越放大。说「球极投影」即此。
items.pe: Edge magnification, conformal throughout.

definition.zh: d3.geoStereographic 从球面一点透视投影到切平面：共形（保角），除透视点外处处有限。
definition.en: Conformal and finite except the antipode.

distinction.zh: 与 orthographic 的区别：stereographic 有透视放大且保角；与 gnomonic 的区别：投影中心在对跖点而非球心。
distinction.en: stereographic is conformal with edge magnification; orthographic flattens.

items.dz: 从球心投影：所有大圆变直线。
items.de: Great circles become straight lines.
items.pz: 航海/航空大圆航线画直线；可用范围小于半球。说「大圆拉直」即此。
items.pe: Great-circle routes render straight.

definition.zh: d3.geoGnomonic 从球心透视：所有大圆投影为直线，但畸变剧烈，适用范围小于半球。
definition.en: Great circles become straight lines.

distinction.zh: 与 stereographic 的区别：投影中心在球心（大圆保直）vs 对跖点（保角）；可用范围更小。
distinction.en: gnomonic straightens great circles; stereographic preserves angles.

items.dz: 从极点等积：半球面积不变形。
items.de: Equal-area view centered on a pole.
items.pz: 极地专题图（冰盖、航线密度）首选。说「等积半球」即此。
items.pe: Areas hold; shapes bend.

definition.zh: d3.geoAzimuthalEqualArea 是方位等积投影：从切点看半球面积严格守恒，形状向边缘压扁。
definition.en: Equal-area view centered on a pole.

distinction.zh: 与 orthographic 的区别：等积 vs 透视；与 azimuthal-equidistant 的区别：守恒量是面积还是距离。
distinction.en: azimuthal equal-area conserves area; equidistant conserves center distance.

items.dz: 从中心到任意点距离守恒。
items.de: Distances from the center hold everywhere.
items.pz: 以机场为中心的航程图；联合国会徽同款。说「等距方位」即此。
items.pe: The UN emblem projection.

definition.zh: d3.geoAzimuthalEquidistant 保证切点到任一点的距离沿半径正确（c∝ρ），面积与形状在边缘失真。
definition.en: Distances from the center hold everywhere.

distinction.zh: 与 azimuthal-equal-area 的区别：守恒量是距离而非面积。
distinction.en: equidistant conserves radial distance; equal-area conserves area.

items.dz: 圆锥面保角展开：中纬东西向国家常用。
items.de: A conformal cone over mid latitudes.
items.pz: 欧式中纬度地图（欧洲、中国全图）常用；锥轴过北极。说「圆锥保角」即此。
items.pe: Mid-latitude conformal cone.

definition.zh: d3.geoConicConformal 把球面投到圆锥面再展开：两条标准纬线间保角，纬线为同心圆弧。
definition.en: A conformal cone over mid latitudes.

distinction.zh: 与 mercator 的区别：保形范围是锥带而非全球；经线不再平行而是放射状。
distinction.en: conic conformal preserves angles on a cone; equal-area preserves area.

items.dz: 圆锥面上守面积（Albers 同族）。
items.de: The Albers-family equal-area cone.
items.pz: 面积统计地图（人口/产量着色）首选；美国官方投影 Albers 属此族。说「圆锥等积」即此。
items.pe: Areas hold on a cone.

definition.zh: d3.geoConicEqualArea（Albers 投影的通用形式）在圆锥展开面上严格守面积。
definition.en: The Albers-family equal-area cone.

distinction.zh: 与 conic-conformal 的区别：守恒量是面积而非角度；与方位等积的区别：锥面 vs 平面。
distinction.en: conic equal-area (Albers family) preserves area; conformal preserves angles.

items.dz: 沿经线距离守恒的圆锥投影。
items.de: Distances along meridians hold.
items.pz: railway/时区风格的教育地图；沿经线量距离可信。说「沿经线等距」即此。
items.pe: Meridian distances are true.

definition.zh: d3.geoConicEquidistant 在圆锥展开面上保持沿经线的距离比例。
definition.en: Distances along meridians hold.

distinction.zh: 与 conic-equal-area/conformal 的区别：守恒量是经线距离；形状与面积均可变形。
distinction.en: conic equidistant preserves meridian distances; the others preserve angles or area.

items.dz: 查表式折中投影：既不保角也不等积但观感自然。
items.de: A table-driven compromise projection.
items.pz: 国家地理经典世界图；无解析式、按纬度查表。说「罗宾森」即此。
items.pe: The NatGeo look: compromise by table.

definition.zh: Robinson 投影以离散查表（X'/Y' 系数）定义伪圆柱投影，各项畸变折中，无解析表达式。
definition.en: A table-driven compromise projection.

distinction.zh: 与 mercator 的区别：不保角、两极收敛为线而非无限放大；与 equirectangular 的区别：纬线间距向高纬递减。
distinction.en: Robinson is a lookup-table compromise; Natural Earth is a polynomial one.

items.dz: 多项式折中投影：世界地图的当代默认审美。
items.de: The modern default look for world maps.
items.pz: 多项式定义（非投影几何），整体观感柔和。说「自然地球」即此。
items.pe: Polynomial compromise, gentle look.

definition.zh: d3.geoNaturalEarth1 是伪圆柱折中投影，以四次多项式定义（非严格几何构造），观感自然。
definition.en: The modern default look for world maps.

distinction.zh: 与 robinson 的区别：解析多项式（可微）vs 查表；与 equirectangular 的区别：高纬收敛。
distinction.en: Natural Earth is polynomial and smooth; Robinson is tabulated.

items.dz: 按间隔生成的经纬线框架，投影调试的标尺。
items.de: The lat/lon scaffold for any projection.
items.pz: d3.geoGraticule().step([30,20])：投影畸变一眼可见。说「铺个经纬网」即此。
items.pe: Distortion made visible.

definition.zh: d3.geoGraticule 生成 MultiLineString 经纬网格（step 控间隔、extent 控范围），是投影对比与调试的标准参照物。
definition.en: The lat/lon scaffold for any projection.

distinction.zh: 与真实海岸线的区别：graticule 是数学框架（无地理语义），专用于展示坐标系本身。
distinction.en: graticule is a mathematical scaffold; coastlines carry geographic semantics.

items.dz: 现成的多站点连续/离散色带集合。
items.de: Ready-made continuous and categorical color ramps.
items.pz: d3.interpolateViridis/plasma 或 schemeCategory10：顺序、发散、循环、分类四族开箱即用。说「用现成色带」即此。
items.pe: Pick a researched ramp instead of inventing one.

definition.zh: d3-scale-chromatic 提供顺序（Viridis 等）、发散、循环插值器与分类 scheme 数组：经评审的色彩方案集合。
definition.en: Ready-made continuous and categorical color ramps.

distinction.zh: 与 piecewise 自配色标的区别：schemes 是经感知研究检验的现成方案；与 scaleSequential 的区别：方案是颜色源，比例尺绑定数据域。
distinction.en: Ready-made perceptually vetted ramps; scales bind them to data.

items.dz: 限制缩放平移的世界范围。
items.de: Bounds the pannable world under zoom.
items.pz: zoom.translateExtent([[0,0],[w,h]])：内容拖不出虚线框。说「拖不出边界」即此。
items.pe: The dashed box is the whole world.

definition.zh: d3.zoom 的 translateExtent 以世界坐标定义可视视口的平移边界，配合 scaleExtent 限定交互范围。
definition.en: Bounds the pannable world under zoom.

distinction.zh: 与 scaleExtent 的区别：一个管缩放倍率、一个管平移边界；两者共同构成可预期地图交互。
distinction.en: scaleExtent bounds zoom; translateExtent bounds panning.

dz: 逐帧画出来的那一类：Canvas 2D、Lottie、Rive
de: Everything drawn per frame — Canvas 2D, Lottie, Rive

items.dz: 每帧只画一次
items.de: Exactly one draw per frame
items.pz: requestAnimationFrame 里用 delta time，不要假设 60fps。
items.pe: Drive by delta time inside requestAnimationFrame.

definition.zh: 每帧只画一次
definition.en: Exactly one draw per frame

distinction.zh: requestAnimationFrame 里用 delta time，不要假设 60fps。
distinction.en: Drive by delta time inside requestAnimationFrame.

items.dz: 物理稳定不看帧率
items.de: Physics stays stable at any frame rate
items.pz: 累加 delta，按 16.67ms 固定步进，余量做插值。
items.pe: Accumulate delta, step at 16.67ms, interpolate the remainder.

definition.zh: 物理稳定不看帧率
definition.en: Physics stays stable at any frame rate

distinction.zh: 累加 delta，按 16.67ms 固定步进，余量做插值。
distinction.en: Accumulate delta, step at 16.67ms, interpolate the remainder.

items.dz: 不糊也不虚
items.de: Crisp on retina, no soft edges
items.pz: canvas.width = css * devicePixelRatio，再 ctx.scale(dpr,dpr)。
items.pe: Size the backing store by DPR and scale the context.

definition.zh: 不糊也不虚
definition.en: Crisp on retina, no soft edges

distinction.zh: canvas.width = css * devicePixelRatio，再 ctx.scale(dpr,dpr)。
distinction.en: Size the backing store by DPR and scale the context.

items.dz: 旧笔迹慢慢消失
items.de: Old strokes fade away
items.pz: 每帧盖一层低 alpha 背景，而不是 clearRect。
items.pe: Paint a low-alpha background each frame instead of clearing.

definition.zh: 旧笔迹慢慢消失
definition.en: Old strokes fade away

distinction.zh: 每帧盖一层低 alpha 背景，而不是 clearRect。
distinction.en: Paint a low-alpha background each frame instead of clearing.

items.dz: 静态部分只画一次
items.de: Draw the static layer once
items.pz: 把背景画到 OffscreenCanvas，主画布只 drawImage。
items.pe: Render the background to an OffscreenCanvas and blit it.

definition.zh: 静态部分只画一次
definition.en: Draw the static layer once

distinction.zh: 把背景画到 OffscreenCanvas，主画布只 drawImage。
distinction.en: Render the background to an OffscreenCanvas and blit it.

items.dz: 主线程不掉帧
items.de: The main thread stays free
items.pz: transferControlToOffscreen() 后在 worker 里跑循环。
items.pe: transferControlToOffscreen and run the loop in a worker.

definition.zh: 主线程不掉帧
definition.en: The main thread stays free

distinction.zh: transferControlToOffscreen() 后在 worker 里跑循环。
distinction.en: transferControlToOffscreen and run the loop in a worker.

items.dz: 只擦要改的那一小块
items.de: Only clear what changed
items.pz: 记录改动区域，clearRect 只清那块，省 90% 填充。
items.pe: Track changed regions and clear only those.

definition.zh: 只擦要改的那一小块
definition.en: Only clear what changed

distinction.zh: 记录改动区域，clearRect 只清那块，省 90% 填充。
distinction.en: Track changed regions and clear only those.

items.dz: 路径只构造一次
items.de: Build the path once
items.pz: 把常用形状存成 Path2D 对象，每帧只 fill。
items.pe: Keep shapes as Path2D objects and just fill them.

definition.zh: 路径只构造一次
definition.en: Build the path once

distinction.zh: 把常用形状存成 Path2D 对象，每帧只 fill。
distinction.en: Keep shapes as Path2D objects and just fill them.

items.dz: 别每帧新建渐变
items.de: Do not recreate gradients per frame
items.pz: createLinearGradient 结果缓存起来，它是重对象。
items.pe: Cache gradient objects — creating them is expensive.

definition.zh: 别每帧新建渐变
definition.en: Do not recreate gradients per frame

distinction.zh: createLinearGradient 结果缓存起来，它是重对象。
distinction.en: Cache gradient objects — creating them is expensive.

items.dz: 同一笔画出不同关系
items.de: One stroke, many relationships
items.pz: globalCompositeOperation: 'lighter' 做光累积，'destination-out' 做橡皮。
items.pe: 'lighter' accumulates light; 'destination-out' erases.

definition.zh: 同一笔画出不同关系
definition.en: One stroke, many relationships

distinction.zh: globalCompositeOperation: 'lighter' 做光累积，'destination-out' 做橡皮。
distinction.en: 'lighter' accumulates light; 'destination-out' erases.

items.dz: 只在形状里画
items.de: Draw only inside the shape
items.pz: ctx.clip() 后所有绘制被限制，记得 save/restore 配对。
items.pe: ctx.clip() after save(), and always restore().

definition.zh: 只在形状里画
definition.en: Draw only inside the shape

distinction.zh: ctx.clip() 后所有绘制被限制，记得 save/restore 配对。
distinction.en: ctx.clip() after save(), and always restore().

items.dz: 直接改像素
items.de: Touch the pixels directly
items.pz: getImageData 很慢：一次读取，用 typed array 批量改。
items.pe: getImageData is slow — read once, mutate a typed array.

definition.zh: 直接改像素
definition.en: Touch the pixels directly

distinction.zh: getImageData 很慢：一次读取，用 typed array 批量改。
distinction.en: getImageData is slow — read once, mutate a typed array.

items.dz: 不产生垃圾就不卡顿
items.de: No garbage, no hitches
items.pz: 粒子复用而不是 new，GC 峰值就消失了。
items.pe: Recycle particles instead of allocating; the GC spikes vanish.

definition.zh: 不产生垃圾就不卡顿
definition.en: No garbage, no hitches

distinction.zh: 粒子复用而不是 new，GC 峰值就消失了。
distinction.en: Recycle particles instead of allocating; the GC spikes vanish.

items.dz: 上万粒子还能互相碰
items.de: Thousands of particles still collide
items.pz: 按格子分桶，只检查同桶与邻桶。
items.pe: Bucket by cell and only test neighbours.

definition.zh: 上万粒子还能互相碰
definition.en: Thousands of particles still collide

distinction.zh: 按格子分桶，只检查同桶与邻桶。
distinction.en: Bucket by cell and only test neighbours.

items.dz: 按得重线就粗
items.de: Press harder, thicker line
items.pz: pointerEvents 的 pressure 映射线宽，两点间插值补点。
items.pe: Map pointer pressure to line width and interpolate between samples.

definition.zh: 按得重线就粗
definition.en: Press harder, thicker line

distinction.zh: pointerEvents 的 pressure 映射线宽，两点间插值补点。
distinction.en: Map pointer pressure to line width and interpolate between samples.

items.dz: 手抖也画得顺
items.de: Shaky hands, smooth line
items.pz: 对采样点做移动平均或 Catmull-Rom 拟合，别直连。
items.pe: Moving-average or Catmull-Rom fit the samples.

definition.zh: 手抖也画得顺
definition.en: Shaky hands, smooth line

distinction.zh: 对采样点做移动平均或 Catmull-Rom 拟合，别直连。
distinction.en: Moving-average or Catmull-Rom fit the samples.

items.dz: 落笔处慢慢洇开
items.de: The ink bleeds outward
items.pz: 在笔迹上叠低 alpha 的模糊层，多次累积。
items.pe: Accumulate blurred low-alpha layers over the stroke.

definition.zh: 落笔处慢慢洇开
definition.en: The ink bleeds outward

distinction.zh: 在笔迹上叠低 alpha 的模糊层，多次累积。
distinction.en: Accumulate blurred low-alpha layers over the stroke.

items.dz: 成千条线顺着场走
items.de: Thousands of lines follow the field
items.pz: 每条线沿噪声场步进 200 步，alpha 0.05 叠出质感。
items.pe: March each line 200 steps at alpha 0.05.

definition.zh: 成千条线顺着场走
definition.en: Thousands of lines follow the field

distinction.zh: 每条线沿噪声场步进 200 步，alpha 0.05 叠出质感。
distinction.en: March each line 200 steps at alpha 0.05.

items.dz: 一层活的胶片颗粒
items.de: A living film grain
items.pz: 预生成 3–4 张噪声，轮播比每帧算便宜。
items.pe: Pre-bake three or four noise tiles and cycle them.

definition.zh: 一层活的胶片颗粒
definition.en: A living film grain

distinction.zh: 预生成 3–4 张噪声，轮播比每帧算便宜。
distinction.en: Pre-bake three or four noise tiles and cycle them.

items.dz: 一张图播一套动作
items.de: One sheet, one action
items.pz: drawImage 的 9 参形式裁格子，12fps 最有手感。
items.pe: The nine-argument drawImage crops the cell; 12fps feels best.

definition.zh: 一张图播一套动作
definition.en: One sheet, one action

distinction.zh: drawImage 的 9 参形式裁格子，12fps 最有手感。
distinction.en: The nine-argument drawImage crops the cell; 12fps feels best.

items.dz: 格子拼出整个世界
items.de: A world made of tiles
items.pz: 只画可视范围的瓦片，图集减少纹理切换。
items.pe: Draw only visible tiles from one atlas.

definition.zh: 格子拼出整个世界
definition.en: A world made of tiles

distinction.zh: 只画可视范围的瓦片，图集减少纹理切换。
distinction.en: Draw only visible tiles from one atlas.

items.dz: 世界动，画布不动
items.de: The world moves, the canvas does not
items.pz: ctx.translate 相机偏移 + 缩放，命中检测要反变换。
items.pe: Translate/scale by the camera and inverse-transform hits.

definition.zh: 世界动，画布不动
definition.en: The world moves, the canvas does not

distinction.zh: ctx.translate 相机偏移 + 缩放，命中检测要反变换。
distinction.en: Translate/scale by the camera and inverse-transform hits.

items.dz: 远景走得慢
items.de: Far layers lag behind
items.pz: 每层乘不同系数（0.2 / 0.5 / 1）绘制。
items.pe: Multiply each layer by 0.2 / 0.5 / 1.

definition.zh: 远景走得慢
definition.en: Far layers lag behind

distinction.zh: 每层乘不同系数（0.2 / 0.5 / 1）绘制。
distinction.en: Multiply each layer by 0.2 / 0.5 / 1.

items.dz: 刮开才看得见
items.de: Scratch to reveal
items.pz: destination-out 擦除遮罩层，统计 alpha 判定进度。
items.pe: Erase the cover with destination-out and count alpha for progress.

definition.zh: 刮开才看得见
definition.en: Scratch to reveal

distinction.zh: destination-out 擦除遮罩层，统计 alpha 判定进度。
distinction.en: Erase the cover with destination-out and count alpha for progress.

items.dz: 一瞬间撒出去再落下
items.de: A burst, then gravity
items.pz: 每片自己的旋转与阻力，1.2 秒内清空。
items.pe: Per-piece spin and drag; clear within 1.2 seconds.

definition.zh: 一瞬间撒出去再落下
definition.en: A burst, then gravity

distinction.zh: 每片自己的旋转与阻力，1.2 秒内清空。
distinction.en: Per-piece spin and drag; clear within 1.2 seconds.

items.dz: 升空、炸开、余烬下坠
items.de: Rise, burst, embers fall
items.pz: 三段时间线：上升、爆炸、拖尾衰减。
items.pe: Three phases: ascent, burst, ember decay.

definition.zh: 升空、炸开、余烬下坠
definition.en: Rise, burst, embers fall

distinction.zh: 三段时间线：上升、爆炸、拖尾衰减。
distinction.en: Three phases: ascent, burst, ember decay.

items.dz: 声音画成一排竖条
items.de: Sound as a row of bars
items.pz: AnalyserNode.getByteFrequencyData 每帧喂进柱高。
items.pe: Feed getByteFrequencyData into the bar heights.

definition.zh: 声音画成一排竖条
definition.en: Sound as a row of bars

distinction.zh: AnalyserNode.getByteFrequencyData 每帧喂进柱高。
distinction.en: Feed getByteFrequencyData into the bar heights.

items.dz: 一条抖动的绿线
items.de: One trembling trace
items.pz: getByteTimeDomainData 画折线，余像用低 alpha 清屏。
items.pe: Draw the time-domain data with a low-alpha clear for afterglow.

definition.zh: 一条抖动的绿线
definition.en: One trembling trace

distinction.zh: getByteTimeDomainData 画折线，余像用低 alpha 清屏。
distinction.en: Draw the time-domain data with a low-alpha clear for afterglow.

items.dz: 峰值慢慢回落
items.de: The peak decays slowly
items.pz: 瞬时值直接跟随，峰值线用 0.95 衰减保持。
items.pe: Follow the instant value; hold the peak with 0.95 decay.

definition.zh: 峰值慢慢回落
definition.en: The peak decays slowly

distinction.zh: 瞬时值直接跟随，峰值线用 0.95 衰减保持。
distinction.en: Follow the instant value; hold the peak with 0.95 decay.

items.dz: AE 做的动画直接跑
items.de: After Effects, straight to the web
items.pz: lottie-web 用 renderer:"svg"；性能吃紧改 canvas。
items.pe: lottie-web with renderer "svg"; switch to canvas when heavy.

definition.zh: AE 做的动画直接跑
definition.en: After Effects, straight to the web

distinction.zh: lottie-web 用 renderer:"svg"；性能吃紧改 canvas。
distinction.en: lottie-web with renderer "svg"; switch to canvas when heavy.

items.dz: 只播其中几帧
items.de: Play only a slice
items.pz: playSegments([[0,40]],true)，做状态之间的短过渡。
items.pe: playSegments([[0, 40]], true) for state-to-state beats.

definition.zh: 只播其中几帧
definition.en: Play only a slice

distinction.zh: playSegments([[0,40]],true)，做状态之间的短过渡。
distinction.en: playSegments([[0, 40]], true) for state-to-state beats.

items.dz: 滚动进度就是播放头
items.de: Scroll is the playhead
items.pz: goToAndStop(progress*totalFrames,true)，别调 play()。
items.pe: goToAndStop(progress * totalFrames, true).

definition.zh: 滚动进度就是播放头
definition.en: Scroll is the playhead

distinction.zh: goToAndStop(progress*totalFrames,true)，别调 play()。
distinction.en: goToAndStop(progress * totalFrames, true).

items.dz: 同一动画换品牌色
items.de: One animation, any brand colour
items.pz: 遍历 layer 的 shape 改 c.k，或导出时就用可替换色。
items.pe: Walk the shape layers and patch the colour keys.

definition.zh: 同一动画换品牌色
definition.en: One animation, any brand colour

distinction.zh: 遍历 layer 的 shape 改 c.k，或导出时就用可替换色。
distinction.en: Walk the shape layers and patch the colour keys.

items.dz: 一个文件里装所有状态
items.de: Every state in one file
items.pz: inputs 传布尔/数值，运行时自己在状态间过渡。
items.pe: Feed inputs; the runtime handles the transitions.

definition.zh: 一个文件里装所有状态
definition.en: Every state in one file

distinction.zh: inputs 传布尔/数值，运行时自己在状态间过渡。
distinction.en: Feed inputs; the runtime handles the transitions.

items.dz: 角色跟着指针看
items.de: The character tracks your pointer
items.pz: 把指针坐标喂给 number input，动画自己插值。
items.pe: Feed pointer coords into a number input.

definition.zh: 角色跟着指针看
definition.en: The character tracks your pointer

distinction.zh: 把指针坐标喂给 number input，动画自己插值。
distinction.en: Feed pointer coords into a number input.

items.dz: 一个画板适配所有尺寸
items.de: One artboard, every size
items.pz: fit:"contain" + alignment，别用固定像素画板。
items.pe: fit "contain" with an alignment, never fixed pixels.

definition.zh: 一个画板适配所有尺寸
definition.en: One artboard, every size

distinction.zh: fit:"contain" + alignment，别用固定像素画板。
distinction.en: fit "contain" with an alignment, never fixed pixels.

items.dz: 矢量画到画布上
items.de: Vector, drawn per frame
items.pz: Path2D 直接吃 SVG path 字符串，省掉 DOM。
items.pe: Path2D accepts an SVG path string — no DOM needed.

definition.zh: 矢量画到画布上
definition.en: Vector, drawn per frame

distinction.zh: Path2D 直接吃 SVG path 字符串，省掉 DOM。
distinction.en: Path2D accepts an SVG path string — no DOM needed.

items.dz: 画布里的字也要讲究
items.de: Type on canvas still needs care
items.pz: textBaseline 用 "alphabetic"，度量用 actualBoundingBox。
items.pe: Use the alphabetic baseline and actualBoundingBox metrics.

definition.zh: 画布里的字也要讲究
definition.en: Type on canvas still needs care

distinction.zh: textBaseline 用 "alphabetic"，度量用 actualBoundingBox。
distinction.en: Use the alphabetic baseline and actualBoundingBox metrics.

items.dz: 一句话就有软阴影
items.de: Soft shadow in one line
items.pz: shadowBlur 很贵：静态阴影预烘焙成图片。
items.pe: shadowBlur is costly — bake static shadows into an image.

definition.zh: 一句话就有软阴影
definition.en: Soft shadow in one line

distinction.zh: shadowBlur 很贵：静态阴影预烘焙成图片。
distinction.en: shadowBlur is costly — bake static shadows into an image.

items.dz: 画布里也能点中东西
items.de: Clickable canvas objects
items.pz: isPointInPath，或画一张 ID 色图读像素。
items.pe: isPointInPath, or read a pixel from an ID buffer.

definition.zh: 画布里也能点中东西
definition.en: Clickable canvas objects

distinction.zh: isPointInPath，或画一张 ID 色图读像素。
distinction.en: isPointInPath, or read a pixel from an ID buffer.

items.dz: 一键存图
items.de: Save the frame
items.pz: toBlob 而不是 toDataURL；大图交给 OffscreenCanvas。
items.pe: Prefer toBlob over toDataURL.

definition.zh: 一键存图
definition.en: Save the frame

distinction.zh: toBlob 而不是 toDataURL；大图交给 OffscreenCanvas。
distinction.en: Prefer toBlob over toDataURL.

items.dz: 把视频画到画布上再处理
items.de: Pipe video through canvas
items.pz: requestVideoFrameCallback 比 rAF 更贴帧。
items.pe: requestVideoFrameCallback beats rAF for video.

definition.zh: 把视频画到画布上再处理
definition.en: Pipe video through canvas

distinction.zh: requestVideoFrameCallback 比 rAF 更贴帧。
distinction.en: requestVideoFrameCallback beats rAF for video.

items.dz: 绿幕抠掉换背景
items.de: Key out the green
items.pz: 在 YCbCr 空间判距离，比 RGB 阈值干净。
items.pe: Threshold in YCbCr, not RGB.

definition.zh: 绿幕抠掉换背景
definition.en: Key out the green

distinction.zh: 在 YCbCr 空间判距离，比 RGB 阈值干净。
distinction.en: Threshold in YCbCr, not RGB.

items.dz: 画面变成字符
items.de: The frame becomes characters
items.pz: 按亮度查字符梯度表 " .:-=+*#%@"。
items.pe: Map luminance onto a character ramp.

definition.zh: 画面变成字符
definition.en: The frame becomes characters

distinction.zh: 按亮度查字符梯度表 " .:-=+*#%@"。
distinction.en: Map luminance onto a character ramp.

items.dz: 按明暗改点的大小
items.de: Dot size follows value
items.pz: 按格取平均亮度，画半径 ∝ 亮度的圆。
items.pe: Average each cell and draw a radius-mapped dot.

definition.zh: 按明暗改点的大小
definition.en: Dot size follows value

distinction.zh: 按格取平均亮度，画半径 ∝ 亮度的圆。
distinction.en: Average each cell and draw a radius-mapped dot.

items.dz: 时间被压进一张图
items.de: Time compressed into one frame
items.pz: 每帧只画一列，列位置随时间右移。
items.pe: Draw one column per frame, marching right.

definition.zh: 时间被压进一张图
definition.en: Time compressed into one frame

distinction.zh: 每帧只画一列，列位置随时间右移。
distinction.en: Draw one column per frame, marching right.

items.dz: 一段段被排序的条纹
items.de: Bands of sorted pixels
items.pz: 按阈值切段，段内按亮度排序，只排一个方向。
items.pe: Segment by threshold and sort each run by luminance.

definition.zh: 一段段被排序的条纹
definition.en: Bands of sorted pixels

distinction.zh: 按阈值切段，段内按亮度排序，只排一个方向。
distinction.en: Segment by threshold and sort each run by luminance.

items.dz: 画布吃自己的上一帧
items.de: The canvas eats its last frame
items.pz: 把自己 drawImage 回来，稍微缩放旋转就成隧道。
items.pe: drawImage the canvas into itself, slightly scaled and rotated.

definition.zh: 画布吃自己的上一帧
definition.en: The canvas eats its last frame

distinction.zh: 把自己 drawImage 回来，稍微缩放旋转就成隧道。
distinction.en: drawImage the canvas into itself, slightly scaled and rotated.

items.dz: 两团靠近就黏成一团
items.de: They fuse as they approach
items.pz: 场值求和后取等值线；CSS 侧用 blur+contrast 近似。
items.pe: Sum the fields and threshold; blur + contrast approximates it.

definition.zh: 两团靠近就黏成一团
definition.en: They fuse as they approach

distinction.zh: 场值求和后取等值线；CSS 侧用 blur+contrast 近似。
distinction.en: Sum the fields and threshold; blur + contrast approximates it.

items.dz: 斑纹自己长出来
items.de: Patterns grow on their own
items.pz: Gray-Scott 两组浓度场，feed/kill 决定花纹类型。
items.pe: Gray-Scott with feed and kill rates.

definition.zh: 斑纹自己长出来
definition.en: Patterns grow on their own

distinction.zh: Gray-Scott 两组浓度场，feed/kill 决定花纹类型。
distinction.en: Gray-Scott with feed and kill rates.

items.dz: 规则简单，图案复杂
items.de: Simple rules, complex pattern
items.pz: 生命游戏或 rule 30，每帧只算邻域和。
items.pe: Life or rule 30 — just neighbour sums per frame.

definition.zh: 规则简单，图案复杂
definition.en: Simple rules, complex pattern

distinction.zh: 生命游戏或 rule 30，每帧只算邻域和。
distinction.en: Life or rule 30 — just neighbour sums per frame.

items.dz: 一笔画出的迷宫
items.de: A maze carved in one pass
items.pz: 递归回溯或 Wilson 算法，生成过程本身就是动画。
items.pe: Recursive backtracking — the generation is the animation.

definition.zh: 一笔画出的迷宫
definition.en: A maze carved in one pass

distinction.zh: 递归回溯或 Wilson 算法，生成过程本身就是动画。
distinction.en: Recursive backtracking — the generation is the animation.

items.dz: 一条规则长出一棵树
items.de: One rule grows a tree
items.pz: 字符串重写 + turtle 绘制，迭代 5 次就够密。
items.pe: String rewriting plus turtle drawing; five iterations is plenty.

definition.zh: 一条规则长出一棵树
definition.en: One rule grows a tree

distinction.zh: 字符串重写 + turtle 绘制，迭代 5 次就够密。
distinction.en: String rewriting plus turtle drawing; five iterations is plenty.

items.dz: 一帧只有 16ms
items.de: You get 16ms per frame
items.pz: 超预算就降粒子数或降 DPR，而不是掉帧。
items.pe: Over budget, cut particle count or DPR — not frames.

definition.zh: 一帧只有 16ms
definition.en: You get 16ms per frame

distinction.zh: 超预算就降粒子数或降 DPR，而不是掉帧。
distinction.en: Over budget, cut particle count or DPR — not frames.

items.dz: 切走就别烧电
items.de: Stop burning battery in the background
items.pz: visibilitychange 时 cancelAnimationFrame，回来再启。
items.pe: Cancel the rAF loop on visibilitychange.

definition.zh: 切走就别烧电
definition.en: Stop burning battery in the background

distinction.zh: visibilitychange 时 cancelAnimationFrame，回来再启。
distinction.en: Cancel the rAF loop on visibilitychange.

items.dz: 把路径打包成对象反复描画。
items.de: Bundle a path once, stroke it many times.
items.pz: const p=new Path2D("M0 0 L10 10");ctx.stroke(p)——路径与状态解耦可复用。说「路径对象化」即此。
items.pe: Decouple path data from the state machine.

definition.zh: Path2D 把路径数据封装为可保存、可复用、可由 SVG 字符串构造的对象，配合 ctx.stroke/fill/clip 反复使用。
definition.en: Bundle a path once, stroke it many times.

distinction.zh: 与逐次 beginPath 手绘的区别：Path2D 与画布状态机解耦，可预构建、可缓存（pathcache 条目即其缓存应用）。
distinction.en: Path2D decouples path data from the state machine; beginPath redraws by hand.

items.dz: createLinearGradient 起止点间插值色标。
items.de: Color stops interpolated along a line.
items.pz: const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,200,0);g.addColorStop(0,…)。说「canvas 渐变」即此。
items.pe: Stops along an x0,y0→x1,y1 vector.

definition.zh: createLinearGradient(x0,y0,x1,y1) 生成沿向量的渐变，addColorStop 添加色标后作为 fillStyle/strokeStyle 使用。
definition.en: Color stops interpolated along a line.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS linear-gradient 的区别：canvas 渐变绑定用户坐标系（随 transform 变换），色标 API 命令式添加。
distinction.en: Canvas gradients bind to the user coordinate system and transform with it.

items.dz: 双圆环间插值：可做光晕与 3D 球。
items.de: Interpolation between two circles.
items.pz: createRadialGradient(x0,y0,r0,x1,y1,r1)：双圆定义环带。说「径向渐变」即此。
items.pe: Two circles bound the ramp.

definition.zh: createRadialGradient 在起始圆与终止圆之间插值色标，可产生偏心高光与锥形过渡。
definition.en: Interpolation between two circles.

distinction.zh: 与 SVG radialGradient 的区别：命令式色标、双圆参数更显式；锥形渐变（两圆错位）是 canvas 版独有玩法。
distinction.en: Two circles bound the ramp; CSS radial gradients use center and radii instead.

items.dz: shadowBlur/Offset/Color 给后续绘制加投影。
items.de: Shadow attributes for subsequent draws.
items.pz: ctx.shadowColor/Blur/OffsetX/Y 设置后影响每一次 fill/stroke。说「canvas 投影」即此。
items.pe: State-wide shadow for every draw.

definition.zh: shadowColor/shadowBlur/shadowOffsetX/Y 是画布状态：设置后所有填充与描边自动附带投影，直到重置。
definition.en: Shadow attributes for subsequent draws.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS box-shadow 的区别：canvas 投影是绘图状态（作用后续每个路径），不是盒模型属性。
distinction.en: Shadow attributes are draw state affecting every path; box-shadow is a box property.

items.dz: setLineDash 序列切分描边。
items.de: Segment strokes with dash lists.
items.pz: ctx.setLineDash([8,4]) + lineDashOffset 蚂蚁线。说「canvas 虚线」即此。
items.pe: Dash list plus lineDashOffset.

definition.zh: setLineDash([实,空,…]) 以交替段切分描边，lineDashOffset 移动相位（选区蚂蚁线动画的基础）。
definition.en: Segment strokes with dash lists.

distinction.zh: 与 SVG stroke-dasharray 的区别：语义一致但 canvas 是绘图状态；与 CSS border dashed 的区别：节距完全可控。
distinction.en: Dash lists match SVG stroke-dasharray semantics but ride as canvas state.

items.dz: 单控制点曲线：轻量圆滑连接。
items.de: One control point, smooth joins.
items.pz: quadraticCurveTo(cx,cy,x,y)：语音气泡尾巴、缓弯连线。说「二次曲线」即此。
items.pe: One control point shapes the bend.

definition.zh: quadraticCurveTo 以单个控制点定义二次贝塞尔段：控制点拉弯曲线但自身不在曲线上。
definition.en: One control point, smooth joins.

distinction.zh: 与 bezierCurveTo 的区别：三次版有两个控制点（更自由的 S 形）；与 arc 的区别：贝塞尔是参数曲线非圆弧。
distinction.en: One control point; bezierCurveTo carries two for freer S-curves.

items.dz: ellipse() 带旋转角与双半径。
items.de: ellipse() with rotation and dual radii.
items.pz: ctx.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,rotation,0,2π)。说「画椭圆弧」即此。
items.pe: Rotation comes free.

definition.zh: ctx.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,rotation,start,end) 绘制可旋转的双半径椭圆弧，替代 scale 压扁 circle 的老办法。
definition.en: ellipse() with rotation and dual radii.

distinction.zh: 与 scale+arc 组合的区别：ellipse 不产生缩放变换（描边宽度不被压扁），旋转是几何参数。
distinction.en: ellipse() takes rotation as geometry; scaling an arc distorts stroke width.

items.dz: save/restore 以栈方式快照绘图状态。
items.de: State snapshots on a stack.
items.pz: 变换/样式成对 save-restore，防止状态泄漏到后续绘制。说「状态栈」即此。
items.pe: Push before mutate, pop after.

definition.zh: save() 将当前全部绘图状态（变换、样式、裁剪）压栈，restore() 弹出恢复——构成状态隔离的括号。
definition.en: State snapshots on a stack.

distinction.zh: 与手动重设每项状态的区别：栈恢复一次性完整还原（含 transform/clip），防泄漏且更快。
distinction.en: The state stack restores everything at once; manual resets miss clip regions.

items.dz: globalAlpha 乘到每次绘制的整体透明。
items.de: A master opacity multiplier.
items.pz: ctx.globalAlpha=0.3 淡入整批绘制；与 fillStyle rgba 叠乘。说「整体透明」即此。
items.pe: Multiplies with per-color alpha.

definition.zh: globalAlpha 是全局乘法透明因子，与颜色的 alpha 通道相乘后决定最终不透明度。
definition.en: A master opacity multiplier.

distinction.zh: 与 rgba 色值的区别：globalAlpha 作用于所有绘制（含位图），无需逐个改色；两层相乘易产生非预期透明度。
distinction.en: globalAlpha multiplies every draw including bitmaps; per-color alpha needs recoloring.

items.dz: imageSmoothingEnabled 控制位图缩放插值。
items.de: Toggle interpolation on scaled bitmaps.
items.pz: ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false 复刻像素风；quality 选低/中/高。说「关平滑」即此。
items.pe: false = nearest-neighbor upscale.

definition.zh: imageSmoothingEnabled/imageSmoothingQuality 决定 drawImage 缩放位图时的插值策略。
definition.en: Toggle interpolation on scaled bitmaps.

distinction.zh: 与 image-rendering:pixelated 的区别：一个是 canvas 内部绘制的插值状态，一个是 CSS 对元素缩放的渲染策略。
distinction.en: imageSmoothingEnabled is canvas-internal interpolation; image-rendering is CSS element scaling.

items.dz: createPattern 把图像变成可重复填充。
items.de: Repeat an image as fill.
items.pz: ctx.createPattern(img,"repeat") 作为 fillStyle 铺满路径。说「图案填充」即此。
items.pe: repeat / repeat-x / repeat-y.

definition.zh: createPattern(image, repetition) 将位图/画布包装为重复填充样式，随变换矩阵一起变形。
definition.en: Repeat an image as fill.

distinction.zh: 与 SVG pattern 的区别：canvas pattern 是样式对象（命令式），变换跟随当前矩阵；离屏小图即纹理源。
distinction.en: Patterns are imperative style objects that follow the current matrix; SVG patterns are declarative nodes.

items.dz: putImageData 把像素缓冲直接写上画布。
items.de: Write raw pixels straight to the canvas.
items.pz: ctx.putImageData(imageData,dx,dy)：绕过一切合成状态。说「裸写像素」即此。
items.pe: Bypasses transforms, alpha and clips.

definition.zh: putImageData 将 ImageData 的 RGBA 缓冲按像素写到位图，完全绕过变换、透明与裁剪等绘图状态。
definition.en: Write raw pixels straight to the canvas.

distinction.zh: 与 drawImage 的区别：putImageData 是裸拷贝（不走合成器），drawImage 参与全部状态；处理像素用 getImageData/putImageData 对。
distinction.en: putImageData is a raw copy bypassing compositing; drawImage respects all state.

items.dz: willReadFrequently 提示引擎走 CPU 路径。
items.de: Hint the engine to prefer CPU backing.
items.pz: getContext("2d",{willReadFrequently:true})——频繁 getImageData 时减半开销。说「读多写少加提示」即此。
items.pe: A context attribute, not a method.

definition.zh: getContext 的 willReadFrequently 选项提示浏览器该画布将被频繁回读，促使其使用 CPU 侧后备缓冲避免 GPU→CPU 回传。
definition.en: Hint the engine to prefer CPU backing.

distinction.zh: 与 offscreen canvas 的区别：那是离屏渲染机制；此提示只影响后备存储策略，不改任何可见行为。
distinction.en: A context attribute hinting CPU backing; offscreen canvas is a separate rendering mechanism.

items.dz: roundRect() 原生圆角矩形路径。
items.de: Native rounded-rect paths.
items.pz: ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,[tl,tr,br,bl])：四角可独立半径。说「原生圆角矩形」即此。
items.pe: Per-corner radii in one call.

definition.zh: roundRect(x,y,w,h,radii) 以原生路径绘制圆角矩形，radii 可为数组分别指定四角，替代手写 arcTo 序列。
definition.en: Native rounded-rect paths.

distinction.zh: 与手写 arcTo/arc 组合的区别：一个调用替代十余行样板；四角独立半径是手写难匹配的细节。
distinction.en: One call with per-corner radii; hand-rolled arcTo chains are error-prone boilerplate.

items.dz: measureText 返回字形的精确宽度矩阵。
items.de: Precise glyph metrics before drawing.
items.pz: ctx.measureText(s).width/actualBoundingBox*：绘制前对齐与截断。说「量字」即此。
items.pe: Width plus ascent/descent boxes.

definition.zh: measureText 返回 TextMetrics：宽度、实际字形包围盒（actualBoundingBox*）、基线距离等，供绘制前布局决策。
definition.en: Precise glyph metrics before drawing.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS 测量的区别：canvas 无 DOM 流，度量是唯一获得文本尺寸的途径；实际包围盒比 em 宽度更精确。
distinction.en: Canvas has no DOM flow: measureText is the only way to size text before drawing.

items.dz: setTransform 直接设定六元仿射矩阵。
items.de: Set the affine matrix outright.
items.pz: setTransform(a,b,c,d,e,f) 或 translate/rotate/scale 的底层真相。说「矩阵直设」即此。
items.pe: One call replaces the whole CTM.

definition.zh: setTransform(a,b,c,d,e,f) 一步设定当前变换矩阵（缩放/旋转/切变/平移的合成），resetTransform 复位。
definition.en: Set the affine matrix outright.

distinction.zh: 与 translate/rotate 链式调用的区别：链式是矩阵乘法累积，setTransform 覆盖式设定（可精确复原已知状态）。
distinction.en: setTransform overwrites the whole CTM; translate/rotate chains multiply onto it.

items.dz: ctx.filter 直接套用 CSS 滤镜函数。
items.de: CSS filter functions on canvas draws.
items.pz: ctx.filter="blur(4px) contrast(1.2)" 后绘制即带滤镜。说「canvas 滤镜」即此。
items.pe: Same functions as CSS filter.

definition.zh: ctx.filter 接受 CSS filter 函数列表（blur/brightness/grayscale…），作用于其后的每次绘制。
definition.en: CSS filter functions on canvas draws.

distinction.zh: 与 SVG filter url 的区别：canvas filter 用函数速记（也可 url(#f)），是绘图状态而非元素属性。
distinction.en: ctx.filter is draw state using CSS function syntax; SVG filters are referenced nodes.

items.dz: textBaseline 决定 y 坐标对齐哪条基线。
items.de: Which font line the y coordinate targets.
items.pz: textBaseline: alphabetic/top/middle/bottom…图文混排对齐的关键。说「基线对齐」即此。
items.pe: Seven named lines per glyph.

definition.zh: textBaseline 设定 fillText 的 y 参考线（alphabetic/top/hanging/middle/ideographic/bottom）。
definition.en: Which font line the y coordinate targets.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS vertical-align 的区别：这是绘制坐标系的对齐语义；多语言混排对齐错误多源于默认 alphabetic。
distinction.en: textBaseline is a drawing-coordinate alignment; vertical-align is layout context.

items.dz: lineJoin/lineCap 控制描边拐角与端点。
items.de: Corner and endpoint shaping.
items.pz: lineJoin:miter/round/bevel + lineCap:butt/round/square。说「描边线型」即此。
items.pe: Joins knit corners; caps end strokes.

definition.zh: lineJoin（miter/round/bevel）与 lineCap（butt/round/square）决定描边转折与端点的形状，是 canvas 描边风格的两大开关。
definition.en: Corner and endpoint shaping.

distinction.zh: 与 SVG stroke-linejoin/linecap 的区别：同名同义，但 canvas 是绘图状态（影响后续所有描边）。
distinction.en: Same semantics as SVG stroke attributes, but riding as canvas draw state.

dz: Lenis、滚动时间线、滚动叙事——把滚动条当成播放头
de: Lenis, scroll timelines, scrollytelling — the scrollbar as a playhead

items.dz: 滚动带一点惯性但不失控
items.de: Inertia without losing control
items.pz: new Lenis({lerp:.1})，别把 lerp 调到 0.05 以下。
items.pe: new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1 }) — below 0.05 feels drunk.

definition.zh: 滚动带一点惯性但不失控
definition.en: Inertia without losing control

distinction.zh: new Lenis({lerp:.1})，别把 lerp 调到 0.05 以下。
distinction.en: new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1 }) — below 0.05 feels drunk.

items.dz: 跳锚点也是滑过去的
items.de: Anchors glide instead of jump
items.pz: lenis.scrollTo(target,{offset:-80,duration:1.2})
items.pe: lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: -80, duration: 1.2 })

definition.zh: 跳锚点也是滑过去的
definition.en: Anchors glide instead of jump

distinction.zh: lenis.scrollTo(target,{offset:-80,duration:1.2})
distinction.en: lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: -80, duration: 1.2 })

items.dz: 开弹窗时背景不动
items.de: The page freezes behind a modal
items.pz: lenis.stop() / start()，比 overflow:hidden 不跳版。
items.pe: lenis.stop() and start() — no layout jump like overflow: hidden.

definition.zh: 开弹窗时背景不动
definition.en: The page freezes behind a modal

distinction.zh: lenis.stop() / start()，比 overflow:hidden 不跳版。
distinction.en: lenis.stop() and start() — no layout jump like overflow: hidden.

items.dz: 整页进度驱动一个动效
items.de: Page progress drives one animation
items.pz: animation-timeline:scroll(root block)，纯 CSS 不掉帧。
items.pe: animation-timeline: scroll(root block) — no JS, no jank.

definition.zh: 整页进度驱动一个动效
definition.en: Page progress drives one animation

distinction.zh: animation-timeline:scroll(root block)，纯 CSS 不掉帧。
distinction.en: animation-timeline: scroll(root block) — no JS, no jank.

items.dz: 元素自己知道进出视口的进度
items.de: Each element knows its own entry progress
items.pz: animation-timeline:view(); animation-range:entry 0% cover 40%。
items.pe: animation-timeline: view() with an animation-range.

definition.zh: 元素自己知道进出视口的进度
definition.en: Each element knows its own entry progress

distinction.zh: animation-timeline:view(); animation-range:entry 0% cover 40%。
distinction.en: animation-timeline: view() with an animation-range.

items.dz: 进场和退场分别控制
items.de: Entry and exit, separately
items.pz: animation-range 可写 entry / exit / cover / contain 四段。
items.pe: animation-range takes entry, exit, cover and contain.

definition.zh: 进场和退场分别控制
definition.en: Entry and exit, separately

distinction.zh: animation-range 可写 entry / exit / cover / contain 四段。
distinction.en: animation-range takes entry, exit, cover and contain.

items.dz: 滚动后头部变矮变实
items.de: The header compacts as you scroll
items.pz: position:sticky + view timeline 改高度与阴影，别监听 scroll。
items.pe: Sticky plus a view timeline, not a scroll listener.

definition.zh: 滚动后头部变矮变实
definition.en: The header compacts as you scroll

distinction.zh: position:sticky + view timeline 改高度与阴影，别监听 scroll。
distinction.en: Sticky plus a view timeline, not a scroll listener.

items.dz: 顶部一条线告诉你还剩多少
items.de: A hairline says how far you are
items.pz: scroll(root block) 驱动 scaleX，transform-origin:left。
items.pe: scroll(root block) into scaleX with a left origin.

items.dz: 一屏钉住，内容分段推进
items.de: One screen, several beats
items.pz: 钉住容器，按 progress 切换段落与图形状态。
items.pe: Pin the section and switch beats by progress.

definition.zh: 一屏钉住，内容分段推进
definition.en: One screen, several beats

distinction.zh: 钉住容器，按 progress 切换段落与图形状态。
distinction.en: Pin the section and switch beats by progress.

items.dz: 纵滚驱动横向长卷
items.de: Vertical scroll pulls a horizontal reel
items.pz: 钉住外层，内层 translateX 到 -(n-1)*100vw。
items.pe: Pin the wrapper and translate the strip by viewport widths.

definition.zh: 纵滚驱动横向长卷
definition.en: Vertical scroll pulls a horizontal reel

distinction.zh: 钉住外层，内层 translateX 到 -(n-1)*100vw。
distinction.en: Pin the wrapper and translate the strip by viewport widths.

items.dz: 每次滚动必停在一屏
items.de: It always lands on a section
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:y mandatory，长内容页千万别用。
items.pe: y mandatory — never on long-form content.

definition.zh: 每次滚动必停在一屏
definition.en: It always lands on a section

distinction.zh: scroll-snap-type:y mandatory，长内容页千万别用。
distinction.en: y mandatory — never on long-form content.

items.dz: 接近了才吸
items.de: It snaps only when close
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:y proximity 对长文更友好。
items.pe: y proximity is kinder to long documents.

definition.zh: 接近了才吸
definition.en: It snaps only when close

distinction.zh: scroll-snap-type:y proximity 对长文更友好。
distinction.en: y proximity is kinder to long documents.

items.dz: 一次只能翻一屏
items.de: One section per gesture
items.pz: scroll-snap-stop:always 防止快滑跳过内容。
items.pe: scroll-snap-stop: always stops fling-throughs.

definition.zh: 一次只能翻一屏
definition.en: One section per gesture

distinction.zh: scroll-snap-stop:always 防止快滑跳过内容。
distinction.en: scroll-snap-stop: always stops fling-throughs.

items.dz: 锚点不被吸顶头挡住
items.de: Anchors clear the sticky header
items.pz: scroll-padding-top 等于头部高度，一行解决。
items.pe: scroll-padding-top equal to the header height.

definition.zh: 锚点不被吸顶头挡住
definition.en: Anchors clear the sticky header

distinction.zh: scroll-padding-top 等于头部高度，一行解决。
distinction.en: scroll-padding-top equal to the header height.

items.dz: 子区域滚完不带动整页
items.de: The page stays put when the panel ends
items.pz: overscroll-behavior:contain，弹窗内滚动的必需项。
items.pe: overscroll-behavior: contain — mandatory inside modals.

definition.zh: 子区域滚完不带动整页
definition.en: The page stays put when the panel ends

distinction.zh: overscroll-behavior:contain，弹窗内滚动的必需项。
distinction.en: overscroll-behavior: contain — mandatory inside modals.

items.dz: 出现滚动条时不跳版
items.de: No jump when the scrollbar appears
items.pz: scrollbar-gutter:stable，比 overflow-y:scroll 优雅。
items.pe: scrollbar-gutter: stable beats forcing overflow.

definition.zh: 出现滚动条时不跳版
definition.en: No jump when the scrollbar appears

distinction.zh: scrollbar-gutter:stable，比 overflow-y:scroll 优雅。
distinction.en: scrollbar-gutter: stable beats forcing overflow.

items.dz: 背景比内容慢
items.de: The background trails the content
items.pz: 背景层 translateY 乘 0.3，用 scroll timeline 驱动。
items.pe: Multiply the background translate by 0.3.

definition.zh: 背景比内容慢
definition.en: The background trails the content

distinction.zh: 背景层 translateY 乘 0.3，用 scroll timeline 驱动。
distinction.en: Multiply the background translate by 0.3.

items.dz: 三层不同速度造纵深
items.de: Three speeds make depth
items.pz: 前景 1.2×、中景 1×、远景 0.6×，别超过三层。
items.pe: Foreground 1.2×, mid 1×, far 0.6× — three layers max.

definition.zh: 三层不同速度造纵深
definition.en: Three speeds make depth

distinction.zh: 前景 1.2×、中景 1×、远景 0.6×，别超过三层。
distinction.en: Foreground 1.2×, mid 1×, far 0.6× — three layers max.

items.dz: 滚到就从下方揭开
items.de: It unmasks from below
items.pz: clip-path inset 由 view timeline 驱动，比 opacity 更有质感。
items.pe: Drive a clip-path inset from the view timeline.

definition.zh: 滚到就从下方揭开
definition.en: It unmasks from below

distinction.zh: clip-path inset 由 view timeline 驱动，比 opacity 更有质感。
distinction.en: Drive a clip-path inset from the view timeline.

items.dz: 图随滚动缓慢变大
items.de: The image grows as you pass
items.pz: scale 1→1.08 就够，超过 1.15 会显廉价。
items.pe: Scale 1 → 1.08; past 1.15 it looks cheap.

definition.zh: 图随滚动缓慢变大
definition.en: The image grows as you pass

distinction.zh: scale 1→1.08 就够，超过 1.15 会显廉价。
distinction.en: Scale 1 → 1.08; past 1.15 it looks cheap.

items.dz: 滚动就转一圈
items.de: Scroll spins it
items.pz: 整段滚动映射 0–360°，配 will-change:transform。
items.pe: Map the whole range to 360°.

definition.zh: 滚动就转一圈
definition.en: Scroll spins it

distinction.zh: 整段滚动映射 0–360°，配 will-change:transform。
distinction.en: Map the whole range to 360°.

items.dz: 往下滚整页换气质
items.de: The page changes mood downward
items.pz: 给 body 背景做 scroll timeline，两三个色阶就够。
items.pe: A scroll timeline on the body background, two or three stops.

definition.zh: 往下滚整页换气质
definition.en: The page changes mood downward

distinction.zh: 给 body 背景做 scroll timeline，两三个色阶就够。
distinction.en: A scroll timeline on the body background, two or three stops.

items.dz: 读到哪句哪句变深
items.de: The current line darkens
items.pz: 每行一个 view timeline，非当前行降到 35% 灰。
items.pe: One view timeline per line; dim the rest.

definition.zh: 读到哪句哪句变深
definition.en: The current line darkens

distinction.zh: 每行一个 view timeline，非当前行降到 35% 灰。
distinction.en: One view timeline per line; dim the rest.

items.dz: 一个词一个词被点亮
items.de: Words light up in turn
items.pz: 把句子拆词，每词 animation-range 错开 3%。
items.pe: Split into words and offset each range by 3%.

definition.zh: 一个词一个词被点亮
definition.en: Words light up in turn

distinction.zh: 把句子拆词，每词 animation-range 错开 3%。
distinction.en: Split into words and offset each range by 3%.

items.dz: 数字随滚动长大
items.de: The number grows with scroll
items.pz: 进度映射到数值，注意 tabular-nums 防抖。
items.pe: Map progress to the value; keep tabular numerals.

definition.zh: 数字随滚动长大
definition.en: The number grows with scroll

distinction.zh: 进度映射到数值，注意 tabular-nums 防抖。
distinction.en: Map progress to the value; keep tabular numerals.

items.dz: 卡片一张压一张钉住
items.de: Cards pile up as you scroll
items.pz: 每张 position:sticky top 递增，配轻微 scale 递减。
items.pe: Sticky with increasing top and a slight scale down.

definition.zh: 卡片一张压一张钉住
definition.en: Cards pile up as you scroll

distinction.zh: 每张 position:sticky top 递增，配轻微 scale 递减。
distinction.en: Sticky with increasing top and a slight scale down.

items.dz: 上一屏被下一屏推走
items.de: The next screen pushes the last away
items.pz: 上层 sticky + 下层正常流，上层做 scale/opacity 退场。
items.pe: Sticky upper layer exits with scale and opacity.

definition.zh: 上一屏被下一屏推走
definition.en: The next screen pushes the last away

distinction.zh: 上层 sticky + 下层正常流，上层做 scale/opacity 退场。
distinction.en: Sticky upper layer exits with scale and opacity.

items.dz: 滚得快跑马灯也快
items.de: Scroll faster, the ticker runs faster
items.pz: 把滚动速度映射到 animation-duration 或 playbackRate。
items.pe: Map scroll velocity onto playbackRate.

definition.zh: 滚得快跑马灯也快
definition.en: Scroll faster, the ticker runs faster

distinction.zh: 把滚动速度映射到 animation-duration 或 playbackRate。
distinction.en: Map scroll velocity onto playbackRate.

items.dz: 上滚和下滚表现不同
items.de: Up and down behave differently
items.pz: 记录上一帧 scrollY 判方向，加 8px 死区防抖。
items.pe: Compare with the last scrollY, with an 8px dead zone.

definition.zh: 上滚和下滚表现不同
definition.en: Up and down behave differently

distinction.zh: 记录上一帧 scrollY 判方向，加 8px 死区防抖。
distinction.en: Compare with the last scrollY, with an 8px dead zone.

items.dz: 停下来了才做重活
items.de: Heavy work waits for the stop
items.pz: scrollend 事件（或 150ms 防抖）里再取数、再排版。
items.pe: Do fetches and layout on scrollend, not on scroll.

definition.zh: 停下来了才做重活
definition.en: Heavy work waits for the stop

distinction.zh: scrollend 事件（或 150ms 防抖）里再取数、再排版。
distinction.en: Do fetches and layout on scrollend, not on scroll.

items.dz: 滚到底自动接一页
items.de: The next page appends itself
items.pz: 哨兵元素 + IntersectionObserver，别监听 scroll。
items.pe: A sentinel element with IntersectionObserver.

definition.zh: 滚到底自动接一页
definition.en: The next page appends itself

distinction.zh: 哨兵元素 + IntersectionObserver，别监听 scroll。
distinction.en: A sentinel element with IntersectionObserver.

items.dz: 返回时回到原来的位置
items.de: Back returns you to where you were
items.pz: history.scrollRestoration="manual" 后自己存取位置。
items.pe: Set scrollRestoration to manual and store it yourself.

definition.zh: 返回时回到原来的位置
definition.en: Back returns you to where you were

distinction.zh: history.scrollRestoration="manual" 后自己存取位置。
distinction.en: Set scrollRestoration to manual and store it yourself.

items.dz: 看不见的先不排版
items.de: Offscreen content is not laid out
items.pz: content-visibility:auto + contain-intrinsic-size 防跳。
items.pe: content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size.

definition.zh: 看不见的先不排版
definition.en: Offscreen content is not laid out

distinction.zh: content-visibility:auto + contain-intrinsic-size 防跳。
distinction.en: content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size.

items.dz: 上方内容加载不推走视线
items.de: Late content above must not shove you
items.pz: overflow-anchor:auto 默认开；固定高度占位更稳。
items.pe: overflow-anchor is on by default; reserve height anyway.

definition.zh: 上方内容加载不推走视线
definition.en: Late content above must not shove you

distinction.zh: overflow-anchor:auto 默认开；固定高度占位更稳。
distinction.en: overflow-anchor is on by default; reserve height anyway.

items.dz: 还能滚就有一道阴影
items.de: A shadow says there is more
items.pz: 用 background-attachment:local 的渐变自动出现/消失。
items.pe: Local-attachment gradients appear only when scrollable.

definition.zh: 还能滚就有一道阴影
definition.en: A shadow says there is more

distinction.zh: 用 background-attachment:local 的渐变自动出现/消失。
distinction.en: Local-attachment gradients appear only when scrollable.

items.dz: 首屏底部给一个下滑暗示
items.de: A hint to keep going
items.pz: 小箭头轻微上下浮动，滚动 1 屏后消失。
items.pe: A gently bobbing arrow that leaves after one screen.

definition.zh: 首屏底部给一个下滑暗示
definition.en: A hint to keep going

distinction.zh: 小箭头轻微上下浮动，滚动 1 屏后消失。
distinction.en: A gently bobbing arrow that leaves after one screen.

items.dz: 右侧点标出你在第几节
items.de: Dots on the right mark your place
items.pz: 每节一个 view timeline，当前节的点放大。
items.pe: One view timeline per section; scale the active dot.

definition.zh: 右侧点标出你在第几节
definition.en: Dots on the right mark your place

distinction.zh: 每节一个 view timeline，当前节的点放大。
distinction.en: One view timeline per section; scale the active dot.

items.dz: 一路滚一路推进画面
items.de: Scrolling pushes into the image
items.pz: scale 与 clip-path 同时跟进度，比纯缩放有层次。
items.pe: Scale plus clip-path reads deeper than scale alone.

definition.zh: 一路滚一路推进画面
definition.en: Scrolling pushes into the image

distinction.zh: scale 与 clip-path 同时跟进度，比纯缩放有层次。
distinction.en: Scale plus clip-path reads deeper than scale alone.

items.dz: 标题随滚动变大变紧
items.de: The headline grows and tightens
items.pz: font-size 与 letter-spacing 一起插值才自然。
items.pe: Interpolate size and tracking together.

definition.zh: 标题随滚动变大变紧
definition.en: The headline grows and tightens

distinction.zh: font-size 与 letter-spacing 一起插值才自然。
distinction.en: Interpolate size and tracking together.

items.dz: 线随滚动画出来
items.de: The line draws as you scroll
items.pz: stroke-dashoffset 绑定 scroll 进度，pathLength=1 好算。
items.pe: Bind stroke-dashoffset to progress with pathLength 1.

definition.zh: 线随滚动画出来
definition.en: The line draws as you scroll

distinction.zh: stroke-dashoffset 绑定 scroll 进度，pathLength=1 好算。
distinction.en: Bind stroke-dashoffset to progress with pathLength 1.

items.dz: 滚动过程中形状变了
items.de: The shape changes on the way
items.pz: border-radius 与 clip-path 都可跟进度，一次只变一个。
items.pe: Radius or clip-path — change one, not both.

definition.zh: 滚动过程中形状变了
definition.en: The shape changes on the way

distinction.zh: border-radius 与 clip-path 都可跟进度，一次只变一个。
distinction.en: Radius or clip-path — change one, not both.

items.dz: 横滚看图，纵滚翻章
items.de: Sideways for images, down for chapters
items.pz: 内层 overflow-x:auto + snap，别劫持纵向滚动。
items.pe: Inner overflow-x with snap; never hijack vertical scroll.

definition.zh: 横滚看图，纵滚翻章
definition.en: Sideways for images, down for chapters

distinction.zh: 内层 overflow-x:auto + snap，别劫持纵向滚动。
distinction.en: Inner overflow-x with snap; never hijack vertical scroll.

items.dz: 滚动就是拖时间轴
items.de: Scroll is the timeline
items.pz: currentTime = progress*duration；视频要 preload 且无音轨。
items.pe: currentTime = progress × duration; preload, no audio track.

definition.zh: 滚动就是拖时间轴
definition.en: Scroll is the timeline

distinction.zh: currentTime = progress*duration；视频要 preload 且无音轨。
distinction.en: currentTime = progress × duration; preload, no audio track.

items.dz: 别抢用户的滚动手感
items.de: Do not steal the scroll
items.pz: 要么完全接管一屏并可退出，要么彻底不改。
items.pe: Either fully own one screen with an exit, or leave it alone.

definition.zh: 别抢用户的滚动手感
definition.en: Do not steal the scroll

distinction.zh: 要么完全接管一屏并可退出，要么彻底不改。
distinction.en: Either fully own one screen with an exit, or leave it alone.

items.dz: 手机上别自己做平滑
items.de: Do not fake smoothing on phones
items.pz: 移动端关掉 Lenis，交给系统惯性最跟手。
items.pe: Disable smooth scrolling on touch — native inertia wins.

definition.zh: 手机上别自己做平滑
definition.en: Do not fake smoothing on phones

distinction.zh: 移动端关掉 Lenis，交给系统惯性最跟手。
distinction.en: Disable smooth scrolling on touch — native inertia wins.

items.dz: 关掉视差只留淡入
items.de: Parallax off, fade stays
items.pz: prefers-reduced-motion 下取消所有位移与缩放。
items.pe: Drop translate and scale under reduced motion.

definition.zh: 关掉视差只留淡入
definition.en: Parallax off, fade stays

distinction.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 下取消所有位移与缩放。
distinction.en: Drop translate and scale under reduced motion.

items.dz: 滚到附近才加载
items.de: Load just before it is needed
items.pz: loading="lazy" + fetchpriority，首屏图反而要 eager。
items.pe: loading="lazy" with fetchpriority; hero images stay eager.

definition.zh: 滚到附近才加载
definition.en: Load just before it is needed

distinction.zh: loading="lazy" + fetchpriority，首屏图反而要 eager。
distinction.en: loading="lazy" with fetchpriority; hero images stay eager.

items.dz: 章节之间要有硬切换
items.de: Chapters need a hard cut
items.pz: 整块背景色互换 + 一条 1px 线，别做渐变过渡。
items.pe: Swap the background and add a hairline — no gradient fade.

definition.zh: 章节之间要有硬切换
definition.en: Chapters need a hard cut

distinction.zh: 整块背景色互换 + 一条 1px 线，别做渐变过渡。
distinction.en: Swap the background and add a hairline — no gradient fade.

items.dz: 读到底按钮才升起
items.de: The button rises at the end
items.pz: 最后一屏用 view timeline 抬起 CTA，只做一次。
items.pe: Raise the CTA on the last screen, once.

definition.zh: 读到底按钮才升起
definition.en: The button rises at the end

distinction.zh: 最后一屏用 view timeline 抬起 CTA，只做一次。
distinction.en: Raise the CTA on the last screen, once.

items.dz: 目录高亮当前章节
items.de: The outline tracks your section
items.pz: 每节 view timeline 切高亮，点击用 scrollTo 平滑跳。
items.pe: Highlight by view timeline; jump with a smooth scrollTo.

definition.zh: 目录高亮当前章节
definition.en: The outline tracks your section

distinction.zh: 每节 view timeline 切高亮，点击用 scrollTo 平滑跳。
distinction.en: Highlight by view timeline; jump with a smooth scrollTo.

items.dz: 滚动擦出对比图
items.de: Scroll wipes between two images
items.pz: clip-path 的 inset 右值跟进度，两图完全重合。
items.pe: Tie the clip inset to progress with the images aligned.

definition.zh: 滚动擦出对比图
definition.en: Scroll wipes between two images

distinction.zh: clip-path 的 inset 右值跟进度，两图完全重合。
distinction.en: Tie the clip inset to progress with the images aligned.

items.dz: 页脚从下方被拉出来
items.de: The footer is pulled up from under
items.pz: 正文 sticky 到底，页脚在其下方随滚动露出。
items.pe: Sticky the body; let the footer emerge underneath.

definition.zh: 页脚从下方被拉出来
definition.en: The footer is pulled up from under

distinction.zh: 正文 sticky 到底，页脚在其下方随滚动露出。
distinction.en: Sticky the body; let the footer emerge underneath.

items.dz: 过去的内容变虚
items.de: Passed content softens
items.pz: exit 区间加 blur 与降低 opacity，别超过 6px。
items.pe: Blur and fade on the exit range, under 6px.

definition.zh: 过去的内容变虚
definition.en: Passed content softens

distinction.zh: exit 区间加 blur 与降低 opacity，别超过 6px。
distinction.en: Blur and fade on the exit range, under 6px.

items.dz: 角落显示当前章节名
items.de: The corner names your chapter
items.pz: 进入某节时替换文字，用 200ms 交叉淡入。
items.pe: Cross-fade the label in 200ms on section change.

definition.zh: 角落显示当前章节名
definition.en: The corner names your chapter

distinction.zh: 进入某节时替换文字，用 200ms 交叉淡入。
distinction.en: Cross-fade the label in 200ms on section change.

items.dz: 首屏元素滚动后变成导航项
items.de: The hero mark becomes the nav mark
items.pz: 同一元素两处位置之间插值，配 position:sticky。
items.pe: Interpolate one element between two anchors.

definition.zh: 首屏元素滚动后变成导航项
definition.en: The hero mark becomes the nav mark

distinction.zh: 同一元素两处位置之间插值，配 position:sticky。
distinction.en: Interpolate one element between two anchors.

dz: Matter.js / Rapier：不写关键帧，写世界规则
de: Matter.js and Rapier — write world rules, not keyframes

items.dz: 东西自己往下掉
items.de: Things fall on their own
items.pz: engine.gravity.y=1，像素世界用 0.8–1.2 最像地球。
items.pe: engine.gravity.y around 1 reads as Earth.

definition.zh: 东西自己往下掉
definition.en: Things fall on their own

distinction.zh: engine.gravity.y=1，像素世界用 0.8–1.2 最像地球。
distinction.en: engine.gravity.y around 1 reads as Earth.

items.dz: 弹得高还是啪一下就停
items.de: Bouncy or dead
items.pz: restitution 0 完全不弹，0.9 接近皮球。
items.pe: restitution 0 is dead, 0.9 is a rubber ball.

definition.zh: 弹得高还是啪一下就停
definition.en: Bouncy or dead

distinction.zh: restitution 0 完全不弹，0.9 接近皮球。
distinction.en: restitution 0 is dead, 0.9 is a rubber ball.

items.dz: 滑一段就停
items.de: It slides, then stops
items.pz: friction + frictionAir 一起调，空气阻力常被忘。
items.pe: Tune friction and frictionAir together.

definition.zh: 滑一段就停
definition.en: It slides, then stops

distinction.zh: friction + frictionAir 一起调，空气阻力常被忘。
distinction.en: Tune friction and frictionAir together.

items.dz: 重的推不动，轻的一碰就飞
items.de: Heavy resists, light flies
items.pz: density 决定质量，别用 mass 直接赋值。
items.pe: Set density and let mass follow.

definition.zh: 重的推不动，轻的一碰就飞
definition.en: Heavy resists, light flies

distinction.zh: density 决定质量，别用 mass 直接赋值。
distinction.en: Set density and let mass follow.

items.dz: 堆高了就会塌
items.de: Stack it high and it falls
items.pz: 静止堆叠要开 sleeping，否则一直抖。
items.pe: Enable sleeping for resting stacks or they jitter.

definition.zh: 堆高了就会塌
definition.en: Stack it high and it falls

distinction.zh: 静止堆叠要开 sleeping，否则一直抖。
distinction.en: Enable sleeping for resting stacks or they jitter.

items.dz: 一个推倒一串
items.de: One topples the rest
items.pz: 每块间距略小于高度，倒下才连锁。
items.pe: Spacing slightly under the height keeps the chain going.

definition.zh: 一个推倒一串
definition.en: One topples the rest

distinction.zh: 每块间距略小于高度，倒下才连锁。
distinction.en: Spacing slightly under the height keeps the chain going.

items.dz: 吊着的东西自己摆
items.de: Hung things swing
items.pz: Constraint 的 stiffness=1 当刚性杆，<0.1 当橡皮筋。
items.pe: Constraint stiffness 1 is a rod, under 0.1 a rubber band.

definition.zh: 吊着的东西自己摆
definition.en: Hung things swing

distinction.zh: Constraint 的 stiffness=1 当刚性杆，<0.1 当橡皮筋。
distinction.en: Constraint stiffness 1 is a rod, under 0.1 a rubber band.

items.dz: 两头交替摆，中间不动
items.de: The ends trade, the middle rests
items.pz: 等质量球排成一线，restitution 接近 1。
items.pe: Equal masses in a line with restitution near 1.

definition.zh: 两头交替摆，中间不动
definition.en: The ends trade, the middle rests

distinction.zh: 等质量球排成一线，restitution 接近 1。
distinction.en: Equal masses in a line with restitution near 1.

items.dz: 一串关节像绳子
items.de: Jointed segments read as rope
items.pz: Composites.stack + Composites.chain，节数别超 20。
items.pe: Composites.chain over a stack; keep under 20 links.

definition.zh: 一串关节像绳子
definition.en: Jointed segments read as rope

distinction.zh: Composites.stack + Composites.chain，节数别超 20。
distinction.en: Composites.chain over a stack; keep under 20 links.

items.dz: 一张布被吹起来
items.de: Fabric catches the wind
items.pz: Composites.softBody 的行列弹簧，crossBrace 打开更稳。
items.pe: Composites.softBody with crossBrace enabled.

definition.zh: 一张布被吹起来
definition.en: Fabric catches the wind

distinction.zh: Composites.softBody 的行列弹簧，crossBrace 打开更稳。
distinction.en: Composites.softBody with crossBrace enabled.

items.dz: 一坨可以被挤扁
items.de: A blob you can squash
items.pz: 内部压力约束 + 外圈弹簧，别用刚体近似。
items.pe: Pressure constraint inside, springs around.

definition.zh: 一坨可以被挤扁
definition.en: A blob you can squash

distinction.zh: 内部压力约束 + 外圈弹簧，别用刚体近似。
distinction.en: Pressure constraint inside, springs around.

items.dz: 能抓住物体拖走
items.de: You can grab and drag bodies
items.pz: MouseConstraint 的 stiffness 0.2 才有拉扯手感。
items.pe: MouseConstraint stiffness 0.2 gives the pull a feel.

definition.zh: 能抓住物体拖走
definition.en: You can grab and drag bodies

distinction.zh: MouseConstraint 的 stiffness 0.2 才有拉扯手感。
distinction.en: MouseConstraint stiffness 0.2 gives the pull a feel.

items.dz: 松手时带着速度飞出去
items.de: Release carries the velocity
items.pz: 松手速度取最近 3 帧位移平均，避免抖动。
items.pe: Average the last three frames for release velocity.

definition.zh: 松手时带着速度飞出去
definition.en: Release carries the velocity

distinction.zh: 松手速度取最近 3 帧位移平均，避免抖动。
distinction.en: Average the last three frames for release velocity.

items.dz: 有些物体互相穿过
items.de: Some bodies ignore each other
items.pz: collisionFilter 的 category / mask 位运算。
items.pe: Bitwise category and mask on collisionFilter.

definition.zh: 有些物体互相穿过
definition.en: Some bodies ignore each other

distinction.zh: collisionFilter 的 category / mask 位运算。
distinction.en: Bitwise category and mask on collisionFilter.

items.dz: 进区域触发但不阻挡
items.de: It triggers without blocking
items.pz: isSensor:true 的 body 只报碰撞不产生反作用力。
items.pe: isSensor bodies report contacts without response.

definition.zh: 进区域触发但不阻挡
definition.en: It triggers without blocking

distinction.zh: isSensor:true 的 body 只报碰撞不产生反作用力。
distinction.en: isSensor bodies report contacts without response.

items.dz: 看看这条线撞到什么
items.de: What does this ray hit
items.pz: Query.ray 或 Rapier 的 castRay，做视线与落点预测。
items.pe: Query.ray or Rapier castRay for line of sight.

definition.zh: 看看这条线撞到什么
definition.en: What does this ray hit

distinction.zh: Query.ray 或 Rapier 的 castRay，做视线与落点预测。
distinction.en: Query.ray or Rapier castRay for line of sight.

items.dz: 一下把它打出去
items.de: One hit sends it flying
items.pz: applyForce 是持续力，冲量要一帧内给完。
items.pe: applyForce is continuous; an impulse lands in one step.

definition.zh: 一下把它打出去
definition.en: One hit sends it flying

distinction.zh: applyForce 是持续力，冲量要一帧内给完。
distinction.en: applyForce is continuous; an impulse lands in one step.

items.dz: 被拧着转起来
items.de: Twisted into a spin
items.pz: body.torque 累加角速度，注意 inertia 会抵抗。
items.pe: Torque accumulates angular velocity against inertia.

definition.zh: 被拧着转起来
definition.en: Twisted into a spin

distinction.zh: body.torque 累加角速度，注意 inertia 会抵抗。
distinction.en: Torque accumulates angular velocity against inertia.

items.dz: 转着转着停下来
items.de: The spin winds down
items.pz: frictionAir 同时衰减线速度与角速度。
items.pe: frictionAir damps both linear and angular velocity.

definition.zh: 转着转着停下来
definition.en: The spin winds down

distinction.zh: frictionAir 同时衰减线速度与角速度。
distinction.en: frictionAir damps both linear and angular velocity.

items.dz: 沿斜面加速下滑
items.de: It accelerates down the ramp
items.pz: 静摩擦大于 tan(θ) 就不会动，先算再调。
items.pe: Static friction above tan(θ) means it never moves.

definition.zh: 沿斜面加速下滑
definition.en: It accelerates down the ramp

distinction.zh: 静摩擦大于 tan(θ) 就不会动，先算再调。
distinction.en: Static friction above tan(θ) means it never moves.

items.dz: 踩上去就被送走
items.de: Step on and be carried
items.pz: 每帧给接触物体设水平速度，不用移动地面。
items.pe: Set contact velocity each step; the belt itself stays put.

definition.zh: 踩上去就被送走
definition.en: Step on and be carried

distinction.zh: 每帧给接触物体设水平速度，不用移动地面。
distinction.en: Set contact velocity each step; the belt itself stays put.

items.dz: 浮在水面上下起伏
items.de: It bobs on the surface
items.pz: 按浸没深度给向上力 ρ·g·V，再加水阻。
items.pe: Upward force by submerged volume, plus drag.

definition.zh: 浮在水面上下起伏
definition.en: It bobs on the surface

distinction.zh: 按浸没深度给向上力 ρ·g·V，再加水阻。
distinction.en: Upward force by submerged volume, plus drag.

items.dz: 一阵阵地被吹歪
items.de: Gusts push it sideways
items.pz: 风是随时间变化的力场，别用常量。
items.pe: Wind is a time-varying field, not a constant.

definition.zh: 一阵阵地被吹歪
definition.en: Gusts push it sideways

distinction.zh: 风是随时间变化的力场，别用常量。
distinction.en: Wind is a time-varying field, not a constant.

items.dz: 靠近就被吸过去
items.de: It gets pulled in
items.pz: 力 ∝ 1/r²，要设最小距离防数值爆炸。
items.pe: Force ∝ 1/r² with a minimum distance clamp.

definition.zh: 靠近就被吸过去
definition.en: It gets pulled in

distinction.zh: 力 ∝ 1/r²，要设最小距离防数值爆炸。
distinction.en: Force ∝ 1/r² with a minimum distance clamp.

items.dz: 绕着中心不掉下去
items.de: It circles without falling in
items.pz: 初速度垂直于半径且等于 √(GM/r) 才是圆轨。
items.pe: A circular orbit needs v = √(GM/r) perpendicular to r.

definition.zh: 绕着中心不掉下去
definition.en: It circles without falling in

distinction.zh: 初速度垂直于半径且等于 √(GM/r) 才是圆轨。
distinction.en: A circular orbit needs v = √(GM/r) perpendicular to r.

items.dz: 中心炸开推走一切
items.de: Everything is pushed outward
items.pz: 对范围内每个 body 施加径向冲量，随距离衰减。
items.pe: Radial impulse to every body in range, falling with distance.

definition.zh: 中心炸开推走一切
definition.en: Everything is pushed outward

distinction.zh: 对范围内每个 body 施加径向冲量，随距离衰减。
distinction.en: Radial impulse to every body in range, falling with distance.

items.dz: 拉太狠就断了
items.de: Pull too hard and it snaps
items.pz: 每帧检查约束长度，超阈值就 remove。
items.pe: Check the constraint length each step and remove past a threshold.

definition.zh: 拉太狠就断了
definition.en: Pull too hard and it snaps

distinction.zh: 每帧检查约束长度，超阈值就 remove。
distinction.en: Check the constraint length each step and remove past a threshold.

items.dz: 一刀切成两半
items.de: One cut, two bodies
items.pz: 切线两侧顶点重建两个凸多边形，别切凹形。
items.pe: Rebuild two convex hulls from the split vertices.

definition.zh: 一刀切成两半
definition.en: One cut, two bodies

distinction.zh: 切线两侧顶点重建两个凸多边形，别切凹形。
distinction.en: Rebuild two convex hulls from the split vertices.

items.dz: 关节乱晃地倒下去
items.de: It flops down by its joints
items.pz: 每关节设角度限制，否则会拧成麻花。
items.pe: Angle limits on every joint or it knots up.

definition.zh: 关节乱晃地倒下去
definition.en: It flops down by its joints

distinction.zh: 每关节设角度限制，否则会拧成麻花。
distinction.en: Angle limits on every joint or it knots up.

items.dz: 车轮压过颠簸
items.de: Wheels absorb the bumps
items.pz: 轮子用 revolute 关节 + 悬挂用有阻尼的弹簧。
items.pe: Revolute joints for wheels, damped springs for suspension.

definition.zh: 车轮压过颠簸
definition.en: Wheels absorb the bumps

distinction.zh: 轮子用 revolute 关节 + 悬挂用有阻尼的弹簧。
distinction.en: Revolute joints for wheels, damped springs for suspension.

items.dz: 不动的就别算了
items.de: Stop simulating what has settled
items.pz: enableSleeping:true，静止 60 帧后进入睡眠。
items.pe: enableSleeping — bodies sleep after ~60 still frames.

definition.zh: 不动的就别算了
definition.en: Stop simulating what has settled

distinction.zh: enableSleeping:true，静止 60 帧后进入睡眠。
distinction.en: enableSleeping — bodies sleep after ~60 still frames.

items.dz: 一个时间步拆成更小的连续增量
items.de: One time step split into smaller increments
items.pz: 把一个外层时间步拆成若干小步；下面用四个区间、五个时间检查点表示推进过程。子步数由模拟需求决定，不等同于连续碰撞检测。
items.pe: Split one outer time step into smaller increments. The four intervals and five checkpoints below illustrate that progression; the substep count depends on the simulation and is distinct from continuous collision detection.

definition.zh: 子步进将一个模拟时间步拆分为更小的时间增量，逐步推进求解过程。
definition.en: Sub-stepping divides one simulation time step into smaller time increments and advances the solver through them.

distinction.zh: 连续碰撞检测扫描运动并求出碰撞时间；子步进拆分时间推进。两者可以组合使用，但不是同义词。
distinction.en: Continuous collision detection sweeps motion to find a time of impact; sub-stepping divides time advancement. They can be combined but are not synonyms.

items.dz: 同样输入必得同样结果
items.de: Same input, same outcome
items.pz: 固定步长 + 固定随机种子，才能录制回放。
items.pe: Fixed timestep plus a fixed seed makes replays possible.

definition.zh: 同样输入必得同样结果
definition.en: Same input, same outcome

distinction.zh: 固定步长 + 固定随机种子，才能录制回放。
distinction.en: Fixed timestep plus a fixed seed makes replays possible.

items.dz: 物理 60Hz，画面 120Hz 也顺
items.de: Physics at 60Hz, display at 120
items.pz: 渲染时在上一步与当前步之间按余量插值。
items.pe: Interpolate between the last two physics states.

definition.zh: 物理 60Hz，画面 120Hz 也顺
definition.en: Physics at 60Hz, display at 120

distinction.zh: 渲染时在上一步与当前步之间按余量插值。
distinction.en: Interpolate between the last two physics states.

items.dz: 几千刚体还能实时
items.de: Thousands of bodies, real time
items.pz: Rapier 跑在 WASM 里，初始化是异步的。
items.pe: Rapier runs in WASM; init is async.

definition.zh: 几千刚体还能实时
definition.en: Thousands of bodies, real time

distinction.zh: Rapier 跑在 WASM 里，初始化是异步的。
distinction.en: Rapier runs in WASM; init is async.

items.dz: 几块拼成一个物体
items.de: Several parts, one body
items.pz: Body.create({parts:[...]})，重心自动重算。
items.pe: Body.create with parts recomputes the centre of mass.

definition.zh: 几块拼成一个物体
definition.en: Several parts, one body

distinction.zh: Body.create({parts:[...]})，重心自动重算。
distinction.en: Body.create with parts recomputes the centre of mass.

items.dz: 复杂形状用凸包代替
items.de: Approximate with a hull
items.pz: 凹形要分解成多个凸体（decomp），性能差很多。
items.pe: Concave shapes need decomposition — much costlier.

definition.zh: 复杂形状用凸包代替
definition.en: Approximate with a hull

distinction.zh: 凹形要分解成多个凸体（decomp），性能差很多。
distinction.en: Concave shapes need decomposition — much costlier.

items.dz: 一个动作引发一串
items.de: One action, a cascade
items.pz: 碰撞事件里再施力，注意别在事件里改世界结构。
items.pe: Apply force in the collision event, but never mutate the world there.

definition.zh: 一个动作引发一串
definition.en: One action, a cascade

distinction.zh: 碰撞事件里再施力，注意别在事件里改世界结构。
distinction.en: Apply force in the collision event, but never mutate the world there.

items.dz: 界面元素也用弹簧不是曲线
items.de: UI motion by spring, not curve
items.pz: 把刚度/阻尼当设计参数，一套值贯穿全站。
items.pe: Treat stiffness and damping as design tokens.

definition.zh: 界面元素也用弹簧不是曲线
definition.en: UI motion by spring, not curve

distinction.zh: 把刚度/阻尼当设计参数，一套值贯穿全站。
distinction.en: Treat stiffness and damping as design tokens.

items.dz: 拖完还滑一段再停
items.de: It coasts after the drag
items.pz: 速度 × 0.95 每帧衰减，低于 0.1px 归零。
items.pe: Decay velocity by 0.95 per frame, snap to zero under 0.1px.

definition.zh: 拖完还滑一段再停
definition.en: It coasts after the drag

distinction.zh: 速度 × 0.95 每帧衰减，低于 0.1px 归零。
distinction.en: Decay velocity by 0.95 per frame, snap to zero under 0.1px.

items.dz: 一堆方块落进格子里
items.de: Blocks drop into their slots
items.pz: 物理落位后 snap 到网格，两段动效衔接。
items.pe: Let physics land it, then snap to the grid.

definition.zh: 一堆方块落进格子里
definition.en: Blocks drop into their slots

distinction.zh: 物理落位后 snap 到网格，两段动效衔接。
distinction.en: Let physics land it, then snap to the grid.

items.dz: 一坨会流动的液体
items.de: A liquid that actually flows
items.pz: SPH：邻域密度求压力，粒子数控制在 2k 内。
items.pe: SPH pressure from neighbour density; cap around 2k particles.

definition.zh: 一坨会流动的液体
definition.en: A liquid that actually flows

distinction.zh: SPH：邻域密度求压力，粒子数控制在 2k 内。
distinction.en: SPH pressure from neighbour density; cap around 2k particles.

items.dz: 颗粒堆成一个锥
items.de: Grains pile into a cone
items.pz: 高摩擦小颗粒，休止角自然出现。
items.pe: High-friction small bodies find their own angle of repose.

definition.zh: 颗粒堆成一个锥
definition.en: Grains pile into a cone

distinction.zh: 高摩擦小颗粒，休止角自然出现。
distinction.en: High-friction small bodies find their own angle of repose.

items.dz: 手要够到某个点
items.de: The hand reaches the target
items.pz: FABRIK 迭代两三次就够，末端优先。
items.pe: Two or three FABRIK iterations is enough.

definition.zh: 手要够到某个点
definition.en: The hand reaches the target

distinction.zh: FABRIK 迭代两三次就够，末端优先。
distinction.en: Two or three FABRIK iterations is enough.

items.dz: 关节不能反折
items.de: Joints cannot bend backwards
items.pz: 给 revolute 设 min/max 角，UI 里也一样有效。
items.pe: Set min and max on revolute joints.

definition.zh: 关节不能反折
definition.en: Joints cannot bend backwards

distinction.zh: 给 revolute 设 min/max 角，UI 里也一样有效。
distinction.en: Set min and max on revolute joints.

items.dz: 被驱动着匀速转
items.de: Driven at constant speed
items.pz: 设目标角速度与最大扭矩，别硬设角度。
items.pe: Target an angular velocity with a max torque.

definition.zh: 被驱动着匀速转
definition.en: Driven at constant speed

distinction.zh: 设目标角速度与最大扭矩，别硬设角度。
distinction.en: Target an angular velocity with a max torque.

items.dz: 别让东西飞出世界
items.de: Nothing escapes the world
items.pz: 四面静态墙 + 定期清理越界 body。
items.pe: Four static walls plus a periodic out-of-bounds sweep.

definition.zh: 别让东西飞出世界
definition.en: Nothing escapes the world

distinction.zh: 四面静态墙 + 定期清理越界 body。
distinction.en: Four static walls plus a periodic out-of-bounds sweep.

items.dz: 几百个就够讲故事
items.de: A few hundred bodies tells the story
items.pz: 视觉密度靠贴图与拖影，不靠更多刚体。
items.pe: Fake density with sprites and trails, not more bodies.

definition.zh: 几百个就够讲故事
definition.en: A few hundred bodies tells the story

distinction.zh: 视觉密度靠贴图与拖影，不靠更多刚体。
distinction.en: Fake density with sprites and trails, not more bodies.

items.dz: 物理落位后交给 CSS 收尾
items.de: Physics lands it, CSS finishes
items.pz: 停下的瞬间读位置写成 transform，然后销毁世界。
items.pe: Read the resting transform, write it to CSS, drop the world.

definition.zh: 物理落位后交给 CSS 收尾
definition.en: Physics lands it, CSS finishes

distinction.zh: 停下的瞬间读位置写成 transform，然后销毁世界。
distinction.en: Read the resting transform, write it to CSS, drop the world.

items.dz: 关掉物理只留状态
items.de: Drop the simulation, keep the state
items.pz: reduced-motion 下直接给最终位置，不跑模拟。
items.pe: Under reduced motion, jump to the final layout.

definition.zh: 关掉物理只留状态
definition.en: Drop the simulation, keep the state

distinction.zh: reduced-motion 下直接给最终位置，不跑模拟。
distinction.en: Under reduced motion, jump to the final layout.

dz: p5 那一派：写规则、给种子，让画面自己长出来
de: The p5 school — write rules, plant a seed, let the image grow

items.dz: 同一个种子永远长成同一张
items.de: One seed, always the same piece
items.pz: randomSeed(n) 或自带 PRNG，作品才可复现、可收藏。
items.pe: randomSeed(n) or your own PRNG makes the work reproducible.

definition.zh: 同一个种子永远长成同一张
definition.en: One seed, always the same piece

distinction.zh: randomSeed(n) 或自带 PRNG，作品才可复现、可收藏。
distinction.en: randomSeed(n) or your own PRNG makes the work reproducible.

items.dz: 随机但不抽搐
items.de: Random without the twitch
items.pz: 用 noise(t) 而不是 random()，路径才连续。
items.pe: noise(t) instead of random() keeps the path continuous.

definition.zh: 随机但不抽搐
definition.en: Random without the twitch

distinction.zh: 用 noise(t) 而不是 random()，路径才连续。
distinction.en: noise(t) instead of random() keeps the path continuous.

items.dz: 每格的值来自同一片噪声
items.de: One noise field, sampled per cell
items.pz: noise(x*0.08, y*0.08) 决定大小/旋转，尺度别太大。
items.pe: Sample noise(x·0.08, y·0.08) for size or rotation.

definition.zh: 每格的值来自同一片噪声
definition.en: One noise field, sampled per cell

distinction.zh: noise(x*0.08, y*0.08) 决定大小/旋转，尺度别太大。
distinction.en: Sample noise(x·0.08, y·0.08) for size or rotation.
