items.dz: 几千条线顺着场走出纹理
items.de: Thousands of lines find the field
items.pz: 角度 = noise*TAU，每条线走 150 步、alpha 0.06。
items.pe: Angle = noise·TAU; 150 steps per line at alpha 0.06.

definition.zh: 几千条线顺着场走出纹理
definition.en: Thousands of lines find the field

distinction.zh: 角度 = noise*TAU，每条线走 150 步、alpha 0.06。
distinction.en: Angle = noise·TAU; 150 steps per line at alpha 0.06.

items.dz: 不重叠地塞满画面
items.de: Fill the frame without overlap
items.pz: 随机撒点、半径长到碰到别人就停（放松法）。
items.pe: Grow each radius until it touches a neighbour.

definition.zh: 不重叠地塞满画面
definition.en: Fill the frame without overlap

distinction.zh: 随机撒点、半径长到碰到别人就停（放松法）。
distinction.en: Grow each radius until it touches a neighbour.

items.dz: 随机但间距均匀
items.de: Random, evenly spaced
items.pz: Bridson 算法保证任意两点距离 ≥ r。
items.pe: Bridson's algorithm guarantees a minimum spacing.

definition.zh: 随机但间距均匀
definition.en: Random, evenly spaced

distinction.zh: Bridson 算法保证任意两点距离 ≥ r。
distinction.en: Bridson's algorithm guarantees a minimum spacing.

items.dz: 大块不停切成小块
items.de: Big blocks keep splitting
items.pz: 按概率决定继续切还是停，深度上限 5–6。
items.pe: Split by probability, cap the depth at five or six.

definition.zh: 大块不停切成小块
definition.en: Big blocks keep splitting

distinction.zh: 按概率决定继续切还是停，深度上限 5–6。
distinction.en: Split by probability, cap the depth at five or six.

items.dz: 横竖切分 + 少量色块
items.de: Orthogonal splits, a few colour fields
items.pz: 只用三原色 + 黑白，色块占比别超过 25%。
items.pe: Three primaries plus black and white, under 25% colour.

definition.zh: 横竖切分 + 少量色块
definition.en: Orthogonal splits, a few colour fields

distinction.zh: 只用三原色 + 黑白，色块占比别超过 25%。
distinction.en: Three primaries plus black and white, under 25% colour.

items.dz: 斜线把网格串起来
items.de: Diagonals lace the grid
items.pz: 每格随机选一条对角线（10 PRINT 那一招）。
items.pe: Pick one diagonal per cell — the 10 PRINT trick.

definition.zh: 斜线把网格串起来
definition.en: Diagonals lace the grid

distinction.zh: 每格随机选一条对角线（10 PRINT 那一招）。
distinction.en: Pick one diagonal per cell — the 10 PRINT trick.

items.dz: 四分之一圆拼出迷宫
items.de: Quarter arcs make a labyrinth
items.pz: 两种瓦片随机放置，接缝必须对齐。
items.pe: Two tile variants placed at random with aligned seams.

definition.zh: 四分之一圆拼出迷宫
definition.en: Quarter arcs make a labyrinth

distinction.zh: 两种瓦片随机放置，接缝必须对齐。
distinction.en: Two tile variants placed at random with aligned seams.

items.dz: 像向日葵那样排点
items.de: Sunflower seed packing
items.pe: Angle i × 137.5°, radius c√i.

definition.zh: 像向日葵那样排点
definition.en: Sunflower seed packing

distinction.en: Angle i × 137.5°, radius c√i.

items.dz: 两个圆滚出花纹
items.de: Two circles trace a rosette
items.pz: 内外半径比是有理数才闭合。
items.pe: The radius ratio must be rational to close.

definition.zh: 两个圆滚出花纹
definition.en: Two circles trace a rosette

distinction.zh: 内外半径比是有理数才闭合。
distinction.en: The radius ratio must be rational to close.

items.dz: 两个正弦画出的结
items.de: A knot from two sines
items.pz: x=sin(at+δ), y=sin(bt)，a:b 决定形状。
items.pe: x = sin(at + δ), y = sin(bt); a:b sets the shape.

definition.zh: 两个正弦画出的结
definition.en: A knot from two sines

distinction.zh: x=sin(at+δ), y=sin(bt)，a:b 决定形状。
distinction.en: x = sin(at + δ), y = sin(bt); a:b sets the shape.

items.dz: 带衰减的摆线
items.de: Damped pendulum drawing
items.pz: 四个衰减正弦叠加，衰减率决定收敛速度。
items.pe: Four damped sines; the decay rate sets the collapse.

definition.zh: 带衰减的摆线
definition.en: Damped pendulum drawing

distinction.zh: 四个衰减正弦叠加，衰减率决定收敛速度。
distinction.en: Four damped sines; the decay rate sets the collapse.

items.dz: 花瓣数由参数决定
items.de: The petal count is a parameter
items.pz: r = cos(kθ)，k 为整数时花瓣数是 k 或 2k。
items.pe: r = cos(kθ) — petals are k or 2k.

definition.zh: 花瓣数由参数决定
definition.en: The petal count is a parameter

distinction.zh: r = cos(kθ)，k 为整数时花瓣数是 k 或 2k。
distinction.en: r = cos(kθ) — petals are k or 2k.

items.dz: 两层细纹叠出第三种图案
items.de: Two grids, a third pattern
items.pz: 两层间距接近、角度差 1–3° 时最明显。
items.pe: Strongest at a 1–3° offset between near-equal grids.

definition.zh: 两层细纹叠出第三种图案
definition.en: Two grids, a third pattern

distinction.zh: 两层间距接近、角度差 1–3° 时最明显。
distinction.en: Strongest at a 1–3° offset between near-equal grids.

items.dz: 点越大越暗
items.de: Bigger dots, darker value
items.pz: 点半径 ∝ 目标灰度，网格角度 45° 最不显眼。
items.pe: Radius by value; a 45° screen angle hides the grid.

definition.zh: 点越大越暗
definition.en: Bigger dots, darker value

distinction.zh: 点半径 ∝ 目标灰度，网格角度 45° 最不显眼。
distinction.en: Radius by value; a 45° screen angle hides the grid.

items.dz: 像地形图那样的层线
items.de: Contours like a topo map
items.pz: marching squares 提取等值线，层距要一致。
items.pe: Marching squares with an even interval.

definition.zh: 像地形图那样的层线
definition.en: Contours like a topo map

distinction.zh: marching squares 提取等值线，层距要一致。
distinction.en: Marching squares with an even interval.

items.dz: 几条吸引/排斥规则长出生态
items.de: Attraction rules grow an ecosystem
items.pz: 每种颜色对其他颜色有不同吸引力矩阵。
items.pe: A per-colour attraction matrix does all the work.

definition.zh: 几条吸引/排斥规则长出生态
definition.en: Attraction rules grow an ecosystem

distinction.zh: 每种颜色对其他颜色有不同吸引力矩阵。
distinction.en: A per-colour attraction matrix does all the work.

items.dz: 像霜一样长出枝
items.de: It branches like frost
items.pz: 随机漫步的粒子碰到就粘住，形成分形枝。
items.pe: Random walkers stick on contact and branch.

definition.zh: 像霜一样长出枝
definition.en: It branches like frost

distinction.zh: 随机漫步的粒子碰到就粘住，形成分形枝。
distinction.en: Random walkers stick on contact and branch.

items.dz: 群体留下的轨迹本身是画
items.de: The flock draws the piece
items.pz: 给每只 boid 留低 alpha 拖影，跑 30 秒。
items.pe: Low-alpha trails, thirty seconds of runtime.

definition.zh: 群体留下的轨迹本身是画
definition.en: The flock draws the piece

distinction.zh: 给每只 boid 留低 alpha 拖影，跑 30 秒。
distinction.en: Low-alpha trails, thirty seconds of runtime.

items.dz: 按邻接规则拼出连贯图案
items.de: Tiles resolve by adjacency rules
items.pz: 每格保留可能性集合，最低熵优先坍缩。
items.pe: Collapse the lowest-entropy cell first.

definition.zh: 按邻接规则拼出连贯图案
definition.en: Tiles resolve by adjacency rules

distinction.zh: 每格保留可能性集合，最低熵优先坍缩。
distinction.en: Collapse the lowest-entropy cell first.

items.dz: 下一块取决于上一块
items.de: Each tile depends on the last
items.pz: 状态转移矩阵决定序列，比纯随机有节奏。
items.pe: A transition matrix gives rhythm that pure random lacks.

definition.zh: 下一块取决于上一块
definition.en: Each tile depends on the last

distinction.zh: 状态转移矩阵决定序列，比纯随机有节奏。
distinction.en: A transition matrix gives rhythm that pure random lacks.

items.dz: 规整里加一点不规整
items.de: Order with a little disorder
items.pz: 每格位置加 ±10% 抖动，比完全随机好看。
items.pe: Jitter each cell ±10% — better than full randomness.

definition.zh: 规整里加一点不规整
definition.en: Order with a little disorder

distinction.zh: 每格位置加 ±10% 抖动，比完全随机好看。
distinction.en: Jitter each cell ±10% — better than full randomness.

items.dz: 生成式作品最难的是配色
items.de: Colour is the hard part
items.pz: 固定 2 主 1 辅，色相差 30/150/180 三选一。
items.pe: Two dominants and one accent; hue gaps of 30, 150 or 180.

definition.zh: 生成式作品最难的是配色
definition.en: Colour is the hard part

distinction.zh: 固定 2 主 1 辅，色相差 30/150/180 三选一。
distinction.en: Two dominants and one accent; hue gaps of 30, 150 or 180.

items.dz: 同一构图换配色就是新作
items.de: Same composition, new palette
items.pz: 把颜色抽成索引，色表可整体替换。
items.pe: Index the colours so the table can be swapped.

definition.zh: 同一构图换配色就是新作
definition.en: Same composition, new palette

distinction.zh: 把颜色抽成索引，色表可整体替换。
distinction.en: Index the colours so the table can be swapped.

items.dz: 一层噪点让画面有实体感
items.de: Grain gives it a body
items.pz: 叠 4–8% 的噪点，混合模式用 overlay。
items.pe: Four to eight percent noise on overlay.

definition.zh: 一层噪点让画面有实体感
definition.en: Grain gives it a body

distinction.zh: 叠 4–8% 的噪点，混合模式用 overlay。
distinction.en: Four to eight percent noise on overlay.

items.dz: 像印在纸上
items.de: It sits on paper
items.pz: 两层低对比噪声 + 极轻的暖色偏移。
items.pe: Two low-contrast noise layers and a warm cast.

definition.zh: 像印在纸上
definition.en: It sits on paper

distinction.zh: 两层低对比噪声 + 极轻的暖色偏移。
distinction.en: Two low-contrast noise layers and a warm cast.

items.dz: 两色错版印刷感
items.de: Two-colour print misregistration
items.pz: 两个色版各偏移 1–2px，混合模式 multiply。
items.pe: Offset each plate 1–2px and multiply.

definition.zh: 两色错版印刷感
definition.en: Two-colour print misregistration

distinction.zh: 两个色版各偏移 1–2px，混合模式 multiply。
distinction.en: Offset each plate 1–2px and multiply.

items.dz: 色块叠出第三种颜色
items.de: Overlaps make a third colour
items.pz: 三个半透明色块 multiply 叠加，边缘略错位。
items.pe: Three translucent fields multiplied, edges slightly off.

definition.zh: 色块叠出第三种颜色
definition.en: Overlaps make a third colour

distinction.zh: 三个半透明色块 multiply 叠加，边缘略错位。
distinction.en: Three translucent fields multiplied, edges slightly off.

items.dz: 灰度映射到两个色
items.de: Greyscale into two colours
items.pz: 暗部一色、亮部一色，中间线性插值。
items.pe: One colour for shadows, one for highlights.

definition.zh: 灰度映射到两个色
definition.en: Greyscale into two colours

distinction.zh: 暗部一色、亮部一色，中间线性插值。
distinction.en: One colour for shadows, one for highlights.

items.dz: 整幅画由字符组成
items.de: The image is made of characters
items.pz: 按亮度选字符，等宽字体 + 行高 1 才不变形。
items.pe: Monospace at line-height 1 or the aspect breaks.

definition.zh: 整幅画由字符组成
definition.en: The image is made of characters

distinction.zh: 按亮度选字符，等宽字体 + 行高 1 才不变形。
distinction.en: Monospace at line-height 1 or the aspect breaks.

items.dz: 把字当图形用
items.de: Letters as pure shape
items.pz: 大字裁切 + 局部放大，别怕看不清全字。
items.pe: Crop and blow up — legibility is not the goal.

definition.zh: 把字当图形用
definition.en: Letters as pure shape

distinction.zh: 大字裁切 + 局部放大，别怕看不清全字。
distinction.en: Crop and blow up — legibility is not the goal.

items.dz: 字形由参数生成
items.de: Letterforms from parameters
items.pz: 骨架 + 可变笔宽/衬线开关，一套参数一套字。
items.pe: A skeleton plus stroke and serif parameters.

definition.zh: 字形由参数生成
definition.en: Letterforms from parameters

distinction.zh: 骨架 + 可变笔宽/衬线开关，一套参数一套字。
distinction.en: A skeleton plus stroke and serif parameters.

items.dz: 有限模块组合出无限版式
items.de: A few modules, endless layouts
items.pz: 定义 4–6 个模块与放置规则，其余交给随机。
items.pe: Define four to six modules and placement rules.

definition.zh: 有限模块组合出无限版式
definition.en: A few modules, endless layouts

distinction.zh: 定义 4–6 个模块与放置规则，其余交给随机。
distinction.en: Define four to six modules and placement rules.

items.dz: 一条重写规则长成树
items.de: A rewrite rule becomes a tree
items.pz: F→FF+[+F-F-F]-[-F+F+F]，角度 22–25° 最像植物。
items.pe: Angles of 22–25° read as plants.

definition.zh: 一条重写规则长成树
definition.en: A rewrite rule becomes a tree

distinction.zh: F→FF+[+F-F-F]-[-F+F+F]，角度 22–25° 最像植物。
distinction.en: Angles of 22–25° read as plants.

items.dz: 每一枝再分两枝
items.de: Each branch splits again
items.pz: 递归 6 层就够密，长度每层 ×0.7。
items.pe: Six levels, each 0.7 the length.

definition.zh: 每一枝再分两枝
definition.en: Each branch splits again

distinction.zh: 递归 6 层就够密，长度每层 ×0.7。
distinction.en: Six levels, each 0.7 the length.

items.dz: 一直放大都还有细节
items.de: Detail all the way down
items.pz: 双精度到 1e-14 就该换 perturbation 算法。
items.pe: Past 1e-14, switch to perturbation maths.

definition.zh: 一直放大都还有细节
definition.en: Detail all the way down

distinction.zh: 双精度到 1e-14 就该换 perturbation 算法。
distinction.en: Past 1e-14, switch to perturbation maths.

items.dz: 参数一动形状全变
items.de: One parameter, a whole new shape
items.pz: c 沿一条路径移动，形状连续变形。
items.pe: Move c along a path for continuous morphing.

definition.zh: 参数一动形状全变
definition.en: One parameter, a whole new shape

distinction.zh: c 沿一条路径移动，形状连续变形。
distinction.en: Move c along a path for continuous morphing.

items.dz: 混沌里的稳定形状
items.de: A stable shape inside chaos
items.pz: Lorenz / Clifford 迭代十万次，点越多越亮。
items.pe: Iterate a Clifford or Lorenz map 100k times.

definition.zh: 混沌里的稳定形状
definition.en: A stable shape inside chaos

distinction.zh: Lorenz / Clifford 迭代十万次，点越多越亮。
distinction.en: Iterate a Clifford or Lorenz map 100k times.

items.dz: 随机跳一半，跳出谢尔宾斯基
items.de: Random half-steps draw Sierpiński
items.pz: 每次朝随机顶点走一半，十万点后成三角。
items.pe: Step halfway to a random vertex, 100k times.

definition.zh: 随机跳一半，跳出谢尔宾斯基
definition.en: Random half-steps draw Sierpiński

distinction.zh: 每次朝随机顶点走一半，十万点后成三角。
distinction.en: Step halfway to a random vertex, 100k times.

items.dz: 一条线由无数细点组成
items.de: A line made of dust
items.pz: 沿路径撒点，垂直方向高斯抖动。
items.pe: Scatter along the path with a Gaussian normal offset.

definition.zh: 一条线由无数细点组成
definition.en: A line made of dust

distinction.zh: 沿路径撒点，垂直方向高斯抖动。
distinction.en: Scatter along the path with a Gaussian normal offset.

items.dz: 边缘不规则、颜色不均
items.de: Ragged edge, uneven wash
items.pz: 多边形顶点递归扰动 + 多层 3% 透明叠加。
items.pe: Recursively perturb a polygon and stack 3% layers.

definition.zh: 边缘不规则、颜色不均
definition.en: Ragged edge, uneven wash

distinction.zh: 多边形顶点递归扰动 + 多层 3% 透明叠加。
distinction.en: Recursively perturb a polygon and stack 3% layers.

items.dz: 墨顺着纸纹爬
items.de: Ink crawls along the grain
items.pz: 各向异性扩散：沿纸纹方向的扩散率更高。
items.pe: Anisotropic diffusion, faster along the grain.

definition.zh: 墨顺着纸纹爬
definition.en: Ink crawls along the grain

distinction.zh: 各向异性扩散：沿纸纹方向的扩散率更高。
distinction.en: Anisotropic diffusion, faster along the grain.

items.dz: 用点的密度表现明暗
items.de: Density carries the tone
items.pz: Lloyd relaxation 让点分布贴合灰度图。
items.pe: Lloyd relaxation fits the dots to the tone map.

definition.zh: 用点的密度表现明暗
definition.en: Density carries the tone

distinction.zh: Lloyd relaxation 让点分布贴合灰度图。
distinction.en: Lloyd relaxation fits the dots to the tone map.

items.dz: 排线方向跟着明暗走
items.de: Hatch direction follows the form
items.pz: 按梯度方向排线，交叉两层表现暗部。
items.pe: Hatch along the gradient; cross-hatch the shadows.

definition.zh: 排线方向跟着明暗走
definition.en: Hatch direction follows the form

distinction.zh: 按梯度方向排线，交叉两层表现暗部。
distinction.en: Hatch along the gradient; cross-hatch the shadows.

items.dz: 白线深底的工程感
items.de: White lines on a deep field
items.pz: 细网格 + 粗主线 + 单一强调色。
items.pe: Fine grid, heavier majors, one accent.

definition.zh: 白线深底的工程感
definition.en: White lines on a deep field

distinction.zh: 细网格 + 粗主线 + 单一强调色。
distinction.en: Fine grid, heavier majors, one accent.

items.dz: 一笔到底的线稿
items.de: One continuous pen path
items.pz: 路径优化成最短单笔路线（TSP art）。
items.pe: Optimise into one shortest path — TSP art.

definition.zh: 一笔到底的线稿
definition.en: One continuous pen path

distinction.zh: 路径优化成最短单笔路线（TSP art）。
distinction.en: Optimise into one shortest path — TSP art.

items.dz: 大字 + 大留白 + 一个色块
items.de: Big type, big space, one field
items.pz: 版面只放三样东西：标题、图形、一行小字。
items.pe: Three elements only: headline, shape, one line of small type.

definition.zh: 大字 + 大留白 + 一个色块
definition.en: Big type, big space, one field

distinction.zh: 版面只放三样东西：标题、图形、一行小字。
distinction.en: Three elements only: headline, shape, one line of small type.

items.dz: 一秒生成一百个版式
items.de: A hundred layouts a second
items.pz: 把网格位置、字号、色块当参数随机组合。
items.pe: Randomise slot, size and field as parameters.

definition.zh: 一秒生成一百个版式
definition.en: A hundred layouts a second

distinction.zh: 把网格位置、字号、色块当参数随机组合。
distinction.en: Randomise slot, size and field as parameters.

items.dz: 同一份代码出 4K
items.de: The same code prints at 4K
items.pz: 所有尺寸用相对单位，导出时只改画布尺寸。
items.pe: Size everything relatively; export by changing the canvas.

definition.zh: 同一份代码出 4K
definition.en: The same code prints at 4K

distinction.zh: 所有尺寸用相对单位，导出时只改画布尺寸。
distinction.en: Size everything relatively; export by changing the canvas.

items.dz: 看不出起点和终点
items.de: No visible start or end
items.pz: 所有参数用 sin(t·2π) 驱动，t 归一化到 0–1。
items.pe: Drive everything by sin(t·2π) with t in 0–1.

definition.zh: 看不出起点和终点
definition.en: No visible start or end

distinction.zh: 所有参数用 sin(t·2π) 驱动，t 归一化到 0–1。
distinction.en: Drive everything by sin(t·2π) with t in 0–1.

items.dz: 导成视频而不是录屏
items.de: Render frames, do not screen-record
items.pz: 固定 deltaTime 逐帧渲染再合成，才不掉帧。
items.pe: Render with a fixed delta and encode after.

definition.zh: 导成视频而不是录屏
definition.en: Render frames, do not screen-record

distinction.zh: 固定 deltaTime 逐帧渲染再合成，才不掉帧。
distinction.en: Render with a fixed delta and encode after.

items.dz: 把可能性摊开来看
items.de: Lay the possibilities out
items.pz: 同一算法排成网格，两个轴各扫一个参数。
items.pe: Grid the outputs, one parameter per axis.

definition.zh: 把可能性摊开来看
definition.en: Lay the possibilities out

distinction.zh: 同一算法排成网格，两个轴各扫一个参数。
distinction.en: Grid the outputs, one parameter per axis.

items.dz: 生成一千张，挑三张
items.de: Generate a thousand, keep three
items.pz: 生成式的作者身份在于筛选，不在于随机。
items.pe: Authorship in generative work is curation, not randomness.

definition.zh: 生成一千张，挑三张
definition.en: Generate a thousand, keep three

distinction.zh: 生成式的作者身份在于筛选，不在于随机。
distinction.en: Authorship in generative work is curation, not randomness.

dz: pretext 那一派：断行、度量、基线都可计算，也都可以动起来
de: The pretext school — line breaking, metrics and baselines as computable, animatable state

items.dz: 整段一起算，不是一行一行贪心
items.de: The paragraph is optimised as a whole
items.pz: 给每个断点算 badness，动态规划求全段最小总代价。
items.pe: Score each breakpoint by badness and dynamic-program the paragraph.

definition.zh: 整段一起算，不是一行一行贪心
definition.en: The paragraph is optimised as a whole

distinction.zh: 给每个断点算 badness，动态规划求全段最小总代价。
distinction.en: Score each breakpoint by badness and dynamic-program the paragraph.

items.dz: 两行长短接近才像标题
items.de: Lines of similar length read as a title
items.pz: text-wrap:balance，或自己二分栏宽求最小行长方差。
items.pe: text-wrap: balance, or binary-search the measure for minimal variance.

definition.zh: 两行长短接近才像标题
definition.en: Lines of similar length read as a title

distinction.zh: text-wrap:balance，或自己二分栏宽求最小行长方差。
distinction.en: text-wrap: balance, or binary-search the measure for minimal variance.

items.dz: 最后一行不能只剩一个词
items.de: The last line never holds one word
items.pz: text-wrap:pretty；引擎侧则给末行加惩罚项。
items.pe: text-wrap: pretty — engine-side, penalise short last lines.

definition.zh: 最后一行不能只剩一个词
definition.en: The last line never holds one word

distinction.zh: text-wrap:pretty；引擎侧则给末行加惩罚项。
distinction.en: text-wrap: pretty — engine-side, penalise short last lines.

items.dz: 窄栏靠断词救回来
items.de: Narrow columns need hyphens
items.pz: Liang 算法查词典给断点，最少留 2 / 3 个字母。
items.pe: Liang patterns for breakpoints; keep 2 before, 3 after.

definition.zh: 窄栏靠断词救回来
definition.en: Narrow columns need hyphens

distinction.zh: Liang 算法查词典给断点，最少留 2 / 3 个字母。
distinction.en: Liang patterns for breakpoints; keep 2 before, 3 after.

items.dz: 别让空白连成一条河
items.de: No white river down the column
items.pz: 词距惩罚 + 相邻行空隙对齐检测，必要时改断点。
items.pe: Penalise word-space stretch and detect vertically aligned gaps.

definition.zh: 别让空白连成一条河
definition.en: No white river down the column

distinction.zh: 词距惩罚 + 相邻行空隙对齐检测，必要时改断点。
distinction.en: Penalise word-space stretch and detect vertically aligned gaps.

items.dz: 排版前先量，量完一次成型
items.de: Measure first, lay out once
items.pz: canvas measureText 或一次性 Range.getClientRects，别循环读 layout。
items.pe: Use canvas measureText or one batched Range.getClientRects.

definition.zh: 排版前先量，量完一次成型
definition.en: Measure first, lay out once

distinction.zh: canvas measureText 或一次性 Range.getClientRects，别循环读 layout。
distinction.en: Use canvas measureText or one batched Range.getClientRects.

items.dz: 框贴着字，不多一像素
items.de: The box hugs the text exactly
items.pz: width:fit-content 或按最长行宽度定框，气泡才不虚胖。
items.pe: fit-content, or size the box by the longest line.

definition.zh: 框贴着字，不多一像素
definition.en: The box hugs the text exactly

distinction.zh: width:fit-content 或按最长行宽度定框，气泡才不虚胖。
distinction.en: fit-content, or size the box by the longest line.

items.dz: 字号自动缩到刚好装满
items.de: Type scales to fill exactly
items.pz: 二分字号直到测量宽高刚好不溢出，缓存结果。
items.pe: Binary-search the size until it just fits; cache the result.

definition.zh: 字号自动缩到刚好装满
definition.en: Type scales to fill exactly

distinction.zh: 二分字号直到测量宽高刚好不溢出，缓存结果。
distinction.en: Binary-search the size until it just fits; cache the result.

items.dz: 所有文字都落在同一套横线上
items.de: Every line lands on the same rails
items.pz: 行高取网格整数倍（如 4px 的 6 倍），首行做 half-leading 补偿。
items.pe: Line-height as a multiple of the grid; compensate the first line.

definition.zh: 所有文字都落在同一套横线上
definition.en: Every line lands on the same rails

distinction.zh: 行高取网格整数倍（如 4px 的 6 倍），首行做 half-leading 补偿。
distinction.en: Line-height as a multiple of the grid; compensate the first line.

items.dz: 首行上方那点多余空白要去掉
items.de: Kill the extra space above the first line
items.pz: text-box-trim / leading-trim，或用 cap-height 手算偏移。
items.pe: text-box-trim, or offset by cap-height manually.

definition.zh: 首行上方那点多余空白要去掉
definition.en: Kill the extra space above the first line

distinction.zh: text-box-trim / leading-trim，或用 cap-height 手算偏移。
distinction.en: text-box-trim, or offset by cap-height manually.

items.dz: 引号和 A 要挂到栏外一点
items.de: Quotes and A hang past the margin
items.pz: 按字形左右侧承（side bearing）负外移，别整体缩进。
items.pe: Nudge by side bearing, not by indenting the block.

definition.zh: 引号和 A 要挂到栏外一点
definition.en: Quotes and A hang past the margin

distinction.zh: 按字形左右侧承（side bearing）负外移，别整体缩进。
distinction.en: Nudge by side bearing, not by indenting the block.

items.dz: 行首标点挂出去
items.de: Leading punctuation hangs outside
items.pz: hanging-punctuation:first last，中文引号尤其需要。
items.pe: hanging-punctuation: first last — essential for CJK quotes.

definition.zh: 行首标点挂出去
definition.en: Leading punctuation hangs outside

distinction.zh: hanging-punctuation:first last，中文引号尤其需要。
distinction.en: hanging-punctuation: first last — essential for CJK quotes.

items.dz: 中文全角标点该压掉一半
items.de: Full-width punctuation gives back half its width
items.pz: text-spacing-trim 或按字形类别压缩标点前后间距。
items.pe: text-spacing-trim, or compress by punctuation class.

items.dz: 汉字与英文之间要留四分之一空
items.de: A quarter space between Han and Latin
items.pz: text-autospace / 手动插 U+2009，别用普通空格。
items.pe: text-autospace, or insert a thin space — not a normal one.

definition.zh: 汉字与英文之间要留四分之一空
definition.en: A quarter space between Han and Latin

distinction.zh: text-autospace / 手动插 U+2009，别用普通空格。
distinction.en: text-autospace, or insert a thin space — not a normal one.

items.dz: AV、To 这类组合要收紧
items.de: AV and To need pulling together
items.pz: font-kerning:normal 交给字体的 kern 表，别全局加 letter-spacing。
items.pe: font-kerning: normal — trust the font, not a global tracking value.

definition.zh: AV、To 这类组合要收紧
definition.en: AV and To need pulling together

distinction.zh: font-kerning:normal 交给字体的 kern 表，别全局加 letter-spacing。
distinction.en: font-kerning: normal — trust the font, not a global tracking value.

items.dz: 字越大字距越紧
items.de: Bigger type, tighter tracking
items.pz: letter-spacing 用 em 并随 clamp 递减：标题 -0.035em，正文 0。
items.pe: Track in em: −0.035em at display sizes, 0 in body.

definition.zh: 字越大字距越紧
definition.en: Bigger type, tighter tracking

distinction.zh: letter-spacing 用 em 并随 clamp 递减：标题 -0.035em，正文 0。
distinction.en: Track in em: −0.035em at display sizes, 0 in body.

items.dz: 用宽度轴而不是缩放
items.de: Use the width axis, not scale
items.pz: font-variation-settings 的 wdth 轴插值，字形不会变形。
items.pe: Interpolate the wdth axis so glyphs never distort.

definition.zh: 用宽度轴而不是缩放
definition.en: Use the width axis, not scale

distinction.zh: font-variation-settings 的 wdth 轴插值，字形不会变形。
distinction.en: Interpolate the wdth axis so glyphs never distort.

items.dz: 字重连续变化，不跳档
items.de: Weight moves continuously
items.pz: wght 轴可插值：400→700 之间任意值都合法。
items.pe: The wght axis is continuous — 400 → 700 with no steps.

definition.zh: 字重连续变化，不跳档
definition.en: Weight moves continuously

distinction.zh: wght 轴可插值：400→700 之间任意值都合法。
distinction.en: The wght axis is continuous — 400 → 700 with no steps.

items.dz: 小字加粗一点才看得清
items.de: Small sizes need more weight
items.pz: opsz 轴让字体自己在小号时加粗、大号时收细。
items.pe: The opsz axis thickens small text and refines display sizes.

definition.zh: 小字加粗一点才看得清
definition.en: Small sizes need more weight

distinction.zh: opsz 轴让字体自己在小号时加粗、大号时收细。
distinction.en: The opsz axis thickens small text and refines display sizes.

items.dz: 数字跳动时列不抖
items.de: Columns stop twitching
items.pz: font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums，所有会变的数字都要开。
items.pe: tabular-nums on anything that changes.

items.dz: 真小型大写不是缩小的大写
items.de: Real small caps are not shrunk capitals
items.pz: font-variant-caps:small-caps，字体没这套就别硬做。
items.pe: font-variant-caps: small-caps — skip it if the font lacks them.

definition.zh: 真小型大写不是缩小的大写
definition.en: Real small caps are not shrunk capitals

distinction.zh: font-variant-caps:small-caps，字体没这套就别硬做。
distinction.en: font-variant-caps: small-caps — skip it if the font lacks them.

items.dz: fi、ffl 要连起来
items.de: fi and ffl should join
items.pz: font-variant-ligatures:common-ligatures；等宽代码字体反而要关。
items.pe: Enable common ligatures; disable them in code faces.

definition.zh: fi、ffl 要连起来
definition.en: fi and ffl should join

distinction.zh: font-variant-ligatures:common-ligatures；等宽代码字体反而要关。
distinction.en: Enable common ligatures; disable them in code faces.

items.dz: 首字母占三行高
items.de: The first letter owns three lines
items.pz: initial-letter:3，配 initial-letter-align 对齐基线。
items.pe: initial-letter: 3 with initial-letter-align.

items.dz: 要么缩进，要么段间距，别都要
items.de: Indent or space — never both
items.pz: text-indent:1.5em 且段间距归零，是书籍排法。
items.pe: text-indent 1.5em with zero paragraph margin.

definition.zh: 要么缩进，要么段间距，别都要
definition.en: Indent or space — never both

distinction.zh: text-indent:1.5em 且段间距归零，是书籍排法。
distinction.en: text-indent 1.5em with zero paragraph margin.

items.dz: 项目符号挂在文本外
items.de: Bullets hang outside the text block
items.pz: padding-left + text-indent 负值，或 list-style-position:outside。
items.pe: Positive padding with a negative text-indent.

definition.zh: 项目符号挂在文本外
definition.en: Bullets hang outside the text block

distinction.zh: padding-left + text-indent 负值，或 list-style-position:outside。
distinction.en: Positive padding with a negative text-indent.

items.dz: 最后一栏不能空一半
items.de: The last column must not be half empty
items.pz: column-fill:balance，或计算后强制断栏。
items.pe: column-fill: balance, or force breaks after measuring.

definition.zh: 最后一栏不能空一半
definition.en: The last column must not be half empty

distinction.zh: column-fill:balance，或计算后强制断栏。
distinction.en: column-fill: balance, or force breaks after measuring.

items.dz: 别让一行孤零零跑到下一栏
items.de: No single line stranded in the next column
items.pz: orphans / widows:2，分栏与分页都生效。
items.pe: orphans and widows: 2 — works for columns and print.

definition.zh: 别让一行孤零零跑到下一栏
definition.en: No single line stranded in the next column

distinction.zh: orphans / widows:2，分栏与分页都生效。
distinction.en: orphans and widows: 2 — works for columns and print.

items.dz: 脚注跟着引用所在页
items.de: Notes stay with their reference
items.pz: 先排正文测高，再把脚注塞进剩余高度，超出则往后推。
items.pe: Lay out body first, then fit notes into the leftover height.

definition.zh: 脚注跟着引用所在页
definition.en: Notes stay with their reference

distinction.zh: 先排正文测高，再把脚注塞进剩余高度，超出则往后推。
distinction.en: Lay out body first, then fit notes into the leftover height.

items.dz: 页眉写着当前章节
items.de: The header knows its section
items.pz: 排版时记录每页首个标题，回填到页眉。
items.pe: Record the first heading per page and back-fill the header.

definition.zh: 页眉写着当前章节
definition.en: The header knows its section

distinction.zh: 排版时记录每页首个标题，回填到页眉。
distinction.en: Record the first heading per page and back-fill the header.

items.dz: 字跟着曲线走
items.de: Letters ride the curve
items.pz: SVG textPath + startOffset；每字自转要单独算切线。
items.pe: SVG textPath with startOffset; per-glyph rotation needs tangents.

definition.zh: 字跟着曲线走
definition.en: Letters ride the curve

distinction.zh: SVG textPath + startOffset；每字自转要单独算切线。
distinction.en: SVG textPath with startOffset; per-glyph rotation needs tangents.

items.dz: 一圈字围成徽章
items.de: Type wrapped into a seal
items.pz: 每字 rotate(i*360/n) + translateY(-r)，字距按弧长算。
items.pe: rotate(i · 360/n) with translateY(−r); space by arc length.

definition.zh: 一圈字围成徽章
definition.en: Type wrapped into a seal

distinction.zh: 每字 rotate(i*360/n) + translateY(-r)，字距按弧长算。
distinction.en: rotate(i · 360/n) with translateY(−r); space by arc length.

items.dz: 中文竖着读
items.de: CJK read top to bottom
items.pz: writing-mode:vertical-rl，数字用 text-combine-upright。
items.pe: writing-mode: vertical-rl; combine digits upright.

items.dz: 阿拉伯语和数字混排不乱
items.de: Arabic and digits keep their order
items.pz: dir="auto" + Unicode 隔离符 U+2068/2069，别手动反转。
items.pe: dir="auto" with isolate marks — never reverse strings by hand.

definition.zh: 阿拉伯语和数字混排不乱
definition.en: Arabic and digits keep their order

distinction.zh: dir="auto" + Unicode 隔离符 U+2068/2069，别手动反转。
distinction.en: dir="auto" with isolate marks — never reverse strings by hand.

items.dz: 窄屏行高大一点
items.de: Narrow screens need more leading
items.pz: line-height:calc(1.2 + .35*(60ch - 100%)/40ch) 之类的插值。
items.pe: Interpolate leading against the measure, not the viewport.

definition.zh: 窄屏行高大一点
definition.en: Narrow screens need more leading

distinction.zh: line-height:calc(1.2 + .35*(60ch - 100%)/40ch) 之类的插值。
distinction.en: Interpolate leading against the measure, not the viewport.

items.dz: 一行 45–75 个字符最好读
items.de: 45–75 characters per line
items.pz: max-width:65ch 是最省事的可读性修复。
items.pe: max-width: 65ch is the cheapest readability fix there is.

definition.zh: 一行 45–75 个字符最好读
definition.en: 45–75 characters per line

distinction.zh: max-width:65ch 是最省事的可读性修复。
distinction.en: max-width: 65ch is the cheapest readability fix there is.

items.dz: 换栏宽时每行弹到新位置
items.de: Lines spring to their new places
items.pz: 断行结果变化时，对每行的 y 用弹簧插值而不是重绘。
items.pe: Spring each line to its new y instead of repainting.

definition.zh: 换栏宽时每行弹到新位置
definition.en: Lines spring to their new places

distinction.zh: 断行结果变化时，对每行的 y 用弹簧插值而不是重绘。
distinction.en: Spring each line to its new y instead of repainting.

items.dz: 两个字之间连续变形
items.de: One glyph melts into another
items.pz: 同一可变字体的两个实例插值，跨字体要先做轮廓匹配。
items.pe: Interpolate two instances of one variable font.

definition.zh: 两个字之间连续变形
definition.en: One glyph melts into another

distinction.zh: 同一可变字体的两个实例插值，跨字体要先做轮廓匹配。
distinction.en: Interpolate two instances of one variable font.

items.dz: 只重排改动的那几段
items.de: Only the touched paragraphs re-lay out
items.pz: 缓存每段的断行结果，脏标记驱动局部重排。
items.pe: Cache per-paragraph breaks and re-run only the dirty ones.

definition.zh: 只重排改动的那几段
definition.en: Only the touched paragraphs re-lay out

distinction.zh: 缓存每段的断行结果，脏标记驱动局部重排。
distinction.en: Cache per-paragraph breaks and re-run only the dirty ones.

items.dz: 十万行也能秒滚
items.de: Instant scroll on 100k lines
items.pz: 按行高预估总高，只渲染可视窗口 ± 缓冲。
items.pe: Estimate total height by line height; render the window plus buffer.

definition.zh: 十万行也能秒滚
definition.en: Instant scroll on 100k lines

distinction.zh: 按行高预估总高，只渲染可视窗口 ± 缓冲。
distinction.en: Estimate total height by line height; render the window plus buffer.

items.dz: 读写分离，一帧只布局一次
items.de: Read then write, one layout per frame
items.pz: 先批量读 rect，再批量改样式，别交替。
items.pe: Batch all reads, then all writes — never interleave.

definition.zh: 读写分离，一帧只布局一次
definition.en: Read then write, one layout per frame

distinction.zh: 先批量读 rect，再批量改样式，别交替。
distinction.en: Batch all reads, then all writes — never interleave.

items.dz: 换字体不跳版
items.de: Swapping fonts must not reflow
items.pz: size-adjust + ascent-override 把回退字体对齐到主字体度量。
items.pe: size-adjust and ascent-override align the fallback metrics.

definition.zh: 换字体不跳版
definition.en: Swapping fonts must not reflow

distinction.zh: size-adjust + ascent-override 把回退字体对齐到主字体度量。
distinction.en: size-adjust and ascent-override align the fallback metrics.

items.dz: 先看得见，再变漂亮
items.de: Readable first, refined second
items.pz: font-display:swap 配度量兼容回退，CLS 才为 0。
items.pe: font-display: swap plus metric-compatible fallbacks keeps CLS at zero.

definition.zh: 先看得见，再变漂亮
definition.en: Readable first, refined second

distinction.zh: font-display:swap 配度量兼容回退，CLS 才为 0。
distinction.en: font-display: swap plus metric-compatible fallbacks keeps CLS at zero.

items.dz: 首屏只下那几十个字形
items.de: Ship only the glyphs above the fold
items.pz: unicode-range 分片 + 中文按字频分包。
items.pe: Split by unicode-range; chunk CJK by frequency.

definition.zh: 首屏只下那几十个字形
definition.en: Ship only the glyphs above the fold

distinction.zh: unicode-range 分片 + 中文按字频分包。
distinction.en: Split by unicode-range; chunk CJK by frequency.

items.dz: 小字号笔画交叉处要留缝
items.de: Tiny type needs relief at the joins
items.pz: 选带 ink trap 的字体，或用 opsz 轴代劳。
items.pe: Pick a face with ink traps, or let the opsz axis handle it.

definition.zh: 小字号笔画交叉处要留缝
definition.en: Tiny type needs relief at the joins

distinction.zh: 选带 ink trap 的字体，或用 opsz 轴代劳。
distinction.en: Pick a face with ink traps, or let the opsz axis handle it.

items.dz: 字号来自一条比例
items.de: Sizes come from one ratio
items.pz: 1.25 或 1.333 的等比数列，只用其中 5–6 级。
items.pe: A 1.25 or 1.333 ratio — use only five or six steps.

definition.zh: 字号来自一条比例
definition.en: Sizes come from one ratio

distinction.zh: 1.25 或 1.333 的等比数列，只用其中 5–6 级。
distinction.en: A 1.25 or 1.333 ratio — use only five or six steps.

items.dz: 段距是行高的整数倍
items.de: Spacing in multiples of the leading
items.pz: 所有纵向间距取 line-height 的 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 倍。
items.pe: All vertical space at 0.5×, 1× or 1.5× the leading.

definition.zh: 段距是行高的整数倍
definition.en: Spacing in multiples of the leading

distinction.zh: 所有纵向间距取 line-height 的 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 倍。
distinction.en: All vertical space at 0.5×, 1× or 1.5× the leading.

items.dz: 图标要对齐字的高度而非行盒
items.de: Icons align to cap height, not the line box
items.pz: 按 cap-height 计算偏移，别用 vertical-align:middle 敷衍。
items.pe: Offset by cap-height instead of vertical-align: middle.

definition.zh: 图标要对齐字的高度而非行盒
definition.en: Icons align to cap height, not the line box

distinction.zh: 按 cap-height 计算偏移，别用 vertical-align:middle 敷衍。
distinction.en: Offset by cap-height instead of vertical-align: middle.

items.dz: 位数变化时不推挤后面
items.de: Adding a digit must not shove the rest
items.pz: 数字容器给 min-width:Nch 并右对齐。
items.pe: Give the number min-width in ch and right-align it.

definition.zh: 位数变化时不推挤后面
definition.en: Adding a digit must not shove the rest

distinction.zh: 数字容器给 min-width:Nch 并右对齐。
distinction.en: Give the number min-width in ch and right-align it.

items.dz: 文件名要保住后缀
items.de: Keep the extension visible
items.pz: 按字符宽度从中间裁，别用 text-overflow 一刀切尾。
items.pe: Trim from the middle by measured width, not text-overflow.

definition.zh: 文件名要保住后缀
definition.en: Keep the extension visible

distinction.zh: 按字符宽度从中间裁，别用 text-overflow 一刀切尾。
distinction.en: Trim from the middle by measured width, not text-overflow.

items.dz: 第三行末尾接省略号
items.de: Ellipsis at the end of line three
items.pz: -webkit-line-clamp:3 配 overflow:hidden，行高必须固定。
items.pe: -webkit-line-clamp: 3 with a fixed line-height.

definition.zh: 第三行末尾接省略号
definition.en: Ellipsis at the end of line three

distinction.zh: -webkit-line-clamp:3 配 overflow:hidden，行高必须固定。
distinction.en: -webkit-line-clamp: 3 with a fixed line-height.

items.dz: 只在需要时才断
items.de: It only breaks when it must
items.pz: 在长复合词里插 ­，比 hyphens:auto 更可控。
items.pe: Insert soft hyphens in long compounds for precise control.

definition.zh: 只在需要时才断
definition.en: It only breaks when it must

distinction.zh: 在长复合词里插 ­，比 hyphens:auto 更可控。
distinction.en: Insert soft hyphens in long compounds for precise control.

items.dz: 数字和单位不能被拆开
items.de: Never split a number from its unit
items.pz: 3 425 ha —— 单位、姓名缩写都该用 nbsp。
items.pe: Use nbsp between value and unit, and after initials.

definition.zh: 数字和单位不能被拆开
definition.en: Never split a number from its unit

distinction.zh: 3 425 ha —— 单位、姓名缩写都该用 nbsp。
distinction.en: Use nbsp between value and unit, and after initials.

items.dz: 直引号是错的
items.de: Straight quotes are a bug
items.pz: 排版时把直引号替换成 “ ” ‘ ’，代码块除外。
items.pe: Replace straight quotes with typographic ones — outside code.

definition.zh: 直引号是错的
definition.en: Straight quotes are a bug

distinction.zh: 排版时把直引号替换成 “ ” ‘ ’，代码块除外。
distinction.en: Replace straight quotes with typographic ones — outside code.

items.dz: 连字号、短破折、长破折各有其用
items.de: Hyphen, en dash and em dash each have a job
items.pz: -连词、–范围、—插入语，中文用——占两格。
items.pe: Hyphen joins, en dash ranges, em dash interrupts.

definition.zh: 连字号、短破折、长破折各有其用
definition.en: Hyphen, en dash and em dash each have a job

distinction.zh: -连词、–范围、—插入语，中文用——占两格。
distinction.en: Hyphen joins, en dash ranges, em dash interrupts.

items.dz: 按纸张高度切页
items.de: Break by paper height
items.pz: break-inside:avoid 保护卡片，标题后禁止断页。
items.pe: break-inside: avoid on cards; no break right after a heading.

definition.zh: 按纸张高度切页
definition.en: Break by paper height

distinction.zh: break-inside:avoid 保护卡片，标题后禁止断页。
distinction.en: break-inside: avoid on cards; no break right after a heading.

items.dz: 改了哪一行看得见
items.de: You can see which line moved
items.pz: 两次断行结果做 diff，只给变化的行加过渡。
items.pe: Diff the two break solutions and transition only the changed lines.

definition.zh: 改了哪一行看得见
definition.en: You can see which line moved

distinction.zh: 两次断行结果做 diff，只给变化的行加过渡。
distinction.en: Diff the two break solutions and transition only the changed lines.

dz: 不装库也能做的那一批：WAAPI、@starting-style、anchor、popover
de: What ships in the browser — WAAPI, @starting-style, anchor, popover

items.dz: 一行 JS 起一段动效
items.de: One line of JS, one animation
items.pz: el.animate(keyframes,{duration:300,easing,fill:"both"})
items.pe: el.animate(keyframes, { duration: 300, fill: "both" })

definition.zh: 一行 JS 起一段动效
definition.en: One line of JS, one animation

distinction.zh: el.animate(keyframes,{duration:300,easing,fill:"both"})
distinction.en: el.animate(keyframes, { duration: 300, fill: "both" })

items.dz: 拿到正在跑的动效再改它
items.de: Grab what is running and retune it
items.pz: el.getAnimations({subtree:true}) 后改 playbackRate / currentTime。
items.pe: Mutate playbackRate or currentTime on the returned animations.

definition.zh: 拿到正在跑的动效再改它
definition.en: Grab what is running and retune it

distinction.zh: el.getAnimations({subtree:true}) 后改 playbackRate / currentTime。
distinction.en: Mutate playbackRate or currentTime on the returned animations.

items.dz: 等动效结束再做下一步
items.de: Await the end, then continue
items.pz: await anim.finished 比 animationend 事件可靠。
items.pe: await anim.finished beats the animationend event.

definition.zh: 等动效结束再做下一步
definition.en: Await the end, then continue

distinction.zh: await anim.finished 比 animationend 事件可靠。
distinction.en: await anim.finished beats the animationend event.

items.dz: 动效结束后保留终态
items.de: Keep the end state
items.pz: anim.commitStyles() 后 cancel()，比 fill:forwards 干净。
items.pe: commitStyles then cancel — cleaner than fill: forwards.

definition.zh: 动效结束后保留终态
definition.en: Keep the end state

distinction.zh: anim.commitStyles() 后 cancel()，比 fill:forwards 干净。
distinction.en: commitStyles then cancel — cleaner than fill: forwards.

items.dz: 同一段动效可快可慢可倒放
items.de: Same beat, any speed or direction
items.pz: anim.playbackRate=-1 就是倒放，UI 收起最常用。
items.pe: playbackRate −1 reverses — ideal for closing states.

definition.zh: 同一段动效可快可慢可倒放
definition.en: Same beat, any speed or direction

distinction.zh: anim.playbackRate=-1 就是倒放，UI 收起最常用。
distinction.en: playbackRate −1 reverses — ideal for closing states.

items.dz: 中途打断就原路返回
items.de: Interrupt and it retraces
items.pz: anim.reverse() 从当前进度反向，不会跳。
items.pe: reverse() runs back from the current time — no jump.

definition.zh: 中途打断就原路返回
definition.en: Interrupt and it retraces

distinction.zh: anim.reverse() 从当前进度反向，不会跳。
distinction.en: reverse() runs back from the current time — no jump.

items.dz: 多个元素严格同步
items.de: Several elements, one clock
items.pz: 多个 animation 共用 timeline 与 startTime。
items.pe: Share one timeline and startTime across animations.

definition.zh: 多个元素严格同步
definition.en: Several elements, one clock

distinction.zh: 多个 animation 共用 timeline 与 startTime。
distinction.en: Share one timeline and startTime across animations.

items.dz: 刚出现的元素也能有过渡
items.de: Even newly added elements transition
items.pz: @starting-style 给初次渲染值，配 transition-behavior。
items.pe: @starting-style supplies the first-render value.

definition.zh: 刚出现的元素也能有过渡
definition.en: Even newly added elements transition

distinction.zh: @starting-style 给初次渲染值，配 transition-behavior。
distinction.en: @starting-style supplies the first-render value.

items.dz: display 与 visibility 也能过渡
items.de: Even display can transition
items.pz: transition-behavior:allow-discrete，配 @starting-style 才完整。
items.pe: allow-discrete plus @starting-style completes the pattern.

definition.zh: display 与 visibility 也能过渡
definition.en: Even display can transition

distinction.zh: transition-behavior:allow-discrete，配 @starting-style 才完整。
distinction.en: allow-discrete plus @starting-style completes the pattern.

items.dz: 不写 JS 也能有浮层
items.de: Overlays without JS
items.pz: popover + popovertarget，自带 top-layer 与 ESC 关闭。
items.pe: popover with popovertarget gives you the top layer and ESC.

definition.zh: 不写 JS 也能有浮层
definition.en: Overlays without JS

distinction.zh: popover + popovertarget，自带 top-layer 与 ESC 关闭。
distinction.en: popover with popovertarget gives you the top layer and ESC.

items.dz: 焦点陷阱和遮罩都自带
items.de: Focus trap and scrim included
items.pz: showModal() + ::backdrop 过渡，别再手搓遮罩。
items.pe: showModal() with a ::backdrop transition.

definition.zh: 焦点陷阱和遮罩都自带
definition.en: Focus trap and scrim included

distinction.zh: showModal() + ::backdrop 过渡，别再手搓遮罩。
distinction.en: showModal() with a ::backdrop transition.

items.dz: 浮层贴着触发器，自动避让
items.de: The overlay sticks to its trigger
items.pz: anchor-name + position-anchor + position-try-fallbacks。
items.pe: anchor-name, position-anchor and position-try-fallbacks.

definition.zh: 浮层贴着触发器，自动避让
definition.en: The overlay sticks to its trigger

distinction.zh: anchor-name + position-anchor + position-try-fallbacks。
distinction.en: anchor-name, position-anchor and position-try-fallbacks.

items.dz: 整页切换由浏览器补间
items.de: The browser tweens the page swap
items.pz: startViewTransition + ::view-transition-group 自定义曲线。
items.pe: startViewTransition, then style ::view-transition-group.

items.dz: 前进和后退用不同过渡
items.de: Forward and back differ
items.pz: startViewTransition({types:["forward"]}) 后按类型写 CSS。
items.pe: Pass types, then branch the CSS on them.

definition.zh: 前进和后退用不同过渡
definition.en: Forward and back differ

distinction.zh: startViewTransition({types:["forward"]}) 后按类型写 CSS。
distinction.en: Pass types, then branch the CSS on them.

items.dz: 让自定义属性可以被补间
items.de: Custom properties become animatable
items.pz: @property --x{syntax:"<length>";inherits:false;initial-value:0px}
items.pe: @property declares the syntax so it can interpolate.

definition.zh: 让自定义属性可以被补间
definition.en: Custom properties become animatable

distinction.zh: @property --x{syntax:"<length>";inherits:false;initial-value:0px}
distinction.en: @property declares the syntax so it can interpolate.

items.dz: 渐变本身在动
items.de: The gradient stop itself moves
items.pz: 把色标位置声明为 @property 的 <percentage>。
items.pe: Declare the stop position as a typed percentage.

definition.zh: 渐变本身在动
definition.en: The gradient stop itself moves

distinction.zh: 把色标位置声明为 @property 的 <percentage>。
distinction.en: Declare the stop position as a typed percentage.

items.dz: 锥形渐变可以真的转
items.de: A conic gradient that really turns
items.pz: @property --a{syntax:"<angle>"} 后直接 animate。
items.pe: Type the angle and animate it directly.

definition.zh: 锥形渐变可以真的转
definition.en: A conic gradient that really turns

distinction.zh: @property --a{syntax:"<angle>"} 后直接 animate。
distinction.en: Type the angle and animate it directly.

items.dz: 按容器宽度换布局
items.de: Layout by container, not viewport
items.pz: container-type:inline-size 后写 @container 断点。
items.pe: container-type: inline-size, then @container rules.

items.dz: 字号跟着容器不是视口
items.de: Type scales to its container
items.pz: cqi / cqb 单位，卡片复用时不会崩。
items.pe: cqi and cqb keep reusable cards sane.

definition.zh: 字号跟着容器不是视口
definition.en: Type scales to its container

distinction.zh: cqi / cqb 单位，卡片复用时不会崩。
distinction.en: cqi and cqb keep reusable cards sane.

items.dz: 子元素状态影响父层样式
items.de: A child state restyles the parent
items.pz: .card:has(:focus-visible){...} 不用 JS 加 class。
items.pe: .card:has(:focus-visible) — no class toggling needed.

definition.zh: 子元素状态影响父层样式
definition.en: A child state restyles the parent

distinction.zh: .card:has(:focus-visible){...} 不用 JS 加 class。
distinction.en: .card:has(:focus-visible) — no class toggling needed.

items.dz: 状态样式写在一起
items.de: States live with the rule
items.pz: 原生嵌套 + &:hover，别再靠预处理器。
items.pe: Native nesting with &:hover — no preprocessor.

definition.zh: 状态样式写在一起
definition.en: States live with the rule

distinction.zh: 原生嵌套 + &:hover，别再靠预处理器。
distinction.en: Native nesting with &:hover — no preprocessor.

items.dz: 样式只在一段 DOM 里生效
items.de: Styles bounded to a subtree
items.pz: @scope (.card) to (.content) 精确划边界。
items.pe: @scope (.card) to (.content) draws the boundary.

definition.zh: 样式只在一段 DOM 里生效
definition.en: Styles bounded to a subtree

distinction.zh: @scope (.card) to (.content) 精确划边界。
distinction.en: @scope (.card) to (.content) draws the boundary.

items.dz: 覆盖顺序变成显式的
items.de: Override order becomes explicit
items.pz: @layer reset,base,components,utilities 一次定完。
items.pe: Declare the layer order once, up front.

definition.zh: 覆盖顺序变成显式的
definition.en: Override order becomes explicit

distinction.zh: @layer reset,base,components,utilities 一次定完。
distinction.en: Declare the layer order once, up front.

items.dz: 同一色系自动派生
items.de: Derive a whole ramp from one colour
items.pz: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 70%, white) 生成浅色态。
items.pe: color-mix in oklab derives tints and shades.

definition.zh: 同一色系自动派生
definition.en: Derive a whole ramp from one colour

distinction.zh: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 70%, white) 生成浅色态。
distinction.en: color-mix in oklab derives tints and shades.

items.dz: 从一个色算出整套
items.de: One token, a whole scale
items.pz: oklch(from var(--c) calc(l + .1) c h) 派生更可控。
items.pe: oklch(from …) derives with real control.

items.dz: 一行搞定双主题
items.de: Both themes in one declaration
items.pz: color:light-dark(#3a5f7a,#eef4f8)，配 color-scheme。
items.pe: light-dark() with color-scheme set.

definition.zh: 一行搞定双主题
definition.en: Both themes in one declaration

distinction.zh: color:light-dark(#3a5f7a,#eef4f8)，配 color-scheme。
distinction.en: light-dark() with color-scheme set.

items.dz: 原生控件也跟品牌色
items.de: Native controls take the brand colour
items.pz: accent-color:#e8879c 一行改掉勾选框与滑块。
items.pe: accent-color restyles checkboxes and ranges in one line.

definition.zh: 原生控件也跟品牌色
definition.en: Native controls take the brand colour

distinction.zh: accent-color:#e8879c 一行改掉勾选框与滑块。
distinction.en: accent-color restyles checkboxes and ranges in one line.

items.dz: 输入框跟着内容长
items.de: The input grows with its content
items.pz: field-sizing:content，配 max-inline-size 兜底。
items.pe: field-sizing: content with a max-inline-size cap.

definition.zh: 输入框跟着内容长
definition.en: The input grows with its content

distinction.zh: field-sizing:content，配 max-inline-size 兜底。
distinction.en: field-sizing: content with a max-inline-size cap.

items.dz: 标题均衡、正文避免孤字
items.de: balance for titles, pretty for body
items.pz: 标题 balance，正文 pretty，其他别乱用。
items.pe: balance for headings, pretty for prose.

definition.zh: 标题均衡、正文避免孤字
definition.en: balance for titles, pretty for body

distinction.zh: 标题 balance，正文 pretty，其他别乱用。
distinction.en: balance for headings, pretty for prose.

items.dz: 卡片内部也对齐外层网格
items.de: Card innards align to the outer grid
items.pz: grid-template-rows:subgrid，让卡片各行严格对齐。
items.pe: subgrid keeps every card row on the same rails.

definition.zh: 卡片内部也对齐外层网格
definition.en: Card innards align to the outer grid

distinction.zh: grid-template-rows:subgrid，让卡片各行严格对齐。
distinction.en: subgrid keeps every card row on the same rails.

items.dz: 媒体位提前占好，不跳版
items.de: Reserve the box, no shift
items.pz: aspect-ratio:16/9 + object-fit:cover 是标配。
items.pe: aspect-ratio with object-fit: cover.

definition.zh: 媒体位提前占好，不跳版
definition.en: Reserve the box, no shift

distinction.zh: aspect-ratio:16/9 + object-fit:cover 是标配。
distinction.en: aspect-ratio with object-fit: cover.

items.dz: 背景内容彻底不可交互
items.de: The background truly goes cold
items.pz: 打开浮层时给主内容加 inert，比 tabindex=-1 彻底。
items.pe: Mark the page inert behind an overlay.

definition.zh: 背景内容彻底不可交互
definition.en: The background truly goes cold

distinction.zh: 打开浮层时给主内容加 inert，比 tabindex=-1 彻底。
distinction.en: Mark the page inert behind an overlay.

items.dz: 只给键盘用户看焦点环
items.de: The ring is for keyboard users
items.pz: 别用 outline:none；鼠标点击不会触发它。
items.pe: Never outline: none — mouse clicks do not trigger it.

definition.zh: 只给键盘用户看焦点环
definition.en: The ring is for keyboard users

distinction.zh: 别用 outline:none；鼠标点击不会触发它。
distinction.en: Never outline: none — mouse clicks do not trigger it.

items.dz: 吸顶后自动换样式
items.de: Stuck elements restyle themselves
items.pz: @container scroll-state(stuck:top) 里改阴影与高度。
items.pe: @container scroll-state(stuck: top) — no scroll listener.

definition.zh: 吸顶后自动换样式
definition.en: Stuck elements restyle themselves

distinction.zh: @container scroll-state(stuck:top) 里改阴影与高度。
distinction.en: @container scroll-state(stuck: top) — no scroll listener.

items.dz: 轮播圆点由 CSS 生成
items.de: CSS generates the carousel dots
items.pz: scroll-marker-group + ::scroll-marker，无需 JS 同步。
items.pe: scroll-marker-group keeps the dots in sync for free.

definition.zh: 轮播圆点由 CSS 生成
definition.en: CSS generates the carousel dots

distinction.zh: scroll-marker-group + ::scroll-marker，无需 JS 同步。
distinction.en: scroll-marker-group keeps the dots in sync for free.

items.dz: 前后翻页按钮自带状态
items.de: Prev and next know when to disable
items.pz: ::scroll-button(left/right) 自动处理禁用态。
items.pe: ::scroll-button handles its own disabled state.

definition.zh: 前后翻页按钮自带状态
definition.en: Prev and next know when to disable

distinction.zh: ::scroll-button(left/right) 自动处理禁用态。
distinction.en: ::scroll-button handles its own disabled state.

items.dz: 一个展开另一个自动收起
items.de: Opening one closes the rest
items.pz: 给多个 <details> 同一个 name 属性即可。
items.pe: Give several <details> the same name.

definition.zh: 一个展开另一个自动收起
definition.en: Opening one closes the rest

distinction.zh: 给多个 <details> 同一个 name 属性即可。
distinction.en: Give several <details> the same name.

items.dz: 展开有过渡不是硬跳
items.de: Disclosure gets a transition
items.pz: interpolate-size:allow-keywords 让 height:auto 可过渡。
items.pe: interpolate-size makes height: auto transitionable.

definition.zh: 展开有过渡不是硬跳
definition.en: Disclosure gets a transition

distinction.zh: interpolate-size:allow-keywords 让 height:auto 可过渡。
distinction.en: interpolate-size makes height: auto transitionable.

items.dz: 对 auto 也能做数学
items.de: Maths on auto
items.pz: height:calc-size(auto, size + 12px)。
items.pe: height: calc-size(auto, size + 12px).

definition.zh: 对 auto 也能做数学
definition.en: Maths on auto

distinction.zh: height:calc-size(auto, size + 12px)。
distinction.en: height: calc-size(auto, size + 12px).

items.dz: 手机地址栏收起时不跳
items.de: No jump when the URL bar hides
items.pz: 首屏高度用 dvh，固定元素用 svh 更稳。
items.pe: dvh for hero height, svh for fixed chrome.

definition.zh: 手机地址栏收起时不跳
definition.en: No jump when the URL bar hides

distinction.zh: 首屏高度用 dvh，固定元素用 svh 更稳。
distinction.en: dvh for hero height, svh for fixed chrome.

items.dz: 刘海和小白条都躲开
items.de: Clear the notch and the home bar
items.pz: padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + viewport-fit=cover。
items.pe: env(safe-area-inset-*) with viewport-fit=cover.

items.dz: 关键操作给一下轻震
items.de: A short tick on commit
items.pz: navigator.vibrate(10)，只在确认类操作上用。
items.pe: navigator.vibrate(10) — commits only.

items.dz: 调起系统分享面板
items.de: Bring up the system sheet
items.pz: navigator.share({title,url})，必须由用户手势触发。
items.pe: navigator.share must come from a user gesture.

definition.zh: 调起系统分享面板
definition.en: Bring up the system sheet

distinction.zh: navigator.share({title,url})，必须由用户手势触发。
distinction.en: navigator.share must come from a user gesture.

items.dz: 未读数落在图标上
items.de: Unread count on the icon
items.pz: navigator.setAppBadge(n)，清零别忘。
items.pe: navigator.setAppBadge(n) — and clear it.

definition.zh: 未读数落在图标上
definition.en: Unread count on the icon

distinction.zh: navigator.setAppBadge(n)，清零别忘。
distinction.en: navigator.setAppBadge(n) — and clear it.

items.dz: 点之前就已经加载好了
items.de: Loaded before the click
items.pz: <script type="speculationrules"> 声明 prerender 候选。
items.pe: Declare prerender candidates in speculationrules.

definition.zh: 点之前就已经加载好了
definition.en: Loaded before the click

distinction.zh: <script type="speculationrules"> 声明 prerender 候选。
distinction.en: Declare prerender candidates in speculationrules.

items.dz: 有人真的会因为动效难受
items.de: Motion makes some people ill
items.pz: 默认无动效、逐步增强，比反过来安全。
items.pe: Design motion-free first, then enhance.

definition.zh: 有人真的会因为动效难受
definition.en: Motion makes some people ill

distinction.zh: 默认无动效、逐步增强，比反过来安全。
distinction.en: Design motion-free first, then enhance.

items.dz: 高对比下加粗边界
items.de: Stronger borders under high contrast
items.pz: 别只靠颜色区分状态，加形状或边框。
items.pe: Never encode state in colour alone.

definition.zh: 高对比下加粗边界
definition.en: Stronger borders under high contrast

distinction.zh: 别只靠颜色区分状态，加形状或边框。
distinction.en: Never encode state in colour alone.

items.dz: 系统高对比主题下还能看
items.de: Survives forced-colors mode
items.pz: 关键边框用 CanvasText，别写死颜色。
items.pe: Use system colour keywords for critical borders.

definition.zh: 系统高对比主题下还能看
definition.en: Survives forced-colors mode

distinction.zh: 关键边框用 CanvasText，别写死颜色。
distinction.en: Use system colour keywords for critical borders.

items.dz: 别给几百个元素都加
items.de: Do not hint hundreds of nodes
items.pz: 每屏最多 2–3 个提升层，用完就撤。
items.pe: Two or three promoted layers per screen, then remove.

definition.zh: 别给几百个元素都加
definition.en: Do not hint hundreds of nodes

distinction.zh: 每屏最多 2–3 个提升层，用完就撤。
distinction.en: Two or three promoted layers per screen, then remove.

items.dz: 把重绘关在一个盒子里
items.de: Repaints stay in the box
items.pz: contain:paint layout style 能砍掉大量无关重排。
items.pe: contain: paint layout style cuts unrelated reflow.

definition.zh: 把重绘关在一个盒子里
definition.en: Repaints stay in the box

distinction.zh: contain:paint layout style 能砍掉大量无关重排。
distinction.en: contain: paint layout style cuts unrelated reflow.

items.dz: 只动 transform / opacity / filter
items.de: Transform, opacity, filter — nothing else
items.pz: 动 width / top / box-shadow 会每帧重排重绘。
items.pe: Animating width or top forces layout every frame.

definition.zh: 只动 transform / opacity / filter
definition.en: Transform, opacity, filter — nothing else

distinction.zh: 动 width / top / box-shadow 会每帧重排重绘。
distinction.en: Animating width or top forces layout every frame.

items.dz: 背景由代码画出来
items.de: The background is a program
items.pz: registerPaint 后 background:paint(myPattern)。
items.pe: registerPaint, then background: paint(name).

definition.zh: 背景由代码画出来
definition.en: The background is a program

distinction.zh: registerPaint 后 background:paint(myPattern)。
distinction.en: registerPaint, then background: paint(name).

items.dz: 自己定义两个状态怎么过渡
items.de: Define your own tween
items.pz: @property + 自定义属性驱动多个声明同步变化。
items.pe: One typed property can drive several declarations.

definition.zh: 自己定义两个状态怎么过渡
definition.en: Define your own tween

distinction.zh: @property + 自定义属性驱动多个声明同步变化。
distinction.en: One typed property can drive several declarations.

items.dz: 触屏就别做悬停效果
items.de: No hover effects on touch
items.pz: @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) 才挂 hover。
items.pe: Gate hover behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

definition.zh: 触屏就别做悬停效果
definition.en: No hover effects on touch

distinction.zh: @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) 才挂 hover。
distinction.en: Gate hover behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

items.dz: 监听任意元素盒子尺寸变化（不限于窗口）。
items.de: Observes any element box, not just the window.
items.pz: ResizeObserver 回调直接给你 contentRect；容器查询之前的事实标准。说「观察元素尺寸」即此。
items.pe: contentRect in the callback.

definition.zh: ResizeObserver 在被观察元素的盒子尺寸变化时异步回调（entries 含 contentRect/contentBoxSize），覆盖窗口变化、内容撑开、折叠面板等所有来源。
definition.en: Observes any element box, not just the window.

distinction.zh: 与 window.resize 的区别：resize 只报窗口事件且需手动量元素；与表类条目（table/resize-observer、responsive/resize-observer）的区别：那些是其应用效果。
distinction.en: Element-level observation vs window.resize, which only reports the window.

items.dz: 监听 DOM 树的增删改与属性变化。
items.de: Watches DOM tree mutations.
items.pz: 第三方组件注入、广告清理、无障碍树同步都靠它；批量回调防抖动。说「监听 DOM」即此。
items.pe: Batched mutation records.

definition.zh: MutationObserver 监听子树/属性/文本变更，以 MutationRecord 数组批量异步回调。
definition.en: Watches DOM tree mutations.

distinction.zh: 与轮询 DOM 的区别：零轮询成本且不丢事件；与 IntersectionObserver 的区别：那是几何交叉，这是结构变化。
distinction.en: Structural mutations, batched; IntersectionObserver watches geometry instead.

items.dz: 订阅 LCP/CLS/longtask 等性能条目流。
items.de: Subscribes to performance entry streams.
items.pz: PerformanceObserver(e=>…).observe({type:"largest-contentful-paint"})。说「订阅性能条目」即此。
items.pe: Streaming entries by type.

definition.zh: PerformanceObserver 订阅各类性能条目（LCP/CLS/longtask/event/resource…）的实时流，替代轮询 performance.getEntries。
definition.en: Subscribes to performance entry streams.

distinction.zh: 与 performance.now 的区别：那是取时间戳，这是订阅条目流；与 RUM SDK 的区别：SDK 内部就用它采集。
distinction.en: Streaming entry subscription vs polling performance.getEntries.

items.dz: 鼠标/触摸/笔统一的指针事件流与捕获。
items.de: One event model for mouse, touch and pen.
items.pz: pointerdown/move/up + setPointerCapture：拖拽一次写对所有输入。说「Pointer Events」即此。
items.pe: One handler, every input.

definition.zh: Pointer Events 将鼠标/触摸/笔统一为 pointer 事件流（含 pointerId、压力、倾斜），setPointerCapture 保证拖拽不丢事件。
definition.en: One event model for mouse, touch and pen.

distinction.zh: 与 mouse 事件的区别：mouse 触摸时序不同且无笔压；与 touch 事件的区别：touch 不含鼠标。统一模型省掉双写。
distinction.en: One unified model; mouse and touch events each miss the other inputs.

items.dz: HTML5 原生拖放：draggable + dataTransfer。
items.de: Native dragging with dataTransfer payloads.
items.pz: dragstart 设置 dataTransfer.setData，drop 处读取——文件拖入上传区。说「原生拖放」即此。
items.pe: Payload rides in dataTransfer.

definition.zh: HTML DnD 以 draggable 属性 + dragstart/dragover/drop 事件 + dataTransfer 数据载荷构成原生拖放协议。
definition.en: Native dragging with dataTransfer payloads.

distinction.zh: 与 Pointer Events 手写拖拽的区别：原生 DnD 自带系统级文件拖入/跨窗口语义；手写则完全自控视觉。
distinction.en: Native DnD carries system file semantics; pointer-driven drags are fully custom.

items.dz: 把元素（非页面）提升到全屏。
items.de: Promotes an element to fullscreen.
items.pz: el.requestFullscreen() + :fullscreen 伪类样式；Esc 退出。说「元素全屏」即此。
items.pe: The element goes fullscreen, not the page.

definition.zh: Fullscreen API 以 requestFullscreen 将指定元素铺满屏幕，配套 :fullscreen 伪类与 fullscreenchange 事件。
definition.en: Promotes an element to fullscreen.

distinction.zh: 与 F11 的区别：F11 全屏整个页面，API 只全屏一个元素（视频/画布/图表），且需要用户手势与权限策略。
distinction.en: Element-level fullscreen; F11 takes the whole page.

items.dz: 视频悬浮小窗：离开页面继续播放。
items.de: A floating always-on-top video window.
items.pz: video.requestPictureInPicture()；leavepictureinpicture 回到主页面。说「画中画」即此。
items.pe: The video floats above everything.

definition.zh: Picture-in-Picture 让视频元素进入系统级悬浮小窗，切走标签页也持续播放。
definition.en: A floating always-on-top video window.

distinction.zh: 与 fullscreen 的区别：全屏占满视口，PiP 悬浮于一切窗口之上；与 Document PiP 的区别：后者是整个文档。
distinction.en: PiP floats above the OS; fullscreen fills the viewport.

items.dz: 物理像素与 CSS 像素之比：锐度的根本参数。
items.de: The physical-to-CSS pixel ratio.
items.pz: dpr=2 时 100px 元素占 200 物理像素；canvas 按 dpr 放大才不糊。说「按 dpr 画」即此。
items.pe: Scale canvases by dpr or blur.

definition.zh: devicePixelRatio 返回物理像素与 CSS 像素之比（随缩放/跨屏变化），位图资源与 canvas 尺寸须乘以它。
definition.en: The physical-to-CSS pixel ratio.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS 像素的区别：CSS px 是抽象单位；位图只懂物理像素——不乘 dpr 就是模糊的根源。
distinction.en: Physical pixels vs CSS pixels; unscaled bitmaps are the blur source.

items.dz: 缩放/软键盘造成的「真正可见区域」。
items.de: The actually-visible region under pinch and keyboard.
items.pz: window.visualViewport.height/offsetTop：键盘弹起后仍知道哪 30% 可见。说「可视视口」即此。
items.pe: Keyboard shrinks it; visualViewport knows.

definition.zh: visualViewport 暴露捏合缩放与软键盘挤压后真正可见的区域（offset/ scale），并可监听其变化。
definition.en: The actually-visible region under pinch and keyboard.

distinction.zh: 与 layout viewport 的区别：布局视口不变（媒体查询用），可视视口随手势变化；fixed 元素跟随前者。
distinction.en: visualViewport tracks pinch/keyboard; layout viewport stays fixed for media queries.

items.dz: JS 里实时求值与订阅媒体查询。
items.de: Evaluate and subscribe to media queries from JS.
items.pz: matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener——断点/偏好变化实时响应。说「matchMedia」即此。
items.pe: Subscribe, don't poll.

definition.zh: matchMedia 返回 MediaQueryList：matches 实时求值，change 事件在断点跨越时触发。
definition.en: Evaluate and subscribe to media queries from JS.

distinction.zh: 与 @media 的区别：@media 是 CSS 内分支；matchMedia 把同样的条件逻辑给 JS（且监听变化）。
distinction.en: Subscribable media conditions from JS; @media is CSS-internal branching.

items.dz: Web Audio 的实时频域/时域数据出口。
items.de: Real-time spectrum data from Web Audio.
items.pz: AnalyserNode.getByteFrequencyData 画频谱条；AudioContext 起点在用户手势。说「音频可视化」即此。
items.pe: getByteFrequencyData into bars.

definition.zh: AnalyserNode 输出实时频率域（FFT）与时域数据，供 canvas/WebGL 可视化。
definition.en: Real-time spectrum data from Web Audio.

distinction.zh: 与直接播放的区别：analyser 是旁路探针（不影响输出），常与 MediaElementSource 相接。
distinction.en: A bypass probe of the audio graph; it never alters the output.

items.dz: 浏览器内置 TTS：网页可以开口说话。
items.de: The browser speaks: built-in TTS.
items.pz: speechSynthesis.speak(new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text))——无障碍朗读、陪读模式。说「网页朗读」即此。
items.pe: Zero-cost screen-reader-adjacent TTS.

definition.zh: SpeechSynthesis 以 utterance 队列驱动系统 TTS：可选 voice/rate/pitch，伴随 start/end 事件。
definition.en: The browser speaks: built-in TTS.

distinction.zh: 与 Web Speech Recognition 的区别：一个 TTS 一个 ASR；与无障碍阅读器的区别：那是用户侧工具，TTS 是页面主动发声。
distinction.en: TTS output; SpeechRecognition is the input direction.

items.dz: 浏览器语音转文字（实验性）。
items.de: Speech to text in the browser (experimental).
items.pz: webkitSpeechRecognition interimResults 实时上屏——语音输入框。说「网页听写」即此。
items.pe: Interim results stream as you talk.

definition.zh: SpeechRecognition（webkit 前缀）将麦克风语音流式转为文本，interimResults 提供中间结果。
definition.en: Speech to text in the browser (experimental).

distinction.zh: 与 speechSynthesis 的方向相反（ASR vs TTS）；与 WebGPU/云 ASR 的区别：本 API 由浏览器/系统引擎执行。
distinction.en: ASR input; SpeechSynthesis is output.

items.dz: 轮询手柄按键与摇杆轴值。
items.de: Poll gamepad buttons and axes.
items.pz: navigator.getGamepads() 每帧轮询：axes[0/1] 左摇杆、buttons[0] A 键。说「手柄」即此。
items.pe: Poll per frame, not events.

definition.zh: Gamepad API 通过 getGamepads() 轮询连接的手柄：按钮按下值与摇杆轴值（-1..1）。
definition.en: Poll gamepad buttons and axes.

distinction.zh: 与键盘事件的区别：手柄是状态轮询模型（无事件流），需在 rAF 中读取；连接/断开有事件。
distinction.en: Polling state model, not events; keyboard is event-driven.

items.dz: 异步读写剪贴板（文本/图像）。
items.de: Async clipboard read and write.
items.pz: navigator.clipboard.writeText(t) 复制；read() 需权限。说「异步剪贴板」即此。
items.pe: Async, permission-gated.

definition.zh: Clipboard API（navigator.clipboard）异步读写文本/图像，需用户手势与权限授权。
definition.en: Async clipboard read and write.

distinction.zh: 与 document.execCommand 的区别：execCommand 已废弃且同步；Clipboard API 是 promise 化的标准接口。
distinction.en: Promise-based and permission-gated; execCommand is deprecated and synchronous.

items.dz: 防止屏幕熄灭（食谱/导航场景）。
items.de: Keep the screen awake legitimately.
items.pz: navigator.wakeLock.request("screen")——演示/菜谱/健身跟练。说「保持常亮」即此。
items.pe: Request, release, reacquire on visibility.

definition.zh: Screen Wake Lock 阻止屏幕自动熄灭；页面隐藏时锁自动释放，回前台需重新申请。
definition.en: Keep the screen awake legitimately.

distinction.zh: 与常亮硬件 API 的区别：仅作用于浏览器可见期间的屏幕；是节能合规的显式申请机制。
distinction.en: Explicit screen-awake requests auto-released on hide; no hardware-wide control.

items.dz: 读取/锁定屏幕旋转状态。
items.de: Read and lock screen rotation.
items.pz: screen.orientation.type/angle + lock("landscape")——横屏游戏。说「锁横屏」即此。
items.pe: Type, angle, and lock.

definition.zh: Screen Orientation API 暴露当前朝向（type/angle）并允许全屏条件下锁定为指定朝向。
definition.en: Read and lock screen rotation.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS media orientation 的区别：媒体查询只读；本 API 可写（lock），且给 change 事件。
distinction.en: Writable rotation lock; media orientation queries are read-only.

items.dz: 陀螺仪三轴角度驱动视差与 360 全景。
items.de: Gyroscope angles drive parallax and panoramas.
items.pz: deviceorientation 的 alpha/beta/gamma 驱动全景图视角。说「陀螺仪视差」即此。
items.pe: Alpha, beta, gamma.

definition.zh: DeviceOrientationEvent 提供设备的 alpha（罗盘）/beta（前后倾）/gamma（左右倾）角度。
definition.en: Gyroscope angles drive parallax and panoramas.

distinction.zh: 与 DeviceMotionEvent 的区别：orientation 给姿态角，motion 给加速度；iOS 需用户手势显式授权。
distinction.en: Posture angles; DeviceMotionEvent reports accelerations instead.

items.dz: 经用户授权获取经纬度（含 watching）。
items.de: Permissioned lat/lng, once or watched.
items.pz: getCurrentPosition/watchPosition + accuracy；必须 HTTPS + 授权。说「定位」即此。
items.pe: Permission first, always.

definition.zh: Geolocation API 在用户授权下提供经纬度与精度（米），支持一次性获取与持续 watch。
definition.en: Permissioned lat/lng, once or watched.

distinction.zh: 与 IP 定位的区别：GPS/WiFi 定位精度高但需授权；watchPosition 持续追踪耗电明显。
distinction.en: GPS/WiFi accuracy under permission; IP lookup is coarse and implicit.

items.dz: 把消息发到操作系统通知中心。
items.de: Post messages to the OS notification center.
items.pz: Notification.requestPermission()→new Notification(title,{body})。说「系统通知」即此。
items.pe: Beyond the tab, into the OS.

definition.zh: Notifications API 在授权后向操作系统通知中心发布通知（可在页面关闭时由 Service Worker 触发）。
definition.en: Post messages to the OS notification center.

distinction.zh: 与页面内 toast 的区别：toast 只在页面内，notification 进入系统层并可达离线场景。
distinction.en: OS-level posts reachable offline; in-page toasts die with the tab.

items.dz: 知道页面是否在前台、用户是否切走。
items.de: Know whether the page is actually visible.
items.pz: document.visibilityState + visibilitychange：切后台暂停动画/视频。说「前台后台」即此。
items.pe: Pause when hidden, resume on return.

definition.zh: Page Visibility API 以 visibilityState（visible/hidden）与 visibilitychange 事件报告页面前台状态。
definition.en: Know whether the page is actually visible.

distinction.zh: 与 blur/focus 的区别：blur 是元素焦点，visibility 是页面级可见性；节流动画/上报都以前者为准。
distinction.en: Page-level visibility; blur/focus is element focus.

items.dz: localStorage/sessionStorage 的键值持久化。
items.de: Key-value persistence in the browser.
items.pz: localStorage.setItem/getItem（同源持久 5MB）+ storage 事件跨页签同步。说「本地存取」即此。
items.pe: Same-origin key-value with events.

definition.zh: Web Storage 提供 localStorage（持久）与 sessionStorage（会话）的同源键值存储，storage 事件跨页签广播变更。
definition.en: Key-value persistence in the browser.

distinction.zh: 与 IndexedDB 的区别：Storage 是小体量同步字符串 KV；IndexedDB 是异步结构化数据库。
distinction.en: Synchronous small-string KV; IndexedDB is async structured data.

items.dz: 深拷贝含循环引用的复杂数据（Date/Map/ArrayBuffer）。
items.de: Deep-clone cyclic rich data.
items.pz: structuredClone(obj)：比 JSON.parse(JSON.stringify) 强得多（Map/Set/循环/类型化数组）。说「结构化克隆」即此。
items.pe: JSON could never do this.

definition.zh: structuredClone 按结构化克隆算法深拷贝对象：支持 Map/Set/Date/ArrayBuffer/循环引用，不支持函数与 DOM 节点。
definition.en: Deep-clone cyclic rich data.

distinction.zh: 与 JSON 往返的区别：JSON 丢类型/丢循环/把 Date 变字符串；与 shallow spread 的区别：那是浅拷贝。
distinction.en: Deep clone with cycles and typed arrays; JSON round-trips lose all of that.

items.dz: 无刷新改 URL 与导航栈（SPA 路由的根基）。
items.de: URL changes without navigation: SPA routing's base.
items.pz: pushState/replaceState + popstate 事件：前后端同构路由。说「改地址不跳页」即此。
items.pe: pushState + popstate = router.

definition.zh: History API 的 pushState/replaceState 修改地址栏与历史栈而不触发导航，popstate 事件响应用户前进/后退。
definition.en: URL changes without navigation: SPA routing's base.

distinction.zh: 与 location.href 的区别：赋值 href 会真正导航；pushState 保持页面状态，由路由器接管渲染。
distinction.en: pushState edits the URL without navigation; location.href navigates for real.

items.dz: 把 URL 当对象解析与构造。
items.de: URLs as first-class objects.
items.pz: new URL(s, base).searchParams.get("q")——查询参数/路径段/协议零手写解析。说「URL 对象」即此。
items.pe: searchParams over string.split.

definition.zh: URL API 将地址解析为协议/host/path/searchParams 等结构化字段，支持相对解析与序列化。
definition.en: URLs as first-class objects.

distinction.zh: 与正则解析的区别：URL API 处理编码/IDN/相对路径等边界正确；searchParams 自动 URL 编解码。
distinction.en: Structured parsing with correct encoding; regex URL parsing breaks on edge cases.

items.dz: 字符串与 UTF-8 字节序列的双向转换。
items.de: Strings to UTF-8 bytes and back.
items.pz: new TextEncoder().encode(str)→Uint8Array；WebTransport/加密/文件的前置。说「字节转换」即此。
items.pe: Strings are UTF-8 bytes in waiting.

definition.zh: TextEncoder/TextDecoder 在字符串与 UTF-8 字节间转换，是加密、流处理与二进制协议的必备件。
definition.en: Strings to UTF-8 bytes and back.

distinction.zh: 与 atob/btoa 的区别：那是 base64；编码 API 处理任意 Unicode → UTF-8 字节。
distinction.en: UTF-8 bytes vs strings; atob/btoa is base64, not text encoding.

items.dz: 全双工长连接：服务器可主动推。
items.de: Full-duplex socket with server push.
items.pz: new WebSocket(url) + onmessage：协作编辑/行情推送。说「长连接推送」即此。
items.pe: The server can speak first.

definition.zh: WebSocket 经握手升级为 TCP 全双工帧通道：双向低延迟推送，适合协作与实时行情。
definition.en: Full-duplex socket with server push.

distinction.zh: 与 SSE 的区别：SSE 是单向服务器推送（文本），WebSocket 双向二进制；与轮询的区别：无常连开销。
distinction.en: Full-duplex frames; SSE is server-to-client text only.

items.dz: 基于 QUIC 的现代低延迟传输：流+数据报。
items.de: QUIC-based streams and datagrams.
items.pz: WebTransport 替代 WebSocket 的下一代：多流无队头阻塞、可靠/不可靠双模。说「QUIC 通道」即此。
items.pe: Streams without head-of-line blocking.

definition.zh: WebTransport 基于 HTTP/3 QUIC：多路并发流（无队头阻塞）与不可靠数据报并存。
definition.en: QUIC-based streams and datagrams.

distinction.zh: 与 WebSocket 的区别：WebSocket 单 TCP 流（一丢全堵）；WebTransport 流间独立且可选不可靠交付。
distinction.en: QUIC streams with no head-of-line blocking; WebSocket multiplexes over one TCP stream.

items.dz: 同源页签间的直接消息通道。
items.de: Direct messaging between same-origin tabs.
items.pz: new BroadcastChannel("app").postMessage——多页签登出同步。说「页签广播」即此。
items.pe: Tabs talking to tabs.

definition.zh: BroadcastChannel 在同源的所有页签/worker 间广播消息（发布-订阅语义）。
definition.en: Direct messaging between same-origin tabs.

distinction.zh: 与 storage 事件的区别：storage 是键值变化的旁听，BroadcastChannel 是显式消息总线（可传结构化对象）。
distinction.en: Explicit same-origin messaging; storage events eavesdrop on KV writes.

items.dz: 页面之外的常驻代理：离线缓存与推送的宿主。
items.de: The persistent proxy: offline and push host.
items.pz: SW 拦截 fetch → 缓存策略（cache-first / network-first）→ 离线可用。说「离线优先」即此。
items.pe: Fetch interception is the superpower.

definition.zh: Service Worker 是独立于页面的常驻脚本：拦截 fetch 实现离线缓存策略，并承载推送通知与后台同步。
definition.en: The persistent proxy: offline and push host.

distinction.zh: 与 HTTP 缓存的区别：HTTP 缓存是被动的，SW 是可编程的请求代理；生命周期独立于页面。
distinction.en: A programmable fetch proxy with its own lifecycle; HTTP cache is passive.

items.dz: 授权后读写用户选择的本地文件/目录。
items.de: Read and write user-picked files and folders.
items.pz: showOpenFilePicker + createWritable——本地优先应用（编辑器/工具）。说「直接读写文件」即此。
items.pe: A writable handle, not a download.

definition.zh: File System Access 提供用户授权的文件/目录读写句柄（createWritable 就地保存），句柄可存入 IndexedDB 续用。
definition.en: Read and write user-picked files and folders.

distinction.zh: 与 <input type=file> 的区别：input 只读一次；FSA 可写回、可枚举目录、句柄可复用。
distinction.en: Writable persistent handles; input[type=file] is one-shot read-only.

items.dz: 授权访问摄像头/麦克风流。
items.de: Permissioned camera and microphone streams.
items.pz: getUserMedia({video}) → video.srcObject = stream。说「开摄像头」即此。
items.pe: Stream, then attach.

definition.zh: getUserMedia 在授权后返回摄像头/麦克风的 MediaStream，可接 video/Web Audio/录制器。
definition.en: Permissioned camera and microphone streams.

distinction.zh: 与 screen capture 的区别：capture 取摄像头麦克风，getDisplayMedia 取屏幕；流都可进 analyser 做可视化。
distinction.en: Camera/mic streams; getDisplayMedia captures screens instead.

items.dz: 选择屏幕/窗口/页签进行录制或共享。
items.de: Capture a screen, window or tab.
items.pz: getDisplayMedia({video}) —— 屏幕共享/录屏教程。说「录屏」即此。
items.pe: Share a screen, window or tab.

definition.zh: getDisplayMedia 让用户选择要共享的屏幕/窗口/页签，返回 MediaStream 供录制或传输。
definition.en: Capture a screen, window or tab.

distinction.zh: 与 getUserMedia 的区别：来源是屏幕而非摄像头；常与 WebRTC/WebTransport 组合成远程协作。
distinction.en: Screen/window/tab sources; getUserMedia captures devices.
