items.pe: A strict modular grid, a grotesque face, flush-left ragged-right text, and a single accent colour on exactly one geometric element.

definition.zh: 网格、无衬线、一条红斜线
definition.en: Grid, grotesque, one red rule

distinction.zh: 严格模块网格 + Helvetica 类字体 + 齐左不齐右；单一强调色只出现在一个几何元素上，绝不铺满。
distinction.en: A strict modular grid, a grotesque face, flush-left ragged-right text, and a single accent colour on exactly one geometric element.

items.dz: 圆方三角与三原色
items.de: Circle, square, triangle, primaries
items.pz: 基本几何形 + 红黄蓝 + 无衬线全大写；形体承担全部装饰，绝不加纹理与阴影。构成要能拆成尺规能画出来的元素。
items.pe: Primitive geometry, red/yellow/blue, uppercase sans. Form carries all decoration — no texture, no shadow. Everything drawable with compass and rule.

definition.zh: 圆方三角与三原色
definition.en: Circle, square, triangle, primaries

distinction.zh: 基本几何形 + 红黄蓝 + 无衬线全大写；形体承担全部装饰，绝不加纹理与阴影。构成要能拆成尺规能画出来的元素。
distinction.en: Primitive geometry, red/yellow/blue, uppercase sans. Form carries all decoration — no texture, no shadow. Everything drawable with compass and rule.

items.dz: 像一篇论文的图，而不是营销页
items.de: Figures from a paper, not a marketing page
items.pz: 白底细线 + 等宽数字 + 真坐标轴与图例 + 单一强调色；不要渐变、不要入场动画。数字自己会说话。
items.pe: White ground, hairlines, tabular numerals, real axes and legends, one accent. No gradients, no entrance animation — the numbers carry it.

definition.zh: 像一篇论文的图，而不是营销页
definition.en: Figures from a paper, not a marketing page

distinction.zh: 白底细线 + 等宽数字 + 真坐标轴与图例 + 单一强调色；不要渐变、不要入场动画。数字自己会说话。
distinction.en: White ground, hairlines, tabular numerals, real axes and legends, one accent. No gradients, no entrance animation — the numbers carry it.

items.dz: 像一张施工图
items.de: Reads like a construction drawing
items.pz: 蓝底白线或白底细蓝线 + 尺寸标注 + 剖面符号 + 等宽标签；线宽严格分级（0.25 / 0.5 / 1pt），标注比图形更重要。
items.pe: Blue ground with white lines, dimension callouts, section marks, monospace labels. Line weights strictly graded — the annotation matters more than the drawing.

definition.zh: 像一张施工图
definition.en: Reads like a construction drawing

distinction.zh: 蓝底白线或白底细蓝线 + 尺寸标注 + 剖面符号 + 等宽标签；线宽严格分级（0.25 / 0.5 / 1pt），标注比图形更重要。
distinction.en: Blue ground with white lines, dimension callouts, section marks, monospace labels. Line weights strictly graded — the annotation matters more than the drawing.

items.dz: 像一本杂志的内页，而不是一个落地页
items.de: A magazine spread, not a landing page
items.pz: 衬线大标题 + 多栏正文 + 图注小字；靠栏宽变化与首字下沉建立阅读节奏，导航退成一行细字。
items.pe: Serif display, multi-column body, small captions. Rhythm comes from varying measure and a drop cap; the nav shrinks to one thin line.

definition.zh: 像一本杂志的内页，而不是一个落地页
definition.en: A magazine spread, not a landing page

distinction.zh: 衬线大标题 + 多栏正文 + 图注小字；靠栏宽变化与首字下沉建立阅读节奏，导航退成一行细字。
distinction.en: Serif display, multi-column body, small captions. Rhythm comes from varying measure and a drop cap; the nav shrinks to one thin line.

items.dz: 报头、栏线、通栏大标题
items.de: A masthead, column rules, a banner headline
items.pz: 衬线报头 + 多栏细分栏线 + 报纸灰纸底 + 图注小字；标题层级用字号跨度而不是颜色，双线分隔是签名动作。
items.pe: A serif masthead, hairline column rules, newsprint grey, small captions. Hierarchy by size jumps, never colour; the double rule is the signature.

definition.zh: 报头、栏线、通栏大标题
definition.en: A masthead, column rules, a banner headline

distinction.zh: 衬线报头 + 多栏细分栏线 + 报纸灰纸底 + 图注小字；标题层级用字号跨度而不是颜色，双线分隔是签名动作。
distinction.en: A serif masthead, hairline column rules, newsprint grey, small captions. Hierarchy by size jumps, never colour; the double rule is the signature.

items.dz: 产品长得像一份文档
items.de: The product looks like a document
items.pz: 左侧目录 + 单栏正文 + 行内块编辑 + 极浅分隔线；字体层级少，靠间距分节，光标是唯一的动效。
items.pe: A sidebar outline, one text column, inline blocks, near-invisible rules. Few type levels; spacing does the sectioning and the caret is the only motion.

definition.zh: 产品长得像一份文档
definition.en: The product looks like a document

distinction.zh: 左侧目录 + 单栏正文 + 行内块编辑 + 极浅分隔线；字体层级少，靠间距分节，光标是唯一的动效。
distinction.en: A sidebar outline, one text column, inline blocks, near-invisible rules. Few type levels; spacing does the sectioning and the caret is the only motion.

items.dz: 把汉字当成版面主体，不是英文版式的填空
items.de: Han characters as the subject, not filler in a Latin layout
items.pz: 大字号中文标题 + 字重只用两级 + 行高 1.5 以上 + 标点挤压；英文降为辅助行，字距靠字号而不是 letter-spacing。
items.pe: Large Han display type, only two weights, line-height above 1.5, punctuation kerned. Latin drops to a support line; rhythm from size, not letter-spacing.

definition.zh: 把汉字当成版面主体，不是英文版式的填空
definition.en: Han characters as the subject, not filler in a Latin layout

distinction.zh: 大字号中文标题 + 字重只用两级 + 行高 1.5 以上 + 标点挤压；英文降为辅助行，字距靠字号而不是 letter-spacing。
distinction.en: Large Han display type, only two weights, line-height above 1.5, punctuation kerned. Latin drops to a support line; rhythm from size, not letter-spacing.

items.dz: 近黑的夜空里挂着一颗会呼吸的球
items.de: A breathing orb hung in a near-black sky
items.pz: 近黑冷底 + 一颗大尺寸发光球体（月/星/环）+ 极简中文大字 + 一条细高光；渐变必须细，球体只有一个光源。
items.pe: A near-black cool ground, one oversized luminous orb, minimal large CJK type, one hairline specular. Faint gradients; the orb takes exactly one light.

definition.zh: 近黑的夜空里挂着一颗会呼吸的球
definition.en: A breathing orb hung in a near-black sky

distinction.zh: 近黑冷底 + 一颗大尺寸发光球体（月/星/环）+ 极简中文大字 + 一条细高光；渐变必须细，球体只有一个光源。
distinction.en: A near-black cool ground, one oversized luminous orb, minimal large CJK type, one hairline specular. Faint gradients; the orb takes exactly one light.

items.dz: 半透明面板浮在彩色背景上
items.de: Frosted panels floating over colour
items.pz: backdrop-filter:blur + 8–16% 白底 + 1px 高光描边；必须有彩色或图像背景才成立，且要盯住正文对比度。
items.pe: backdrop-filter blur, an 8–16% white fill, a 1px light border. It only works over colour or imagery — and body contrast needs watching.

definition.zh: 半透明面板浮在彩色背景上
definition.en: Frosted panels floating over colour

distinction.zh: backdrop-filter:blur + 8–16% 白底 + 1px 高光描边；必须有彩色或图像背景才成立，且要盯住正文对比度。
distinction.en: backdrop-filter blur, an 8–16% white fill, a 1px light border. It only works over colour or imagery — and body contrast needs watching.

items.dz: 控件像从同色表面顶出来的
items.de: Controls extruded from a same-colour surface
items.pz: 同色底 + 一对相反方向的柔和内外阴影；对比天生偏低，交互态必须再加边框或色彩兜底，否则不可用。
items.pe: One surface colour with paired soft light/dark shadows. Contrast is inherently low — back every interaction state with a border or colour or it fails accessibility.

definition.zh: 控件像从同色表面顶出来的
definition.en: Controls extruded from a same-colour surface

distinction.zh: 同色底 + 一对相反方向的柔和内外阴影；对比天生偏低，交互态必须再加边框或色彩兜底，否则不可用。
distinction.en: One surface colour with paired soft light/dark shadows. Contrast is inherently low — back every interaction state with a border or colour or it fails accessibility.

items.dz: 一切都像捏出来的软陶
items.de: Everything looks moulded from clay
items.pz: 超大圆角 + 双层柔和内外阴影 + 低饱和粉彩；形体要"胖"，描边为零，投影要软到看不出边界。
items.pe: Huge radii, layered soft inner and outer shadows, pastel fills. Forms are chubby, strokes are zero, shadows soft enough to have no edge.

definition.zh: 一切都像捏出来的软陶
definition.en: Everything looks moulded from clay

distinction.zh: 超大圆角 + 双层柔和内外阴影 + 低饱和粉彩；形体要"胖"，描边为零，投影要软到看不出边界。
distinction.en: Huge radii, layered soft inner and outer shadows, pastel fills. Forms are chubby, strokes are zero, shadows soft enough to have no edge.

items.dz: 界面模仿真实材质
items.de: The interface imitates real material
items.pz: 材质贴图、缝线、金属高光、真实投影；隐喻必须一致，别一半木纹一半扁平。光源方向全站统一。
items.pe: Textures, stitching, metal speculars, real shadows. Keep the metaphor consistent — no half wood-grain, half flat — and one light direction site-wide.

definition.zh: 界面模仿真实材质
definition.en: The interface imitates real material

distinction.zh: 材质贴图、缝线、金属高光、真实投影；隐喻必须一致，别一半木纹一半扁平。光源方向全站统一。
distinction.en: Textures, stitching, metal speculars, real shadows. Keep the metaphor consistent — no half wood-grain, half flat — and one light direction site-wide.

items.dz: 素材本身就是装饰
items.de: The material is the decoration
items.pz: 米白与灰褐 + 天然材质留痕 + 大量负空间 + 细字重；不对称构图，禁止纯黑与高饱和，动效慢到几乎察觉不到。
items.pe: Off-white and taupe, visible material grain, deep negative space, light weights. Asymmetric; no pure black, no saturation, motion slow to the edge of perception.

definition.zh: 素材本身就是装饰
definition.en: The material is the decoration

distinction.zh: 米白与灰褐 + 天然材质留痕 + 大量负空间 + 细字重；不对称构图，禁止纯黑与高饱和，动效慢到几乎察觉不到。
distinction.en: Off-white and taupe, visible material grain, deep negative space, light weights. Asymmetric; no pure black, no saturation, motion slow to the edge of perception.

items.dz: 克制、高级、留白买不起
items.de: Restrained, expensive, space you can’t afford
items.pz: 暗色或米色底 + 细衬线大写标题 + 宽字距 + 金铜色细节；动效必须慢，任何弹跳都掉价。CTA 只用描边。
items.pe: Dark or ivory ground, light serif caps, wide tracking, brass details. Motion must be slow — any bounce cheapens it. CTAs are outline only.

definition.zh: 克制、高级、留白买不起
definition.en: Restrained, expensive, space you can’t afford

distinction.zh: 暗色或米色底 + 细衬线大写标题 + 宽字距 + 金铜色细节；动效必须慢，任何弹跳都掉价。CTA 只用描边。
distinction.en: Dark or ivory ground, light serif caps, wide tracking, brass details. Motion must be slow — any bounce cheapens it. CTAs are outline only.

items.dz: 不修饰，硬碰硬
items.de: Unfinished on purpose, hard against hard
items.pz: 默认字体、纯黑白、无圆角无阴影、超大字号压满版；把 HTML 的结构本身暴露出来当装饰。
items.pe: System type, pure black and white, no radius, no shadow, headline pushed to the edges. The raw HTML structure is the decoration.

definition.zh: 不修饰，硬碰硬
definition.en: Unfinished on purpose, hard against hard

distinction.zh: 默认字体、纯黑白、无圆角无阴影、超大字号压满版；把 HTML 的结构本身暴露出来当装饰。
distinction.en: System type, pure black and white, no radius, no shadow, headline pushed to the edges. The raw HTML structure is the decoration.

items.dz: 粗黑描边 + 硬投影 + 高饱和色块
items.de: Thick outlines, hard offset shadows, loud blocks
items.pz: 2–3px 纯黑描边、4–6px 无模糊位移阴影、荧光色块；圆角可有可无，但阴影必须是硬的，按下时位移要真。
items.pe: A 2–3px black outline, a 4–6px zero-blur offset shadow, fluorescent fills. Radius optional; the shadow must stay hard and the press must really move.

definition.zh: 粗黑描边 + 硬投影 + 高饱和色块
definition.en: Thick outlines, hard offset shadows, loud blocks

distinction.zh: 2–3px 纯黑描边、4–6px 无模糊位移阴影、荧光色块；圆角可有可无，但阴影必须是硬的，按下时位移要真。
distinction.en: A 2–3px black outline, a 4–6px zero-blur offset shadow, fluorescent fills. Radius optional; the shadow must stay hard and the press must really move.

items.dz: 像复印机印坏的小册子
items.de: A photocopier having a bad day
items.pz: 高对比二值化图 + 复印噪点 + 手写与打字机混排 + 歪斜贴纸；不对齐才是对的，边缘要有脏。
items.pe: Hard-threshold images, copier noise, typewriter and handwriting mixed, skewed stickers. Misalignment is the point, and the edges must be dirty.

definition.zh: 像复印机印坏的小册子
definition.en: A photocopier having a bad day

distinction.zh: 高对比二值化图 + 复印噪点 + 手写与打字机混排 + 歪斜贴纸；不对齐才是对的，边缘要有脏。
distinction.en: Hard-threshold images, copier noise, typewriter and handwriting mixed, skewed stickers. Misalignment is the point, and the edges must be dirty.

items.dz: 故意打破所有惯例
items.de: Every convention broken on purpose
items.pz: 错位网格、冲突字体、诡异配色、非常规交互；必须留一条清晰的主动线，否则只是坏设计而不是反设计。
items.pe: Off-grid, clashing faces, awkward colour, unconventional interaction. Keep one clear path through — otherwise it is merely bad design.

definition.zh: 故意打破所有惯例
definition.en: Every convention broken on purpose

distinction.zh: 错位网格、冲突字体、诡异配色、非常规交互；必须留一条清晰的主动线，否则只是坏设计而不是反设计。
distinction.en: Off-grid, clashing faces, awkward colour, unconventional interaction. Keep one clear path through — otherwise it is merely bad design.

items.dz: 字本身就是图像
items.de: The letterform is the image
items.pz: 可变字体极端轴值 + 字形变形拉伸叠印 + 破格网格；可读性只保住一个层级即可，其余交给张力。
items.pe: Extreme variable-font axes, distorted and overprinted glyphs, a broken grid. Only one level needs to stay legible; the rest is tension.

definition.zh: 字本身就是图像
definition.en: The letterform is the image

distinction.zh: 可变字体极端轴值 + 字形变形拉伸叠印 + 破格网格；可读性只保住一个层级即可，其余交给张力。
distinction.en: Extreme variable-font axes, distorted and overprinted glyphs, a broken grid. Only one level needs to stay legible; the rest is tension.

items.dz: 像 1998 年的网页
items.de: A page from 1998
items.pz: 系统窗口边框、蓝色带下划线的超链接、表格布局、访客计数器；克制地怀旧，不要真的用 <blink>。
items.pe: System window chrome, blue underlined links, table layout, a hit counter. Nostalgic on purpose — skip the actual <blink>.

definition.zh: 像 1998 年的网页
definition.en: A page from 1998

distinction.zh: 系统窗口边框、蓝色带下划线的超链接、表格布局、访客计数器；克制地怀旧，不要真的用 <blink>。
distinction.en: System window chrome, blue underlined links, table layout, a hit counter. Nostalgic on purpose — skip the actual <blink>.

items.dz: 镀铬、半透明、液态形体
items.de: Chrome, translucency, liquid forms
items.pz: 金属渐变文字 + 亚克力质感 + 气泡与光晕；冷色高光要有明确的光源方向，斜体是必需的。
items.pe: Metallic gradient type, acrylic surfaces, bubbles and bloom. Give the cool speculars one consistent light direction — and italics are mandatory.

definition.zh: 镀铬、半透明、液态形体
definition.en: Chrome, translucency, liquid forms

distinction.zh: 金属渐变文字 + 亚克力质感 + 气泡与光晕；冷色高光要有明确的光源方向，斜体是必需的。
distinction.en: Metallic gradient type, acrylic surfaces, bubbles and bloom. Give the cool speculars one consistent light direction — and italics are mandatory.

items.dz: 上世纪想象的未来
items.de: The future as the last century imagined it
items.pz: 太空时代插画 + 橙棕配色 + 圆角科技造型；字体用宽体几何无衬线，别用现代科技风的窄体。
items.pe: Space-age illustration, burnt-orange palette, rounded techno forms, wide geometric sans. Never a modern narrow tech face.

definition.zh: 上世纪想象的未来
definition.en: The future as the last century imagined it

distinction.zh: 太空时代插画 + 橙棕配色 + 圆角科技造型；字体用宽体几何无衬线，别用现代科技风的窄体。
distinction.en: Space-age illustration, burnt-orange palette, rounded techno forms, wide geometric sans. Never a modern narrow tech face.

items.dz: 粉紫落日与网格地平线
items.de: A magenta sunset over a grid horizon
items.pz: 粉紫青三色 + 透视网格地面 + 全角标题 + 石膏像；刻意的 VHS 噪点与色偏，标题要有 RGB 分离。
items.pe: Magenta/cyan/violet, a perspective grid floor, full-width type, plaster busts, deliberate VHS noise and an RGB-split headline.

definition.zh: 粉紫落日与网格地平线
definition.en: A magenta sunset over a grid horizon

distinction.zh: 粉紫青三色 + 透视网格地面 + 全角标题 + 石膏像；刻意的 VHS 噪点与色偏，标题要有 RGB 分离。
distinction.en: Magenta/cyan/violet, a perspective grid floor, full-width type, plaster busts, deliberate VHS noise and an RGB-split headline.

items.dz: 每个像素都是手放的
items.de: Every pixel placed by hand
items.pz: 固定像素网格 + image-rendering:pixelated + 有限调色板；缩放必须整数倍，动画走 steps() 不走补间。
items.pe: A fixed pixel grid, image-rendering: pixelated, a limited palette. Scale by whole integers, and animate with steps() — never tween.

definition.zh: 每个像素都是手放的
definition.en: Every pixel placed by hand

distinction.zh: 固定像素网格 + image-rendering:pixelated + 有限调色板；缩放必须整数倍，动画走 steps() 不走补间。
distinction.en: A fixed pixel grid, image-rendering: pixelated, a limited palette. Scale by whole integers, and animate with steps() — never tween.

items.dz: 折线、圆点、撞色几何
items.de: Squiggles, dots, clashing geometry
items.pz: 80 年代孟菲斯派：饱和撞色 + 波浪与网格图案 + 随机散布几何；构图故意不对称，但底色必须统一。
items.pe: The 80s Memphis school — clashing saturated colour, squiggle and grid patterns, scattered geometry, deliberately asymmetric over one unifying ground.

definition.zh: 折线、圆点、撞色几何
definition.en: Squiggles, dots, clashing geometry

distinction.zh: 80 年代孟菲斯派：饱和撞色 + 波浪与网格图案 + 随机散布几何；构图故意不对称，但底色必须统一。
distinction.en: The 80s Memphis school — clashing saturated colour, squiggle and grid patterns, scattered geometry, deliberately asymmetric over one unifying ground.

items.dz: 黑底、细渐变、一条发光的线
items.de: Black ground, subtle gradients, one glowing line
items.pz: 近黑背景 + 极低饱和文字 + 单一冷光焦点；渐变必须细，一旦浓就变成廉价科技感。边框用 1px 微亮。
items.pe: Near-black ground, desaturated text, one cold light focus. Keep gradients faint — heavy ones read as cheap tech. Borders are 1px, barely lit.

definition.zh: 黑底、细渐变、一条发光的线
definition.en: Black ground, subtle gradients, one glowing line

distinction.zh: 近黑背景 + 极低饱和文字 + 单一冷光焦点；渐变必须细，一旦浓就变成廉价科技感。边框用 1px 微亮。
distinction.en: Near-black ground, desaturated text, one cold light focus. Keep gradients faint — heavy ones read as cheap tech. Borders are 1px, barely lit.

items.dz: 大小不一的方块拼满一屏
items.de: Unequal tiles tiling the whole screen
items.pz: 一套统一圆角与间距的模块网格，每格一个信息单元；格子跨列跨行制造节奏，禁止格内再分栏。
items.pe: A modular grid with one radius and one gap; one idea per tile. Rhythm comes from spans — never sub-divide a tile.

definition.zh: 大小不一的方块拼满一屏
definition.en: Unequal tiles tiling the whole screen

distinction.zh: 一套统一圆角与间距的模块网格，每格一个信息单元；格子跨列跨行制造节奏，禁止格内再分栏。
distinction.en: A modular grid with one radius and one gap; one idea per tile. Rhythm comes from spans — never sub-divide a tile.

items.dz: 一屏之内看完全部指标
items.de: Every metric on one screen
items.pz: 卡片化 KPI + 图表网格 + 状态色（升/降）；密度高但要有明确的视觉层级与对齐基线，数字用等宽。
items.pe: KPI cards, a chart grid, semantic up/down colour. High density still needs one hierarchy, one baseline, and tabular numerals.

definition.zh: 一屏之内看完全部指标
definition.en: Every metric on one screen

distinction.zh: 卡片化 KPI + 图表网格 + 状态色（升/降）；密度高但要有明确的视觉层级与对齐基线，数字用等宽。
distinction.en: KPI cards, a chart grid, semantic up/down colour. High density still needs one hierarchy, one baseline, and tabular numerals.

items.dz: 纸片有厚度，光从上方来
items.de: Sheets with elevation, light from above
items.pz: 海拔阴影体系 + 主色/次色/表面色 token + 涟漪反馈；阴影只表示层级，不当装饰。
items.pe: An elevation shadow system, primary/secondary/surface tokens, ripple feedback. Shadows encode depth, never decoration.

definition.zh: 纸片有厚度，光从上方来
definition.en: Sheets with elevation, light from above

distinction.zh: 海拔阴影体系 + 主色/次色/表面色 token + 涟漪反馈；阴影只表示层级，不当装饰。
distinction.en: An elevation shadow system, primary/secondary/surface tokens, ripple feedback. Shadows encode depth, never decoration.

items.dz: 整站像一个终端会话
items.de: The whole site is a terminal session
items.pz: 等宽字体 + 命令行提示符 + 光标 + 制表符边框；配色沿用 solarized / gruvbox / nord 这类既成主题，别自创。
items.pe: Monospace, a prompt, a cursor, box-drawing frames. Borrow an established scheme — solarized, gruvbox, nord — never invent one.

definition.zh: 整站像一个终端会话
definition.en: The whole site is a terminal session

distinction.zh: 等宽字体 + 命令行提示符 + 光标 + 制表符边框；配色沿用 solarized / gruvbox / nord 这类既成主题，别自创。
distinction.en: Monospace, a prompt, a cursor, box-drawing frames. Borrow an established scheme — solarized, gruvbox, nord — never invent one.

items.dz: 几团颜色互相渗透
items.de: Colour blooms bleeding into each other
items.pz: 多个 radial-gradient 叠加 + 大半径柔化 + 缓慢位移；颜色数控制在 3–4 个，超了就变脏。
items.pe: Stack radial gradients, soften them wide, drift slowly. Three or four hues maximum — more turns muddy.

definition.zh: 几团颜色互相渗透
definition.en: Colour blooms bleeding into each other

distinction.zh: 多个 radial-gradient 叠加 + 大半径柔化 + 缓慢位移；颜色数控制在 3–4 个，超了就变脏。
distinction.en: Stack radial gradients, soften them wide, drift slowly. Three or four hues maximum — more turns muddy.

items.dz: 整页就是一个可进入的场景
items.de: The page is a scene you enter
items.pz: WebGL 场景 + 滚动驱动相机 + DOM 只放少量文字；必须给静态首帧与降级路径，否则弱设备直接白屏。
items.pe: A WebGL scene with a scroll-driven camera and very little DOM text. Always ship a static first frame and a fallback, or weak devices see white.

definition.zh: 整页就是一个可进入的场景
definition.en: The page is a scene you enter

distinction.zh: WebGL 场景 + 滚动驱动相机 + DOM 只放少量文字；必须给静态首帧与降级路径，否则弱设备直接白屏。
distinction.en: A WebGL scene with a scroll-driven camera and very little DOM text. Always ship a static first frame and a fallback, or weak devices see white.

items.dz: 看得见每一个三角面
items.de: Every triangle stays visible
items.pz: 刻意保留低面数 + 平面着色（flat shading）+ 明确的面间明暗差；绝不开平滑法线，那会毁掉整个语言。
items.pe: Keep the poly count low, use flat shading, let adjacent faces differ clearly. Never smooth the normals — that kills the whole language.

definition.zh: 看得见每一个三角面
definition.en: Every triangle stays visible

distinction.zh: 刻意保留低面数 + 平面着色（flat shading）+ 明确的面间明暗差；绝不开平滑法线，那会毁掉整个语言。
distinction.en: Keep the poly count low, use flat shading, let adjacent faces differ clearly. Never smooth the normals — that kills the whole language.

items.dz: 30° 斜轴上的小世界
items.de: A small world on a 30° axis
items.pz: 固定 30° 等轴投影、无透视收缩、三面明暗固定；所有物件共用一套光照与网格，一处破轴全盘就散。
items.pe: A fixed 30° axonometric projection, no perspective convergence, three constant face values. One light and one grid for everything — one broken axis ruins it.

definition.zh: 30° 斜轴上的小世界
definition.en: A small world on a 30° axis

distinction.zh: 固定 30° 等轴投影、无透视收缩、三面明暗固定；所有物件共用一套光照与网格，一处破轴全盘就散。
distinction.en: A fixed 30° axonometric projection, no perspective convergence, three constant face values. One light and one grid for everything — one broken axis ruins it.

items.dz: 霓虹、高密度信息、雨夜都市
items.de: Neon, dense information, a wet city at night
items.pz: 深色底 + 两种霓虹色（品红/青）+ 扫描线与故障；信息要"过载"，但正文仍需 4.5:1 对比。
items.pe: Dark ground, two neon hues (magenta/cyan), scanlines and glitch. Overload the information — but keep body text at 4.5:1.

definition.zh: 霓虹、高密度信息、雨夜都市
definition.en: Neon, dense information, a wet city at night

distinction.zh: 深色底 + 两种霓虹色（品红/青）+ 扫描线与故障；信息要"过载"，但正文仍需 4.5:1 对比。
distinction.en: Dark ground, two neon hues (magenta/cyan), scanlines and glitch. Overload the information — but keep body text at 4.5:1.

items.dz: 照片去色，字压上去
items.de: Desaturate the photo, set type over it
items.pz: 全站灰度 + 一张主图占 60% 以上 + 大衬线标题压图；只允许一个彩色元素破局，那就是 CTA。
items.pe: Full greyscale, one image over 60% of the frame, a serif headline across it. Exactly one colour element may break it — the CTA.

definition.zh: 照片去色，字压上去
definition.en: Desaturate the photo, set type over it

distinction.zh: 全站灰度 + 一张主图占 60% 以上 + 大衬线标题压图；只允许一个彩色元素破局，那就是 CTA。
distinction.en: Full greyscale, one image over 60% of the frame, a serif headline across it. Exactly one colour element may break it — the CTA.

items.dz: 像时装杂志的封面
items.de: A fashion cover, not a homepage
items.pz: 超大细衬线标题压人像 + 极少 UI + 大量出血图；导航退成一行小字，CTA 只是一条下划线。
items.pe: An oversized light serif over a portrait, almost no UI, full-bleed imagery. The nav shrinks to one small line; the CTA is just an underline.

definition.zh: 像时装杂志的封面
definition.en: A fashion cover, not a homepage

distinction.zh: 超大细衬线标题压人像 + 极少 UI + 大量出血图；导航退成一行小字，CTA 只是一条下划线。
distinction.en: An oversized light serif over a portrait, almost no UI, full-bleed imagery. The nav shrinks to one small line; the CTA is just an underline.

items.dz: 像手撕纸片贴出来的版面
items.de: Torn paper, taped down
items.pz: 纸质纹理 + 撕边遮罩 + 轻微旋转与投影 + 手写标注；每片素材角度不同才有拼贴感，白色缝隙要清脆。
items.pe: Paper texture, torn-edge masks, slight rotations with shadows, handwritten notes. Vary every angle and keep the white gutters crisp.

definition.zh: 像手撕纸片贴出来的版面
definition.en: Torn paper, taped down

distinction.zh: 纸质纹理 + 撕边遮罩 + 轻微旋转与投影 + 手写标注；每片素材角度不同才有拼贴感，白色缝隙要清脆。
distinction.en: Paper texture, torn-edge masks, slight rotations with shadows, handwritten notes. Vary every angle and keep the white gutters crisp.

items.dz: 滚动就是翻页
items.de: Scrolling is turning the page
items.pz: 滚动位置驱动章节切换：sticky 画面 + 递进文字；每屏只推进一个信息，进度必须可见。
items.pe: Scroll position drives chapters — a sticky visual with advancing text. One idea per screen, and always show progress.

definition.zh: 滚动就是翻页
definition.en: Scrolling is turning the page

distinction.zh: 滚动位置驱动章节切换：sticky 画面 + 递进文字；每屏只推进一个信息，进度必须可见。
distinction.en: Scroll position drives chapters — a sticky visual with advancing text. One idea per screen, and always show progress.

items.dz: 一半字，一半图，中缝就是版式
items.de: Half type, half image — the seam is the layout
items.pz: 50/50 或 40/60 硬分割 + 两侧独立滚动或对比材质；分割线位置全站保持一致，缝隙不加圆角。
items.pe: A hard 50/50 or 40/60 split, each side its own material or scroll. Keep the seam in the same place site-wide, and never round it.

definition.zh: 一半字，一半图，中缝就是版式
definition.en: Half type, half image — the seam is the layout

distinction.zh: 50/50 或 40/60 硬分割 + 两侧独立滚动或对比材质；分割线位置全站保持一致，缝隙不加圆角。
distinction.en: A hard 50/50 or 40/60 split, each side its own material or scroll. Keep the seam in the same place site-wide, and never round it.

items.dz: 几何形当图像用
items.de: Geometry standing in for imagery
items.pz: 大块几何形 + 一个饱和色 + 图形与字重叠；形体裁切要跨出容器边界才有张力。
items.pe: Big geometric masses, one saturated hue, shapes overlapping the type. Let forms bleed past the container edge or the tension dies.

definition.zh: 几何形当图像用
definition.en: Geometry standing in for imagery

distinction.zh: 大块几何形 + 一个饱和色 + 图形与字重叠；形体裁切要跨出容器边界才有张力。
distinction.en: Big geometric masses, one saturated hue, shapes overlapping the type. Let forms bleed past the container edge or the tension dies.

items.dz: 一张会动的海报当首页
items.de: A poster that moves, used as a homepage
items.pz: 整屏一张海报构图 + 循环动效（字距/位移/遮罩）+ 极少导航；所有节奏对齐同一个循环长度。
items.pe: One poster composition filling the viewport, a looping motion (tracking, shift, mask), almost no nav. All timing on one loop length.

definition.zh: 一张会动的海报当首页
definition.en: A poster that moves, used as a homepage

distinction.zh: 整屏一张海报构图 + 循环动效（字距/位移/遮罩）+ 极少导航；所有节奏对齐同一个循环长度。
distinction.en: One poster composition filling the viewport, a looping motion (tracking, shift, mask), almost no nav. All timing on one loop length.

items.dz: 动效是主角，不是点缀
items.de: Motion is the subject, not the garnish
items.pz: 入场/滚动/悬停三层动效编排成一条线，用统一的缓动与时长阶梯；必须尊重 reduced-motion。
items.pe: Entrance, scroll and hover choreographed as one line with a shared easing and duration ladder. Honour reduced-motion.

definition.zh: 动效是主角，不是点缀
definition.en: Motion is the subject, not the garnish

distinction.zh: 入场/滚动/悬停三层动效编排成一条线，用统一的缓动与时长阶梯；必须尊重 reduced-motion。
distinction.en: Entrance, scroll and hover choreographed as one line with a shared easing and duration ladder. Honour reduced-motion.

items.dz: 没有一条直线
items.de: Not a single straight line
items.pz: blob 形状 + 不规则圆角 + 柔和低饱和色；用 border-radius 四值或 SVG 路径造形，别用对称椭圆。
items.pe: Blob forms, asymmetric radii, soft muted colour. Shape with four-value radii or SVG paths — symmetric ellipses read as clip-art.

definition.zh: 没有一条直线
definition.en: Not a single straight line

distinction.zh: blob 形状 + 不规则圆角 + 柔和低饱和色；用 border-radius 四值或 SVG 路径造形，别用对称椭圆。
distinction.en: Blob forms, asymmetric radii, soft muted colour. Shape with four-value radii or SVG paths — symmetric ellipses read as clip-art.

items.dz: 线条有抖动，颜色出框
items.de: Wobbling strokes, colour outside the lines
items.pz: 不规则手绘线 + 蜡笔质感填色 + 手写体标注；线宽要有粗细变化，否则像矢量描边而不是手绘。
items.pe: Irregular strokes, crayon fills, handwritten notes. Vary stroke weight — even weight reads as vector outline, not hand.

definition.zh: 线条有抖动，颜色出框
definition.en: Wobbling strokes, colour outside the lines

distinction.zh: 不规则手绘线 + 蜡笔质感填色 + 手写体标注；线宽要有粗细变化，否则像矢量描边而不是手绘。
distinction.en: Irregular strokes, crayon fills, handwritten notes. Vary stroke weight — even weight reads as vector outline, not hand.

items.dz: 统一线宽的插画
items.de: Illustration at one stroke weight
items.pz: 全站插画同一线宽（1.5–2px）与同一端点形状；填色只作为线稿背后的色块，绝不替代线。
items.pe: One stroke weight (1.5–2px) and one cap style everywhere. Colour sits behind the line, never replaces it.

definition.zh: 统一线宽的插画
definition.en: Illustration at one stroke weight

distinction.zh: 全站插画同一线宽（1.5–2px）与同一端点形状；填色只作为线稿背后的色块，绝不替代线。
distinction.en: One stroke weight (1.5–2px) and one cap style everywhere. Colour sits behind the line, never replaces it.

items.dz: 真实的绿，不是品牌绿
items.de: Real green, not brand green
items.pz: 实景摄影 + 森林绿与土色 + 手写点缀；关键是照片真实，避免图库式"可持续插画"和柔焦绿。
items.pe: Documentary photography, forest greens and earth tones, one handwritten accent. Real photos — skip stock sustainability art and soft-focus green.

definition.zh: 真实的绿，不是品牌绿
definition.en: Real green, not brand green

distinction.zh: 实景摄影 + 森林绿与土色 + 手写点缀；关键是照片真实，避免图库式"可持续插画"和柔焦绿。
distinction.en: Documentary photography, forest greens and earth tones, one handwritten accent. Real photos — skip stock sustainability art and soft-focus green.

items.dz: 乐观的绿色未来
items.de: An optimistic green future
items.pz: 植物 + 明亮金绿 + 装饰性新艺术曲线 + 通透玻璃；和赛博朋克相反：明亮、有机、可持续。
items.pe: Plants, bright gold-greens, art-nouveau curves, clear glass. The inverse of cyberpunk — bright, organic, sustainable.

definition.zh: 乐观的绿色未来
definition.en: An optimistic green future

distinction.zh: 植物 + 明亮金绿 + 装饰性新艺术曲线 + 通透玻璃；和赛博朋克相反：明亮、有机、可持续。
distinction.en: Plants, bright gold-greens, art-nouveau curves, clear glass. The inverse of cyberpunk — bright, organic, sustainable.

items.dz: 填满、堆叠、喧闹但有序
items.de: Full, stacked, loud — and still ordered
items.pz: 多色多字体多图层，但用一套网格与一个统一底色收住；阅读焦点仍然只留一个。
items.pe: Many colours, faces and layers held by one grid and one ground colour. Still exactly one reading focus.

definition.zh: 填满、堆叠、喧闹但有序
definition.en: Full, stacked, loud — and still ordered

distinction.zh: 多色多字体多图层，但用一套网格与一个统一底色收住；阅读焦点仍然只留一个。
distinction.en: Many colours, faces and layers held by one grid and one ground colour. Still exactly one reading focus.

items.dz: 一张抖出来的黑白点阵图当整页主角，字是等宽，颜色只有黑与白
items.de: One dithered black-and-white image carries the page; monospace type, no colour at all
items.pz: 把照片压成 1bit：阈值抖动或网点半调，全站只留黑白两色加一款等宽字，标题和正文靠字号拉开层级。抖动是刻意的，不是压缩失真。
items.pe: Reduce photography to 1-bit with order dithering or halftone, hold the palette to black and white, and let one monospace face carry display and body copy through size alone. The dither is deliberate, not a compression artefact.

definition.zh: 一张抖出来的黑白点阵图当整页主角，字是等宽，颜色只有黑与白
definition.en: One dithered black-and-white image carries the page; monospace type, no colour at all

distinction.zh: 把照片压成 1bit：阈值抖动或网点半调，全站只留黑白两色加一款等宽字，标题和正文靠字号拉开层级。抖动是刻意的，不是压缩失真。
distinction.en: Reduce photography to 1-bit with order dithering or halftone, hold the palette to black and white, and let one monospace face carry display and body copy through size alone. The dither is deliberate, not a compression artefact.

items.dz: 一块点阵屏加一个旋钮，像硬件面板而不是网页
items.de: A dot-matrix display and a knob — a hardware panel, not a web page
items.pz: 主视觉用 LED 点阵屏，背景是细网格，标签一律等宽大写；按钮画成实体键，带按下位移和轻微投影。整体直角、低饱和、金属灰。
items.pe: Lead with an LED matrix, lay a hairline grid behind everything, set every label in uppercase mono, and draw buttons as physical keys that travel when pressed. Right angles, desaturated grey, no ornament.

definition.zh: 一块点阵屏加一个旋钮，像硬件面板而不是网页
definition.en: A dot-matrix display and a knob — a hardware panel, not a web page

distinction.zh: 主视觉用 LED 点阵屏，背景是细网格，标签一律等宽大写；按钮画成实体键，带按下位移和轻微投影。整体直角、低饱和、金属灰。
distinction.en: Lead with an LED matrix, lay a hairline grid behind everything, set every label in uppercase mono, and draw buttons as physical keys that travel when pressed. Right angles, desaturated grey, no ornament.

items.dz: 一张满幅人物大片顶在最上面，标题粗到有点过分
items.de: A full-bleed campaign photo on top, headline heavier than it needs to be
items.pz: 首屏就是一张满幅人物照，粗黑无衬线标题压在图上；商品用横滑一排在下面。动效只做位移和缩放，不玩花活。
items.pe: Open with a full-bleed photo, set the headline in the heaviest grotesque you can justify, and put products in a single horizontal rail under it. Motion is limited to translate and scale.

definition.zh: 一张满幅人物大片顶在最上面，标题粗到有点过分
definition.en: A full-bleed campaign photo on top, headline heavier than it needs to be

distinction.zh: 首屏就是一张满幅人物照，粗黑无衬线标题压在图上；商品用横滑一排在下面。动效只做位移和缩放，不玩花活。
distinction.en: Open with a full-bleed photo, set the headline in the heaviest grotesque you can justify, and put products in a single horizontal rail under it. Motion is limited to translate and scale.

items.dz: 白墙、黑字、大留白，标题大而中性，说明字小到几乎听不见
items.de: White walls, black type, vast margins — big neutral headline, whisper-small captions
items.pz: 底色接近纯白但不刺眼；标题用中性无衬线或过渡衬线，字距收一点。展览信息、票务、赞助人一律小字排在底部，中间只放一件作品。
items.pe: Near-white ground, one neutral sans or transitional serif at display size with tight tracking, and everything logistical — dates, tickets, credits — set small along the base. The middle belongs to a single work.

definition.zh: 白墙、黑字、大留白，标题大而中性，说明字小到几乎听不见
definition.en: White walls, black type, vast margins — big neutral headline, whisper-small captions

distinction.zh: 底色接近纯白但不刺眼；标题用中性无衬线或过渡衬线，字距收一点。展览信息、票务、赞助人一律小字排在底部，中间只放一件作品。
distinction.en: Near-white ground, one neutral sans or transitional serif at display size with tight tracking, and everything logistical — dates, tickets, credits — set small along the base. The middle belongs to a single work.

items.dz: 栏目多、字号小、行距松，用细边框把每一块分开
items.de: Many columns, small type, generous leading — every block fenced by a hairline
items.pz: 信息密度高但不挤：正文 12–13px、行高 1.9，块与块之间只用 1px 细线分隔；配色克制到近乎无色，重点靠加粗和缩进。
items.pe: Dense but unhurried: 12–13px body at 1.9 leading, blocks separated only by hairlines, a palette that is almost no palette. Emphasis comes from weight and indent, never from colour.

definition.zh: 栏目多、字号小、行距松，用细边框把每一块分开
definition.en: Many columns, small type, generous leading — every block fenced by a hairline

distinction.zh: 信息密度高但不挤：正文 12–13px、行高 1.9，块与块之间只用 1px 细线分隔；配色克制到近乎无色，重点靠加粗和缩进。
distinction.en: Dense but unhurried: 12–13px body at 1.9 leading, blocks separated only by hairlines, a palette that is almost no palette. Emphasis comes from weight and indent, never from colour.

items.dz: 一列窄栏、大量留白，链接是深蓝不是亮色
items.de: A single narrow column, a lot of margin, links in navy rather than a bright accent
items.pz: 正文一栏不超过 60 字符，中线对齐；链接用深蓝加下划线，激活态才变色。图片小、少、方，其余交给留白。
items.pe: Keep the measure under 60 characters on the centre line. Links are navy with an underline and only change on activation. Images stay small, few and square; everything else is margin.

definition.zh: 一列窄栏、大量留白，链接是深蓝不是亮色
definition.en: A single narrow column, a lot of margin, links in navy rather than a bright accent

distinction.zh: 正文一栏不超过 60 字符，中线对齐；链接用深蓝加下划线，激活态才变色。图片小、少、方，其余交给留白。
distinction.en: Keep the measure under 60 characters on the centre line. Links are navy with an underline and only change on activation. Images stay small, few and square; everything else is margin.

items.dz: 深底加一块高饱和色，节目单是列表，播放器常驻底部
items.de: A dark ground, one saturated block, a schedule as a plain list, a player that never leaves
items.pz: 背景近黑，主色只用一个高饱和色；节目按时间排成无边框列表，当前节目用色块标出。底部常驻一条播放器，字号收紧、字距拉近。
items.pe: Near-black ground, exactly one saturated accent. The schedule is an unfenced list ordered by time, the current slot marked by a colour block, and a player bar that stays put. Type tight, tracking tighter.

definition.zh: 深底加一块高饱和色，节目单是列表，播放器常驻底部
definition.en: A dark ground, one saturated block, a schedule as a plain list, a player that never leaves

distinction.zh: 背景近黑，主色只用一个高饱和色；节目按时间排成无边框列表，当前节目用色块标出。底部常驻一条播放器，字号收紧、字距拉近。
distinction.en: Near-black ground, exactly one saturated accent. The schedule is an unfenced list ordered by time, the current slot marked by a colour block, and a player bar that stays put. Type tight, tracking tighter.

items.dz: 近黑的底、金色细线、衬线标题，产品放正中间
items.de: Near-black ground, gold hairlines, a serif headline and the product dead centre
items.pz: 底色压到近黑，分隔线用 1px 香槟金；标题是衬线，正文小到 9px 并拉开字距。产品永远居中，四周全是留白。
items.pe: Push the ground to near-black and draw every divider in a 1px champagne gold. Serif headline, 9px body with open tracking, the product always centred and nothing crowding it.

definition.zh: 近黑的底、金色细线、衬线标题，产品放正中间
definition.en: Near-black ground, gold hairlines, a serif headline and the product dead centre

distinction.zh: 底色压到近黑，分隔线用 1px 香槟金；标题是衬线，正文小到 9px 并拉开字距。产品永远居中，四周全是留白。
distinction.en: Push the ground to near-black and draw every divider in a 1px champagne gold. Serif headline, 9px body with open tracking, the product always centred and nothing crowding it.

items.dz: 表格优先，行高固定，字号极小，颜色只用来标状态
items.de: Table first: fixed row heights, tiny type, colour used only to mark state
items.pz: 一切对齐到列：站名、时间、站台三列，行高恒定 22px；红蓝是功能色不是装饰色。信息层级靠字重和灰阶，不靠色块。
items.pe: Everything snaps to columns — name, time, platform — at a fixed 22px row height. Red and blue are functional signals, never decoration. Hierarchy comes from weight and grey level, not fills.

definition.zh: 表格优先，行高固定，字号极小，颜色只用来标状态
definition.en: Table first: fixed row heights, tiny type, colour used only to mark state

distinction.zh: 一切对齐到列：站名、时间、站台三列，行高恒定 22px；红蓝是功能色不是装饰色。信息层级靠字重和灰阶，不靠色块。
distinction.en: Everything snaps to columns — name, time, platform — at a fixed 22px row height. Red and blue are functional signals, never decoration. Hierarchy comes from weight and grey level, not fills.

items.dz: 半透明彩色叠在一起，圆角很大，阴影很浅
items.de: Translucent colour layers stacked, generous rounding, barely-there shadow
items.pz: 彩色层用 40%–70% 透明叠加，背景是柔和渐变；圆角 18–22px，阴影浅到几乎看不见。文字压在玻璃上，靠字重而不是描边保证可读。
items.pe: Stack colour layers at 40–70% opacity over a soft gradient, round corners to 18–22px, and keep shadows almost invisible. Type sits on the glass and stays readable through weight, not outlines.

definition.zh: 半透明彩色叠在一起，圆角很大，阴影很浅
definition.en: Translucent colour layers stacked, generous rounding, barely-there shadow

distinction.zh: 彩色层用 40%–70% 透明叠加，背景是柔和渐变；圆角 18–22px，阴影浅到几乎看不见。文字压在玻璃上，靠字重而不是描边保证可读。
distinction.en: Stack colour layers at 40–70% opacity over a soft gradient, round corners to 18–22px, and keep shadows almost invisible. Type sits on the glass and stays readable through weight, not outlines.

items.dz: 米白纸底、手绘标本、拉丁学名用小字排在下面
items.de: Cream paper, drawn specimens, Latin binomials set small beneath
items.pz: 底色偏米黄像旧纸；插画用细线平涂，不描边不渐变。每张卡下方是中文学名 + 拉丁双名 + 采集地，字小但整齐。
items.pe: A cream ground that reads as old paper, plates drawn in flat fills with hairline outlines, and each card footed by local name, Latin binomial and locality in small orderly type.

definition.zh: 米白纸底、手绘标本、拉丁学名用小字排在下面
definition.en: Cream paper, drawn specimens, Latin binomials set small beneath

distinction.zh: 底色偏米黄像旧纸；插画用细线平涂，不描边不渐变。每张卡下方是中文学名 + 拉丁双名 + 采集地，字小但整齐。
distinction.en: A cream ground that reads as old paper, plates drawn in flat fills with hairline outlines, and each card footed by local name, Latin binomial and locality in small orderly type.

items.dz: 页面本身就是一张字体样本：大字试样、极窄行距、等宽小字标注
items.de: The page is the specimen: giant glyphs, razor-tight leading, mono metadata
items.pz: 主视觉直接排大字试样，行距压到 0.86；字重、字号、字距用等宽小字标在旁边。不放大图，页面说的一切都由字承担。
items.pe: Set the specimen itself as the hero at 0.86 leading, and annotate weight, size and tracking in mono down the side. No imagery: the type carries every claim on the page.

definition.zh: 页面本身就是一张字体样本：大字试样、极窄行距、等宽小字标注
definition.en: The page is the specimen: giant glyphs, razor-tight leading, mono metadata

distinction.zh: 主视觉直接排大字试样，行距压到 0.86；字重、字号、字距用等宽小字标在旁边。不放大图，页面说的一切都由字承担。
distinction.en: Set the specimen itself as the hero at 0.86 leading, and annotate weight, size and tracking in mono down the side. No imagery: the type carries every claim on the page.

dz: 用字符和点当像素：真实地理数据生成的字符地球与点阵地图、抖动灰阶、终端图形
de: Characters and dots used as pixels — a real-geometry ASCII globe and dot-matrix map, dithered ramps, terminal graphics

items.dz: 真实的大陆在自转，不是贴图
items.de: Real continents, actually rotating
items.pz: 正射投影（orthographic）逐帧把经纬网格投到圆盘上：每个屏幕点反解出经纬度，查陆海掩膜决定画不画，再按 cos(角距) 做球面明暗。这里把 36 帧（每 10° 经度）烤成一张 6×6 精灵图，用 steps() 切帧——横向步进列、纵向步进行，两条动画各管一个 background-position 分量。
items.pe: Orthographic projection, frame by frame: invert each screen point to lon/lat, test it against a land mask, then shade by cos of the angular distance. Here 36 frames (10° of longitude each) are baked into a 6×6 sprite and stepped with steps() — one animation walks the columns, another the rows.

definition.zh: 真实的大陆在自转，不是贴图
definition.en: Real continents, actually rotating

distinction.zh: 正射投影（orthographic）逐帧把经纬网格投到圆盘上：每个屏幕点反解出经纬度，查陆海掩膜决定画不画，再按 cos(角距) 做球面明暗。这里把 36 帧（每 10° 经度）烤成一张 6×6 精灵图，用 steps() 切帧——横向步进列、纵向步进行，两条动画各管一个 background-position 分量。
distinction.en: Orthographic projection, frame by frame: invert each screen point to lon/lat, test it against a land mask, then shade by cos of the angular distance. Here 36 frames (10° of longitude each) are baked into a 6×6 sprite and stepped with steps() — one animation walks the columns, another the rows.

items.zh: 点阵地图 · 节点与航线
items.dz: 干净的点阵底图，上面跑一条航线
items.de: A clean dot plate with one route drawn across it
items.pz: 底图是等距圆柱投影的规则点阵：先把陆地栅格化，再按单元格覆盖率（≥34%）决定是否落点，孤点剔除，南极裁掉——点距约为点径的四倍才够干净。节点用同心 box-shadow 做脉冲环，航线用 border-radius 的一段圆弧配 clip-path 逐段画出。
items.pe: The plate is a regular grid in equirectangular projection: rasterise the land, keep a cell only if ≥34% covered, drop orphans, clip Antarctica. Pitch should be about four times the dot radius. Nodes pulse with concentric box-shadows; the route is an arc of a rounded box revealed by clip-path.

definition.zh: 干净的点阵底图，上面跑一条航线
definition.en: A clean dot plate with one route drawn across it

distinction.zh: 底图是等距圆柱投影的规则点阵：先把陆地栅格化，再按单元格覆盖率（≥34%）决定是否落点，孤点剔除，南极裁掉——点距约为点径的四倍才够干净。节点用同心 box-shadow 做脉冲环，航线用 border-radius 的一段圆弧配 clip-path 逐段画出。
distinction.en: The plate is a regular grid in equirectangular projection: rasterise the land, keep a cell only if ≥34% covered, drop orphans, clip Antarctica. Pitch should be about four times the dot radius. Nodes pulse with concentric box-shadows; the route is an arc of a rounded box revealed by clip-path.

items.dz: 同一份地理数据，落到字符网格上
items.de: The same geometry, resampled onto a character grid
items.pz: 字符格不是正方形（约 1:2），所以纵向要多压一倍才不变形。每格取陆地覆盖率，≥42% 给 █，≥18% 给 ·，其余留空——两级就够，三级以上开始显脏。
items.pe: Character cells are about 1:2, so squash twice as much vertically. Take land coverage per cell: ≥42% gets █, ≥18% gets ·, the rest stays blank. Two levels is enough — three starts to look dirty.

definition.zh: 同一份地理数据，落到字符网格上
definition.en: The same geometry, resampled onto a character grid

distinction.zh: 字符格不是正方形（约 1:2），所以纵向要多压一倍才不变形。每格取陆地覆盖率，≥42% 给 █，≥18% 给 ·，其余留空——两级就够，三级以上开始显脏。
distinction.en: Character cells are about 1:2, so squash twice as much vertically. Take land coverage per cell: ≥42% gets █, ≥18% gets ·, the rest stays blank. Two levels is enough — three starts to look dirty.

items.dz: 一道斜波扫过整片字符
items.de: One diagonal wave sweeping the field
items.pz: 整片同一个字形，只用 animation-delay 沿索引递增制造相位差；delay 用负值动画就不必等第一轮跑完。
items.pe: One glyph everywhere; phase comes from an animation-delay that grows with the cell index. Negative delays start the field mid-cycle.

definition.zh: 一道斜波扫过整片字符
definition.en: One diagonal wave sweeping the field

distinction.zh: 整片同一个字形，只用 animation-delay 沿索引递增制造相位差；delay 用负值动画就不必等第一轮跑完。
distinction.en: One glyph everywhere; phase comes from an animation-delay that grows with the cell index. Negative delays start the field mid-cycle.

items.dz: 从左到右越来越"重"
items.de: Ink weight climbing left to right
items.pz: 按列给不同的字重与透明度，就得到一条可读的密度梯度——字符版的灰阶条。
items.pe: Weight and alpha per column give a readable density ramp — the character-grid version of a greyscale wedge.

definition.zh: 从左到右越来越"重"
definition.en: Ink weight climbing left to right

distinction.zh: 按列给不同的字重与透明度，就得到一条可读的密度梯度——字符版的灰阶条。
distinction.en: Weight and alpha per column give a readable density ramp — the character-grid version of a greyscale wedge.

items.dz: 越暗的地方字符越"重"
items.de: Darker areas take heavier glyphs
items.pz: 把亮度 0–255 映射到一张按笔画密度排序的字符表（" .:-=+*#%@"），这一步叫 luminance ramp。表的单调性比长度重要。
items.pe: Map luminance 0–255 onto a glyph table ordered by ink density (" .:-=+*#%@") — the luminance ramp. Monotonicity matters more than length.

definition.zh: 越暗的地方字符越"重"
definition.en: Darker areas take heavier glyphs

distinction.zh: 把亮度 0–255 映射到一张按笔画密度排序的字符表（" .:-=+*#%@"），这一步叫 luminance ramp。表的单调性比长度重要。
distinction.en: Map luminance 0–255 onto a glyph table ordered by ink density (" .:-=+*#%@") — the luminance ramp. Monotonicity matters more than length.

items.dz: 只有四级墨，看着是连续渐变
items.de: Four ink levels reading as a smooth gradient
items.pz: 4×4 Bayer 矩阵做阈值抖动，用 ░▒▓█ 表现灰阶。它的花纹是确定性的，所以放大不会像噪点抖动那样"沙沙"。
items.pe: A 4×4 Bayer threshold matrix over ░▒▓█. The pattern is deterministic, so it never fizzes the way noise dithering does when scaled.

definition.zh: 只有四级墨，看着是连续渐变
definition.en: Four ink levels reading as a smooth gradient

distinction.zh: 4×4 Bayer 矩阵做阈值抖动，用 ░▒▓█ 表现灰阶。它的花纹是确定性的，所以放大不会像噪点抖动那样"沙沙"。
distinction.en: A 4×4 Bayer threshold matrix over ░▒▓█. The pattern is deterministic, so it never fizzes the way noise dithering does when scaled.

items.dz: 同样一格字符，四倍分辨率
items.de: Four times the resolution per cell
items.pz: U+2800 盲文块每格 2×4 点，是终端里能拿到的最高有效分辨率；btop、gnuplot 的字符图都靠它。
items.pe: U+2800 braille cells pack 2×4 dots — the highest usable resolution in a terminal. btop and gnuplot lean on it.

definition.zh: 同样一格字符，四倍分辨率
definition.en: Four times the resolution per cell

distinction.zh: U+2800 盲文块每格 2×4 点，是终端里能拿到的最高有效分辨率；btop、gnuplot 的字符图都靠它。
distinction.en: U+2800 braille cells pack 2×4 dots — the highest usable resolution in a terminal. btop and gnuplot lean on it.

items.dz: 一列列字符往下掉
items.de: Columns of glyphs falling
items.pz: 每列一个独立速度与偏移的字符流，头部最亮、尾部指数衰减；尾迹用一层 mask 渐变，比逐字设透明度便宜得多。
items.pe: One stream per column, each with its own speed and offset: bright head, exponential tail. A single gradient mask is far cheaper than per-glyph opacity.

definition.zh: 一列列字符往下掉
definition.en: Columns of glyphs falling

distinction.zh: 每列一个独立速度与偏移的字符流，头部最亮、尾部指数衰减；尾迹用一层 mask 渐变，比逐字设透明度便宜得多。
distinction.en: One stream per column, each with its own speed and offset: bright head, exponential tail. A single gradient mask is far cheaper than per-glyph opacity.

items.dz: 用字符拼出的巨大标题
items.de: A headline built out of characters
items.pz: FIGlet / toilet 字体把每个字母展开成多行字符网格，标准 banner 高 6 行；CI 日志与 CLI 欢迎页的常见开场。
items.pe: FIGlet fonts expand each letter into a multi-row grid; the standard banner is six rows. Ubiquitous in CI logs and CLI splash screens.

definition.zh: 用字符拼出的巨大标题
definition.en: A headline built out of characters

distinction.zh: FIGlet / toilet 字体把每个字母展开成多行字符网格，标准 banner 高 6 行；CI 日志与 CLI 欢迎页的常见开场。
distinction.en: FIGlet fonts expand each letter into a multi-row grid; the standard banner is six rows. Ubiquitous in CI logs and CLI splash screens.

items.dz: 纯字符画出来的面板
items.de: A panel drawn entirely in glyphs
items.pz: U+2500 制表符（─│┌┐└┘├┤┬┴┼）拼边框与分栏，是 ncurses / TUI 的基本材料；宽度必须按字符数算，不能按像素。
items.pe: The U+2500 box-drawing range builds frames and splits — the raw material of ncurses and every TUI. Size everything in characters, never pixels.

definition.zh: 纯字符画出来的面板
definition.en: A panel drawn entirely in glyphs

distinction.zh: U+2500 制表符（─│┌┐└┘├┤┬┴┼）拼边框与分栏，是 ncurses / TUI 的基本材料；宽度必须按字符数算，不能按像素。
distinction.en: The U+2500 box-drawing range builds frames and splits — the raw material of ncurses and every TUI. Size everything in characters, never pixels.

items.dz: 一个字符位上的旋转
items.de: Rotation inside a single cell
items.pz: 一组等宽帧（⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏ 或 |/-\）用 steps() 逐帧切换，80–120ms 一帧最不晃眼。
items.pe: A ring of equal-width frames stepped with steps(); 80–120ms per frame reads best.

definition.zh: 一个字符位上的旋转
definition.en: Rotation inside a single cell

distinction.zh: 一组等宽帧（⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏ 或 |/-\）用 steps() 逐帧切换，80–120ms 一帧最不晃眼。
distinction.en: A ring of equal-width frames stepped with steps(); 80–120ms per frame reads best.

items.dz: 方块一格一格填满
items.de: Blocks filling one cell at a time
items.pz: 整格用 █，余数用 ▏▎▍▌▋▊▉ 做八分之一细分——tqdm / pv 就是这么画的，比像素条更容易对齐日志。
items.pe: Full cells in █, the remainder in the ▏▎▍▌▋▊▉ eighths — how tqdm and pv draw it, and it aligns with log text.

definition.zh: 方块一格一格填满
definition.en: Blocks filling one cell at a time

distinction.zh: 整格用 █，余数用 ▏▎▍▌▋▊▉ 做八分之一细分——tqdm / pv 就是这么画的，比像素条更容易对齐日志。
distinction.en: Full cells in █, the remainder in the ▏▎▍▌▋▊▉ eighths — how tqdm and pv draw it, and it aligns with log text.

items.dz: 那个方块一直在呼吸
items.de: The block that never stops blinking
items.pz: VT100 光标是 530ms 硬切（steps(1)），不是淡入淡出；软光标才用 opacity 过渡。
items.pe: A VT100 cursor hard-switches about every 530ms with steps(1) — only soft cursors fade.

definition.zh: 那个方块一直在呼吸
definition.en: The block that never stops blinking

distinction.zh: VT100 光标是 530ms 硬切（steps(1)），不是淡入淡出；软光标才用 opacity 过渡。
distinction.en: A VT100 cursor hard-switches about every 530ms with steps(1) — only soft cursors fade.

items.dz: 一行行日志自己往上走
items.de: Log lines climbing on their own
items.pz: 定高容器 + 整体 translateY，进入时给一档 opacity 台阶；时间戳与数字用等宽对齐，日志才不抖。
items.pe: A fixed-height box, one translateY on the block, an opacity step as rows enter. Tabular figures keep timestamps from jittering.

definition.zh: 一行行日志自己往上走
definition.en: Log lines climbing on their own

distinction.zh: 定高容器 + 整体 translateY，进入时给一档 opacity 台阶；时间戳与数字用等宽对齐，日志才不抖。
distinction.en: A fixed-height box, one translateY on the block, an opacity step as rows enter. Tabular figures keep timestamps from jittering.

items.dz: 一行字符里的趋势线
items.de: A trend line inside one line of text
items.pz: 把序列归一化到 ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ 八级块字符，一行字就是一张图；状态栏里最省地方的可视化。
items.pe: Normalise the series onto the ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ eighths — one line of text becomes a chart. The cheapest viz in any status bar.

definition.zh: 一行字符里的趋势线
definition.en: A trend line inside one line of text

distinction.zh: 把序列归一化到 ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ 八级块字符，一行字就是一张图；状态栏里最省地方的可视化。
distinction.en: Normalise the series onto the ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ eighths — one line of text becomes a chart. The cheapest viz in any status bar.

items.dz: 用方块排出来的排行榜
items.de: A ranking drawn in blocks
items.pz: 标签左对齐、条形用 █ 重复、数值右对齐等宽——CLI 报表的标准三栏，宽度按最长标签定。
items.pe: Left-aligned labels, repeated █ bars, right-aligned tabular values — the standard three columns of a CLI report, sized by the longest label.

definition.zh: 用方块排出来的排行榜
definition.en: A ranking drawn in blocks

distinction.zh: 标签左对齐、条形用 █ 重复、数值右对齐等宽——CLI 报表的标准三栏，宽度按最长标签定。
distinction.en: Left-aligned labels, repeated █ bars, right-aligned tabular values — the standard three columns of a CLI report, sized by the longest label.

items.dz: 字符组成的流动色场
items.de: A flowing colour field made of glyphs
items.pz: 多个正弦叠加（sin(x)+sin(y)+sin(x+y+t)）求值后查字符表，是 demoscene 的入门题；这里用一层渐变裁进字里。
items.pe: Sum a few sines — sin(x)+sin(y)+sin(x+y+t) — and look the value up in the ramp. The demoscene starter exercise; here a gradient is clipped into the glyphs.

definition.zh: 字符组成的流动色场
definition.en: A flowing colour field made of glyphs

distinction.zh: 多个正弦叠加（sin(x)+sin(y)+sin(x+y+t)）求值后查字符表，是 demoscene 的入门题；这里用一层渐变裁进字里。
distinction.en: Sum a few sines — sin(x)+sin(y)+sin(x+y+t) — and look the value up in the ramp. The demoscene starter exercise; here a gradient is clipped into the glyphs.

items.dz: 像老显示器那样有横纹和辉光
items.de: Old-monitor stripes and phosphor glow
items.pz: 偶数行叠半透明黑（repeating-linear-gradient），再加 text-shadow 磷光与极轻的桶形畸变；扫描线间距必须是整像素，否则会摩尔纹。
items.pe: Overlay a repeating-linear-gradient on alternate rows, add a phosphor text-shadow and a touch of barrel distortion. Keep the stripe pitch on whole pixels or it moirés.

definition.zh: 像老显示器那样有横纹和辉光
definition.en: Old-monitor stripes and phosphor glow

distinction.zh: 偶数行叠半透明黑（repeating-linear-gradient），再加 text-shadow 磷光与极轻的桶形畸变；扫描线间距必须是整像素，否则会摩尔纹。
distinction.en: Overlay a repeating-linear-gradient on alternate rows, add a phosphor text-shadow and a touch of barrel distortion. Keep the stripe pitch on whole pixels or it moirés.

items.dz: 一个字一个字打出来
items.de: One character at a time
items.pz: 等宽字体 + ch 单位宽度配 steps(n)，才不会露出半个字；变宽字体必须改成逐字 span。
items.pe: Monospace plus a ch-unit width stepped with steps(n) — anything else shows half a glyph. Proportional type needs per-character spans.

definition.zh: 一个字一个字打出来
definition.en: One character at a time

distinction.zh: 等宽字体 + ch 单位宽度配 steps(n)，才不会露出半个字；变宽字体必须改成逐字 span。
distinction.en: Monospace plus a ch-unit width stepped with steps(n) — anything else shows half a glyph. Proportional type needs per-character spans.

items.dz: 字符被替换成乱码再复原
items.de: Glyphs corrupt into noise, then resolve
items.pz: 随机替换（scramble）配 steps 抽帧，替换池只取同宽字符，字段宽度才不会跳。
items.pe: Scramble on stepped frames, drawing only from same-width glyphs so the field never reflows.

definition.zh: 字符被替换成乱码再复原
definition.en: Glyphs corrupt into noise, then resolve

distinction.zh: 随机替换（scramble）配 steps 抽帧，替换池只取同宽字符，字段宽度才不会跳。
distinction.en: Scramble on stepped frames, drawing only from same-width glyphs so the field never reflows.

items.dz: 半圆表盘也能用字符画
items.de: Even a dial can be typed
items.pz: 半圆刻度用 ╱╲│ 排布，指针一格反色；htop / btop 的资源表就是这套，读数必须等宽。
items.pe: Arrange ╱╲│ into a half-circle scale and invert one cell for the needle — the htop / btop resource dial. Keep the readout tabular.

definition.zh: 半圆表盘也能用字符画
definition.en: Even a dial can be typed

distinction.zh: 半圆刻度用 ╱╲│ 排布，指针一格反色；htop / btop 的资源表就是这套，读数必须等宽。
distinction.en: Arrange ╱╲│ into a half-circle scale and invert one cell for the needle — the htop / btop resource dial. Keep the readout tabular.

items.dz: Git `--graph` 在提交旁绘出分支结构
items.de: Git `--graph` draws branch structure beside commits
items.pz: 用等宽文本中的 │╱╲ 与提交节点表示分支和合并；Git 默认按拓扑顺序显示图谱。
items.pe: Monospace │╱╲ lanes and commit nodes show branch and merge structure; Git defaults to topological ordering for the graph.

definition.zh: Git log 的 `--graph` 选项会在提交信息旁绘制分支结构，以文本图形呈现提交历史。
definition.en: Git log's `--graph` option draws branch structure beside commit output as a text-based graphical representation of commit history.

distinction.zh: 普通提交列表显示提交顺序；`--graph` 还绘制分支和合并结构。等宽字体与制表字符属于呈现方式。
distinction.en: A plain commit list shows sequence; `--graph` also draws branch and merge structure. Monospace fonts and box-drawing characters are rendering choices.
